title: Evaluating Multi-Task Morphological Concept Learning for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy Assessment in 3D CT
summary: Morphological characteristics such as spiculation and lobulation play an important role in assessing pulmonary nodules on computed tomography (CT), particularly in relation to malignancy risk. This study examines whether learning radiologist-annotated morphological features together with malignancy risk from lesion-centred 3D CT volumes improves classification performance. The Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset was used, comprising 3,918 reader-level nodule annotations from 742 patients after excluding indeterminate malignancy ratings. Patient-level splitting was used for training, validation, and testing, with 112 patients and 628 reader annotations in the held-out test set. A single-task 3D convolutional neural network was compared with a multi-task model predicting malignancy risk, spiculation, and lobulation. The single-task model achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.548 and receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.552, while the multi-task model achieved 0.539 and 0.558, respectively. Patient-level bootstrap analysis showed an ROC-AUC difference of 0.005 (95% confidence interval (CI): -0.087 to 0.090) and a balanced-accuracy difference of -0.009 (95% CI: -0.067 to 0.043). The auxiliary tasks were strongly imbalanced and showed limited predictive performance. Overall, including morphological features did not clearly improve malignancy-risk classification, showing the importance of class balance, label formulation, and reader-level annotation structure in multi-task pulmonary CT analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在三维CT肺结节分析中，将放射科医生标注的形态学特征（毛刺、分叶）与恶性风险一起进行多任务学习，是否能提升分类性能。结果显示多任务学习未带来明显改善。
AI.motivation: 毛刺、分叶等形态学特征在评估肺结节恶性风险中很重要。作者希望验证：以病灶为中心的三维CT体积中，同时学习放射科医生标注的形态学特征与恶性风险，能否改善分类表现。这关系到如何更好地利用医生标注信息进行多任务学习。
AI.method: 使用LIDC-IDRI数据集，排除不确定恶性评分后，获得742名患者的3,918条读者级结节标注。按患者划分训练、验证与测试集，测试集含112名患者、628条读者标注。对比单任务3D卷积神经网络与同时预测恶性风险、毛刺、分叶的多任务模型。并采用患者级bootstrap分析评估差异。
AI.result: 单任务模型平衡准确率0.548，ROC-AUC 0.552；多任务模型分别为0.539和0.558。患者级bootstrap显示ROC-AUC差异为0.005（95% CI：-0.087至0.090），平衡准确率差异为-0.009（95% CI：-0.067至0.043）。辅助任务类别极不平衡，预测性能有限。
AI.conclusion: 加入形态学特征并未明显改善恶性风险分类。结果说明类别平衡、标签构建方式及读者级标注结构在多任务肺部CT分析中具有重要性。

title: Masked Swingers: Harnessing Data Augmentation to Advance Autoencoders for Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) removes the need for annotations and makes models that are capable across more domains than supervised learning. The autoencoder SSL framework learns by reconstructing its own input after information loss through a bottleneck or noise injection. Masked autoencoders (MAE) are the most successful instantiation of this framework: they encode a random subset of patches, then decode the masked-out patches. In this work, we introduce key modifications to improve MAEs. Our method augments an image in two different ways, then masks and encodes each view separately. It then exchanges the global representations (CLS tokens) between views before decoding the masked patches. By design, our Masked Swingers encourages learning a view-agnostic summary of the image to facilitate efficient transfer. We perform extensive experiments, and find Masked Swingers outperforms MAE by +3-5% on ImageNet-1K kNN and provides large gains on fine-grained tasks, e.g., relative gains of +45% on instance retrieval, +22% on animal re-ID, and +76% on Omniglot character recognition. To boot, Swingers reduces error -64% relative to MAE on three new state-probing datasets, opening the door to world modeling. Welcome to our Swingers party.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Masked Swingers，一种改进的掩码自编码器（MAE）自监督框架：对图像进行两种增强后分别掩码编码，并在解码被掩码patch前交换两视图的全局表示（CLS token），从而促使模型学习视图无关的图像摘要，显著提升迁移与细粒度任务表现。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习无需标注且跨域能力更强，其中掩码自编码器（MAE）是最成功的实现。但MAE仅从单一视图重建被掩码patch，所学表示可能偏向视图特定信息，限制了迁移与细粒度任务的效果，因此需要改进以学习更通用的表示。
AI.method: 对同一图像施加两种不同的数据增强，得到两个视图；分别对每个视图进行掩码与编码；在解码被掩码patch前，交换两个视图的全局表示（CLS token）；随后各自解码被掩码patch进行重建。该设计促使模型学习视图无关（view-agnostic）的图像摘要表示。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K kNN上比MAE提升+3-5%；在细粒度任务上大幅提升：实例检索相对提升+45%，动物re-ID提升+22%，Omniglot字符识别提升+76%；在三个新的state-probing数据集上相对MAE误差降低64%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在双视图间交换CLS token，Masked Swingers能够学习视图无关的全局表示，在迁移与细粒度任务上显著优于MAE，并在state-probing任务上表现出色，为世界建模开辟了新的可能性。

title: GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. Our analysis bounds canonical prediction error and establishes that the cross-view and intervention constraints can be jointly satisfied. Empirically, GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning across three VLM backbones, with the main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively. These gains also extend to autonomous driving and embodied reasoning, demonstrating the robust generalization across domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 GaugeVLM，通过显式3D场景中的受控干预构建跨视角关联监督，其核心目标 GaugeDPO 将测量误差转为偏好边际，在三个VLM骨干、10项空间指标上均优于SFT。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在同一空间关系的不同视角间会自相矛盾，且当该关系发生变化时无法响应。解决这些失败需要能捕捉误差幅度与跨观测几何依赖的监督信号，而基于单答案或序数偏好的训练隐含了这些结构，未加以显式利用。
AI.method: 在显式3D场景中通过受控的物体与相机干预，生成带测量差值与跨视角共享真值的关联观测，将结构显式化。核心目标 GaugeDPO：把测量误差转成偏好边际；直接监督跨视角的正确规范排序；将干预引起的答案几率对比与实测关系变化通过视角特定尺度相连接。并给出规范预测误差的界，证明跨视角约束与干预约束可联合满足。
AI.result: 在三个VLM骨干上，GaugeVLM 在全部10项既有空间度量上超过监督微调；主模型7B在MSMU距离与QSpatial+上分别提升15.0与18.9个百分点。增益亦延伸至自动驾驶与具身推理，体现跨域泛化。
AI.conclusion: 显式的几何结构与误差幅度监督是可落地的学习信号，能一致改善VLM的空间关系理解并跨域泛化。

title: It Takes Little to Rewrite Perception: Targeted Semantic Substitution in Vision-Language Models at $ε\leq 4/255$
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed in safety-critical scenarios, and understanding to which extent they can be controlled by adversarial perturbation is a prerequisite for evaluating their trustworthiness. Existing representation-alignment attacks, which make a VLM perceive a target image, achieve limited success at $\varepsilon \leq 4/255$. Therefore, VLMs seems robust to perturbations in this range. We show that this robustness does not hold, as targeted semantic substitution succeeds within the same range. Specifically, we align each stream of the source image with its counterpart in the target image in the victim VLM's post-merger token space, operating under a white-box threat model. We evaluate under a strict success criterion, requiring the model to simultaneously name the target, confirm its presence, and deny the source. In images, target semantics appear at $\varepsilon = 2/255$ and complete replacement reaches 38\% at $\varepsilon = 4/255$. On video, complete replacement reaches 35.9\% at $\varepsilon = 1/255$. We also observe a phenomenon of \textit{semantic fusion}, where Large Language Model (LLM) rationalizes contradictory visual signals into a coherent narrative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的定向语义替换攻击，在$\varepsilon \leq 4/255$的扰动范围内成功将源图像语义替换为目标语义，打破了VLM在该范围内鲁棒的既有认知。
AI.motivation: VLM广泛部署于安全攸关场景，评估其对抗扰动的可控性是可信度评估的前提。现有表征对齐攻击在$\varepsilon \leq 4/255$时成功率有限，使人误以为VLM在该范围内对扰动鲁棒，本文旨在揭示这种鲁棒性并不成立。
AI.method: 在白盒威胁模型下，于受害VLM融合后的token空间（post-merger token space）中，将源图像的每一路表征与目标图像对应表征进行对齐，实现定向语义替换。采用严格成功判据：模型须同时说出目标、确认其存在并否认源图像。
AI.result: 图像上，目标语义在$\varepsilon = 2/255$时即出现，完整替换在$\varepsilon = 4/255$时达38%；视频上，完整替换在$\varepsilon = 1/255$时达35.9%。此外观察到"语义融合"现象，即LLM将相互矛盾的视觉信号合理化为连贯叙事。
AI.conclusion: VLM在$\varepsilon \leq 4/255$范围内并非鲁棒，定向语义替换在该范围内可行，表明其可信度评估需重新审视，并揭示LLM对矛盾视觉信号的"语义融合"解释现象。

title: Strike a Chord! Modal Kinetic Typography
summary: We introduce modal kinetic typography, which animates a vector glyph to express a semantic concept while keeping it legible. Our key idea is to build motion from the glyph's natural vibration modes. Specifically, a finite-element eigenproblem assembled from the vector outline yields the glyph's softest modes, for the whole letter and for each of its parts, allowing it to bend. The problem's zero-energy solutions, i.e., rigid translations and rotations, are applied in closed form to each part, allowing parts to also move as blocks. To animate the glyph, a frozen video diffusion model supervises only the modes' amplitudes and phases. Our modal approach addresses two weaknesses of prior work. Free-form point optimization under video score distillation (SDS) moves each point and frame independently along noisy gradients, tearing the outline and causing jitter. In contrast, our modes are smooth along the outline and driven by a few whole-cycle harmonics, which restricts these gradients to smooth, seamlessly looping motion. On the other hand, structured alternatives rely on skeletons or keypoints from category-specific priors, whereas our modes come from the glyph itself; the only prior is a list naming each letter's moving parts, generated once for the whole alphabet by a language model. In modal kinetic typography, shape and motion are disentangled by construction: a single base outline is sculpted toward the concept, and the modal drive cannot alter it, so a letter can also be animated without being reshaped. Our method produces more articulated and smoother motion than Dynamic Typography and AniClipart at comparable or better concept alignment, with less glyph tearing than Dynamic Typography, and is preferred by human raters, including in a frozen-shape setting where motion alone must carry the concept. Our results were also preferred over Astra (GPT-6) by human raters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模态动态字体"（modal kinetic typography）：基于矢量字形的有限元特征模态构建运动，对字形及其部件的振幅与相位由冻结的视频扩散模型监督，实现语义化、平滑循环且可读的动态字体动画。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两类缺陷：基于视频分数蒸馏（SDS）的自由点优化逐点逐帧沿噪声梯度独立移动，会导致轮廓撕裂与抖动；而基于骨架或关键点的结构化方法依赖类别特定的先验。作者希望直接从字形自身的几何结构中导出运动，既保持轮廓平滑，又无需外部结构化先验。
AI.method: 从矢量轮廓装配有限元特征问题，求解得到字形整体及其各部件的"最软模态"；问题中的零能解（刚性平移与旋转）以闭式形式施加于各部件，使部件可作为刚体运动。动画时，冻结的视频扩散模型仅监督各模态的振幅与相位。模态仅由少数整周期谐波驱动，故梯度被限制在平滑、无缝循环的运动空间内。
AI.result: 相比 Dynamic Typography 与 AniClipart，本方法产生更具关节化、更平滑的运动，概念对齐度相当或更优，字形撕裂更少；在冻结形状（仅靠运动传达概念）设定下也受到人类评分者偏好，并且结果也被人类评分者偏好于 Astra（GPT-6）。
AI.conclusion: 模态动态字体在构造上实现形状与运动的解耦：单一基础轮廓被塑造以表达概念，而模态驱动无法改变该轮廓，因此字母既可在不重塑的情况下被动画化。该方法以极少的先验（仅由语言模型为整个字母表生成一次的部件命名列表）实现了更优的动态字体生成效果。

title: ExploreNet: Learning Where to Explore in Diffusion GRPO
summary: Group-relative RL methods such as Flow-GRPO post-train image generators by exploring with isotropic Gaussian noise added at every denoising step. This noise decides which rollouts the model learns from, yet it perturbs every channel and spatial position of the latent equally. In this paper, we instead show that latent elements differ in how much they change the generated image, so exploration should adapt to these differences. We introduce EXPLORENET to learn an adaptive exploration distribution. EXPLORENET is a policy that predicts a noise scale for every latent element from the current latent, the denoising step, and the prompt, before any reward is observed; it is trained on the reward spread of each rollout group and discarded after training, leaving inference unchanged. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, EXPLORENET improves held-out GenEval2 by 14% over Flow-GRPO, transfers to two independent compositional benchmarks and five preference and image-quality models, and reaches a 67.2% human preference win-rate. Overall, across our group-relative diffusion RL experiments, we find that exploration is learnable, the shape of the exploration distribution outweighs its magnitude, and rollout quality is more effective than rollout quantity.

AI.tldr: EXPLORENET为扩散模型RL后训练学习自适应探索分布，按潜变量元素预测噪声尺度，显著提升生成质量且不改变推理。
AI.motivation: 现有群组相对RL方法（如Flow-GRPO）在每步去噪加入各向同性高斯噪声进行探索，对所有通道与空间位置施加相同扰动；但潜变量元素对生成图像的影响程度不同，探索应随之自适应，而非均匀施加。
AI.method: 提出EXPLORENET：一个策略网络，在未观测奖励前，依据当前潜变量、去噪步与提示，为每个潜变量元素预测噪声尺度，从而学习自适应探索分布；该网络仅以每个rollout群组的奖励方差（reward spread）为训练信号，训练完成后丢弃，推理过程保持不变。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上，EXPLORENET使留出集GenEval2相较Flow-GRPO提升14%，并可迁移至两个独立组合性基准及五个偏好/图像质量模型，人类偏好胜率达67.2%。
AI.conclusion: 在群组相对扩散RL实验中得出三点结论：探索是可学习的；探索分布的“形状”比其“幅度”更重要；rollout的“质量”比“数量”更有效。

title: Learning Semantic Inpainting for Animatable Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: We present SInGA, a novel method for learning Semantic Inpainting for animatable Gaussian head Avatars from a single image. Existing avatar approaches often rely on multi-view observations and lack effective handling of unobserved regions in single-view settings, limiting their applicability in such scenarios. To address this, we propose a semantic inpainting framework defined in UV space for completing unobserved facial regions. Our key insight lies in the structured topology of the UV representation, which provides consistent spatial correspondences and enables reliable completion of identity-specific features using the inherent symmetry cues of human faces. We extract features from observed regions and use them to complete unobserved regions. The completed representation is then used to regress Gaussian attributes, effectively performing Gaussian inpainting. In addition, instead of relying on a single Gaussian at each surface or pixel location, we stack multiple Gaussians to enhance detail. The resulting avatar generalizes across identities without requiring per-identity optimization and can be animated with driving inputs. Experimental results show that our method generates high-quality head avatars with improved completeness and identity preservation, while supporting realistic animation and consistent rendering from unobserved views.

AI.tldr: 提出SInGA，在UV空间进行语义补全，从单张图像学习可动画的高斯头部化身。
AI.motivation: 现有化身方法依赖多视角观测，在单视角设置下对未观测区域处理不佳，限制了其适用性。
AI.method: 在UV空间构建语义补全框架，利用UV表示的结构化拓扑一致性与人脸对称线索，从观测区域提取特征补全未观测区域；补全后的表示用于回归高斯属性，实现高斯补全；并在每个表面/像素位置堆叠多个高斯以增强细节。
AI.result: 生成高质量头部化身，完整性与身份保持性提升，支持逼真动画，并能从未观测视角进行一致渲染；跨身份泛化，无需逐身份优化。
AI.conclusion: SInGA验证了UV空间语义补全在单图高斯头部化身中的有效性，兼顾完整性、身份保持与动画渲染。

title: TrackFish3D: Self-Supervised 3D Tracking of Schooling Fish from Multi-view Videos
comment: to be published in the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Quantifying collective fish behavior requires accurate trajectories, yet multi-view 3D tracking remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, visually similar individuals, and the long-standing scarcity of identity annotations. We present TrackFish3D, a geometry-driven self-supervised framework for dense multi-camera 3D tracking of schooling fish. Instead of relying on appearance-based re-identification or manually annotated identities, TrackFish3D turns calibrated multi-view geometry into supervision: triangulation and reprojection consistency provide pseudo-associations, while a geometric encoder and global association transformer learn all-to-all cross-view correspondence within each frame. To make these associations identity-aware, TrackFish3D introduces a self-supervised contrastive objective that separates co-visible individuals in the embedding space, together with a temporal predictor that preserves identities and bridges short occlusions across frames. The resulting model is trained once on unlabeled footage and applied directly to unseen test videos, requiring no cross-view identity labels, temporal annotations, 3D ground truth, appearance features, or test-time optimization. On our benchmark, TrackFish3D improves 3D Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy from 87.7% for the strongest baseline to 95.8%. On the 3D-ZeF zebrafish benchmark, it achieves 81.1% MOTA, compared with 77.4% for the best geometric baseline. TrackFish3D also generalizes beyond fish, achieving strong results on real-world bird tracking.

AI.tldr: TrackFish3D：一种几何驱动的自监督框架，用标定多视角几何监督替代身份标注，实现密集多相机3D鱼群跟踪，在自有基准与3D-ZeF上均显著优于基线，并可泛化到鸟类跟踪。
AI.motivation: 多视角3D鱼类跟踪面临频繁遮挡、个体外观高度相似以及长期缺乏身份标注的困难，现有方法依赖外观重识别或人工身份标注，成本高且不可靠。
AI.method: 将标定多视角几何转化为监督信号：利用三角化与重投影一致性生成伪关联；采用几何编码器与全局关联Transformer学习帧内全对全跨视角对应；引入自监督对比目标在嵌入空间分离共视个体，并用时间预测器保持身份、跨越短时遮挡。模型仅在无标注视频上训练一次，测试时无需跨视角身份标签、时序标注、3D真值、外观特征或测试时优化。
AI.result: 在自有基准上，3D多目标跟踪准确率（MOTA）从最强基线的87.7%提升至95.8%；在3D-ZeF斑马鱼基准上达到81.1% MOTA，优于最佳几何基线的77.4%；在真实鸟类跟踪任务上也取得良好效果。
AI.conclusion: 几何驱动的自监督范式可有效替代身份标注与外观线索，实现高精度、可泛化的多视角3D密集跟踪，并具备跨物种迁移能力。

title: Inductive Visual Logic for Few-Shot Out-Of-Distribution Adaptation in VLMs
summary: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) such as Qwen-VL and LLaVA achieve strong zero-shot performance on tasks overlapping with their pretraining distribution, yet fail on specialized domains where the required discriminative features were never learned, a regime we term distant out-of-distribution (OOD). Standard adaptation methods cannot overcome this representational absence because they operate within the encoder's existing feature space. However, VLMs retain a robust descriptive capacity even when discrimination collapses: a model that cannot classify a medical scan can still articulate its visual patterns. Exploiting this asymmetry, we introduce Inductive Visual Logic (IVL), a training-free framework that constructs classification knowledge from the model's surviving descriptive ability. IVL extracts visual traits from few-shot support images through dual-mode prompting, combining semantic descriptions with primitive visual observations, and organizes them into per-class trait dictionaries. At inference, hierarchical filtering identifies spatially grounded trait evidence for classification. Across multiple distant-OOD benchmarks, IVL achieves the highest aggregate accuracy under two VLM backbones while producing interpretable, trait-traceable predictions.

title: Composition, Not Conversation: VLMs Lose the Scene, Not the Thread
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly reason over visual evidence that is cropped, segmented, retrieved, or revealed over time. Yet most VQA benchmarks present the complete image and question at once. We ask what models lose when the same information is fragmented. We introduce Layered-VQA, with 93 scenes and 300 questions. Each image is decomposed into ordered RGBA layers that exactly recompose the original scene, and each question is annotated with supporting, minimal-sufficient, and distractor layers. We evaluate eleven open-weight VLMs from 3B to 32B parameters and two proprietary models with a scale of 187,200 conversations, graded by 1.74M open-model cross-judgments. We find three consistent failures. Loss in Composition: fragmenting the question has a small effect, but fragmenting the scene substantially reduces accuracy; recomposing the same layers largely restores performance. Oracle Inversion: even oracle-selected sufficient evidence can perform worse than the complete scene. Loss in Grounding: as more evidence is required, grounding degrades much faster than answer accuracy. Together, these results show that having the right visual evidence is not enough. How that evidence is composed and presented determines whether models can use and ground it. The right evidence is not enough: VLMs need the scene it came from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Layered-VQA基准（93个场景、300个问题、187,200轮对话），将图像分解为有序RGBA图层并标注支持/最小充分/干扰图层，评测11个开源与2个专有VLM，发现三类一致失败：组合损失、Oracle反转、接地损失，证明碎片化视觉证据即使正确也损害模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA基准多一次性给出完整图像与问题，而真实应用中VLM常需对裁剪、分割、检索或逐步呈现的碎片化视觉证据进行推理。作者想探究：当同样的信息被碎片化呈现时，模型究竟损失了什么。
AI.method: 构建Layered-VQA：将每张图像分解为有序RGBA图层，可精确重组原场景；每个问题标注支持层、最小充分层与干扰层。评测11个3B–32B开源VLM与2个专有模型，共187,200轮对话，由1.74M开源模型交叉评判进行打分。
AI.result: 发现三类一致失败：(1) 组合损失——碎片化问题影响小，碎片化场景显著降低准确率，重组图层可大部分恢复性能；(2) Oracle反转——即使oracle选择的充分证据也可能比完整场景表现更差；(3) 接地损失——所需证据越多，接地能力退化远快于答案准确率。
AI.conclusion: 拥有正确的视觉证据并不足够；证据如何被组合与呈现，决定模型能否使用并接地它。正确证据不足以支撑推理，VLM还需要其来源场景的上下文。

title: PhyProbe: Rethinking Physical Consistency Evaluation in Generated Videos
summary: Evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches rely on off-the-shelf vision-language models, which can often be myopic to physical dynamics, or fine-tuned evaluators trained on human annotations, which overfit to dataset-specific cues and fail to generalize. A key challenge is that existing supervision sources provide either relative ordering or absolute scores, but not both reliably and consistently across varied settings. To this end, we introduce PhyProbe, an evaluator that extracts features from a frozen pretrained spatio-temporal encoder and maps them to a scalar physical consistency violation score via a lightweight scoring head. PhyProbe is trained through a unified objective combining pairwise ranking, regression on noisy scalar annotations, and anchor-based calibration over a curated set of heterogeneous supervision sources. Experiments show that PhyProbe outperforms prior methods on most pairwise benchmarks spanning real-generated and generated-generated pairs under varying correspondence, with the largest gains in no-correspondence and generated-generated settings where existing fine-tuned evaluators degrade sharply. PhyProbe achieves strong correlation with human judgments, with close agreement between rank-based and linear metrics, indicating that scores are both well ordered and anchored to a stable [0, 1] scale. Further, despite being trained on supervision indicative of physical consistency, without explicit general-preference labels, PhyProbe also performs competitively on human preference benchmarks: consistent with the observation that physics violations are entangled with broader quality degradations.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyProbe：基于冻结时空编码器特征+轻量打分头的物理一致性评估器，用排序、含噪回归与锚点校准的统一目标训练，在多数成对基准上超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: 生成视频的物理一致性评估仍是基础难题：现成视觉语言模型对物理动力学"近视"，而基于人工标注微调的评估器易过拟合数据集特定线索、泛化差。核心症结在于现有监督源只能可靠提供相对排序或绝对分数之一，无法在多样场景下同时稳定提供二者。
AI.method: PhyProbe从冻结的预训练时空编码器中提取特征，经轻量评分头映射为标量"物理一致性违背分数"；训练采用统一目标，结合成对排序、对含噪标量标注的回归，以及在精选异构监督源上的锚点校准。
AI.result: 在覆盖真实-生成与生成-生成配对、不同对应关系的多数成对基准上优于先前方法；在无对应与生成-生成场景中增益最大（此类场景下既有微调评估器性能急剧下降）。与人类判断相关性高，排名类与线性指标高度一致，说明分数既排序良好又锚定在稳定的[0,1]尺度。此外，尽管未用显式通用偏好标签，在人类偏好基准上也具竞争力，印证物理违背与更广泛质量退化相互纠缠。
AI.conclusion: PhyProbe通过融合相对与绝对监督并锚定评分尺度，实现了更可泛化的物理一致性评估，并可迁移至人类偏好判断，表明物理一致性评估与整体视频质量评估存在内在关联。

title: Team MSU GenText-Forensics Challenge 2026 Technical Report
summary: Document text forgery has evolved beyond simple pixel-level manipulation: modern attacks alter not only the appearance of a document but also its meaning, and increasingly target the OCR & LLM pipelines that consume such documents. The ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge therefore requires systems that not only decide whether a multilingual text image is forged, but also localize the point of manipulation, identify the attack type, and produce a human-readable forensic report with supporting evidence. We present our solution, a decomposed chain-of-thought (CoT) pipeline that combines a document tampering detector (DTD) with two Qwen3-VL-32B vision-language models, each LoRA-adapted to a distinct sub-task. DTD produces tampering probability maps that are converted into numbered candidate regions; a first model (the Filterer) validates these regions and assigns a preliminary forgery type, while a second model (the Semantic Detective) merges and re-grounds the surviving regions, searches for purely semantic anomalies that are invisible to pixel-level detectors, and writes the final report. Both models are trained by distilling chain-of-thought traces from a privileged Qwen3-VL-235B teacher that has access to ground-truth masks and reports. Our approach secured third place in the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge. We describe the data preparation, test-time augmentation, region rendering, distillation protocol, and training configuration in detail, and report ablations over detector thresholds, prompt designs, and pipeline decompositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式思维链（CoT）流水线，结合文档篡改检测器与两个LoRA微调的Qwen3-VL-32B模型，实现多语言文本图像的伪造判定、篡改定位、攻击类型识别与取证报告生成，在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。
AI.motivation: 现代文档伪造已超越简单的像素级篡改：攻击不仅改变文档外观，还改变其语义，并且越来越多地针对消费文档的OCR与LLM流水线。因此挑战赛要求系统不仅判断多语言文本图像是否被伪造，还需定位篡改点、识别攻击类型，并生成带证据的可读取证报告。
AI.method: 采用分解式思维链（CoT）流水线：文档篡改检测器（DTD）生成篡改概率图并转换为编号候选区域；第一个模型（Filterer）验证区域并赋予初步伪造类型；第二个模型（Semantic Detective）合并并重新定位存活区域，检索像素级检测器不可见的纯语义异常，并撰写最终报告。两个模型均通过对可访问真实掩码与报告的Qwen3-VL-235B特权教师模型进行CoT轨迹蒸馏来训练，各自进行LoRA适配以对应不同子任务。
AI.result: 在ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics挑战赛中获得第三名。文中详细描述了数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置，并给出了针对检测器阈值、提示设计与流水线分解的消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 分解式CoT流水线结合像素级检测与语义级推理，能有效应对兼具视觉与语义篡改、并面向OCR/LLM流水线的现代文档伪造攻击。

title: VidHarness: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Cost-Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about hour-long videos, but processing every frame is prohibitively expensive, even though the evidence for a question usually spans only a few seconds. Video agents, i.e., harness programs wrapped around a frozen VLM, address this by observing the video selectively, yet existing harnesses are hand-crafted by experts through slow build-and-test cycles. We propose VidHarness, a framework that automates harness design for cost-efficient long video understanding, in which a harness proposer iteratively evolves harnesses based on execution feedback from an evolution environment. To escape the local optima of greedy refinement, we organize the evolution as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), and to reduce the evaluation cost, we integrate uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity validation, which screens new harnesses on a few questions and promotes only the promising ones. Since the best harness varies with the frame budget, we further introduce a mixture-of-harness that routes each question to a harness specialized for its budget. VidHarness sets new state-of-the-art results on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and Video-Holmes, outperforms the strongest hand-crafted video agent by up to $11.2$ points, and generalizes to the knowledge-intensive benchmarks Video-MMMU and MMVU with fewer than half of the frames of uniform sampling.

AI.tldr: VidHarness：用MCTS自动进化视频智能体harness，结合不确定性感知多保真验证与混合harness路由，在多个长视频理解基准上刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能回答小时级长视频问题，但逐帧处理代价极高，而问题所需证据通常仅几秒。现有视频智能体（围绕冻结VLM的harness程序）依赖专家手工设计，构建-测试周期缓慢。
AI.method: 提出VidHarness框架自动设计harness：harness proposer依据进化环境的执行反馈迭代进化harness；将进化组织为蒙特卡洛树搜索以跳出贪心优化的局部最优；引入不确定性感知的多保真验证，在少量问题上筛选新harness，仅保留有潜力者；针对最优harness随帧预算变化的问题，引入mixture-of-harness，将每个问题路由到适配其预算的专用harness。
AI.result: 在LongVideoBench、Video-MME、Video-Holmes上取得新SOTA，超越最强手工视频agent最多11.2分；在知识密集型基准Video-MMMU和MMVU上具备泛化能力，且所用帧数不足均匀采样的一半。
AI.conclusion: 自动化harness设计可显著提升长视频理解的成本效率与性能，MCTS进化、多保真验证与预算感知路由是关键有效成分，并对知识密集型任务具有泛化性。

title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
summary: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoopVL，研究循环Transformer能否有效扩展到视觉-语言模型。LoopVL结合模块级循环与模型级循环，通过共享模块迭代更新统一的视觉-语言状态，并在多模态理解与视觉推理基准上超越同规模及更大规模的非循环模型。
AI.motivation: 探究Loop Transformers（循环Transformer）是否能有效迁移到视觉-语言模型，验证循环结构在多模态建模中的实用价值，并理解共享参数如何支撑更深的跨模态计算。
AI.method: LoopVL融合Module-Loop与Model-Loop两种计算方式，通过共享模块迭代更新统一的视觉-语言状态；从零开始训练，经历语言预训练、多模态训练与后训练三个阶段。
AI.result: 在多项多模态理解与视觉推理基准上，LoopVL优于一系列同等规模乃至更大规模的非循环模型；同时观察到"Visual Aha Moments"现象，表现为跨循环的视觉注意力出现显著转移。
AI.conclusion: LoopVL为循环式视觉-语言建模提供了实证支持，并给出共享参数如何在持续演化的视觉-语言状态上支撑更深层多模态计算的直观视角。

title: MOBA-VL: Event-Localized Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time MOBA Commentary
summary: Real-time commentary for Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) esports requires a vision-language model (VLM) to narrate a live match second by second, both fluently and accurately. Existing streaming VLMs sound natural but often miss key events such as kills and objectives. To address this limitation, we use game telemetry, which records exactly when each event occurs, as a supervision signal. We introduce MOBA-VL, a 9B-parameter model trained on this signal with event-localized multi-turn reinforcement learning, which rewards the turns that describe each event. We also collect MOBACast, 860 professional matches (about 460 hours) across three MOBA games with word-level timestamped commentary, and MOBACast-Bench, a benchmark from held-out tournaments. On MOBACast-Bench, MOBA-VL achieves the highest Overall score on full matches (63.25 vs. 55.12 for StreamingVLM) and clips (63.45 vs. 56.22 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Event-localized credit also raises event recall from 34.5 to 42.1 over supervised fine-tuning. Code and data will be released, and demos are available on an anonymous project page at https://moba-vl.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出MOBA-VL（9B参数视觉语言模型），利用游戏遥测数据作为监督信号，通过事件定位的多轮强化学习提升MOBA电竞赛事实时解说的事件捕捉能力，并构建MOBACast数据集与MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型在MOBA电竞赛事实时解说中语言流畅但常遗漏关键事件（如击杀、目标），亟需提升叙事准确性与事件覆盖度。
AI.method: 以游戏遥测数据（精确记录事件发生时刻）作为监督信号；采用事件定位的多轮强化学习，对描述各事件的对话轮次给予奖励；构建MOBACast数据集（3款MOBA游戏、860场职业比赛约460小时、词级时间戳解说）及MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在MOBACast-Bench上，MOBA-VL在完整比赛（63.25 vs. 55.12，对比StreamingVLM）与片段（63.45 vs. 56.22，对比DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）上均取得最高Overall分数；事件定位信用分配相较监督微调将事件召回率从34.5提升至42.1。
AI.conclusion: 基于遥测信号的事件定位强化学习可有效提升流式VLM在MOBA解说中的事件捕捉与整体表现，代码与数据将开源。

title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Text- and image-conditioned world generators can create visually rich 3D environments, yet these worlds often remain silent or rely on soundtracks synthesized solely from text or rendered video. Although such audio can convey what should be heard, it lacks an explicit representation of where sound sources are located and how their perceived sound should vary with listener movement. We introduce Audible World Models, a training-free framework that incorporates sound into the generated world state. Starting from a text prompt, our system constructs a panoramic 3D proxy, separates it into semantic layers, identifies sound-producing foreground objects and ambient background regions, and synthesizes dry audio for each sound label. It then anchors these sources to reconstructed geometry and renders listener-dependent spatial audio using geometric acoustic propagation. By explicitly linking semantics, geometry, and sound propagation, the framework maintains persistent source locations while adapting the rendered audio to changes in listener viewpoint and motion. Experiments across 80 generated scenes demonstrate substantial gains in spatial consistency over text-, video-, and panorama-conditioned baselines, while preserving competitive semantic alignment. VLM-based assessments and human evaluations further indicate that our soundtracks are preferred for their audio-visual consistency, spatial plausibility, and motion-dependent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架"Audible World Models"，将声音显式嵌入生成的三维世界状态中，实现声源定位与随听者运动变化的空间音频渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有文本/图像驱动的3D世界生成虽视觉丰富，但世界"无声"，或仅依赖文本或渲染视频合成配乐。此类音频只能表达"应听到什么"，缺乏对声源空间位置及听者移动时听感变化的显式表征。
AI.method: 免训练框架：由文本提示构建全景三维代理，分离为语义层，识别发声前景物体与背景环境区域，为每个声音标签合成干声（dry audio）；将声源锚定到重建几何上，利用几何声学传播渲染依赖听者的空间音频，显式关联语义、几何与声音传播。
AI.result: 在80个生成场景中，空间一致性相比文本、视频、全景条件基线显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐；基于VLM的评估与人工评测表明，其音轨在视听一致性、空间合理性与运动依赖行为方面更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 显式地将语义、几何与声传播相链接，可使声源位置保持持久稳定，并让渲染音频随听者视角与运动自适应变化，为生成式世界模型引入空间化声音提供了有效途径。

title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time. Most methods represent the human and object as separate trajectories and predict the global human-object couplings. Learning this complex, dynamically changing relationship implicitly, however, often yields object drift, missed contact, and penetration. We introduce PAMI, a Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation. Inspired by the classic Hough Transform, our key idea is to localize object motion by letting body-part anchors vote for it: we express object motion relative to multiple body-part anchors and use PamiVAE to learn an interaction latent space, decoding frame-wise weights that aggregate these part-specific votes. Building on this representation, PAMI generates interactions in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. PamiGen first generates a coarse human-object interaction from text in this structured latent space, and PamiRefiner then recursively resolves fine-grained contact geometry using a hybrid surface-sensing representation, combining long-range probes that capture overall body-part influence with short-range sensors that resolve detailed contacts near the object surface. Experiments on InterAct show that PAMI generates more faithful interactions and more accurate human-relative object motion than previous methods, achieving 14.5% higher contact recall than the previous state of the art. Extensive ablations validate the contributions of both the part-anchored voting representation and hybrid surface-sensing refinement.

AI.tldr: PAMI：以身体部位锚点投票表达物体运动，构建交互隐空间，并用粗到细的PamiGen与PamiRefiner生成文本条件下的全身人-物交互。
AI.motivation: 文本条件下的全身人-物交互生成需同时满足文本一致性与人-物时序协调，但多数方法将人与物表示为独立轨迹并隐式学习全局耦合关系，易导致物体漂移、接触丢失与穿模。核心难点在于动态变化的人-物关系的精确建模。
AI.method: 受Hough变换启发，提出部位锚定的运动表示：将物体运动相对于多个身体部位锚点表达，由PamiVAE学习交互隐空间并解码逐帧权重以聚合各部位投票。基于该表示采用粗到细层次：PamiGen在结构化隐空间由文本生成粗粒度人-物交互；PamiRefiner用混合表面感知表示递归求解细粒度接触几何，结合刻画整体部位影响的长程探针与解析物体表面附近细节接触的短程传感器。
AI.result: 在InterAct数据集上，PAMI生成的交互更忠实、人-物相对物体运动更准确，接触召回率较此前最优方法提升14.5%。消融实验验证了部位锚定投票表示与混合表面感知细化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以部位锚点投票显式局部化物体运动并结合粗到细生成与混合表面感知细化，可有效缓解漂移、漏接触与穿模，提升文本条件人-物交互生成的协调性与准确性。

title: Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception
summary: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate. We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文主张专用视觉系统的核心问题不是“生成更多数据”，而是“生成哪些数据”，并提出“精选合成数据”范式，讨论程序化渲染、物理仿真、生成式AI三种策展范式及其在工业缺陷检测、历史影像修复、6DoF位姿估计中的应用。
AI.motivation: 通用数据集无法提供任务所需的领域先验，而人工标注昂贵、不精确或不可行，因此需要有针对性地设计合成数据。
AI.method: 提出精选合成数据（curated synthetic data）概念，即围绕特定任务设计场景内容、外观变化、传感特性和标注；分析三种互补策展范式：程序化渲染（显式参数控制，标注由构造产生）、基于物理的仿真（编码观测效应机制，生成精确对齐的监督配对）、生成式AI（从小规模真实种子集学习传感器特定外观，逼近真实但易产生幻觉与标注不准）。
AI.result: 在工业表面缺陷检测、退化数字化彩色干版修复、基于RGB与事件数据的6DoF位姿估计三个示例中展示了三种范式，并分析了结合合成与真实数据的不同数据制度和训练策略。
AI.conclusion: 精选合成数据应被理解为真实观测的补充，结合可控监督与学习外观的混合流水线是实现可靠sim-to-real迁移最有前景的方向。

title: Caption-Mediated Perceived-Safety Estimation for Pedestrian Routing
summary: This paper presents an explainable approach to pedestrian routing, in which perceived safety is estimated from street-level imagery through an explicit natural-language intermediate representation. A vision--language model caption is generated and stored before any scoring is undertaken, and the perceived-risk class is derived entirely from structured features of that stored text, so that every segment score remains inspectable by the user. Nine captioning conditions across five model families are benchmarked against a direct Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) image-embedding baseline under an identical downstream pipeline, and the caption-mediated representation is found to reach parity with the image embedding rather than to trail it. The approach was deployed over 654,115 images covering 36 electoral wards in two locations in Northern England (Manchester and Huddersfield). Independent field validation against 3,669 locally collected ratings of 494 images across 70 participant sessions established agreement that is statistically significant but modest, at $r=0.262$, against a measured noise ceiling of 0.737 imposed by disagreement between raters. A single-use confirmatory test then found that a pipeline 44\% stronger on the supervised benchmark did not produce measurable improvement in the field ($r=0.250$, $p=0.84$), so the benchmark gains did not predict the deployment gains in this case. Routing behaviour varies systematically with journey length. There is negligible change below 1\,km, reaching a median increase of 12.78\% in low-risk route length for a median detour of 2.73\% on journeys of 3 to 6 km.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释的行人路径规划方法：先生成并存储街景图像的视觉-语言描述，再由该文本的结构化特征推导感知风险等级，使每个路段评分可核查。在654,115张图像、两个英格兰北部城市部署，基准测试与CLIP图像嵌入基线持平，但实地验证相关性仅r=0.262，基准提升未能转化为实地提升。
AI.motivation: 行人路径规划中的感知安全通常由不透明的图像嵌入直接评分，用户无法查看评分依据，缺乏可解释性；同时需要检验监督基准上的性能提升是否真能带来实地部署效果的改善。
AI.method: 以显式的自然语言为中间表示：先由视觉-语言模型生成图像描述并存储，再完全从该文本的结构化特征推导感知风险类别，保证评分可检视。在统一下游流程下，对比九种描述生成条件（跨五个模型家族）与直接CLIP图像嵌入基线。部署覆盖654,115张图像、36个选区。通过3,669条实地评分（494张图像、70场参与者会话）进行独立验证，并设置单次确证性测试检验基准提升与实地提升的关系。
AI.result: 描述中介表示在监督基准上达到与图像嵌入基线相当的水平，而非落后。实地验证相关性为r=0.262（显著但中等），受评估者间分歧造成的噪声上限0.737限制。确证性测试显示，基准上强44%的流程在实地未带来可测改进（r=0.250，p=0.84）。路径行为随旅程长度系统变化：1 km以下变化可忽略；3–6 km旅程在中位绕行2.73%时，低风险路段长度中位增加12.78%。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言中间表示可在保持评分可解释的同时与图像嵌入基线性能持平；但监督基准的提升不必然预测实地部署的改进，基准与现场表现存在脱节。路径规划对感知安全的偏好随距离增加而更明显，长距离出行更倾向选择低风险路线。

title: Beyond Layers: Position-Resolved Gradient Conflict and Position-Aware Modulation for Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) train image understanding and autoregressive image generation on shared parameters, and the two objectives are known to interfere. Existing diagnoses and remedies operate at the resolution of layers or experts, measuring conflict per layer and resolving it by separating parameters. We argue that this resolution hides an orthogonal axis. Generation in a UMM is next-token prediction over a raster sequence of visual tokens whose roles vary systematically with position, so how strongly a generation gradient interferes with understanding should depend on where in the sequence it originates. We introduce a position-resolved interference map that attributes understanding-generation gradient conflict to visual-token positions within every layer, computed from a single backward pass at $1.2\times$ the cost of a standard backward pass. On Show-o and Janus-Pro, position explains a large share of conflict variance after controlling for depth (partial $η^2=0.31$ vs. $0.35$ for layer on Show-o; $0.15$ vs. $0.30$ on Janus-Pro): the first quarter of the sequence has a mean gradient cosine of $-0.18$ against understanding, the last quarter $-0.02$. The dependence survives per-position gradient-norm normalization, retaining $80%$ of its effect size, and conflict strength tracks semantic content (Spearman $ρ=0.64$). Building on the map, we propose position-aware modulation (PAM), which removes the anti-aligned component of generation gradients only at high-conflict positions without changing the architecture. Under a matched trainable-parameter budget, PAM improves over layer-wise separation by $+21$ MME and $+2.4$ GenEval points on Show-o while matching it on POPE and overall FID; a random-position control recovers about $31%$ of the gain. Position-based and layer-based separation are complementary degrees of freedom and can be combined.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出位置分辨的干扰图，揭示统一多模态模型中理解-生成梯度冲突随视觉token位置系统性变化，并据此提出位置感知调制（PAM）以在不改架构下缓解冲突。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在共享参数上同时训练图像理解与自回归图像生成，两个目标存在干扰。现有诊断与缓解方法在层或专家粒度上衡量冲突并按参数分离解决，作者认为该粒度掩盖了一个正交维度：生成是栅格视觉token序列上的下一token预测，token角色随位置系统性变化，因此生成梯度对理解的干扰强度可能取决于其在序列中的位置。
AI.method: 作者提出位置分辨的干扰图，在每一层内将理解-生成梯度冲突归因到视觉token位置，仅需一次反向传播即可计算，成本为标准反向传播的1.2倍。基于该图提出位置感知调制（PAM）：仅在冲突高的位置移除生成梯度中与理解反对齐的分量，不改变模型架构。
AI.result: 在Show-o和Janus-Pro上，控制深度后位置能解释冲突方差的很大部分（Show-o上偏η²=0.31，层为0.35；Janus-Pro上0.15对0.30）：序列前四分之一对理解的梯度余弦均值为-0.18，后四分之一为-0.02。该依赖在逐位置梯度范数归一化后仍保留80%效应量，冲突强度与语义内容相关（Spearman ρ=0.64）。在匹配可训练参数预算下，PAM较层粒度分离在Show-o上提升+21 MME和+2.4 GenEval点，同时在POPE和整体FID上持平；随机位置对照组仅恢复约31%的增益。
AI.conclusion: 位置与层是互补的分离自由度，可组合使用；位置分辨的干扰图为缓解UMM理解-生成干扰提供了新的有效视角与简单方法。

title: Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment
summary: Judging image quality is not only ecologically relevant to everyday human tasks, but also underpins many machine vision tasks such as image generation. This paper proposes a framework to understand the inherent perceptual space underlying image quality judgment in humans. We propose a multi-dimensional observer model that represents images as distributions in a latent perceptual space and that models human judgment as comparing noisy samples. Being constrained by neural representations in the primate ventral stream and fit to large-scale behavioral data, the model enables analysis of perceptual structure while matching the predictive power of existing metrics. Using this model, we find that the perceptual spaces needed to account for image quality judgment in humans are extremely low-dimensional compared to the image space even when considering its sparsity. The exact structure of the space (e.g., dimensionalities, information encoded) varies between low-level and high-level quality judgments, suggesting that, despite a shared retinal encoding in the beginning, humans selectively construct task-dependent perceptual spaces in visual decision making.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个多维观察者模型，将图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，并将人类判断建模为对含噪样本的比较，以解析人类图像质量判断背后的感知结构。
AI.motivation: 图像质量判断既具生态意义，又是图像生成等机器视觉任务的基础，但人类质量判断背后的内在感知空间结构尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建受灵长类腹侧通路神经表征约束、拟合大规模行为数据的多维观察者模型：图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，人类判断建模为含噪样本比较。
AI.result: 该模型在匹配现有指标预测力的同时可分析感知结构；发现人类图像质量判断所需感知空间维度极低，远低于图像空间（即使考虑稀疏性）；空间结构（维度、编码信息）在低层与高层质量判断间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 尽管起点共享视网膜编码，人类在视觉决策中会选择性地构建任务依赖的感知空间。

title: GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction
summary: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. On standard datasets, GazeFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on per-frame metrics, and the generated trajectories align better with human gaze temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出 GazeFlow，用条件流匹配直接建模注视点的联合分布，实现自中心注视预测的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 自中心注视预测应用广泛但困难，因为人类注视本身具有随机性；这种随机性并非无约束，而是受三方面结构约束：注视与眼跳交替的时间动态、自上而下的任务影响、自下而上的视觉显著性。
AI.method: GazeFlow 将注视建模为以自上而下和自下而上信息为条件的注视位置时间序列的联合分布，采用条件流匹配（CFM）：学习一个速度场，将高斯噪声样本迭代传输为从该联合分布中采样的合理注视轨迹。速度场的条件包括视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征，以及通过全局查询这些特征获得的自上而下任务信息。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上，GazeFlow 在逐帧指标上达到SOTA性能，且生成的轨迹与人类注视的时间动态更一致。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模注视的联合分布而非独立逐帧预测，能同时提升逐帧精度与轨迹的时间动态一致性。

title: ThinkV2V: Unleashing the Reasoning Capability of MLLMs for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
summary: Instruction-guided video editing has made significant progress, yet existing methods use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) primarily as semantic encoders, so they often fall short in working with implicit edits that require causal or semantic reasoning. To bridge this fundamental gap in video editing, we propose ThinkV2V, a reasoning-driven framework for complex instruction-guided video editing, explicitly activating MLLM thinking before visual generation. At its core, ThinkV2V builds on a practical MLLM-to-DiT architecture to turn explicit thinking over the source video and instruction into refined conditioning signals for video editing. Further, we equip it with a dedicated training and inference recipe, combining Progressive Curriculum Training, which gradually cultivates the model from basic editing to reasoning-intensive cases, with Inference-Time Thinking Scaling, which iteratively refines candidate prompts and selects the most reliable one, to better elicit reasoning in challenging editing scenarios. We also curate the ThinkV2V-150K dataset and introduce ThinkV2V-Bench to support training and evaluation of video editing with implicit intent and causal reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ThinkV2V on both complex and standard editing scenarios, in which our 5B-scale DiT model substantially outperforms larger 10B-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: ThinkV2V是一个推理驱动的指令引导视频编辑框架，通过在视觉生成前激活MLLM的思考能力，并采用MLLM-to-DiT架构将显式推理转化为精炼的条件信号，配合渐进式课程训练和推理时思考缩放，在复杂与标准编辑场景均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）当作语义编码器使用，缺乏因果或语义推理能力，因此在需要推理的隐式编辑任务上表现不足。作者希望弥合视频编辑中这一根本性差距。
AI.method: 提出ThinkV2V框架：核心为MLLM-to-DiT架构，将针对源视频和指令的显式思考转化为精炼的条件信号用于视频编辑；训练与推理方案结合了渐进式课程训练（从基础编辑逐步培养到推理密集型案例）与推理时思考缩放（迭代精炼候选提示并选择最可靠者）；同时构建ThinkV2V-150K数据集并提出ThinkV2V-Bench评测基准。
AI.result: 在复杂和标准编辑场景下均取得SOTA性能，其中5B规模的DiT模型大幅超越更大的10B规模基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 激活MLLM的显式推理并结合专用训练/推​​理配方，可有效提升指令引导视频编辑（尤其是隐式意图与因果推理类任务）的性能，且小规模模型也能超越更大基线。

title: Detail in Context: A Dual-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Mycosis Fungoides Detection
summary: Mycosis fungoides (MF) is a rare form of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma that is often misdiagnosed in early stages due to its visual similarity to benign inflammatory dermatoses. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for improving patient outcomes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic framework for automated MF detection that combines dual- scale histopathological image analysis with deep learning. To distinguish MF from other lymphoproliferative skin conditions, the proposed approach leverages a late-fusion ensemble of dual- magnification (10x and 20x) convolutional neural networks (CNNs), complemented by a random forest classifier trained on 16 clinical features. Experimental results on an expanded dataset of 6,267 images (4,306 MF; 1,961 Non-MF) across 463 patients demonstrate that strong detection performance is obtained by prioritizing higher-resolution cytological details (20x) within broader architectural context (10x). The image-based late-fusion model achieves an accuracy of 83.58% and a sensitivity of 89.13%, while the clinical random forest model achieves an accuracy of 96.6% and sensitivity of 93.8%, highlighting the po- tential of this multimodal framework as a robust clinical decision support system in dermatology. This framework addresses two distinct clinical objectives: an image-based dual-scale pipeline optimized for the early diagnostic screening of MF versus non- MF dermatoses, and a complementary clinical metadata model designed for the subsequent staging of confirmed MF cases (patch/plaque versus tumor)

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合双尺度组织病理图像分析与深度学习的蕈样肉芽肿（MF）自动诊断框架：采用10x与20x双放大倍率CNN的晚融合集成，并辅以基于16个临床特征的随机森林分类器。
AI.motivation: MF是一种罕见的皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤，早期因与良性炎症性皮肤病外观相似而常被误诊；早期准确诊断对改善患者预后至关重要，因此需要自动化的诊断支持手段。
AI.method: 方法上，为区分MF与其他淋巴增殖性皮肤病，构建双放大倍率（10x与20x）CNN的晚融合（late-fusion）集成，并补充一个在16个临床特征上训练的随机森林分类器，形成多模态诊断框架。
AI.result: 在扩展数据集（463名患者、6,267张图像，其中MF 4,306张、非MF 1,961张）上，优先利用20x的高分辨率细胞学细节并结合10x的更广组织结构可获得较强检测性能：图像晚融合模型准确率83.58%、灵敏度89.13%；临床随机森林模型准确率96.6%、灵敏度93.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态框架可作为皮肤科稳健的临床决策支持系统，并分别面向两个临床目标：用于MF与非MF皮肤病早期筛查的双尺度图像流程，以及用于确诊MF后续分期（斑片/斑块 vs 肿瘤）的临床元数据模型。

title: LongTake: Learning to Sustain Dynamics in Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: World models, game simulators, and long-take video creation require coherent scene evolution and sustained dynamics over extended durations. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion provides a natural framework for long-horizon generation, yet extended rollouts often become near-static or lose visual quality. We hypothesize that these failures reflect the limited guidance provided by short-video supervision on how ongoing scene dynamics develops over longer durations. This motivates us to introduce LongTake, a two-stage training pipeline built around Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing (TF) on curated real long videos. Long-Horizon TF trains the AR model to predict later frames conditioned on long ground-truth video prefixes, extending direct supervision beyond the short training horizon. This supervision is designed to help the model sustain dynamics and preserve visual quality during long-horizon generation. Our central finding is that this training stage strengthens direct initialization for distribution matching distillation (DMD) under student self-rollout, without the intermediate few-step distillation stage used in standard pipelines. Under the same five-second DMD training setup, our initialization yields substantially higher dynamic degree than short horizon TF initialization on 30-second rollouts at comparable aesthetic quality, and surpasses the evaluated baselines in both measures. Hybrid DMD further reuses this teacher to extend supervision to later frames of the self-rollout while retaining bidirectional joint supervision over the initial window. On long-horizon self-rollouts, LongTake lies on the Pareto front of dynamic degree and aesthetic quality, and Hybrid DMD attains the highest dynamic degree among evaluated methods at both 30s and 60s.

AI.tldr: LongTake 提出两阶段训练框架，核心是长时程教师强制（Long-Horizon TF），用真实长视频训练自回归视频扩散模型并直接初始化为 DMD 蒸馏，在长时程自生成中同时保持动态性与画质。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散适合长时程生成，但长时间 rollout 往往趋于近静态或画质退化。作者假设原因在于短视频监督无法提供"场景动态如何长期演化"的指导。
AI.method: 两阶段流程：第一阶段在精选真实长视频上做 Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing，让 AR 模型以长真实前缀为条件预测后续帧，将直接监督扩展到短训练视野之外；该阶段用于为 DMD 提供更强的初始化，省去标准流程中的中间少步蒸馏阶段。第二阶段 Hybrid DMD 复用该教师模型，把监督扩展到自 rollout 的较后帧，同时对初始窗口保留双向联合监督。
AI.result: 相同的 5 秒 DMD 训练设置下，该初始化在 30 秒 rollout 上动态程度显著高于短视频 TF 初始化，美学质量相当，并在两项指标上超过对比基线。长时程自 rollout 中，LongTake 位于动态程度—美学质量帕累托前沿；Hybrid DMD 在 30s 与 60s 上取得评估方法中最高的动态程度。
AI.conclusion: 长时程教师强制是维持长视频自回归生成动态与画质的有效监督形式，并可作为 DMD 的优质初始化，无需中间少步蒸馏阶段。

title: Retargeting Motions to Diverse Skeletons via Learnable Flattening
summary: Cross-structural motion retargeting aims to transfer motion between different skeletal topologies. Despite recent progress, existing state-of-the-art models struggle with reliability in zero-shot settings, i.e. skeletons with different topologies which were unseen during training, and recent Transformer-based attempts have failed to outperform specialized geometric methods. We bridge this gap with a Transformer Autoencoder that learns a topology- and translation-invariant latent space. Our core contribution is a learnable flattening of skeletal graphs that captures both local dependencies and global structure. Unlike the standard transformer architecture, which adds positional information to token content, we integrate graph-based positional encodings multiplicatively, a design choice that follows directly from our flattening formulation. The resulting model handles diverse skeletal topologies within a single unified architecture and trains in a fully unsupervised manner, requiring no paired retargeting data. Ablation studies show, that the graph encodings, multiplicative formulation, and Transformer backbone is critical for the performance. In zero-shot evaluations, our method reduces global joint position error by $43-47\%$ over current benchmarks. A user study ($n = 37$), including expert animators, further ranks our approach highest in motion alignment and physical plausibility ($p < 0.05$). These results demonstrate that our model design is key to making transformer architectures effective for motion retargeting, outperforming existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习拓扑与平移不变隐空间的Transformer自编码器，通过可学习的骨架图展平与乘法式图位置编码，实现跨结构动作重定向，在零样本设置下将全局关节位置误差降低43-47%，用户研究评价最优。
AI.motivation: 跨结构动作重定向需在不同骨骼拓扑间迁移动作。现有SOTA模型在零样本（训练未见拓扑）下可靠性不足，且基于Transformer的方法未能超越专门的几何方法，亟需新的模型设计使Transformer在此任务上有效。
AI.method: 采用Transformer自编码器学习拓扑与平移不变的隐空间；核心是可学习的骨骼图展平（flattening），同时捕捉局部依赖与全局结构；不同于标准Transformer将位置信息相加到token内容，本文将图位置编码以乘法方式整合；单一统一架构处理多样拓扑，完全无监督训练，无需成对重定向数据。
AI.result: 消融实验表明图编码、乘法式公式与Transformer骨干对性能至关重要；零样本评测中全局关节位置误差比现有基准降低43-47%；用户研究（n=37，含专业动画师）在动作对齐与物理合理性上排名最高（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 模型设计是使Transformer架构在动作重定向中有效并超越现有方法的关键，统一架构与无监督训练可处理多样骨骼拓扑并在零样本下取得领先性能。

title: Restoring without Forgetting: Filter-Level Continual Image Restoration via Parameter-Space Integrated Gradients
summary: Adapting image restoration models to a stream of new tasks without revisiting past data remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we propose Restoring without Forgetting (RwF), a filter-level continual adaptation framework for image restoration built upon a critical observation: task-specific knowledge is centered in a small subset of filters and can be separated from those reconstructing general content. RwF first performs parameter-space integrated gradients attribution to localize degradation-critical filters in a coarse-to-fine manner. It then adapts to new tasks by generating task-specific filters from a filter bank using compact factorized low-rank transformations, further augmented with cross-task attention and prototypical contrastive learning, and lastly assembles them back only at localized positions. Experiments on six restoration tasks show that RwF effectively avoids forgetting and achieves competitive restoration quality against all-in-one methods that have full data access, and outperforms LoRA-style adaptation with $\sim$10$\times$ fewer additional parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/funkdub/Restoring-without-Forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RwF，一种面向图像复原的滤波器级持续自适应框架，通过定位退化关键滤波器并在局部位置组装任务特定滤波器，在不回访旧数据的情况下避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 图像复原模型在适应新任务流时，若不回访历史数据会遭遇灾难性遗忘。作者的关键观察是：任务特定知识集中在少数滤波器上，可与重建通用内容的滤波器分离，因此可在滤波器级别进行隔离式适配。
AI.method: RwF 首先通过参数空间集成梯度归因，以粗到细的方式定位退化关键滤波器；随后利用紧凑的分解式低秩变换从滤波器库中生成任务特定滤波器，并引入跨任务注意力和原型对比学习；最后仅在被定位的位置组装这些滤波器。
AI.result: 在六个复原任务上的实验表明，RwF 能有效避免遗忘，复原质量可与具备全量数据访问的 all-in-one 方法相竞争，并且以约少 10 倍的额外参数优于 LoRA 式适配方法。
AI.conclusion: RwF 验证了滤波器级持续适配在图像复原中的有效性，通过关键滤波器定位与低秩任务滤波器生成，在参数高效的同时兼顾了抗遗忘与复原质量。代码已开源。

title: StereoGaussians: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Stereo Images
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.

AI.tldr: StereoGaussians 从单个标定双目图像对前馈预测度量 3DGS 表示，通过复用冻结双目网络中间特征与标定视差锚定几何，并引入第二高斯层与扩展画布，实现对近邻视角外推及去遮挡区域的渲染。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3DGS 无需逐场景优化即可重建，但实用双目相机应用需要超出输入视角的近邻外推。仅靠双目深度只能锚定可见表面，渲染新暴露区域还需学习外观与额外场景容量。
AI.method: 方法由单标定双目图像对预测度量 3DGS。复用冻结预训练双目网络的中间表示以预测高斯基元属性，并用标定视差锚定几何。采用第二高斯层与扩展图像画布为去遮挡及视场外内容提供容量。训练数据 SceneSplat-Stereo 由质量过滤的 3DGS 教师构建，将双目输入与近邻目标视角配对，覆盖 803 个场景。
AI.result: 在未见过的真实与照片级真实双目基准上，方法优于强视图合成基线；消融实验支持主要设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了无需逐场景优化、仅凭双目输入即可前馈预测度量 3DGS 并进行近邻外推的可行性，第二高斯层与扩展画布、标定视差锚定等设计均被消融验证有效。

title: PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) often rely on separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing visual context length and complicating integration with established vision-language pretraining pipelines. Recent advances in pixel-space modeling offer an encoder-free alternative, but extending this paradigm from images to videos is non-trivial: video understanding and generation adopt different temporal representations, leaving the design of a unified visual interface an open question. We present PixelUMM, an encoder-free model for unified image and video understanding and generation directly in pixel space. PixelUMM represents images as spatial patches and videos as spatiotemporal tubelets, connecting raw pixels to a shared multimodal backbone through single-layer linear projections. Its Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combines shared attention with task-specific parameters and extends clean-pixel prediction to video generation, jointly supporting autoregressive text prediction and pixel-space flow matching. Experiments show that PixelUMM achieves competitive performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks. We further conduct empirical studies of key design choices, including decoder design and spatial-temporal patch size, providing insights for future pixel-space unified multimodal models.

AI.tldr: PixelUMM：无需编码器、直接在像素空间统一图像与视频的理解与生成，图像用空间patch、视频用时空tubelet，经单层线性投影接入共享多模态主干，采用Mixture-of-Transformers架构并结合自回归文本预测与像素空间流匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）通常对理解和生成使用分离的视觉表示，增加了视觉上下文长度，并使其难以与已有的视觉-语言预训练流程整合。像素空间建模提供了无编码器的替代方案，但从图像扩展到视频存在困难：视频理解与生成采用不同的时序表示，统一视觉接口的设计仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出PixelUMM，一个无编码器、直接在像素空间进行图像与视频统一理解与生成的模型。将图像表示为空间patch，视频表示为时空tubelet，通过单层线性投影将原始像素连接到共享多模态主干。其Mixture-of-Transformers架构将共享注意力与任务特定参数相结合，并把干净像素预测扩展到视频生成，联合支持自回归文本预测与像素空间流匹配。
AI.result: 在图像与视频的理解和生成任务上，PixelUMM均取得具有竞争力的性能。作者还对关键设计选择进行了实证研究，包括解码器设计和时空patch尺寸，为未来像素空间统一多模态模型提供参考。
AI.conclusion: PixelUMM验证了无需编码器、在像素空间统一图像与视频理解生成这一范式的可行性，并揭示了关键设计选择的影响，为该方向后续研究提供了经验与启示。

title: Aperture: Training-Free Multiscale Concept Bottlenecks for Remote Sensing
summary: While earth observation models have advanced substantially, they still lack interpretability. While concept-bottleneck models provide interpretability and expert interaction, they are either too expensive to train for the remote sensing domain or perform poorly without annotation. We posit that in expert domains like remote sensing, such training-free models require both fine details in both image and concept space. In image space, we propose a multiscale concept bottleneck using greedy quadtree routing to locate small concepts. In concept space, we replace contrastive vision language models with pre-trained MLLMs and present a way to get reliable concept scores from them. We introduce APERTURE that blends concept scores at the global image and native concept-scale level to give state-ofthe-art training-free model performance. To test these models, introduce SiFC, a fine-grained concept-centric dataset across three countries, with human-reviewed class-level concept maps. On SiFC, APERTURE outperforms the best training-free baselines by more than 10 percentage points in macro F1-score, and notably also outperforms supervised concept bottleneck models. Targeted component-removal tests examine whether concept scores respond to changes in visual evidence, while temporal experiments show that descriptor updates improve recognition of technological changes without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练概念瓶颈模型APERTURE，通过多尺度图像空间与MLLM概念评分融合，在遥感细粒度数据集SiFC上大幅超越免训练基线及监督式概念瓶颈模型。
AI.motivation: 地球观测（遥感）模型虽性能提升但缺乏可解释性；概念瓶颈模型虽可解释且支持专家交互，但在遥感领域要么训练成本过高，要么在无标注情形下表现很差。作者假设在遥感这类专家领域，免训练模型需在图像空间与概念空间均具备细粒度细节。
AI.method: 图像空间：提出多尺度概念瓶颈，使用贪心四叉树路由定位小尺度概念。概念空间：用预训练MLLM替代对比式视觉语言模型，并提出从中获取可靠概念分数的方法。模型APERTURE将全局图像与原生概念尺度级别的概念分数进行融合。同时构建SiFC数据集：跨三国的细粒度概念中心数据集，含人工审核的类别级概念图。
AI.result: 在SiFC上，APERTURE的宏F1比最佳免训练基线高10个百分点以上，且优于监督式概念瓶颈模型。针对性组件移除测试验证概念分数是否随视觉证据变化而响应；时序实验表明描述符更新可在不重训练的情况下改善对技术变化的识别。
AI.conclusion: 在遥感等专家领域，免训练概念瓶颈模型通过在图像与概念双空间引入细粒度信息（多尺度路由+MLLM可靠概念评分+多尺度融合）可实现SOTA免训练性能，并超越监督式概念瓶颈模型，同时具备可解释性与无需重训练的可更新性。

title: After a Decade: Bringing Shadow Removal into the Real World with Agentic Training Data
summary: Shadow removal looks nearly solved on established benchmarks, yet remains brittle in the real world. Models have advanced; the paired training data they rely on have barely changed in nearly a decade. The reason is simple: obtaining a shadow-free target requires removing the occluder while keeping the scene, camera, and illumination otherwise unchanged, making diverse paired data difficult to capture. Meanwhile, large shadow detection datasets already contain diverse real-world images and masks, but no shadow-free targets. To turn this abundant but incomplete data into paired supervision, we propose an offline agentic workflow combining physics-motivated generation, failure detection, feedback-driven retry, candidate selection, and deterministic correction. Using this workflow, we construct AgenticShadow, a dataset of 17,138 image-mask-target triplets spanning general scenes, faces, and remote sensing. Our construction workflow reduces Color Distribution Difference by 50.5% over previous shadow removal work, while training existing shadow removal models on AgenticShadow reduces cross-domain LAB RMSE by 19.7-37.5%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种离线智能体工作流，利用已有的大规模阴影检测数据集生成配对监督数据，构建了包含17,138个三元组的AgenticShadow数据集，显著提升了现有阴影去除模型的跨域性能。
AI.motivation: 阴影去除在已有基准上看似已基本解决，但在真实世界中仍很脆弱。核心瓶颈在于配对训练数据近十年几乎未变：获得无阴影目标需要在不改变场景、相机和光照的前提下移除遮挡物，导致多样化配对数据极难采集。而现有大规模阴影检测数据集虽包含多样的真实图像和掩码，却缺少无阴影目标。
AI.method: 提出一种离线智能体工作流（offline agentic workflow），将丰富但不完整的检测数据转化为配对监督，包含五个环节：物理启发的生成（physics-motivated generation）、失败检测（failure detection）、反馈驱动的重试（feedback-driven retry）、候选选择（candidate selection）以及确定性校正（deterministic correction）。
AI.result: 基于该工作流构建了AgenticShadow数据集，包含17,138个"图像-掩码-目标"三元组，覆盖通用场景、人脸和遥感。相比以往阴影去除工作，构建流程将色彩分布差异（Color Distribution Difference）降低50.5%；在AgenticShadow上训练现有阴影去除模型，可将跨域LAB RMSE降低19.7%–37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体工作流复用现有阴影检测数据生成高质量配对监督，能够突破配对数据稀缺这一长期瓶颈，显著增强阴影去除模型的跨域泛化能力，并提供了一个大规模多域数据集。

title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Exo2EgoHOI，一个 HOI 感知的视频生成框架，通过 4D HOI 先验与双分支残差适配器、分解门控交叉注意力，实现保持手-物交互的第一人称视频生成。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人类操作视频对具身智能价值高，但大规模采集成本昂贵；将丰富的第三人称操作视频转换为第一人称是可行的替代方案。现有方法在大视角变化下难以忠实保留手-物交互，原因在于缺乏细粒度交互引导与以物体为中心的锚定不足。
AI.method: 1) 统一 4D HOI 先验，融合场景几何、关节化手部渲染与稠密手-物关系场；2) 双分支残差适配器，将结构与关系线索注入视频生成主干；3) 分解门控交叉注意力（Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention），分别编码物体与背景参考，自适应融合全局语义与局部外观特征作为以物体为中心的锚点。
AI.result: 在 ARCTIC-HOI 与 Ego-Exo4D 上，物体一致性与 HOI 保持显著提升，同时视觉保真度具有竞争力。ARCTIC-HOI 上，物体 mIoU 提升 32.3%，MPJPE 与 PA-MPJPE 分别降低 34.7% 与 50.0%（相对各自最优基线）。
AI.conclusion: Exo2EgoHOI 通过交互感知的生成设计，有效缓解了大视角变化下的 HOI 保真与物体一致性问题，为可扩展的第一人称操作数据合成提供了可行方案。

title: HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding
summary: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出层级神经场表示：以多分辨率子图实现高效可扩展的隐式建图，统一查询与解码机制同时支持几何与语义特征，并在SDF构建与开放词汇物体定位任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有神经隐式表示多聚焦几何重建，缺乏语义信息，难以支撑高层空间理解与任务规划；同时环境规模与复杂度增长时，后端优化面临计算效率瓶颈。因此需要一种既具语义能力又可高效扩展的隐式表示。
AI.method: 核心设计包含三部分：(1) 层级神经场，将场景分解为互相重叠的子图，在各局部子图内进行层级优化以实现可扩展计算；(2) 统一查询与解码机制，使可学习地图特征经查询-解码过程输出几何与语义两类结果，训练与推理共用；(3) 特征编码器预测初始层级网格特征，显著减少从零优化子图特征的时间。此外，子图间估计漂移通过在隐式特征空间内直接对齐与融合来校正，避免解码最终输出从而大幅加速；在此表示上同时嵌入几何特征与视觉-语言隐特征。
AI.result: 在SDF构建与开放词汇物体定位两类任务上进行了验证，显著提升了计算与内存效率，保持高估计精度，并使机器人在大规模真实世界基准上具备空间感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过层级子图隐式表示、统一查询解码与特征空间内子图融合，同时解决了语义缺失与后端优化效率两大问题，为机器人大规模场景理解与任务规划提供了兼顾效率、精度与语义的建图方案。

title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
summary: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.

AI.tldr: 提出从单段非循环2D视频重建可循环4D动态水面场景的方法，用Eulerian运动场平流高斯splat实现，支持新视角交互式渲染。
AI.motivation: 已有水体场景重建主要基于2D视频纹理，仅能生成循环播放视频，无法从新视角观看。本文希望从3D视角出发，实现可从任意新视角交互渲染的循环4D动态重建。
AI.method: 将运动表示为3D静态Eulerian运动场，对在固定时间周期循环重生的规范高斯splat进行平流，以渲染损失监督；并引入非周期、时变的残差项，捕获偏离静态Eulerian运动场的非周期与随机动态。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，该框架在水体场景的逼真动画生成上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 以Eulerian运动场平流高斯splat并结合时变残差，可从单段非循环2D视频实现高保真、可循环、可新视角交互渲染的4D水面动态重建。

title: STEPS: Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style Using Diffusion and Contrastive Style Encoding
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. A version of this paper appeared in PAKDD 2026 (LNCS vol. 16618)
summary: We introduce Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style (STEPS), a novel diffusion model architecture for quality text replacement in images. Scene Text Editing (STE), also known as Visual Text Editing, consists of changing the textual content in an image while conserving the original style, e.g. font, colors, orientation, background, etc. STEPS advances the state of the art in STE through directed focus on improved style preservation. We introduce a style encoder for visual text that captures style independently of textual content, and a model architecture that combines the style encoder with multiple semantic conditions (target text characters encoding and rendered glyphs). STEPS achieves superior results to previous STE methods in style preservation, output readability, and subjective quality.

AI.tldr: 提出STEPS——一种用于场景文本编辑的扩散模型架构，通过独立于文本内容的风格编码器与多重语义条件（目标字符编码与渲染字形）结合，实现高质量文本替换并显著提升风格保持能力。
AI.motivation: 场景文本编辑（STE）需在改变图像文字内容的同时保留原风格（字体、颜色、朝向、背景等）。现有方法在风格保持方面仍不足，本文旨在专门针对风格保持进行改进。
AI.method: 构建扩散模型架构STEPS；设计面向视觉文本的风格编码器，使风格表征与文本内容解耦；将该风格编码器与多种语义条件（目标文本字符编码、渲染字形）融合，引导生成。
AI.result: 在风格保持、输出可读性和主观质量三方面均优于此前的STE方法。
AI.conclusion: STEPS通过显式解耦风格与内容并引入多重语义条件，推进了STE领域的风格保持性能，取得了当前最优效果。

title: Template-Search Domain Adaptation via Multi-Stage Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Object Tracking
summary: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. In practice, sensor availability or operation may change over time, creating a substantial representation gap between template and search frames. Unlike conventional multi-modal tracking where paired modalities are simultaneously available, cross-modal tracking requires localization when template and search frames originate from different active modalities. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. Enc-CFA TSDA-Track applies contrastive alignment to encoder representations after interaction to strengthen target-level cross-modal correspondence. Both variants retain a shared inference pipeline without modality-specific branches. Experiments on LasHeR, and zero-shot evaluations on RGBT234 and GTOT under multiple cross-modal protocols demonstrate improvements over representative state-of-the-art trackers. For instance, under the modality-switch protocol on RGBT234, Pre-AFA TSDA-Track achieves an SR/PR of 43.2/56.0, compared with 36.8/50.0 for ToMP-101 baseline. In addition, a study on Anti-UAV-024 further verifies the applicability of TSDA-Track to aerial tracking. Our study highlights the effectiveness of feature alignment domain adaptation for cross-modal tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出TSDA-Track框架，通过模板-搜索域自适应缩小跨模态跟踪中的模态差距，并在多个数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统跟踪假设模板与搜索帧来自同一传感模态，而实际中传感器可用性或工作状态会随时间变化，导致模板与搜索帧之间存在显著的表示鸿沟。与现有多模态跟踪（配对模态同时可用）不同，跨模态跟踪需要在模板与搜索帧来自不同活跃模态时完成定位。
AI.method: 提出TSDA-Track模板-搜索域自适应框架，在训练中缩小模态差异，并研究两种特征对齐策略：Pre-AFA TSDA-Track在transformer的模板-搜索交互之前施加对抗对齐以抑制模态特定偏置；Enc-CFA TSDA-Track在交互之后对编码器表示施加对比对齐以增强目标级跨模态对应关系。两种变体均保持共享推理流程，无需模态特定分支。
AI.result: 在LasHeR上实验，并在RGBT234和GTOT上进行零样本评估（多种跨模态协议），相比代表性最先进跟踪器均有提升。例如在RGBT234的模态切换协议下，Pre-AFA TSDA-Track取得SR/PR为43.2/56.0，而ToMP-101基线为36.8/50.0。此外在Anti-UAV-024上的研究进一步验证了TSDA-Track对空中跟踪的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了特征对齐域自适应在跨模态跟踪中的有效性。

title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. However, VLAs can take only a limited number of frames as visual input due to the high token cost of an image, which is problematic for memory-dependent tasks such as determining the arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. Existing solutions use latent vector memories accessed through cross-attention, which are neither interpretable nor portable. In this paper, we propose AD-Memo, a general-purpose VLA driving agent with language-based memory. The agent outputs memory as an extension of its Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to record surrounding objects critical to driving; this memory becomes part of the agent's future input. We curate memory-based datasets and train VLAs with a two-stage recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and \textit{Da Capo}, a novel semi-closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm which uses trajectory-level advantage for memory and step-level advantage for driving, leading to better credit assignment. Across scenarios such as all-way stops and general driving, AD-Memo improves driving quality, enables better question answering on driving scenes, and produces plug-and-play memory for other models.

AI.tldr: AD-Memo 提出一种基于语言记忆的通用 VLA 自动驾驶智能体，将关键驾驶物体记录为 Chain-of-Thought 的记忆扩展，并通过 SFT 与半闭环 RL 算法 Da Capo 进行训练，在停车博弈与长时序场景中提升驾驶质量与可解释性。
AI.motivation: VLA 基础模型因图像 token 成本高而只能输入有限帧，导致依赖记忆的任务（如全向停车到达顺序判定、长时序场景理解）表现不佳。现有基于隐向量记忆与 cross-attention 的方案既不可解释也不可移植。
AI.method: 提出 AD-Memo：智能体将记忆作为 Chain-of-Thought 的扩展输出，记录对驾驶关键的环境物体，并作为未来输入的一部分。构建基于记忆的数据集，采用两阶段训练：监督微调 SFT，以及半闭环强化学习算法 Da Capo——对记忆使用轨迹级优势、对驾驶使用步级优势以实现更好的信用分配。
AI.result: 在全向停车与一般驾驶等场景中，AD-Memo 提升了驾驶质量，改善了驾驶场景问答能力，并生成可供其他模型即插即用（plug-and-play）的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 基于语言记忆的显式记忆机制可替代隐向量记忆，兼顾可解释性与可移植性，配合半闭环 RL 训练可有效提升 VLA 自动驾驶智能体的记忆依赖任务表现。

title: ReGain: Restoring Subject Fidelity in Personalization on Synthetic Images
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are personalized to a subject by DreamBooth fine-tuning on a handful of its images. Increasingly, these images come from a diffusion model rather than a camera. We show that fine-tuning on such synthetic images degrades subject fidelity, producing oversaturated color and excess high-frequency detail. To isolate the cause, we fine-tune two models from the same base model with the same DreamBooth recipe, one on real photos of a subject and one on synthetic images of that subject generated by the first. We trace the degradation to classifier-free guidance (CFG). For the model personalized on synthetic images, the angle between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions, and with it the norm of their difference, is much larger than for the model personalized on real photos. This inflation grows toward high frequencies and also appears at other prompts semantically close to the subject, such as its class noun, but not at unrelated ones. We propose ReGain, a training-free correction applied at sampling time that measures how much each frequency band of the guidance is inflated relative to the base model and scales that band down accordingly. ReGain needs no real photos. On Stable Diffusion v1.5, ReGain closes 51-64% of the subject-fidelity gap to the model personalized on real photos, as measured by DINO, DINOv2 and CLIP-I. It also improves subject fidelity on SDXL and SD 3.5 and preserves text alignment on all three backbones.

AI.tldr: 对合成图像做 DreamBooth 微调会因 CFG 引导被放大而损害主体保真度，作者提出免训练、免真实照片的采样期校正方法 ReGain，按频带压缩引导幅度。
AI.motivation: 个性化文生图扩散模型（如 DreamBooth）越来越多地使用扩散模型生成的合成图像而非真实照片进行微调。作者发现这种合成图像微调会导致主体保真度下降，表现为颜色过饱和与高频细节过多，因此需要定位其成因并加以修正。
AI.method: 在同一基础模型上用相同 DreamBooth 配方分别对真实照片与合成图像微调，进行对照分析，将退化归因于 classifier-free guidance（CFG）：合成图像个性化模型中，条件与无条件噪声预测之间的夹角及其差向量范数显著增大，且随频率升高而加剧，并在与主体语义相近的提示（如类别名词）上出现。基于此提出 ReGain：一种采样期施加的免训练校正，逐频带度量引导相对于基础模型的膨胀程度并按比例缩放该频带。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 上，ReGain 以 DINO、DINOv2 和 CLIP-I 衡量，弥补了相对真实照片个性化模型 51–64% 的主体保真度差距；同时在 SDXL 和 SD 3.5 上提升主体保真度，并在三种骨干网络上保持文本对齐能力。该方法无需真实照片。
AI.conclusion: 合成图像微调引起的主体保真度退化可明确归因于 CFG 引导在高频及语义相近提示上的膨胀；通过在采样时按频带重新标定引导，可在不依赖真实照片、无需额外训练的前提下有效缓解该问题，并具备跨骨干网络的泛化性。

title: Unveiling the Value of Motion for Cinematic Camera Trajectories
summary: Cinematic camera motion is a fundamental storytelling tool, defined not only by where the camera is positioned in the scene, but also by how it moves in terms of direction and speed. Recent work on camera trajectory generation and alignment to text relies on pose-centric representations. While in principle a network could derive direction of movement and speed, we find that in practice this might not happen. In fact, in this paper we discover that decomposing the camera trajectory representation from the traditional per-frame poses to direction and speed has surprising benefits across multiple tasks, including trajectory-to-text alignment as well as text-to-trajectory generation. To accurately evaluate the former, we introduce a simple and reliable protocol that overcomes the limitations of prior evaluation baselines. For the latter, building on this representational insight, we propose a novel generative model for camera trajectories, CineGEN, that achieves superior performance across a variety of metrics.
