AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360与LLFF数据集上，UGOD提升了稀疏视角新视角合成质量，并产生比对比方法更紧凑的高斯表示。
AI.conclusion: 高斯不确定性可为稀疏视角重建提供有效的渲染时控制，验证了不确定性引导在3DGS中的价值。

title: DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion supports streaming generation and interactive control, but its KV cache grows with the generated history. Existing compression strategies discard history using fixed windows or select tokens through local attention and similarity signals, without directly measuring whether a chunk contributes information beyond the retained context. We introduce DeCoPrune, a training-free method that treats cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem. We find that tokens with larger discrepancies between intermediate clean predictions and final denoised values tend to carry visual evidence less predictable from the retained context. DeCoPrune uses this model-intrinsic signal to retain high-discrepancy tokens in the long-term cache while pruning low-discrepancy tokens. To evaluate information retention, we introduce CMBench, comprising 58 approximately one-minute generated or real-world context episodes and 116 Reappear or Revisit continuation tasks requiring recall of earlier events or objects. Experiments with LingBot World v2 show that DeCoPrune achieves a DINO score of 0.6701 on a 0-1 scale, with an 85.43% reduction in cumulative historical KV token counts and a 4.14-fold continuation-generation speedup over FullKV. Its head-specialized variant reaches 0.6783 at an 86.19% pruning ratio, approaching FullKV's 0.6803 score and exceeding the evaluated compression baselines at similar budgets. These results indicate that denoising consistency can support long-range information retention while reducing autoregressive inference cost. Our project homepage is https://decoprune.github.io. The code is available at https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench, and the benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法DeCoPrune，将自回归视频扩散的KV缓存压缩视为去噪一致性问题，并构建CMBench长程记忆基准。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散支持流式生成与交互控制，但KV缓存随生成历史增长。现有压缩策略依赖固定窗口或局部注意力、相似度信号来丢弃/选择token，未直接衡量某个片段相对保留上下文是否携带额外信息。
AI.method: DeCoPrune为免训练方法：观察到中间干净预测与最终去噪值差异大的token，其视觉证据更难从保留上下文预测；据此将高差异token保留在长期缓存，剔除低差异token。同时提出CMBench基准，含58个约一分钟的生成或真实上下文片段，以及116个Reappear/Revisit延续任务，考察对早期事件或物体的召回。
AI.result: 在LingBot World v2上，DeCoPrune取得0.6701 DINO分数（0-1区间），累计历史KV token减少85.43%，延续生成较FullKV加速4.14倍；头部分化变体在86.19%剪枝率下达0.6783，接近FullKV的0.6803，并在同等预算下超过所评估的压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 去噪一致性可作为长程信息保留的有效依据，在降低自回归推理成本的同时维持召回性能。

title: CamAgent: An LLM-Agent Framework for Multi-Species Camera-Trap Workflows
summary: Camera traps accumulated vast, multidimensional data for wildlife monitoring, yet translating raw media archives into meaningful ecological insights remains highly fragmented. Current research workflows require laboriously stitching together disparate analysis tools and scripts, creating steep programming hurdles and complicating end-to-end spatiotemporal analyses. To overcome this fragmentation, we present CamAgent, an autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agent framework that integrates camera-trap analytical workflows into a unified intelligent ecosystem. CamAgent interprets natural-language ecological intent, schedules computational routing, and executes specialized tools spanning computer-vision perception (e.g., SpeciesNet), CamtrapDP-compatible data management, detection-corrected occupancy modeling, temporal activity analysis, and species co-occurrence networks. The framework automates multi-stage analytical pipelines while maintaining essential data-quality controls and analytical conventions. Consequently, CamAgent significantly reduces manual programming overhead for conservationists, establishing a transparent, scalable, and fully integrated paradigm for camera-trap ecology. Our project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4.

AI.tldr: CamAgent是一个基于大语言模型的自主智能体框架，将红外相机监测的分散分析工具整合为统一的智能生态系统，实现自然语言驱动的端到端生态分析。
AI.motivation: 红外相机积累了海量多维野生动物监测数据，但现有研究流程需手工拼接各种分析工具与脚本，编程门槛高，端到端时空分析复杂，导致数据到生态洞察的转化高度碎片化。
AI.method: 提出CamAgent，一个LLM自主智能体框架。它能解析自然语言的生态学意图，调度计算路由，并执行覆盖计算机视觉感知（如SpeciesNet）、CamtrapDP兼容的数据管理、检测校正的占域建模、时间活动分析和物种共现网络等专用工具，自动完成多阶段分析流水线，同时保持数据质量控制和分析规范。
AI.result: CamAgent显著降低了保护工作者的手工编程负担，实现多阶段分析流程的自动化，并保持数据质量与分析规范。项目地址：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4
AI.conclusion: CamAgent为红外相机生态学建立了一种透明、可扩展且完全集成的分析范式，弥合了原始媒体档案与生态学洞察之间的鸿沟。

title: Beyond Local Linearity: Scale-Resolved Geometry of Learned Image Encoders
comment: Extended abstract, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps). 14 pages, 5 figures
summary: Understanding how learned representations respond to finite input changes is important for characterizing their sensitivity, invariances, and robustness. Yet existing geometric analyses are predominantly local and describe only infinitesimal perturbations. We introduce a scale-resolved statistic that compares an encoder's measured feature displacement with its local linear prediction as the perturbation magnitude increases. Across diverse image encoders, we discover a characteristic plateau-rise-peak-decay profile, which we call the bump. The bump is absent at initialization, emerges early during standard training, and does not form under randomized labels or random-noise inputs. Its shape also varies with the training distribution and robustness objective. These results establish departures from local geometry as a signature of how encoder representations are shaped by learning.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度分辨统计量比较编码器特征位移与其局部线性预测，发现"bump"（平台-上升-峰值-衰减）曲线，作为表征学习塑造的几何签名。
AI.motivation: 现有几何分析多为局部方法，仅描述无穷小扰动下的敏感性、不变性与鲁棒性，无法刻画有限输入变化下表征的响应，因此需要一种跨越扰动尺度的分析工具。
AI.method: 引入一种尺度分辨（scale-resolved）统计量，在扰动幅度递增时，将编码器实测的特征位移与其局部线性预测进行比较，从而量化表征对局部几何的偏离程度，并在多种图像编码器上进行测量。
AI.result: 在多种图像编码器上观察到一致的"平台-上升-峰值-衰减"曲线（称为bump）；该曲线在初始化时不出现，标准训练早期出现；随机标签或随机噪声输入下不形成；其形状随训练分布与鲁棒性目标而变化。
AI.conclusion: 对局部几何的偏离可作为表征如何被学习过程塑造的特征签名，为理解编码器的敏感性、不变性与鲁棒性提供跨尺度的分析视角。

title: GRC-Pose: Generation-Reconstruction Correspondence for Prior-Free 6D Object Pose Tracking
summary: Prior-free 6D object pose tracking seeks to recover the trajectory of an unseen object from a single RGB video without object-specific CAD models, posed reference images, or pose annotations. Geometric foundation models provide complementary object-centric and scene-centric cues, yet SAM3D CAD is indexed by an arbitrary object-local surface parameterization, whereas reconstructed evidence is expressed in a sequence-specific world frame with partial surface coverage. To exploit this complementarity, we formulate tracking as generation-reconstruction correspondence and introduce GRC-Pose, a correspondence-based framework that combines learned correspondence prediction with robust pose estimation. Concretely, GeoCorr-Matcher estimates weighted object-scene correspondences and per-match uncertainty for each pose candidate. FGH-Solver integrates these matches through multiple robust geometric estimators and sequence-level posterior inference, while a posterior-gated memory retains only inlier-supported observations through occlusion and viewpoint change. Extensive evaluation shows that with SAM3D CAD, GRC-Pose achieves state-of-the-art Average Recall and motion retention on HOT3D, improving the latter by 58% over prior art. On classical benchmarks including YCBInEOAT and LINEMOD, it remains highly competitive.

AI.tldr: 提出 GRC-Pose：将无需先验的6D物体位姿跟踪建模为生成-重建对应问题，结合对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计，在 HOT3D 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: Prior-free 6D 位姿跟踪需在无 CAD 模型、无带位姿参考图像、无标注条件下从单目 RGB 视频恢复未见物体轨迹。几何基础模型提供物体中心与场景中心两类互补线索，但二者坐标系不一致：SAM3D CAD 基于任意物体局部表面参数化，而重建证据位于序列特定的世界坐标系且表面覆盖不完整。如何利用这种互补性并弥合坐标系差异是核心动机。
AI.method: 将跟踪表述为“生成-重建对应”（generation-reconstruction correspondence），提出对应框架 GRC-Pose，把学习式对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计结合。其中 GeoCorr-Matcher 为每个位姿候选估计带权重的物体-场景对应及逐匹配不确定性；FGH-Solver 通过多个鲁棒几何估计器与序列级后验推断融合这些匹配；并引入后验门控记忆（posterior-gated memory），在遮挡与视角变化中仅保留得到内点支持的观测。
AI.result: 在使用 SAM3D CAD 时，GRC-Pose 在 HOT3D 上取得 SOTA 的 Average Recall 与 motion retention，后者较此前方法提升 58%；在 YCBInEOAT、LINEMOD 等经典基准上仍具很强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成-重建对应统一物体中心与场景中心线索，并配合不确定性加权匹配、鲁棒求解与后验门控记忆，可在无需物体先验情况下实现稳健的6D位姿跟踪，且在不同类型基准上兼具先进性与泛化竞争力。

title: Is Better Teacher Supervision Enough? Unlocking Student-side Learning in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by providing token-level supervision from a teacher on a student's own trajectories. Existing methods primarily focus on enhancing this teacher-side guidance (e.g., by enriching teacher inputs and refining teacher feedback), yet we find that limited student perception is another critical bottleneck in multimodal OPD. By providing oracle visual facts, the performance of OPD-trained students can still be substantially improved for both weak and strong teachers. To address this bottleneck, we propose S-OPD, a simple multimodal on-policy distillation framework that explicitly strengthens student perceptual learning through two objectives. Specifically, Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast separates student policies under original and masked images with teacher-based token-level gating, strengthening the student's reliance on visual evidence during reasoning. Policy Agreement aligns student policies under original and noise-perturbed images, further improving perceptual robustness to visual noise. Notably, our method can be seamlessly plugged into existing OPD frameworks, requiring no additional data annotations, model parameters or inference operations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks across student scales and distillation paradigms demonstrate consistent performance improvements, with gains of up to 4.25 points on LogicVista. When combined with existing teacher-side supervision methods, our method can yield further gains. Code is available at https://github.com/Sirilaw/S-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 S-OPD，一种简单的多模态在线策略蒸馏框架，通过教师校准策略对比与策略一致性两个目标强化学生的感知学习，可无缝嵌入现有 OPD 框架，在八个基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法主要聚焦于增强教师侧的指导（如丰富教师输入、改进教师反馈），但作者发现学生自身的感知能力有限是另一个关键瓶颈：即使提供 oracle 视觉事实，弱教师和强教师训练出的学生性能仍能显著提升。
AI.method: 提出 S-OPD，通过两个目标显式增强学生感知学习：(1) Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast，借助教师基于 token 级别的门控，区分学生在原图与被遮挡图像下的策略，强化学生对视觉证据的依赖；(2) Policy Agreement，对齐学生在原图与噪声扰动图像下的策略，提升对视觉噪声的感知鲁棒性。方法无需额外数据标注、模型参数或推理操作，可直接接入现有 OPD 框架。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，跨不同学生规模与蒸馏范式均取得一致的性能提升，LogicVista 上最高提升 4.25 分；与现有教师侧监督方法结合时可获得进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 学生感知受限是多模态 OPD 的关键瓶颈，S-OPD 通过强化学生感知学习有效缓解该问题，且兼容现有框架，具有良好可扩展性与互补性。

title: How to Reduce Localization Ambiguity? Geometry-Semantic Constrained BEV Representation Learning for Satellite-Ground Localization
summary: Satellite-ground localization estimates the planar position and yaw orientation of a ground camera within a geo-referenced satellite image. Most recent methods map ground and satellite features into a shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) space and establish spatial correspondences. However, insufficient depth constraints can assign one ground feature to different distances along a viewing direction, creating geometric ambiguity in BEV feature placement. Similar appearances at different locations can also create descriptor matching ambiguity, while existing descriptor learning lacks explicit semantic supervision to distinguish them. We propose GeoSem-BEV, a geometry-semantic constrained BEV representation learning method. Radial depth supervision constrains distance assignment, and vertical height supervision constrains height aggregation. Shared explicit semantic supervision promotes consistent semantic predictions across views and helps distinguish locations with similar semantics. These constraints improve feature placement and descriptor discriminability, enhancing state-of-the-art BEV localization models. On VIGOR with unknown orientation, GeoSem-BEV reduces mean orientation error by 37.2% and 38.1% in the cross-area and same-area settings, respectively. The corresponding errors are reduced by 10.8% and 15.6% on DReSS-D. On KITTI-CVL, it reduces same-area mean orientation error by 26.8% under 10 degree orientation noise.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoSem-BEV，通过几何与语义约束改进BEV表示学习，显著降低卫星-地面定位的朝向误差。
AI.motivation: 现有BEV方法存在两类歧义：深度约束不足导致同一地物被映射到视线方向不同距离（BEV特征放置的几何歧义）；不同位置外观相似导致描述子匹配歧义，且描述子学习缺乏显式语义监督以区分它们。
AI.method: GeoSem-BEV是一种几何-语义约束的BEV表示学习方法：径向深度监督约束距离分配，垂直高度监督约束高度聚合；共享显式语义监督促进跨视图语义预测一致，并帮助区分语义相似的位置。
AI.result: 在VIGOR未知朝向设定下，跨区域和同区域平均朝向误差分别降低37.2%和38.1%；在DReSS-D上分别降低10.8%和15.6%；在KITTI-CVL上，10度朝向噪声下同区域平均朝向误差降低26.8%。
AI.conclusion: 几何与语义约束能改善特征放置并提升描述子判别性，从而增强现有最先进BEV定位模型。

title: GeoGAT: Bidirectional Temporal Sampling Meets Hierarchical Graph Attention for Global Video Geo-localization
summary: Global video geo-localization aims to infer the geographic location of a video worldwide, evaluating performance across four geographic hierarchies: city, state/province, country, and continent. Existing methods typically employ one-way uniform sampling to process video frames and train independent classifiers for each hierarchy, which leads to the loss of key geographic cues and prediction conflicts between hierarchies, especially for complex multi-shot edited videos. To address these limitations, we propose GeoGAT, which integrates bidirectional temporal sampling with graph attention networks (GATs). Specifically, GeoGAT extracts forward and offset-reversed frame sequences to construct complementary spatiotemporal features. These fused features are then fed into a predefined geographical hierarchy graph, where GATs perform structure-aware message passing, while a dual-constraint mechanism prunes predictions to eliminate cross-hierarchy conflicts. We construct GeoGAT10k, comprising 9,720 multi-shot edited videos from 166 cities worldwide, specifically to benchmark generalization ability on complex video structures. Experimental results on CityGuessr68k and GeoGAT10k demonstrate that GeoGAT eliminates hierarchical conflicts entirely and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four geographic hierarchies. On CityGuessr68k, GeoGAT outperforms the strongest baseline, evaluated under both classification and retrieval protocols, by 2.6 percentage points at the city level. On the more challenging GeoGAT10k with multi-shot edited videos, the accuracy improvement exceeds 24 percentage points, validating strong generalization to complex real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoGAT，结合双向时序采样与图注意力网络（GAT）实现全球视频地理定位，并构建 GeoGAT10k 数据集，在四个地理层级上均达 SOTA 且完全消除层级冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有方法采用单向均匀采样处理视频帧，并为每个地理层级训练独立分类器，导致关键地理线索丢失以及层级间预测冲突，在复杂的多镜头剪辑视频中尤为严重。
AI.method: GeoGAT 采用双向时序采样：提取前向与偏移反转（offset-reversed）帧序列以构建互补的时空特征；将融合特征输入预定义的地理层级图，由 GAT 进行结构感知的消息传递；并引入双约束机制对预测进行剪枝以消除跨层级冲突。同时构建 GeoGAT10k 数据集（9,720 段多镜头剪辑视频，覆盖全球 166 个城市）用于评测泛化能力。
AI.result: 在 CityGuessr68k 与 GeoGAT10k 上，GeoGAT 完全消除层级冲突并在四个地理层级上均取得 SOTA。在 CityGuessr68k 上，分类与检索两种评测协议下城市级精度较最强基线提升 2.6 个百分点；在难度更高的 GeoGAT10k 上，精度提升超过 24 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 双向采样与图注意力建模相结合可有效保留地理线索并协调多层级预测，验证了模型对复杂真实场景（多镜头剪辑视频）的强泛化能力。

title: Perceptual Color Difference Modeling Using Machine Learning and Human Similarity Judgments
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to IEEE Access for consideration
summary: Accurate assessment of color differences is essential for applications ranging from digital design to quality control. While existing color difference metrics, such as CIEDE2000, aim to approximate human perception, they may still exhibit inconsistencies with perceptual judgments. In this study, we investigate a data-driven approach to color-difference estimation based directly on human evaluations. We collect similarity judgments for 2,000 systematically generated color pairs, each rated by seven observers using a four-point ordinal scale. These judgments are then used to train regression models using different color representations, including RGB channel differences, HSI differences, and COLIBRI fuzzy linguistic categories. Experiments with five regression algorithms show that the choice of color model has a greater influence on prediction performance than the choice of regression algorithm. Using COLIBRI features alone, linear regression achieves an R2 of 0.595, outperforming RGB and HSI representations, which achieve R2 values of 0.479 and 0.493, respectively. The best performance is obtained by LightGBM using the combined representation, reaching an R2 of 0.703. The results indicate that human perceptual color differences are better captured when numerical color coordinates are complemented by graded perceptual categories, highlighting the potential of data-driven models for perceptually aligned color-difference estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2000对颜色的七人主观相似性评分，比较RGB、HSI与COLIBRI模糊语言特征在五种回归算法下的色差估计性能，发现颜色表征比算法选择影响更大，融合表征配LightGBM达R²=0.703。
AI.motivation: 现有色差度量（如CIEDE2000）虽旨在逼近人类感知，但仍与主观感知判断存在不一致，因此需要直接基于人类评价的数据驱动色差估计方法。
AI.method: 采集2000组系统生成颜色对的相似性判断，每组由7名观察者以四级有序量表评分；以此训练回归模型，比较RGB通道差、HSI差与COLIBRI模糊语言类别等不同颜色表征，并使用五种回归算法进行实验。
AI.result: 颜色模型选择对预测性能的影响大于回归算法选择。仅用COLIBRI特征时线性回归R²=0.595，优于RGB（0.479）与HSI（0.493）；组合表征下LightGBM表现最佳，R²=0.703。
AI.conclusion: 将数值颜色坐标与分级感知类别相结合，能更好刻画人类感知色差，表明数据驱动模型在感知对齐的色差估计方面具有潜力。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: We study few-step video generation, i.e., distilling a multi-step video generator, which typically requires tens of sampling steps, incurring substantial latency and compute, into a few-step student. Consistency distillation is a common recipe, in which a multi-step teacher provides the consistency targets for a few-step student. However, these teacher-guided targets are not equally trustworthy, and the content is harder to learn where it varies rapidly over time, e.g., moving foliage shadows or flowing water. We observe that supervision reliability follows the local difficulty of the content rather than semantic complexity: regions that change little yield consistent endpoint predictions, whereas regions with large temporal variation produce larger discrepancies that coincide with the largest perceptual errors. Motivated by this observation, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation (UACD), which reweights consistency supervision at each spatiotemporal region using a local, parameter-free uncertainty estimate. Specifically, we construct two independently perturbed teacher-guided consistency paths, whose student endpoint predictions provide a consensus target; the discrepancy between the student's direct prediction and this target is the uncertainty proxy. We then relax the consistency penalty on high-uncertainty regions through an exponential weight, while keeping the full penalty elsewhere, since the student cannot be expected to match targets that are hard to learn. To preserve perceptual quality under aggressive step reduction, we integrate feature-space adversarial training with semantic alignment. With parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation of the 50-step Wan model, our method achieves state-of-the-art 4-step generation on VBench 2.0 (0.556 mean score) and is preferred over competing methods in a user study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不确定性感知一致性蒸馏（UACD），通过局部、无参数的不确定性估计对一致性监督进行时空重加权，在50步Wan模型上利用LoRA实现4步视频生成，在VBench 2.0取得0.556的SOTA平均分，并在用户偏好研究中胜出。
AI.motivation: 多步视频生成器采样步数多、延迟与算力开销大，需蒸馏为少步学生模型。一致性蒸馏常以多步教师提供目标，但教师引导的目标并非同等可信：时间上变化剧烈的区域（如移动树影、流水）更难学习。作者观察到监督可靠性取决于内容的局部难度而非语义复杂度——变化小的区域端点预测一致，时间变化大的区域预测差异更大且与最大感知误差吻合。
AI.method: UACD在每个时空区域用局部、无参数的不确定性估计对一致性监督重加权：构造两条独立扰动的教师引导一致性路径，学生端点预测给出共识目标，学生直接预测与该目标的差异作为不确定性代理；对高不确定性区域用指数权重放松一致性惩罚，其余区域保持完整惩罚。为在激进降步下保持感知质量，结合特征空间对抗训练与语义对齐；并对50步Wan模型采用参数高效的LoRA适配。
AI.result: 在VBench 2.0上以LoRA适配50步Wan模型实现4步生成的SOTA结果，平均分0.556；用户研究中也优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 以内容局部难度而非语义复杂度衡量监督可靠性，并用无参数不确定性对一致性蒸馏做时空重加权，是提升少步视频生成质量的有效途径；结合特征空间对抗训练与语义对齐可在显著降步下保持感知质量，在客观基准与主观偏好上均验证了有效性。

title: Feature-Aware Token Attack for Compression-Triggered Stealthy Failures in Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 29 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual-token compression improves the efficiency of large vision-language models, but can expose failures that full-token evaluation misses. We study adversarial images that preserve full-token correctness yet induce errors after compression, even when both inference paths succeed on the clean image. Creating such failures is challenging because perturbing token importance can also damage the visual content needed for full-token inference. We propose Feature-Aware Token Attack (FATA), which couples attention suppression with cosine-based feature preservation on a fixed set of salient clean-image tokens. In the primary LLaVA-1.5-7B setting, FATA uses only vision-encoder gradients, without access to the deployed compressor, token budget, or downstream task. Across four visually dependent task subsets and four compressors under a controlled reconstruction protocol, FATA achieves SR = 96.3% full-token accuracy retention and CBR = 22.1% conditional blinding, compared with 89.8% and 15.7% for CAA. Ablations support the role of both objectives in balancing compressed-path failure against full-token preservation. FATA also has the lowest measured detection rate among four attacks across three evaluated detectors at a 5% false-positive rate. These findings motivate assessing adversarial robustness jointly across full-token and compressed inference.

AI.tldr: 提出特征感知令牌攻击（FATA），通过注意力抑制+余弦特征保持，使视觉令牌压缩路径出错，同时保持全令牌路径正确，暴露压缩引入的对抗脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 视觉令牌压缩提升大视觉语言模型效率，但可能带来全令牌评估无法发现的失败模式；需要研究"全令牌正确、压缩后出错"的对抗图像，而现有攻击难以兼顾扰动令牌重要性同时不破坏全令牌推理所需的视觉内容。
AI.method: FATA在固定的干净图像显著令牌集合上，将注意力抑制与基于余弦的特征保持相耦合；主设置（LLaVA-1.5-7B）仅使用视觉编码器梯度，不访问部署的压缩器、令牌预算或下游任务。
AI.result: 在四个视觉依赖任务子集、四种压缩器的受控重建协议下，FATA达到96.3%全令牌准确率保持（SR）与22.1%条件致盲率（CBR），优于CAA的89.8%与15.7%；消融验证两个目标各自作用；在5%假阳性率下，三个检测器上FATA检测率在四种攻击中最低。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明应在全令牌与压缩推理两条路径上联合评估对抗鲁棒性。

title: Asking the World: Generalist Physical Reasoning through Agentic World Modeling and Probing
summary: Physical reasoning from video requires inferring latent physical properties and dynamics beyond direct observation. Direct VLM inference remains unreliable on complex physical tasks without explicit modeling and validation, while predefined tool pipelines rely on task- and domain-specific priors that limit generalization across materials, dynamics, and reasoning tasks. We introduce Asking the World (ATW), a generalist agent that constructs and interrogates task-relevant executable worlds through two adaptive stages: World Modeling calibrates a world from video, while World Probing queries, simulates, and intervenes on it to obtain question-relevant evidence. Rather than prescribing the operations in either stage, ATW determines how to model and probe according to the scene and question. We develop PolyWorld Engine, a lightweight and highly programmable Warp-based multiphysics simulator for constructing and probing worlds with rigid bodies, soft bodies, cloth, ropes, fluids, and their coupled interactions. CEM-based system identification recovers task-relevant dynamics during World Modeling. The resulting world becomes an active workspace for question-directed physical experiments rather than a predetermined downstream tool. We evaluate ATW on CLEVRER, ContPhy, and three real-world scenarios. Using Gemini-3-Flash as its base VLM, ATW achieves 80.82% overall per-question accuracy on CLEVRER, improving direct Gemini-3-Flash by 46.50 points, GPT-5.5 by 13.58 points, and PhysMind by 8.27 points. On ContPhy, it reaches 70.56% overall accuracy, surpassing Gemini-3-Flash by 28.10 points and GPT-5.5 by 3.53 points. Across the three real-world scenarios, ATW achieves 71.67% accuracy, 28.33 points above GPT-5.5. These results establish agentic world modeling and probing as an effective, execution-grounded approach to generalist physical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出ATW通用智能体，通过自适应地构建并探询可执行世界来实现视频物理推理。
AI.motivation: 视频物理推理需推断直接观测之外的潜在物理属性与动力学。直接VLM推理在复杂物理任务上不可靠，而预定义工具管线依赖任务与领域先验，泛化性受限。
AI.method: ATW包含两个自适应阶段：世界建模（World Modeling）从视频中校准世界；世界探询（World Probing）通过查询、仿真与干预获取与问题相关的证据。构建PolyWorld Engine——基于Warp的轻量级可编程多物理仿真器，支持刚体、软体、布料、绳索、流体及其耦合交互；世界建模中采用基于CEM的系统辨识恢复任务相关动力学。
AI.result: 以Gemini-3-Flash为基座VLM：CLEVRER上每题整体准确率80.82%，较直接Gemini-3-Flash提升46.50点、GPT-5.5提升13.58点、PhysMind提升8.27点；ContPhy上70.56%，超越Gemini-3-Flash 28.10点、GPT-5.5 3.53点；三个真实场景平均71.67%，高于GPT-5.5 28.33点。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式世界建模与探询是一种有效、执行落地的通用物理推理方法。

title: When Can Text Replace Vision? Structural Bottlenecks in Diagram Reasoning
summary: Can structured text replace vision for diagram reasoning? A wrong answer after textualization can arise because the representation omits information the question needs, or because the solver fails to use information that is present. We introduce a diagnostic protocol to distinguish these explanations. Using the same solver model and generation settings, we compare three input conditions: the original image, question-blind structure extracted by a vision-language model, or gold structure derived from the diagram source. Validity-triggered recovery tests truncation and schema failure, question-relevant fidelity measures preservation of answer-critical structure, and matched edge interventions test the effect of error location. On a reserved holdout of 240 public FlowGen diagrams, evaluated under a frozen protocol, gold structure reaches 87% accuracy while direct vision and learned text both remain below 30%. The aggregate comparison includes source-derived relation labels that may not be printed in the image and uses different learned and gold graph encodings, so it does not isolate extraction error alone. Retrying only invalid extractions makes nearly every public representation schema-valid yet leaves accuracy essentially unchanged. The public learned-text deficit relative to gold more than doubles with structural difficulty. Question-relevant topology predicts correctness better than whole-graph topology. In an exposed intervention study, a single answer-relevant edge edit reduces the primary solver's original-answer accuracy to near zero, while matched irrelevant edits largely preserve it. Supplied structure requires fewer solving tokens than vision, but learned acquisition removes this advantage at single use. These comparisons motivate evaluating acquired text by the answer-relevant evidence it preserves and by the solver's ability to use that representation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种诊断协议，用于区分"结构化文本替代视觉进行图表推理"中错误答案的两个来源：表示本身缺失问题所需信息，还是求解器未能利用已有信息。
AI.motivation: 在用结构化文本替代视觉输入进行图表推理时，答案错误可能源于两种机制：文本化过程丢失了问题所需信息（表示缺陷），或求解器未能使用已存在的信息（求解缺陷）。此前研究未区分这两者，因此无法判断瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 在相同求解器模型与生成设置下比较三种输入条件：原始图像、视觉语言模型抽取的问题盲结构、以及由图源得到的金标准结构。采用有效性触发的恢复测试检验截断与模式失效；用问题相关保真度衡量答案关键结构的保留；用匹配边干预测试错误位置的影响。在240个公开FlowGen图表保留集上以冻结协议评估。
AI.result: 金标准结构准确率达87%，而直接视觉与学习文本均低于30%。仅重试无效抽取可使几乎所有表示通过模式校验，但准确率基本不变。学习文本相对金标准的差距随结构难度增加而翻倍以上。问题相关拓扑比整图拓扑更能预测正确性。干预实验中，编辑一条答案相关边使主求解器原始答案准确率降至近零，而匹配的无关编辑基本保持准确率。供给结构比视觉消耗更少求解token，但单次使用时学习抽取削弱了这一优势。
AI.conclusion: 聚合比较包含图像中未必印出的源导出关系标签并使用不同的学习与金标准图编码，故未单独隔离抽取误差。评估习得文本应关注其保留的答案相关证据及求解器使用该表示的能力，而非仅看模式有效性或整图保真度。

title: MindWorldBench: Evaluating Mental-State-to-Behavior Reasoning in Image-to-Video Generation
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Current image-to-video models achieve visual realism and physical plausibility, but reasoning about mental states remains unexplored. Actions are driven by belief, desire, and perception, requiring inference beyond explicit instructions. We introduce MindWorldBench to evaluate mental-state-conditioned video generation. We formalize this as mental-state-to-behavior reasoning, where models generate actions from a world state and latent variables without explicit action prompts. MindWorldBench utilizes Zero-Action Prompting and a counterfactual design with 744 prompts to isolate the causal effects of mental states. An automated pipeline evaluates video quality, commonsense plausibility, and mental-state consistency. Evaluations of 11 models show that despite visual fidelity and physical reasoning, models fail to align behaviors with latent mental states. We identify a failure mode, termed Omniscient Bias, where models default to the objective world state rather than human's subjective belief. These results demonstrate a disconnect between visual generation and cognitive reasoning, suggesting a need for explicit mental-state modeling in video generation systems. Project website: https://richard2049-lee.github.io/MindWorldBench/

AI.tldr: 论文提出MindWorldBench，用于评估"心理状态条件视频生成"，即模型需从世界状态与潜在心理变量（信念、欲望、感知）推断行为，而非依据显式动作提示。实验发现11个模型虽视觉逼真却无法将行为对齐潜在心理状态，并识别出"全知偏差"失败模式。
AI.motivation: 当前图生视频模型虽在视觉真实感与物理合理性上表现出色，但对心理状态的推理仍属空白。人类行为由信念、欲望与感知驱动，往往超出显式指令所能刻画的范围，因此需要专门的评测基准来检验模型是否具备心理状态到行为的推理能力。
AI.method: 形式化定义为"心理状态到行为的推理"：给定世界状态与潜在变量，模型在无显式动作提示下生成动作。构建MindWorldBench，采用Zero-Action Prompting与反事实设计，共744条提示词以分离心理状态的因果效应；并设计自动化评估流程，从视频质量、常识合理性、心理状态一致性三个维度打分。
AI.result: 对11个模型的评测显示，尽管具备视觉保真度与物理推理能力，模型仍无法使生成行为与潜在心理状态对齐。研究识别出一类失败模式"全知偏差"（Omniscient Bias）：模型倾向于依据客观世界状态而非人的主观信念生成行为。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了视觉生成与认知推理之间的脱节，表明视频生成系统需要引入显式的心理状态建模，才能实现真正的心理状态条件生成。

title: OP-CAD: On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation for Robust Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models deployed in real-world environments encounter external noise that can interfere with their perception and understanding of multimodal inputs. We study their robustness in audio-visual understanding, focusing on question answering under environmental noise and competing speech. The challenge is to resist acoustic interference while preserving useful audio evidence. On-policy distillation provides dense teacher feedback on student-generated responses, but uniform token weighting does not explicitly prioritize positions affected by acoustic interference. We introduce OP-CAD (On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation), a curriculum-based privileged self-distillation framework for robust audio-visual understanding. Training progresses from mild to severe environmental noise and competing speech, with selective token-level supervision at each stage. The student generates responses from corrupted audio-visual input, while a frozen teacher uses clean audio and the verified answer to supervise the same response prefixes. To allocate this supervision, OP-CAD compares teacher predictions under clean, corrupted, and visual-only contexts without revealing the answer. These matched comparisons measure sensitivity to audio removal and corruption; a bounded weighting rule emphasizes positions identified by either signal while retaining supervision throughout the response. OP-CAD outperforms the compared methods across all evaluated noise conditions. Paired analyses further show improved preservation of clean-correct answers under strong interference, with no observed aggregate clean-accuracy penalty. These results demonstrate the value of directing clean-teacher supervision toward acoustically sensitive predictions for robust audio-visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OP-CAD（On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation），一个基于课程式的特权自蒸馏框架，用于提升音视频大模型在环境噪声与竞争语音下的鲁棒性。其核心是在同一生成前缀上，用干净音频的冻结教师进行 token 级选择性监督，并依据“去音频/被污染”敏感性对 token 加权，从而在噪声条件下优于对比方法，且无明显干净精度损失。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的外部噪声会干扰全模态大模型对多模态输入的感知与理解，尤其影响音视频问答。核心难点在于既要抵抗声学干扰，又要保留有用的音频证据。on-policy 蒸馏虽能对学生生成的回答提供密集教师反馈，但均匀的 token 加权并未显式优先照顾受声学干扰影响的位置。
AI.method: OP-CAD（On-Policy Clean-Audio Distillation）采用课程式特权自蒸馏：训练从轻度到严重的环境噪声与竞争语音递进，每一阶段进行选择性 token 级监督。学生基于被破坏的音视频输入生成回答，冻结教师使用干净音频和已验证答案监督相同回答前缀。为分配监督权重，OP-CAD 在不暴露答案的前提下，比较教师在干净、被污染与仅视觉三种上下文下的预测，这些匹配比较度量了对“去除音频”和“音频被破坏”的敏感性；采用有界加权规则，强调被任一信号识别出的位置，同时保留对整段回答的监督。
AI.result: OP-CAD 在所有评估的噪声条件下均优于对比方法。配对分析进一步显示，在强干扰下干净正确的回答得到更好保留，且未观察到总体干净精度损失。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，将干净教师的监督导向对声学敏感的预测位置，对鲁棒的音视频推理具有重要价值。

title: TripleFlow: Training-Free Video Object Removal by Bridging Residual Editing and Native Generation
summary: Video object removal presents a uniquely difficult editing challenge. Because a removal prompt specifies only what to erase rather than what to generate, the model must infer and reconstruct a highly specific occluded background entirely from the surrounding context. Existing training-free methods struggle with this because their editing mechanisms act primarily as localized erasers. They fail to actively synthesize the missing background details and often leave behind ghosting artifacts. To solve this, we propose TripleFlow, a training-free framework that tightly couples erasure and generation. It coordinates a source flow, a residual flow, and a synthesis flow throughout the entire process. By reusing a single target prediction, the residual flow isolates and suppresses the object, while the synthesis flow independently reconstructs the occluded background. Crucially, TripleFlow injects this newly synthesized background back into the editing trajectory at every step. This continuous feedback loop ensures that the generated structures actively guide the removal process, achieving seamless completion that is spatiotemporally consistent with the unedited scene. Extensive evaluations across five challenging benchmarks demonstrate that TripleFlow establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 TripleFlow，通过源流、残差流、合成流三流协同，将擦除与生成紧密耦合，实现视频目标移除中遮挡背景的高保真重建。
AI.motivation: 视频目标移除中，移除提示只指定"要擦除什么"而非"要生成什么"，模型必须完全依赖周围上下文推断并重建高度特定的被遮挡背景。现有免训练方法其编辑机制本质上只是局部擦除器，无法主动合成缺失的背景细节，且常留下鬼影伪影。
AI.method: 提出 TripleFlow，一个将擦除与生成紧密耦合的免训练框架，全程协调源流（source flow）、残差流（residual flow）与合成流（synthesis flow）三条流。通过复用单一目标预测，残差流负责隔离并抑制目标对象，合成流独立重建被遮挡背景；关键地，TripleFlow 在每一步将新合成的背景重新注入编辑轨迹，形成持续反馈回路，使生成结构主动引导移除过程。
AI.result: 在五个具有挑战性的基准上开展广泛评估，TripleFlow 在重建保真度与时间一致性两方面均显著优于现有基线，达到新的 state-of-the-art 水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过三流协同与逐步背景回注的连续反馈机制，TripleFlow 实现了与未编辑场景在时空上无缝一致的补全，证明将生成信号主动引入擦除轨迹是解决视频目标移除背景重建难题的有效途径。

title: MEND: Label-Free Detection, Localisation, and Correction of Latent Hallucination in World Models
comment: Accepted at DICTA 2026 (International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications). Camera-ready version
summary: World Models are appearing as the next major frontier in computer vision. However, their robustness is currently largely unexplored. We identify the phenomenon of hallucination in latent World Models: given a state and an action, the predicted next latent can decode to a scene that never occurs. Because the prediction is statistically ordinary and is fed back autoregressively by the model, the error is both silent and compounding. We study whether such latent hallucination can be detected, localised, and corrected at inference time, on a frozen self-supervised world model in the absence of ground-truth error labels. We introduce Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising (MEND), a single conditional score network trained by denoising score matching on real transitions, whose score field serves three roles: its magnitude detects hallucination, its per-token field localises it to specific image patches, and it defines an inference-time correction direction. On two navigation environments MEND detects hallucination with an AUROC of up to 0.80 without using actions, exceeding a single-Gaussian density baseline while also localising the error (per-token AUPRC up to 0.87) and correcting it, all from one score field. Our correction reliably reduces single-step latent error and improves predictions. We identify that a part of the error is tangent to the data manifold, hence, we focus on detection and localisation while highlighting promises of the correction.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统研究潜在世界模型中的"幻觉"现象，提出 MEND——一个在真实转移上经去噪得分匹配训练的条件得分网络，其得分场可同时实现幻觉检测、定位与推理时校正。
AI.motivation: 世界模型正成为计算机视觉的新前沿，但其鲁棒性尚缺乏研究。作者发现潜在世界模型存在"幻觉"：给定状态与动作，预测的下一潜在表示解码后可能得到从未出现过的场景。由于该预测在统计上"平常"（低概率异常）且被自回归反馈，错误既静默又不断累积。核心问题是：在冻结的自监督世界模型、且没有真实误差标签的条件下，能否在推理时检测、定位并校正这种潜在幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 Masked Empirical-Bayes Neural Denoising（MEND）：一个条件得分网络，通过在真实转移数据上做去噪得分匹配（denoising score matching）训练。该得分场承担三重角色——(1) 得分幅值用于检测幻觉；(2) 逐 token 的得分场将错误定位到具体图像块（patch）；(3) 得分场定义推理时的校正方向。整个过程在冻结模型、无误差标签下完成。
AI.result: 在两个导航环境中，MEND 不使用动作信息即可检测幻觉，AUROC 最高达 0.80，超过单高斯密度基线；同时实现错误定位（逐 token AUPRC 最高 0.87）并进行校正，三者均由同一得分场给出。校正方法能稳定降低单步潜在误差并改善预测。作者指出部分误差与数据流形相切（tangent to the data manifold），因此重点放在检测与定位，同时指出校正的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 潜在世界模型的幻觉可被检测、定位与部分校正；单一条件得分场即可统一完成三项任务。由于部分误差位于数据流形的切空间，完全校正具有内在困难，未来工作应继续挖掘校正的潜力。

title: Aligning Thoughts with Answers: Probability Rewards to Tame Thinking Drift
summary: This paper studies \textbf{thinking--answer consistency} in vision-language models. We focus on Visual Intention Grounding, where a model infers a target object based on a human intention query and predicts a bounding box. We reveal that previous IoU-based reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks suffer from ``thinking drift'', where the model produces a correct bounding box, despite having an incorrect reasoning process pointing to a different target object. Thus, we propose \textbf{Rita} (\textit{ReInforcing Thinking--Answer consistency}) as a novel RL paradigm to tame the drift. Specifically, Rita introduces two reasoning-label-free RL rewards, constructed from the conditional probability of reference answers: a \textbf{thinking reward} and a \textbf{consistency reward}. It also adopts a difficulty-aware \textbf{data filtering} strategy that selects informative easy-to-medium samples for RL using rollout error rate and reward variance. Extensive experiments on EgoIntention and the new RefEgo-Int benchmarks show that Rita performs consistently superior to the supervised finetuning approaches and vanilla RL-finetuned frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型的"思维-答案一致性"问题，提出Rita强化学习范式，通过思维奖励与一致性奖励缓解思维漂移，在EgoIntention和RefEgo-Int上优于监督微调与普通RL框架。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IoU的强化学习框架存在"思维漂移"：模型虽输出正确边界框，但其推理过程却指向了不同的目标物体，即推理与答案不一致，缺乏对思维过程的约束。
AI.method: 提出Rita（ReInforcing Thinking-Answer consistency）范式：引入两种无需推理标签的RL奖励——思维奖励（thinking reward）与一致性奖励（consistency reward），均由参考答案的条件概率构建；并采用难度感知的数据过滤策略，基于rollout错误率与奖励方差筛选易到中等难度的信息性样本用于RL训练。
AI.result: 在EgoIntention与新建的RefEgo-Int基准上，Rita持续优于监督微调方法和普通RL微调框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式强化思维与答案的一致性，可有效抑制思维漂移，提升视觉意图定位任务的性能。

title: Fiber-Resolved Microstructure Quantification from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI using Detection Transformers
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; Accepted at MICCAI 2026 Workshop CDMRI; Code: https://github.com/Marcus02W/Diffusion-DETR
summary: Fiber orientation and compartmental microstructure are central to the characterization of white matter tissue in diffusion MRI, yet existing methods either resolve fiber orientations without quantifying microstructure, or quantify microstructure while assuming a fixed number of compartments and a single fiber direction. Nonparametric approaches that recover both require tensor-valued diffusion encoding and computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of an ill-posed inverse Laplace transform. We propose to reframe this problem as an object detection-like task, adopting the Detection Transformer (DETR) architecture to jointly predict mean diffusivity (MD), fractional anisotropy (FA), main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel from standard multi-shell diffusion MRI with linear encoding. Hungarian matching during training resolves permutation invariance across compartments. We introduce mean Average Precision as a reproducible benchmark metric. Evaluated on synthetic test data with up to five compartments per voxel, our model achieves $R^2=0.95$ for MD, $R^2=0.88$ for FA, and a median angular error of 4.2°, with performance scaling naturally with compartmental signal fraction.

AI.tldr: 该论文将白质纤维方向与微结构联合估计重构为类目标检测任务，采用DETR架构从标准多壳线性扩散MRI中预测每体素可变数量分室的MD、FA、主纤维方向与信号占比，并引入mAP作为可复现评测指标。
AI.motivation: 扩散MRI中，纤维方向与分室微结构对白质表征均至关重要，但现有方法要么只解析方向不量化微结构，要么在固定分室数与单一纤维方向假设下量化微结构；能同时恢复两者的非参数方法依赖张量值扩散编码与计算昂贵的蒙特卡洛反演，且需处理病态逆拉普拉斯变换。
AI.method: 将问题重述为类目标检测任务，采用Detection Transformer（DETR）架构，从标准多壳线性编码扩散MRI中联合预测每个体素可变数量分室的平均弥散率（MD）、各向异性分数（FA）、主纤维方向与信号占比；训练时使用匈牙利匹配解决分室间的排列不变性；引入mean Average Precision（mAP）作为可复现基准指标。
AI.result: 在每体素最多五个分室的合成测试数据上，模型取得MD的R²=0.95、FA的R²=0.88、中位角度误差4.2°，且性能随分室信号占比自然变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明可用目标检测范式替代昂贵的非参数反演，从标准线性编码多壳扩散MRI中联合估计可变数量分室的纤维方向与微结构，并获得较高精度与可复现的评测基准。

title: Uruqi: Learning Spatial Cognition from Visual Experience
summary: Spatial intelligence requires maintaining a coherent understanding of the world as the embodied agent moves. Like humans, the agent must use its own motion to interpret changes across observations and update object locations and spatial relations accordingly. Despite spatial post-training having substantially broadened the spatial intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs), they still struggle with two atomic spatial capabilities: tracking self-motion and mapping the surrounding world during motion. To address this gap, we provide dense multi-turn supervision over interleaved atomic capabilities within each training episode, mimicking the visual experience of a continuously moving agent that reasons as it observes. To scale this up, we synthesize 11,738 motif-driven camera trajectories over a broad range of 3D scenes, supporting self-motion tracking, persistent object mapping, and rich spatial operations within each visual experience. By training models to reason over these atomic questions, our URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B improves accuracy from 15.84% to 47.73% on our Uruqi benchmark comprising 52k questions across 2.7k episodes. URUQI-SI-Mix-8B further reaches 50.41%, comparable to the 50.08% achieved by GPT-6 Astra. Trained solely on our synthesized data, URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of 17.13% over its InternVL3-8B backbone across three external spatial benchmarks. These results highlight continuous visual experience as a scalable source of supervision for developing spatial cognition in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出URUQI框架，通过合成1.1万余条相机轨迹提供密集多轮监督，训练VLM的自我运动追踪与世界映射能力，在自建基准上准确率从15.84%提升至47.73%，外部基准平均相对提升17.13%。
AI.motivation: 空间智能要求具身智能体在移动中维持连贯的世界理解，需利用自身运动解释观测变化并更新物体位置与空间关系。现有VLM经空间后训练后仍缺乏两项原子能力：追踪自我运动、在运动中映射周围世界。
AI.method: 在每个训练回合内对交错的原子能力提供密集多轮监督，模拟连续移动智能体边观察边推理的视觉体验；合成11,738条motif驱动的相机轨迹，覆盖多种3D场景，支持自我运动追踪、持久物体映射与丰富空间操作。
AI.result: URUQI_Syn-8B在含52k问题、2.7k回合的Uruqi基准上准确率由15.84%升至47.73%；URUQI-SI-Mix-8B达50.41%，与GPT-6 Astra的50.08%相当；仅用合成数据训练，在三个外部空间基准上较InternVL3-8B骨干平均相对提升17.13%。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉体验可作为可扩展的监督来源，用于发展VLM的空间认知能力。

title: DC-SAE: Deep Compression Semantic Autoencoder for Faster Diffusion Convergence
summary: High-compression tokenizers are essential for scaling latent image generative models. However, aggressive compression creates a fundamental tradeoff between reconstruction fidelity and generation efficiency: high compression image encoder always increases the learning difficulty of diffusion training, resulting in slow model convergence. Recent representation autoencoders speed up the diffusion training by improving the latent feature's expressive capability by replacing VAE encoders with pretrained semantic encoders, yet they are typically limited to moderate compression and lose pixel-level details necessary for faithful reconstruction. To achieve both high compression and fast diffusion training, we propose DC-SAE, a Decoupled Compact Semantic Autoencoder designed for high-compression image generation with accelerated diffusion model convergence. DC-SAE consists of two key components: (1) a macro-level architecture design that leverages semantic encoders to enable higher compression ratios, and (2) a pixel-level encoder that preserves low-level details, ensuring high-fidelity image reconstruction. We empirically demonstrate that DC-SAE performs strongly on image generation tasks, achieving both compact latent representations and efficient training dynamics. Specifically, on the ImageNet dataset with $512 \times 512$ resolution, DC-SAE achieves $32\times$ spatial compression, with 29.79 PSNR and 3.37 gFID, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art high-compression tokenizer baselines DC-AE by 13.5% and 54.9% on PSNR and gFID, respectively, maintaining comparable throughput and faster diffusion model training convergence. Beyond class-conditional generation, a $1.6$B-parameter DiT using DC-SAE achieves 0.84 on GenEval and 86.007 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation at $1024\times1024$ resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DC-SAE，一种解耦紧凑语义自编码器，通过宏观架构设计与像素级编码器解耦，实现高压缩率（32×）与快速扩散训练收敛的兼顾，在 ImageNet 512×512 上取得 29.79 PSNR 和 3.37 gFID。
AI.motivation: 高压缩 tokenizer 对扩展潜在图像生成模型至关重要，但激进压缩会在重建保真度与生成效率之间形成根本性权衡：高压缩编码器加大扩散训练难度，导致收敛缓慢。现有表示自编码器虽用预训练语义编码器替换 VAE 编码器、提升了潜特征表达能力并加速训练，但通常仅限中等压缩，且丢失忠实重建所需的像素级细节。因此需要一种同时实现高压缩与快速扩散训练的方法。
AI.method: 提出 DC-SAE（Decoupled Compact Semantic Autoencoder），包含两个关键组件：(1) 宏观层面架构设计，利用语义编码器支持更高压缩比；(2) 像素级编码器，保留低层细节以确保高保真图像重建。二者解耦以同时兼顾压缩效率与重建质量。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 512×512 分辨率上，DC-SAE 实现 32× 空间压缩，达到 29.79 PSNR 与 3.37 gFID，在 PSNR 和 gFID 上分别较此前最优高压缩 tokenizer 基线 DC-AE 提升 13.5% 和 54.9%，同时保持相当吞吐量并加快扩散模型训练收敛。在文本到图像生成任务上，采用 DC-SAE 的 1.6B 参数 DiT 在 1024×1024 分辨率下取得 GenEval 0.84 与 DPG-Bench 86.007。
AI.conclusion: DC-SAE 通过解耦紧凑语义自编码器设计，打破了高压缩下重建保真度与扩散训练效率之间的权衡，在类条件与文本到图像生成任务中均表现强劲，同时实现紧凑潜表示与高效训练动态，超越既有高压缩 tokenizer 基线。

title: Emergent Multi-View Geometry Through Self-Distillation
summary: Over a century ago, Henri Poincaré argued that a motionless observer cannot acquire the notion of space. Yet, most visual representation learning methods operate on individual images, while those that leverage multiple views rely on RGB reconstruction, entangling geometry with appearance. We propose Poincar3, a self-supervised method that learns representations from multiple views through self-distillation instead of RGB reconstruction. We combine masked patch and image-level distillation with a teacher that observes additional views, enabling training from scratch without explicit 3D supervision. Poincar3 outperforms both previous single and multi-view self-supervised approaches such as DINOv3, MuM, and Muskie on correspondence estimation, camera pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction. Using a lightweight Poincaré adapter, we also find that our learned features encode camera motion more accurately than existing self-supervised representations.

AI.tldr: 提出Poincar3，一种基于自蒸馏而非RGB重建的多视角自监督表征学习方法。
AI.motivation: 受Poincaré观点启发（静止观察者无法获得空间概念），指出多数视觉表征学习方法仅用单张图像，而多视角方法依赖RGB重建，将几何与外观纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 通过自蒸馏从多视角学习表征：结合掩码patch与图像级蒸馏，并使用观察额外视角的teacher模型，实现无需显式3D监督的从头训练；另引入轻量级Poincaré适配器。
AI.result: 在对应估计、相机位姿估计和3D重建上优于DINOv3、MuM、Muskie等单/多视角自监督方法；学习到的特征通过Poincaré适配器能更准确地编码相机运动。
AI.conclusion: 用自蒸馏替代RGB重建可从多视角学得蕴含几何/相机运动信息的表征，且无需显式3D监督。

title: Universal Cross-Prompt Adversarial Attacks on Promptable Concept Segmentation
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) achieves remarkable performance in visual segmentation. The latest SAM3 extends promptable segmentation to concept-level prediction, broadening the scope of segmentation foundation models. While recent works reveal that SAM and SAM2 are vulnerable to adversarial examples, the robustness of SAM3 under the concept segmentation paradigm remains unexplored. In addition, existing adversarial attacks on SAM-series models exhibit limited cross-prompt transferability. To this end, we propose AdvPCS, a universal cross-prompt adversarial attack for Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS), including a min-max prompt optimization strategy, a global-local perception deception attack, and a temporal transition deviation attack. Specifically, we first identify the hardest-to-attack prompts via min-max bilevel optimization. In the inner maximization, we enhance diversity over candidate point, box, and text prompts. In the outer minimization, we select prompts with the highest responses based on the confidence scores output by the detector. Given the selected prompts, we apply the perception deception attack to minimize both global and local existence probabilities under joint prompting and employ the temporal memory misalignment attack to maximize inter-frame semantic inconsistency and corrupt memory pointers. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that a single universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) generated by our method generalizes across frames from different videos and achieves strong attack performance under point, box, and text prompts. In particular, it reduces the average mIoU of various PCS models on the SA-CO dataset to below 5% under text prompts, demonstrating strong attack ability.

AI.tldr: 提出AdvPCS，首个针对SAM3可提示概念分割（PCS）的通用跨提示对抗攻击，含最小-最大提示优化、全局-局部感知欺骗与时序转移偏差攻击。
AI.motivation: SAM3将可提示分割扩展到概念级预测，但已有研究仅揭示SAM/SAM2对对抗样本脆弱，SAM3在概念分割范式下的鲁棒性尚未探索；且现有SAM系列攻击的跨提示迁移性有限。
AI.method: AdvPCS包含三部分：(1) 最小-最大提示优化：通过双层优化识别最难攻击提示，内层最大化在点、框、文本提示上增强多样性，外层最小化基于检测器置信度选高响应提示；(2) 全局-局部感知欺骗攻击：在联合提示下最小化全局与局部存在概率；(3) 时序转移偏差攻击：最大化帧间语义不一致性并破坏记忆指针。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，单个通用对抗扰动（UAP）可跨不同视频帧泛化，在点、框、文本提示下均取得强攻击性能；在SA-CO数据集文本提示下，将多种PCS模型的平均mIoU降至5%以下。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次揭示SAM3在概念分割范式下的对抗脆弱性，提出的通用跨提示攻击AdvPCS具有强泛化攻击能力。

title: PLRS-IC: A Dual-Calibration Framework for Chest X-Ray Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Fine-grained vision-language alignment in chest radiography enables zero-shot classification, grounding, and segmentation without task-specific annotations. However, this alignment is fundamentally hindered by two intertwined sources of ambiguity: projection-induced visual mismatch and patient-agnostic semantic overlap. First, at the local feature level, frontal and lateral radiographs exhibit distinct appearances for the same clinical finding, rendering a shared patch-text similarity geometry inherently suboptimal. Compounding this visual ambiguity is a semantic mismatch during global contrastive optimization, where instance-level objectives penalize cross-patient pairs as strict negatives even when they share identical positive clinical concepts. To address this dual ambiguity, we propose PLRS-IC, a unified dual-calibration framework for chest X-ray representation learning. At the local alignment stage, Projection-Conditioned Low-Rank Residual Similarity (PLRS) dynamically adapts patch-text matching to projection-specific manifolds using a bounded, parameter-efficient low-rank residual. At the global optimization stage, Information-Content-Calibrated Soft False-Negative Suppression (IC-SFNS) leverages a corpus-derived information-theoretic prior to soften the penalty of semantically overlapping negatives without altering original contrastive assignments. Extensive experiments across nine public zero-shot benchmark settings demonstrate that our framework yields consistent improvements in classification, grounding, and segmentation, validating the necessity of dual-calibration in medical vision-language pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PLRS-IC双重校准框架，通过投影条件低秩残差相似性（PLRS）和信息内容校准软假阴性抑制（IC-SFNS），解决胸片视觉语言对齐中的投影性视觉失配与患者无关语义重叠双重歧义，在九个零样本基准上实现分类、定位与分割的一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉语言对齐可实现胸片零样本分类、定位与分割，但受两类相互交织的歧义阻碍：一是投影导致的视觉失配——正位与侧位胸片对同一临床发现呈现不同外观，共享的图文块相似性几何并非最优；二是全局对比优化中的语义失配——实例级目标将跨患者但具有相同阳性临床概念的样本对视为严格负样本，产生假阴性惩罚。
AI.method: 提出PLRS-IC统一双重校准框架，含两个模块：局部对齐阶段采用投影条件低秩残差相似性（PLRS），借助有界的参数高效低秩残差，将图文块匹配动态适配到投影特定流形；全局优化阶段采用信息内容校准软假阴性抑制（IC-SFNS），利用语料库导出的信息论先验软化语义重叠负样本的惩罚，且不改变原始对比分配。
AI.result: 在九个公开零样本基准设置上的大量实验表明，该框架在分类、定位与分割任务上均取得一致性提升，验证了医学视觉语言预训练中双重校准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 投影性视觉失配与语义重叠两类歧义是胸片视觉语言对齐的核心瓶颈，局部与全局的双重校准可有效缓解该问题，提升零样本多任务性能。

title: MegaAvatar: Controllable Talking Avatar Generation
summary: This report presents \textbf{MegaAvatar}, a controllable talking avatar generation framework built on top of the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B model. Compared with previous talking-avatar methods that mainly rely on audio or reference-image conditioning, we introduce additional SMPL-X-derived 3D guidance, enabling global control over body pose and head motion. Specifically, we render the driving SMPL-X sequence into dense mesh frames and encode them with a lightweight 3D convolutional encoder, whose outputs are injected into the latent tokens to provide overall motion control. Furthermore, we extend Wan2.2-TI2V-5B with additional audio and face cross-attention modules to enable fine-grained expression control and preserve the input identity, respectively. In addition, we implement an audio-to-SMPL-X model to predict an SMPL-X sequence conditioned on the reference image and input audio, allowing MegaAvatar to support audio-driven inference without user-provided SMPL-X frames. Experiments show that MegaAvatar achieves high-quality talking avatar generation with controllable body and head motion, speech-synchronized facial expressions, and consistent identity preservation. MegaAvatar also supports inference with flexible resolutions and video lengths. Codes, dataset, models will be avaliable in https://github.com/Jeoyal/MegaAvatar

AI.tldr: MegaAvatar 是基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 的可控说话虚拟人生成框架，通过引入 SMPL-X 三维引导实现身体姿态与头部运动的全局控制，并支持音频驱动推理、灵活分辨率与视频长度。
AI.motivation: 既有说话虚拟人方法主要依赖音频或参考图像条件，缺乏对身体姿态与头部运动的全局控制能力。本文希望在此基础上引入三维结构引导，以提升运动的可控性与生成质量。
AI.method: 以 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 为基座：1）将驱动 SMPL-X 序列渲染为稠密网格帧，用轻量 3D 卷积编码器编码后注入 latent token，提供整体运动控制；2）为基座扩展音频与面部 cross-attention 模块，分别实现细粒度表情控制与输入身份保持；3）训练 audio-to-SMPL-X 模型，以参考图像和输入音频为条件预测 SMPL-X 序列，从而支持无需用户提供 SMPL-X 帧的音频驱动推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，MegaAvatar 能够生成高质量的说话虚拟人视频，身体与头部运动可控，面部表情与语音同步，并保持身份一致性；同时支持灵活的分辨率与视频长度推理。代码、数据集与模型将开源于 https://github.com/Jeoyal/MegaAvatar。
AI.conclusion: MegaAvatar 通过引入 SMPL-X 三维引导与多模态注意力模块，在统一框架中实现了运动可控、表情同步、身份保持的说话虚拟人生成，并具备音频驱动与灵活推理的实用性。

title: BMASH: Ball-Motion-Aware Soccer Header Spotting
summary: Recent advances in computer vision have made broadcast sports videos increasingly useful for event analysis, performance assessment, and player-safety applications. In soccer, however, header spotting remains a challenging problem due to the subtle and short-lived nature of header events. This paper focuses on soccer header spotting: identifying moments in broadcast videos where the ball contacts a player's head. We first adapt and evaluate Video Swin as a strong action-recognition baseline for this task, and then introduce BMASH, a ball-motion-aware fusion framework that integrates detector-derived ball features. BMASH combines Video Swin action representations with ball-presence and motion features from frame-level soccer-ball detection, integrating player-action context with ball dynamics to distinguish headers from visually similar events. We evaluate BMASH using game-level splits with separate test matches and rotating validation folds, considering both centered-window classification and continuous full-video spotting. Results show that Video Swin provides a strong baseline for header spotting, while BMASH improves clip-level AP and ROC-AUC over the corresponding Video Swin baseline. In continuous full-video spotting, BMASH achieves a comparable event-level F1-performance with a different precision--recall trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文针对足球广播视频中的头球事件检测问题，提出BMASH框架，将Video Swin动作表征与源自检测器的足球存在性及运动特征融合，在片段级分类与连续整视频检测两种设定下均取得改进。
AI.motivation: 头球事件在广播视频中具有细微、短暂的特点，容易被误判为视觉相似的其他动作，因此检测难度大；而头球检测对事件分析、表现评估和球员安全应用具有重要价值。
AI.method: 先适配并以Video Swin作为动作识别强基线；再提出BMASH球运动感知融合框架，将Video Swin的动作表征与帧级足球检测得到的球存在性及运动特征相结合，融合球员动作上下文与球的运动动态以区分头球与视觉相似事件。评估采用按比赛划分的划分方式，使用独立测试比赛与轮换验证折，覆盖居中窗口分类和连续整视频检测两种任务。
AI.result: Video Swin为头球检测提供了强基线；BMASH在片段级AP与ROC-AUC上优于对应的Video Swin基线；在连续整视频检测中，BMASH达到与基线相当的事件级F1，但呈现不同的精确率—召回率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 引入球运动感知特征能有效提升头球检测的片段级判别能力，并在连续检测场景下提供不同的性能权衡，表明融合动作上下文与球动态信息是解决头球检测问题的有效方向。

title: Rethinking Generative Image Compression at Extremely Low Bitrates
summary: Generative image compression produces visually plausible reconstructions at low bitrates, yet their behavior as the rate approaches zero remains largely unexplored. When pushed below normal operating rates, representative codecs undergo semantic collapse: rather than gracefully losing source-specific detail, they produce malformed or unrecognizable content. Our analysis identifies two factors. As the bitrate decreases, reconstruction losses increasingly conflict with semantic objectives on gradients and visual results, while pixel-space and reconstruction-oriented VAE diffusion models become less efficient on semantic preservation. Guided by these findings, we introduce RAE-CoD, a compression-oriented diffusion (CoD) built in a representation autoencoder (RAE) space with direct alignment between compressed and source representations, preserving recognizable, naturally structured content for a $256\times256$ image with as few as 16 bits. We evaluate this framework using five vision foundation models (VFM) and a blinded vision-language model protocol. On MSCOCO-30K, RAE-CoD stands out from all evaluation. At 0.001-0.008 bpp, it reduces relative VFM feature MSE and Fréchet Distance ratio by at least 25.7% and 69.1% over the best competitors. Meanwhile, semantic recognizability and quality of the reconstructions remain nearly constant while source consistency falls smoothly, replacing abrupt semantic collapse with a graceful transition toward unconditional generation. Code will be released at https://github.com/LuizScarlet/RAE-CoD.

AI.tldr: 论文研究极低码率下的生成式图像压缩，发现现有编解码器会发生产语义崩塌，提出在表示自编码器(RAE)空间构建压缩导向扩散模型RAE-CoD，在16比特/256×256图像下仍保持可辨识内容，并在MSCOCO-30K上大幅优于基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像压缩在低码率下能得到视觉合理的重建，但当码率趋近于零时的行为几乎未被探索。作者发现主流编解码器在低于正常工作码率时会发生"语义崩塌"，即不是平滑地丢失源特定细节，而是产生扭曲甚至不可识别的内容，因此需要分析其成因并设计新框架。
AI.method: 分析发现两个因素：(1) 随码率降低，重建损失与语义目标在梯度和视觉结果上冲突加剧；(2) 像素空间与重建导向的VAE扩散模型在语义保持上效率下降。据此提出RAE-CoD，在表示自编码器(RAE)空间中构建压缩导向扩散模型，并在压缩表示与源表示之间进行直接对齐，以保留可辨识、结构自然的内容。评估使用5个视觉基础模型(VFM)及盲测的视觉-语言模型协议。
AI.result: 在MSCOCO-30K上，RAE-CoD在所有评估中表现突出。在0.001-0.008 bpp区间，其VFM特征MSE和Fréchet距离比率的相对降幅分别至少为25.7%和69.1%，优于最佳竞争者。同时，重建的语义可辨识度与质量几乎保持恒定，而源一致性平滑下降。
AI.conclusion: RAE-CoD将极低码率下突发的语义崩塌替换为向无条件生成的平滑过渡，在近乎零码率的极端条件下仍能保持可辨识且结构自然的重建，代码将开源。

title: TexTailor: Texture-Preserving Video Virtual Try-On via Adaptive Garment Conditioning
summary: Video virtual try-on has attracted increasing attention due to its broad potential in digital fashion and intelligent e-commerce. However, existing methods primarily focus on low-resolution settings and still face substantial challenges when extended to high-resolution scenarios. These limitations can be attributed to two main factors: (1) the insufficient utilization of rich garment reference information, and (2) the lack of explicit positional modeling between garment and video representations during cross-modal interaction, which weakens fine-grained local correspondence. To address these issues, we propose TexTailor, a high-fidelity video virtual try-on framework built upon a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer. Specifically, we introduce a timestep-adaptive modulation mechanism to dynamically adjust garment visual representations throughout denoising. We further develop a frame-aligned positional encoding strategy to strengthen garment-to-video correspondence, together with a multi-source injection design that reduces interference among heterogeneous conditions. Extensive experiments on multiple video virtual try-on benchmarks, including the high-resolution Eevee dataset, demonstrate that TexTailor achieves competitive performance in garment detail preservation, temporal consistency, and overall video quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TexTailor，一个基于预训练视频Diffusion Transformer的高保真视频虚拟试穿框架，通过时序自适应调制、帧对齐位置编码和多源注入设计，解决高分辨率场景下服装参考信息利用不足与跨模态位置建模缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 视频虚拟试穿在数字时尚和智能电商领域潜力巨大，但现有方法主要聚焦低分辨率场景，扩展到高分辨率时面临两大挑战：(1) 丰富的服装参考信息利用不足；(2) 跨模态交互中服装与视频表征之间缺乏显式位置建模，削弱了细粒度局部对应关系。
AI.method: TexTailor构建于预训练视频Diffusion Transformer之上。核心设计包括：(1) 时序步长自适应调制机制（timestep-adaptive modulation），在去噪过程中动态调整服装视觉表征；(2) 帧对齐位置编码策略（frame-aligned positional encoding），强化服装到视频的对应关系；(3) 多源注入设计（multi-source injection），降低异构条件之间的干扰。
AI.result: 在多个视频虚拟试穿基准（包括高分辨率Eevee数据集）上的大量实验表明，TexTailor在服装细节保持、时序一致性和整体视频质量方面均取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: TexTailor通过时序自适应调制、帧对齐位置编码和多源注入三项设计，有效缓解了高分辨率视频虚拟试穿中服装信息利用不足与跨模态对应建模缺失的问题，验证了基于视频Diffusion Transformer框架实现高保真试穿的可行性与有效性。

title: Rethinking Multi-Image Re-Representation in Multi-Image Understanding
summary: Multi-image understanding requires MLLMs not only to recognise the content of individual images, but also to organise visual evidence distributed across them. We study this problem through multi-image re-representation, viewing prompted Chain-of-Thought reasoning and agentic visual tool use as different ways of re-organising visual evidence during reasoning. We introduce Mosaic, a general-purpose multi-image visual harness that enables an MLLM to actively construct visual intermediates with ten composable image operations. We compare five re-representation settings on existing multi-image benchmarks and on MosaicBench, a new grounding-focused benchmark for fine-grained multi-image understanding. Our experiments show that the relative benefits of textual and visual re-representation are strongly task-dependent. Visual re-representation is particularly effective for tasks requiring precise visual evidence, including hypothesis testing, precision comparison, and orientation-sensitive reasoning, while tasks dominated by higher-level semantic content show smaller or less consistent gains. Building on this finding, we train MosaicAgent-8B to use Mosaic with reinforcement learning using only accuracy and format rewards. Without demonstration trajectories or rewards for specific tool-use, the agent learns to compose visual operations over multiple steps and exhibits diverse problem-solving patterns unpromptedly. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/gengyuanmax/Mosaic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多图重表征视角，并构建通用多图视觉工具Mosaic及基准MosaicBench，发现文本/视觉重表征的收益高度依赖任务，且用RL训练的MosaicAgent-8B能自主学会组合视觉操作。
AI.motivation: 多图理解要求多模态大模型不仅识别单图内容，还要组织跨图分布的视觉证据。现有工作对"如何在推理过程中重组视觉证据"缺乏系统性研究，文本链式思维与智能体工具使用孰优孰劣、何时更优尚不清晰。
AI.method: 将提示式CoT推理与智能体视觉工具使用统一视为推理中的视觉证据重表征，提出通用多图视觉工具Mosaic（含十种可组合图像操作），并在现有基准与新建的MosaicBench上比较五种重表征设置；进一步用仅含准确率与格式奖励的强化学习训练MosaicAgent-8B。
AI.result: 文本与视觉重表征的相对收益强依赖任务：视觉重表征在需要精确视觉证据的任务（假设检验、精度比较、方向敏感推理）上尤为有效，而在高层语义主导任务上增益较小或不稳定。MosaicAgent-8B无需示范轨迹或工具使用奖励，即学会多步组合视觉操作并自发展现多样解题模式。
AI.conclusion: 多图理解中的重表征策略应按任务性质选择；工具增强的视觉重表征配合强化学习可让模型自主涌现多步视觉操作能力，为通用多图理解提供可行路径，代码与数据将开源。

title: COBICount: Separating Object and Background Responses for Remote Sensing Object Counting Without Training on Target Data
summary: Remote sensing object counting estimates how many buildings, vehicles, or ships appear in overhead images. Most supervised counters predict a density map, whose sum gives the object count, and assume similar categories, sizes, and backgrounds. Applying them across regions, sensors, or categories often requires target data or further training, which may be costly or unavailable. We study source-only counting. Training for the counting task and model selection use one group of images that shares an object category and similar imaging conditions, with one point marking each object. Target images and information remain unavailable until the model is fixed. This reduces data preparation but makes transfer harder. A model trained on one source may place high density values, called responses, on real objects and repeated background structures. Road edges, parking grids, roof boundaries, and water boundaries may then be counted as objects, creating candidate origin ambiguity. COBICount separates response generation, acceptance, and background suppression. Candidate Evidence (CE) generates possible responses. Candidate Acceptance (CA) keeps compact responses centered on objects. Bias Isolation (BI) reduces responses associated with repeated background structures. Their outputs form the final density map. Trained on RSOC Building and evaluated directly on DOTA Large Vehicle, Small Vehicle, and Ship, COBICount achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over the target domains among the compared methods, 174.132. It uses 5.07 million parameters and 17.41 billion floating point operations for a 512x512 input. COBICount improves transfer without target data or training for each target. The code will be available at: https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount.

AI.tldr: 提出COBICount，用于遥感目标计数中的source-only迁移，通过分离响应生成、接受与背景抑制来缓解候选来源歧义，在多个目标域上取得更低MAE。
AI.motivation: 大多数监督式遥感计数方法依赖密度图回归，并假设源域与目标域在类别、尺度和背景上相似；跨区域、传感器或类别迁移时通常需要目标域数据或额外训练，成本高且未必可行。因此论文研究source-only counting：训练和模型选择仅使用一组共享类别、成像条件相近且有单点标注的源图像，目标图像与信息在模型固定前不可用，从而减少数据准备但增加迁移难度。
AI.method: COBICount将密度图预测过程拆分为响应生成、响应接受和背景抑制三部分。Candidate Evidence（CE）生成可能的响应；Candidate Acceptance（CA）保留以目标为中心、紧凑的响应；Bias Isolation（BI）降低与重复背景结构相关的响应。三者输出组合为最终密度图，以缓解道路边缘、停车网格、屋顶边界和水域边界等重复结构造成的候选来源歧义。
AI.result: 在RSOC Building上训练，并直接评测于DOTA Large Vehicle、Small Vehicle和Ship，COBICount在所比较方法中取得目标域平均最低MAE，为174.132；模型参数量为5.07M，512x512输入下计算量为17.41 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: COBICount无需目标域数据或针对每个目标域的训练即可提升迁移性能，验证了将响应生成、接受与背景抑制解耦对source-only遥感目标计数有效。代码将在 https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount 提供。

title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoTools，首个面向第一人称视角工具使用理解的数据与评测套件，含100小时数据与1000题基准，验证其训练与诊断价值。
AI.motivation: 真实具身任务（日常与专业活动）多为工具中介，需要推理可供性、手-工具-物几何、流程进度与因果效果；但现有多模态视频模型在感知型任务上表现良好，却在工具中心的具身推理上受限，主要瓶颈是缺乏真实第一人称数据和诊断性基准。
AI.method: 构建EgoTools套件：EgoTools-Data为100小时工具中心第一人称录像语料，含同步音频、密集描述、重推理叙述及补充3D信息；EgoTools-Bench为1000个QA对、四条赛道的诊断基准，覆盖从感知与几何到流程与因果推理。并以此数据对Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct做全量监督微调，采用严格的源视频隔离。
AI.result: 现有模型难以将工具使用锚定到视觉证据：Gemini-3.1-Pro总体准确率66.9%，但感知与锚定仅51.7%。作为训练资源，在完整1000题基准上，全量监督微调将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct从50.0%提升至60.9%。
AI.conclusion: EgoTools可作为统一资源，同时支持真实第一人称工具使用理解的训练与诊断评测。

title: InfoAgent: Traceable Generation and Repair of Evidence-Grounded Infographics
summary: Reliable infographic generation requires facts, symbols, and visual relations to remain consistent through rendering and revision. Correcting one element also requires tracking its supporting evidence and the dependencies affected by the change. We present \textbf{InfoAgent}, a training-free framework for \emph{evidence-bound visual-symbolic program synthesis}. Its Infographic Visual Description (IVD) records factual payloads, evidence provenance, execution routes, and verification obligations in a typed dependency graph. Retrieved design priors guide compilation, and layered execution combines raster synthesis with editable symbolic and binding objects while retaining their traces. Dependency-aware repair localizes corrections, rechecks affected dependencies, and requires protected obligations to remain satisfied under the declared checkers. Unresolved obligations remain explicit. On IGenBench, InfoAgent achieves 93.0 Q-ACC and 59.0 I-ACC. We also introduce InfoGraphicBench-Evidence, where complete-checklist pass rates on 200 test requests increase from 21.5\% for Same-IVD Prompt to 23.5\% for the initial layered output and 28.5\% after repair, using the same evidence and initial IVD. On 120 audited repair cases, localized repair edits 12.4\% of the canvas on average, compared with 67.3\% for global regeneration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架InfoAgent，通过证据绑定的可视化-符号化程序合成实现可靠的信息图生成与修订。
AI.motivation: 信息图生成需保证事实、符号与视觉关系在渲染和修订过程中保持一致，且修正某一元素时需追踪其证据来源及受影响的依赖关系，现有方法难以满足这一需求。
AI.method: 提出InfoAgent免训练框架，核心为信息图视觉描述（IVD），以类型化依赖图记录事实载荷、证据来源、执行路径与验证义务；检索设计先验指导编译；分层执行结合栅格合成与可编辑的符号及绑定对象并保留其轨迹；依赖感知修复定位修改、重查受影响依赖，并要求受保护义务在声明的检查器下保持满足，未解决的义务被显式保留。
AI.result: 在IGenBench上取得93.0 Q-ACC与59.0 I-ACC；在InfoGraphicBench-Evidence上，200个测试请求的完整清单通过率由Same-IVD Prompt的21.5%提升至初始分层输出的23.5%，修复后达28.5%（使用相同证据与初始IVD）；在120个审计修复案例中，局部化修复平均仅编辑画布的12.4%，而全局重生成需编辑67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 证据绑定与依赖感知修复机制可有效提升信息图生成的可靠性与修订效率，显著降低编辑范围并提高校验通过率。

title: PCB-MC: Missing Component Analysis in Printed Circuit Boards
summary: Detecting missing components on printed circuit boards (PCBs) differs fundamentally from conventional object detection, as the model must localize components that are not present. We introduce PCB-MC, a curated dataset for missing component detection with footprint level annotations built on top of the RF100 dataset. The dataset contains 197 distinct board types, each corresponding to a unique PCB design, with multiple augmented samples per type. We also provide benchmark results on PCB-MC by evaluating a diverse set of supervised and unsupervised methods. To ensure fair evaluation, we propose board type aware cross validation splits that prevent layout leakage between training and test sets. Supervised models showcase high false negative rates on unseen board designs, and unsupervised anomaly detection methods fail entirely due to the lack of spatial alignment with a board specific reference. These results confirm that missing component detection on diverse PCB layouts remains an open challenge. We release PCB-MC and all training protocols to support reproducible research on structural absence detection in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PCB-MC 数据集，用于 PCB 缺失元件检测（足迹级标注，197 种板型），并给出监督/无监督基线；结果表明跨板型泛化是该任务的开放挑战。
AI.motivation: PCB 缺失元件检测与传统目标检测本质不同：模型需定位“不存在”的元件（结构缺失），而现有数据集和评测协议不针对该问题，且多板型间的布局差异会导致评测泄漏。
AI.method: 在 RF100 基础上构建 PCB-MC 数据集，提供足迹级（footprint level）标注，含 197 种不同板型、每种板型多个增强样本；提出板型感知的交叉验证划分（board type aware cross validation splits）以避免训练/测试间的布局泄漏；并对多种监督与无监督方法进行基准评测。
AI.result: 监督模型在未见过的板型设计上假阴性率较高；无监督异常检测方法因缺少与特定板型参考图的空间对齐而完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 多样布局下的 PCB 缺失元件检测仍是开放挑战；作者公开 PCB-MC 及全部训练协议，以支持工业检测中结构性缺失检测的可复现研究。

title: Towards Trustworthy AI for Glioma Diagnosis: A Task-Aware Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:033
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is a key requirement for trustworthy AI in high-stakes medical image analysis. In this work, we evaluate UQ in a multi-task Deep Learning framework for MRI-based glioma diagnosis that performs tumor segmentation and predicts IDH mutation status, 1p/19q co-deletion status, and tumor grade. Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) is used for a detailed task-aware analysis of predictive, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty. We assess MC sample convergence, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, associations with segmentation performance, and the effect of voxel-wise uncertainty aggregation on case-level reliability. We also compare MCD with Deep Ensembles (DE) and Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles (MCDE), examine interactions between segmentation quality and classification, and evaluate a composite trust score integrating segmentation and classification uncertainty. Across tasks, uncertainty estimates supported meaningful error detection, while calibration depended on the dropout rate, with moderate rates yielding the most reliable probabilities. Uncertainty decomposition provided task-dependent interpretability but did not consistently improve error detection over predictive uncertainty alone. DE and MCDE showed comparable operational utility, with no method consistently dominating across tasks and metrics. The composite trust score did not consistently outperform classification uncertainty for selective prediction. Overall, our results provide a task-aware evaluation strategy and practical guidance for the development of trustworthy AI for glioma diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文在多任务深度学习框架（MRI胶质瘤分割与IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失、分级预测）中系统评估了不确定性量化（UQ），比较MCD、DE与MCDE，分析校准、误差检测、选择性预测及分割-分类交互。
AI.motivation: 高风险的医学影像分析中，可信AI必须提供可靠的不确定性估计。然而现有多为单任务、单一UQ方法的评估，缺乏面向多任务胶质瘤诊断的任务感知UQ系统研究，尤其缺乏对预测/偶然/认知不确定性分解、聚合方式及分割与分类交互的实证分析。
AI.method: 在多任务DL框架中同时进行肿瘤分割与IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失、肿瘤分级预测。以Monte Carlo Dropout（MCD）为主，进行任务感知的预测、aleatoric与epistemic不确定性分解分析；评估MC样本收敛性、校准、误差检测、选择性预测、与分割性能的关联，以及体素级不确定性聚合对病例级可靠性的影响。并对比MCD、Deep Ensembles（DE）与Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles（MCDE），考察分割质量与分类的交互，评估融合分割与分类不确定性的复合信任分数（trust score）。
AI.result: 各任务中不确定性估计均支持有效的误差检测；校准效果依赖dropout率，中等dropout率给出最可靠的预测概率。不确定性分解提供任务相关的可解释性，但在误差检测上未稳定优于单一预测不确定性。DE与MCDE的操作效用相当，无方法在各任务与指标上一致占优。复合信任分数在选择性预测上未稳定超过分类不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出任务感知的UQ评估策略，并给出面向胶质瘤诊断可信AI开发的实践指导：应采用任务相关的校准与不确定性聚合方式，并对多种UQ方法进行跨任务、跨指标的比较，而非依赖单一方法与复合分数。

title: CAST: Causal Advantage-Structured Training with Spatially Grounded Compositional Rewards for Diffusion Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning has been extended to flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. However, this paradigm faces three limitations: (1) Window selection. Existing methods manually set the stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling window, i.e., the denoising steps where exploration noise is injected. We instead determine it from each model's denoising trajectory. (2) Reward saturation. Current methods rely on scoring models trained on human annotations; we find that such scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable on the latest SOTA open-source DMs, making advantage estimation largely ineffective. (3) Sample inefficiency. A single scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, leaving minimal gradient guidance for targeted improvement. To address these issues, we propose CAST (Causal Advantage-Structured Training), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs, which (1) identifies the denoising step at which each model fixes the objects and their spatial arrangement in the image and uses that timing to set the SDE window, (2) decomposes each prompt via Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) into verifiable-atoms, i.e., minimal semantic units such as an object, count, attribute, or spatial relation that can each be checked independently, and rewards each atom separately, and (3) projects the signed atom-level advantages into pixel space through teacher-forced attention and uses them to spatially weight the SDE policy objective. We fine-tune two of the strongest open-source DMs, FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, with CAST, and evaluate them on GenEval 2, a compositional benchmark, and on Qwen-Image-Bench for overall quality. Within almost the same training budget, CAST's improvement over the base model on the most challenging GenEval 2 prompts is up to 3.07x that of Flow-GRPO, while overall generation quality also improves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAST，一种面向预训练扩散模型的强化学习微调方法，通过从去噪轨迹自动确定SDE窗口、基于因果场景图分解奖励原子、并将原子级优势投影到像素空间加权策略目标，缓解窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效三大问题，在GenEval 2与Qwen-Image-Bench上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有将在线强化学习扩展到流匹配扩散模型图像生成的范式存在三个局限：(1)窗口选择：现有方法依赖人工设定注入探索噪声的SDE采样窗口，缺乏对模型去噪特性的自适应；(2)奖励饱和：基于人工标注训练的评分模型在最新SOTA开源DM上得分极高且几乎无法区分，导致优势估计基本失效；(3)样本低效：单一标量奖励将不同失败模式压缩为近乎相同的分数，缺乏针对性改进的梯度指导。
AI.method: CAST包含三个核心设计：(1)识别模型在去噪过程中确定物体及其空间布局的步骤，据此设定SDE窗口；(2)通过因果场景图(CSG)将提示分解为可独立验证的原子（对象、数量、属性、空间关系等最小语义单元），并对每个原子分别给予奖励；(3)利用教师强制注意力将带符号的原子级优势投影到像素空间，并以空间加权方式调制SDE策略目标。
AI.result: 在FLUX.2-dev与Qwen-Image-2512两个最强开源DM上进行CAST微调，并在组合性基准GenEval 2和整体质量基准Qwen-Image-Bench上评估。在几乎相同的训练预算下，CAST在最困难的GenEval 2提示上相较基线的提升最高达Flow-GRPO的3.07倍，同时整体生成质量也有改善。
AI.conclusion: CAST通过数据驱动地确定探索窗口、原子级奖励分解与像素空间优势投影，有效缓解了扩散模型RL微调中的窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效问题，在组合生成能力与整体质量上均优于现有方法，验证了结构化因果优势在扩散模型强化学习中的有效性。

title: ResARC: Residual-Aware AutoRegressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression
summary: Progressive autoregressive image codecs provide an appealing paradigm for generative compression by quantizing continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and generating the remaining suffix tokens at the decoder. However, their reconstruction quality is fundamentally limited by two residuals introduced along this pipeline: the quantization residual, arising from information loss during discrete tokenization, and the generation residual, resulting from imperfect autoregressive generation of the suffix tokens. To address these limitations, we introduce ResARC, a residual-aware autoregressive codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals at the decoder. Specifically, we generate the quantization residual with a diffusion transformer conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context, while requiring no additional side information. In parallel, we compute the generation residual at the encoder and employ a learned Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress and transmit it for decoder-side correction. The recovered residuals are then integrated with the reconstructed latent representation and decoded through an adapted VAE decoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResARC achieves competitive perceptual similarity while substantially improving distributional fidelity over leading generative codecs across the ultra-low bitrate regime. Code and models will be released soon.

AI.tldr: ResARC 是一个残差感知的自回归图像编解码器，在解码端显式补偿量化残差与生成残差，在超低码率下取得竞争性感知相似度并显著提升分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 渐进式自回归图像编解码器通过将连续潜变量量化为离散 token、传输由粗到细的前缀 token 并在解码端生成剩余后缀 token，实现生成式压缩。但其重建质量受两处残差限制：离散化带来的量化残差，以及后缀 token 自回归生成不完美造成的生成残差。
AI.method: 提出 ResARC，在解码端同时补偿两种残差：量化残差由以自回归解码上下文为条件的扩散 Transformer 生成，且无需额外边信息；生成残差在编码端计算，并通过学习到的生成残差编解码器（Generation Residual Codec）高效压缩与传输以供解码端校正。恢复的残差与重建潜表示融合后，经适配的 VAE 解码器解码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ResARC 在超低码率区间达到具有竞争力的感知相似度，同时在分布保真度上显著优于主流生成式编解码器。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并补偿量化残差与生成残差，ResARC 有效缓解了渐进式自回归生成式压缩中的质量瓶颈；代码与模型将很快发布。

title: DensePed-Lite: Quality-Aware Adaptive Detection for Dense Pedestrians under Occlusion
summary: Pedestrian detection plays a crucial role in computer vision with applications in autonomous driving, surveillance, and public safety. However, real-world dense scenes bring severe challenges, including heavy occlusion, drastic scale variations, and strict real-time requirements. Existing lightweight detectors struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency while often neglecting quality-aware feature modeling and consistency between classification and localization, leading to unstable performance under crowded conditions. To address these issues, we propose DensePed-Lite, a unified framework built on a single principle: under occlusion the network should adapt its behavior to the quality of what it observes rather than assume complete information. This principle is realized at three points where occlusion does the most damage: unreliable confidence scoring (UQE), fragmented spatial coverage (MPSC), and incoherent multi-scale fusion (CTDM). The three mechanisms reinforce one another instead of acting in isolation, all without significantly increasing complexity. Experiments on CityPersons and CrowdHuman validate that DensePed-Lite achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared with recent state-of-the-art lightweight methods, making it suitable for real-time deployment in dense pedestrian scenarios.
