AI.tldr: 提出DensePed-Lite统一框架，以"网络应根据观测质量自适应调整行为"为核心原则，通过UQE、MPSC、CTDM三个互补机制应对遮挡下的置信度不可靠、空间覆盖碎片化和多尺度融合不一致问题，在CityPersons与CrowdHuman上实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 密集场景下的行人检测面临严重遮挡、剧烈尺度变化和严格实时性要求。现有轻量级检测器难以兼顾精度与效率，且往往忽视质量感知的特征建模以及分类与定位之间的一致性，导致拥挤条件下性能不稳定。因此需要一个能在遮挡下依据观测质量自适应调整的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出DensePed-Lite框架，基于单一核心原则：遮挡下网络应依据其所观测内容的质量自适应调整行为，而非假设信息完整。该原则落实在遮挡危害最大的三个环节：(1) UQE——针对不可靠的置信度评分；(2) MPSC——针对碎片化的空间覆盖；(3) CTDM——针对不一致的多尺度融合。三机制相互增强而非孤立作用，且不显著增加模型复杂度。
AI.result: 在CityPersons和CrowdHuman数据集上的实验表明，DensePed-Lite相较于近期最先进的轻量级方法取得了更优的精度-效率权衡，适合密集行人场景下的实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过质量自适应的统一设计，DensePed-Lite在密集遮挡场景中有效平衡了精度与效率，为实时行人检测提供了可行方案。

title: From Wrecks to Wisdom: Recovering Crash Mechanics from Real-World Multi-View Photos
summary: Estimating accident mechanics from real-world crashes is important for vehicle-safety analysis, injury modeling, crash-severity prediction, and operational workflows such as insurance claim triage. In standard crash records, key metadata such as impact configuration, principal direction of force, and change in velocity ($ΔV$) may be missing, delayed, or corrupted, while post-crash photographs are widely available and contain rich visual evidence of deformation. We study how much crash-mechanics information can be recovered directly from vehicle photos when structured signals are absent. We formulate crash understanding as supervised prediction from per-case multi-view photo sets. Targets include six Collision Deformation Classification (CDC) descriptors and the longitudinal and lateral components of reconstructed $ΔV$. Each photo is encoded by a shared visual backbone, and the resulting view-level features are fused into a case-level representation from which target-specific heads predict crash descriptors. Using 15.2k training cases from the Crash Investigation Sampling System, drawn from about 1.5M photos before filtering, together with 1.15k validation and 1.15k test cases, we define an evaluation protocol for vision-based crash descriptor estimation from incomplete multi-view evidence. Post-crash imagery alone provides usable signal for several non-trivial crash-mechanics descriptors, while weakly observable and long-tailed targets remain challenging. Within the compared training regimes, the selected joint-training recipe reduces mean absolute angular error for principal direction of force from 20.1 to 14.05 degrees and longitudinal $ΔV$ MAE from 8.04 to 7.45 km/h. Our work provides a reference point for future multimodal fusion with structured crash metadata.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在结构化事故记录缺失的情况下，能否仅凭事故后的车辆多视角照片直接恢复碰撞力学信息，包括六项CDC描述符与重构ΔV的纵横分量。
AI.motivation: 真实世界事故记录中，碰撞构型、主受力方向、速度变化量ΔV等关键元数据常缺失、延迟或损坏，而事故后照片普遍可得且包含丰富的变形视觉证据，因此有必要评估从照片中直接恢复碰撞力学信息的可行性。
AI.method: 将事故理解建模为基于单案例多视角照片集的监督预测任务。每张照片经共享视觉骨干编码，视图级特征融合为案例级表示，再由目标专用预测头输出六项CDC描述符及ΔV纵向、横向分量。数据取自Crash Investigation Sampling System，原始约150万张照片经筛选后得到15.2k训练、1.15k验证与1.15k测试案例。
AI.result: 事故后影像对多项非平凡碰撞力学描述符可提供有效信号，但弱可观测与长尾目标仍具挑战。在对比的训练范式中，所选联合训练方案将主受力方向的平均绝对角度误差由20.1°降至14.05°，纵向ΔV的MAE由8.04 km/h降至7.45 km/h。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了基于视觉、面向不完整多视角证据的碰撞描述符估计评测协议，为未来与结构化事故元数据的多模态融合提供了参考基准。

title: OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
summary: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniReasoningBench 基准、OmniQA 数据引擎和 MFSD 学习方法，系统性地评估并激发全模态模型的音视频联合推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽已统一音频、视觉与语言，但基准、训练数据与学习方法大多独立处理各模态，导致音视频联合推理能力既缺乏评估也难以被有效激发。
AI.method: 提出三部分工作：(1) OmniReasoningBench 基准，含 1,150 道选择题与开放题，覆盖视频内推理与视频外推理两任务，要求音频与视觉证据缺一不可；(2) OmniQA 数据引擎，自动构建以证据为锚的联合推理 QA 对及带时间戳的线索链，并生成 OmniReasoning-SFT-112K 与 OmniReasoning-RL-19K 训练数据；(3) Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD) 在线策略自蒸馏方法，在模态特定线索上下文中评估采样响应，解耦单一线索贡献与跨模态交互贡献，实现 token 级信用分配。
AI.result: 基于该数据与方法训练的 OmniReasoning-30B-A3B 在 OmniVideoBench 上达 50.0%，在 OmniReasoningBench 上达 42.5%，较基座 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking 分别提升 12.8 与 9.3 个百分点；在 Video-MME-v2 等通用及长视频基准上也取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基准、数据引擎与学习方法的协同设计，为全模态联合推理的后续研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: Front-to-Back: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Asymmetric Cross-View Vehicle Re-Identification
comment: Submitted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC)
summary: Matching the same vehicle across front and rear cameras is difficult because the cameras do not share a view and the vehicle's appearance changes substantially. We introduce Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 manually verified vehicle handovers from 20 recording sequences in South Africa. Each example asks a model to match a vehicle highlighted in a front-camera image to the same vehicle among at least three candidates in a later rear-camera image. We evaluate seven zero-shot vision-language models, four image-retrieval baselines, and 25 human participants. Models are tested using full front RGB images, cropped target vehicles, and binary silhouettes. The strongest VLM achieved 76.6 percent Rank-1 accuracy on target crops, compared with 74.0 percent for the frozen SigLIP2 baseline; this difference was not statistically clear. Human participants achieved 94.0 percent accuracy with full images and 92.2 percent with target crops. Under our evaluation setup, enabling reasoning improved accuracy across all three input conditions for every model evaluated in both modes. We also found that VLMs generally performed worse on full scenes than on target crops. These results show that general-purpose VLMs do not yet consistently outperform strong visual retrieval for front-to-rear vehicle matching, while humans remain substantially more reliable.

AI.tldr: 提出 Front2Back-ReID 基准，用于跨前后摄像头同一车辆匹配，评测 7 个零样本视觉语言模型、4 个图像检索基线与 25 名人类；结果显示通用 VLM 尚未稳定超越强视觉检索，人类仍显著更可靠。
AI.motivation: 前后摄像头不共享视野，车辆外观在两侧视角间变化显著，导致同一车辆跨镜头匹配困难，而现有基准与评测缺乏对该任务的针对性覆盖。
AI.method: 构建 Front2Back-ReID 基准，包含来自南非 20 段录制序列、经人工核验的 500 个车辆交接样本；每个样本要求将前摄像头中被标注的车辆，在后续后摄像头图像的至少三个候选中匹配出来。评测 7 个零样本视觉语言模型、4 个图像检索基线以及 25 名人类参与者，输入条件包括完整前视 RGB 图像、裁剪目标车辆和二值剪影。
AI.result: 最强 VLM 在目标裁剪上达到 76.6% Rank-1 准确率，冻结的 SigLIP2 基线为 74.0%，差异统计上不明确；人类使用完整图像达 94.0%，使用目标裁剪达 92.2%。启用推理在三种输入条件下均提升所有模型准确率；VLM 在完整场景上的表现普遍差于目标裁剪。
AI.conclusion: 通用视觉语言模型在前后车辆匹配任务上尚未稳定优于强视觉检索方法，人类可靠性明显更高。

title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
summary: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的粒子滤波式相机控制视频生成方法 PartiCam，通过全局-局部细化框架改进扩散奖励引导，在无需重训模型的情况下提升相机轨迹贴合度、减少漂移并改善画质。
AI.motivation: 大型视频扩散模型难以生成严格遵循指定相机轨迹的视频。免训练方法可跨骨干网络通用，并规避构建大规模相机标注数据集的需求，同时还能产出可用于训练相机条件视频扩散模型的受控数据。然而现有基于采样的引导方法轨迹不稳定：要么探索过广而无法遵循目标相机运动，要么过早坍缩而随时间丧失视觉多样性。
AI.method: PartiCam 是一种免训练的、以粒子滤波为根基的方法。核心是面向扩散奖励引导的全局-局部细化框架：在 Sequential Monte-Carlo（SMC）引导基础上，引入基于粒子滤波重采样的局部细化阶段。
AI.result: 实验表明，相机轨迹贴合度大幅提升，漂移减少，视觉质量更好，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 全局-局部细化框架能实现准确且一致的相机控制，在免训练前提下显著改善相机可控视频生成的效果。

title: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
summary: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了大规模镜头光晕（lens flare）去除数据集，微调扩散模型去除大型光晕；并提出基于主点对称性的显式光晕表征模型，与3DGS联合优化，实现3D场景中光晕与场景的分解，可用于编辑和迁移。
AI.motivation: 镜头光晕是相机成像系统的属性而非场景本身内容，会显著降低3D场景重建等下游任务的质量。现有方法多针对围绕光源的小型光晕，难以处理填满整幅图像的大型光晕；同时，光晕作为艺术表现工具有广泛需求，但多视角一致的光晕表征与重建尚属空白。
AI.method: 1) 结合公开真实数据与程序化生成流程，构建大型光晕去除数据集，并在其上微调扩散模型；2) 提出利用光晕关于相机主点对称性的光晕表征模型；3) 构建联合优化框架，同时优化该光晕模型与高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型，借助光晕去除模型实现3D场景的光晕-场景分解。
AI.result: 在既有基准及新构建的大型反射光晕基准上评估去除效果，直接量化光晕/场景分解质量，并证明该流程对自动光源定位误差具有鲁棒性。重建的光晕为显式且可重渲染的，支持编辑并迁移到新图像与新3D场景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时推进了大型镜头光晕的去除与多视角一致的光晕表征与重建，实现了光晕与3D场景的显式分解及可编辑、可迁移渲染，并验证了流程对光源定位误差的鲁棒性。

title: Comparative study of adapting pre-trained models for driving behavior video captioning
summary: This report examines and compares some of the many fine tuning and prompting methods existing, applying them within the domain of autonomous driving. The idea is to compare these methods by adapting a Large Language Model (LLM) on a video dataset. LLM's have become extremely good at achieving a good understanding of different forms of data and this study aims to induce a low dimensional understanding of driving situations into our primary test model SpaceTimeGPT. Experiments on BDD-X (Berkeley DeepDrive eXplanation) dataset demonstrate good performance of the full fine tuning framework on some automatic metrics, and in some metrics, it even surpasses the baseline. We also try Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and prompt engineering on VideoLLaVA model and discuss its limitations.

AI.tldr: 该报告在自动驾驶域中比较了多种微调与提示方法，通过在视频数据集上适配LLM，考察其对驾驶情境的低维理解能力。
AI.motivation: LLM已具备对多模态数据的强理解能力，作者希望将这种能力迁移到自动驾驶，并系统比较现有微调与提示方法的适用性。
AI.method: 以SpaceTimeGPT为主测模型，在BDD-X（Berkeley DeepDrive eXplanation）视频数据集上进行全量微调，并尝试LoRA与提示工程方法于VideoLLaVA模型。
AI.result: 全量微调框架在部分自动评测指标上表现良好，某些指标甚至超越基线；LoRA与提示工程在VideoLLaVA上存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 全量微调在自动驾驶视频理解任务中效果显著，而LoRA与提示工程受限于当前设置，尚需进一步改进。

title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. NDDL constructs compact multi-space trajectory representations and trains a timestep-conditioned dynamics model to predict the diffusion evolution. In the inference phase, deviations between the observed and predicted transitions are exploited to quantify dynamics inconsistency for backdoor detection. NDDL further enables trigger localization without any prior knowledge of the embedded backdoor by performing substitution with low-semantic words. Extensive experiments for diverse backdoor attacks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed NDDL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NDDL 框架，从转移动力学视角防御 T2I 扩散模型后门，仅用良性样本学习正常扩散轨迹动态，通过预测偏差检测后门并定位触发器。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 扩散模型后门防御多依赖内部表示的特定异常模式，随着攻击机制日益多样，泛化性受限。作者观察到良性扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜在空间和噪声空间中呈现结构化、依赖时间步的转移模式，而后门攻击会破坏这种正常演化规律。
AI.method: NDDL 仅使用良性样本，构建紧凑的多空间轨迹表示（cross-attention、latent、noise），训练一个以时间步为条件的动力学模型来预测扩散演化过程。推理阶段，利用观测转移与预测转移之间的偏差量化动力学不一致性以进行后门检测；并通过低语义词替换实现无需任何后门先验知识的触发器定位。
AI.result: 在多种后门攻击上的大量实验表明，NDDL 具有有效的检测性能与良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将后门防御建模为扩散轨迹的转移动力学学习问题，仅依赖良性样本即可实现跨攻击机制的检测与触发器定位，为 T2I 扩散模型安全部署提供了通用性更强的防御思路。

title: EffGS: Efficient and High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but existing general-purpose acceleration methods suffer severe rendering quality degradation when extended to more complex, large-scale scenes. To address this issue, we propose EffGS, a more general acceleration framework that improves training and rendering efficiency while maintaining reconstruction quality comparable to or better than vanilla 3DGS across bounded and large-scale scenes. EffGS combines frequency-aware guidance, localized density control, and adaptive primitive scale modulation. First, an importance scoring mechanism combines pixel-wise reconstruction errors with a difference-of-Gaussians mask scheduled over training to provide stage-dependent spatial guidance. Second, localized densification and pruning restricts density modifications to Gaussians with valid projected footprints in the sampled views. Third, learnable per-Gaussian scale modulation adjusts effective primitive extent during optimization while retaining the Compact Box rasterization rule. Extensive experiments on bounded and large-scale scene datasets demonstrate a favorable balance between reconstruction quality, training time, and primitive count. Component ablations and matched-primitive-budget comparisons further support the effectiveness of the framework.

AI.tldr: 提出EffGS，一种针对3D高斯泼溅的通用加速框架，结合频率感知引导、局部化密度控制与自适应图元尺度调制，在有界和大规模场景中兼顾训练与渲染效率及重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有通用加速方法在扩展到更复杂、大规模场景时会出现严重的渲染质量下降，缺乏兼顾效率与质量的通用加速框架。
AI.method: EffGS融合三项机制：（1）重要性评分机制，将逐像素重建误差与随训练调度的DoG（高斯差分）掩码结合，提供分阶段的空间引导；（2）局部化稠密化与剪枝，仅对在采样视图中具有有效投影足迹的高斯进行密度修改；（3）可学习的逐高斯尺度调制，在优化中调整图元有效范围，同时保留Compact Box光栅化规则。
AI.result: 在有界与大规模场景数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建质量、训练时间和图元数量之间取得了良好平衡；组件消融与同图元预算对比进一步验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EffGS是一种更通用的3DGS加速框架，可在有界和大规模场景中提升训练与渲染效率，并保持与原始3DGS相当或更优的重建质量。

title: RESUME: Recurrent State Updates from Motion and Residual Signals for Efficient Video Language Modeling
summary: Existing video language models encode sampled RGB frames independently, so a long video must either exhaust the token budget or drop the changes between sampled frames. Codec-aware front-ends read the motion vectors and residuals that encoding produced, but in their deployed form each predictive frame is still tokenized on its own: the tokens are a function of the current primitives, not of a carried reference. We argue that a more natural function is of both---the current primitives and a carried reference. A clip and its time reversal share the same frames and differ only in the order of changes---an axis that symmetric pooling discards by construction, and that is non-empty in the frozen vision features VideoLMs use---and the codec recurrence already composes those changes in order against a reference state. We introduce RESUME, a stateful codec representation: an anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, each subsequent predictive frame is consumed as an update to that state, and a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens from the accumulated state. Codec prediction is thereby kept at the representation level and handed to the language model as a trajectory, not as a set of independent token groups. At the same per-predictive-frame token budget as prior codec-aware methods, a predictive frame enters the language model as a readout of what the front-end already knows, not as an encoding of the current primitives alone. Across ten benchmarks, the gains concentrate on temporal reasoning: on all three temporal benchmarks RESUME improves over both the RGB-frame baseline LLaVA-Video-7B (by 2.8, 5.1, and 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench) and the codec-based baseline CoPE-7B, while staying competitive on general and long-form QA. Frozen-transition tests further show anchor dependence, order sensitivity, and useful rollout behavior beyond the training horizon.

AI.tldr: RESUME 提出一种有状态的编解码表征，用锚定 I 帧初始化紧凑隐状态，后续预测帧作为对该状态的更新，再由共享读出层输出 VideoLM 兼容 token，从而将帧间变化以有序轨迹形式交给语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型独立编码采样 RGB 帧，长视频要么耗尽 token 预算，要么丢失采样帧之间的变化；已有 codec-aware 前端虽读取运动矢量与残差，但每个预测帧仍被单独 token 化，token 仅是当前原语的函数，而非"当前原语 + 携带参考"的函数。作者指出，视频片段与其时间反转共享相同帧、仅变化顺序不同，而对称池化在构造上就丢弃顺序，且该顺序信息在 VideoLM 所用冻结视觉特征中非空；同时编解码器的递推机制本身已按序将变化组合到参考状态上。
AI.method: RESUME 是一种有状态编解码表征：1）以锚定 I 帧初始化一个紧凑隐状态；2）每个后续预测帧被消费为对该状态的更新（update），保持编解码预测在表征层面；3）共享读出层（shared readout）从累积状态中暴露 VideoLM 兼容的 token。由此，预测帧以"前端已知内容的读出"而非"当前原语单独编码"的形式进入语言模型，把变化作为轨迹而非独立 token 组传递，且在相同每预测帧 token 预算下运行。
AI.result: 在十个基准上，增益集中于时间推理：三个时间基准上 RESUME 均优于 RGB 帧基线 LLaVA-Video-7B（TempCompass、TOMATO、MVBench 分别提升 2.8、5.1、3.9 分）与 codec 基线 CoPE-7B，同时在通用与长视频 QA 上保持竞争力。冻结迁移测试进一步显示锚点依赖性、顺序敏感性和超出训练时间范围的有效 rollout 行为。
AI.conclusion: 将编解码预测保持在表征层面并以有状态轨迹形式交给语言模型，可有效保留帧间变化的时间顺序信息，在同等 token 预算下显著提升时间推理性能，并展现出锚点依赖、顺序敏感及可外推的 rollout 特性。

title: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
summary: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging. We propose CASE: a series of role-specific Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence, together with a tool-use harness and an agentic post-training framework for compact vision-language policy models. We further introduce a longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank, comprising 50,401 clinical questions derived from real-world ICD-10-coded diagnoses of 4,739 participants. Each question links to a patient-specific environment containing clinical context and multi-sequence MRI from baseline and follow-up visits, where agents autonomously select which visits, organs, modalities, slices, and specialist tools to inspect and compare. Supervised fine-tuning transfers evidence-seeking workflows from 14,734 frontier-model interaction trajectories, followed by agentic reinforcement learning on the learner's own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation and rubric-based LLM feedback refine evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences. Experiments show that CASE moves beyond question-answer imitation toward transferable investigation policies, strengthening evidence-grounded longitudinal reasoning. Under matched evaluation conditions, our Qwen3-VL-8B based agent achieves over 16% and 10% relative improvements in answer accuracy over GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8. Code will be available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/CASE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CASE（面向证据检索的临床智能体系列），配套工具调用框架与智能体后训练方法，并构建基于UK Biobank的纵向多模态基准，使紧凑视觉语言模型能自主检索证据、跨访视纵向推理；其Qwen3-VL-8B智能体在匹配条件下相对GPT-5.4与Claude Opus 4.8分别提升超16%和10%的答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准多评估对预设证据的推理能力，而非在临床记录与纵向影像中主动检索证据的能力。基础模型虽可借工具调用充当临床智能体，但缺乏面向"证据检索"的角色化智能体设计、专用工具框架、后训练方案，以及能够检验自主检索与纵向比较能力的多模态评测环境。
AI.method: 1) 提出CASE：一组角色特定的临床证据检索智能体（Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence），配套工具调用框架（tool-use harness）；2) 面向紧凑视觉语言策略模型设计智能体后训练框架：先用14,734条前沿模型交互轨迹做监督微调，迁移证据检索工作流，再在智能体自身环境交互上进行智能体强化学习；3) 引入特权式同策略自蒸馏（privileged on-policy self-distillation）与基于评分量规的LLM反馈，在不规定工具调用序列的前提下优化"证据—结论"推理；4) 构建基于UK Biobank的纵向多模态基准：50,401个临床问题，源自4,739名参与者的真实ICD-10编码诊断，每个问题关联患者特定环境，含临床上下文与基线和随访访视的多序列MRI，智能体需自主选择访视、器官、模态、切片及专科工具进行检查与比较。
AI.result: 实验表明CASE超越问答模仿，形成可迁移的检查策略，增强基于证据的纵向推理；在匹配评测条件下，基于Qwen3-VL-8B的智能体在答案准确率上相对GPT-5.4和Claude Opus 4.8分别取得超过16%和10%的相对提升。代码将于 https://github.com/VinyehShaw/CASE 发布。
AI.conclusion: 将临床基础模型能力从"对给定证据的推理"推进到"主动检索证据并跨访视纵向比较"是关键方向；通过角色化智能体、工具框架与智能体后训练的结合，紧凑模型也能习得可迁移的调查策略，并在纵向多模态基准上显著优于大型通用前沿模型，说明后训练与评测环境设计对证据检索型临床智能体至关重要。

title: Invariant Shape Analysis of Surfaces with Spherical Topology
summary: Spherical harmonic descriptors of closed 3D shapes depend on the parameterization, the pose and the scale of the surface, and the standard rotation-invariant reductions, the power spectrum and the bispectrum, discard the relative orientation of the harmonic bands and cannot distinguish a shape from its mirror image. We construct a descriptor that removes all three dependencies exactly and loses nothing else: a conformal parameterization normalized by its conformal barycenter, followed by polynomial invariants of the rotation group. Identifying each harmonic band with a binary form turns the rotation quotient into classical invariant theory and makes reflections visible as the sign of an invariant, so chirality is recorded. The descriptor is complete for the truncated expansion, stable in the orbit distance, and comes with numerical diagnostics. Benchmarks confirm the guarantees, and on bilateral anatomical structures the descriptor separates mirror-image pairs from asymmetric pairs, which parity-blind descriptors cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对闭合三维形状的球谐描述子，通过共形重心归一化参数化并利用旋转群多项式不变量，精确消除参数化、位姿与尺度依赖，同时保留手性信息（镜像可分辨），对截断展开完备、在轨道距离下稳定，并提供数值诊断与基准验证。
AI.motivation: 球谐描述子依赖表面的参数化、位姿和尺度；标准的旋转不变约简——功率谱与双谱——丢弃了各谐波频带的相对朝向，因此无法区分一个形状与其镜像。作者希望构造一个能精确去除这三种依赖、且不丢失其他信息（尤其是手性）的描述子。
AI.method: 先用共形重心归一化的共形参数化消除参数化依赖，再对旋转群施加多项式不变量；将每个谐波频带等同于一个二元形式（binary form），从而把旋转商转化为经典不变量理论，使反射表现为某个不变量的符号，从而记录手性。该描述子对截断展开是完备的，在轨道距离意义下稳定，并附带数值诊断工具。
AI.result: 基准实验证实了上述理论保证；在双侧解剖结构上，该描述子能够将镜像对与不对称对区分开，而奇偶性盲（parity-blind）的描述子无法做到这一点。
AI.conclusion: 通过共形归一化与旋转群多项式不变量的结合，可获得一个既消除参数化、位姿、尺度依赖，又保留手性信息的三维形状描述子，在截断意义下完备且数值稳定，并能解决传统功率谱/双谱无法处理的镜像区分问题。

title: Steering Fields: Adaptive Vector Fields for Safe Image Generation and Beyond
summary: As state-of-the-art text-to-image flow models achieve near-photorealistic quality, controlling their outputs, e.g., suppressing harmful content while promoting benign alternatives, has become a central challenge. The current steering paradigm consists of adding a global steering vector to selected activations. While functional, a fixed and example-agnostic vector applied uniformly along the entire trajectory cannot adapt to the changing state of the generation and often causes unintended global changes. We introduce Steering Fields, a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process. Steering Fields operate on the noisy states of flow models, expose a continuous trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and are compositional, enabling the simultaneous induction and inhibition of concepts, setting a new state of the art on safety steering benchmarks. Despite using no explicit spatial masks or object priors, the trajectory-adaptive estimation naturally preserves local structure, in a manner reminiscent of image editing. In fact, Steering Fields can serve as a structure-preserving image-editing technique that achieves state-of-the-art semantic fidelity (CLIP, VQAScore), while remaining model-agnostic and inversion-free.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Steering Fields，将固定引导向量推广为在流模型生成轨迹每一步自适应重估引导方向的方法，在安全引导基准上达到最优，并可作为无需反演、模型无关的结构保持图像编辑技术。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像流模型质量接近照片级，如何控制其输出（抑制有害内容、促进良性替代）成为核心挑战。现有引导范式是在选定激活上加一个全局固定引导向量，虽有效但示例无关、沿整个轨迹统一施加，无法适应生成过程中的状态变化，常导致非预期的全局改变。
AI.method: 提出 Steering Fields，对引导向量做推广：在生成过程的每一步，基于流模型的噪声状态自适应地重新估计引导方向。该方法暴露了引导强度与内容保持之间的连续权衡，并具有可组合性，可同时诱导和抑制概念。无需显式空间掩码或物体先验，轨迹自适应的估计即可自然保持局部结构。
AI.result: 在安全引导基准上取得新的最优表现；作为结构保持的图像编辑技术，在语义保真度（CLIP、VQAScore）上达到最优，同时保持模型无关且无需反演。
AI.conclusion: Steering Fields 通过轨迹自适应的引导方向估计，克服了固定全局引导向量的局限，兼顾安全引导与内容保持，并可推广为一种模型无关、无需反演的结构保持图像编辑方法。

title: A Generalizable and Explainable Framework for Synthetic Video Detection Using First-Digit Gradient Statistics
summary: AI video generators have not only become harder to detect but are used to generate a diverse set of scenarios from landscapes to street views to animal videos. This creates a problem where CNN-based detectors are effective but offer no insight into their inner workings, while forensics-based detectors are often pretrained for a set scenario or become too complex to derive meaningful insights. We present a novel approach to AI video detection using Sobel gradient values analysed with the first-digit law. Using linear discriminant analysis, we visualise the discriminatory signal, while a multi-layer perceptron is used for classification. The detection method has no generator- or scenespecific features, and the model has no knowledge of container formats, codec, bitrate, or compression artefacts. The model is trained and tested on GenBuster-200K, GenBusterBench, GenVA, FaceForensics++ C23, and CelebDF. We also show how zero-shot detection fails even though the feature set carries a discriminatory signal.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Sobel梯度值结合首位数字定律的AI视频检测方法，用LDA可视化判别信号、MLP分类，跨多个数据集验证且不依赖生成器、场景或压缩信息。
AI.motivation: AI视频生成器愈发难以检测，且可生成从风景到街景再到动物等多样场景。现有CNN检测器虽有效但缺乏可解释性；取证类检测器常针对固定场景预训练，或过于复杂而难以得出有意义的洞察。
AI.method: 使用Sobel梯度值并借助首位数字定律（first-digit law）进行分析；通过线性判别分析（LDA）对判别信号进行可视化；使用多层感知机（MLP）进行分类。检测方法不包含生成器或场景特定特征，模型不涉及容器格式、编解码、码率或压缩伪影等信息。
AI.result: 模型在GenBuster-200K、GenBusterBench、GenVA、FaceForensics++ C23和CelebDF上训练与测试；并展示即使特征集携带判别信号，零样本检测仍会失败。
AI.conclusion: Sobel梯度与首位数字定律结合可实现不依赖生成器、场景及压缩信息的AI视频检测，具备一定可解释性；但零样本场景下检测性能有限。

title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
summary: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于真实视频、跨度达1公里的地理布局理解基准，并按人类空间认知的层级阶段（地标锚定、路径连接、全局心理地图整合）评估视觉语言模型。实验发现当前模型几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别与文本匹配来绕过复杂空间推理，而非真正的路径积分或几何勘测知识。
AI.motivation: 推动视觉语言模型（VLM）在大规模空间智能方面的前沿研究。现有工作缺乏对真实世界视频中、远距离（可达1公里）地理布局理解能力的评测手段，因此需要一个新基准来系统检验模型的空间认知水平。
AI.method: 受认知科学文献启发，构建首个探查真实视频中地理布局理解的基准，距离跨度达1公里；并依据人类空间意识的分层阶段设计评估框架：通过地标进行锚定、通过路线连接地标、再整合为全局心理地图。在此基础上对当前主流VLM开展大量实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示了当前AI模型处理空间信息时存在根本性分歧：模型并未使用真正的路径积分，也未形成几何勘测知识，而是几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别与文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在远距离真实场景的层级化空间认知上存在明显缺陷，倾向于以浅层的视觉与语言匹配替代真正的空间推理。该基准已公开，可供后续研究用于评测和改进大规模空间智能。

title: SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images
summary: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SPOON框架，将多视图组合式3D生成重构为场景级、几何依据的位姿推理，通过Guide-Route-Reconcile范式协调物体位姿与相机配置，生成全局一致的3D场景。
AI.motivation: 组合式3D场景生成需从视觉观测恢复完整物体形状及其空间布局。现有方法或将场景布局与物体生成耦合，或独立地从各视图观测估计空间摆放，导致位姿假设跨视图存在歧义与不一致，产生混乱的"物体-相机大杂烩"（object-camera soup），难以形成全局一致的场景。
AI.method: 提出SPOON框架，将多视图组合式3D生成重新表述为场景级、以几何为依据的位姿推理。不再独立处理各视图的物体位姿假设，而是借助重建得到的多视图几何对其进行协调，采用Guide-Route-Reconcile（引导-路由-调和）范式，逐步将物体位姿与相机配置组织为连贯的场景级空间布局。
AI.result: 在ARSG-110K与MIDI-3D-Front数据集上，跨不同输入视图数量均取得物体摆放与场景组合的一致性提升。在ARSG-110K上，相比强基线，场景级与物体级Chamfer距离分别降低12.7%和17.7%。
AI.conclusion: SPOON通过场景级几何依据的位姿推理有效缓解跨视图位姿歧义，实现全局一致的组合式3D场景生成，验证了协调多视图几何信息的有效性。

title: Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition
summary: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.

AI.tldr: 本文从函数层面分析不确定性分解框架，发现有限样本下存在不可行的AU/EU区域，其边界受类别数与MC样本数N限制（AU ≤ log(2)/N），并据此解释认知坍缩现象。
AI.motivation: 标准信息论框架将不确定性分解为偶然不确定性(AU)与认知不确定性(EU)，但实践中存在两大问题：AU与EU高度相关的纠缠问题，以及EU幅度随模型容量增大而收缩的认知坍缩问题。作者希望从函数层面剖析该框架的根本结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 在函数层面对不确定性分解框架进行理论分析，刻画在有限设置下不可行的AU与EU取值区域，推导该不可行区域随类别数和蒙特卡洛样本数N（如N个成员的集成）的缩放规律，并分析不可行区域边界与认知坍缩的关系。
AI.result: 发现假设的AU、EU范围中有相当一部分在有限设置下不可行，无法由任何类别概率达到；不可行区域受AU ≤ log(2)/N约束；当模型置信度高时，AU > EU由该根本结构性限制所保证，从而解释了认知坍缩；增大集成规模可通过缩小不可行区域来缓解认知坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 应谨慎对待在低AU区间将AU与EU视为独立量的做法，因为当AU ≤ log(2)/N时二者相互耦合；增大集成规模是缓解认知坍缩的有效途径。

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
comment: 61 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/groundanything/ Code: [https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything](https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything) Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything, https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything-VLM
summary: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GroundAnything，一个 4B 参数的双向扩散式视觉定位基础模型，通过分块去噪实现并行解码与精确定位，在 30 个基准上达到同级最优。
AI.motivation: 自回归（AR）定位模型将空间预测序列化，导致顺序延迟并强加因果生成顺序；但定位本质是视觉证据提取，物体、位置与空间关系受图像和查询联合约束，并不存在内在的从左到右生成顺序。因此作者认为双向扩散更契合该任务，可让空间假设并行涌现并迭代联合精炼。
AI.method: 1) 将定位视为视觉证据提取，采用双向扩散替代自回归序列化；2) 引入 GroundAnything，4B 参数定位基础模型，以 blockwise denoising（分块去噪）调和快速并行解码与精确定位；3) 训练流程包括：公开数据集与专用数据引擎的定位预训练、带联合 AR 与扩散目标的 AR-to-diffusion 直接转换、监督微调，以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习后训练；4) 采用熵引导解码（entropy-guided decoding）与可选的自推测解码模式；5) 进行渐进式推理优化基础设施实验。
AI.result: 在 30 个定位基准上，AR 变体 GroundAnything-VLM 以 72.42% 取得同级模型新 SOTA，与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力；采用熵引导解码后，GroundAnything 以平均 61.75% 超越此前同规模 SOTA（基于 MTP 的快速模型 LocateAnything 为 53.32%）；可选自推测模式相对 AR 对应模型实现 4.51× 加速，COCO F1mIoU 仅下降 0.74 个百分点；基础设施实验表明渐进式推理优化可将并行解码转化为实际加速。
AI.conclusion: 双向扩散式分块去噪可有效替代自回归序列化定位，兼顾并行解码效率与定位精度；结合熵引导解码、自推测模式与推理优化，GroundAnything 在精度和延迟上均具优势，适用于延迟敏感的真实世界视觉定位系统。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
comment: 64 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundingPI Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundingPI
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: GroundingPI：4B 定位基础模型，以共享词表中的量化坐标点/框统一输出，经多模态与空间预训练、SFT 及 GRPO 强化学习训练，在34个基准上平均73.68%达SOTA，并提升机器人操作与自动驾驶下游性能。
AI.motivation: 精确的定位能力至关重要：需在杂乱场景与微小目标下指明目标对象及其位置，且速度须满足闭环控制。然而现有VLA与WAM的感知模块沿用通用视觉-语言与视频生成骨干，在这类场景仍表现不佳，故需专门的定位感知基础模型。
AI.method: 提出GroundingPI，4B定位基础模型，将点和框表示为共享词表中的量化坐标。训练分三阶段：多模态与空间预训练、监督微调、基于GRPO的强化学习，监督来自公开数据集与专用数据引擎。此外系统分析预训练规模与数据组成（覆盖11类感知能力），并作为下游视觉骨干接入机器人操作与自动驾驶模型。
AI.result: 在34个定位基准、11类感知能力上与44个基线对比，GroundingPI平均73.68%，超过更大规模的GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。RoboTwin 2.0上四个分布外设置全面优于所评估的主流骨干，最高相对提升24.8%；RoboCasa-GR1上用50%演示数据超过用75%数据训练的基线；nuScenes上开环平均L2误差0.296 m。预训练规模扩大时下游任务持续提升；稠密定位对操作与驾驶均有显著收益，OCR可作为感知学习的催化剂。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将"定位"作为感知基础，并表明面向感知的专门预训练是物理智能基础模型的有前景方向。

title: FOMO: Forget the Concept, Don't Miss Out on the Scene in Selective Video Unlearning
summary:
The rapid advancement of generative video models has enabled the synthesis of increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, while also raising concerns about the generation of harmful content. The reliance on large-scale web datasets during training inevitably exposes these models to undesirable material, making concept unlearning an essential mitigation. Existing methods mainly target static visual concepts, such as objects, identities, or unsafe appearance, largely overlooking motion unlearning. Furthermore, these approaches often pay little attention to preserving the surrounding scene. As a result, successful concept removal may unintentionally alter the background, composition, or overall video dynamics. We argue that effective unlearning should ideally change only what is targeted, while minimizing unnecessary changes to the remaining scene. In this work, we introduce FOMO, to the best of our knowledge the first training-based selective video unlearning method that directly treats preservation of the original scene as a priority. We formulate unlearning around two complementary objectives: what to change and what to preserve. Our method localizes concept-related representations and modifies them, while the preservation mechanism maintains non-target scene information without requiring auxiliary data. Beyond simply erasing unwanted concepts, FOMO explicitly redirects the generation toward a specified safe alternative. We further extend this formulation to motion unlearning, where the concept is defined by temporal behavior rather than a fixed spatial region. Our solution achieves effective unlearning across unsafe content, object, and motion concepts, while achieving the best trade-off between concept removal and scene preservation.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/FOMO
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/FOMO

AI.tldr: FOMO 是首个基于训练的、选择性视频概念遗忘方法，将原始场景保持作为核心目标，并首次系统处理"运动概念"遗忘。它通过定位并修改概念相关表征、同时无需辅助数据地保持非目标场景信息，实现定向重定向到安全替代概念，在移除与保持之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频模型训练依赖大规模网络数据，不可避免地接触到不良内容，因此概念遗忘成为必要的缓解手段。然而现有方法主要针对静态视觉概念（物体、身份、不安全外观），忽视了运动/时序概念的遗忘；同时这些方法很少关注保持周围场景，导致概念移除时会无意改变背景、构图或整体视频动态。作者主张有效的遗忘应"只改变目标对象，尽量减少对剩余场景的不必要改动"。
AI.method: 提出 FOMO，据称是首个基于训练的选择性视频遗忘方法，直接以保持原始场景为优先。其核心是将遗忘形式化为两个互补目标："改变什么"与"保持什么"：通过定位与概念相关的表征并对其进行修改；保持机制在无需辅助数据的情况下维持非目标场景信息。除单纯擦除不良概念外，FOMO 还将生成显式重定向到指定的安全替代概念。该框架进一步扩展到运动遗忘，此时概念由时序行为而非固定空间区域定义。
AI.result: 在不安全内容、物体和运动概念上均实现了有效遗忘，并在概念移除与场景保持之间取得了最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: FOMO 将视频概念遗忘从静态视觉扩展到运动级时序概念，并以场景保持为优先，兼顾概念移除与生成重定向，为生成式视频模型的安全缓解提供了具有选择性且低副作用的方案。代码与项目主页已公开。

title: Semantic Watermarking for Malicious Image Manipulation Detection
summary: The proliferation of high-fidelity generative editing models has made it possible to inject violent or sexual content into otherwise ordinary images while preserving visual plausibility, with concrete consequences for public discourse and vulnerable populations. We propose a robust semantic watermarking framework that reframes the watermark as a recoverable semantic reference rather than an opaque identifier. Our framework combines a $β$-VAE-based binary watermark (CLIP-VAE) with explicit channel-aware training---random bit-flip noise is injected during training so that the decoder learns graceful degradation under the noisy watermarking channel. As a downstream application, a lightweight module SDA-Net uses the recovered semantic embedding to expose not only whether but in which semantic direction an image has been altered. In a 5-way comparison against representative binary hashing baselines (SimHash, ITQ, HashNet, and their robust-MLP variants), CLIP-VAE achieves the highest reconstruction cosine similarity to the original CLIP embedding under realistic InstructPix2Pix bit-error rates, and uniquely supports direction-of-drift detection---a forensic complement to existing content-moderation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出语义水印框架CLIP-VAE，将水印作为可恢复的语义参考，结合β-VAE二值水印与通道感知训练，在真实误码率下重建余弦相似度优于基线，并支持语义漂移方向检测。
AI.motivation: 高保真生成编辑模型可向普通图像注入暴力或性内容且保持视觉合理性，对公共话语和脆弱群体造成实际影响，因此需要更强的语义级内容溯源与取证手段。
AI.method: 将水印重构为可恢复的语义参考而非不透明标识；框架由基于β-VAE的二值水印（CLIP-VAE）构成，训练时注入随机比特翻转噪声以实现通道感知训练，使解码器在含噪水印信道下优雅退化；下游使用轻量模块SDA-Net，利用恢复的语义嵌入判断图像是否被篡改及篡改的语义方向。
AI.result: 在与SimHash、ITQ、HashNet及其鲁棒MLP变体共5组代表性二值哈希基线的对比中，CLIP-VAE在真实InstructPix2Pix误码率下对原始CLIP嵌入的重建余弦相似度最高，且独有地支持漂移方向检测。
AI.conclusion: 语义水印可作为现有内容审核流程的取证补充，不仅判断是否被篡改，还能指示语义漂移方向。

title: ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and supplementary material: https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/
summary: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/.

AI.tldr: 提出ExpandDiff，一种条件扩散管线，联合重建LDR图像中被裁剪的阴影和高光，在SI-HDR基准上显著提升重建精度。
AI.motivation: 单图像HDR重建需在保留LDR可见内容的同时推断缺失细节。由于传感器动态范围和曝光的差异，LDR图像在阴影和高光区域丢失的信息量各不相同，现有方法难以兼顾双向裁剪的复原。
AI.method: 提出动态裁剪合成（DCS），在从HDR目标构建训练输入时随机采样阴影与高光裁剪百分位数，以适配信息丢失的多样性；采用像素空间扩散模型，由空间自适应归一化引导，并通过有界输出头预测感知编码的HDR，在单次采样轨迹中同时重建两个裁剪方向。
AI.result: 在SI-HDR基准上，ExpandDiff各变体相比最强对比方法在PU21-PSNR上提升3.43 dB；在双侧裁剪条件下提升7.34 dB。
AI.conclusion: ExpandDiff通过动态裁剪合成与条件扩散的结合，有效联合重建阴影与高光裁剪，显著优于现有方法，代码与补充材料已公开。

title: D-Scope: Decomposing and Steering Diffusion Transformers with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal visual structure in diffusion transformers (DiTs), but interpreting a feature does not establish whether it can be used to control generation. We introduce D-Scope (Diffusion Scope), a framework that connects feature interpretation to generation control through shared visual evidence. D-Scope aggregates SigLIP~2 embeddings of highly activating image patches into visual centroids. Matching target text descriptions against these visual centroids in the shared image-text embedding space then enables retrieval of individual features without per-feature text annotations. The underlying patches provide evidence for inspecting each selection, while spatially masked interventions test the corresponding decoder direction at varying strengths under fixed generation conditions. We characterize 150 SAEs across two model families and five layers, and introduce a benchmark of 100 target concepts with ten contexts each spanning under-specified and explicit-conflict conditions. Our empirical results show that high reconstruction fidelity can coexist with low dictionary utilization and limited visual-evidence coverage. Under per-case best-of-sweep strength selection, contrastive retrieval yields larger mean regional SigLIP~2 gains than direct retrieval across the tested steering configurations, without consistently improving outside-region preservation. D-Scope provides an inspectable framework for evaluating sparse DiT features through their visual evidence and the effects of their decoder directions on generation. The demo is available at https://jiahaozhang-public.github.io/d-scope/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 D-Scope 框架，将扩散 Transformer 中稀疏自编码器的特征解释与生成控制相连接，通过共享视觉证据实现特征检索与干预评估。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽能揭示扩散 Transformer 的视觉结构，但仅解释特征并不能确定其能否用于控制生成，缺乏从特征解释到生成控制的桥梁。
AI.method: D-Scope 将高激活图像块的 SigLIP~2 嵌入聚合为视觉质心，在共享图文嵌入空间中将目标文本描述与质心匹配，实现无需逐特征文本标注的特征检索；底层图像块为选择提供证据，并通过空间掩码干预在固定生成条件下以不同强度测试对应的解码器方向。作者刻画了两个模型家族、五个层级的 150 个 SAE，并构建了包含 100 个目标概念、每个概念 10 个上下文（涵盖欠指定与显式冲突条件）的基准。
AI.result: 实验显示高重建保真度可与低字典利用率和有限的视觉证据覆盖并存；在逐案例最优强度选择下，对比式检索在所测试的引导配置中比直接检索带来更大的区域平均 SigLIP~2 增益，但未持续改善区域外保持。
AI.conclusion: D-Scope 提供了一个可检验的框架，通过特征的视觉证据及其解码器方向对生成的影响来评估稀疏 DiT 特征。

title: Introduction to Computer Vision
comment: 217 pages. For online notes and code, see https://sbirchfield.github.io/cvintro
summary: This book presents a code-first introduction to computer vision, spanning classical 2D image processing, classical 3D vision, and deep learning. Organized as 44 short chapters across three parts, the book builds each topic from first principles: image arithmetic and morphology; convolution, pyramids, and frequency-domain filtering; feature detection, optical flow, and stereo; projective geometry, camera calibration, and structure from motion; and the full arc of modern deep learning, from a single neuron through convolutional networks, backpropagation, classic architectures, transfer learning, object detection, and semantic and instance segmentation, concluding with engineering considerations like mixed-precision and parallel training. Every technique is implemented directly in Python and NumPy or PyTorch and checked numerically against the corresponding OpenCV or PyTorch library function, so readers see not just the mathematics but its concrete behavior on real and synthetic data. The material was distilled with AI assistance from freely available online course notes, condensing extensive working code into concise mathematical exposition while preserving verified, reproducible results throughout. It is intended as a self-contained reference for students and practitioners who want to understand computer vision algorithms and their Python implementations.

AI.tldr: 本书以代码优先方式系统介绍计算机视觉，涵盖二维图像处理、三维视觉与深度学习，共44章，每项技术用Python/NumPy或PyTorch实现并与OpenCV/PyTorch库函数数值比对验证。
AI.motivation: 面向希望既理解计算机视觉算法数学原理、又掌握其Python实现的学生与从业者，提供自包含的参考材料；弥合理论数学与实践代码之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用代码优先的教学组织：全书分三部分、共44个短章，从第一性原理逐主题构建——图像算术与形态学、卷积/金字塔/频域滤波、特征检测/光流/立体视觉、投影几何/相机标定/运动恢复结构，以及从单神经元到卷积网络、反向传播、经典架构、迁移学习、目标检测、语义与实例分割直至混合精度与并行训练等工程实践的完整深度学习脉络；所有技术直接用Python与NumPy或PyTorch实现，并与对应OpenCV或PyTorch库函数做数值校验；内容借助AI辅助从公开在线课程笔记提炼，将大量代码压缩为简洁数学阐述，同时保留可验证、可复现的结果。
AI.result: 形成一部自包含的计算机视觉参考书，读者不仅可见数学推导，还能观察其在真实与合成数据上的具体行为，且实现结果经库函数数值比对验证。
AI.conclusion: 该书适合作为学生与从业者理解计算机视觉算法及其Python实现的自包含参考，突出理论、代码与可复现验证三者结合。

title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
summary: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity \textit{reconstruction} (rFID below $2$) with unsupervised \textit{subtype discovery}, recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy $0.950$ vs.\ at most $0.281$) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned \textit{generation} raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ($90.5\%$ vs.\ $27.7\%$) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE's salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.

AI.tldr: SAGE 在冻结自编码器的高维空间潜空间中直接学习显著/共性因子，并以显著表示条件化扩散 Transformer，实现高保真重建、无监督子类型发现与生成。
AI.motivation: 对比分析需从目标数据集（如戴眼镜人脸）中分离出目标特有的显著因子与两数据集共享的共性内容；理想显著表示应捕捉每张图像的目标特有细节（眼镜形状、颜色、位置），从而在无子类型标签下揭示子类型并生成新样本。但此前方法多依赖低维/解耦潜变量，难以在高维空间保留细节。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE：在冻结表示自编码器的高维空间潜空间中直接学习显著因子与共性因子，并将学习到的参考图像显著表示作为条件，驱动扩散 Transformer 生成。
AI.result: 在 Digits-ImageNet 与 FFHQ 眼镜数据上，rFID 低于 2 的高保真重建；无监督子类型发现中数字恢复探针准确率 0.950（基线最高 0.281），并揭示眼镜类型、更细的太阳镜风格及错误标注图像；显著条件生成使 Digits-ImageNet 子类型准确率达 90.5%（未因子化潜变量为 27.7%），两数据集多样性均提升。在视网膜 OCT 上，仅用正常/疾病标签即可将三种疾病分离。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 证明在高维冻结潜空间中直接进行对比因子分解可同时实现高保真重建、无监督子类型发现与可控生成，并在医学图像上以弱标签完成疾病分离，具有良好泛化性。

title: FANVIDv2: Evaluating Video Super-Resolution by Face and Licence-Plate Recognition Under Compound Degradation
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is normally judged by PSNR and SSIM on clips that were downsampled bicubically, although in surveillance its purpose is to make faces and licence plates \emph{recognisable}. We present FANVIDv2, a benchmark that scores VSR by what a recognition pipeline can do with its output. FANVIDv2 provides $320\times180$ low-resolution (LR) clips with high-resolution (HR) references for 48 public figures (with one HR gallery image each) and 375 licence-plate clips covering 360 distinct plate strings. LR clips are generated with a randomised compound degradation (blur, resize jitter, sensor noise, JPEG compression, final downsampling) rather than bicubic downsampling alone. Two metrics score recognition \emph{inside} detections: FaceRecBox rewards a face only if it is localised and correctly identified, and TextRecBox scores plate transcriptions by normalised edit distance weighted by localisation quality. With a 2.3\,M-parameter VSR baseline (RCDM), FaceRecBox rises from 0.6864 to 0.7222, identity accuracy on matched faces from 84.35\% to 86.93\%, and TextRecBox from 0.3088 to 0.3667; a residual-map gated variant (RCDM-RMGF) reaches 0.3801 on plates. We describe the degradation model, the baseline architectures and the scorers in detail, and release annotations, metadata, download and degradation scripts and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 提出FANVIDv2视频超分辨基准，以识别流水线的实际效果（人脸识别与车牌转录）评价VSR，而非仅用PSNR/SSIM。
AI.motivation: 传统VSR评价基于双三次下采样片段的PSNR/SSIM，但在监控场景中VSR的真正目的是让摄像机拍到的人脸和车牌变得"可识别"，指标与实际用途脱节。
AI.method: 构建FANVIDv2基准：提供320×180低分辨率片段及高分辨率参考，涵盖48位公众人物（各1张HR gallery图）与375个车牌片段（360个不同车牌字符串）；LR片段采用随机复合退化（模糊、缩放抖动、传感器噪声、JPEG压缩、最终下采样）生成。定义两项"检测框内"识别指标：FaceRecBox（仅当人脸被定位且正确识别才给分）与TextRecBox（按定位质量加权的归一化编辑距离评车牌转录）。基线为2.3M参数的RCDM及残差图门控变体RCDM-RMGF。
AI.result: 在RCDM基线上，FaceRecBox从0.6864提升至0.7222，匹配人脸的identity accuracy从84.35%提升至86.93%，TextRecBox从0.3088提升至0.3667；RCDM-RMGF在车牌上达0.3801。
AI.conclusion: VSR质量应以识别任务的实际性能衡量；FANVIDv2提供退化模型、基线架构与评分器细节，并开源标注、元数据、数据下载与退化脚本及评测代码。

title: Diffusable Latents from Structure-Agnostic Distillation
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling
summary: Distilling pretrained foundation models into an autoencoder bottleneck improves latent diffusability, enabling diffusion models to converge faster and reach higher sample quality. Standard distillation aligns the latent at each position to a co-located teacher feature, tying the latent layout to the teacher's. We show this constraint is unnecessary: aligning a single pooled image-level descriptor to the teacher's performs as well as or slightly better than dense position-wise distillation. We compare first-order and relational pooled objectives across latent shapes and teacher modalities. First-order matching extends naturally to 1D token-sequence latents and across modalities, where distilling a text encoder into an image autoencoder still improves diffusability; a relational objective based only on each image's nearest neighbours improves it as well. Code and blog post are available at https://github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation and https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation/.

AI.tldr: 将预训练基础模型蒸馏到自编码器瓶颈可提升潜空间可扩散性，但标准位置对齐蒸馏并非必要；仅用图像级池化描述子对齐即可达到相当或更优效果。
AI.motivation: 标准蒸馏将每个位置的潜变量对齐到同位置的教师特征，使潜变量布局被绑定到教师布局上。作者质疑这一约束的必要性，希望探索是否可用更简单、结构无关的蒸馏目标。
AI.method: 对比一阶与关系型池化目标，在多种潜变量形状（如1D token序列）与教师模态下进行实验：将文本编码器蒸馏进图像自编码器，并测试仅基于每张图像最近邻的关系型目标。
AI.result: 将单个池化的图像级描述子对齐到教师，其表现与稠密逐位置蒸馏相当或略好；一阶匹配可自然扩展到1D token序列潜变量及跨模态场景；仅用最近邻的关系型目标同样能提升可扩散性。
AI.conclusion: 逐位置对齐约束并非必要，结构无关的池化蒸馏目标足以改善潜空间可扩散性，为扩散模型加速收敛与提升样本质量提供了更灵活的设计空间。

title: BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging
summary: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone (Terris et al.) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. A single network then draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Kohler camera-shake benchmark, BAM outperforms in just 3 steps both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality, at a fraction of their computational cost. BAM gives the community an accessible entry point to generative computational imaging, lowers the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new path for research on physics-aware Bayesian computational imaging. Official page: https://bayesian-anything-model.github.io/

AI.tldr: BAM 是一个仅 36M 参数的轻量级基础模型，通过将算子条件化的 RAM 主干升级为条件流映射，实现少步、物理感知的贝叶斯后验采样，在多种线性逆问题上以 3 步超越专用模型与领先零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 当前贝叶斯计算成像缺乏物理感知的基础模型：大型基础图像模型作为即插即用先验需零样本近似似然引导，带来显著偏差与计算开销；而物理感知生成模型虽避免偏差，却各自绑定特定数据集、任务与仪器，泛化性差。
AI.method: 将算子条件化的 Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) 主干升级为条件流映射，使仪器物理特性在推理时指定而非训练时固定；模型仅 36M 参数，在大规模图像语料与前向算子库上联合预训练；单网络在少步内直接采样后验，无需似然近似、无需调节引导权重。
AI.result: 在 FFHQ、AFHQ、LSUN、DIV2K 及 Kohler 相机抖动基准的线性逆问题上，BAM 仅用 3 步即在样本质量上超越专用模型和领先零样本方法，且计算成本仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: BAM 为社区提供了生成式计算成像的易用入口，降低了成像模型训练的经济与环境成本，并为物理感知贝叶斯计算成像研究开辟了新路径。

title: Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了排版攻击对视觉语言模型（VLM）AI生成图像检测的影响，发现推理模式比直接模式更脆弱，攻击效果存在方向不对称性，且更大模型清洁准确率更高的同时也更易受攻击。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多用于AI生成图像检测并提供自然语言解释，但其解读图像内文字的能力可能使真实性判断受到误导性语义线索的干扰，这一安全隐患尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 在检测导向、开放权重和商业VLM上系统评估排版攻击策略，涵盖real-to-fake与fake-to-real两个方向；考察图像与文本变换下的攻击鲁棒性，并研究叠加正确类别提示是否有助于纠错。
AI.result: 推理模式普遍比直接模式更易受攻击；攻击效果表现出明显的方向不对称性；更大模型清洁检测准确率更高，但攻击成功率也更高；并分析了变换条件下的鲁棒性及纠错效果。
AI.conclusion: 该分析刻画了排版攻击如何影响真实性判断，揭示了当前基于VLM的AIGI检测系统的局限性。

title: MC-PanDA++: Simpler, Stronger, and More Robust Domain-Adaptive Panoptic Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) reduces the annotation burden in panoptic segmentation by leveraging a cost-effectively labeled source domain (e.g., synthetic) and an unlabeled target domain to bridge the distribution gap. Existing panoptic UDA methods rely on teacher-student consistency learning built upon suboptimal per-pixel segmentation architectures. In contrast, state-of-the-art mask transformers are rarely adopted due to their pronounced vulnerability to confirmation bias in consistency learning, where erroneous teacher predictions are reinforced during training. Our earlier approach, MC-PanDA, mitigates this issue through fine-grained confidence estimation, which suppresses gradients from unreliable masks while sampling informative yet reliable locations for loss computation. However, this method entails a complex multi-stage training and requires careful hyperparameter tuning. This work presents MC-PanDA++, which addresses these limitations by introducing: (i) self-supervised vision encoders that provide a stronger and more robust initialization, further reducing the reliance on human annotations, (ii) per-class, self-adapting mask-wide loss scaling that stabilizes training and enables the usage of a single set of hyperparameters across domains, and (iii) a single-stage training pipeline that decreases overall conceptual complexity. Together, these improvements result in a conceptually simpler, better-performing, and more robust method for domain-adaptive panoptics. Source code: https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA

AI.tldr: 本文提出MC-PanDA++，一种面向全景分割无监督域适应（UDA）的改进方法，通过引入自监督视觉编码器、逐类别自适应掩码级损失缩放以及单阶段训练流程，在降低训练复杂度的同时提升性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 全景分割的UDA旨在利用合成源域与无标注目标域减轻标注负担。现有方法多基于次优的逐像素分割架构并依赖教师-学生一致性学习。而先进的mask transformer架构因易受确认偏误（confirmation bias）影响——错误教师预测在训练中被强化——而鲜少被采用。作者早期工作MC-PanDA虽通过细粒度置信度估计缓解该问题，但训练流程复杂且需精细调参。
AI.method: MC-PanDA++在MC-PanDA基础上引入三项改进：(i) 采用自监督视觉编码器提供更强、更鲁棒的初始化，进一步减少对人工标注的依赖；(ii) 提出逐类别、自适应、掩码级（mask-wide）的损失缩放策略，稳定训练并实现跨域单一超参数集；(iii) 设计单阶段训练流程，降低整体概念复杂度。
AI.result: 相比MC-PanDA，所提方法在概念上更简洁、性能更优且更鲁棒，实现了域自适应全景分割中的有效性提升，同时通过单阶段训练与统一超参数减少了调参负担。源码已开源于GitHub。
AI.conclusion: MC-PanDA++通过自监督初始化、自适应掩码级损失缩放与单阶段训练，系统性地解决了mask transformer在UDA一致性学习中的确认偏误与高复杂度问题，为域自适应全景分割提供了更简洁、高效、鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Unapologetically Distributed: A Call for Decentralized Document Analysis
summary: Privacy has become an increasingly important concern in the Document Analysis community, to the extent that in many environments such as archives, governmental institutions, and local businesses, the adoption of automation is restricted by legal and policy constraints. While federated learning has often been regarded as a ``necessary evil'', implying an unavoidable performance trade-off in exchange for decentralization and privacy, many prior works overlook its potential to improve robustness to out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we present Unapologetically Distributed, the first comprehensive study evaluating distributed learning in Document Analysis along three key axes simultaneously: the tasks addressed, the architectures employed, and the fine-tuning strategies applied. Specifically, we demonstrate how various distributed training approaches enhance generalization capabilities across diverse tasks such as Table Recognition, handwriting recognition, and Word Spotting, particularly during transfer learning stages. Our results provide strong evidence that decentralization is not merely a constraint, but a valuable opportunity to improve model robustness and adaptability in real-world Document Analysis scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Unapologetically Distributed"，首次在文档分析领域同时从任务、架构、微调策略三个维度系统评估分布式（联邦）学习，证明去中心化不仅不是性能妥协，反而能提升对分布外数据的泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 隐私在文档分析社区日益重要，档案机构、政府机构和本地企业等环境受法律与政策限制，限制了自动化采用。联邦学习常被视为"必要的恶"，被认为必然带来性能权衡，且以往研究忽视了其在提升分布外数据鲁棒性方面的潜力。
AI.method: 提出"Unapologetically Distributed"研究，首次同时沿三个关键轴评估文档分析中的分布式学习：（1）所处理的任务，（2）所采用的架构，（3）所应用的微调策略；覆盖表格识别、手写识别和词发现（Word Spotting）等多样化任务。
AI.result: 多种分布式训练方法增强了跨任务的泛化能力，尤其在迁移学习阶段表现明显。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化并非仅是约束条件，而是提升真实场景下文档分析模型鲁棒性与适应性的宝贵机会。

title: ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShieldCLIP 框架与 ViSUv2 数据集，将多模态编码器的安全对齐从"样本来源"改为"各模态安全状态"条件化，在保留安全内容的前提下抑制有害关联。
AI.motivation: CLIP 等网络规模预训练的多模态编码器嵌入了有害关联，需在安全对齐中抑制而不破坏良性表示；但伦理与现实约束使得无法大规模采集真实不安全内容，现有数据集将安全真实样本与生成样本配对时，把所有生成样本一律标注为不安全，即使其中某个模态本身是安全的，导致误伤安全内容。
AI.method: 提出 ShieldCLIP：首个以每个模态的观测安全状态（而非样本来源）为条件进行安全对齐的框架。配套构建 ViSUv2 数据集，含 195k 四元组、覆盖 578 个概念与 28 个类别、具备独立的分模态安全标签。基于这些标签定义四路条件目标：安全内容锚定；不安全模态重定向到其安全对应物；混合配对仅更新不安全分支；两模态均不安全时施加一致性约束。
AI.result: 在跨模态检索、基于 Stable Diffusion v1.4 与 SDXL 的文生图、以及基于 LLaVA 的图生文三类任务上评估，ShieldCLIP 相较既有安全对齐编码器与强缓解基线持续减少有害输出，同时保持原嵌入空间的效用。消融实验表明，模态特异性监督与选择性对齐目标均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以分模态安全状态为条件的细粒度对齐，可在不牺牲多模态表示效用的前提下有效降低下游生成与检索中的有害输出，为该方向提供了数据集、目标函数与评测范式。

title: When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic
summary: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5\% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100\% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial $p=0.035$) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/background split. Naive masking is itself a major source of risk: it causes the largest average-accuracy loss of any method we evaluate, and its own per-image segmentation step is a significant runtime bottleneck. To address this, we design a batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation routine that cuts this overhead from 3.5$\times$ to 1.75$\times$ baseline. Gating deployment by SIM's sign recovers masking's benefits while avoiding its worst failures, matching or exceeding a strong pruning baseline on 7 of 8 datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出无标签部署前诊断指标SIM，通过其符号预测语义掩码对worst-group鲁棒性的影响，并设计批处理GPU分割例程降低开销。
AI.motivation: 掩码式token剪枝对worst-group鲁棒性的帮助或损害此前无法在部署前预判，且效果高度不稳定（相对提升最高82.5%，下降最高100%），亟需无标签、无微调的诊断方法。
AI.method: 在8个虚假相关基准上系统研究语义掩码；揭示"虚假反转"现象——当虚假属性背景可分时，背景patch的CLIP文本相似度高于真实目标；提出Spurious Inversion Metric（SIM），基于该特征的免标签诊断指标，并用其符号作为部署门控；同时设计批处理、免同步的GPU分割例程。
AI.result: SIM符号在全部8个数据集上达到统计显著预测（二项p=0.035），在6种CLIP架构与清晰前景/背景划分下保持可靠；朴素掩码造成所有方法中最大的平均精度损失，其逐图分割是运行时瓶颈，新例程将开销从3.5×降至1.75×；按SIM符号门控部署在8个数据集中的7个上匹配或超过强剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 掩码式token剪枝的风险可在部署前无标签预测，SIM可作为有效的部署门控；结合高效GPU分割例程，能够在规避最差失效的同时保留掩码收益。

title: BTC3D: Blended Tile Conditioning for Detail-Enhancing Image-to-3D Generation
summary: Recent diffusion-based pipelines have achieved promising progress in image-to-3D synthesis. However, generating high-fidelity details remains challenging, especially when the input image contains rich details. Existing approaches often rely on globally encoded conditioning features, which compress spatial information and limit the model to reproduce fine-grained details. This common design often leads to a phenomenon we term detail attenuation. Moreover, improving image-to-3D synthesis quality typically requires retraining or fine-tuning large diffusion models, which can be computationally expensive and impractical for complex 3D pipelines. In this work, we present Blended Tile Conditioning for image-to-3D generation (BTC3D), a training-free inference time framework that enhances fine-grained detail preservation in image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. To alleviate detail attenuation, we first examine the image feature additivity in image-to-3D models. Based on this property, we introduce a blended tile embedding that extracts local conditioning signals from split image regional patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details. To integrate the global and local conditioning guidance stably, we propose a dynamic conditioning schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise stages of diffusion. Our proposed method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into existing image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves texture quality and visual fidelity of the base model while maintaining global structural consistency in a training-free manner.

AI.tldr: 提出BTC3D，一种免训练的推理时框架，通过混合瓦片嵌入与动态条件调度缓解图生3D中的细节衰减，提升纹理质量与视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的图生3D方法多依赖全局编码的条件特征，压缩了空间信息，导致细节衰减，难以复现输入图像中的细粒度细节；而提升质量通常需重训练或微调大型扩散模型，计算昂贵且不适用于复杂3D流程。
AI.method: 首先分析图生3D模型中的图像特征可加性；据此设计混合瓦片嵌入，从切分的图像区域块中提取局部条件信号；并提出动态条件调度，在扩散后期低噪声阶段逐步增强瓦片级条件的影响，以稳定融合全局与局部引导。整个方法在推理时运行，可无缝接入现有图生3D扩散流程。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在免训练前提下显著提升基础模型的纹理质量与视觉保真度，同时保持全局结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: BTC3D通过局部瓦片条件与动态调度的结合，有效缓解细节衰减，为图生3D扩散流程提供了一种免训练、即插即用的细节增强方案。

title: Let the Carrier Carry the Attack: Preserving the Subject in Adversarial Image Generation
summary: Strong unrestricted adversarial attacks can distort the primary object of an image, hereafter referred to as the subject. To preserve subject integrity without compromising attack magnitude, we introduce the carrier: a secondary visual element that provides an auxiliary region to facilitate the attack under global classifier guidance. We demonstrate three key findings: 1. A carrier mitigates subject distortion by absorbing a larger share of globally normalized attack updates. 2. A carrier improves cross-model transferability, governed by the strength of target-related features that balance semantic separation and transfer performance. 3. Successful targeted attacks retain the personalized subject as the primary content perceived by humans while successfully misleading the classifier. Our results demonstrate that a visually secondary carrier offers an auxiliary spatial pathway for adversarial changes, enabling strong and transferable attacks while improving subject preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出"载体"(carrier)概念:在图像中引入一个次要视觉元素作为辅助攻击区域,在全局分类器引导下实施无限制对抗攻击,从而在保持攻击强度的同时减轻主体失真并提升跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: 强无限制对抗攻击往往会扭曲图像中的主要对象(主体),破坏主体完整性。现有方法在攻击幅度与主体保真之间存在权衡,作者希望在不牺牲攻击强度的前提下保护主体不被扭曲。
AI.method: 引入"载体"——一个次要视觉元素,为攻击提供附加空间区域,在全局归一化(global classifier guidance)下引导对抗更新。通过让载体吸收更大比例的全局归一化攻击更新来分担扰动,并分析载体中目标相关特征的强度对语义分离与迁移性的平衡作用。
AI.result: 三点发现:(1)载体通过吸收更大份额的全局归一化攻击更新来减轻主体失真;(2)载体提升跨模型迁移性,该迁移性受目标相关特征强度调节,该强度需在语义分离与迁移性能间取得平衡;(3)成功的定向攻击在误导分类器的同时,人类感知仍以个性化主体为主要内容。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上处于次要地位的载体为对抗扰动提供了辅助空间通道,可实现强且可迁移的攻击,同时改善主体保持。载体概念为无限制对抗攻击中"攻击强度-主体保真"的权衡提供了一种新思路。

title: FAST: Flow Any Scene Transformer
summary: Scaling has become a primary driver of progress in language and vision foundation models, yet its role in precise correspondence matching remains underexplored. In this work, we present Flow Any Scene Transformer (FAST), a scalable correspondence model driven by two key insights. First, we reveal that the query-key projections inside single-view vision foundation models encode a coarse yet reusable prior for cross-view matching. Second, reusing these pretrained projections in cross-attention form yields a highly effective initialization for a ViT-based matcher built from a single-view encoder. Guided by these insights, we build FAST upon a vanilla single-view foundation model, utilizing a zero-parameter rewiring strategy to convert selected self-attention layers into cross-attention for cross-view interaction. This design allows ViT-based matchers to scale with advances in single-view foundation models, bypassing the need for a dedicated pair-centric pretraining stage. To fully unlock the scaling potential of this formulation, we assemble a 6-million-pair training corpus for general-purpose dense 2D displacement estimation across diverse co-visible image pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, while scaling favorably with both backbone size and training data.

AI.tldr: 提出FAST，一种利用单视图视觉基础模型查询-键投影作为跨视图匹配先验的可扩展对应模型，通过零参数重连将自注意力转为跨注意力，并用600万对语料训练，实现多基准SOTA并对骨干规模与数据规模良好扩展。
AI.motivation: 规模扩展是语言与视觉基础模型进步的核心驱动力，但其在精确对应匹配中的作用尚未被充分探索；现有ViT匹配器通常依赖专门的成对（pair-centric）预训练阶段，限制了随单视图基础模型进展而扩展的能力。
AI.method: 基于两个关键发现：单视图视觉基础模型内部的查询-键投影编码了粗粒度但可复用的跨视图匹配先验；以跨注意力形式复用这些预训练投影可为ViT匹配器提供有效初始化。据此，FAST以标准单视图基础模型为骨架，采用零参数重连策略将选定的自注意力层转换为跨注意力以进行跨视图交互，从而免除专门的成对预训练阶段；并构建了覆盖多样共视图像对的600万对训练语料，用于通用稠密2D位移估计。
AI.result: 在广泛的对应匹配基准上达到state-of-the-art性能；并且在骨干网络规模和训练数据规模两个维度均表现出良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 单视图基础模型的注意力投影可作为可复用的跨视图匹配先验，通过零参数重连即可将ViT匹配器接入单视图基础模型的扩展红利，为可扩展的稠密对应估计提供了一条无需成对预训练的有效路径。

title: Determining Vertical Displacement of Agricultural Areas Using UAV-Photogrammetry and a Heteroscedastic Deep Learning Model
summary: This article introduces an algorithm that uses a U-Net architecture to determine vertical ground surface displacements from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-photogrammetry point clouds, offering an alternative to traditional ground filtering methods. Unlike con-ventional ground filters that rely on point cloud classification, the proposed approach em-ploys heteroscedastic regression. The U-Net model predicts the conditional expected val-ues of the elevation corrections, aiming to reduce the impact of vegetation on determined ground surface elevations. Concurrently, it estimates the logarithm of the elevation cor-rection variance, allowing for direct quantification of the uncertainty associated with each elevation correction value. The algorithm was evaluated using three metrics: the root mean square error (RMSE) of vertical displacements, the percentage of nodes with deter-mined displacement values, and the percentage of outliers among those values. Perfor-mance was assessed using the technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal so-lution (TOPSIS) method and compared against several ground-filter-based algorithms across four datasets, each including at least two time intervals. In most cases, the U-Net-based approach demonstrated a slight performance advantage over traditional ground filtering techniques. For example, for the U-Net-based algorithm, for one of the test da-tasets, the RMSE of the determined subsidences was 6.1 cm, the percentage of nodes with determined subsidences was 80.5%, and the percentage of outliers was 0.2%. For the same case, the algorithm based on the next best model (SMRF) allowed an RMSE of 7.7 cm to be obtained; for 77.3% of nodes, the subsidences were determined; and the percentage of outliers was 0.3%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于U-Net的异方差回归算法，从UAV摄影测量点云直接确定垂直地表位移，可替代传统地面滤波方法，并在多数情况下性能略优。
AI.motivation: 传统地面滤波方法依赖点云分类，植被会影响地表高程确定精度，且难以直接量化高程修正的不确定性。
AI.method: 采用U-Net架构进行异方差回归：模型预测高程修正量的条件期望值以降低植被影响，同时估计高程修正方差的对数，从而直接量化每个高程修正值的不确定性。使用RMSE、确定位移节点百分比和异常值百分比三项指标评估，并通过TOPSIS方法在四个数据集（每个至少含两个时间间隔）上与多种基于地面滤波的算法进行比较。
AI.result: 多数情况下U-Net方法略优于传统地面滤波。某测试数据集中，U-Net的沉降RMSE为6.1 cm，确定沉降节点百分比为80.5%，异常值百分比为0.2%；同一案例下次优模型SMRF的RMSE为7.7 cm，确定沉降节点百分比为77.3%，异常值百分比为0.3%。
AI.conclusion: U-Net异方差回归能有效替代传统地面滤波，在垂直位移确定中兼具精度与不确定性量化优势。

title: Seeing as Humans Do: Learning from Motion to Segment Anything Without Supervision
comment: Published at ECCV 2026. Includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/360CVGroup/MoSA
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) relies heavily on massive manual annotations, creating a fundamental bottleneck for model scaling. While unsupervised methods attempt to learn object concepts from motion, they typically overfit to moving entities, lacking both multi-granularity understanding and the ability to generalize to static objects. To overcome this, we introduce Motion-Grounded Segment Anything (MoSA), a highly scalable unsupervised framework that learns a transferable objectness prior from unlabeled videos. MoSA operates in three progressive stages: (1) automatically generating multi-granularity motion pseudo-labels from large-scale video data; (2) training a Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM) via contrastive learning to internalize a generalized, appearance-driven concept of objects; and (3) transferring this learned prior into a prompt-guided architecture for segment-anything-style inference on images. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven challenging benchmarks (e.g., COCO and ADE20K) demonstrate that MoSA significantly outperforms existing unsupervised methods. Notably, despite using zero manual annotations, MoSA achieves segmentation performance comparable to the fully supervised SAM. Our findings reveal that harnessing large-scale unlabeled motion is a feasible and highly scalable alternative to annotation-driven segment-anything pipelines.

AI.tldr: MoSA：一种从无标注视频中学习可迁移物体先验的高可扩展无监督分割框架，通过三阶段流程实现零样本分割，性能可与全监督SAM媲美。
AI.motivation: SAM依赖海量人工标注，构成模型规模化的根本瓶颈；现有无监督方法从运动学习物体概念时易过拟合于运动实体，缺乏多粒度理解且难以泛化到静态物体。
AI.method: MoSA分三阶段：（1）从大规模视频数据自动生成多粒度运动伪标签；（2）通过对比学习训练感知分组模型（PGM），内化泛化的、由外观驱动的物体概念；（3）将学到的先验迁移至提示引导架构，实现图像上的segment-anything式推理。
AI.result: 在七个挑战性基准（如COCO、ADE20K）上的广泛零样本评估表明，MoSA显著优于现有无监督方法；在零人工标注条件下，其分割性能与全监督SAM相当。
AI.conclusion: 利用大规模无标注运动是替代标注驱动segment-anything流程的可行且高可扩展方案。

title: Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}.
