It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: Optimus-R：一种以记忆为中心的VLA框架，将机器人适配建模为显式的查询-技能记忆调优，避免参数微调带来的高成本与灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在适配新任务/新域时依赖参数调优，成本高且易导致对已学任务的灾难性遗忘，需更高效的适配范式。
AI.method: 提出Optimus-R框架，含三部分：(i) 内联记忆接口用于技能抽取，将可学习记忆token插入VLA前缀流，使主干在原生动作条件路径中生成控制感知的查询与技能表示；(ii) 查询-技能记忆库用于技能学习，将技能外化为“查询原型”（决定检索什么）与“技能值”（指定如何动作），支持技能复用与扩展；(iii) 轻量Bridge-and-Adapt机制用于技能更新，通过轻量适配器与残差记忆更新对齐目标域查询/技能与现有记忆空间。
AI.result: 在域内适配、跨域适配与终身学习实验中，Optimus-R实现了数据高效的技能学习，并缓解了灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆为中心的显式查询-技能调优为VLA机器人适配提供了高效、可扩展且抗遗忘的替代方案，优于传统参数调优路径。

title: P-SRM: Selective Recovery of Rejected Predictions in Visual Tracking
summary: Many visual tracking methods use rejection mechanisms to suppress unreliable predictions. However, these mechanisms can also reject correctly localized candidates, leaving useful information unused. We investigate how to identify and recover these candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates. To this end, we propose P-SRM (Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method), which combines spatial responses, past accepted states, and native decision margins to reassess candidates and selectively restore reliable predictions. We evaluate P-SRM on six trackers and four datasets spanning category-specific, point, and generic object tracking. Across all nine configurations, P-SRM improves rejected-candidate ranking and overall tracking performance. These results show that post-rejection verification can identify and recover useful predictions discarded by native rejection, demonstrating the value of reusing rejected information. Project repository: https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出后拒绝选择性恢复方法P-SRM，在保留原有接受输出与候选坐标的前提下，利用空间响应、历史接受状态和原始决策边界重新评估被拒绝候选，从而识别并恢复其中有用的可靠预测。
AI.motivation: 视觉跟踪中的拒绝机制虽能抑制不可靠预测，但也会误拒定位正确的候选，导致有用信息被浪费。作者希望在不改变原有接受输出和候选坐标的情况下，识别并恢复这些被错误拒绝的有效候选。
AI.method: 提出P-SRM（Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method），结合三类信息对被拒绝候选重新评估：空间响应、过去的接受状态、以及原生决策边界（decision margins），据此选择性地恢复可靠预测。
AI.result: 在六种跟踪器和四个数据集（涵盖类别特定、点和通用目标跟踪）上评估，共九种配置下P-SRM均改善了被拒绝候选的排序与整体跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 后拒绝验证能够识别并恢复被原生拒绝机制丢弃的有用预测，表明复用被拒绝信息具有实际价值。

title: Spherical Interpolation for Backward-Compatible Multimodal Representations
summary: Contrastive vision-language models map visual and textual representations into a shared normalized embedding space, making cosine similarity the natural metric for cross-modal retrieval. A practical challenge arises during model upgrades: independently trained models generally produce incompatible representation spaces, so replacing a deployed model typically requires recomputing embeddings for the entire gallery, which is prohibitively expensive at scale. Orthogonal post-hoc alignment can partially mitigate this problem by mapping new-model queries into the old-model gallery space. However, because independently trained models can differ in fine-grained representation structure, the orthogonal alignment remains approximate, leaving a residual angular discrepancy between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query. We study whether interpolation along the spherical geodesic between these two normalized query representations can improve retrieval without re-indexing the gallery. We characterize when this path contains an interior query direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this characterization to Recall@$K$ through a local margin-based certification result. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model families show that post-alignment spherical interpolation improves over orthogonal alignment alone, recovering backward-compatibility in most evaluated settings. Consistent with our geometric characterization, per-query oracle analysis shows that retrieval-favorable interior points occur frequently in practice. Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility .

AI.tldr: 研究在模型升级后，通过对新旧模型查询表示之间的球面测地线进行插值（球面线性插值），在不重建图库索引的前提下改善跨模态检索的向后兼容性。
AI.motivation: 对比视觉-语言模型将图像和文本映射到同一归一化嵌入空间，余弦相似度是跨模态检索的自然度量。但独立训练的模型表示空间互不兼容，升级部署模型时通常需重算整个图库的嵌入，规模大时代价高昂。事后正交对齐虽可将新模型查询映射到旧模型图库空间，但因两模型细粒度结构差异，仍存在残余角度偏差，对齐是近似的。
AI.method: 将旧模型查询表示与新模型查询经正交对齐后的表示视为单位球面上的两点，沿其球面测地线做插值（SLERP），得到介于两端点之间的查询方向。理论刻画该路径何时存在比两端点更接近"检索最优方向"的内部点，并通过局部基于间隔（margin）的认证结果将这一几何刻画与 Recall@K 联系起来。在多个基准和模型族上实验，并做逐查询 oracle 分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，对齐后的球面插值优于单独的正交对齐，在多数评估设置中恢复了向后兼容性。per-query oracle 分析显示，检索有利的内部控制点在实践中频繁出现，与几何刻画一致。
AI.conclusion: 沿球面测地线插值是提升模型升级向后兼容性的有效且低成本的事后方法，无需重建图库嵌入；其有效性由几何刻画和间隔认证理论支撑，代码已开源。

title: DyRAD: Radar Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Reconstructing dynamic driving scenes from recorded sensor data supports closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems by synthesizing observations beyond the original trajectory. Unlike cameras and LiDAR, radar measures radial velocity directly through Doppler. Yet existing radar novel-view synthesis fails to exploit this capability: methods addressing dynamic scenes reconstruct only range-azimuth tensors, while methods that render Doppler assume static scenes. Moreover, because radar processing spreads each reflection across multiple bins, existing representations absorb this spread into scene geometry, causing it to render incorrectly when the viewpoint moves. We present DyRAD, which models dynamic driving scenes using static background reflectors and motion-tracked dynamic point reflectors to render complete range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) tensors. Reflector velocities are derived from object tracks and projected onto the line of sight, making Doppler both a rendered output and supervision for those tracks. Crucially, we render reflectors through a fixed analytic point-spread function (PSF) derived from the radar's signal-processing chain, preventing sensor-induced spread from being baked into the scene representation. Beyond improving scene reconstruction, this separation also enables zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer, allowing the same reconstructed scene to be rendered under different radar specifications without refitting. We evaluate DyRAD on RADIal, Boreas, and a synthetic benchmark across both on-path poses and displaced viewpoints untested by prior work. On RADIal, DyRAD recovers radar detections in 90.7% of reference-detected objects, compared with 26.9% for the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: DyRAD：用静态背景+运动点反射体建模动态驾驶场景，渲染完整RAD张量，借助固定解析PSF避免传感器扩散混入几何，并支持零样本雷达配置迁移。
AI.motivation: 雷达可通过多普勒直接测径向速度，但现有雷达新视角合成未充分利用：动态场景方法仅重建距离-方位张量，渲染多普勒的方法又假设静态场景。此外，雷达处理会将每个反射扩散到多个bin，已有表示把这种扩散吸收进场景几何，导致视角移动时渲染错误。
AI.method: 提出DyRAD，用静态背景反射体与运动跟踪的动态点反射体建模动态驾驶场景，渲染完整距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）张量。反射体速度由目标轨迹导出并投影到视线方向，使多普勒既作为渲染输出，也作为轨迹监督。关键是通过由雷达信号处理链导出的固定解析点扩散函数（PSF）渲染反射体，防止传感器导致的扩散被烘焙进场景表示。
AI.result: 在RADIal、Boreas及合成基准上评估，覆盖原始路径位姿与先前工作未测试的偏移视角。在RADIal上，DyRAD对参考检测目标的雷达检测恢复率为90.7%，最强基线为26.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将传感器扩散与场景几何分离不仅提升场景重建，还实现零样本传感器配置迁移，使同一重建场景可在不同雷达规格下渲染而无需重新拟合。

title: Hyperspectral Image Models: Technical Report
comment: Documentation and benchmark library for hyperspectral image models
summary: Hyperspectral remote sensing has advanced across diverse deep learning paradigms, including spectral spatial CNNs, Vision Transformers, Mamba, graph neural networks, Kolmogorov Arnold networks, and self supervised masked autoencoding. Yet progress remains hindered by fragmented repositories, incompatible tensor conventions, and non standardized evaluation. Hyperspectral Image Models addresses these challenges through a modular framework unifying 55 representative models across six paradigms with a common registry, automatic 4D/5D tensor adaptation, and standardized constructors. It integrates 24 benchmark scenes from Airborne, Spaceborne, UAV, and Mars CRISM sensors, with caching, label remapping, PCA, explicit band selection or raw spectra, optional spatial max pooling, and arbitrary PxP patch extraction. To prevent inflated accuracy from overlapping windows, it supports class balanced random partitioning and spatially disjoint regional blocking with Chebyshev guard bands that eliminate train test pixel overlap. Experiments use a single config.yaml with deterministic seeds and complete provenance, generating LaTeX benchmark tables and classification maps. Across 1,320 model scene evaluations and 6,600 seeded runs, scene difficulty dominates architecture, with mean accuracy ranging from 96.40% on Botswana to 56.70% on Houston 2018, versus a 15 point spread across paradigm means. No paradigm universally dominates, while sub 1 M parameter models can match architectures two orders of magnitude larger. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tanishq251/Hyperspectral-Image-Models.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出Hyperspectral Image Models模块化框架，统一55个高光谱图像模型（六类范式）、24个基准场景，并提供标准化张量适配、数据集构造与无重叠划分评测流程，开源代码。
AI.motivation: 高光谱遥感深度学习模型众多（光谱-空间CNN、ViT、Mamba、GNN、KAN、自监督掩码自编码等），但研究进展受限于代码库碎片化、张量约定不兼容以及评测非标准化，导致结果难以复现与公平比较。
AI.method: 构建统一注册表整合六类范式共55个代表性模型，提供从4D/5D张量自动适配与标准化构造器；集成Airborne、Spaceborne、UAV、Mars CRISM四类传感器的24个基准场景，支持缓存、标签重映射、PCA、显式波段选择或原始光谱、可选空间最大池化及任意P×P块提取；采用类别均衡随机划分与空间不相交区域分块（Chebyshev保护带）消除训练-测试像素重叠；实验通过单一config.yaml、确定性种子与完整溯源，自动生成LaTeX基准表与分类图。
AI.result: 完成1,320次模型-场景评测与6,600次带种子运行；场景难度主导架构表现，平均精度从Botswana的96.40%到Houston 2018的56.70%，而范式均值差异仅约15个百分点；无任何范式全面占优，且参数小于1M的模型可媲美参数量高两个数量级的架构。
AI.conclusion: 标准化、模块化的统一框架能有效消除高光谱图像模型评测中的工程与协议偏差；实证表明数据集/场景特性比架构范式更能决定性能，模型规模并非性能的可靠代理，未来研究应重视基准场景与严格空间划分。

title: Grounding with Confidence: Controllable Generative Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding supports applications such as video search, content review, and automated editing by localizing events described in natural language. Yet existing generative models typically output timestamps without explicit interval-level confidence scores to guide candidate selection. We separate candidate generation from acceptance by scoring individual intervals within the original decoding pass. A lightweight confidence head reads pooled decoder states, providing an explicit score trained for interval selection. Offline verifier scores supervise the head on fixed candidate sequences, and temporal-overlap labels adapt it to current rollouts during reinforcement learning. GT-anchored candidate-pool supervision and set-level optimization train the generator. The resulting scores support ranking, threshold-based selection, and rejection without invoking an external verifier at inference. On a fixed OMTG-Bench candidate pool, confidence raises query-macro Recall@0.5 from 9.95% to 14.42% over generation order at a 10% global return budget, and from 26.48% to 31.12% at a 25% budget. The continuous scores let downstream applications adjust return budgets or acceptance thresholds to match their precision-recall preferences, without regenerating candidate intervals.

AI.tldr: 该论文在生成式视频时序定位中引入轻量级置信度头，为每个候选区间提供显式分数，实现候选生成与接受的解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式模型输出时间戳时缺乏区间级的显式置信度分数，无法有效指导候选区间的筛选与接受。
AI.method: 将候选生成与接受分离，在原始解码过程中对单个区间打分：轻量级置信度头读取池化解码器状态，用离线验证器分数在固定候选序列上监督，并通过时序重叠标签在强化学习中适配当前 rollout；采用 GT 锚定候选池监督与集合级优化训练生成器。
AI.result: 在固定 OMTG-Bench 候选池上，10% 全局返回预算下 query-macro Recall@0.5 从 9.95% 提升至 14.42%，25% 预算下从 26.48% 提升至 31.12%。
AI.conclusion: 连续置信度分数支持排序、阈值选择与拒绝，推理时无需外部验证器；下游应用可灵活调整返回预算或接受阈值以匹配精度-召回偏好，无需重新生成候选区间。

title: Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network for Screen Content Video Quality Enhancement
summary: Different from natural videos, Screen Content Videos (SCVs) are characterized by abrupt motion, scene switches, and high-frequency details such as text and graphics. Conventional video enhancement methods, which rely heavily on temporal continuity, often suffer from performance degradation when processing SCVs due to the disruption of temporal correlations. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network (STM-Net), a novel framework specifically tailored for compressed SCV enhancement. Our approach integrates three complementary components: a Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD) that routes input into three parallel streams to avoid feature contamination, a Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE) module that adaptively handles abrupt transitions without explicit detection, and a Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD) module that preserves critical high-frequency details. Experimental results demonstrate that STM-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both objective metrics and subjective visual quality, providing a robust solution for screen content artifacts. Code is available at https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STM-Net，一个针对压缩屏幕内容视频（SCV）增强的时空多尺度网络框架，通过三个互补模块应对 SCV 的突变运动和细节损失问题，实验证明其优于现有 SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 屏幕内容视频（SCV）具有突变运动、场景切换以及文本和图形等高频率细节的特征，与自然视频差异显著。传统视频增强方法高度依赖时间连续性，在处理 SCV 时因时间相关性被破坏而性能下降。因此需要一种专门针对压缩 SCV 增强的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network（STM-Net）框架，包含三个组件：(1) Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher（PG-STD）：将输入路由到三条并行流，避免特征污染；(2) Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction（BTFE）模块：无需显式检测即可自适应处理突变过渡；(3) Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation（CMFD）模块：保留关键高频细节。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，STM-Net 在客观指标和主观视觉质量两方面均优于当前最先进（SOTA）方法，为屏幕内容伪影问题提供了鲁棒的解决方案。代码已开源：https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net。
AI.conclusion: STM-Net 通过分流路由、双向时序建模与多尺度特征蒸馏的协同设计，有效解决了 SCV 时间相关性破坏与高频细节丢失问题，在压缩屏幕内容视频增强任务中取得了优于 SOTA 的性能。

title: Learning Where to Look: Anatomical Grounding and Guided Attention for Cardiac MRI Vision-Language Models
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) enables assessment of cardiac anatomy, ventricular function, and myocardial tissue characteristics. Clinicians interpret these images by identifying cardiac structures and focusing on the regions relevant to each clinical question, motivating anatomically guided vision-language models (VLMs). Yet CMR-specific supervision for anatomical localisation and clinical question answering remains limited. To address this gap, we investigate fine-grained CMR visual question answering through anatomical grounding and guided attention. We construct 128,915 anatomical-grounding and 42,799 clinical QA pairs across short-axis cine, late gadolinium enhancement, and long-axis cine. These datasets support anatomical recognition, localisation, and clinical assessment without requiring paired reports for individual training images. To help the model learn where to look, we introduce Cardiac Anatomy-Routed Attention (CARA), which selects predicted anatomical priors according to the question and guides decoder attention with learned task-specific strengths. Combining anatomical grounding pretraining with CARA yields our model, CARA-VL. Experiments demonstrate CARA-VL's strengths in clinical assessment and regional localisation across CMR imaging settings, with promising generalization to an external clinical cohort. Together, our data and method provide a practical framework for studying and advancing cardiac visual understanding in VLMs. We will release the QA data derived from public datasets upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了大规模心脏磁共振（CMR）解剖定位与临床问答数据集，并提出Cardiac Anatomy-Routed Attention（CARA）机制，实现解剖先验引导的视觉语言模型CARA-VL，在临床评估与区域定位任务上表现优异并具外部泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有CMR视觉语言模型缺乏针对解剖定位与临床问答的细粒度监督，难以实现解剖引导的视觉理解。
AI.method: 构建128,915个解剖定位对与42,799个临床QA对（覆盖短轴cine、延迟钆增强、长轴cine）；提出CARA机制，按问题选择预测的解剖先验，并以学习的任务特定强度引导解码器注意力；结合解剖定位预训练形成CARA-VL。
AI.result: 在多种CMR成像设置下，CARA-VL在临床评估与区域定位方面表现突出，并在外部临床队列中展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该数据与方法为研究并推进VLM的心脏视觉理解提供了实用框架，相关QA数据将于发表后公开。

title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic VLN 框架，通过 Goal/Verify/Memory/Visuomotor 四个智能体实现自适应目标设定、动态验证与多模态历史压缩，兼顾长程一致性并降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体做视觉语言导航时，选择局部可行动作无法保证长程任务中执行与预期路线一致；且不断累积的交互历史会增大后续决策输入，导致推理开销显著。
AI.method: 框架包含四个智能体：Goal Agent 依据指令、当前观测与执行历史设定自适应局部目标；Visuomotor Agent 执行动作以达成目标；Verify Agent 用针对具体目标的验证问题动态判断观测结果是否满足完成条件；Memory Agent 在目标完成验证后以此为边界压缩对应的多模态交互历史，同时保留后续导航所需信息。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上评估导航性能，在三种模型骨干上检验框架变体，并研究执行过程中的上下文演化；真实世界中在八条挑战性路线上各评测三次，达到 83.3% 成功率与 1.51 m 导航误差。
AI.conclusion: 验证式自适应目标与基于目标边界的记忆压缩能有效提升长程 VLN 的路线一致性与执行效率，并在仿真与真实环境中取得良好表现。

title: MCD: Causal Distillation of Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet this ability degrades substantially as model size decreases. Knowledge distillation offers a natural way to bridge this gap, but existing methods primarily align output distributions or hidden representations directly. Such alignment teaches the student what the teacher predicts without revealing which evidence in the complex context causally supports that prediction. Consequently, a student can imitate the teacher's answer while continuing to rely on language priors, prompt structure, or other spurious cues. To address this limitation, we introduce Multimodal Causal Distillation (MCD), a distillation framework that transfers how a strong teacher uses multimodal evidence during ICL. MCD uses structure-preserving token interventions to identify and verify causal evidence, then transfers how the teacher responds when that evidence is retained or removed. This design connects distillation to the causal patterns by which the model uses contextual evidence during multimodal ICL. Experiments across three LVLM families and seven benchmarks show that MCD improves student performance by 7.23 points on average and outperforms vanilla distillation by 4.68 points, while further analyses confirm the generalizability of these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态因果蒸馏（MCD）框架，通过结构保持的token干预识别因果证据，并迁移教师模型在证据保留/移除时的响应方式，使小模型在LVLM多模态上下文学习中获得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型具备强多模态上下文学习能力，但该能力随模型规模缩小而显著下降。现有知识蒸馏方法主要直接对齐输出分布或隐层表示，只教学生"教师预测什么"，未揭示上下文中哪些证据因果地支撑该预测。因此学生可能模仿答案却仍依赖语言先验、提示结构等虚假线索。
AI.method: 提出多模态因果蒸馏（MCD）。采用结构保持的token干预（structure-preserving token interventions）识别并验证因果证据；随后迁移教师在证据被保留或移除时的响应方式，将蒸馏与模型在多模态ICL中使用上下文证据的因果模式相连接。
AI.result: 在三个LVLM系列和七个基准上实验，MCD平均提升学生性能7.23分，比普通蒸馏高4.68分，进一步分析验证了增益的可泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过迁移教师利用多模态证据的因果过程而非仅对齐输出，MCD有效缓解小模型多模态ICL能力退化，性能显著优于传统蒸馏，且具有良好泛化性。

title: CoVisco: Codec-Native Vision Encoder with Native Token Compression for Unified Image-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models face a fundamental scaling bottleneck: the number of visual tokens grows with both temporal duration and spatial resolution, making long-video understanding expensive for the vision encoder and the language model. Existing methods often compress visual tokens after dense encoding, creating a mismatch between the representation used during training and the compact interface required at deployment. We present CoVisco, a codec-native vision encoder with native token compression for unified image-video understanding. By combining codec-native input support with segmented attention, CoVisco can encode long visual inputs in a single forward pass without forming dense patch-to-patch interactions across all frames. Each temporal segment is equipped with learnable abstract tokens that learn a compact segment-level representation, while fine-grained patch tokens remain available throughout the encoder. Alternating intra-segment and abstract-communication layers preserve video-level context through the abstract-token channel. A lightweight selector further exposes either abstract tokens alone or abstract tokens augmented with a runtime-selected subset of patch tokens, yielding a compact visual interface that reduces the visual context and prefill burden of downstream MLLMs while retaining fine-grained evidence when needed. Pretrained with contrastive objectives on 565M image--text pairs and 6.4M videos, CoVisco shows competitive performance on video-oriented embedding and multimodal understanding benchmarks. In the evaluated four-segment, 64-frame setting, abstract-only inference uses only 400 visual tokens while achieving video-understanding performance close to, and on some benchmarks exceeding, OneVision-Encoder. Selected patch tokens further improve fine-grained video reasoning. Project URL: https://github.com/ernie-research/CoVisco.git

AI.tldr: 提出 CoVisco——一种原生支持 token 压缩的编码器（codec-native vision encoder），通过分段注意力与可学习抽象 token 实现单次前向编码长视频，抽象 token 单独推理仅 400 视觉 token 即可达到接近甚至超越 OneVision-Encoder 的视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 数量随时长与空间分辨率增长，长视频理解对视编码器与语言模型造成高昂开销；现有方法多在稠密编码后再压缩，导致训练表示与部署所需紧凑接口之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: 1) codec-native 输入支持 + 分段注意力（segmented attention），无需在所有帧间构建稠密 patch-to-patch 交互即可单次前向编码长视觉输入；2) 每个时间片段配备可学习抽象 token，学习片段级紧凑表示，同时全编码器保留细粒度 patch token；3) 交替的段内层与抽象通信层（intra-segment / abstract-communication），经抽象 token 通道保持视频级上下文；4) 轻量选择器（selector）在推理时输出仅抽象 token，或抽象 token 加运行时选定的部分 patch token，形成紧凑视觉接口；5) 在 565M 图文对与 6.4M 视频上以对比目标预训练。
AI.result: 在视频嵌入与多模态理解基准上具备竞争力；在四段、64 帧设置下，仅抽象 token 推理使用 400 个视觉 token，视频理解性能接近、部分基准超过 OneVision-Encoder；加入选定 patch token 可进一步提升细粒度视频推理。
AI.conclusion: CoVisco 通过编码器原生的 token 压缩与灵活接口，缓解了下游 MLLM 的视觉上下文与 prefill 负担，同时按需保留细粒度证据，为统一的图像-视频理解提供了高效方案。

title: Super-Resolving Unseen Hyperspectral Sensors at Any Scale via Spatial Operators
summary: Achieving cross-sensor generalization and arbitrary-scale reconstruction with a single model remains challenging in hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR). Although recent methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, applying them to new sensors or scales beyond the training range often requires additional data and computation to maintain reconstruction quality. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHSR, which predicts band-shared spatial operators rather than spectral values. Cross-Spectral Mapping (CSM) resamples inputs with any number of bands to fixed reference positions and predicts local operators with Gaussian supports. Continuous Operator-Field Reconstruction (COFR) composes these operators into a continuous field and applies them to all original bands for arbitrary-scale reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that operator prediction outperforms direct spectral-value prediction on all seven datasets. Trained solely on ARAD with only 0.538M parameters, OmniHSR outperforms all directly transferred baselines on six unseen datasets without target-domain training data or adaptation. Across twelve upsampling factors from $\times2$ to $\times48$, it improves average PSNR on Pavia U and Chikusei by 0.55 dB over the strongest baseline. It also surpasses baselines trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor and achieves up to $36\times$ faster inference. Our code will be publicly released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniHSR，通过预测波段共享空间算子而非光谱值，实现单模型跨传感器泛化与任意尺度高光谱超分辨。
AI.motivation: 高光谱超分辨中，单一模型难以同时实现跨传感器泛化与任意尺度重建；现有任意尺度方法迁移到新传感器或超出训练范围的尺度时，通常需额外数据与计算才能保持重建质量。
AI.method: OmniHSR预测波段共享的空间算子而非光谱值。跨光谱映射（CSM）将任意波段数的输入重采样到固定参考位置，并预测具有高斯支撑的局部算子；连续算子场重建（COFR）将这些算子组合为连续场，并作用于全部原始波段以完成任意尺度重建。
AI.result: 在全部七个数据集上，算子预测均优于直接光谱值预测。仅用ARAD训练、参数量仅0.538M的情况下，OmniHSR在六个未见数据集上无需目标域训练或自适应即超过所有直接迁移基线；在×2至×48共十二个上采样倍率下，Pavia U与Chikusei平均PSNR较最强基线提升0.55 dB，并超过目标传感器上从头训练或自适应的基线，推理速度最高快36倍。
AI.conclusion: 以算子预测替代光谱值预测是提升高光谱超分辨跨传感器泛化与任意尺度重建的有效范式，可在极小参数与无目标域数据条件下取得更优性能与效率。

title: Learning to Reason with Compressed Context: Ground-Truth-Free Adaptation of OmniLLMs via Self-Distillation
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) enable unified audio-video understanding, but their long multimodal token sequences make deployment computationally expensive. Token compression reduces this cost, yet aggressive compression often lowers accuracy. Existing works predominantly focus on designing better compression mechanisms; however, adapting the underlying language model to reason effectively over the remaining compressed context remains under-explored. To address this, we propose CAFD (Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation), a ground-truth-free self-distillation framework that adapts OmniLLMs to fixed compression pipelines without requiring reference answers, rationales, or correctness rewards. CAFD leverages the full-token view of the same multimodal sample as a source of privileged information: a full-context self-teacher provides soft target supervision to a compressed-context student along the student's on-policy trajectory. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B across five audio-video benchmarks, five compression pipelines, and five deployment budgets, CAFD demonstrates consistent gains, improving 120 out of 125 conditions with an average accuracy boost of 1.44 points and recovering 26.9% of the accuracy gap on average. These results demonstrate that the proposed ground-truth-free adaptation offers an effective and practical route to improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployed OmniLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CAFD，一种无需真值答案的自蒸馏框架，通过让压缩上下文的学生模型对齐全上下文自教师的软目标，提升 OmniLLM 在 token 压缩下的推理准确率。
AI.motivation: OmniLLM 的长多模态 token 序列导致部署成本高，token 压缩虽可降本但激进压缩会损失精度。现有工作主要聚焦于改进压缩机制，却忽视了让底层语言模型适应剩余压缩上下文并有效推理这一问题。
AI.method: CAFD（Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation）是一个无需真值的自蒸馏框架，无需参考答�、推理链或正确性奖励。它利用同一多模态样本的全 token 视图作为特权信息：全上下文自教师沿学生模型的 on-policy 轨迹，向压缩上下文学生提供软目标监督，从而将 OmniLLM 适配到固定压缩流水线。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上，跨 5 个音视频基准、5 种压缩流水线和 5 个部署预算进行评估，CAFD 在 125 个条件中 120 个取得提升，平均准确率提高 1.44 分，平均恢复 26.9% 的精度差距。
AI.conclusion: 该无真值适配方法为改善已部署 OmniLLM 的精度-效率权衡提供了一条有效且实用的途径。

title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
summary: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇关于4D场景重建的统一综述，围绕场景表示、时序建模、重建流程与优化目标组织现有方法，梳理数据集与评价指标，并指出实验实践局限与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 4D场景重建需从视觉观测恢复动态环境的演化几何、外观与运动。尽管神经场景表示取得进展，但非刚性运动、遮挡、时序不一致以及重建保真度与计算效率的权衡仍使动态场景重建充满挑战；同时NeRF与3DGS等方法的相互关系、设计选择与评价协议较为零散，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 提出统一的4D场景重建分析框架，按场景表示、时序建模策略、重建流程和优化目标对现有方法进行分类与比较，分析不同设计选择对几何保真度、外观一致性、运动表示和计算效率的影响；并整合常用数据集与评价指标。
AI.result: 通过统一框架揭示了不同设计选择如何影响几何、外观、运动与效率等关键性能；汇总了常用数据集和评价指标，识别了当前实验实践中的不足。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将方法发展与底层假设及评价证据相连接，为理解现有4D场景重建方法并提供未来研究方向提供了结构化基础，同时维护了一个持续更新的论文与资源集合。

title: Can We Anticipate Violence? Multimodal Learning from Pre-Incident Behavioral Cues
summary: Detecting violence after it begins is important from recognizing behavioral cues that appear immediately beforehand. This work studies short-horizon pre-incident risk recognition from multimodal video signals. We construct a binary Normal-versus-Risky setting from temporally annotated XD-Violence clips, using 443 samples with source-level separation across training, validation, and test sets. Each sample consists of a variable-length pre-incident clip, with its duration determined by the observable behavioral context preceding the incident. The inci- dent itself is excluded from all input clips. We evaluate three complementary information sources: facial-region appearance, temporally aligned audio, and body-motion features derived from tracked keypoints. Controlled ablations are performed with Swin-Tiny, ViT-Tiny, and DeiT-Tiny to measure the contribution of each modality under the same split. Results show that combining all modalities is more effective than using any other combination alone. The best configuration, Deit-Tiny with audio, facial appearance, and motion, achieves 91.21% accuracy, 88.96% balanced accuracy, 93.65% F1-score, and 96.38% ROC-AUC on the held-out test set. These results suggest that complementary appearance, acoustic, and kinematic cues provide useful evidence for recognizing elevated pre-incident risk.

AI.tldr: 该工作基于XD-Violence构建"正常 vs 风险"二分类任务，利用事件前的可变长度片段（不含事件本身），融合面部外观、音频与骨骼运动三模态信息，在DeiT-Tiny上取得91.21%准确率等最优结果。
AI.motivation: 事件发生后的暴力检测已有较多研究，但更具价值的是在事件发生前依据即时可见的行为线索进行短时域风险预警，而现有工作对事前多模态线索的系统性评估仍然不足。
AI.method: 从带时间标注的XD-Violence中抽取443个样本，按来源划分训练/验证/测试集以避免泄漏；每个样本为事件前可变长度片段（时长由可观测的行为上下文决定），删除事件本身。评估三类互补信息：面部区域外观、时间对齐音频、由追踪关键点导出的身体运动特征；在相同划分下用Swin-Tiny、ViT-Tiny、DeiT-Tiny进行受控消融，比较各模态及组合的贡献。
AI.result: 全模态融合优于任意其他组合；最佳配置为DeiT-Tiny结合音频、面部外观与运动，在留出测试集上达到91.21%准确率、88.96%平衡准确率、93.65% F1和96.38% ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: 外观、声学与运动学线索具有互补性，可为事前风险升高识别提供有效证据，支持面向事前预警的短时域多模态风险识别路线。

title: WARP: A Unified Benchmark for Invisible Image Watermarking -- Robustness and Protection Against Attacks
summary:
Digital image watermarking is increasingly critical in media contexts, as emerging regulations and industry practices require marking AI-generated content and ensuring traceable sources to prevent manipulation or misuse. Recent advances in invisible watermarking methods highlight the need to update existing benchmarking practices to reflect current techniques and evaluation criteria.
  We address this by introducing WARP -- a unified framework and benchmark for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks. WARP incorporates 32 recent classical, deep, and generative watermarking methods, as well as 34 different erasing techniques, ranging from traditional distortions to more sophisticated adversarial, purification, and re-embedding attacks. It provides standardized, reproducible, and easily scalable protocols for evaluating perceptual quality, watermark readability, and attack resilience.
  Using WARP, we extensively evaluate current invisible watermarking techniques, collecting the largest robustness benchmark in the field. Results identify the most robust approaches under both distortion and adversarial conditions, and reveal consistent relationships between watermarking methods and the attack strategies most effective against them. Our experiments also highlight that some of the watermarking methods considered are highly vulnerable to reembedding, even if they are robust to standard distortions. The code is made available at https://github.com/ispras/wibe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WARP——一个面向不可见水印鲁棒性评估的统一框架与基准，集成32种水印方法与34种擦除攻击，构建了该领域最大的鲁棒性基准。
AI.motivation: 随着法规与行业实践要求对AI生成内容进行标记并确保来源可追溯，数字图像水印愈发关键；而现有基准测试实践未能反映最新的水印技术与评估标准，亟需更新。
AI.method: WARP整合32种近期经典、深度及生成式水印方法，以及34种擦除技术（涵盖传统失真、对抗攻击、净化与重嵌入攻击），提供标准化、可复现、易扩展的协议，用于评估感知质量、水印可读性与抗攻击鲁棒性。
AI.result: 基于WARP对当前不可见水印技术进行了大规模评估，构建了领域内最大的鲁棒性基准；识别出在失真与对抗条件下最鲁棒的方法，揭示了水印方法与最有效攻击策略之间的稳定对应关系，并发现部分方法虽能抵抗标准失真，却对重嵌入攻击高度脆弱。
AI.conclusion: WARP为不可见水印鲁棒性评估提供了统一、可扩展的基准，揭示了方法—攻击间的规律与重嵌入脆弱性等关键问题，代码已开源。

title: Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian, a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 to 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features.

AI.tldr: Radian：在冻结视觉基础模型(VFM)的表示空间中引入对抗蒸馏，与on-policy DMD互补，改善少步自回归视频生成的质量与稳定性，训练后附加组件丢弃，不改变生成器结构与推理去噪预算。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频生成可实现高效流式合成，但早期时间块引入的误差会作为上下文被复用，随rollout传播，导致细节退化、结构漂移与运动不稳定。现有DMD主要在扩散潜空间对齐学生与教师分布，缺少对解码后视频感知质量的直接监督。
AI.method: 提出Radian表示空间对抗蒸馏框架：在冻结VFM定义的视觉特征空间中对on-policy DMD补充真实数据对抗监督。训练时对学生自回归rollout稀疏解码帧，提取多层级视觉表示，用轻量判别器头区分生成输出与真实视频帧。DMD目标将学生锚定到预训练教师，表示空间对抗目标提供感知与语义的互补梯度，促进高质量模式。附加组件在训练后丢弃，生成器架构与推理去噪预算不变。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-1.3B上覆盖四步分块、一步逐帧与分钟级自回归生成。四步生成下VBench Total为0.8444、VideoAlign Total为0.8033；相比Rolling Forcing将VBench-Long从0.7805提升至0.8041且去噪步数更少。在图像、视频与扩散表示上的受控对比表明，表示空间选择会诱导不同的对抗信号，外部VFM梯度比来自扩散内部特征的对抗监督更有效地补充DMD。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间对抗蒸馏可在不改变生成器架构与推理去噪预算的前提下，通过外部VFM特征的对抗监督补充DMD，提升少步自回归视频生成的感知质量、长视频一致性与稳定性，且表示空间的选择对对抗信号性质有显著影响。

title: CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities. Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy-tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters. During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations. Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition. Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model. Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy-tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出策略-工具协同进化框架，通过从VLM推理轨迹中蒸馏经验，联合进化高层策略与可执行媒体工具，形成可复用技能（无需更新模型参数），在超长视频时间定位中提升精度并降低视觉token开销，且可泛化到通用长视频QA。
AI.motivation: 超长视频时间定位需在有限视觉预算下平衡长程证据搜索与细粒度事件理解，而现有智能体方法仍主要依赖预定义策略与固定工具能力，缺乏自适应性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出策略-工具协同进化框架：在进化过程中，由外部技能更新器（skill updater）从VLM的智能体推理轨迹中蒸馏可迁移的长视频时间定位任务经验，据此优化长程图像观测与细粒度视频观测的编排策略；同时利用其编码能力升级现有工具或创建新工具以适配长视频证据获取。最终VLM在进化策略指导下自主编排工具，协同图像与视频观测完成推理，无需依赖更强的独立规划模型。
AI.result: 在5个基准、3种VLM上的大量实验表明：策略-工具协同进化持续提升超长视频时间定位精度，同时降低推理阶段视觉token成本；进化所得技能在无额外任务特定进化的情况下，对通用长视频QA亦有显著性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 策略-工具协同进化是一种有效且具泛化性的长视频理解框架，可在不更新模型参数的前提下形成可复用技能，兼顾精度、效率与跨任务迁移能力。

title: Less Data, Better Timing: Student-Curriculum Coupling for VLM On-Policy Distillation in Temporal Video Grounding
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student's current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. Supervision can therefore be activated, suspended, or reactivated as competence changes, concentrating teacher computation and optimization on current task-level deficits. Across three TVG benchmarks, SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD on its original curriculum, while using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%. Ablations support the complementary roles of capability-structured curriculum design and student-dependent supervision in achieving these gains. Together, these results establish SCC as a data- and compute-efficient framework for TVG post-training, delivering stronger temporal grounding by aligning trustworthy supervision with the student's evolving learning needs.

AI.tldr: 提出学生-课程耦合（SCC）闭环框架，让动态学生决定当前激活的监督子集，在三个TVG基准上以更少数据与算力取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时序视频定位（TVG）的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）训练课程由固定教师和初始学生状态构建，隐含假设所选样本在整个优化过程中始终具有正监督价值。作者指出监督可信度（目标是否可信）与监督必要性（是否契合学生当前任务能力）是不同但耦合的两个维度，二者共同决定监督价值，固定课程为此存在缺陷。
AI.method: 提出学生-课程耦合（SCC）闭环框架：由紧凑的Anchor-Frontier课程定义候选监督空间，演进中的学生动态决定其激活子集；监督可随能力变化被激活、暂停或重新激活，从而将教师计算与优化集中于当前任务级能力缺口。同时区分并耦合监督可信度与监督必要性两个维度。
AI.result: 在三个TVG基准上，SCC相较原始课程下的Video-OPD平均召回率相对提升5.1%，训练样本减少60.0%，训练时间减少50.4%；消融实验验证了能力结构课程设计与学生依赖监督的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: SCC是一个数据与算力高效的TVG后训练框架，通过将可信监督与学生的演进学习需求对齐，实现更强的时序定位性能。

title: LongEmo: Towards Emotion Understanding and Reasoning in Long Videos
summary: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in affective computing, their reasoning capabilities are largely confined to short video clips with limited interactions. However, real-world emotions are not merely isolated instantaneous reactions but dynamic and cumulative processes deeply shaped by past experiences and ongoing events. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongEmoBench, a benchmark dedicated to emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. It assesses progressive capabilities scaling from continuous scene interactions to complex episodic developments. Furthermore, we propose LongEmo, a novel memory-augmented agentic framework designed to tackle the immense challenges of long-range affective reasoning. LongEmo processes continuous video streams to construct an Event Memory Graph, explicitly modeling long-range dependencies and capturing emotional dynamics across discrete events. Given a question, the agent retrieves a query-relevant event stream from the graph, iteratively integrating multimodal memories and relational dependencies to deduce the final answer. Extensive evaluations of 17 representative methods reveal that they struggle significantly with emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. In contrast, LongEmo achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the efficacy of its event-centric memory architecture.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出长视频情感理解与推理基准LongEmoBench及记忆增强智能体框架LongEmo，通过事件记忆图建模长程情感动态，在17种代表性方法对比中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型的情感计算能力主要局限于短片段且交互有限，而真实情感是由过往经验与持续事件共同塑造的动态累积过程，二者之间存在显著差距，亟需面向长视频的情感理解与推理评测与建模方法。
AI.method: 提出LongEmoBench基准，从连续场景交互到复杂情节发展评测递进能力；并设计记忆增强智能体框架LongEmo，对连续视频流构建事件记忆图以显式建模长程依赖与离散事件间情感动态，给定问题后检索查询相关事件流，迭代整合多模态记忆与关系依赖以推理答案。
AI.result: 对17种代表性方法的广泛评测显示，现有方法在长视频情感理解与推理上表现明显不足；LongEmo达到最优性能，验证了事件中心记忆架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 长视频情感推理需要事件级的长期记忆机制，LongEmo的事件记忆图架构为长程情感理解提供了有效范式，并为该方向建立了新的评测基准。

title: GateSPINE: Gated Cross-View Fusion for Lumbar Spine MRI Report Generation
summary: Automated report generation can ease the burden radiolo gists face when interpreting multi-sequence MRI studies. Unlike CT, MRI examinations comprise multiple sequences and imaging planes, each con tributing complementary diagnostic information. Existing methods en code a study as a single volume and combine multiple acquisitions by fixed rules. Findings visible in only one plane are thus diluted and of ten missed, lowering recall on clinical efficacy metrics, where a missed abnormality is most costly. We propose GateSPINE, a vision-language framework that fuses sagittal T1 and T2 volumes with a training-free operator, encodes the fused sagittal and axial volumes with two parallel 3D encoders, and decodes their combined representation into a report. Its core mechanism is a gated cross view fusion module that predicts, per feature channel and token, how much of each view to admit, so the more informative view dominates at each spatial location. We evaluate GateSPINE on three lumbar MRI datasets, comprising two public bench marks and a private cohort collected from Phenikaa University Hospital, using both natural language generation (NLG) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. GateSPINE achieves the highest CE F1 through improved re call on all three datasets; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism, which is validated on the two cohorts with both imaging planes. GateSPINE also remains competitive on standard NLG metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出GateSPINE视觉-语言框架，通过免训练算子融合矢状位T1/T2，并用双3D编码器分别编码矢状与轴位体积，核心的门控跨视图融合模块按特征通道和token自适应决定各视图贡献，从而在腰椎MRI报告生成中提升临床效能指标。
AI.motivation: MRI检查包含多序列、多成像平面，各提供互补诊断信息；现有方法将检查编码为单一体积并用固定规则组合多次采集，导致仅在单一平面可见的病灶被稀释、常被漏检，降低临床效能指标中的召回率，而漏诊异常代价最高。
AI.method: GateSPINE：1）用免训练算子融合矢状位T1与T2体积；2）用两个并行3D编码器分别编码融合后的矢状位与轴位体积；3）将联合表示解码为报告。核心为门控跨视图融合模块，逐特征通道、逐token预测各视图的接纳程度，使信息量更大的视图在对应空间位置占主导。
AI.result: 在三个腰椎MRI数据集（两个公开基准与Phenikaa大学医院私有队列）上，用自然语言生成（NLG）与临床效能（CE）指标评估。GateSPINE在三个数据集上均取得最高CE F1，源于召回率提升；在无轴位序列的SPIDER上，该提升归因于矢状位融合组件而非门控跨视图机制，后者在两个同时具备两种成像平面的队列上得到验证。标准NLG指标上亦保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GateSPINE通过门控跨视图融合实现多平面MRI自适应信息整合，显著提高报告生成的临床效能（尤其是召回率），同时保持NLG指标竞争力，优于采用固定融合规则的现有方法。

title: VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning
summary: Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains. Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an $11.33\%$ relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.

AI.tldr: VR-JEPA通过对齐V-JEPA预测器与任务特定推理逻辑，用局部对比状态学习和技能专家引导视频生成，在VBVR-Pro-Bench上相对提升11.33%。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型缺乏关于潜在视觉状态应如何演化的显式引导，导致生成轨迹易出现物理与结构不一致，削弱推理可靠性；而V-JEPA虽提供丰富的时空先验，却不能自然适配复杂视觉任务所需的逻辑推理能力。
AI.method: 提出VR-JEPA框架：(i) 在同一输入条件下将成功轨迹与生成替代轨迹配对，利用其V-JEPA表示的差异识别信息量高的状态与token，进行局部对比监督；(ii) 为V-JEPA预测器配备在锚任务数据上训练的技能特定专家，使其共享时空先验跨认知域自适应特化；预测的潜在轨迹为视频生成提供任务特定逻辑引导。
AI.result: 在大型VBVR-Pro-Bench数据集上，VR-JEPA相较前沿的基于生成的推理基线取得11.33%的相对提升，显著减轻物理伪影并增强逻辑一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将V-JEPA预测器与任务特定推理逻辑对齐并以潜在轨迹引导视频生成，VR-JEPA有效提升了视频生成推理的物理与逻辑可靠性，为通向视觉智能提供了可行路径。

title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
summary: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, and retrievable memories. MemOpt consistently improves MemLife by 2.7--5.0% across different video and question distributions, with gains that generalize across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.

AI.tldr: 提出MemLife多模态记忆系统与MemOpt强化学习框架，解决长时第一人称视频检索的记忆保真与检索竞争问题，在四个长时基准上显著优于无训练基线。
AI.motivation: 长时自中心视频（数月乃至数百小时）若每次查询都重处理原始片段，计算代价过高；现有记忆系统将视频压缩为文本，但存在两类失效：记忆未保留关键证据，或检索器在增长的搜索空间中因检索竞争而定位失败。因此需要既保真又易检索的记忆构建与检索机制。
AI.method: MemLife：构建以实体为根基、第一人称视角的文本情节（entity-grounded, first-person text episodes），并采用时间索引的智能体式检索器（time-indexed agentic reader），无需训练、无需查询时访问视频。MemOpt：一个强化学习框架，优化记忆写入器（memory writer），使其产出忠实、信息丰富且可检索的记忆，可跨写入器与读取器骨干以及不同记忆系统泛化。
AI.result: MemLife 在四个长时基准上比最强无训练基线提升 4.6–12.0%。MemOpt 在不同视频与问题分布下持续提升 MemLife 2.7–5.0%，且增益可跨写入器/读取器骨干与记忆系统迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过实体根基的情节化文本记忆与时间索引智能体检索，可在不训练、不访问原始视频的条件下实现可扩展的长时自中心视频记忆；进一步以强化学习优化记忆写入器，可稳定提升记忆的忠实性、信息量与可检索性，并具备良好泛化性。

title: Recognition of Urbanized Areas in UAV-Derived Very-High-Resolution Visible-Light Imagery
summary: This study compared classifiers that differentiate between urbanized and non-urbanized areas based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-acquired RGB imagery. The tested solutions in-cluded numerous vegetation indices (VIs) thresholding and neural networks (NNs). The analysis was conducted for two study areas for which surveys were carried out using different UAVs and cameras. The ground sampling distances for the study areas were 10 mm and 15 mm, respectively. Reference classification was performed manually, obtaining approximately 24 million classified pix-els for the first area and approximately 3.8 million for the second. This research study included an analysis of the impact of the season on the threshold values for the tested VIs and the impact of image patch size provided as inputs for the NNs on classification accuracy. The results of the con-ducted research study indicate a higher classification accuracy using NNs (about 96%) compared with the best of the tested VIs, i.e., Excess Blue (about 87%). Due to the highly imbalanced nature of the used datasets (non-urbanized areas constitute approximately 87% of the total datasets), the Mat-thews correlation coefficient was also used to assess the correctness of the classification. The analysis based on statistical measures was supplemented with a qualitative assessment of the classification results, which allowed the identification of the most important sources of differences in classification between VIs thresholding and NNs.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了基于无人机RGB影像区分城市化与非城市化区域的分类器，包括多种植被指数阈值法和神经网络；结果表明神经网络精度约96%，优于最佳植被指数（Excess Blue，约87%）。
AI.motivation: 现有城市化区域与非城市化区域的分类研究多依赖卫星影像或单一数据集，缺乏对无人机RGB影像中植被指数阈值法与神经网络在不同季节、不同传感器条件下的系统对比与验证。
AI.method: 在两个研究区采集无人机RGB影像（地面采样距离分别为10 mm与15 mm），采用多种植被指数阈值化与神经网络进行分类对比；人工标注参考数据约2400万和380万像素；分析季节对植被指数阈值的影响及输入影像块尺寸对神经网络精度的影响，并使用马修斯相关系数评估类别高度不平衡（非城市化区域约占87%）条件下的分类正确性。
AI.result: 神经网络分类精度约96%，高于最佳植被指数Excess Blue的约87%；季节变化影响植被指数阈值取值，影像块尺寸影响神经网络分类精度；结合统计指标与定性评估识别出两类方法分类差异的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 在无人机RGB影像的城市化/非城市化分类任务中，神经网络总体优于植被指数阈值法，且需考虑季节与输入块尺寸的影响；在类别不平衡条件下应结合马修斯相关系数等指标进行综合评价。

title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作经验字典（AED），将历史动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入，支持跨任务技能复用与语义关联建模，并通过运动感知转移损失减少背景干扰，在仿真与真实跨本体任务中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）虽结合视觉动态预测与动作生成，但不显式支持跨操作任务的动作经验复用；同时冗余背景元素干扰关键视觉信息提取，使其难以捕捉可指导目标动作预测的跨任务语义关系。
AI.method: 提出AED，将历史动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入。先用预训练动作分词器聚合历史动作并与视觉观测对齐，从AED中检索动作嵌入；再通过交叉注意力对池化嵌入进行视觉条件化，并前置到噪声动作token，为目标预测提供交互上下文与动作意图；此外引入运动感知转移损失，在随机时间区间上监督视觉特征变化预测。
AI.result: 在仿真基准实验和真实世界跨本体（cross-embodiment）设置下验证了AED的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AED通过共享动作嵌入实现技能复用与跨任务语义关系建模，运动感知转移损失降低对无关背景线索的依赖，从而提升动作预测效果，具备仿真与真实跨本体场景的泛化能力。

title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://xiaji2021.github.io/LOCI/
summary: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.

AI.tldr: LOCI 是一种混合空间记忆架构，通过结合键值缓存与投影几何条件化的循环线性注意力记忆，在保持一致显存流式处理长视频的同时，更忠实地重建重访场景内容。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在相机重访已观测区域时应重现先前内容，这需要既能记忆历史观测，又能针对当前视角检索正确信息。键值缓存保留了视觉细节但随视频长度增长；循环记忆紧凑却将历史压缩为固定状态，导致单次过往观测无法直接检索。因此需要兼顾两种表示。
AI.method: 提出 LOCI 混合空间记忆架构。在一半 transformer 块中，主注意力保留过往观测的键值缓存；在另一半中，注意力被限制于当前块，并由循环线性注意力记忆补充，其读写均以投影相机几何为条件，使视角同时进入记忆寻址与存储内容。循环读出结果流入后续缓存支持的块，为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。
AI.result: 在公开 MIND 记忆基准与留存的录制轨迹上，LOCI 比重代表性世界模型及相同配方的全 softmax 模型更忠实地重现重访内容；在完整历史下，等长度时峰值显存较全 softmax 降低约 30%。在保留观测的有界记忆库下，它能以恒定显存流式处理长视频，并在相同预算下比全 softmax 更忠实。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合键值缓存与几何条件化的循环线性注意力记忆，LOCI 兼顾细节保留与紧凑表示，实现了长视频的恒定显存流式处理与更忠实的内容重现。

title: EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance
summary: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model's parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases \textit{perception under insufficient evidence} and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models. The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL. All code, models, and data are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"证据不足下的感知"问题，将视觉感知建模为可通过交互获取额外信息的智能体过程，构建了专用训练数据与基准，并训练出首个显式通过交互解决感知查询的感知智能体EviRover。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉感知被设定为对图像的单次前馈预测，假设图像内容与模型参数知识足以回答查询。但在现实场景中，当任务依赖细粒度视觉细节，或需要知识密集、最新的信息时，该假设往往失效，即"证据不足下的感知"。现有研究缺乏针对该设定所需的数据与基准。
AI.method: 1）设计两套专用数据生成流程，产出EviRover-SFT-5K与EviRover-RL-12K训练数据；2）构建EviLens——覆盖五类感知任务、共688个实例的人工验证基准；3）基于上述数据提出EviRover，采用监督微调（SFT）后接智能体强化学习（agentic RL）的两阶段训练范式，显式训练模型通过交互解决感知查询。
AI.result: 4B规模的EviRover在EviLens上平均超越其骨干模型30分，性能可与先进闭源模型相当。增益可迁移至WebEyes、常规感知基准及通用多模态基准，其中BrowseComp-VL提升15分。
AI.conclusion: 将感知形式化为可交互获取信息的智能体过程，能有效缓解单次快照假设的局限；EviRover作为首个显式训练用于交互式解决感知查询的感知智能体，验证了数据、基准与SFT+RL训练范式的有效性，且收益具备良好泛化性。代码、模型与数据均已开源。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
summary: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.

AI.tldr: 提出StreamRig，一种在冻结多视图3D基础模型上为标定多相机平台构建因果流式里程计的“冻结-流式”框架，仅训练74.6M参数模块，以相对位姿为监督，在四个数据集上实现更低漂移且低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人与车辆普遍搭载同步多相机平台，但多数流式3D基础模型面向单目输入，如何高效利用平台几何（标定信息）仍是难题。现有方案要么仅支持单目流式，要么是需完整信息的离线平台感知模型，难以兼顾效率与精度。
AI.method: 冻结多视图3D基础模型作为前端，联合感知同步视图并利用平台标定；Rig-Resampler压缩多视图特征，CausalBridge以因果注意力配合KV缓存，轻量头回归平台位姿；周期性重锚定协议保障长序列稳定。仅训练这些模块（共74.6M参数），以相对位姿为唯一监督。两阶段训练：组重定位预训练 + 因果平台训练，将冻结前端几何先验与预训练模块对齐能力迁移到流式里程计。
AI.result: 在NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360及自采集人形机器人数据集ZJH上评估，训练仅用仿真、真实世界为零样本。四个数据集上平移与旋转漂移均低于所比较的非oracle单目流式模型和平台感知离线模型，同时保持低推理成本；消融与受控相机数量实验揭示了性能增益来源，并考察了更长训练窗口对长时程推理的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结多视图基础模型并仅训练轻量流式模块，StreamRig有效利用多相机平台几何实现因果流式里程计，在跨数据集零样本评测中兼顾精度与效率，为平台感知流式定位提供了可行范式。

title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ComputerSD，一种面向计算机使用智能体（CUA）的在线自蒸馏方法，将GUI交互的实时反馈转化为策略学习指导，联合优化token级OPSD与轨迹级GRPO，在OSWorld-Verified上显著超越纯结果奖励的GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA在线训练方法主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，无法为中间动作提供监督信号。虽然在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）能通过特权重打分提供token级学习信号，但直接应用于CUA存在两个问题：一是固定指导可能与学生当前状态不匹配，二是指导引发的概率偏移可能与步骤级正确性冲突。
AI.method: 提出ComputerSD在线自蒸馏方法：由微调后的GUI分析器在每次动作后生成指导与步骤级价值分数，指导提供特权上下文，分数用于调节OPSD信号；在完全异步的训练框架中联合优化token级OPSD与轨迹级GRPO。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，ComputerSD在通用Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking和专用EvoCUA-8B骨干上分别比仅用结果奖励的GRPO高出1.9和4.1个百分点；分布外评估进一步验证了其泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了通过在线自蒸馏从实时反馈中学习对CUA的有效性。

title: Looped Diffusion Transformer
summary: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.

AI.tldr: 提出Looped Diffusion Transformer（Looped-DiT），通过在去噪步内重复运行共享Transformer块来增加计算深度而非参数量，配合中间循环深度监督与自调制注意力解决朴素循环的图像质量退化问题，260M模型可超越6.5倍大模型且推理算力降低4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 传统提升文本到图像模型性能依赖增大模型规模或增加去噪步数，计算成本高。作者希望探索一种替代性的算力扩展方式：在每个去噪步内重复运行共享Transformer块，以固定参数量换取计算深度增加，从而在内部表示上实现迭代细化。
AI.method: 分析发现朴素循环无法稳定提升图像质量，原因是中间循环监督薄弱、注意力更新不受约束导致局部信息被逐步侵蚀。为此提出Looped-DiT：结合跨中间循环的深度监督（deep supervision）与自调制注意力（self-modulating attention），以稳定循环特征更新。
AI.result: 在匹敌参数量与匹敌计算量的设定下，Looped-DiT持续优于非循环基线。260M参数的循环模型在多个文本到图像基准上超越大6.5倍的模型，同时推理计算量低4.9倍。此外，循环深度增加带来的收益大于在同一下推理预算下增加去噪步数；更深循环能逐步纠正早期循环的错误，表现出潜在推理（latent reasoning）特征。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算为扩散模型提供了一种更有效的迭代计算形式，是扩展视觉生成模型的一种有前景的途径。

title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://github.com/lzk901372/glare
summary: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对双人对话中倾听者反应生成这一被忽视的问题，构建了细粒度反应标注数据集，提出音频驱动的流匹配基线GLARE及面向反应的评估协议，在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有说话头生成进展迅速，但双人对话中倾听者行为（何时反应、如何反应、反应类型）的生成仍研究不足。其瓶颈在于：现有双人数据集缺乏细粒度的倾听者反应标注；沿用的评估指标继承自说话头与视频生成任务，只衡量视觉真实感，无法判断倾听者反应是否恰当。
AI.method: 从三方面展开：(1) 数据集：基于RealTalk与Seamless Interaction构建倾听头专用数据集，约147小时成对说话者-倾听者视频，含64,557条事件级反应标注，涵盖点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉、惊讶六类；(2) 模型：提出音频驱动基线GLARE，基于流匹配Transformer，采用Qwen2-Audio提取韵律条件，并引入时间反应损失对逐帧反应进行显式监督；(3) 评估：提出面向反应的评估协议，联合衡量反应发生（R-F1）、时间对齐（R-tIoU）、非对称时间偏差（R-ATD）与反应区域视觉质量（R-FID）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GLARE在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均相较先前的倾听头方法取得一致性提升，说明反应感知的数据、建模与评估对自然倾听行为的生成至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该工作指出反应感知的数据、建模与评估是生成自然倾听行为的关键，为双人对话中倾听者行为生成提供了数据、基线与评估三方面的支撑。

title: Atomizer-IO: Beyond Pixels, Patches and Grids
summary: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出 Atomizer-IO：以"观测原子"为接口、从物理关系推导结构的视觉架构，摆脱网格假设，可泛化到遥感多模态与无序点云。
AI.motivation: 主流视觉架构默认观测位于规则网格上，这对自然图像有效，但对通道、时间采样、空间分辨率和几何结构均可变的传感数据过于受限；而通用集合式架构虽去除网格，却同时丧失了有用的空间归纳偏置。
AI.method: 基于数据原子化表示：每个观测由其测量值与采集元数据（metadata）描述；采用局部交叉注意力将观测映射到可任意放置的锚点（anchor points），从而由观测间的物理关系推导结构，而非依赖预定义网格。
AI.result: 通过逐步放松网格假设（变化的栅格配置、不完整通道集、灵活输出密度、直至无栅格输入）进行评测：在多数任务上与灵活的遥感（EO）专用架构相当，并提供训练后对推理成本的控制和有竞争力的算力—性能权衡；同一形式无需架构重设计即可扩展到无序 3D 点云。
AI.conclusion: 像素、图块与网格不必成为传感架构的接口定义；以观测为中心、原子化且带元数据的接口是一种更通用、可跨模态泛化的建模范式。

title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
summary: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MatLoom，一种面向文本到材质生成的紧凑层级式编程语言，让预训练语言模型生成可执行材质程序，在无需任务微调的情况下通过解析器引导修复与预览批判迭代，并在噪声种子搜索下生成与提示对齐的 PBR 材质。
AI.motivation: 材质生成不仅应产出外观，还应保留构造该外观的规则。已有方法多直接生成材质贴图，缺乏显式结构、可编辑性与构造过程的保留。作者希望用可执行程序表达图层、空间表达式与 PBR 通道之间的依赖关系，使材质资产同时具备对齐性和可继续创作的源代码。
AI.method: 提出 MatLoom 层级式语言：每个程序组合 alpha 蒙版图层，共享空间表达式定义覆盖率及 PBR 通道，显式建模图案、颜色与浮雕间的依赖。独立解释器将程序求值为材质贴图，源代码保留命名字段与图层参数。方法不进行任务特定微调，流程包括解析器引导修复、基于预览的批判修订，以及在固定候选源码前提下搜索噪声种子。
AI.result: 在 141 条提示的基准上、使用六种骨干模型评估，最佳配置在四项平面布局提示对齐指标上的平均分均高于三个扩散基线；其初始程序在平均 BLIPScore 上已超过三个基线，且早于批判或种子搜索。跨骨干汇总的保留程序中位长度为 21 行。30 名参与者、20 条提示的盲测四选一中，本文渲染获得 59.2% 的选择率，而最受偏好基线为 19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的可执行程序能够在生成提示对齐材质的同时，把材质的构造过程作为资产的一部分保留下来，兼顾生成质量与后续可编辑性。

title: I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video
summary: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

AI.tldr: 该文研究自监督学习在连续视频流（严格时序滑窗、无全局打乱、无多轮重放）下的预训练，构建WT++数据集，并发现批内高相似性是主要瓶颈，提出StreamMAE有效缓解。
AI.motivation: 标准自监督预训练采用独立采样、跨epoch全局打乱的i.i.d.管线，与婴儿连续视觉流的学习方式差异巨大，因此需要研究连续视频流场景下的自监督预训练可行性及挑战。
AI.method: 构建WT++（95小时城市步行游览视频）流式预训练数据集与评测套件；对比对比学习、蒸馏及MAE在流式设定下的表现；诊断批间与批内相似性；提出StreamMAE，在保留MAE重构目标基础上引入流感知正则化与运动偏置的裁剪选择。
AI.result: 对比学习与蒸馏方法在流式设定下表现不佳，MAE更鲁棒但仍逊于标准i.i.d.预训练；批间相似性并非性能差距主因，批内近重复帧导致的高相似性才是核心挑战；StreamMAE超越流式基线，追平同数据i.i.d. MAE，与ImageNet预训练MAE具竞争力，并在流从12小时增至95小时时呈正向扩展。
AI.conclusion: 连续视频流预训练的主要障碍是批内帧近重复，StreamMAE通过重建目标加流感知正则化与运动偏置裁剪有效缓解该问题，实现与i.i.d.预训练相当的性能并可随数据规模正向扩展。

title: Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners
summary: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoMSN，一种基于掩码孪生网络的视频自监督时空表示学习框架，复用图像ViT，无需重建解码器，在多个视频基准上以更少预训练轮次达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督学习依赖重型3D架构或基于重建的自编码器，计算开销大、预训练效率低。作者希望复用标准图像ViT与图像基础模型，实现高效且无需重建的视频表示学习。
AI.method: 将视频表示为"超级图像"（由采样帧构成的网格），并从中构造两个视图：一个做空间patch掩码，另一个做时间帧掩码，且保证帧间无信息泄漏。共享ViT编码器用掩码孪生损失对齐两视图嵌入，捕捉运动与外观线索，无需解码器。基于预训练的DINO-v3和DeiT-v3图像编码器初始化。
AI.result: 在Kinetics-400、UCF101和HMDB51上达到SOTA性能，相比先前视频自监督方法，预训练轮次分别减少最多32倍和160倍；在低样本分类场景下也表现强劲，验证了表示的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 无解码器的掩码孪生框架借助图像基础模型可高效实现视频时空表示学习，兼顾性能与预训练效率，并在标签稀缺场景下具备良好迁移能力。

title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
summary: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式3D装配环境AssemblyWorld与基准AssemblyWorldBench（100个任务、80个物体），用于检验预训练通用智能体能否在无装配微调条件下通过视觉交互完成精确装配。
AI.motivation: 3D装配要求将部件及其关系的理解转化为精确空间排布。核心问题是：预训练通用智能体能否在不进行装配专项微调的前提下，仅通过视觉交互完成物体装配。目前缺乏统一的评测环境来回答该问题。
AI.method: 构建AssemblyWorld交互环境：智能体只能查看渲染后的2D视图并通过操作刚性部件进行装配，无法直接访问网格顶点或面，可依据图像或装配手册进行；装配结果以几何方式评估。基于该环境构建AssemblyWorldBench，涵盖家具、工业装配与碎片重组三类共80个物体、100个装配任务，并对8个智能体系统进行评测，同时分析视觉参考、交互轨迹与失败案例。
AI.result: 各系统能力差异显著：最强系统部件准确率为80.9%，但完整装配成功率仅59.4%；开源系统在执行可靠性与装配精度上均明显落后于较强的闭源系统；失败分析显示智能体虽能修正装配过程，但仍残留定位误差。
AI.conclusion: AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配智能体、刻画"近似结构恢复"与"精确重建"之间的差距提供了统一平台。

title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 27 pages (10-page main text), 5 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://vitex-bench.github.io/
summary: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together.
