We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViTeX-Bench基准套件（含387个720p真实视频数据集与三轴13指标评测协议），并发布微调参考编辑器ViTeX-Edit-14B，以推进视频场景文本编辑在视觉质量、时序一致性与编辑局部性上的研究。
AI.motivation: 视频生成日益真实可控，但视频编辑、尤其是需保持原始场景动态的精确局部编辑发展滞后。视频场景文本编辑（替换店面招牌、白板、产品标签上的文字）需在保留周边内容、运动与相机动态的同时改写文本，图像领域已成熟，而视频场景文本编辑在视觉质量、时序一致性和编辑局部性上仍缺乏研究。现有资源缺乏成对真实视频数据，通用视频编辑指标也无法直接衡量目标文本在时间维度上是否始终保持正确。
AI.method: 提出ViTeX-Bench，由ViTeX-Dataset与三轴评测协议组成。数据集含387个真实世界720p视频，附文本区域掩码与编辑指令：230条经审核、流水线生成的成对编辑用于训练，157条构成冻结评测集。协议通过13项指标评估文本正确性、视觉与时序质量、编辑局部性，每轴设一个主指标并进行帕累托权衡比较；辅以OCR校准、人工评估与标注敏感性分析。同时发布ViTeX-Edit-14B，在成对训练集上以运动对齐的字形-视频条件微调。
AI.result: 在来自四个编辑家族的八种基线上，同时实现准确文本、时序稳定与场景保持仍很困难。ViTeX-Edit-14B取得CharAcc 0.688，为所评估的视频原生编辑器中最高均值，并在原始编辑器输出中拥有最低的可比文本裁剪Warp。
AI.conclusion: ViTeX-Bench为研究视频场景文本编辑中的上述权衡提供了可复现的基础，并开源参考编辑器ViTeX-Edit-14B。

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
summary: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

AI.tldr: 提出Physis-Lang自演化框架，将"物理语言"作为数据策展、模型训练与视频生成共享且可优化的表示，无需额外视觉/数值信号即可提升视频世界模型的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型常生成视觉逼真但违背基本物理规律的视频，而主流做法默认自然语言不足以表达可靠生成所需的物理知识，因而引入额外的视觉、隐变量、数值或规划信号，本文旨在重新审视并挑战这一假设。
AI.method: 以语言描述物理过程的实体、成因、交互、支配原理、时序演化与结果；构建PhysCapBench，将物理过程拆解为原子断言，用召回率与精确率评估描述；采用智能体循环迭代分析断言级错误并优化生成物理描述的指令；将模型缺陷转化为文本描述，结合语言引导检索获取覆盖缺失物理过程的视觉多样视频。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准上，基于Wan与Cosmos两种骨干网络均取得物理合理性的持续提升；尤为突出的是，从开源Cosmos3-Nano骨干出发，Physis-Lang增强后的模型超越了领先的闭源Veo 3.1模型。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言足以作为可靠物理视频生成的共享可优化表示，语言驱动的自演化循环可有效提升物理合理性，并使开源骨干具备超越闭源领先模型的能力。

title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and model: https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow
summary: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

AI.tldr: 提出Multimodal Flow，一种完全连续的语言-视觉统一生成模型，用共享的chunk-causal flow骨干对多模态连续表示建模，避免视觉量化瓶颈与模态依赖目标，在统一多模态预训练上超越离散与混合模型。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型存在两类权衡：一类将语言与量化图像都作为离散token建模，带来视觉量化瓶颈；另一类将离散语言预测与连续图像生成结合，需要模态相关的目标函数与采样流程。完全连续建模可规避上述权衡，并支持共享生成过程，但在多模态预训练中仍未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出统一连续架构Multimodal Flow，将多模态连续表示与共享的chunk-causal flow骨干结合。把文本块与图像组织为有序连续hyperchunks，保持文本token顺序与视觉空间结构；骨干通过Flow Matching学习单一向量场。联合注意力实现跨模态交互，模态特定FFN分别处理各模态。训练时并行预测多个目标chunk，推理时顺序生成hyperchunks。实例化MF-1并在多模态数据上预训练。
AI.result: 在0.6B、1.2B、1.6B规模上，继续预训练持续提升多模态建模效果。仅用150B预训练token，MF-1在GenEval与DPG-Bench上平均82.8分，在VQAv2、MMBench、POPE上平均75.3分，与用更多数据训练的统一模型相当。在匹配数据、优化与参数预算下，Multimodal Flow进一步优于代表性混合模型与离散模型。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了基于连续chunk嵌入流建模作为一种新的完全连续统一多模态建模范式。代码与模型已公开于 https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow 。

title: Beyond Missing Rates: Rethinking Incomplete Multi-View Clustering with Protocol Divergence
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 as a poster paper
summary: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) is typically evaluated by retraining separate models under different missing-view configurations. Evaluations indexed only by nominal missing rate can overlook differences in observation structure across missing-view protocols. We show that missing-data protocols with identical nominal missing rates can induce substantially different learning regimes, differing by approximately 50-fold in the proportion of fully observed samples. We formalize this phenomenon as protocol divergence, which quantifies structural disparities among missing-view protocols beyond marginal missing rates. Furthermore, we analyze support-gated reconstruction mechanisms and show that their optimization contribution is inherently limited by the frequency of eligible observations under explicit normalization and optimization conditions. Based on these observations, we propose CRAFT (Co-occurrence-free Robust Attention-masked Fusion Transformer), a train-once framework that combines representation learning with an architecture designed to process missing-view inputs. CRAFT combines (i) per-sample forward computation using each sample's observed views and shared parameters, and (ii) mask-aware fusion over nonempty observed-view subsets. The deployment evaluation starts from training data with all views available and reuses one final checkpoint per dataset and seed across missing-view protocols without retraining. Experiments on CUB and MultiFashion show that CRAFT achieves the strongest performance in 12 out of 13 information-matched settings. Additional deployment experiments across seven benchmarks and sixteen missing configurations demonstrate substantial computational savings through checkpoint reuse while maintaining competitive clustering performance. Code and evaluation tools: https://github.com/dk23lhl/CRAFT and https://github.com/dk23lhl/imvc-audit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"协议分歧"概念揭示相同名义缺失率下观测结构差异可达约50倍，并据此设计免共现的CRAFT框架，实现一次训练、多协议复用的不完整多视图聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有不完整多视图聚类评估在不同缺失视图配置下需分别重训模型，且仅以名义缺失率作为评估指标，忽略了不同缺失协议间观测结构的差异；作者发现相同名义缺失率可导致完全观测样本比例相差约50倍，从而形成截然不同的学习机制。
AI.method: 提出协议分歧（protocol divergence）形式化刻画超越边际缺失率的结构性差异；分析支持门控重建机制，证明在显式归一化与优化条件下其优化贡献受合格观测频率限制；据此设计CRAFT（免共现鲁棒注意力掩码融合Transformer），包含按样本使用其观测视图与共享参数的前向计算，以及对非空观测视图子集的掩码感知融合，实现一次训练、复用同一检查点适配多种缺失协议。
AI.result: 在CUB与MultiFashion上，CRAFT在13个信息匹配设置中的12个取得最优性能；在7个基准、16种缺失配置的部署实验中，通过检查点复用显著节省计算量，同时保持有竞争力的聚类性能。
AI.conclusion: 名义缺失率不足以刻画缺失视图协议，协议分歧揭示了评估与优化中的结构性偏差；CRAFT以一次训练即可跨协议部署，兼顾性能与计算效率，为IMVC提供了更严谨的评估视角与实用框架。

title: BIND: Binding 3D Robot Actions to 2D Image Features
summary: We introduce BIND, a new action representation for visuomotor robot policies that binds 3D robot actions to their corresponding 2D image features, yielding strong data efficiency gains and robustness to out-of-distribution object positions and camera viewpoints. The action heads of current robot policies are typically formulated as an MLP regression from a single global feature vector produced by a pre-trained vision encoder. This global formulation requires the policy network to discover, from demonstrations alone, the relationship between target robot actions and the image features they project onto. The consequence is that although modern image features are semantically descriptive, spatially robust, and even multiview-consistent, the policies built on them are brittle to subtle changes in camera viewpoint and object placement--and surprisingly data-inefficient. BIND closes this gap by supplying the action-feature relationship through camera geometry rather than learning: it discretizes a volume of candidate end effector positions, attaches each candidate to the pre-trained features at its projection in each camera view, and selects actions by scoring each candidate's position and image-bound feature combination. On a real robot, we study data efficiency and out-of-distribution robustness to unseen object positions and camera viewpoints, as well as general long-horizon task execution and dexterity. We find BIND to be highly data-efficient and robust: it achieves near-perfect success on tasks with as few as 5 demonstrations, and degrades gracefully under steep camera-viewpoint shifts and held-out object positions where coordinate-regression baselines completely fail.

AI.tldr: 提出BIND动作表示,利用相机几何将3D机器人动作绑定到2D图像特征,实现高数据效率与对分布外物体位置和视角的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉运动策略的动作头通常是从预训练视觉编码器输出的单一全局特征向量进行MLP回归,需要仅凭演示数据自行发现动作与图像特征的对应关系,导致策略对相机视角和物体位置的细微变化脆弱,且数据效率低下。
AI.method: BIND通过相机几何而非学习来提供动作-特征关系:离散化候选末端执行器位置体积,将每个候选与其在各相机视图投影处的预训练特征关联,通过对每个候选的位置与图像绑定特征组合进行打分来选择动作。
AI.result: 在真实机器人上研究了数据效率、对未见物体位置和相机视角的分布外鲁棒性,以及长时程任务执行与灵巧性。BIND在仅5次演示的任务上达到近乎完美的成功率,在剧烈相机视角变化和留出物体位置下性能优雅退化,而坐标回归基线完全失败。
AI.conclusion: BIND通过相机几何显式建立动作与图像特征的绑定,显著提升视觉运动策略的数据效率和对视角、物体位置变化的鲁棒性,优于坐标回归基线。

title: TrafficSignBench: Rule-Centric Closed-Loop Evaluation of Traffic-Sign Compliance in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving planners are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics such as driving score, destination rate, and collision rate, which do not explicitly measure compliance with traffic rules. As a result, planners can achieve high benchmark scores while still exhibiting unsafe or illegal behaviors, limiting their applicability to real-world deployment. To address this gap, we introduce TrafficSignBench, a large-scale, traffic sign-centric benchmark for systematic and interpretable evaluation of traffic-rule compliance in autonomous driving. Our framework combines real-map-based simulation for realistic road layouts with rule-targeted procedural scenario generation for scalable and balanced coverage of underrepresented rules. We implement traffic rules corresponding to 34 traffic signs, each equipped with an automatic rule checker for detecting violations during closed-loop execution. This design yields 29,000 diverse road scenes and 29 distinct testing scenario types, enabling controlled evaluation of rule-specific planner behavior. We construct 5,800 testing scenes and demonstrate that current autonomous driving planners can exhibit poor traffic-rule compliance despite strong performance on standard evaluation metrics. To address this limitation, we transform existing planners into rule-compliant trajectory experts via explicit traffic-sign constraints, enabling scalable generation of high-quality oracle trajectories for fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrafficSignBench，一个以交通标志为核心的大规模基准，用于对自动驾驶规划器的交通规则合规性进行系统且可解释的评估，并结合规则约束生成高质量专家轨迹以提升合规性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶规划器通常使用驾驶得分、到达率、碰撞率等聚合指标进行评估，这些指标并未显式衡量交通规则合规性，导致规划器可能在基准测试中得分很高，却仍表现出不安全或违规行为，限制了其在实际部署中的适用性。
AI.method: 该框架结合基于真实地图的仿真以提供真实道路布局，以及面向规则的流程化场景生成，以实现对欠代表规则的可扩展且均衡的覆盖。作者实现了对应 34 种交通标志的交通规则，每种规则均配备自动规则检查器，用于在闭环执行中检测违规行为。该设计生成了 29,000 个多样道路场景和 29 种不同的测试场景类型，从而支持对规则特定规划器行为的受控评估。作者构建了 5,800 个测试场景，并通过显式交通标志约束将现有规划器转化为规则合规的轨迹专家，用于可扩展地生成高质量 oracle 轨迹以进行微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前自动驾驶规划器尽管在标准评估指标上表现强劲，但可能表现出较差的交通规则合规性。通过显式交通标志约束，可将现有规划器转化为规则合规的轨迹专家，并支持生成用于微调的高质量 oracle 轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TrafficSignBench 弥补了现有评估未显式衡量交通规则合规性的不足，实现了大规模、可解释、规则导向的自动驾驶规划器评估，并为提升规划器的交通规则合规性提供了可扩展的专家轨迹生成方案。

title: Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

AI.tldr: 该论文在可控测试床GRIDUMM上系统审计了"理解-生成梯度冲突指标能预测下游权衡"这一假设，发现方向性冲突指标与最终权衡几乎不相关，且抑制冲突不会改善权衡。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）的设计日益围绕理解目标与生成目标之间的梯度冲突展开，普遍假设"降低这些冲突指标即可改善理解-生成权衡"，但该前提从未被直接检验。
AI.method: 构建受控测试床GRIDUMM，复制UMM训练的关键结构要素，同时使真实权衡可精确计算；在63种配置、372个测量检查点上评估方向性冲突指标与最终权衡的相关性，并进行单调抑制冲突的剂量-反应干预实验，同时对比功能干扰指标与训练损失。
AI.result: 没有任何方向性冲突指标在与最终权衡的相关性上达到|Spearman|<0.3且置信区间不含零；剂量-反应干预单调压制冲突后权衡保持平坦，分离了相关与因果；范数比是生成失败检测器，但在已掌握生成的配置中失效；功能干扰度量优于方向性冲突度量，训练损失与权衡强相关。
AI.conclusion: 结果并非证明冲突无用，而是表明其作为诊断目标的有效性必须被实证建立而非默认假设；作者发布审计协议作为可复用标准。

title: What to Attend, What to Keep: Skill-Conditioned Visuotactile Representation with Progress-Guided Event Memory
summary: Robotic manipulation integrates vision, touch, and language, whose importance shifts across stages: vision guides reaching, while touch, through its evolution over time, decides grasping, alignment, and contact. Yet existing multi-modal manipulation policies typically use fixed temporal contexts and fusion strategies, despite shifts in what each modality contributes across different skills. We study how vision and touch should be combined at the level of primitive skills, asking what each skill needs from each sensor, and propose a skill-conditioned representation in which the queried skill conditions fusion over modality-specific short-term observation tokens while attending to a sparse event memory that retains terminal observations from the last $K$ executed skills. Evaluated by skill progress estimation on three contact-rich tasks, it reduces slip-detection delay by 87% against fine-tuned SOTA progress models, twist-completion delay by 67.5% against a vision-only ablation, and progress error on a blind search task by 92% through sparse event memory. Gains concentrate exactly where completion is defined by contact or task history. More broadly, our results suggest that observation formation not only policy architecture is a central challenge in multi-modal representation. Project Website: http://what-to-attend-what-to-keep.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种技能条件表征，让查询技能决定视觉与触觉的融合方式，并借助稀疏事件记忆保留最近K个技能的终态观测，从而在接触密集型任务中显著降低进度估计延迟与误差。
AI.motivation: 机器人的视觉与触觉在不同操作阶段的重要性会发生变化：视觉主要引导接近，触觉随时间演化决定抓取、对齐与接触。然而现有多模态操作策略通常使用固定的时间上下文与固定的融合策略，忽视了各模态在不同技能中贡献的差异。
AI.method: 在原始技能（primitive skill）层面研究视觉与触觉应如何组合：让被查询的技能对模态专属的短期观测token进行条件化融合，同时关注一个稀疏事件记忆，该记忆保留最近K个已执行技能的终态观测。
AI.result: 在三个接触密集型任务上进行技能进度估计评估：相比微调的SOTA进度模型，滑移检测延迟降低87%；相比仅视觉的消融版本，扭转完成延迟降低67.5%；在盲搜索任务上，通过稀疏事件记忆使进度误差降低92%。增益集中在完成由接触或任务历史定义之处。
AI.conclusion: 观测的形成方式（而非仅策略架构）是多模态表征中的核心挑战。

title: Correcting WHERE, Preserving HOW: Compositional Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Referential Guidance
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable flexible action generation, their generalization across diverse environmental elements, including manipulated objects, destinations, and backgrounds, is limited by the lack of diversity in robotic training data. Trained end-to-end on such data, VLAs tend to exploit visual shortcuts, associating actions with task-irrelevant visual features rather than the intended task semantics. These shortcuts block recomposition of elements already seen by the policy, that is, compositional generalization. Existing approaches mitigate such entanglement through task-relevant perception or targeted data diversification, but offer no explicit mechanism for unseen recomposition and require backbone-specific modifications with retraining. We observe that under such recomposition, VLAs often fail at global grounding while retaining local manipulation skills that recover near the correct target in familiar configurations. Therefore, we propose Referential Guidance (ReGuide), a training-free wrapper that, given object poses from a grounding module, combines semantic and geometric rebinding to guide the end-effector into demonstration-supported configurations of the instructed referent, where the frozen policy can resume execution. Experiments in simulation across multiple VLA backbones as well as on a real robot show that ReGuide improves success rates under compositional shifts by up to 56.8 and 75.0 percentage points, respectively, while preserving standard-task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Referential Guidance（ReGuide），一种免训练的包装模块，通过语义与几何重绑定将机械臂末端引导至演示支持的构型，缓解 VLA 的视觉捷径与组合泛化失败，在仿真与真机上分别最高提升 56.8 与 75.0 个百分点成功率，且不损失标准任务性能。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型虽能灵活生成动作，但机器人训练数据多样性不足，导致其泛化到新物体、目标位置与背景的能力受限。端到端训练使模型利用视觉捷径，将动作与任务无关的视觉特征关联，而非任务语义，从而阻碍已见元素的重新组合（组合泛化）。现有方法多依赖任务相关感知或定向数据多样化，缺乏面向未见组合的显式机制，且需针对特定骨干网络修改并重新训练。
AI.method: 作者观察到在组合重构下，VLA 常在全局定位上失败，但仍保留局部操作技能，可在熟悉配置中接近正确目标。据此提出 ReGuide：一个免训练包装器，借助 grounding 模块提供的物体位姿，结合语义重绑定与几何重绑定，将末端执行器引导到指令指代物中演示支持的构型，使冻结策略得以恢复执行。
AI.result: 在仿真中跨多个 VLA 骨干网络以及真实机器人上的实验表明，ReGuide 在组合偏移场景下将成功率分别最高提升 56.8 与 75.0 个百分点，同时保持标准任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ReGuide 通过免训练的外层引导机制显式解决 VLA 的组合泛化短板，无需修改骨干或重新训练，即可在多种建模框架与真实平台上显著提升组合偏移下的鲁棒性，并保全常规任务表现。

title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
summary: Chart editing requires cross-modal edit grounding, realizing a requested visual change in the code that draws it, with necessary related updates and without altering unrelated content. Existing benchmarks emphasize either code executability or chart quality, but their metrics do not clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes. We introduce ChartRevise, a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing. For dataset construction, we build on the grammar of graphics to systematically cover chart-editing operations, using source-program checks to verify their applicability across chart types and libraries. To improve edit exactness, our pipeline checks individual requirements and guides repair or exclusion when they are unmet. The resulting dataset contains 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries. For evaluation, our reference-free protocol separately measures atomic requirement completion, identifies gratuitous changes, and detects missed coupled updates. These checks are combined with successful execution and rendering to determine exact-edit success. Across five models and four external benchmarks, fine-tuning yields relative gains of 16\% in mean requirement recall and 22\% in mean exact-edit rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartRevise 数据集与评测协议，用于程序级精确图表编辑：区分需求完成、遗漏的耦合更新与无关改动。
AI.motivation: 图表编辑需要跨模态的编辑定位，即在绘图代码中实现请求的视觉变化，同时完成必要的关联更新且不改动无关内容。现有基准侧重代码可执行性或图表质量，其指标无法清晰区分"请求是否完成"、"是否遗漏耦合更新"和"是否产生多余改动"。
AI.method: 基于图形语法（grammar of graphics）系统覆盖图表编辑操作，用源程序检查验证其在不同图表类型与绘图库上的适用性；流水线逐条检验需求，未满足时引导修复或剔除。数据集含 92,438 条记录，覆盖 344 种编辑类型、20 种图表类型、3 个绘图库。评测采用无参考（reference-free）协议，分别度量原子需求完成度、识别多余改动、检测遗漏的耦合更新，并与成功执行和渲染结合判定精确编辑成功。
AI.result: 在 5 个模型和 4 个外部基准上，微调带来平均需求召回率 16% 的相对提升，平均精确编辑率 22% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: ChartRevise 通过细粒度、程序锚定的编辑评测，能更清晰地区分编辑的完成度、耦合更新与无关改动，并在多模型、多基准上验证了其对精确图表编辑能力的提升作用。

title: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
summary: Long-form subtitle translation requires reasoning over discourse and cultural context spanning episodes or entire series, while maintaining consistent terminology and style. Existing single-LLM methods are largely sentence-level, and multi-agent systems often use static workflows that do not adapt to scene complexity or production context. We propose SMART, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent system for long-foRm subtitle Translation. During test-time training, SMART builds persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic router and Mixture-of-Agents layer with tools for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and uses textual critiques to update agent prompts and routing policies without retraining the underlying LLMs. During test-time inference, the evolved configuration translates the remaining series. We also introduce Subtitle Arena, covering 14 genres, 2--198 episodes per series, production years 1959--2023, and 15 target locales, together with SubMQM, a subtitle-adapted MQM framework with seven dimensions and 19 error categories. SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system. On the public MuSC benchmark, SMART obtains the best model result across all four language pairs and also achieves the best human-evaluation result, with an overall score of 4.50/5.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SMART，一种自进化多智能体长剧集字幕翻译系统，通过测试时训练构建剧集级记忆并动态路由，配合判官-精炼回路更新提示与路由策略，同时发布Subtitle Arena基准与SubMQM评测框架，在15个翻译方向上取得最佳MQM得分，平均惩罚较最强竞品降低6.9%，并在MuSC基准四个语向上均获最佳模型与人工评测结果（4.50/5）。
AI.motivation: 长剧集字幕翻译需要跨集甚至跨季的语篇与文化语境推理，并保持术语与风格一致。现有单LLM方法多为句级处理，缺乏全局一致性；多智能体系统则依赖静态工作流，无法随场景复杂度或制作语境自适应调整。因此需要一个能自我进化、动态适配的长剧集字幕翻译方案。
AI.method: 提出SMART自进化多智能体系统。测试时训练阶段：构建持久的剧集级记忆，对部分句子经动态路由与Mixture-of-Agents层翻译，并调用术语验证、字幕约束校验与上下文检索工具；通过judge-refiner循环对候选打分，以文本批评更新智能体提示与路由策略，无需重训练底层LLM。测试时推理阶段：用进化后的配置翻译剩余剧集。同时发布Subtitle Arena基准（14类体裁、每剧2–198集、制作年份1959–2023、15个目标语区）及SubMQM字幕适配MQM框架（7维度、19类错误）。
AI.result: SMART在Subtitle Arena全部15个翻译方向上取得最佳整体MQM得分，平均惩罚较最强竞争多智能体系统降低6.9%；在公开MuSC基准上，四个语向均获最佳模型结果，同时取得最佳人工评测结果，总体得分4.50/5。
AI.conclusion: SMART通过测试时自进化的多智能体架构，有效解决长剧集字幕翻译中的语篇连贯、术语与风格一致性问题，优于静态单LLM与多智能体方法；配套的Subtitle Arena与SubMQM为长剧集字幕翻译提供了系统化基准与细粒度评测工具。

title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to additional reflection information. Specifically, we build on top of the open-source Qwen-image-2512 and observe a significant performance gain from 0.747 to 0.808 on GenEval and from 32.97 to 35.53 on GenEval2 Soft-TIFA. Moreover, attempts with more powerful external critics (e.g., GPT5.6-Luna) show that multimodal models with strong judge capabilities can anticipate a higher self-evolving ceiling. Last but not least, mixed text-rendering outcomes show that our self-improvements may not be uniform across different tasks. Our study aims to shed light on the current hot recursive self-improvement research line to enhance the user experience when using multimodal models without external supervision or guidance.

AI.tldr: UniEvo-VL：让多模态模型在测试时利用自身批判反馈进行自我进化，学生只看原题、教师看 privileged 批判，最小化二者去噪扩散分布的逐状态散度；在 Qwen-image-2512 上 GenEval 与 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 统一的多模态模型可生成并理解内容，从而能提供并学习自我反馈；现有做法依赖独立且往往更大的教师模型进行监督，成本高且受限于外部能力。作者希望让单一多模态模型在测试时计算中利用自身建设性自我纠正反馈实现自我进化，无需外部监督或指导。
AI.method: 提出 UniEvo-VL 自进化框架。将模型自我批判作为 privileged information，让同一多模态模型以不同上下文分别扮演教师与学生：学生仅见原始问题，教师额外条件于 privileged critique。训练目标是最小化二者在学生自身采样轨迹上的逐状态去噪扩散分布散度。基于开源 Qwen-image-2512 实现，并尝试更强外部批评者（如 GPT5.6-Luna）以考察自我进化的上限。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-image-2512 上，GenEval 从 0.747 提升至 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 从 32.97 提升至 35.53；使用更强外部批评者表明，具备强评判能力的多模态模型可预期更高的自我进化上限；混合文本渲染结果显示自我改进在不同任务上可能并不均匀。
AI.conclusion: UniEvo-VL 证明多模态模型可借助自身批判反馈在测试时实现自我进化，在无外部监督或指导的情况下提升图像生成能力并保持对额外反思信息的敏感性，为递归自我改进研究方向提供启示，同时提示自我改进效果存在任务间不均衡性。

title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 rollout 的草稿模型训练框架，通过 Anchor-Label Relabelling 与 In-Rollout Anchors 两个组件，在保留原始语料的前提下恢复块内全部监督信号，显著提升投机解码的接受长度。
AI.motivation: 块级投机解码草稿模型通常在外部模型撰写的语料上训练，一旦块内出现一个离策略 token，就会使该块后续所有槽位的监督失效；现有方法只能丢弃这些偏离槽位，造成严重监督损失。
AI.method: 框架包含两个互补组件：Anchor-Label Relabelling（ALR）用贪心目标 rollout 的分布替换语料标签，为所有预测槽位恢复有效监督；In-Rollout Anchors（IRA）将草稿块直接置于这些 rollout 中，让草稿模型接触目标模型生成的上下文，并复用预计算的 rollout 特征，不增加额外目标开销。
AI.result: 在固定的视觉-语言与文本语料上，贪婪接受长度较 DFlash 最多提升 36.5%，并持续优于擦除基线；单轮训练即超过最优擦除调度，三轮后接受长度可匹配在目标模型重生成响应上训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在固定语料、不修改原文条件下训练投机草稿模型提供了有效且计算高效的方法。

title: Where MLLMs Fail and Why: Causal Task Decomposition for Capability Failure Diagnosis
summary: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. We propose a causal decomposition framework that isolates these two failure modes through controlled interventions on the prerequisite dependencies of each task. Our capability metrics (NC, IC, RC) score each task under unassisted, correct, or incorrect prerequisites to diagnose where failures arise; contribution metrics (N-Score, S-Score), adapted from probabilities of causation, quantify each prerequisite's necessity and sufficiency to determine why. We instantiate the framework in CADET, a diagnostic benchmark of 10 composite tasks decomposed into 46 unit tasks with over 33,000 human-annotated questions spanning perception, spatial, temporal, and cognitive categories. Diagnosing frontier MLLMs with our framework uncovers systematic patterns that end-to-end accuracy obscures. Capability-wise, supplying correct prerequisites eliminates 54\% of errors on cognitive tasks, lifting them from weakest to above spatial and temporal. Prerequisite-wise, causal contributions are concentrated in a few critical prerequisites, and supplying the single most important one alone captures 84\% of the gain from supplying all prerequisites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果分解框架，通过干预任务的先决依赖，区分MLLM组合任务失败是内禀能力缺陷还是上游级联错误，并构建CADET诊断基准进行验证。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率只能记录多模态大模型（MLLM）在组合任务上的失败频率，却无法判断失败源于目标能力的内禀缺陷，还是上游先决条件的级联错误，导致诊断信息不足、难以定位问题根源。
AI.method: 提出因果分解框架，对每个任务的先决依赖进行受控干预；设计能力指标（NC、IC、RC），分别在无辅助、先决正确、先决错误条件下评分以诊断失败来源；引入借鉴因果概率的贡献指标（N-Score、S-Score）量化各先决条件的必要性与充分性；实例化为CADET基准，包含10个组合任务、分解为46个单元任务、超33,000个人工标注问题，覆盖感知、空间、时间与认知类别。
AI.result: 对前沿MLLM的诊断揭示出端到端准确率掩盖的系统性模式：提供正确先决可使认知任务错误减少54%，使其从最弱提升至优于空间与时间任务；因果贡献集中于少数关键先决，仅提供最重要的单一先决即可获得提供全部先决84%的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将组合任务失败归因从单一准确率细化为能力与贡献维度，能更精确地定位MLLM的薄弱环节；关键先决的高杠杆效应表明针对性优化少数依赖即可大幅提升性能。

title: World-as-Graph: Relational World Modeling Through Latent Space Graphs
summary: World models aim to learn representations of real-world environments and predict their future evolution. Recent object-centric world models have made expressive progress by representing visual scenes as sets of object-level latent states, but object-object relations are often captured only implicitly, which limits explicit relational and temporal structure modeling and object-centric dynamic memory modeling. To address such challenges, we propose World-As-Graph (WAG), a graph-based object-centric world model that introduces relational inductive bias into JEPA-style predictive representation learning. The proposed WAG contains two main modules: (1) Relation-aware structure induction, which constructs time-varying latent graphs from object-centric slots and designs relation-aware object masking policies to guide relational object representation learning in latent space; (2) Object-centric memory transition, which maintains and updates object-level dynamic states by combining relational information from neighboring objects with historical memory, enabling effective autoregressive future prediction. Extensive experiments on both visual reasoning and robotic manipulation tasks could demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed WAG.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 World-As-Graph (WAG)，一种将关系归纳偏置引入 JEPA 风格预测表征学习的图式物体中心世界模型，通过关系感知结构归纳与物体中心记忆转移两个模块实现显式关系与时间建模，在视觉推理与机器人操作任务上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有物体中心世界模型虽将视觉场景表示为物体级潜在状态集合，但对物体间关系的建模多为隐式，限制了显式的关系与时间结构建模，以及物体中心的动态记忆建模。
AI.method: WAG 包含两个主要模块：(1) 关系感知结构归纳：从物体中心槽构建时变潜在图，并设计关系感知的物体掩码策略，在潜在空间中引导关系型物体表征学习；(2) 物体中心记忆转移：通过结合邻近物体的关系信息与历史记忆来维护和更新物体级动态状态，从而实现有效的自回归未来预测。
AI.result: 在视觉推理与机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，所提出的 WAG 具有优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将关系归纳偏置显式引入 JEPA 风格的预测表征学习，WAG 有效弥补了物体中心世界模型在关系与时间结构建模上的不足，验证了图式物体中心建模的可行性与有效性。

title: Anchoring Adversarial Trajectories to Data Manifolds: A Bilevel Transfer Optimization Framework
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight. 21 pages, 6 figures
summary: A key bottleneck in adversarial transfer is a trajectory-level geometric disconnect: ambient gradients often drift away from the intrinsic data manifold, causing surrogate-specific overfitting. To rectify this, we propose Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer (MABT), a unified framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to the shared semantic subspace. MABT introduces a relaxed manifold-anchoring operator as a semantic rectifier to suppress off-manifold noise. With this constraint, we cast transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem that learns a geometry-aligned initialization by minimizing expected transfer risk under a surrogate uncertainty distribution. We further develop a Hessian-free solver with linear-time complexity to handle the resulting hierarchy. Experiments demonstrate improved transferability for 10 baseline attackers across 28 attack configurations, diverse victim architectures, and defense mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MABT框架，通过流形锚定将对抗轨迹约束在共享语义子空间，并以分布双层优化学习几何对齐初始化，配合Hessian-free线性时间求解器，显著提升对抗样本迁移性。
AI.motivation: 对抗迁移的关键瓶颈是轨迹级几何脱节：环境梯度常偏离内在数据流形，导致代理模型过拟合，攻击难以迁移到其他受害模型。
AI.method: 提出Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer（MABT）统一框架。引入松弛流形锚定算子作为语义校正器抑制离流形噪声；将迁移攻击生成建模为分布双层优化问题，在代理不确定性分布下最小化期望迁移风险以学习几何对齐初始化；设计Hessian-free求解器，具有线性时间复杂度以处理层级优化。
AI.result: 实验在28种攻击配置、多种受害架构及防御机制下，对10种基线攻击方法均取得迁移性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过流形锚定与几何对齐初始化的结合，MABT有效缓解代理过拟合并提升对抗迁移性，且求解器高效可扩展，具通用性与实用价值。

title: DiFF: Doppler-informed Flow Matching for Human Motion Flow
comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026. Code: https://github.com/keroseus/DiFF
summary: Perceiving human motion via privacy-preserving 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is critical for next-generation human-robot interaction (HRI), where point cloud scene flow serves as a foundational motion representation. Yet the extreme sparsity and noise of 4D radar point clouds make non-rigid motion flow estimation severely ill-posed--a challenge that existing rigid-centric methods and prior works fail to adequately address, largely because they neglect the rich Doppler velocity cues inherent in 4D radar. We propose DiFF, a generative framework that marries Doppler-informed motion priors with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based conditional flow matching model. At its core, a KAN-attention mechanism enables expressive feature extraction, while a prior-guided generative process harnesses Doppler cues to regularize the ill-posed solution space. Extensive experiments show that DiFF achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across diverse real-world datasets, reducing 3D endpoint error to the millimeter scale on the mmBody benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出DiFF，一种融合多普勒运动先验与基于KAN的条件流匹配的生成式框架，用于4D毫米波雷达点云的非刚性场景流估计，在mmBody等数据集上达到SOTA，3D端点误差降至毫米级。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达可在保护隐私前提下感知人体运动，对下一代人机交互至关重要。但4D雷达点云极度稀疏且含噪，导致非刚性运动流估计严重不适定；现有以刚性为中心的方法及先前工作未能充分解决该问题，主要因为忽视了4D雷达固有的丰富多普勒速度线索。
AI.method: DiFF将多普勒信息驱动的运动先验与基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的条件流匹配模型相结合。核心包括KAN注意力机制以实现高表达力特征提取，以及先验引导的生成过程，利用多普勒线索对不适定解空间进行正则化。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上取得SOTA性能，在mmBody基准上将3D端点误差降至毫米级。
AI.conclusion: DiFF通过显式利用多普勒先验并结合KAN条件流匹配，有效缓解了4D雷达点云非刚性场景流估计的不适定性，验证了多普勒线索在该任务中的关键价值。

title: Exploiting Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026), Vienna, Austria. 8 pages. (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes
summary: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have revolutionized robotic manipulation by seamlessly integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation in an end-to-end learning framework. However, since these models are designed to interact directly with the physical world and humans, their security is critical, and even small vulnerabilities can lead to catastrophic failures. In this work, we propose the Universal Adversarial Object, a sphere with optimized surface texture that significantly degrades task success rates when placed within the robot's field of view. Specifically, our approach introduces a multi-level attack framework that jointly disrupts trajectory planning, task execution, and action control. We validate our method in both simulated and real-world robotic settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the adversarial object reduces the average task success rates by 31.2%-39.9% for two representative VLA models (Pi0 and RDT), with success rates dropping to near zero in complex scenarios. Index Terms--Vision-Language-Action models, adversarial attack, robotic security, universal adversarial object

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通用对抗物体"——一个表面纹理经过优化的球体，放置在机器人视野内即可显著降低VLA模型的任务成功率，在仿真和真实环境中对Pi0与RDT两个模型的平均成功率降低31.2%–39.9%。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成端到端融合，直接与物理世界和人类交互，其安全性至关重要；即使是微小漏洞也可能导致灾难性失败，因此需要研究其对抗脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出通用对抗物体：一个优化表面纹理的球体；设计多层级攻击框架，联合干扰轨迹规划、任务执行与动作控制；在仿真与真实机器人环境中进行验证。
AI.result: 对两个代表性VLA模型（Pi0和RDT），对抗物体使平均任务成功率下降31.2%–39.9%，在复杂场景中成功率降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型存在显著的对抗脆弱性，简单的通用对抗物体即可造成严重任务失败，凸显机器人安全防护的紧迫性。

title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
summary: World models offer a promising way to help robots understand how the physical world evolves and plan complex behaviours through imagination. Yet existing studies mainly demonstrate what these models can accomplish, leaving unclear when their predictions remain useful for planning and where they fail. We study this question using action-conditioned predictors built on five frozen self-supervised visual backbones: V-JEPA 2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAEv2, VideoPrism, and DINOv2. We use frozen backbones to test representations intended to transfer across environments. We evaluate these models on diverse Meta-World manipulation tasks and real-robot interactions from BridgeData V2. We find that a world model guides action selection reliably only when the goal lies within, or slightly beyond, the trajectory it imagines during planning. With five-step rollouts, the length the predictor was trained on, the world model ranks actions reliably only for targets five to ten control steps ahead, whereas task goals lie 16 to 53 steps away. Neither an 81-fold larger predictor nor longer-rollout training extends this range; the encoder affects both range and closed-loop success, with V-JEPA 2.1 performing most consistently. More fundamentally, the limit persists under perfect prediction: using the real simulator, success falls from 92% to 41% as the target moves from five to twenty steps ahead of a five-step rollout. Planning therefore requires either longer imagined trajectories or closer subgoals. For distant goals, pure imagination succeeds in 23% of episodes, planning with feedback (MPC) raises success to 30%, imagining as far as the goal to 47%, and nearby expert subgoals to 76%. Used within its plannable range, a world model can also improve a vision-language-action (VLA) policy: choosing among eight actions the VLA proposes raises its success from 65% to 77% across 16 different tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了动作条件世界模型预测在机器人规划中的可用边界，发现其仅在想象轨迹范围内（约5-10控制步）可靠引导动作选择，远短于实际任务目标距离（16-53步），并提出延长想象、子目标分解等策略突破该限制。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型研究主要展示其能力（能做什么），但未阐明其预测在何时仍对规划有用、以及在何处失效。作者希望明确世界模型的可规划范围及其失效边界，为机器人想象式规划的应用提供指导。
AI.method: 基于五个冻结的自监督视觉骨干（V-JEPA 2、V-JEPA 2.1、VideoMAEv2、VideoPrism、DINOv2）构建动作条件预测器；使用冻结骨干以检验可跨环境迁移的表征。在多样化Meta-World操作任务及BridgeData V2真实机器人交互上进行评估，并借助真实模拟器进行"完美预测"对照实验。
AI.result: 在五步rollout（训练长度）下，世界模型仅对前方5-10控制步的目标可靠排序动作，而任务目标位于16-53步外；将预测器扩大81倍或延长rollout训练均未扩展该范围；编码器同时影响作用范围与闭环成功率，V-JEPA 2.1表现最稳定。完美预测下限制依然存在：目标从五步外移至二十步外（五步rollout），成功率从92%降至41%。对于远距离目标，纯想象成功率23%，MPC反馈规划提升至30%，想象至目标距离达47%，附近专家子目标达76%。在可规划范围内，世界模型可提升VLA策略：在8个候选中选择使成功率从65%升至77%（16个任务）。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的规划能力受限于其想象轨迹的长度：只有目标落在想象范围之内或略微超出时才能可靠引导动作。远距离目标规划需依赖更长想象轨迹或更近的子目标。该限制源于想象与目标距离的错配而非预测精度，在可规划范围内世界模型仍能有效增强VLA策略。

title: MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 4 pages + 1 page references, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. HRC extracts differences between interaction representations at adjacent horizons, encodes them as temporal motion cues, and injects them into action tokens through a gated residual. During training, robot-arm masks rendered from future frames are used to construct KL-based motion-grounding supervision, while inference uses only the current observation. On six MetaWorld tasks, MotionWeave achieves a 75.3% average success rate, an absolute gain of 8.6% over π0 (66.7%), especially on sustained-interaction tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave.

AI.tldr: MotionWeave：以运动为中心的未来动力学框架，用AIMG和HRC两模块实现动作块预测，在MetaWorld六任务上达75.3%成功率，比π0高8.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型引入世界模型提供动态监督，但显式预测未来图像/视频会包含与控制无关的外观信息；且基于整体未来视觉表征和全局共享动作特征的引导，难以建立动作与局部视觉变化之间的逐步对应关系。
AI.method: 提出MotionWeave框架，含两个模块：Action-Induced Motion Grounder（AIMG）以动作与本体感知表征为条件构造horizon-specific查询，从当前视觉token中定位每个未来动作时间步相关的交互区域；Horizon Residual Composer（HRC）提取相邻horizon交互表征的差异，编码为时序运动线索，并通过门控残差注入动作token。训练时用未来帧渲染的机械臂掩码构造KL-based运动定位监督，推理仅用当前观测。
AI.result: 在六个MetaWorld任务上平均成功率75.3%，相比π0（66.7%）绝对提升8.6%，在持续交互任务上提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以运动为中心的未来动力学建模能更有效地建立动作与局部视觉变化的时序对应，优于显式未来视觉预测与全局特征引导，为动作块预测提供更精准的动态监督。

title: Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection
summary: A robot that observes people interacting with objects should be able to carry out later requests that refer back to those interactions. Such requests may specify a grasp target by the role it played in a past event rather than by its name or appearance. Moreover, the target may no longer be visible when the robot is asked to act. We present BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system for this event-referential setting. Given the event history and the current scene, the system identifies the requested object or part and localizes it for grasping. If the target is occluded, it combines an event prior recovered from the history with current scene geometry to select camera viewpoints likely to reveal the target. The system uses pretrained models without additional task-specific training. In real-robot experiments with a single wrist-mounted RGB-D camera, it achieves grasp success rates of 76% and 77% for initially visible and occluded targets, respectively, compared with 40% and 55% for the strongest baseline in each condition. On four additional scenes with heavy occlusion, it increases grasp success rates from 75% to 95% while reducing the mean number of views from 3.35 to 2.20, compared with an active-perception baseline given the target's ground-truth 3D bounding box.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BeyondSCe，一个零样本机器人抓取系统，用于处理以事件角色指代目标且在需要抓取时目标可能不可见（被遮挡）的场景。
AI.motivation: 机器人在观察人类与物体交互后，可能收到回溯这些交互的请求；此类请求可能通过目标在过去事件中所扮演的角色而非名称或外观来指定，且机器人在执行时目标可能已不可见。现有方法难以处理这种事件指代性、目标被遮挡的抓取任务。
AI.method: 系统以事件历史和当前场景为输入，识别被请求的物体或部件并定位以进行抓取。若目标被遮挡，则将从历史中恢复的事件先验与当前场景几何相结合，选择更可能揭示目标的相机视角。系统仅使用预训练模型，无需针对任务的额外训练，并使用单个腕部安装的 RGB-D 相机。
AI.result: 在真实机器人实验中，对初始可见和初始被遮挡的目标，抓取成功率分别为 76% 和 77%，而各条件下最强基线分别为 40% 和 55%。在四个严重遮挡场景中，相比给定目标真值 3D 边界框的主动感知基线，抓取成功率从 75% 提升至 95%，同时平均视角数从 3.35 降至 2.20。
AI.conclusion: BeyondSCe 证明了结合事件先验与当前场景几何可在零样本、无需任务特定训练的条件下有效完成事件指代性抓取，并在可见与遮挡条件下均显著优于基线，且能以更少视角实现更高成功率。

title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
summary: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniWAM 统一混合流世界-动作模型，通过独立动作编码器与输出头共享主干，结合 Manipulation Anchor Pose 监督和自动构建的百万级 MAP-Data，实现导航与操作的联合表示学习与统一策略。
AI.motivation: 移动操作包含导航到可操作位姿与物体交互两个阶段，二者在动作空间和视觉需求上差异显著，统一策略学习困难；同时，带显式可操作位姿监督的真实世界导航数据采集成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 1) UniWAM：统一混合流世界-动作模型，为导航和操作设置独立的动作编码器与输出头，共享共同主干，支持在独立采样的导航与操作数据上进行联合表示学习，并支持单流独立推理与双流批量并行推理。2) 提出 Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) 监督，用于确定停止位置与朝向。3) 自动流水线从大规模 3D 场景构建 MAP-Data，含超 150 万 episodes、7500 小时，提供逐帧目标物体边界框与图像平面 MAP 坐标作为导航辅助监督，并结合投影末端执行器轨迹为操作提供监督，从第一视角观测实现流特定的图像平面动作监督。
AI.result: 在自建 MAP-Bench 上，位置误差较最强外部基线降低 30.1%，朝向误差降低 44.0%；在 24 个真实机器人任务中，MAP 导航与移动操作取得领先结果，操作性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UniWAM 通过混合流架构与 MAP 监督有效统一了导航与操作学习，配合大规模自动生成数据显著提升移动操作性能，并已开源代码、数据与基准。

title: Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback
summary: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为MEQ的互反馈架构，将两个（可能不同模态的）输入反复耦合，使各自的嵌入包含对方信息，最终输出定义为该交互的不动点，并在分类与视觉定位任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态方法多依赖拼接等浅层融合，模态间信息交互有限，难以让每个模态的表征充分吸收另一模态的信息。作者希望建立一种持续、双向的信息交换机制，使两种模态在迭代中相互精炼。
AI.method: 提出互反馈架构MEQ：由两个组件构成，各自输出被反馈给另一组件，形成连续的信息交换循环；将模型最终输出定义为该交互过程的不动点。同时给出理论分析，解释该模型的含义并指导设计选择以避免失效情形（如不收敛等）。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上的分类与视觉定位任务中验证：定量上，在多模态分类（拼接式基线）中取得更优或具竞争力的性能；定性上，当与互补模态配对时，交互机制可逐步精炼视觉定位结果。
AI.conclusion: 互反馈机制能有效增强多模态表征的相互信息融合，在分类与视觉定位任务中均展现出优势，说明"以不动点为输出的双向迭代交互"在多模态场景下具有实用价值与可解释性。

title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $σ$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $σ$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale $σ_c$, the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image--caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that $σ_c$ tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion. Moreover, $σ_c$ yields interpretable measures of the image spatial distribution and caption dependence of memorization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将扩散模型视为以噪声尺度$\sigma$为索引的确定性动力系统族，把去噪器当作自映射研究其动力学；固定点对应平滑数据密度的临界点、吸引子对应众数。基于此提出"临界尺度$\sigma_c$"量化样本的持续性，并证明其能追踪由重复、过拟合和离群点导致的记忆现象，还能在Stable Diffusion中识别完全/部分记忆样本。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常把扩散模型看作"噪声到数据"的随机过程，缺乏对记忆（memorization）现象的几何刻画。作者希望从互补视角理解记忆：由于重复、过拟合或离群点而获得过量概率质量的样本，应比普通样本在更强平滑下仍可区分，需要一个可量化的指标来度量这种"持久性"。
AI.method: 1) 视角转换：在每个固定噪声尺度$\sigma$下，将去噪器视为自映射，研究其确定性动力学。2) 理论联系：精确去噪器的固定点对应平滑数据密度的临界点，吸引子对应其众数；随$\sigma$增大，样本级众数逐级合并为更粗的众数。3) 定义临界尺度$\sigma_c$：样本被固定尺度动力学保留的最大噪声尺度，作为记忆持久性的量化指标。4) 条件模型中，将构造自然扩展到图像-文本对。5) 在受控实验与大规模模型上验证。
AI.result: 实验表明：$\sigma_c$能追踪由数据重复、过拟合和离群点引起的记忆；在Stable Diffusion中可识别出被完全记忆和部分记忆的样本；此外，$\sigma_c$还能给出关于图像空间分布与标题依赖性的可解释度量。
AI.conclusion: 通过把扩散模型重新解释为随噪声尺度变化的确定性动力系统族，论文提供了一种几何化理解记忆的框架。临界尺度$\sigma_c$作为核心度量，能统一刻画多种记忆来源，并在实际大模型上具有可操作性和可解释性，为记忆检测与分析提供了新工具。

title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
summary: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals. We propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that improves advantage construction by shaping student-side reward groups during both critic training and policy optimization. To improve critic-side conditioning, Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration regularizes the critic during training to produce reward groups with non-collapsed spread and smooth rank-wise gaps by matching sorted prompt-wise rewards to group-centered Gaussian quantiles. Building on this conditioned reward geometry, policy-side group power modulation reshapes the prompt-wise reward groups before they are converted into advantages, preserving the critic-induced ordering while increasing optimization-relevant margin separability. Extensive experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GRGC on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations, while introducing negligible overhead over GAD. The code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC.

AI.tldr: 提出GRGC两阶段框架，通过高斯组内最优传输校准与策略侧组功率调制改善黑盒蒸馏中GRPO优势构造，缓解critic与学生优化目标不匹配问题，性能优于GAD且开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 黑盒蒸馏中，GAD等on-policy对抗方法通过critic-学生对抗循环改进SeqKD。但GRPO基于同组学生样本的相对奖励计算优势，而critic主要学习区分教师与学生回复，二者目标不匹配，导致奖励组尺度坍缩或margin脆弱，组内优化信号不稳定。
AI.method: GRGC为两阶段框架：1）critic侧，采用高斯组内最优传输校准，在训练中匹配排序后prompt级奖励与组中心高斯分位数，使奖励组具有非坍缩离散度和平滑秩次间隔；2）策略侧，在奖励转为优势前进行组功率调制，重塑prompt级奖励组，在保持critic诱导排序的同时提升与优化相关的margin可分性。
AI.result: 在多种教师模型、学生模型族与规模及训练数据集上，GRGC在分布内和分布外评测中均有效，较GAD带来可忽略的额外开销。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时塑造critic训练与策略优化中的学生侧奖励组几何，GRGC有效缓解目标不匹配带来的脆弱组优化信号，为黑盒蒸馏提供高效且泛化良好的改进方案。

title: Reliability-Aware Checkpoint Selection for Domain Generalization
summary: Checkpoint selection in domain generalization often relies on source-validation accuracy, yet the selected checkpoint need not provide reliable probabilities on unseen target domains. Source-target distribution shifts can alter accuracy rankings, while accuracy alone does not measure predictive probability quality. We identify an empirical selection opportunity within fixed training trajectories: reselecting among checkpoints with near-optimal source accuracy can improve mean target probability quality with small observed changes in mean target accuracy. We study accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which retains checkpoints within a tolerance of the best source-validation accuracy and ranks them by source reliability. Our reference rule aggregates within-set normalized negative log-likelihood (NLL) and class-wise calibration error (CwECE) using $D_\infty$. AC uses no target data and requires neither additional training nor weight averaging. We evaluate five domain generalization training algorithms on three benchmarks, using PACS to develop the objectives and a 0.5-percentage-point tolerance. In exploratory aggregation comparisons on 360 OfficeHome and TerraIncognita runs, the reference rule reduces mean target soft-bin squared-gap ECE and CwECE by 0.240% and 0.182%, respectively, and NLL by 0.030 relative to Source-Acc. Mean target accuracy changes by +0.213 percentage points. These results identify opportunities for reliability-aware reselection, while the additional benefit of joint over single-objective ranking remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 提出精度约束的可靠性选择方法AC，在源验证精度近优的检查点中按源可靠性重排序，在不使用目标数据的前提下改善目标域概率质量。
AI.motivation: 域泛化中检查点选择通常依赖源验证精度，但源-目标分布偏移会改变精度排序，且精度本身不衡量预测概率质量，因此所选检查点未必在未见目标域上提供可靠概率。
AI.method: AC保留源验证精度在最优值容差范围内的检查点，并按源端可靠性排序；参考规则用D∞聚合集合内归一化的负对数似然（NLL）与类条件校准误差（CwECE）。无需目标数据、额外训练或权重平均；在PACS上开发目标与0.5个百分点容差。
AI.result: 在360次OfficeHome与TerraIncognita运行中，参考规则相较Source-Acc使平均目标soft-bin squared-gap ECE与CwECE分别降低0.240%和0.182%，NLL降低0.030，平均目标精度变化+0.213个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在可靠性感知重选的机会，但联合排序相对单目标排序的额外收益仍待解决。

title: LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception
summary: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.

AI.tldr: LEAP 是一个音视频问答框架，让模型通过分块检索自身证据而无需将整段录音放入单一上下文，从而在长时（小时级）AVQA 上突破上下文与细粒度证据的两难困境。
AI.motivation: 小时级音视频问答存在上下文两难：对整段录音进行密集编码会迅速耗尽上下文上限，而均匀时间压缩又会严重稀释细粒度的声学与视觉证据。因此需要一种既保持有限上下文、又不损失细粒度证据的方法。
AI.method: 将录音切分为固定时长分块，对每块执行轻量级定位过程为短候选窗口打分；将排名最高的窗口汇集并在单次受限的答案生成过程中重新编码，使答案输入与峰值上下文均与录音时长无关。解耦证据定位与推理，可基于预计算转写定位候选时间窗而无需解码媒体帧，同时通过将最终作答过程路由到原始音视频流以保留细粒度视觉与非语音证据。两阶段均训练：定位 LoRA 改善所选窗口，答案 LoRA 改善从相同窗口读出的答案。分块网格原生支持因果查询，从而无需流式专用训练即可支持流式推理。
AI.result: 在多个 AVQA 基准上，LEAP 相比 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 基线提升 4.5–16.8%，并可迁移至第二个全模态骨干 MiniCPM-o 4.5，超过其已发表结果 3.1–13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将证据定位与推理解耦并分块检索，LEAP 在保持上下文有界的同时保留细粒度音视频证据，显著提升长时音视频问答性能并具备骨干可迁移性与流式推理能力。

title: Multi-Link Safety Filtering for VLA Policies Around Moving Hazards
summary: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid's center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from $65.62\%$ to $27.27\%$ and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from $29.35\%$ to $50.43\%$. Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in $2.2$~ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision--language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each $π_{0.5}$ policy call on the integrated GPU from $343$ to $177.3$~ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的多连杆安全屏蔽层（shield），在运行时为预训练VLA策略过滤指令动作，以降低杂乱环境中对无关物体的碰撞风险。
AI.motivation: VLA策略即使成功完成任务，也可能撞倒无关物体，因此任务成功率并不能证明其在杂乱环境中可安全部署；且需要在不重训练的前提下，于运行时保护机械臂不止末端执行器的部位，并跟踪移动的危险物，同时与策略共享机载算力。
AI.method: 用五个椭球覆盖夹爪、手腕与前臂，将所有指令动作通过一个屏障程序（barrier program）针对一个“禁入椭球”进行过滤；该椭球在复位时由RGB-D感知拟合，随后通过稀疏光流随危险物移动其中心，无需重复检测或重拟合。此外通过裁剪视觉-语言前缀和减少flow-matching步数来加速策略调用。
AI.result: 在六种仿真危险物运动条件下，碰撞率由65.62%降至27.27%，安全成功率由29.35%提升至50.43%。消融显示保护手臂连杆优于仅保护末端；跟踪可恢复因复位时冻结估计而损失的大部分保护。异构边缘硬件上，五椭球屏障在CPU上99百分位为2.2ms；π0.5策略调用在集成GPU上由343ms缩短至177.3ms。物理SO-101机械臂四项任务中，屏蔽后16次有3次触碰危险物，未屏蔽为11次。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多连杆安全屏蔽层能有效降低VLA策略在杂乱环境中的碰撞，多连杆保护与危险物跟踪是性能提升的关键，且在边缘硬件上具备实时可行性与物理验证效果。

title: Prototype-Rule Neurosymbolic Regularization for Rank-Constrained Tensor Neural Networks under Label Scarcity
summary: Rank-constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high-order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype-rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit arises from training-time regularization, whereas inference fusion is small and dataset dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究在高阶输入的低秩张量网络中引入可微原型规则作为补充归纳偏置，在四个高光谱基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Rank-R张量神经网络虽降低了高阶输入的参数化复杂度，但未在学习表征中显式约束类别几何结构；作者探究可微原型规则能否在有限监督下为Rank-R张量学习提供互补的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 在Rank-R目标函数中加入基于原型的正则化项，并在推理阶段可选地将原型证据与神经网络logits融合（神经符号推理）；在四个高光谱基准上以四种Rank-R配置评测，采用七折分层与缓解泄漏的空间分离折，并单独进行类支撑预算从2到20样本的空间研究。
AI.result: 空间评估下，完整神经符号推理使Macro-F1变化为：Botswana +8.82个百分点、Indian Pines +5.49、Pavia University +1.59、Salinas -0.62；收益主要来自训练期正则化，推理融合作用较小且依赖数据集。
AI.conclusion: 可微原型规则可为Rank-R张量学习提供有效的互补归纳偏置，显式约束类别几何；其主要贡献集中于训练期正则化，推理阶段融合的增益有限且因数据集而异。

title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
summary: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了自我中心人类数据（Ego4WAM）在统一的世界-动作模型框架下，对齐性、时长/任务多样性、监督方式与使用策略如何共同影响机器人学习效果。
AI.motivation: 自我中心人类数据是可扩展的机器人经验来源，但在人机对齐、行为覆盖和监督信号上差异很大；已有工作显示数据越多收益越好，但不清楚哪些数据属性驱动下游机器人性能提升，也不清楚如何在训练流程中有效使用这些数据。
AI.method: 在固定模型骨干的统一世界-动作模型框架下，对具有不同对齐程度与监督形式的自我中心人类数据展开系统性研究，解耦人机对齐、数据时长与任务多样性、动作监督以及数据使用策略各自的影响。
AI.result: 对齐的人类演示显著提升分布外泛化并降低目标任务机器人数据需求；数据时长与任务多样性对下游能力影响不同；仅有视频监督、无动作标签依然有效，可为后续视频-动作训练提供良好基础。结论通过真机与RoboDojo上的闭环策略评估得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 数据的价值不应只以时长作为唯一扩展轴；Ego4WAM表明对齐性、任务多样性、可用监督与使用策略共同决定自我中心人类数据对机器人学习的价值。

title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出Ranking-PE，将反思式提示进化中的正确性得分矩阵替换为成对排序矩阵，使列均值等于经验AUROC，从而在类不平衡临床数据上优化排序而非准确率，在MIMIC三类疾病上显著优于基于准确率的提示进化。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在临床诊断中应用广泛，但现有适配流程仍以准确率为目标。临床数据类别严重不平衡，多数类常量预测器可轻易超过90%准确率却无临床价值。AUROC是免阈值、对类别平衡不变的排序指标，因此更适合作优化目标。而GEPA等反思式提示优化方法基于逐实例正确性的二值得分矩阵，其列均值即准确率，驱动候选选择，无法反映排序质量。
AI.method: 提出成对级帕累托提示进化（Ranking-PE）：将每个正确性行替换为（正例,负例）实例对的成对排序行，若候选提示给正例打分高于配对负例则记为1；由Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恒等式，列均值即经验AUROC。该替换在提示进化搜索读取的全部三个层面实施：决定帕累托支配的得分矩阵、给反思LM的逐样本反馈、以及最终候选选择。方法不增加模型调用次数，也无需代理损失。
AI.result: 在MIMIC数据集三种疾病上，基于准确率的提示进化可能损害排序性能，而Ranking-PE扭转这一趋势：在微调的Qwen3-VL-8B上比基于准确率的方案高出+5.8 AUROC百分点，在MedGemma-4B上高出+16.2个百分点。消融实验检验了各设计组件，并表明医学级视觉骨干（通过视觉编码器调优的SFT或医学预训练）是必要前提，提示搜索无法替代。
AI.conclusion: Ranking-PE将反思式提示进化从纯文本数据扩展到多模态临床决策，通过以AUROC为导向的成对排序目标替代准确率目标，在类别不平衡场景下有效提升临床排序性能，且不增加模型调用或代理损失。

title: Simulating Synchrony Loop Networks in the Open Source RISP Neuroprocessor
summary:
Neuromorphic spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising alternative to conventional deep neural networks for tasks with computational resource or data constraints. However, their practical applications have been limited by comparatively weak performance on complex learning tasks. Experimental approaches such as Synchrony Loop Propagation (SLP) increasingly seek to address this problem through more sophisticated and heterogeneous neuron models, and have achieved encouraging initial results. However, these neuron models do not readily translate to standard neuromorphic systems designed to support simple leaky integrate-and-fire neurons.
  We present an implementation of an SLP network on the RISP neuroprocessor, an event-driven neuromorphic simulation platform, and evaluate its performance on an unsupervised musical instrument clustering task. The network achieves clustering accuracy comparable to the DBSCAN algorithm, while providing over an order of magnitude improvement in runtime speed and computational efficiency relative to a prior non-neuromorphic SLP implementation.
  These results demonstrate that SLP's core mechanisms can be effectively translated into a neuromorphic architecture to support complex unsupervised learning. More broadly, this work highlights the potential of heterogeneous and extensible neuron models to expand the design space of neuromorphic systems to more complex learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文在RISP神经形态仿真平台上实现了SLP网络，用于无监督乐器聚类任务，性能与DBSCAN相当，运行速度和计算效率较非神经形态SLP实现提升一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 神经形态脉冲神经网络（SNN）在资源或数据受限任务中具有潜力，但在复杂学习任务上性能较弱。SLP等实验性方法通过更复杂、异质的神经元模型提升性能，但这些模型难以移植到仅支持简单LIF神经元的常规神经形态系统上。
AI.method: 在事件驱动的神经形态仿真平台RISP神经处理器上实现SLP网络，并在无监督乐器聚类任务上评估其性能，与DBSCAN算法及此前的非神经形态SLP实现进行对比。
AI.result: 该网络的聚类精度与DBSCAN相当，同时相比此前的非神经形态SLP实现，运行速度和计算效率提升超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: SLP的核心机制可有效迁移到神经形态架构中以支持复杂无监督学习；异质且可扩展的神经元模型有望拓展神经形态系统的设计空间，使其适用于更复杂的学习任务。

title: How much of fly walking is written in the wiring?
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures; Supplementary Information with 4 figures and 9 tables
summary: Connectome models of the fly nerve cord generate walking-like motor rhythms, but oscillation alone does not show that the specific wiring matters. Here we provide, to our knowledge, the first test of which features of motor output depend on the specific wiring. We simulated the leg motor systems of two independent Drosophila connectomes, with synapse counts as fixed weights and glutamatergic synapses treated as inhibitory, and compared each with six families of rewired networks that preserve progressively more of its structure, using pre-registered criteria. We find that rhythm is generic but antagonist coordination is not: many rewired networks were more rhythmic than the real ones, yet the real wiring coordinated antagonistic motor pools more strongly than every rewired network, most of all at the thorax--coxa joint. We trace this specificity to how premotor input is allocated between antagonistic pools. Both connectomes carry Sherrington's reciprocal innervation---neurons that excite one pool inhibit its antagonist---and no rewired network does. Reassigning premotor inputs between the pools abolished coordination even when motor neurons' typical input strength changed little (all pre-registered criteria met in one connectome; same direction in the other). Coordination, not rhythm, therefore reveals whether a connectome model's wiring matters.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模拟两个独立的果蝇连接组腿部运动系统，并与六类保留不同结构程度的"重连"网络对比，发现节律是冗余/通用的，而拮抗肌协调依赖于特定连接布线。
AI.motivation: 连接组模型能产生类似行走的运动节律，但仅凭振荡无法证明特定布线是否重要。作者希望首次系统性检验运动输出的哪些特征真正依赖于特定连接结构，而非网络的泛化动力学属性。
AI.method: 模拟两个独立果蝇连接组的腿部运动系统，以突触计数为固定权重、将谷氨酸能突触视为抑制性；将每个真实网络与六类逐步保留更多结构特征的重连网络对比，采用预注册标准评估；并通过重新分配前运动输入（premotor input）在拮抗肌池之间的分配进行因果验证。
AI.result: 节律具有通用性但拮抗肌协调不具通用性：许多重连网络比真实网络更具节律性，但真实布线对拮抗运动池的协调强于所有重连网络，尤其体现在胸-基节（thorax-coxa）关节。这种特异性源于前运动输入在拮抗池间的分配方式。两个连接组均含有Sherrington式交互支配（兴奋一个池的神经元抑制其拮抗池），而重连网络均无。在池间重新分配前运动输入即消除协调，即使运动神经元的典型输入强度变化很小（一个连接组满足全部预注册标准，另一连接组方向一致）。
AI.conclusion: 协调性而非节律性，才是判断连接组模型的特定布线是否重要的关键指标。特定布线对拮抗肌协调的必要性体现了连接组结构的因果作用。

title: Null-model treatment of the sensory-motor boundary changes an evolutionary connectome comparison
comment: 9 pages main text + appendix (27 pages total), 9 figures (3 in the main text). Code, protocols, results and a dated research log: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22871090 ; https://github.com/gyujeongion/flyconnectome-nulls
summary: Randomised copies of a connectome are the usual baseline for asking whether measured wiring matters, and the answer depends on what the randomisation preserves. We evolved embodied foraging agents whose brains are a compressed adult Drosophila connectome (FlyWire v783; 512 cell-type groups and 1,000 Kenyon cells) alongside agents built on randomised wiring, in pre-registered experiments with ten seeds, four ecologies and 600 generations. Two standard randomisations, a column shuffle and degree-preserving edge swaps, route 10.6 to 10.7 % of olfactory output directly onto descending motor groups, against 0.012 % in the connectome. On the registered primary endpoint, fitness averaged over the run, no difference was detected; at the last common-garden probe the connectome was behind both controls (-0.22 and -0.20 fitness units on seed means). Against controls that keep every sensory-output and motor-input edge and rewire only the interior, the seed-mean difference lay within a +/-0.10 equivalence bound (+0.002 and -0.074, unchanged under a calibration that also matches activity spread), although per ecology the interior column shuffle was ahead by 0.26 in one of four ecologies at ten seeds, a lead that ten further pre-registered seeds did not replicate. Rewiring the connectome so that it acquires the shortcut raised its fitness by 0.44 (10 of 10 seeds) and its dependence on olfaction from 0.15 to 0.99; graded doses raised both in step; at comparable swap counts the full dose was ahead of an interior-only sham by 0.53 (10 of 10 seeds); and a sham that rewired the same boundary edges without creating shortcuts matched the connectome (+0.007) while the full dose was ahead of it by 0.60. What a null preserves at the sensory-motor boundary can decide an evolutionary connectome comparison, and sensory-to-motor path statistics belong next to the degree statistics a null is said to preserve.

AI.tldr: 以压缩果蝇连接组（FlyWire v783）驱动的进化觅食代理与随机化接线对照组比较：标准随机化（列置换、保度边交换）显著增加嗅觉输出直达运动组的捷径比例，但在预注册主终点上未检测到适应度差异；保留感觉-运动边界连边的对照下，连接组与对照在读出的等效界内；而人为赋予连接组捷径可大幅提升适应度与嗅觉依赖度，说明零模型在感觉-运动边界保留什么会决定连接组进化比较的结论。
AI.motivation: 随机化连接组是判断"实测接线是否有意义"的常用基线，但其结论取决于随机化保留了什么。作者关心感官-运动边界处的路径统计是否被标准零模型无意保留或破坏，从而影响进化比较的结论。
AI.method: 以FlyWire v783成体果蝇连接组为脑（512个细胞类型组、1000个Kenyon细胞），构建具身觅食代理；对照组使用随机化接线。预注册实验：10个种子、4种生态、600代。比较两类标准随机化（列置换、保度边交换）与保留全部感觉-输出和运动-输入边、只重连内部的对照；并做捷径植入、梯度剂量、仅内部sham及同边界边但不产生捷径的sham，配合活动扩散校准。
AI.result: 列置换与保度边交换把10.6%–10.7%的嗅觉输出直接接到下降运动组，而连接组仅0.012%。预注册主终点（全程平均适应度）无差异；末次公共环境探针中连接组落后对照（按种子均值-0.22和-0.20）。相对保留感觉-输出/运动-输入边、仅重连内部的对照，种子均值差落在±0.10等效界内（+0.002和-0.074，校准后不变）；但单一生态中内部列置换在四种生态之一以0.26领先，10个追加预注册种子未能复现。给连接组植入捷径使适应度提升0.44（10/10种子），嗅觉依赖从0.15升至0.99；剂量递增同步提升；相同交换数下全剂量优于仅内部sham 0.53（10/10）；同边界边但不产生捷径的sham与连接组相当（+0.007），全剂量领先其0.60。
AI.conclusion: 零模型在感觉-运动边界保留什么会决定进化连接组比较的结果；感觉到运动的路径统计应与零模型声称保留的度统计并列纳入考量。

title: An Island-Based Parallel Biased Random-Key Genetic Algorithm for the Three-Dimensional Trailer Loading Problem
summary: The Three-Dimensional Trailer Loading Problem (3D-TLP) involves determining the optimal placement and orientation of heterogeneous items within the confined space of a trailer while maximizing volume utilization and satisfying a wide range of complex logistical and safety constraints. The 3D-TLP is NP-hard, rendering exact optimization approaches computationally impractical for large-scale industrial applications. To address this challenge, we propose an enhanced Biased Random-Key Genetic Algorithm (BRKGA) accelerated through a novel island-based parallelization framework, PANGEA. The proposed method combines the search efficiency and robustness of BRKGA with a multi-population evolutionary scheme for genetic algorithms. This island-model strategy promotes population diversity, mitigates premature convergence, and significantly reduces computational times. The proposed solution was validated in a real trailer loading process, providing an effective solution approach for real-world large-scale logistics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对三维拖车装载问题（3D-TLP），提出一种基于PANGEA岛式并行框架的增强型BRKGA算法，以提升装载体积利用率并缩短计算时间。
AI.motivation: 3D-TLP要求在有限拖车空间内确定异构货物的最优放置与朝向，同时满足复杂物流与安全约束并最大化体积利用率。该问题属NP-hard，精确优化方法在大规模工业场景中计算不可行，因此需要高效的启发式/元启发式方法。
AI.method: 提出增强型偏随机键遗传算法（BRKGA），并通过新型岛式并行框架PANGEA进行加速。该方法将BRKGA的搜索效率与鲁棒性同多种群进化方案结合，采用岛模型策略以促进种群多样性、缓解早熟收敛并显著降低计算时间。
AI.result: 所提方法在真实拖车装载流程中进行了验证，可为实际大规模物流场景提供有效求解方案；并行岛模型在提升求解质量的同时显著缩短了计算时间。
AI.conclusion: BRKGA与PANGEA岛式并行框架的结合能够有效应对大规模3D-TLP，兼顾求解效率与解的质量，具有良好的实际应用价值。

title: Large Language Model-Guided Evolutionary Discovery of Native Neural Architectures for Spiking Sequence Modeling
comment: 38 pages (15 pages main text + appendix), 12 figures, 10 tables
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer low-energy sequence modeling through sparse, event-driven computation. However, interactions among spike encoding, neuronal dynamics, and information propagation complicate architecture design. Existing SNN sequence models often adapt artificial neural network (ANN) architectures designed for real-valued activations, potentially underusing spike-based communication and temporal state updates, motivating automated discovery of native SNN architectures. Most evolutionary neural architecture search (ENAS) methods operate within predefined configuration spaces, limiting discovery to mechanisms expressible within those spaces. We introduce OpenArchEvo, which uses large language models (LLMs) to evolve executable architecture code in an open program space under spiking-projection constraints. In this space, code differences need not reflect architectural novelty, while direct performance evaluation requires costly training. We construct a three-view representation spanning code, design rationale, and a behavioral fingerprint to support novelty estimation and performance prediction. The search treats predicted performance and estimated novelty as two objectives, using surrogate predictions to select candidates for expensive training evaluations. With an estimated candidate-training cost of 132 V100 GPU-days, the search uncovers multiple native SNN architectures, exemplified by three designs featuring mechanisms such as spike-activity-dependent control of state updates and residual pathways. The discovered NeuroGate surpasses the ANN DeltaNet on WikiText-103, and the discovered architectures reduce estimated architecture-level arithmetic energy by up to 50.6x (LoopMem) relative to a common dense Transformer (ANN) baseline. All code and all discovered architectures will be made publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenArchEvo：用 LLM 在开放程序空间中进化可执行的 SNN 架构代码，并以“代码—设计理由—行为指纹”三视图支撑新颖性估计与性能预测，从而以双目标代理搜索发现原生 SNN 架构。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）具备稀疏、事件驱动计算带来的低能耗序列建模潜力，但脉冲编码、神经元动力学与信息传播之间存在复杂耦合，架构设计困难。现有 SNN 序列模型多沿用面向实值激活的 ANN 架构，可能未充分利用脉冲通信与时间状态更新；而多数进化式神经架构搜索（ENAS）局限于预定义配置空间，只能发现该空间内可表达的机制，无法实现原生 SNN 架构的开放式发现。
AI.method: 提出 OpenArchEvo：利用大语言模型（LLM）在开放程序空间内进化可执行的架构代码，并施加脉冲投影约束。由于代码差异不一定对应架构新颖性，且直接评估需昂贵训练，方法构建覆盖代码、设计理由与行为指纹的三视图表示，用于新颖性估计与性能预测；搜索将预测性能与估计新颖性作为两个目标，通过代理预测筛选候选进入昂贵的训练评估。
AI.result: 在约 132 个 V100 GPU-天的候选训练成本下，搜索发现多个原生 SNN 架构，典型设计包括：脉冲活动依赖的状态更新控制、残差通路等机制。其中 NeuroGate 在 WikiText-103 上超过 ANN 的 DeltaNet；所发现架构相对常见稠密 Transformer（ANN）基线，可将架构级算术能耗估计最多降低 50.6 倍（LoopMem）。
AI.conclusion: 开放程序空间 + LLM 进化 + 三视图代理建模可有效发现原生 SNN 架构，兼顾性能与能效，突破预定义搜索空间的表达限制。代码与全部发现架构将公开。

title: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Source code and data available at Zenodo
summary: This work evaluates the direct transfer of a co-evolved communication protocol from a 2D simulation to a 3D physical environment, without retraining the network weights. Two e-puck-type robots, controlled by a GRU network with residual connection, were evaluated in a food-seeking task with social signaling. The sensory and motor translation layer required three corrections for stable physical operation, including the calibration of a hunger term based on a measurable asymmetry in the trained residual weights.
