Even with these corrections, the transfer was partial and asymmetric: one agent reached the food source in one of thirty tested seeds, while the other did not reach it in any. Task success was measured by both agents reaching the food area. An additional experiment incorporating explicit directional information in the social channel produced observable changes in the trajectory of the receiving agent and improvements in several specific cases. However, these improvements were not enough to allow the second agent to reach the food source, suggesting that the limitation may not be explained solely by signal translation, but also by the ability to navigate under the new physical constraints. The results suggest that successful transfer of emergent communication may depend not only on preserving the signaling process itself, but also on preserving the ecological and navigational conditions under which the protocol evolved.

AI.tldr: 该研究将二维仿真中协同演化出的通信协议直接迁移到三维实物机器人环境（不重新训练权重），结果迁移仅部分成功且不对称，表明迁移成败不仅取决于信号翻译，还取决于演化时生态与导航条件的保持。
AI.motivation: 检验涌现通信协议能否脱离原始仿真环境、直接迁移到真实物理机器人上，从而考察通信协议对训练生态与导航条件的依赖程度，以及"信号翻译"之外的限制因素。
AI.method: 使用两台e-puck型机器人，由带残差连接的GRU网络控制，在带社会信号的觅食任务中直接迁移2D仿真中协同演化出的通信协议，不重训权重；搭建感知—运动翻译层并进行三项修正（含基于训练残差权重中可测量非对称性的饥饿项校准）；另开展在通信通道中加入显式方向信息的对照实验。
AI.result: 翻译层修正后迁移仍为部分且不对称：三十个测试种子中仅一个使其中一台机器人到达食物源，另一台则无一成功（任务成功需两机同时到达）。加入显式方向信息可改变接收方的运动轨迹并在若干个案中带来改善，但不足以让第二台机器人到达食物源。
AI.conclusion: 涌现通信的成功迁移不仅依赖信号过程本身的保全，还依赖协议演化时所处生态与导航条件的保全；迁移失败不能仅归因于信号翻译，还涉及新物理约束下的导航能力。

title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce in complex algorithm-design scenarios. In this paper, we propose sample-efficient parametric self-evolution where agents can explore and learn from self-generated algorithms. First, we characterize in-context evolutionary stagnation and analytically propose the Improvement Chain proposition, showing how learning successive self-generated algorithms can locally increase the likelihood of neighboring algorithms. Motivated by this local-transfer perspective, we further propose Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO) to utilize a global population and a hybrid policy update scheme for retaining and reusing high-quality, diverse self-generated algorithms, shifting the policy towards stronger algorithms. In the task of learning rate schedule design for global placement in electronic design automation, trained only on 4 chip cases, PCPO outperforms the state-of-the-art in-context evolutionary methods (e.g., OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve) on average across 16 chip cases. With an 8B-size base model, PCPO achieves competitive performance compared to frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5.5. PCPO also reduces inference-time token cost by internalizing grounded domain knowledge and prompt distillation. Moreover, PCPO achieves significant speedups on four GPU kernel designs, with an average of 8.27$\times$ speedup against the PyTorch Eager baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出样本高效的参数化自进化方法 PCPO，使算法设计智能体从自生成算法中学习，在稀缺领域数据下超越上下文进化方法，并以 8B 模型比肩前沿闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有算法设计智能体多采用纯上下文进化框架，在需要专业知识的领域易陷入停滞；而参数化适应虽有助内化领域知识，却依赖充足的领域语料，这在高复杂度算法设计场景中难以满足（高质量算法稀缺）。因此需要一种样本高效的参数化自进化范式。
AI.method: 1) 刻画上下文进化的停滞现象，解析地提出"改进链"命题，说明学习连续自生成算法可局部提升相邻算法的成功概率；2) 基于这种局部迁移视角，提出群体策展策略优化（PCPO），利用全局种群与混合策略更新机制保留并复用高质量、多样化的自生成算法，使策略向更强算法偏移。
AI.result: 在电子设计自动化全局布局的学习率调度器设计任务中，仅用 4 个芯片案例训练，PCPO 在 16 个芯片案例上平均超越 SOTA 上下文进化方法（如 OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve）；以 8B 基础模型达到与 GPT-5.5 等前沿闭源模型相当的竞争力；通过内化领域知识与提示蒸馏降低推理 token 成本；在四个 GPU kernel 设计上平均取得 8.27× 于 PyTorch Eager 基线的加速。
AI.conclusion: 自生成算法的参数化自进化可在领域数据稀缺条件下实现样本高效学习，PCPO 兼具性能优势、成本优势和跨任务泛化能力，为算法设计智能体提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: T-Router: Learning Thalamic Routing for Reasoning with Parameter-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Parameter-efficient reinforcement learning aims to improve reasoning with a compact trainable interface to a pretrained model. We introduce the Thalamic Router (T-Router), which concentrates adaptation on the reuse of completed computations. A compressed, addressable bank preserves block changes; a depth-recurrent controller conditions their selection and relative-scale writeback. This coupling gives thalamic context-dependent routing a concrete computational form: learn which earlier contributions a receiving layer uses, and with what influence. Correctness rewards train the interface while preserving backbone parameters and layer order. On an 8.95B-parameter backbone, T-Router allocates 41.73M parameters (0.466% of the backbone) and achieves 83.64 +/- 1.16 MathAvg after GSM8K RL, compared with 73.79 +/- 1.83 for full-parameter GRPO across three evaluation rounds. At a comparable parameter budget and with matched retries, it exceeds LoRA's 77.28 +/- 1.95 MathAvg, improving all three task families and raising mean AIME accuracy from 48.33 to 60.56. Capacity-controlled comparisons favor addressable block changes and recurrent context; separate search training extends the interface to tool-mediated reasoning. These results establish controlled computation reuse as an effective route to parameter-efficient reasoning reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Thalamic Router (T-Router)，将参数高效强化学习的适配集中在"复用已完成计算"上：用可寻址的压缩 bank 保存 block 变化，用深度循环控制器调节其选择与相对缩放回写，仅训练 0.466% 参数即超越全参数 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 参数高效强化学习旨在用紧凑的可训练接口提升预训练模型的推理能力。本文希望把适配聚焦于对既往已完成计算的复用，并赋予"丘脑式情境依赖路由"一个具体的计算形式：让接收层学习使用哪些早期贡献、以何种影响强度使用。
AI.method: T-Router 包含两个耦合组件：(1) 压缩、可寻址的 bank，用于保存 block 级变化；(2) 深度循环控制器，用于条件化地选择这些变化并决定其相对缩放的回写。正确性奖励用于训练该接口，骨干参数与层序保持不变。通过容量控制对比验证可寻址 block 变化与循环情境的作用，并以单独搜索训练将接口扩展到工具中介推理。
AI.result: 在 8.95B 骨干上，T-Router 仅训练 41.73M 参数（占骨干 0.466%），GSM8K RL 后达到 83.64 ± 1.16 MathAvg，而全参数 GRPO 为 73.79 ± 1.83（三轮评估）。在相近参数预算与匹配重试次数下，超过 LoRA 的 77.28 ± 1.95 MathAvg，三类任务族全面提升，AIME 平均准确率由 48.33 提升至 60.56。
AI.conclusion: 受控计算复用是参数高效推理强化学习的一条有效路径；容量控制实验支持可寻址 block 变化与循环情境的增益，且该接口可扩展至工具中介推理。

title: From DNA Design to DNA Slimming: Auditable Agentic Discovery of a Deletion-Only Designer
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agentic AI for Biological Discovery
summary: Compact regulatory DNA can free up space in vector payloads, reduce synthesis and assay burden, and expose which sequence features drive predicted activity. Yet most model-based nucleic-acid designers optimize fixed-length sequences through substitutions; they do not ask which bases of an existing functional element can be removed while retaining predicted activity. We define the task of sequence slimming as selecting an exact-length, order-preserving subsequence while retaining activity. Modeled on the design benchmark NucleoBench, we propose a quantitative evaluation for slimming that balances sequence reduction with maintaining function. Each slimmer must return both the subsequence and its source indices, which can be used to verify that the slimmer obeyed task requirements. To our knowledge, this is the first dedicated benchmark of this deletion-only problem. The coding agent Empirical Research Assistant (ERA) then searched over executable designer programs. ERA received the task prompt and a successful substitution-only designer GrAdaBeam as a starting program, and it modified the designer to produce GRADASLIM. We report held-out evaluations for five transcription-factor binding targets, comparing random, greedy, and ERA-guided slimming at 400 and 100 bp. ERA has the highest mean in 9/10 settings. Paired bootstrap intervals for ERA minus greedy are above zero in all five 400-bp settings, below zero in one 100-bp setting, and overlap zero in the remaining four.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"序列瘦身"(sequence slimming)新任务：在保持预测活性的前提下，从功能DNA元件中选取等长、保序的子序列，并建立首个专门的删除型基准。
AI.motivation: 紧凑的调控DNA可释放载体载荷空间、降低合成与检测负担，并揭示驱动活性的序列特征。然而现有基于模型的核酸设计器多在固定长度上做碱基替换优化，未探索在保留预测活性的前提下能删除哪些碱基，因此缺少针对删除型问题的专用评估。
AI.method: 将序列瘦身定义为选取精确长度且保序的子序列同时保留活性，并基于NucleoBench设计兼顾序列缩减与功能保持的定量评价。瘦身器须同时返回子序列及其源索引以验证任务约束。使用编码智能体Empirical Research Assistant(ERA)在可执行设计程序上搜索，以仅替换型设计器GrAdaBeam为起始程序，将其改造为GRADASLIM。
AI.result: 在五个转录因子结合靶标的留出评估中，比较随机、贪心与ERA引导的瘦身在400 bp和100 bp两种长度下的表现。ERA在10个设置中的9个取得最高均值。ERA减贪心的配对自助法区间在全部5个400 bp设置中均高于零，在1个100 bp设置中低于零，其余4个与零重叠。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对该纯删除问题的专门基准，表明智能体引导的程序搜索能在多数设置下优于随机与贪心基线，尤其对400 bp长度效果稳定。

title: PrecipJEPA: JEPA-Regularized Future-State Prediction with Motion-Source Rendering for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Long-term precipitation nowcasting requires modeling radar-echo evolution while preserving localized high-intensity structures. Recent radar-specific studies motivate location-aware prediction and separating echo displacement from intensity change. However existing encoders learn historical representations mainly from final forecast errors. We propose PrecipJEPA, which couples a structured forecasting path with an auxiliary path that enriches its encoder from observed radar history. In the forecasting path, an online encoder first converts the observations into spatiotemporal tokens. The Task-Driven Future-State Predictor (TFP) combines these tokens with a recent-dynamics summary and spatiotemporal queries to construct future radar states. The Parallel Motion-Source Renderer (PMSR) decodes these states into motion and source-sink fields that transform the latest observation into future frames. During joint training, the History-Masked JEPA (H-JEPA) operates on the auxiliary path to predict masked historical features from visible context, directly supervising the same online encoder from the observed sequence. Experiments on SEVIR and MeteoNet show that PrecipJEPA improves highest-threshold CSI by 118.6% and 35.1%, respectively, over the strongest baselines, while maintaining the highest mean CSI throughout the 3-hour forecast.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrecipJEPA，通过双路径架构（结构化预报路径+历史掩码JEPA辅助路径）提升雷达回波长时降水临近预报性能。
AI.motivation: 长时降水临近预报需建模雷达回波演变并保留局地高强度结构。近期研究强调位置感知预测及将回波位移与强度变化分离，但现有编码器主要依赖最终预报误差来学习历史表征，监督信号有限。
AI.method: PrecipJEPA包含两条路径。预报路径中，在线编码器将观测转为时空token；Task-Driven Future-State Predictor（TFP）结合token、近期动力学摘要及时空查询构建未来雷达状态；Parallel Motion-Source Renderer（PMSR）将状态解码为运动场与源汇场，把最新观测变换为未来帧。联合训练时，辅助路径上的History-Masked JEPA（H-JEPA）由可见上下文预测被掩码的历史特征，直接以观测序列监督同一在线编码器。
AI.result: 在SEVIR与MeteoNet数据集上，PrecipJEPA相比最强基线最高阈值CSI分别提升118.6%和35.1%，并在3小时预报全程保持最高平均CSI。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入历史掩码JEPA辅助路径对在线编码器进行直接监督，PrecipJEPA有效增强历史表征学习，在保持高强度回波结构与长时预报稳定性方面显著优于现有方法。

title: Beyond Text: LLM-Based Dimensional Emotion Evaluation in Multimodal Dialogue
summary: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LLM的多模态对话情感评估框架，在IEMOCAP上同时进行离散情感识别与VAD维度评估，通过LoRA微调的LLaMA模型取得Valence CCC 0.7822的新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 连续维度情感评估在对话场景中研究不足，LLM在多模态对话情感评估上的应用尚未充分探索；同时需要验证声学线索以自然语言描述形式融入LLM的可行性及不同模型规模下的作用差异。
AI.method: 提出基于LLM的框架，在IEMOCAP上执行离散情感识别与VAD维度评估，参考SpeechCueLLM将声学线索转为自然语言描述；对LLaMA、GPT、Qwen三大家族共六个模型在零样本提示、少样本提示和LoRA微调三种设置下进行评估，并进行音频描述消融实验。
AI.result: LoRA微调的LLaMA模型在两个任务上均显著优于提示工程的GPT模型，尽管后者规模更大，差距归因于领域适配而非模型容量；最佳模型Valence CCC达0.7822，为IEMOCAP新SOTA；消融显示文本音频描述对较小模型提升明显（加权F1提升3.5–3.6），但对最大模型贡献有限；VAD各维度性能差异与IEMOCAP标注者一致性层级高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配比模型规模更关键；声学线索在语言能力受限的模型中价值更大；VAD维度间的性能不对称性反映了标注一致性差异。

title: Neural Audio Codec for Robust Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Audio deepfake detectors are typically evaluated on uncompressed audio, although real-world audio often undergoes low-bitrate coding. In this work, we investigate how audio coding affects deepfake detection across codecs, bitrates, and detectors, finding higher errors at lower rates. A mixed-pair protocol isolates codec-induced changes in bona fide and spoof audio, revealing asymmetric, codec-dependent failures: low-rate DAC and EnCodec mainly degrade bona fide detection, whereas X-Codec shows a stronger spoof-side limitation. Motivated by these, we propose a forensic-preserving neural audio codec (FP-NAC), which fine-tunes a pretrained codec using a detector-guided objective while preserving its native hard quantization path and bitrate. On ASVspoof 2019 LA, FP-NAC reduces EER by up to 49.8~pp compared with the original DAC at 0.5~kbps while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality. Although supervised by only one detector, FP-NAC improves performance across multiple detectors, highlighting forensic transparency as a codec design objective alongside perceptual quality. Our codes are available at https://github.com/kjungwoo03/FP-NAC.

AI.tldr: 本文研究音频编码（编解码器、比特率）对深度伪造检测的影响，发现低比特率下错误率更高，且不同编解码器对真实与伪造音频的破坏具有非对称性；为此提出保取证神经音频编解码器（FP-NAC），在保持原量化路径与比特率的前提下用检测器引导微调，在0.5 kbps下于ASVspoof 2019 LA上将EER最多降低49.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测器多在未压缩音频上评估，而真实场景音频常经过低比特率编码，导致评测与实际部署条件脱节；需要系统揭示编码对检测性能的影响机理并缓解该退化。
AI.method: 跨编解码器（DAC、EnCodec、X-Codec）、多比特率与多检测器开展评测；提出"混合配对"（mixed-pair）协议分离编码对真实/伪造音频的独立影响；据此设计FP-NAC，用检测器引导的目标微调预训练编解码器，同时保留其原生硬量化路径与比特率。
AI.result: 低比特率下检测错误率更高；失效模式随编解码器而异且呈非对称：低速率DAC、EnCodec主要损害真实音频检测，X-Codec则表现为更强的伪造侧限制。FP-NAC在ASVspoof 2019 LA上0.5 kbps时将EER较原DAC最多降低49.8个百分点，且重建质量相当；虽仅由单一检测器监督，却能跨多个检测器提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 音频编码会以非对称、依赖编解码器的方式破坏深度伪造检测；"取证透明性"应作为与感知质量并列的编解码器设计目标；FP-NAC通过检测器引导微调在保持比特率与重建质量的同时显著提升鲁棒检测性能，代码已开源。

title: TAGGRAPH: Tag-Augmented Graphs for Graph Retrieval of Agent Persistent Histories
comment: An earlier version was accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Lifelong Learning Agents (LLA)
summary: Long-term memory lets LLM agents recall past interactions and remain consistent across sessions, but memory systems are hard to compare because they often vary in representation, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation. We present a controlled evaluation framework based on shared 5W-style conversational memories. Localized graph configurations traverse a common base graph; AdaptiveGraph adds chronological edges and Personalized PageRank diffusion. We also evaluate BM25 over the same extracted notes and OpenClaw as a raw-input external reference. Retrieval rankings vary across memory settings. On LongMemEval-S, AdaptiveGraph is the strongest graph configuration at 0.844 MRR, but BM25 reaches 0.867 and OpenClaw 0.880. On ATANT Core, localized graph traversal outperforms diffusion and BM25, whereas BM25 leads the stress rounds. Reducing LongMemEval-S within the tested range does not reproduce the ATANT diffusion penalty, but the smallest tested store remains larger than ATANT Core, so store size cannot be ruled out. The penalty also persists under a permissive content-match criterion. Vocabulary normalization and extraction quality substantially affect graph retrieval, and missing extraction tags are common among top-five misses. Retrieval strategies should therefore be evaluated jointly with the memory setting and against strong lexical baselines.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于共享5W式对话记忆的受控评测框架，比较图配置、BM25与OpenClaw等检索方案，发现检索策略需与记忆设置联合评估并对标强词法基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体长期记忆系统在表示、索引、检索与评估上差异较大，难以直接比较，因此需要受控、可比的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建共享5W式对话记忆的受控评测框架；采用在公共基础图上遍历的局部化图配置，AdaptiveGraph加入时间顺序边与Personalized PageRank扩散；同时在相同抽取笔记上评测BM25，并以OpenClaw作为原始输入外部参照。
AI.result: 检索排名随记忆设置变化。LongMemEval-S上AdaptiveGraph为最强图配置（MRR 0.844），但BM25达0.867，OpenClaw达0.880；ATANT Core上局部化图遍历优于扩散与BM25，而BM25在压力轮次领先。缩小LongMemEval-S在测试范围内未复现ATANT的扩散劣势，但最小测试存储仍大于ATANT Core，故不能排除存储规模影响；该劣势在宽松内容匹配标准下仍存在。词汇归一化与抽取质量显著影响图检索，前五漏检中缺少抽取标签较常见。
AI.conclusion: 检索策略应与记忆设置联合评估，并与强词法基线对比，以避免对图检索优势的误判。

title: AdaM-Rec: Adaptive Modality Routing for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: While recent multimodal recommender systems have demonstrated the effectiveness of incorporating visual and textual information to improve downstream performance, most existing methods rely on static modality fusion, assuming that the relative importance of textual and visual signals remains stable across recommendation scenarios. This design may not fully account for an important variation across recommendation requests: some queries require fine-grained visual cues, whereas others are better served by textual or functional semantics, in which case indiscriminate modality fusion brings in uninformative cues and impairs recommendation quality. To address this, we propose AdaM-Rec, an LLM-based framework for adaptive modality routing in multimodal recommendation, which enables dynamic calibration of reliance on textual and multimodal evidence for user-specific queries. Built on structured natural-language representations of items and user preferences, it estimates modality reliability using proxy recall tasks. Specifically, it generates pseudo-queries that match the granularity of the actual query while pointing to the user's positively interacted items as verifiable proxy targets, evaluating which modality yields better recall performance in analogous scenarios and optimizing the routing strategy in an agentic manner. It then performs routed recall with optimized strategy, enriches results with collaborative items, and ranks candidates by their relevance to both the query and user preferences. Experiments demonstrate that AdaM-Rec delivers strong performance against state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness and broader potential of adaptive control over modality reliance in multimodal recommendation.

AI.tldr: AdaM-Rec是一种基于LLM的多模态推荐框架，通过自适应模态路由动态调节对文本与多模态证据的依赖，利用代理召回任务估计模态可靠性，并以智能体方式优化路由策略，实验证明其优于现有最优基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法多采用静态模态融合，假设文本与视觉信号的相对重要性在不同推荐场景中保持稳定。然而不同查询需求各异：有的依赖细粒度视觉线索，有的更适合文本或功能语义，不加区分地融合会引入无效线索、损害推荐质量。
AI.method: 提出AdaM-Rec框架。基于物品与用户偏好的结构化自然语言表示，通过代理召回任务估计模态可靠性：生成与实际查询粒度匹配、指向用户正向交互物品作为可验证代理目标的伪查询，评估哪种模态在类似场景下召回更优，并以智能体方式优化路由策略。随后用优化策略进行路由召回，融入协同过滤物品丰富结果，并依据查询与用户偏好的相关性对候选排序。
AI.result: 实验表明，AdaM-Rec相较于当前最先进的基线方法表现强劲，验证了自适应控制多模态依赖在推荐中的有效性与更广泛潜力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应模态路由能够动态校准对文本与多模态证据的依赖，有效提升多模态推荐性能，展示了该方向的应用前景。

title: Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering
comment: on September 21st submitted for consideration to the Elsevier Data and Information Management (DIM) journal (DIM-D-26-00430)
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向科学问答的可复现RAG测试平台，在46万余篇arXiv论文语料上对六种检索策略进行受控对比，并发布了包含19,484条问题的合成数据集与代码。
AI.motivation: RAG已成为将大语言模型锚定于外部知识的标准方法，但检索流水线的设计空间庞大，各变体间的权衡关系尚不清晰，尤其在真实规模的领域特定语料上缺乏系统性理解。现有研究缺少共享生成器、提示与评测协议的可控对比，也缺少大规模、可复现的评测基准。
AI.method: 在统一设置下对比六种检索策略：(i)经典top-k稠密检索；(ii)基于LLM的查询改写；(iii)查询改写+LLM重排序；(iv)基于RRF的多查询融合；(v)由生成器自主决定是否检索的智能体工具调用流水线；(vi)ColBERTv2后期交互检索。六者共享同一生成器（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）、提示与评测协议；五个单向量流水线共享SPECTER2嵌入与Chroma向量库；均从2024-2025年共463,971篇arXiv论文全语料检索。同时发布由Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct从10,000篇论文随机样本生成的合成问题数据集（问题陈述与方法论问题共19,484条，9,742篇论文查询生成成功），所有策略在同一查询集上评测。
AI.result: 完成了六种流水线的架构与实现描述，并发布代码与合成问题数据集；采用LLM-as-a-judge协议在多个质量维度上评估，并结合直接的金标准论文检索指标。形成一个研究RAG设计选择在成本与质量间权衡的开放测试平台，为可信度、检索鲁棒性与智能体检索等后续研究奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个开放的可复现测试平台，用于在研究文献语料上系统研究RAG设计选择的成本-质量权衡，并可作为未来忠实度、检索鲁棒性与智能体检索研究的基础。

title: Exploring Forum Post Retrieval with Generative Modeling
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as an alternative to embedding-based retrieval, building on the success of generative models in language and vision. We are exploring GR on Facebook Forum, a standalone application for medium-to-heavy users of Facebook Groups. Because Forum is a new surface, its own interaction data are too sparse to train a GR model from scratch. We address this with transfer along two axes: we train on a broader corpus of Facebook Groups engagements rather than Forum sessions alone, and we reuse hierarchical, prefix-based semantic IDs (SIDs) learned from cross-platform Facebook Feed data instead of fitting a Forum-specific tokenizer. A 3B-parameter instruction-tuned language model is then supervised-fine-tuned to generate SIDs directly from user context. We systematically ablate the design choices that matter most in practice, including SID construction, the composition and length of user history, and the inclusion of user-profile features. Our results show that cross-platform SIDs transfer to a new recommendation surface, and offer practical guidance for teams deploying GR on real-world social platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文将生成式推荐(GR)落地到Facebook Forum新场景，通过两层迁移解决数据稀疏问题：在更广泛的Facebook Groups互动语料上训练，并复用来自跨平台Facebook Feed的层次化前缀式语义ID(SID)，再用3B指令微调语言模型直接从用户上下文生成SID，并系统消融了SID构建、用户历史组成与长度、用户画像特征等关键设计。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐在语言与视觉生成模型成功基础上，成为替代基于嵌入检索的方案。但Forum作为新独立应用，其自身交互数据过于稀疏，无法从零训练GR模型，因此需要研究如何在数据稀缺的新推荐面上有效迁移部署GR。
AI.method: 采用双轴迁移策略：一是训练数据从仅Forum会话扩展到更广泛的Facebook Groups互动语料；二是复用从跨平台Facebook Feed数据学到的层次化、前缀式语义ID(SID)，而非拟合Forum专属tokenizer。随后对3B参数指令微调语言模型进行监督微调，使其直接从用户上下文生成SID。并系统消融SID构建方式、用户历史构成与长度、是否引入用户画像特征等设计选择。
AI.result: 实验表明跨平台SID能够迁移到新的推荐面，验证了在数据稀疏的新场景中复用跨平台语义ID与更广泛互动语料的可行性；消融实验揭示了实际部署中最关键的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 跨平台语义ID可有效迁移至新推荐面，为在真实社交平台上部署生成式推荐提供了实用指导。

title: PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Code at https://github.com/Aizhouym/PatchHolmes
summary: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.

AI.tldr: PatchHolmes是一个两阶段补丁检索系统：第一阶段混合检索器给出候选列表，第二阶段用智能体以列表式方式读取前100候选并用四种受限工具选择性核查3~10个提交，最终提交唯一最佳提交。在GitHubAD上Recall@1较Favia提升25.34%、较IRCoT提升31.40%，且仅需一次智能体会话（Favia需十次）；固定候选集时智能体相对检索器top-1再增27.32% Recall@1，迁移至PatchFinder_top10可将Recall@1从24.28%提升至39.86%。
AI.motivation: 补丁检索是漏洞管理流程的基础，但主流咨询数据库中60%~63%的CVE缺少补丁链接。既有方法多为逐点（pointwise）独立打分，无法利用候选间的全局比较信息，且部分方法需多次会话或外部检索，成本高、效果受限。
AI.method: 提出两阶段系统PatchHolmes：第一阶段为混合检索器生成候选；第二阶段引入智能体检查循环，不同于逐点打分，智能体一次性以列表式（listwise）读取top-100候选，并通过四种带预算的工具选择性阅读3~10个提交，最终提交单一最佳提交。系统在冻结的开源权重模型上运行，基于本地Git仓库，无需微调或外部搜索API。
AI.result: 在GitHubAD上，PatchHolmes的Recall@1较逐点二分类器Favia高25.34%、较retrieve-and-CoT基线IRCoT高31.40%，且每CVE仅需一次智能体会话（Favia需十次）。在候选集完全一致时，智能体相对取检索器top-1额外提升27.32% Recall@1；同一智能体原样迁移至PatchFinder_top10，将Recall@1从PatchFinder自身top-1的24.28%提升至39.86%。在Qwen家族内更换LLM骨干，Recall@1波动小于1%；换用gpt-oss仍显著高于无智能体基线，说明增益来自列表式智能体循环。
AI.conclusion: 增益源于列表式智能体循环而非特定模型或外部信息，系统可在冻结的开放权重模型与本地Git仓库上运行，无需微调或外部搜索API，具备良好可迁移性与工程可行性。

title: SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Code at https://github.com/guanqun-yang/SkillSeek
summary: Anthropic's Agent Skills package reusable procedural know-how for an LLM agent into SKILL.md directories, and open-source aggregations have grown past 230,000 skills, making selection rather than authoring the bottleneck. The standing answer in the literature outsources selection to the agent itself: an LLM-mediated retrieval loop that rewrites queries and refines candidates inside the agent's decision loop, paying LLM tokens on every task. We present SkillSeek, an open-source two-stage skill retriever built from the standard IR recipe (a BGE-base bi-encoder feeding a small cross-encoder, exposed over MCP). Across a $4 \times 11$ grid of pool, backbone, and method on the 89-task SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSeek reaches observed parity with the LLM-mediated loop of Liu et al. at essentially no extra cost: plain bm25 alone records a pass rate at or above their refined loop on three of four settings, and a small cross-encoder covers the remaining difference on the fourth. A first-stage recall ceiling explains the pattern, and total per-trial spend drops from USD 51.30 to USD 27.54 (within fifty cents of the no-skill baseline). Under the SkillsBench tasks and OpenHands harness we tested, this positions the standard IR recipe as a strong default for agent-skill retrieval, with LLM-mediated alternatives a natural fit for cases where deterministic methods fall short.

AI.tldr: 提出开源两阶段技能检索器 SkillSeek（BGE-base 双编码器 + 小型交叉编码器，经 MCP 暴露），在 SkillsBench 89 任务上以近乎零额外成本达到与 LLM 中介检索循环相当的通过率，单次试验总花费从 51.30 美元降至 27.54 美元。
AI.motivation: 随着 Anthropic Agent Skills 等开源技能库规模突破 23 万条，瓶颈已从"编写技能"转为"选择技能"。现有文献的主流做法是把选择外包给智能体自身，即在决策循环内用 LLM 改写查询、精炼候选的检索循环，每个任务都消耗 LLM token，成本高昂。
AI.method: SkillSeek 采用标准信息检索配方：第一阶段用 BGE-base 双编码器做召回，第二阶段用小型交叉编码器做重排，并通过 MCP 接口暴露。在 SkillsBench 的 89 个任务上，作者在池规模、骨干模型与方法构成的 4×11 网格中进行评测，与 Liu 等人的 LLM 中介循环对比。
AI.result: SkillSeek 与 LLM 中介循环观察到性能持平且几乎无额外成本：单独使用 bm25 在四种设置中有三种的通过率达到或超过其精炼循环，小型交叉编码器补足第四种设置的差距。第一阶段召回上限可解释该模式；单次试验总花费从 51.30 美元降至 27.54 美元，与无技能基线相差不到 0.5 美元。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的 SkillsBench 任务与 OpenHands 框架下，标准 IR 配方可作为智能体技能检索的强默认方案，LLM 中介替代方案更适合确定性方法失效的场景。

title: Text-Video Retrieval via Multi-Dimensional Saliency Assessment and Granularity-Aware Query Decomposition
summary: Text-video retrieval, which aims to bridge visual and textual modalities by learning a joint embedding space, has become a crucial task in multimodal intelligence. Despite extensive efforts to mitigate visual redundancy, previous methods typically rely on a single-aspect criterion to assess visual importance, overlooking the multifaceted spatiotemporal nature of video. In addition, encoding text into a single global embedding to align with videos compresses temporal events and spatial entities into a unified representation space, further aggravating cross-modal misalignment. To address these issues, we propose MMTI, a method that jointly mitigates visual redundancy and enables multi-grained text-video interaction to achieve accurate multi-grained semantic alignment. Specifically, a key feature selection (KFS) mechanism adaptively identifies and aggregates informative frames and patches by jointly evaluating multi-dimensional saliency and learnable importance scores, effectively compacting dense visual features and mitigating visual redundancy. Furthermore, our proposed multi-grained text-video interaction module (TVIM) employs a dynamic gating mechanism to decompose the text query into sentence, frame, and patch queries (SFP), enabling multi-grained text-video alignment. Complementary alignment at different granularities is thereby achieved. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MMTI方法，通过关键特征选择机制缓解视觉冗余，并借助多粒度文本-视频交互模块实现多粒度语义对齐，在四个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本-视频检索方法在评估视觉重要性时多依赖单一维度准则，忽视了视频的多维时空特性；同时将文本编码为单一全局嵌入与视频对齐，会压缩时序事件与空间实体，加剧跨模态错位。
AI.method: MMTI包含两个核心组件：1）关键特征选择（KFS）机制，通过联合评估多维显著性与可学习重要性分数，自适应识别并聚合有信息量的帧与图像块，压缩稠密视觉特征；2）多粒度文本-视频交互模块（TVIM），采用动态门控机制将文本查询分解为句子、帧、块三级查询（SFP），实现多粒度文本-视频对齐。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合缓解视觉冗余与多粒度文本-视频交互，MMTI实现了准确的多粒度语义对齐，验证了多维度重要性与多层次对齐在文本-视频检索中的有效性。

title: When LLM-Inferred User Context Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation
summary: Contextual information in recommender systems is shifting from static, predefined variables toward latent representations inferred from behavior. Large language models support this shift by rendering an unstructured interaction history as a natural-language summary, which yields a thematic user context that can be encoded and used in place of an aggregate profile. The conditions under which such generated profiles outperform aggregate embeddings have received limited characterization mainly at the domain level. We evaluate semantic user-profiling strategies on a production streaming platform, ranking against the full catalog. The evaluation covers a 2*2 design space crossing representation type (aggregate or LLM-generated) with contextual scope (holistic history or attention-fused short-term and long-term contexts). The relative ordering of the two representation types is conditional on the user's consumption regime. Aggregate profiles are consistently stronger under habitual consumption, which characterizes approximately four-fifths of the population, while LLM-generated profiles are stronger for exploratory users whose subsequent interactions diverge semantically from their history. We also observe a popularity-attractor effect in LLM-generated profiles, which modestly raises within-list diversity while substantially lowering catalog coverage and reducing novelty. These results indicate that a context-aware system can select a profiling strategy from the inferred consumption regime rather than applying one representation to all users.

AI.tldr: 在生产级流媒体平台上，对比聚合画像与LLM生成用户画像在不同消费模式下的排序表现，发现表征优劣取决于用户的习惯性或探索性消费模式。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中的上下文正从静态预定义变量转向由行为推断的潜在表征。LLM可将非结构化交互历史渲染为自然语言摘要，形成主题化的用户上下文以替代聚合画像。但目前关于生成式画像在何种条件下优于聚合嵌入的表征尚不充分，且多停留在领域层面，缺少面向全目录排序、跨消费模式的细粒度刻画。
AI.method: 在生产级流媒体平台上评估语义用户画像策略，对完整目录进行排序。实验采用2×2设计空间，交叉表征类型（聚合画像 vs. LLM生成画像）与上下文范围（整体历史 vs. 注意力融合的短期与长期上下文）。
AI.result: 两种表征的相对排序取决于用户的消费模式：在约占人口五分之四的习惯性消费用户中，聚合画像始终更强；对于后续交互在语义上偏离其历史的探索性用户，LLM生成画像更强。此外，LLM生成画像存在流行度吸引效应，会略微提升列表内多样性，但显著降低目录覆盖率和降低新颖性。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知系统可依据推断出的消费模式为不同用户动态选择画像策略，而非对所有用户统一采用单一表征。

title: RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026. 12 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables
summary: Sessionized interaction histories contain behavioral patterns that can improve sequential recommendation. However, existing models process all sessions through the same parameterized blocks, regardless of their behavioral differences. Mixture of Experts (MoE) enables conditional computation, but it leaves open what should guide expert allocation. We propose RouteRec, a sequential recommender that uses observed session behavior as the routing criterion. RouteRec summarizes four types of behavioral evidence from sessionized histories: interaction tempo, item-group focus, repetition and carryover, and popularity tendency. It uses these cues to route computation at macro, mid, and micro scopes. Cue-derived scores first select expert groups; within each selected group, the current backbone state then refines expert selection. Across six public datasets and 18 dataset-metric combinations, RouteRec ranks first in 12 and second in three, yielding the best overall average rank of 1.61 compared with 4.11 for the next-best baseline. Additional analyses suggest that the behavioral cues guide expert allocation beyond added capacity and produce routing patterns aligned with observed behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/jy1559/RouteRec

AI.tldr: 提出 RouteRec，一种以会话行为证据作为路由依据的序列推荐模型，通过多粒度专家分配提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐模型对所有会话使用同一套参数化模块，忽略了会话间的行为差异；MoE 虽支持条件计算，但“以什么作为专家分配依据”尚未明确。
AI.method: RouteRec 从会话化历史中提取四类行为证据（交互节奏、物品组关注、重复与延续、流行度倾向），在宏观、中观、微观三个粒度上路由计算：先由线索得分选择专家组，再在组内用当前骨干状态细化专家选择。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集、18 个数据集-指标组合上，RouteRec 有 12 项排名第一、3 项排名第二，平均排名 1.61，优于次优基线的 4.11。
AI.conclusion: 行为线索能够在增加容量之外有效引导专家分配，且产生的路由模式与观察到的会话行为一致；代码已开源。

title: Routing Between Generative and Collaborative User Profiles: A Serving-Time Gate for Controllable Novelty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable rich semantic user profiles for recommendation, but such profiles are more expensive to generate and are not necessarily desirable to deploy uniformly. We study whether LLM-generated profiles can instead be invoked selectively within a production recommendation pipeline. Using a real-world streaming dataset covering movies, TV shows, and sports content, we train a serving-time routing gate that assigns each user to either a collaborative sequential recommendation model or a recommendation model driven by an LLM-generated profile. The gate uses only serving-time features and learns to identify users for whom profile-based routing can increase Novelty@10 while preserving ranking relevance. A routing threshold controls how aggressively users are sent to the generative model, exposing a tunable novelty--relevance trade-off. At an overall NDCG-loss budget of 5\%, the learned gate increases Novelty@10 by 6.5\% while routing 12.5\% of users, outperforming simple heuristic and random routing policies at comparable relevance cost. These results show that LLM-generated user profiles can serve as a controllable complement to collaborative recommendation, while results with non-generative semantic profiles indicate that the benefit stems from selective routing rather than LLM generation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在生产级推荐流程中"选择性调用"LLM生成的用户画像：训练一个仅使用服务时特征的路由门控，将用户分流至协同序列模型或LLM画像驱动模型，并通过路由阈值调节新颖性与相关性的权衡，结果显示选择性路由可在可控相关性代价下显著提升新颖性。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成语义丰富的用户画像以增强推荐，但此类画像生成成本高，且并非对所有用户都值得统一部署。因此需要研究能否在生产推荐管线中按需、有选择地调用LLM画像，而非全局启用。
AI.method: 基于覆盖电影、剧集与体育内容的真实流媒体数据集，训练一个服务时路由门控（serving-time routing gate）。该门控仅使用服务时可获得的特征，将每个用户分配至协同序列推荐模型或LLM画像驱动的推荐模型；通过路由阈值控制被送往生成式模型的用户比例，从而显式暴露新颖性—相关性的可调权衡。并与简单启发式与随机路由策略进行对比。
AI.result: 在整体NDCG损失预算为5%的约束下，所学门控将Novelty@10提升6.5%，同时仅路由12.5%的用户，在相当的相关性代价下优于启发式与随机路由策略。此外，使用非生成式语义画像的实验结果表明，收益主要来自选择性路由，而非LLM生成本身。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的用户画像可作为协同推荐的"可控补充"：通过选择性路由在相关性约束下提升推荐新颖性，其增益来源是选择性路由机制，而非单纯依赖LLM生成能力，为生产推荐系统的画像调用提供了可调、成本可控的部署范式。

title: Learning Multiresolution Relevance for Hierarchical Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval with semantic identifiers (SIDs) makes successive decisions over a document hierarchy. Relevant documents for the same query may share coarse prefixes and diverge at finer depths, with branching patterns varying across queries. These paths reveal how relevance is distributed across successive refinements, yet standard full-SID supervision treats them as separate training targets. To make this allocation explicit, we formulate multiresolution relevance as consistent conditional distributions induced by a single document-level relevance measure across the SID hierarchy. We introduce \textbf{RARS}, \textbf{R}esolution-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{R}elevance \textbf{S}upervision, which uses the resulting refinement-level distributions to supervise a shared query representation. RARS aggregates document relevance over prefixes and trains a prefix-conditioned predictor to allocate relevance among sibling branches. All relevance-bearing children participate in local competition, and each local loss is weighted by the relevance mass reaching its parent. This objective trains the query encoder to capture both the coarse structure shared by relevant documents and their finer branch allocations. The predictor is discarded after training, preserving standard autoregressive retrieval at inference. Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/RARS

AI.tldr: 本文提出RARS（Resolution-Aligned Relevance Supervision），将多分辨率相关性建模为SID层级上由单一文档级相关性度量诱导的一致条件分布，用细化层级分布监督共享查询表示；训练时引入前缀条件预测器进行兄弟分支间相关性分配，推理时丢弃预测器，保持标准自回归检索。在三个多语言ESCI区域上一致优于全SID训练及多种软目标/采样树监督基线。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索中，同一查询的相关文档常共享粗粒度前缀而在细粒度深度分叉，分支模式因查询而异。这些路径体现相关性在各层细化中的分配方式，但标准全SID监督把它们当作相互独立的训练目标，未显式刻画这种跨分辨率的相关性分配结构。
AI.method: 将多分辨率相关性形式化为SID层级上由单一文档级相关性度量诱导的一致条件分布。RARS利用由此得到的细化层级分布监督共享查询表示：对前缀聚合文档相关性，训练前缀条件预测器在兄弟分支间分配相关性；所有承载相关性的子节点参与局部竞争，每个局部损失以其父节点获得的相关性质量加权，从而让查询编码器同时捕获相关文档共享的粗粒度结构与更细的分支分配。预测器训练后丢弃，推理仍为标准自回归检索。
AI.result: 在三个多语言ESCI区域上，RARS相对匹配的全SID训练在自回归解码下取得一致提升；在统一检索规则下优于分组软目标、解码器软目标与采样树监督；增益在不同标识符结构与相关性定义下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模SID层级上的多分辨率相关性分配可为生成式检索提供更一致的监督信号，且不改变推理时的标准自回归检索流程，具有跨语言、跨标识符结构与跨相关性定义的稳健性。

title: Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/iclr2027_ResTD.git.

AI.tldr: 提出ResTD框架，将RQ索引过程中被丢弃的残差轨迹信息蒸馏进生成式检索训练，在不改变索引与推理流程的前提下提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索使用离散语义ID（SID），基于残差量化（RQ）构建SID时，标准检索训练只监督被选中的码字，丢弃了产生这些码的残差轨迹。同一硬码可能源于对不同竞争码字的偏好差异，残差轨迹还包含后续量化决策的信息；硬SID监督将不同的量化行为坍缩为相同目标，浪费了索引阶段可用的信息。
AI.method: ResTD（Residual Trajectory Distillation）框架：将冻结的RQ索引器视为过程教师，把残差诱导的码字偏好蒸馏到SID解码状态中。该监督恢复了硬分配所隐藏的区分度，并使较早的解码器状态在生成对应SID后缀之前就能捕获后续量化决策的信息。整个过程保留原始检索索引与推理流程，并可扩展到生成式推荐。
AI.result: 在多语言电商检索实验中，ResTD相对强基线和匹配的训练对照均有稳定提升；受控比较显示残差派生目标优于所测试的仅码本软目标；表示探针表明未来码本偏好可从更早的解码器状态中更有效地恢复。
AI.conclusion: 残差轨迹中的被丢弃信息可有效融入检索学习，ResTD在保持原有索引与推理流程的同时提升生成式检索性能，并可推广至生成式推荐。代码已开源。

title: Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin
summary: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: GEAR是一个端到端生成式检索推荐框架，通过BasisVQ/BasisRQ稳定码本、结合上下文条件重排头解决词元碰撞，并联合优化分词器、生成器与重排器，已在抖音广告大规模线上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索虽将推荐建模为离散物品词元生成，但在真实大规模系统中存在两个耦合瓶颈：一是连续分布漂移下物品分词器易表示坍缩，难以稳定端到端适配；二是候选池庞大导致不同物品共享相同词元序列的物品碰撞，损害检索精度。且扩大码本容量缓解碰撞会加剧坍缩，需同时解决。
AI.method: 提出GEAR端到端框架，联合优化分词器、生成器与重排器。针对表示坍缩，设计BasisVQ，用正交基重参数化码本，实现全局梯度共享与潜空间刚性旋转，稳定梯度动态且无需启发式技巧；并扩展为前缀感知的BasisRQ，在相同渐近时间复杂度下增强码本表达能力。针对物品碰撞，在生成过程中集成上下文条件重排头，以极小计算开销高效区分碰撞物品，统一稳定分词与联合重排，形成完全可微、可扩展范式。
AI.result: 在抖音广告服务数亿日活用户，通过大量线上A/B测试取得显著的经验性提升。
AI.conclusion: GEAR通过统一稳定分词与联合重排的端到端生成框架，同时缓解表示坍缩与物品碰撞，具备可微、可扩展特性，已在大规模真实推荐系统中验证有效。

title: When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation
comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Camera-ready version (CC BY 4.0). RecSys Challenge 2026 Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026, Minneapolis, October 2, 2026. Code and audit artifacts: https://github.com/Sanjeev-S/recsys2026-request-audit
summary: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了LLM生成的对话推荐基准中标签的有效性：在TalkPlay基准中，用户明确点名的歌曲请求与官方标签在半数被审回合中相矛盾；通过在小部分训练回合中加入catalog解析的满足请求的目标，可在冲突回合上获得53.3%的相对nDCG@20提升，同时不损害官方指标。
AI.motivation: LLM流水线生成的合成对话已成为完整对话推荐基准，其中LLM听众与LLM推荐器对话，对话中下一个被记录的曲目成为每轮的官方标签。这些由策略选定的标签使大规模评估可复现，但它们只是模拟用户实际请求的代理。论文动机在于审计标签与请求可直接比较的场景——用户按名称点播确切歌曲的回合，揭示代理标签可能存在系统性偏差。
AI.method: 在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准中，仅使用可见对话和目录元数据，审计用户明确点名歌曲的回合，比较官方标签与用户请求的一致性。提出训练时补充方法：在训练回合的一小部分中加入经目录解析的满足请求的目标（catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets），并与仅使用官方标签训练的匹配对照组进行验证。
AI.result: 在被审计的开发集回合中，官方标签与用户确切歌曲请求相矛盾的比例达到一半。引入训练时补充后，在43个冲突回合上nDCG@20获得53.3%的相对提升，同时官方指标保持不变；该效果经匹配对照组验证，对照组能检测到相同请求但仅使用官方标签训练。
AI.conclusion: 命名目标物品是真实音乐搜索中的主导意图，部署系统避免用替代品替换明确命名的物品，因为这会损害满意度。合成的策略选定标签存在偏差；通过少量训练时补充即可在冲突回合上显著改善性能且不牺牲官方指标，表明基准标签质量值得审计并可低成本修正。

title: KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍快手OneRec系列生成式推荐模型（含OneRec/OneRec-V2、OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason）的演进，指出推理式思维链（CoT）并非总能提升推荐效果，并通过语义对齐、结构化模板监督与强化学习改进，同时宣布与SIGIR 2026合办LLM-Rec Reasoning Generative Recommendation挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐是构建下一代智能推荐系统的前沿方向；在大语言模型推动下，团队希望将物品语义ID与自然语言统一表示，释放自然语言思维链推理在推荐中的潜力。但前期发现引入推理CoT并不总能带来推荐性能提升，因此需要探究如何让推理真正有利于推荐。
AI.method: 基于语义ID的OneRec/OneRec-V2自回归下一物品预测范式，并扩展出OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason系列；其中OneReason通过强化物品与语言的语义对齐、引入结构化模板式兴趣推理监督、以及先进强化学习技术，使推理更有利于推荐。
AI.result: OneRec/OneRec-V2已大规模生产部署，验证了自回归下一物品预测范式在工业推荐系统中的规模化潜力；前期工作表明推理CoT对推荐性能并非稳定正向，OneReason针对性改进以提升推理收益。
AI.conclusion: 推理生成式推荐作为推荐基础模型的前沿课题具有重要研究价值，团队联合SIGIR 2026举办KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation，鼓励更多研究者共同探索。

title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文对决策导向模型Jev在个性化推荐重排序任务中进行了受控实证研究，比较其与推荐专用模型及pointwise/listwise Qwen重排器的推荐效果与服务延迟，发现Jev在保持较强推荐效果的同时延迟增长更平缓，但整体延迟仍高于推荐专用模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型用于推荐重排序时存在推荐质量与服务效率之间的权衡。作者希望探究当重排序本质上是在预定义候选项中进行结构化选择时，决策导向模型是否能提供有用的替代方案。
AI.method: 对TypeSafe AI提出的"System One Model"——Jev进行受控实证研究，用于个性化推荐重排序，并与推荐专用模型以及pointwise和listwise Qwen重排器进行对比。实验覆盖多个Amazon Reviews领域和不同候选集规模，同时评估推荐有效性和实际观测的服务延迟。
AI.result: Jev相对于所评估的基线保持了较强的推荐有效性，且其延迟随候选集规模增长比pointwise Qwen重排器平缓得多；但其观测到的服务延迟仍显著高于推荐专用模型。
AI.conclusion: Jev在不同候选规模与领域上处于一个独特的质量—延迟运行区间。这些发现为将决策导向模型应用于推荐及其他具有结构化输出空间的排序任务提供了进一步研究的动机。

title: Life-Bench: A Benchmark and Knowledge Graph Framework for Multimodal Personalization Beyond Concept Recognition
summary: As large language models increasingly power personal assistants, users expect them to reason over multimodal life histories, from recognizing people to understanding events to aggregating patterns, yet existing benchmarks primarily target concept-level recognition. We introduce Life-Bench, a fully synthetic, human-verified multimodal benchmark of over 11,800 question-answer pairs across 10 tasks, organized by required evidence scope: concept identification, event understanding, and aggregated reasoning. The benchmark's photo-centric personal histories are distributionally aligned with real user accounts under embedding statistic. The interconnected structure of personal data invites graph-based solutions; we propose LifeGraph, a personal knowledge graph framework providing structured retrieval with on-demand access to source visual evidence, showing particular promise on event and aggregated tasks. Systematic evaluation of four retrieval paradigms on Life-Bench demonstrates that accuracy degrades sharply with evidence scope, falling below 0.40 on aggregated tasks, and that no single paradigm dominates across categories. Performance beyond concept recognition remains modest for all evaluated methods, establishing personalization over multimodal histories as an open challenge and Life-Bench as a testbed for future progress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Life-Bench——一个覆盖 11,800+ 问答对、10 项任务的全合成多模态个人生活史基准，并按证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解、聚合推理三类；同时提出基于个人知识图谱的 LifeGraph 框架，实验表明现有方法在聚合任务上准确率低于 0.40，多模态生活史个性化仍是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益充当个人助理，用户期望其能对多模态生活史进行推理（识别人物、理解事件、聚合模式），但现有基准主要聚焦于概念级识别，缺乏对更高层证据范围推理能力的评测手段，因此需要构建更贴近真实个人数据的多模态基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Life-Bench：全合成、经人工校验的多模态基准，含 10 项任务、逾 11,800 问答对，按所需证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解、聚合推理三类；其以照片为中心的个人历史数据在嵌入统计上与真实用户账号分布对齐。2) 提出 LifeGraph：利用个人数据的互联结构，构建个人知识图谱框架，提供结构化检索并支持按需访问原始视觉证据。3) 在 Life-Bench 上系统评测四种检索范式。
AI.result: 准确率随证据范围扩大而急剧下降，聚合类任务低于 0.40；没有任何单一检索范式在所有类别中占优；LifeGraph 在事件理解与聚合类任务上表现突出；所有评测方法在超越概念识别的任务上性能普遍有限。
AI.conclusion: 对多模态生活史的个性化推理仍是开放挑战，Life-Bench 可作为推动未来进展的测试平台。

title: Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas
summary: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用Doc-to-LoRA超网络为每篇论文生成LoRA适配器，使论文空间中的点（包括向量混合点）可直接表示为可对话的LLM；该表示既支持生成（混合点可命名子领域、生成摘要）也支持检索（经可逆变换后与SPECTER2等相当）。
AI.motivation: 传统论文向量表示仅用于相似度检索，向量混合虽可模拟"组合式创新"，但混合点往往对应尚无真实论文存在的想法，缺乏邻近文献可供解读，无法被查询或验证。作者希望让空间中任意点（含混合点）都能以自然语言被提问和指导，从而把"检索"与"生成"统一起来，作为发现和生成新想法的起点。
AI.method: 1) 用Doc-to-LoRA超网络将每篇论文编码为一个LoRA适配器，空间中每一点（含混合点）即对应一个开放自然语言问答与指令的LLM；2) 在APS（美国物理学会）论文上，对每个子领域的平均点指示LLM用少数词命名该领域；3) 在两篇APS论文之间的插值点上让LLM撰写摘要并观察随混合权重变化；4) 为兼顾检索，训练一个小型可逆变换（invertible transform）作用于嵌入，使其在检索任务上具竞争力；因变换可逆，变换后空间中每点仍可映射回对应LLM。
AI.result: 在APS数据上，对子领域平均点命名所得标签，按词重叠度和五位LLM评审小组评判，均比五个基线更接近官方领域名称；在两篇论文之间的插值点上生成的摘要描述随混合权重从一篇论文平滑过渡到另一篇；经可逆变换后，嵌入检索性能与SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma相当，接近SBERT。
AI.conclusion: 将论文表示为LoRA适配器使向量空间中任意点（含混合点）都可作为可对话LLM，兼顾检索与生成；可逆变换保证检索能力的同时不丢失生成能力，使研究者能对空间中任意点的想法进行提问，作为生成新想法的起点。

title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a multi-objective optimization problem where a multi-stage pipeline must balance quality against serving cost. Across twelve \textsc{Bright} datasets, our method reaches the strongest baseline's final quality after a median of one third of the search budget and ends 7.2\% higher in held-out nDCG@10, and under a cost-aware objective it finds pipelines that are on average more accurate while using 11\% fewer tokens per query, showing component-aware feedback to be a promising direction for more efficient self-evolving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出组件感知反馈机制：将每次评估程序与父代比较，识别变化组件及其指标差异并存入归因记忆，供后续变异读取；在LLM重排序多目标优化任务上显著提升搜索效率与质量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索大多只保存候选程序与适应度分数，丢弃了"哪一组件编辑导致哪一指标变化"的信息。这迫使变异LLM从杂乱的历史记录中自行推断先前编辑的效果，导致程序搜索缓慢且不稳定，对本地部署的LLM演化多组件系统尤为明显。
AI.method: 引入组件感知反馈（component-aware feedback）：将每个已评估程序与其父代对比，识别发生变化的组件，并将这些变化与对应指标差异一并记录进归因记忆（attribution memory），供后续变异读取。记忆以两种参照系保存每次变化——相对其父代的局部参照，以及相对种子程序的全局参照，从而同时呈现某次改动的即时效果与自种子以来的累积进展。
AI.result: 在LLM重排序（多目标优化，多阶段流水线需在质量与部署成本间权衡）任务上，于12个BRIGHT数据集上，本方法以中位数仅三分之一的搜索预算即达到最强基线的最终质量，且留出集nDCG@10最终高出7.2%；在成本感知目标下，找到的流水线平均更准确，同时每查询少用11%的token。
AI.conclusion: 组件感知反馈是构建更高效自演化系统的有前景方向，能够通过归因编辑效果显著加速并稳定多组件程序的进化搜索。

title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
summary: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into an autoregressive multi-step retriever. Operating directly in the visual latent space, VHOP-Router retrieves linked image chains in a single tool call without requiring the agent to formulate intermediate text queries. Experiments show VHOP-Router boosts retrieval performance from under 5\% to 76.3\%. In agentic search, it improves task success rates by 52.7\% and reduces the average token length by 61\% from 1886 to 728, whereas upgrading the agent yields only a 3.7\% gain. Compared to a strong baseline where the agent retrieves the top 50 results per step, VHOP-Router maintains superior performance while reducing in-context images by $23\times$ and cutting the cumulative API payload by $35\times$. The models also generalize robustly to unseen difficulty levels and realistic test sets. Ultimately, VHOP and VHOP-Router provide an efficient and effective solution for visual agentic search that leaves native LLM capabilities entirely intact.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VHOP数据生成框架与基准以及VHOP-Router端到端训练管线，将标准嵌入模型转化为自回归多步检索器，在视觉潜空间中单次工具调用即可检索图像链，显著提升视觉智能体搜索性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体依赖检索工具获取外部知识，但视觉智能体搜索受限于标准单步检索器：每个中间步骤都需发出文本查询，当视觉线索难以描述或检索器无法在top结果中提供必要中间证据时表现不佳。作者假设将整个嵌入空间上的多步导航直接下放给检索工具可解决该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出VHOP灵活数据生成框架与基准，含五个核心难度等级，测试视觉匹配与搜索规划。基于此开发VHOP-Router，结合监督微调、在线模仿学习与强化学习的端到端训练管线，将标准嵌入模型转化为自回归多步检索器，直接在视觉潜空间检索链接图像链，单次工具调用无需中间文本查询。
AI.result: VHOP-Router将检索性能从不足5%提升至76.3%；智能体搜索任务成功率提升52.7%，平均token长度由1886降至728、减少61%，而仅升级智能体仅带来3.7%增益。相比每步检索top 50的强基线，在保持更优性能的同时将上下文图像减少23倍、累计API负载降低35倍；并对未见难度等级和真实测试集具有稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VHOP与VHOP-Router为视觉智能体搜索提供了高效有效的解决方案，且完全保留原生LLM能力。

title: TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.

AI.tldr: TRACE系统通过目标分组检索、独立证据定位、多模态表格抽取、模式驱动表格构建与失效关闭验证，弥合"来源可访问"与"评分可见正确"之间的"grounding contract gap"，在71题官方测试集上取得0.760613总分。
AI.motivation: 论文指出"找到相关论文"不等于"依据论文生成可验证答案"。LitTraceQA任务要求规范的论文标识、页面或对象级别的精确证据，以及与评估器匹配的类型化答案；现有方法在来源访问与评分器可见正确性之间存在落差，作者称之为grounding contract gap。
AI.method: 提出TRACE框架，包含三个核心组件：Target-Aware Retrieval（目标分组检索）、Attributed Evidence（独立类型化证据定位）、Contract-Constrained Extraction（模式驱动表格构建与契约约束抽取）。系统对27,487篇论文建立段落、对象、别名、引用与稠密表示的多路索引，并保留每个信号背后的提问目标。表格处理上，先预测observation unit再抽取数值，并使用与评估器兼容的键归一化组装行，最终进行fail-closed验证。
AI.result: 在官方71题测试集上，经审计的clean-track系统得分0.760613，其中paper F1为0.9728、evidence F1为0.6847、多选题准确率0.9800、表行F1为0.5423、宏平均单元格准确率0.3508。在11条公开开发集表格记录上，clean baseline与坐标感知视觉填充的行F1分别为0.291与0.411（该对照含回退输出，非官方测试结论）。
AI.conclusion: 残余错误主要集中在定位符、观测单元、行键与源值身份四类问题上。TRACE验证了将检索、证据定位与契约约束抽取统一建模可有效缩小grounding contract gap。

title: Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted as a shared-task system paper at DocInsights 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.

AI.tldr: EVICALC系统在DocSem共享任务官方最终测试中取得8.61%联合准确率，其公开验证运行达92.17%答案准确率与1.00证据F1，但两者配置与指标不同，不构成受控比较。
AI.motivation: 参与DocSem共享任务，构建能读取PDF、选取段落、生成并计算算术表达式以回答问题的系统，并支持失败案例的中间结果检查。
AI.method: 系统流程为：读取PDF、选择相关段落、让语言模型撰写算术表达式、在本地代码中求值；保存中间结果以供失败排查。另开展读取页面图像的探索性研究，并在100份文档上进行测试。
AI.result: 官方最终测试中1,730个任务的联合准确率为8.61%；公开验证运行答案准确率92.17%、证据F1为1.00；探索性图像阅读研究在100份文档中仅22份返回证据标识。事后人工分析发现一例因OCR与块分组将相关段落并入其他块，导致系统基于无关文本作答。
AI.conclusion: 各项得分因配置与指标不同而不可作受控对比；描述性发现可推动进一步评估，但不足以确立总体得分的成因。

title: Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures
comment: CMNA'26: 26th International Workshop on Computational Models of Natural Argument
summary:
Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings.
  We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了对话场景下的论辩结构预测（ASP），在严格schema约束下比较了有监督微调与基于提示的LLM，并涵盖单步与多步任务架构。基于三个改编自推理锚定理论的对话语料库，从预测性能、跨域泛化、schema合规性和计算效率四方面进行基准测试。结果显示ASP仍具挑战性，论辩关系识别是主要瓶颈，源于对话论辩的隐性与语境依赖特性。
AI.motivation: 近期ASP研究已探索统一神经模型、多步流水线和基于提示的LLM等多样方法，但其相对权衡仍缺乏探讨，尤其在对话场景下。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统厘清各类方法在严格schema约束下的优劣。
AI.method: 在严格schema约束下对ASP进行系统评估，端到端地从对话输入生成完整论辩结构，生成层面比较有监督微调与基于提示的LLM，架构层面比较单步与多步任务设计。构建三个多样化对话语料库，从推理锚定理论改编为双极论辩结构，并在统一评测框架下评估预测性能、跨域泛化、schema合规性与计算效率。
AI.result: ASP仍是一个具有挑战性的任务；论辩关系识别成为主要瓶颈，主要归因于对话论辩的隐性与语境依赖特性。不同方法在预测性能、泛化能力、schema合规性和计算效率上各有取舍。
AI.conclusion: 为促进后续研究，作者公开了数据处理流水线及面向对话语料库的计算ASP端到端建模框架。

title: Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost
summary: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on llama.cpp at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Galahad 记忆层，为 vLLM、SGLang 和 llama.cpp 引入有状态推理，通过缓存 KV 状态（Taliesin）和按需传递文档片段（Blaise）避免提示词重复计算，在召回测试中以更低时延与能耗显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: Transformer 语言模型每 token 的计算量有上限，现有服务在请求之间无状态，导致对同一文档的重复问题会从首 token 重新计算注意力状态；实测七个真实数据集中 98.7% 的提示 token 是模型已读过的文本，造成大量冗余计算与能耗浪费。
AI.method: 提出 Galahad 记忆层，兼容 vLLM、SGLang 与 llama.cpp。包含两个组件：Taliesin 保存文本块的 KV 状态，在后续包含相同字节的请求中直接加载而非重算；Blaise 保留文档本身，仅向模型传递问题所需的章节。恢复状态为逐位一致，并采用失败即重算（fail-closed）机制：任何未通过校验的加载都会退回重算。
AI.result: 在 97,000 token 语料、100 条隐藏事实的召回测试（Gemma 4 31B）中：Taliesin 单独使模型可关注全语料，在 llama.cpp 上答对 98/100，每题 3.0 s、572 J；基线仅能保留最后 12,000 token，答对 10/100，9.3 s、2,754 J。加入 Blaise 后，每题仅读约 668 token，三个运行时均答对 100/100，0.59–0.64 s、200–213 J；调优后的 RAGFlow 管线答对 77。存储语料为一次性成本约 100 s、28 kJ，13 个问题后即可回收其能耗；重启、重水合与热加载后 262,144 个输出 logits 全部逐位匹配；在 vLLM 下对测试的全部 30 个模型均有效。
AI.conclusion: Galahad 将 LLM 服务从无状态推理推进到有状态推理，在保证结果逐位一致与失败安全的前提下，大幅降低重复计算、延迟与能耗，并提升长上下文召回准确率。

title: Overview of BioASQ 2026: The fourteenth BioASQ Challenge on Large-Scale Biomedical Semantic Indexing and Question Answering
comment: 21 pages, 17 tables, International Conference of the Cross-Language Evaluation Forum for European Languages 2026 (CLEF2026)
summary: This paper presents an overview of the fourteenth edition of the BioASQ challenge, organized in the context of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF) 2026. BioASQ is an international challenge series that supports progress in biomedical language processing tasks ranging from semantic indexing and information extraction to question answering and summarization. In 2026, BioASQ included six shared tasks: a) Task 14b on biomedical semantic question answering. b) Task Synergy14 on question answering for developing biomedical top- ics. c) Task MultiClinSum-2 on multilingual clinical summarization. d) Task BioNNE-R on extracting relations between nested named entities in Russian and English. e) Task ELCardioCC on clinical coding in cardiology. f) Task GutBrainIE on gut-brain interplay information extrac- tion. Across these six tasks, 87 distinct teams participated, submitting more than 1000 runs overall. As in previous editions, several submissions reached competitive performance, reflecting the continued progress of state-of-the-art methods across biomedical language processing tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了CLEF 2026背景下第十四届BioASQ挑战赛，涵盖六个共享任务，共87支队伍参与，提交超1000个运行结果，多项提交达到竞争性水平。
AI.motivation: BioASQ作为国际性挑战赛系列，旨在推动生物医学语言处理领域的发展，涵盖从语义索引、信息抽取到问答与摘要等多类任务。本文通过总结第十四届（2026年）挑战赛，反映该领域最新进展与技术水平。
AI.method: 2026年BioASQ包含六个共享任务：(a) 14b生物医学语义问答；(b) Synergy14面向生物医学主题开发的问答；(c) MultiClinSum-2多语言临床摘要；(d) BioNNE-R俄语和英语嵌套命名实体关系抽取；(e) ELCardioCC心脏病学临床编码；(f) GutBrainIE肠-脑交互信息抽取。
AI.result: 六个任务共吸引87支不同队伍参与，整体提交超过1000个运行结果。与往届类似，多个提交达到竞争性性能，体现了当前生物医学语言处理任务的先进方法水平。
AI.conclusion: 第十四届BioASQ挑战赛在CLEF 2026框架下成功举办，覆盖多类生物医学语言处理任务，参与规模与提交数量可观，显示出该领域研究的持续活跃与方法进步。

title: Optimize, Learn, Refine: Whole-Body Grasping and Pick-and-Throw with a Spiral Soft Robot
summary: Soft continuum robots can exploit distributed compliance for whole-body manipulation, but synthesizing behavior through changing contacts remains difficult. We address whole-body grasping and pick-and-throw from an initially ungrasped state through outcome-based actuation-space optimization. Grasping is quantified by tip angular sweep and body-object enclosure, while throwing further incorporates release-direction alignment and minimum release speed. These objectives allow grasping, acceleration, and release to emerge from compliant interaction without prescribing contact forces, contact locations, or body configurations. Because the resulting actuation-to-outcome mapping is nonsmooth, we utilize derivative-free CMA-ES within an optimize-learn-refine framework. CMA-ES generates solutions for sampled conditions, a task-conditioned predictor learns warm starts, and CMA-ES refines them for unseen conditions. In simulation, the method achieves 492/500 successful grasps (98.4%) and success rates of 98%, 97%, and 94% across three directional throwing trials. Learned initialization increases grasping success from 78.6% to 98.4% while reducing the median rollout count from 1184 to 816 in CMA-ES. Hardware experiments achieve a 100% grasping success rate across 50 executions and a 100% pick-and-throw success rate across 30 executions, with 10 repetitions per direction. Together, these simulation and hardware results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across both simulated and physical whole-body manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于结果驱动的驱动空间优化框架，实现软体连续机器人从非抓取状态完成全身抓取与拾取-投掷任务。
AI.motivation: 软体连续机器人具备分布式柔顺性，适合全身操作，但通过接触状态变化来合成行为仍很困难，尤其缺乏对接触力、接触位置和本体构型的先验设定。
AI.method: 以结果导向的目标函数定义任务：抓取用末端角扫掠与本体-物体包覆量化；投掷进一步引入释放方向对齐与最小释放速度。由于驱动-结果映射非光滑，采用无导数CMA-ES，并嵌入"优化-学习-精化"框架：CMA-ES在采样条件下求解，任务条件预测器学习热启动，再对未见条件精化。
AI.result: 仿真中抓取成功492/500（98.4%），三个方向投掷成功率为98%、97%、94%。学习初始化使抓取成功率从78.6%提升至98.4%，CMA-ES中位回合数从1184降至816。硬件实验中50次执行抓取成功率达100%，30次拾取-投掷（每方向10次重复）成功率达100%。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与硬件结果共同验证了该框架在虚拟与真实全身操作任务中的有效性。

title: Fiatlux: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Humanoid Ladder Climbing and Light-Bulb Replacement
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables, 2 figures. Project page: https://fiatlux-bench.github.io
summary: Existing benchmarks evaluate tabletop manipulation, flat-floor household activity, or humanoid locomotion and manipulation as separate task groups; none scores vertical mobility and dexterous work on a fragile payload in one long-horizon episode. We present Fiatlux, a light-bulb replacement benchmark built on NVIDIA Isaac Lab. In one episode, a Unitree G1 humanoid positions a step ladder under a ceiling or wall fixture, climbs it, exchanges a spent bulb in a socket for a fresh one, and leaves the spent one in a disposal crate. We decompose the episode into twelve subtask environments scored on difficulty-weighted gates. The goal is a successful replacement, with the fresh bulb seated, the spent one disposed of, neither dropped, and a fragility bound not crossed. Runs that fall short can earn partial credit. Observations are split into a standard mode (signals a physical robot could sense or estimate) and a privileged mode (exact simulator state). We specify the evaluation protocol and provide reference baseline implementations spanning RSL-RL PPO, zero-shot NVIDIA GR00T N1.7 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and whole-body controllers. Additionally, we provide the teleoperated recordings used to specify and check the success gates. The benchmark code and the teleoperated recordings are available at fiatlux-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fiatlux——一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 的"换灯泡"长时程基准，首次将垂直移动与脆弱载荷上的灵巧操作统一到同一 episode 中评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将桌面操作、平地家务活动、人形行走与操作视为彼此独立的任务组，没有一个能在单个长时程 episode 内同时评测垂直移动与对脆弱载荷的灵巧作业。
AI.method: 基于 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 构建，使用 Unitree G1 人形机器人。单个 episode 包含：将梯子摆到天花板或墙面灯具下方、攀爬、用新灯泡替换灯座中的旧灯泡、将旧灯泡放入废弃箱。将 episode 分解为 12 个子任务环境，按难度加权门控评分。观测分为标准模式（物理机器人可感知或估计的信号）与特权模式（仿真器精确状态）。给出评测协议，并提供 RSL-RL PPO、零样本 NVIDIA GR00T N1.7 VLA 模型及全身控制器的参考基线实现，同时公开用于定义与校验成功门控的遥操作录制数据。
AI.result: 成功判据为完成替换：新灯泡就位、旧灯泡被丢弃、两者均未掉落且不越过脆弱性上限；未达标运行可获得部分分数。
AI.conclusion: 将"垂直移动 + 脆弱物体灵巧操作"整合为单一长时程评测任务，并提供标准/特权观测、难度加权门控与多种基线，配套公开代码与遥操作数据（fiatlux-bench.github.io）。

title: SynIL: Leveraging Synergy for Offline Imitation Learning from Imperfect Demonstration Datasets
summary: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire complex skills directly from massive demonstration datasets, but its performance degrades severely when datasets are contaminated with suboptimal or noisy demonstrations. While prior quality-assessment methods attempt to filter or reweight data, they typically rely on manual pre-selection of expert reference data or task-specific heuristics, limiting scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce SynIL (Synergy-based Imitation Learning), a novel framework for automated, label-free demonstration quality assessment in offline reinforcement learning. Grounded in neuroscientific evidence that motor synergy, a low-dimensional coordinated structure in movement, correlates directly with motor proficiency, SynIL algorithmically quantifies synergy manifestation to generate dense, transition-level reward signals via self-supervised reward regression. Comprehensive evaluations on D4RL locomotion benchmarks and multi-human Robomimic manipulation datasets demonstrate that synergy-derived rewards correlate strongly with ground-truth rewards. Furthermore, SynIL substantially outperforms Behavior Cloning (BC) and achieves performance comparable to, and in sparse-reward human teleoperation scenarios, superior to, offline reinforcement learning trained on true environment rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SynIL，一个基于"运动协同（motor synergy）"的自动化、无标签示范质量评估框架，通过自监督奖励回归生成稠密转移级奖励信号，在 D4RL 与 Robomimic 上显著优于行为克隆，并在稀疏奖励场景下超过使用真实环境奖励的离线强化学习。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习虽能从大规模示范数据中获取复杂技能，但数据中混入次优或噪声示范时性能严重下降。既有质量评估方法多依赖人工预设专家参考数据或任务特定启发式规则，可扩展性受限，因此亟需一种自动化、无标签的质量评估方案。
AI.method: 以神经科学证据为出发点——运动协同（运动中的低维协调结构）与运动熟练度直接相关。SynIL 算法化地量化协同的表现程度，并通过自监督奖励回归，将其转化为稠密的、转移级（transition-level）奖励信号，实现无标签的示范质量评估。
AI.result: 在 D4RL 运动基准与多人类 Robomimic 操作数据集上，协同导出的奖励与真实奖励高度相关；SynIL 大幅优于行为克隆（BC），性能与基于真实环境奖励训练的离线强化学习相当，且在稀疏奖励的人类遥操作场景下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: SynIL 提供了一种无需人工筛选参考数据与任务启发式的自动化、无标签示范质量评估范式，验证了运动协同作为质量代理信号的有效性与可扩展性。

title: A Two-Echelon Covering Tour Vehicle Routing Problem with Drones for Post-Disaster Relief
summary: We introduce the two-echelon covering tour vehicle routing problem (2E-CTVRP) for the distribution of relief supplies after a disaster. In the first echelon, a fleet of trucks transports supplies and drones from a central depot to satellites at the periphery of the affected area. In the second echelon, drones launched in parallel from the satellites deliver the supplies to the centroids of victim clusters, which are obtained by clustering the victim locations, and each truck waits at a satellite until its drones have returned. The problem combines the assignment of satellites to trucks, the sequencing of the truck routes, and the assignment of clusters to satellites, and minimizes the sum of the arrival times of the trucks at the satellites and at the depot. We formulate the 2E-CTVRP as a mixed integer linear program and propose a hybrid metaheuristic, GRASP-ILS-PR, which combines greedy randomized construction, a single-trajectory search, and periodic path relinking on the assignment of clusters to satellites. On a new benchmark set of 110 instances, GRASP-ILS-PR finds all known optimal solutions within 30 seconds, matches or improves on the one-hour solutions of a commercial solver on most larger instances, and improves on them by up to 11% for instances with 50 satellites. It clearly outperforms a conventional GRASP with evolutionary path relinking and yields more consistent results than a simulated annealing algorithm that uses the same search components.
