An analysis of two fleet configurations shows that few large trucks minimize the cumulative arrival time in most instances, whereas many small trucks deliver supplies to the victims earlier and more equitably in every instance.

AI.tldr: 提出两层覆盖巡回车辆路径问题(2E-CTVRP)用于灾后救援物资配送，建立混合整数线性规划模型，并设计GRASP-ILS-PR混合元启发式算法求解。
AI.motivation: 灾后救援物资配送需要在有限车队条件下兼顾配送效率与公平性，且涉及卡车-无人机协同的两层运输结构，现有模型难以刻画卫星分配、路径排序与聚类分配的联合优化需求。
AI.method: 第一层卡车将物资与无人机从中心仓库运至灾区外围卫星点；第二层无人机从卫星点并行出发，向受灾点聚类中心配送，卡车在卫星点等待无人机返回。问题耦合卫星-卡车分配、卡车路径排序和聚类-卫星分配，目标为最小化卡车到达卫星点及返回仓库的到达时间之和。构建混合整数线性规划模型，并提出GRASP-ILS-PR混合元启发式，结合贪婪随机构造、单轨迹搜索与针对聚类-卫星分配的周期性路径重连。
AI.result: 在包含110个算例的新基准集上，GRASP-ILS-PR在30秒内找到所有已知最优解；在多数大规模算例上匹配或优于商业求解器1小时解，在50个卫星点的算例上改进最高达11%；显著优于传统GRASP+进化路径重连，且比使用相同搜索组件的模拟退火算法结果更稳定。车队配置分析表明：少量大型卡车在多数算例中最小化累计到达时间，而多辆小型卡车在所有算例中更早、更公平地完成配送。
AI.conclusion: 2E-CTVRP模型与GRASP-ILS-PR算法能高效求解灾后两层协同配送问题，且车队规模与容量配置在效率与公平性之间存在明确权衡。

title: TALK-Dem: Benchmarking Embodied Task Planning under Dementia-Associated Communication Patterns
summary: Existing LLM-driven robot task planners rely on a taken-for-granted assumption of an ideal user whose instructions are clear, complete, and task-focused. However, when interacting with real-world users, especially those experiencing cognitive impairments, such as people living with dementia (PLWD), the planners often make mistakes and even pose physical safety risks. We proposed TALK-Dem (Talking Attributes and Linguistic Knowledge in Dementia), the first benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven robot task planning under dementia-associated verbal communication. TALK-Dem contains 4,800 instructions and covers five typical communication patterns, including Referential Imprecision, Object Substitution, Empty Speech, Topic Drift, and Intrusion, at three intensity levels. Experiments across six open-weight LLMs reveal a substantial robustness gap. Across communication patterns, open-weight models exhibited performance drops of up to 22.3 percentage points compared to ideal instructions. This revealed a critical gap and even danger for real-world applications, especially in assistive robotics, where locally deployable models are necessary due to privacy concerns and connectivity constraints. To mitigate this issue, we proposed the Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience (CARE) method, which retrieves relevant previously resolved tasks to provide task-specific interpretation and planning context. CARE generally outperformed standard prompting baselines across the six open-weight models, improving average task success by 18.1 percentage points over the vanilla prompt. These results highlighted the importance of both evaluating communication robustness and developing effective adaptation strategies for locally deployable assistive robots. The TALK-Dem dataset is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TALK-Dem-A6B3/.

AI.tldr: 提出TALK-Dem基准，评估LLM驱动机器人任务规划在痴呆相关言语沟通下的鲁棒性，并提CARE方法提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器人任务规划默认用户指令清晰、完整且聚焦任务，但面对真实用户（尤其认知障碍者，如痴呆患者）时易出错甚至带来物理安全风险。该问题在需本地部署的辅助机器人中尤为关键，而相关评估基准缺失，因此需量化沟通鲁棒性缺口并提出改进方法。
AI.method: 构建TALK-Dem基准，含4,800条指令，覆盖五类沟通模式（指代不精确、物体替代、空语、话题漂移、闯入），每类三个强度等级；在六个开源权重LLM上评测；提出CARE（Context-Aware Retrieval from Experience）方法，通过检索相关既往已解决任务为当前指令提供任务特定的解释与规划上下文。
AI.result: 六个开源权重LLM相比理想指令性能最多下降22.3个百分点，显示出显著鲁棒性缺口；CARE在六个模型上普遍优于标准提示基线，相较vanilla prompt平均任务成功率提升18.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TALK-Dem揭示了LLM机器人任务规划在痴呆相关沟通下的脆弱性及真实应用风险；CARE验证了引入经验检索上下文可有效缓解该问题。研究强调评估沟通鲁棒性与开发适配策略对本地部署辅助机器人的重要性，数据集已公开。

title: GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Co-speech gestures for robots must adapt not only to speech and embodiment, but also to the workspace available for performing the motion. Since the same speech can be accompanied by different gestures, a robot can respond to workspace constraints, e.g., gestures for speech next to a wall. In these scenarios, the robot should gesture in a suitable motion rather than simply correcting an unconstrained one. To achieve this goal, we present GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned framework that conditions co-speech gesture generation on a prescribed wrist workspace. The GestAdapt framework learns from six complementary co-speech corpora through a shared motion representation and supports retargeting to different robot embodiments. Quantitative evaluation shows that generated motions remain close to the real-motion distribution while respecting the workspace. In a user study, gestures generated under modified workspace constraints receive a mean quality score of 3.24/5, above our no-workspace variant (2.43/5) and below the reference motions (3.68/5). In a real robot evaluation, all compared motions are retargeted to the Reachy2 humanoid robot under identical workspace constraints. Motions generated with our framework rank first in 69.7\% of comparisons, higher than our no-workspace variant baseline and retargeted ground-truth motions constrained afterward. Overall, the results support adapting gestures to the available workspace during generation, rather than modifying unconstrained trajectories afterward to satisfy workspace constraints, potentially compromising gesture naturalness.

AI.tldr: 提出 GestAdapt，一种以手腕工作空间为条件的共语手势生成框架，使机器人手势在生成阶段即适配可用空间，而非事后修正。
AI.motivation: 机器人共语手势不仅需适配语音与本体结构，还须适配执行动作时可用的工作空间。同一语音可对应不同手势，机器人应针对空间限制生成合适动作，而非对无约束动作做事后修正，否则可能损害手势自然度。
AI.method: GestAdapt 以规定的手腕工作空间为条件进行共语手势生成；通过共享运动表示从六个互补的共语语料库中学习，并支持向不同机器人本体进行重定向（retargeting）。
AI.result: 定量评估显示生成动作在满足工作空间约束的同时保持接近真实动作分布；用户研究中受限工作空间下生成手势平均质量 3.24/5，高于无工作空间变体（2.43/5），低于参考动作（3.68/5）；在 Reachy2 人形机器人实机评估中，相同工作空间约束下本框架生成动作在 69.7% 的对比中排名第一，优于无工作空间基线及事后施加约束的重定向真值动作。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在生成阶段即将手势适配到可用工作空间，而非事后修改无约束轨迹以满足约束，从而避免牺牲手势自然性。

title: Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation
summary: Training data variation, whether through designing a domain randomization (DR) scheme in simulation or curating demonstrations for imitation learning, is a primary lever for improving the robustness of robotic manipulation policies. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, and practitioners typically select randomization parameters through expensive trial and error. We investigate these mechanisms through a series of case studies, randomizing object size, color, and type as well as scene lighting and linguistic prompts across settings including pick-and-place RL in ManiSkill and fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models on LIBERO and RoboTwin. We examine both model behavior and internal representations, using the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as our primary diagnostic tool. We show that the NTK distinguishes a shift in the internal learning mechanism from \textit{memorizing} different situations with insufficient variation (e.g.\ learning what to do for a large cube, and what to do for a small cube) to \textit{adapting} to the situation at hand with sufficient variation. An NTK-based signal-to-noise ratio also helps distinguish when policies have learned to \emph{ignore} task-irrelevant factors (e.g.\ treating blue and red cubes identically, instead of learning a blue sub-policy and a red sub-policy). We use these diagnostics to develop practical guidance for designing DR schemes, selecting models, and detecting shortcut learning. We further compare different kinds of representations and validate our findings with real-world hardware experiments using ACT-based imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究揭示训练数据变化提升机器人操作策略鲁棒性的内在机制，提出以经验神经正切核（NTK）作为核心诊断工具，区分策略是"记忆"不同情境还是"适应"当前情境，并给出数据随机化方案设计的实用指南。
AI.motivation: 训练数据变化（如仿真中的域随机化DR、模仿学习的示范数据筛选）是提升机器人操作策略鲁棒性的主要手段，但其内在机制尚不清晰，实践中往往依靠昂贵的试错来选择随机化参数，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 开展系列案例研究，对物体尺寸、颜色、类型以及场景光照和语言提示进行随机化，覆盖ManiSkill中的抓放强化学习、LIBERO与RoboTwin上视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的微调。同时考察模型行为与内部表征，以经验神经正切核（NTK）为主要诊断工具，并引入基于NTK的信噪比指标。
AI.result: NTK能够区分内部学习机制的转变：变异不足时策略倾向于"记忆"不同情境（如分别为大立方体和小立方体学习对应动作），变异充分时则转向"适应"当前情境。基于NTK的信噪比还有助于判断策略是否学会忽略任务无关因素（如将蓝、红立方体同等对待，而非分别学习蓝、红子策略）。此外比较了不同种类的表征，并通过基于ACT模仿学习的真实硬件实验验证了结论。
AI.conclusion: 所提诊断工具可用于设计域随机化方案、选择模型以及检测捷径学习（shortcut learning），为机器人操作策略的鲁棒性提升提供了机制性理解与实用指导。

title: Draft: A Parametric Tool for Robot Design Exploration
summary: Robot performance is often limited by the cost of iterating on morphology and control together, since every computer-aided design (CAD) change has to be carried into a simulation-ready model before control work begins. Co-design methods attempt to close this gap, but each uses a model generator written for a single platform or lack the use of real-world data to suggest that designs are plausible. We present Draft, a parametric generation tool whose generalized engine compiles any parametric tree of serial chains into a simulation-ready MJCF model, without CAD. It allows engineers to explore design tradeoffs through easily adjustable models and evaluate how changes influence controller performance. Draft grounds the free parameters of each design using trends fitted to a survey of $114$ actuators and $49$ published robot descriptions, so that a generated robot is anchored to real-world hardware. We validate those trends wholistically by building twins of four off-the-shelf robots, whose masses agree to $1.10\times$ geometric mean fold error. Finally, we demonstrate how Draft exposes design tradeoffs by evaluating three quadrupeds through a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Draft——一个参数化生成工具，其通用引擎可将任意串行链参数化树直接编译为可仿真的MJCF模型，无需CAD；并使用基于114个执行器和49个已发布机器人描述拟合的趋势约束设计参数，验证了四个商用机器人数字孪生，并展示四足机器人设计权衡。
AI.motivation: 机器人性能常受限于形态与控制协同迭代的成本：每次CAD改动都需先转为仿真就绪模型才能开展控制工作。已有协同设计方法虽试图弥合该差距，但多为单一平台编写的模型生成器，或缺乏真实世界数据支撑设计合理性。
AI.method: Draft是一个参数化生成工具，其通用引擎可将任意串行链参数化树编译为仿真就绪的MJCF模型，无需CAD。它通过易于调整的模型让工程师探索设计权衡，并评估改动对控制器性能的影响；同时利用对114个执行器和49个已发布机器人描述拟合的趋势来锚定各设计自由参数，使生成机器人贴近真实硬件。
AI.result: 通过构建四个商用机器人的数字孪生整体验证趋势，其质量误差几何平均折叠误差为1.10×；并通过两阶段强化学习课程评估三种四足机器人，展示Draft如何揭示设计权衡。
AI.conclusion: Draft以通用化、无CAD的参数化生成方式结合真实硬件数据趋势，支持形态与控制协同设计中的快速迭代与权衡探索，并经数字孪生验证与四足案例研究证明其有效性。

title: PneuTac: Tactile Manipulation with Soft Pneumatic Robots via Unified MPM-Gaussian Splatting Simulation
summary: Soft robots and tactile sensors have demonstrated great potential in delicate manipulation tasks. Soft pneumatic robots enable safe contact through compliance, and vision-based tactile sensors offer high-resolution touch perception. However, learning tactile manipulation with compliant robots has been challenging, bottlenecked by the lack of efficient simulation. Existing simulators typically model them in isolation, and exhibit large calibration gaps that are difficult to overcome efficiently. We present PneuTac, a unified framework for tactile-feedback manipulation with soft pneumatic robots. We leverage the material point method (MPM) for modelling the dynamics of the soft robot and the deformable tactile membrane, and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) for rendering. Real-to-sim modelling is done with a simple vision-based method, to then train action and perception networks for efficient simulation with surrogate models. We use the framework to drive a tactile-guided pipeline to collect demonstrations in simulation. Through experiments on a custom-designed pneumatic soft finger with a tactile sensing tip, together with additional cross-device evaluations, we show that PneuTac is capable of accurately modelling soft robots with tactile sensors, and that policies trained with simulation-augmented demonstrations outperform baselines trained on the same real data on three real-world contact-rich compliant manipulation tasks, making it a practical framework for tactile manipulation on compliant hardware.

AI.tldr: PneuTac是一个面向软体气动机器人触觉反馈操作的统一仿真框架，结合MPM物理建模与3DGS渲染，实现高精度建模，并通过仿真增强示范训练策略，在三项真实接触密集型任务中优于仅用真实数据的基线。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人与视触觉传感器在精细操作中潜力巨大：软体气动机器人通过柔顺性实现安全接触，视触觉传感器提供高分辨率触觉感知。然而，带柔顺机器人的触觉操作学习受限于缺乏高效仿真——现有仿真器通常将二者孤立建模，且存在难以高效克服的较大标定差距。
AI.method: 提出PneuTac统一框架：采用物质点法（MPM）建模软体机器人与可变形触觉膜动力学，使用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）进行渲染；通过简单的基于视觉的方法完成实到仿（real-to-sim）建模；随后训练动作与感知网络，并借助代理模型实现高效仿真；最后驱动触觉引导流水线在仿真中采集示范数据。
AI.result: 在定制的气动软指（带触觉感知指尖）及跨设备评测中，PneuTac能准确建模带触觉传感器的软体机器人；在三项真实接触密集型柔顺操作任务中，使用仿真增强示范训练的策略优于在相同真实数据上训练的基线。
AI.conclusion: PneuTac是面向柔顺硬件触觉操作的实用框架，验证了统一物理仿真与渲染在软体机器人触觉反馈操作学习中的有效性。

title: A Reachability-based Safety Certificate for Dynamical System Motion Policies
summary: Dynamical Systems (DS) are reactive motion policies representing vector fields trained with theoretical guarantees of stability and convergence. To ensure safety during deployment in unknown environments they must be locally reshaped, either through modulation or geometric control barrier function strategies. However, depending on the geometry of the obstacles and the complexity of the DS, these local strategies can lead the system to unavoidable collisions or spurious attractors. In this work, we certify safety with a value function drawn from the notion of backward reachability tube, which measures the worst-case safety along a rollout trajectory of the nominal DS. Usually, such a value function is intractable for a controlled system due to curse of dimensionality. We show that in the DS-based learning-from-demonstration setting, the absence of a control input collapses the reachability problem to a deterministic rollout, and the presence of certain stability conditions truncates the infinite horizon to a finite one, resulting in a well-defined value function. We further show that the value function we devised is the maximal forward-invariant subset of the obstaclefree region for the nominal DS flow. The application of this certificate function is validated across five DS constructions - analytical, Neural ODE, diffeomorphic latent space, LPV-DS, SE(3)and validate it on a Franka manipulator. Modulation and geometric CBFs also suffer from saddle point in cases of headon approach towards an unsafe zone. We show that CBF-on-V avoids this pitfall entirely.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于后向可达管的值函数证书，用于验证动力系统（DS）策略在未知环境中的安全性，并证明该值函数是标称DS流无障碍区域的最大前向不变子集，在五类DS构造及Franka机械臂上验证，且CBF-on-V可完全避免调制与几何CBF在正面对撞场景下的鞍点问题。
AI.motivation: DS作为具有稳定性与收敛性理论保证的反应式运动策略，在未知环境部署时需局部重塑（调制或几何CBF），但这些局部策略在障碍几何复杂或DS复杂时可能导致不可避免的碰撞或伪吸引子，因此需要更可靠的安全性验证手段。
AI.method: 从后向可达管概念出发构造值函数，度量标称DS rollout轨迹上的最坏情况安全性；论证在DS-based模仿学习设定下，无控制输入使可达性问题退化为确定性rollout，特定稳定性条件将无限时域截断为有限时域，从而得到良定义的值函数，并证明其为标称DS流无障碍区域的最大前向不变子集；在五类DS构造（解析、Neural ODE、微分同胚潜空间、LPV-DS、SE(3)）上验证并应用于Franka机械臂。
AI.result: 该证书函数在五类DS构造上验证有效，并在Franka机械臂上得到验证；调制与几何CBF在正面对撞进入不安全区域时存在鞍点问题，而CBF-on-V完全避免了该缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 所设计的值函数证书可为DS策略提供可计算且理论上严格的安全性保证，其最大前向不变子集性质与CBF-on-V规避鞍点的能力表明该方法优于传统局部重塑策略。

title: Embodiment-aware control by inference over the operator: a simulation study
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/sa-falcone/uee-embodiment-sim (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23044669)
summary: Teleoperation systems are tuned for channel fidelity, while whether the operator experiences the device as part of the body, the Sense of Embodiment (SoE), is measured only afterwards, by questionnaire. Predictive-processing accounts suggest controlling devices to reduce the mismatch between the operator's predictions and the returned feedback, but those predictions are unobservable, and an objective that only penalizes mismatch is minimized by removing feedback. We formulate an embodiment-aware controller, the Universal Embodiment Engine (UEE), that infers the operator's embodiment and visuo-proprioceptive cue weighting from implicit gaze and pupil signals and task outcome, and chooses bounded device settings under explicit preferences, cast as a discrete Active Inference agent. In simulations with 300 heterogeneous synthetic operators, the UEE found the suitable setting within half a minute for most operators, before identifying their exact type, and came close to an oracle in the second half of the session (embodiment 1.68 against 0.73 for the best fixed setting, on a 0-2 scale). Adapting without reading the operator did no better than fixed control, and model-free bandits did worse, whereas an expected-utility controller with the same inference did exactly as well: the benefit comes from Bayesian inference over the operator with explicit preferences, not from the information-seeking term of Active Inference. A naive prediction-error minimizer withheld feedback, as its objective implies, and lost task success (0.74 vs 0.90). The benefit shrank but persisted for operators outside the controller's model family, grew with the variety of the population, and vanished when the controller trusted an uninformative signal or when cue weighting changed mid-session without being modeled. These failures show what studies with people must establish first: calibrated signals and a model of change.

AI.tldr: 提出"通用具身引擎"(UEE)，将具身感(SoE)控制问题建模为离散主动推断智能体，通过隐式眼动与瞳孔信号推断操作者的具身感及视-本体觉线索权重，并选择有界设备参数，仿真中优于固定控制与无模型方法。
AI.motivation: 现有遥操作系统以信道保真度为目标进行调参，而操作者是否将设备体验为身体一部分(具身感SoE)仅在事后用问卷测量。预测加工理论建议通过减少预测与反馈的失配来控制设备，但预测不可观测，且仅以失配为目标的优化会通过取消反馈来最小化损失，因此需要一种能推断隐式具身状态并在显式偏好下选择设备设置的控制器。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为离散Active Inference智能体，构建Universal Embodiment Engine (UEE)：从隐式注视与瞳孔信号及任务结果中贝叶斯推断操作者的具身感与视-本体觉线索权重，在显式偏好约束下选择有界设备设置。在300个异质性合成操作者上进行仿真，并与固定设置、无模型bandit、同推断的期望效用控制器、朴素预测误差最小化器及oracle对比。
AI.result: UEE在大多数操作者上半分钟内即找到合适设置(早于识别其确切类型)，后半程接近oracle(具身感1.68 vs 最佳固定设置0.73，0-2量表)。不读取操作者而自适应与固定控制相当；无模型bandit更差；同推断的期望效用控制器表现完全相同，说明收益来自对操作者的贝叶斯推断与显式偏好，而非主动推断的信息寻求项。朴素预测误差最小化器如目标所暗示地抑制反馈，任务成功率下降(0.74 vs 0.90)。对模型族外操作者收益缩小但仍存在，随群体多样性增大而增大；当控制器信任无信息信号或线索权重在会话中途变化且未被建模时收益消失。
AI.conclusion: 具身感知控制可行且有效，但收益来源是贝叶斯推断与显式偏好，而非Active Inference的信息寻求成分。失败案例表明以人为被试的研究必须首先确立两点：可标定的信号，以及变化模型。

title: Observability Analysis and Online Calibration of Visual-Inertial-Wheel Odometry for 4WIS4WID Mobile Robots
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: In this paper, we present a visual-inertial-wheel odometry (VIWO) framework with online calibration for four-wheel independently steered and driven (4WIS4WID) mobile robots. We derive a 2D odometry model directly from the four driving velocities and steering angles, using both the longitudinal rolling constraints and the lateral no-slip constraints of all wheels. A preintegration model and analytical Jacobians are developed for efficient filtering and calibration. An observability analysis of the linearized VIWO system shows that a drive-only model makes all steering offsets unobservable, whereas the proposed redundant model restores their observability. The analysis also identifies four standard VINS unobservable directions and three additional directions associated with the arbitrary placement of the odometry reference frame. Furthermore, we characterize several degenerate motions, including zero yaw rate, constant steering, and a non-rolling wheel, and derive the corresponding excitation conditions for the thirteen wheel intrinsics that remain after fixing the odometry frame reference. The performance of the proposed system has been demonstrated in both simulation and real-world experiments on a 4WIS4WID mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 提出面向四轮独立转向驱动(4WIS4WID)机器人的视觉-惯性-轮式里程计(VIWO)框架，含在线标定、预积分模型、可观测性分析与退化运动条件推导，并在仿真与实机验证。
AI.motivation: 4WIS4WID机器人各轮转向角与驱动速度可独立控制，轮式里程计模型与常规差速/阿克曼平台不同；仅用驱动速度的模型会导致转向偏置不可观测，且在线标定、状态估计的可观测性与激励条件缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 直接从四轮驱动速度与转向角推导2D里程计模型，同时利用全部车轮的纵向滚动约束与横向无滑移约束；构建预积分模型与解析雅可比以支持高效滤波与标定；对线性化VIWO系统做可观测性分析；推导十三项轮式内参（固定里程计参考系后）在零偏航角速度、恒定转向、车轮不滚动等退化运动下的激励条件。
AI.result: 可观测性分析表明：仅驱动模型使所有转向偏置不可观测，而所提冗余模型恢复其可观测性；识别出四个标准VINS不可观测方向及三个由里程计参考系任意放置引入的附加不可观测方向；刻画了若干退化运动及其对应的激励条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提VIWO框架在4WIS4WID移动机器人上通过仿真与实机实验验证了性能，兼顾在线标定与可观测性保证。

title: L1-MPPI: L1 Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral for Agile UAV Control
summary: This work proposes the L1 Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral (L1-MPPI). It cascades L1 adaptive control with the Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) to improve tracking of high-speed UAV trajectories. Thanks to the L1augmentation, the tracking remains accurate even under model uncertainties and external disturbances, such as an additional payload or a mismatch in the modeled aerodynamic drag. In contrast to existing MPPI approaches for UAV control that do not explicitly model aerodynamic effects, varying payloads, and typically neglect the dynamics of low-level motor controllers, our L1-MPPI approach enhances the dynamic model used in the MPPI by incorporating the low-level flight controller and motor dynamics, as well as an iterative mixing scheme that reflects the approach of the low-level controller. The proposed method demonstrates improved tracking performance in both simulation and the real world, even when the UAV is subjected to an unknown payload. In flight with 35% mass increase, our approach lowers the RMSE by 58.61% with respect to plain MPPI. Compared to the same MPPI using an online mass estimator in place of the L1 augmentation, the RMSE is lower by 38.59%. During the real-world experiments the UAV reaches speeds up to 13.50 m/s and accelerations up to 2.5 g.

AI.tldr: 提出L1自适应模型预测路径积分（L1-MPPI），将L1自适应控制与MPPI级联，用于高速无人机轨迹跟踪，在模型不确定性与外部扰动下仍保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 现有面向无人机控制的MPPI方法通常未显式建模气动效应与变化载荷，且普遍忽略底层电机控制器动力学，导致在模型不确定性和外部扰动（如额外载荷、气动阻力建模偏差）下跟踪精度下降。
AI.method: 将L1自适应控制与MPPI级联；在MPPI所用动力学模型中纳入底层飞行控制器与电机动力学，并引入反映底层控制器工作方式的迭代混合（iterative mixing）方案，借助L1增广提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界中均提升跟踪性能；在35%质量增加的飞行中，相比纯MPPI的RMSE降低58.61%，相比使用在线质量估计器替代L1增广的同类MPPI降低38.59%；实机速度达13.50 m/s，加速度达2.5 g。
AI.conclusion: L1-MPPI通过在MPPI中融合底层控制器/电机动力学与L1自适应增广，有效应对未知载荷及模型不确定性，显著改善高速无人机轨迹跟踪精度。

title: Diffusion-2BC: Hybrid Diffusion and Regression Training for Offline Behavior Cloning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Behavior cloning provides an offline route to autonomous-driving policy learning, but mean-squared-error regression is poorly matched to demonstrations in which one observation admits several valid actions. Diffusion policies can represent conditional multimodal action distributions, yet their closed-loop performance may be unstable when visual features and control are learned from limited data. This paper presents Diffusion-2BC, which combines a diffusion denoising objective with an auxiliary deterministic behavior-cloning loss over a shared visual encoder. The auxiliary branch is used only during training; inference remains diffusion-based. The proposed method is evaluated in the controlled Claw environment and in bird's-eye-view CARLA navigation, including route-conditioned driving, route-free navigation through multiple intersections, and cross-map evaluation from Town01 to Town02. In the Claw task, Diffusion-2BC reduced the mean mask-distance error by approximately 10% relative to a diffusion-based behavior-cloning baseline and by 85% relative to standard deterministic behavior cloning. In route-free CARLA, Diffusion-2BC traveled substantially farther before termination under the evaluation protocol than both baselines in Town01 and Town02. Additional qualitative rollouts revealed distinct route choices, showing the multimodal behavior of the proposed diffusion-based agent. The results indicate that an auxiliary regression signal can improve the closed-loop reliability of diffusion behavior cloning while preserving multimodal prediction in the controlled benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 Diffusion-2BC，将扩散去噪目标与辅助确定性行为克隆损失共享视觉编码器联合训练，辅助分支仅用于训练、推理仍为扩散采样，提升了自动驾驶扩散行为克隆的闭环可靠性。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆是自动驾驶策略学习的离线途径，但均方误差回归难以适配"同一观测对应多个有效动作"的演示数据。扩散策略虽能建模条件多模态动作分布，但在数据有限时视觉特征与控制联合学习会导致闭环性能不稳定。
AI.method: Diffusion-2BC 在共享视觉编码器上同时优化扩散去噪目标与辅助确定性行为克隆损失；辅助回归分支仅在训练阶段使用，推理阶段保持纯扩散采样。评测环境包括受控的 Claw 任务与鸟瞰视角 CARLA 导航，涵盖路线条件驾驶、多路口无路线导航，以及 Town01 到 Town02 的跨地图评估。
AI.result: 在 Claw 任务中，Diffusion-2BC 的平均掩码距离误差相较扩散行为克隆基线降低约 10%，相较标准确定性行为克隆降低约 85%。在无路线 CARLA 中，其在 Town01 与 Town02 上的终止前行驶距离均显著超过两个基线。额外的定性 rollout 显示出不同的路线选择，体现了扩散智能体的多模态行为。
AI.conclusion: 辅助回归信号能够提升扩散行为克隆的闭环可靠性，同时在受控基准中保留多模态预测能力。

title: CADeT: Causal-Aware Deformation Transmission for Indirect Robotic Manipulation of Soft Tissue
summary: Indirect manipulation of deep-seated deformable anatomy inaccessible to the robot is challenging in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) because intervening tissues spatially filter deformation transmission. Passive observations can be ambiguous because the Decoupled and Blocked modes may produce similar motion responses. We propose CADeT, a causal-aware deformation transmission framework that integrates structural causal model (SCM) with active sensing to infer a latent transmission mode and estimate a state-dependent adhesion Jacobian online. During normal manipulation, control actions update the mode belief; when ambiguity persists, an additional probing action is selected to improve mode distinguishability. The mode belief and learned Jacobian are incorporated into a belief-aware model predictive controller for indirect target-shape control. Validation in simulation and on the da Vinci research kit (dVRK), using phantom and ex vivo porcine tissues, shows higher mode-identification accuracy and faster shape-error convergence than the evaluated model-free and model-based baselines. These results show that active sensing improves mode identification and indirect deformation control under the evaluated conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADeT——一种结合结构因果模型与主动感知的因果感知形变传递框架，用于机器人微创手术中深层可变形组织的间接操控。
AI.motivation: 在RAMIS中，机器人无法直接接触到深层组织，中间组织会对形变传递产生空间滤波作用，导致被动观测下的运动响应存在歧义（解耦模式与阻塞模式可能产生相似响应），从而难以准确推断传递模式并实现间接控制。
AI.method: 将结构因果模型（SCM）与主动感知相结合：正常操控时由控制动作更新模式信念；当歧义持续存在时，选择额外的探测动作以提升模式可区分性；在线估计状态相关的粘附雅可比矩阵，并将模式信念与学习到的雅可比引入信念感知模型预测控制器，实现间接目标形状控制。
AI.result: 在仿真以及da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）上使用体模和离体猪组织进行验证，相比所评估的无模型和基于模型的基线方法，取得了更高的模式识别准确率和更快的形状误差收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的条件下，主动感知能够提升传递模式识别能力并改善间接形变控制性能。

title: Onboard Vision and MPC Navigation for Underwater Robots: An Open BlueROV2 Platform for Multi-Robot Experiments & Docking
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Autonomous underwater robots require robust perception, estimation and control to operate in confined environments. This paper presents an open-source BlueROV2 platform combining onboard vision with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) for autonomous navigation and docking. The platform integrates an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX and an Intel RealSense D435i stereo camera in a modular pressure housing. Underwater-calibrated stereo depth and realtime object detection provide relative position measurements of nearby BlueROV2 vehicles in the camera and body frames. A quaternion-based estimator fuses external pose and inertial measurements, while an NMPC controller based on a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom model tracks planned navigation and docking trajectories. To support reproducible development, we also provide open-source physics-based PX4 SITL and Gazebo environments, multi-robot simulation tools and a lowcost physical docking station. Experiments evaluate underwater perception, onboard computational performance, state estimation, trajectory tracking and autonomous docking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套开源BlueROV2平台，集成机载视觉与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），实现受限环境下的自主导航与对接。
AI.motivation: 自主水下机器人在受限环境中运行需要鲁棒的感知、估计与控制能力，现有平台在硬件集成、算法统一及可复现开发环境方面存在不足。
AI.method: 硬件采用NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX与Intel RealSense D435i立体相机，集成于模块化耐压舱；通过水下标定立体深度与实时目标检测获取邻近BlueROV2在相机系与体系下的相对位置；采用基于四元数的估计器融合外部位姿与惯性测量；控制层使用基于六自由度非线性模型的NMPC跟踪导航与对接轨迹；并提供开源PX4 SITL/Gazebo物理仿真、多机器人仿真工具及低成本物理对接站。
AI.result: 实验评估了水下感知、机载计算性能、状态估计、轨迹跟踪与自主对接等关键环节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一套软硬件一体、可复现的开源水下自主导航与对接平台，为受限环境下的多机器人应用奠定基础。

title: Systematically Exploring the Capabilities of GPT-6 Astra as Embodied Policies
summary: GPT-6 Astra exhibits a remarkable ability to generate numerical robot actions, extending its role beyond high-level planning. To assess Astra's capabilities as general-purpose embodied policies, we conduct comprehensive evaluations across six domains, examining direct control, cooperation with learned policies, and feedback-driven adaptation. In gripper manipulation, Astra can correct task targets and prepare contact conditions for subsequent policy execution; hybrid control with π0.5 achieves 48% success on the evaluated RoboDojo subset. In dexterous manipulation, hybrid control achieves 50% success in ten experience-guided DexJoCo trials, while direct in-hand control struggles to coordinate finger contacts. In mobile manipulation, hybrid control reaches 38.7% success on the evaluated RoboCasa365. In navigation, Astra leads our local comparisons, reaching 92% success on RxR instruction following and 82% on HM3D object search, although search incurs substantial detours. In locomotion, dense motion-reference generation remains unreliable: none of five sequential attempts on a single obstacle course reaches the goal, despite improvements in stability and forward progress. In humanoid loco-manipulation, Astra exceeds baseline methods on 13 of 30 HumanoidBench tasks with pretrained whole-body controllers. These findings reveal a gap between useful task decisions and reliable physical control. Inference latency further constrains practical control: across 50 RoboDojo instances per condition, policy-assisted and direct control consume 624.8 million and 1.132 billion tokens. A 30-second locomotion run requires 250 model calls averaging 39.86 seconds each, with physics paused during inference.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了GPT-6 Astra作为通用具身策略的能力，覆盖六大机器人领域，发现其在任务决策层面表现优异，但在可靠物理控制与推理延迟方面仍存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 探索大模型能否从高层规划扩展为可直接生成数值机器人动作的通用具身策略，并评估其在不同具身任务中的实际控制能力与局限。
AI.method: 在六个领域开展综合评估，考察直接控制、与已学习策略协作（混合控制）以及反馈驱动自适应三种模式：夹爪操作、灵巧操作、移动操作、导航、运动控制和人形全身操作，并对比基线方法及推理延迟。
AI.result: 夹爪操作中可修正目标并为后续策略准备接触条件，混合控制配合π0.5在RoboDojo子集达48%成功率；灵巧操作混合控制在DexJoCo十次试验中达50%，但直接手内控制难以协调手指接触；移动操作混合控制达38.7%；导航领先本地对比，RxR达92%、HM3D目标搜索82%，但搜索绕行较多；运动控制中密集运动参考生成不可靠，单一障碍课程五次尝试均未到达目标；人形Loco-manipulation在30项HumanoidBench中13项超过基线。推理延迟方面，每条件50个RoboDojo实例下，策略辅助与直接控制分别消耗6.248亿和11.32亿token；30秒运动控制需250次模型调用，平均每次39.86秒且推理期间物理暂停。
AI.conclusion: GPT-6 Astra在具身任务决策层面具备实用价值，但与可靠物理控制之间存在明显鸿沟，且推理延迟严重制约实际控制应用。

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of a Driving VLA to Class 8 Trucks
summary: Class 8 trucks differ from passenger cars in geometry, dynamics, and maneuvering requirements. As a result, vision-language-action (VLA) models trained for passenger vehicles do not readily transfer to Class 8 trucks, particularly in unstructured scenarios such as accident scenes and construction zones. Rather than training a truck-driving VLA from scratch, we propose an adapt-then-steer strategy that adapts an off-the-shelf VLA to generate trajectories for Class-8 trucks in these challenging scenarios. In the adapt stage, we use NVIDIA's Alpamayo 1.5 as the base model, fine-tuning only its action-generation stack on a few hundred real-world construction and accident-related highway scenarios. In the steer stage, we introduce Flow Velocity Steering (FVS) to further refine the model's predictions while holding the adapted VLA fixed. FVS is a compact, flow-time-conditioned residual module that adds learned corrections to the action-space flow velocity used to update the action sequence at each generation step. In open-loop evaluation on a scenario-disjoint held-out set, targeted fine-tuning more than halves single-candidate average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) over the entire 6.4 s horizon compared to the base model. Using the same targeted demonstrations, FVS further reduces the fine-tuned model's full-horizon ADE and FDE by 13.9% and 16.5%, respectively. At matched data budgets, targeted supervision yields 19-26% lower full-horizon ADE than general truck-driving supervision, while the targeted model remains competitive with a model fine-tuned on approximately 65 times as many general truck-driving scenarios. These results support adapt-then-steer for data-efficient vehicle-domain transfer to Class 8 trucks. Our project website is available at https://truckvla.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出“先适配后引导”(adapt-then-steer)策略，将乘用车VLA模型迁移至Class 8重卡，通过针对性微调动作生成模块并引入Flow Velocity Steering残差模块，实现数据高效的域迁移。
AI.motivation: Class 8重卡在几何结构、动力学与操纵需求上与乘用车存在显著差异，导致为乘用车训练的VLA模型难以直接迁移至重卡，在事故现场、施工区等非结构化场景中尤为突出；而从零训练重卡VLA成本高昂。
AI.method: 分两阶段：1) 适配阶段，以NVIDIA Alpamayo 1.5为基础模型，仅微调其动作生成栈，使用数百个真实施工与事故相关高速场景；2) 引导阶段，固定适配后的VLA，引入Flow Velocity Steering(FVS)——一个紧凑的、以流时间为条件的残差模块，在每步生成中对动作空间的流速度添加学习到的修正量。
AI.result: 在场景不相交的留出集开环评估中：针对性微调使全6.4秒时域的单候选平均位移误差(ADE)与终点位移误差(FDE)较基础模型降低一半以上；FVS在此基础上进一步将全时域ADE、FDE分别降低13.9%和16.5%；同等数据预算下，针对性监督比通用重卡驾驶监督的全时域ADE低19-26%，且与使用约65倍通用重卡场景微调的模型性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持adapt-then-steer作为面向Class 8重卡的数据高效车辆域迁移方案，仅需少量针对性数据即可超越大规模通用数据训练的效果。

title: Drone Soccer: Learning to Manipulate with Multicopter Downwash
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, IROS 2026 Workshop (Sim2Real and Classical Control)
summary: Although multicopter drones are traditionally designed for "perception-only" tasks, like mapping and exploration, recent work has sought to develop Unmanned Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) to solve mobile manipulation tasks. Aerial manipulation performance can be impacted by "downwash," the airflow produced by propellers, but current state-of-the-art UAMs either ignore downwash or treat it as a disturbance. Instead, is it possible to actively use downwash as a tool during manipulation? We design a drone soccer task to explore the feasibility of downwash-based manipulation. Specifically, we develop a simplified downwash dynamics model which we use to train an RL policy to dribble a soccer ball. We further demonstrate that our policy transfers to real world deployment. This work provides key insights into novel manipulation capabilities for multicopters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用多旋翼无人机的桨叶下洗气流作为操控工具，设计"无人机足球"任务，建立简化下洗动力学模型并训练强化学习策略实现带球，成功迁移至真实场景。
AI.motivation: 传统多旋翼无人机多用于"仅感知"任务（如建图与探索），近期研究尝试用空中机械臂（UAM）完成移动操控任务。但桨叶产生的下洗气流会影响操控性能，现有UAM要么忽略下洗，要么将其视为干扰。作者提出反向思路：能否主动将下洗气流作为操控工具使用。
AI.method: 设计"无人机足球"任务以探究基于下洗气流的操控可行性；构建简化的下洗动力学模型，并基于该模型训练强化学习策略，使无人机能够对足球进行带球（dribbling）。
AI.result: 所训练的强化学习策略能够成功迁移到真实世界部署，实现实际的带球操控。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了主动利用下洗气流进行操控的可行性，为多旋翼无人机提供了新型操控能力的关键洞见。

title: FAST-Sync: Fast Group Synchronization for any Matrix Lie Group
summary: Group synchronization (GS) is the problem of estimating a set of $N$ unknown elements $g_1,\ldots, g_N \in \mathcal{G}$ in a group $\mathcal{G}$, given noisy measurements of a subset of their pairwise ratios $g_i^{-1} g_j$. GS problems lie at the core of many state estimation tasks in robotics and computer vision, including 3D vision, robotic mapping, inertial navigation, and molecular reconstruction. Unfortunately, GS problems are typically both high-dimensional and non-convex, and therefore hard to solve in general. In this paper, we present Fast-Sync, a fast linear approximation method for GS that is suitable for initializing local manifold-based optimizers or certifiable global methods. Our approach generalizes chordal initialization to arbitrary matrix Lie groups, and additionally proposes two new key algorithmic enhancements: we show how to exploit both the Kronecker-product structure in the problem data matrix and the topology of the synchronization graph to improve speed, scalability, and accuracy. Experimental evaluation across several GS tasks demonstrates that Fast-Sync provides high-quality initializations that enable local optimizers to efficiently recover globally optimal GS solutions, achieving high success rates even with considerable measurement noise.

AI.tldr: 提出Fast-Sync，一种适用于任意矩阵李群的快速线性近似方法，用于群同步（GS）问题的初始化，通过利用Kronecker积结构和同步图拓扑提升速度、可扩展性和精度。
AI.motivation: 群同步问题在机器人状态估计（3D视觉、建图、惯性导航、分子重构）中处于核心地位，但其通常兼具高维与非凸特性，难以直接求解。因此需要高质量的初始化，以支撑局部流形优化器或可认证全局方法高效收敛到全局最优解。
AI.method: Fast-Sync将弦初始化（chordal initialization）推广到任意矩阵李群，并提出两项关键算法增强：一是利用问题数据矩阵中的Kronecker积结构，二是利用同步图的拓扑信息，以提升速度、可扩展性与精度。
AI.result: 在多个群同步任务上的实验表明，Fast-Sync提供的高质量初始化使局部优化器能够高效恢复全局最优的GS解，即使在较大测量噪声下也能取得高成功率。
AI.conclusion: Fast-Sync是一种快速、可扩展且精度良好的GS初始化方法，可作为局部流形优化器或可认证全局方法的有效前端，显著提升求解全局最优群同步问题的效率与鲁棒性。

title: Dense Temporal Motion Retargeting for Legged Robots
summary: Legged robots can learn expressive whole-body skills from the motions of humans and animals. Due to the morphology gap between the source and the robot, however, the motion must be tailored to the dynamic properties of the robot. In particular, dynamic motions such as a jump require careful adjustment, since their timing and control are interdependent. We propose dense temporal motion retargeting (DTMR), which jointly optimizes timing and control within a single optimization, where dense means that the timing is adjusted for every control step. This dense formulation enables DTMR to deform only the parts of the motion that need a change in timing. The problem is solved with sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) in parallel on a GPU. We evaluate DTMR against baselines on two hours of human motion with four humanoid robots, where the results show that DTMR outperforms baseline methods, particularly on dynamic motions. We also show that allowing more temporal deformation yields more precise retargeting. We further compare DTMR with a baseline that optimizes the temporal dimension, where the result shows that DTMR retargets more precisely under the same deformation budget while being ~19x faster. Lastly, policies trained on our references transfer to a real humanoid robot.

AI.tldr: 提出密集时间运动重定向（DTMR），在单一优化中联合优化时间与控制的逐控制步时间调整方法，通过GPU并行的采样MPC求解，在动态动作上显著优于基线且速度更快，并可迁移到真实人形机器人。
AI.motivation: 人形与动物运动可为足式机器人提供全身技能，但源动作与机器人存在形态差异，动作需按机器人动力学特性调整；尤其跳跃等动态动作中时序与控制相互耦合，需精细调节，而现有重定向方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: DTMR将时间与控制放在同一个优化中联合优化，"密集"指对每个控制步都调整时序，从而只变形需要改变时序的运动片段；采用基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC），在GPU上并行求解。
AI.result: 在两个小时人体运动、四种人形机器人上与基线对比，DTMR整体更优，尤其在动态动作上；允许更大的时间变形可带来更精确的重定向；在相同变形预算下比优化时间维度的基线更精确，且约快19倍；基于其参考轨迹训练的策略可迁移到真实人形机器人。
AI.conclusion: 密集时间运动重定向通过联合优化时序与控制，实现了更精确、更高效的运动重定向，尤其适用于动态动作，并具备向真实机器人迁移的能力。

title: Yggdrasil: a Layer-First 3D Scene Graph for Real-Time Querying
summary:
Robotic agents use 3D scene graphs (3DSG) to perform tasks ranging from scene understanding to scene interaction. Although an extensive body of work addresses scene graph generation, little attention has been paid to optimizing the graph for consumption, which leaves state-of-the-art perception pipelines to work around their own scene graph and to pay a latency cost that does not fit the real-time budget a perception loop runs on.
  We present Yggdrasil, the first 3D scene graph designed to be efficient for both generation and consumption: a layer-first hierarchical graph built from generic nodes, edges, and layers, which expresses the representations existing pipelines already produce, indoor or outdoor, flat or hierarchical, while natively answering the positional and semantic queries downstream tasks issue.
  Against a published DSG baseline, Yggdrasil answers queries up to $121\times$ faster, and every query we measure falls between 2 and 127 microseconds, three to five orders of magnitude inside the 200 microsecond keyframe budget a 3DSG consumer lives in, on both a workstation and embedded class device. We integrate Yggdrasil into three published pipelines spanning human trajectory prediction, object-goal navigation, and human-aware motion planning, where it removes up to 99% of the time each spends on its scene graph. The implementation, benchmark harness, and all three integrations are available online.

AI.tldr: 提出 Yggdrasil——首个兼顾生成与消费效率的 3D 场景图，采用层优先的层级结构，通用节点、边与层，原生支持下游的位置与语义查询，查询速度较基线提升至多 121 倍，单次查询 2–127 微秒，远低于 200 微秒关键帧预算，并成功集成到三条已发表的管线中。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景图（3DSG）研究大量集中于场景图生成，却很少关注图面向消费（consumption）的优化，导致先进感知管线不得不绕过自身场景图，付出与实时感知循环预算不符的延迟代价。
AI.method: 设计层优先（layer-first）的层级图结构，由图元为通用节点、边与层构成；既能表达现有管线已产生的表示（室内或室外、扁平或层级），又原生地响应下游任务提出的位置查询与语义查询。
AI.result: 对比已发表的 DSG 基线，Yggdrasil 的查询速度最高提升 121 倍；所测量的每次查询耗时在 2–127 微秒之间，处于 3DSG 消费者 200 微秒关键帧预算内三到五个数量级，且在工作站与嵌入式级设备上均成立。集成到人类轨迹预测、物体目标导航、人类感知运动规划三条已发表管线中，最多消除各管线在场景图上 99% 的耗时。
AI.conclusion: Yggdrasil 是首个同时面向生成与消费效率的 3D 场景图，能够满足实时感知循环的延迟预算并显著加速下游任务；实现、基准测试框架及三项集成均已在线公开。

title: TERRA: Terrain-Aware Reconstruction, Retargeting and Control for Musculoskeletal Locomotion
summary: Recent advances in musculoskeletal modeling and reinforcement learning have enabled muscle-actuated agents to reproduce increasingly complex human motions. Yet these capabilities remain largely confined to flat ground, in part because motion datasets rarely include aligned terrain geometry and because retargeting terrain interactions to complex musculoskeletal bodies is challenging. We present TERRA, an end-to-end pipeline for terrain-aware retargeting and control of musculoskeletal locomotion. From kinematic trajectories alone, TERRA combines terrain priors, estimated contacts, and negative free-space evidence to recover task-relevant support geometry. TERRA further considers anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints during retargeting. Using the resulting motion-terrain pairs from five datasets, we successfully train a single muscle-actuated control policy on 9.4 hours of diverse locomotion. Across reconstruction, retargeting, and held-out tracking benchmarks, TERRA improves terrain accuracy, sharply reduces anatomical and interaction violations, and achieves the highest observed completion rate over supported terrain families. Overall, TERRA provides a practical route from scene-less motion data to muscle-actuated locomotion over diverse non-flat terrain. Project website: https://cnai.epfl.ch/terra/

AI.tldr: TERRA是一个端到端流水线，从无场景的运动数据中恢复地形几何，并完成面向肌肉骨骼模型的terrain-aware重定向与控制，训练出可在多样非平地上行走的单一肌肉驱动策略。
AI.motivation: 现有肌肉骨骼建模与强化学习虽能复现复杂人体运动，但大多局限于平地；原因是运动数据集普遍缺乏对齐的地形几何，且将地形交互重定向到复杂肌肉骨骼身体上十分困难。
AI.method: 仅从运动学轨迹出发，结合地形先验、估计的接触以及负自由空间证据来恢复任务相关的支撑几何；在重定向过程中同时考虑解剖学、肌腱连续性与接触约束；由此从五个数据集生成运动-地形配对数据。
AI.result: 基于9.4小时的多样运动数据，成功训练出单一肌肉驱动控制策略；在重建、重定向和留出跟踪基准上，TERRA提升了地形精度，显著减少解剖与交互违规，并在各类可支撑地形上取得最高的完成率。
AI.conclusion: TERRA为从无场景运动数据到肌肉驱动的多样非平地运动提供了一条可行路径。

title: Residual Wrench Certification and Margin-Aware Control Synthesis for Aerial Physical Interaction
summary: We develop a task-relative framework for certifying residual wrench authority after hover and contact loading in multirotors with bounded actuators. Using convex geometry, we derive signed margins for prescribed convex reserves, including Euclidean balls and weighted ellipsoids. We obtain computable reserve certificates from actuator-interiority bounds to support slack-maximizing allocation. To preserve the required reserve, we propose command projection onto a tightened feasible set. We then connect the available reserve to structured gain synthesis and certify a local tracking region that respects actuator limits. Within this region, we establish nominal exponential convergence and robust ultimate boundedness. For the prescribed task and morphology family, we show that the optimized octarotor attains a larger margin than the optimized hexarotor at equal total thrust. We evaluate the proposed framework in closed-loop simulations of sustained rigid-wall contact using a fixed-geometry octarotor and a variable-tilt quadrotor with matched installed thrust. The quadrotor's local certificate admits a higher normalized push limit for the prescribed task family. In tests beyond the realizability boundaries, we observe the predicted loss of authority through rotor-thrust limits for the octarotor and tilt-servo limits for the quadrotor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种任务相对框架，用于在受限执行器多旋翼悬停与接触负载后认证残余力旋量权限，并给出可计算的储备证书、指令投影与增益综合方法。
AI.motivation: 多旋翼在接触作业中受执行器饱和约束，接触与悬停负载后是否仍具备足够的力旋量权限（残余权限）缺乏可认证的量化判据；同时不同构型（八旋翼、六旋翼、可变倾转四旋翼）在不同任务下的权限对比缺乏统一指标。
AI.method: 基于凸几何建立任务相对的权限认证框架：推导针对凸储备（欧氏球、加权椭球）的带符号裕度；由执行器内部性界获得可计算的储备证书以支持松弛最大化分配；提出将指令投影到收紧可行集以保持所需储备；将可用储备与结构化增益综合关联，认证满足执行器限制的局部跟踪区域；并在该区域内证明标称指数收敛与鲁棒最终有界性。
AI.result: 在等总推力下，优化后的八旋翼比优化后的六旋翼获得更大裕度；闭环仿真中，固定几何八旋翼与等装机推力可变倾转四旋翼在持续刚性壁接触下表现符合理论；四旋翼的局部证书在给定任务族下具有更高的归一化推压极限；超出可实现边界时，分别观察到八旋翼因旋翼推力限制、四旋翼因倾转伺服限制而出现预测的权限丧失。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为受限执行器多旋翼提供任务相对的残余力旋量权限认证、储备保持分配与跟踪性能保证，并能定量比较不同构型与倾转方案的接触任务权限边界。

title: CEER2: Directional and Tunable End-Effector and Root Compliance for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoids are increasingly capable of tracking complex whole-body motions, but physical interaction introduces a different challenge. When a robot makes contact with a person or the environment, it needs to respond to external forces while preserving the motion needed for the task. This response can vary across directions in the end-effectors and on the body. For example, an end effector may need to accommodate contact force in one direction while maintaining motion accuracy in another, while the robot body may resist an external force or move with it. We present a compliance framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines directional and tunable end-effector (EE) compliance with selectable root compliance for external force rejection or force following. A hierarchical reinforcement learning controller modulates a fixed whole-body tracking policy through high-level EE and root commands, while interaction forces are estimated from proprioceptive history. Our simulation and real-world experiments on a humanoid demonstrate directional stiffness control, online stiffness adjustment, distinct root compliance, compliant manipulation, and collaborative carrying.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）的柔顺框架，将末端执行器的方向性可调柔顺与可选根柔顺（外力抑制或跟随）结合，通过分层强化学习调制固定的全身跟踪策略，交互力由本体感知历史估计，在仿真与实物实验中验证了方向刚度控制、在线刚度调节、不同根柔顺、柔顺操作与人机协同搬运。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人已能跟踪复杂全身动作，但物理交互带来新挑战：接触人或环境时需在响应外力同时保持任务所需运动，且这种响应在不同方向上存在差异（如末端执行器需在某方向顺应接触力、在另一方向保持运动精度；机身需抵抗或跟随外力）。现有方法缺乏对不同方向与不同身体部位柔顺行为的统一、可调控制能力，因此需要一种支持方向性与可调柔顺的移动操作框架。
AI.method: 提出柔顺框架，融合：1）末端执行器（EE）的方向性、可调柔顺；2）可选根柔顺，用于外力抑制（force rejection）或力跟随（force following）。实现上采用分层强化学习控制器：高层输出EE命令与根命令，用以调制一个固定的全身跟踪策略（低层）；交互力则从本体感知历史中估计（无需外部力传感器）。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实人形机器人实验中验证了多项能力：方向性刚度控制、在线刚度调节、不同的根柔顺行为、柔顺操作（compliant manipulation）以及人机协同搬运（collaborative carrying）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过分层RL以高层EE与根命令调制固定的全身跟踪策略，并结合本体感知力估计，可在人形机器人上实现方向性与可调的柔顺行为，兼顾运动精度保持与外力响应/跟随，为人形机器人物理交互与移动操作提供了统一的柔顺控制方案，并在真机上具备可行性。

title: Path-Following Control and Terramechanics Analysis for Planetary Rovers Under Wheel-to-Wheel Traction Asymmetry
comment: Author's version of a manuscript accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026). (c) IEEE
summary: This paper proposes a control strategy for path following that is model-free and relies solely on deceleration for skid-steering planetary rovers navigating deformable loose terrain under continuously imposed traction asymmetry. While conventional controllers that are based on kinematics frequently cause slip-sinkage entrapment by accelerating the wheels during path correction, the proposed approach prevents this failure by setting an upper limit on the maximum commanded velocity. Heading correction is achieved solely through the selective deceleration of the outer wheels, which are located on the outside of the turn, driving them into a negative slip regime to act as a mechanical anchor. The system was evaluated using the four-wheel independent-drive rover EX1 under an asymmetric wheel configuration with different left and right grouser heights that induces significant deviations from the path. Experimental results demonstrate that this deceleration-only control successfully suppresses accumulated lateral drift across various velocity regimes up to 0.7 m/s without causing sinkage. Crucially, direct force measurements from onboard multi-axis sensors provide important empirical evidence of the underlying terramechanics, proving that the targeted deceleration establishes dynamic load equalization across the chassis and completely restores the native thrust capability of the opposite driving wheel.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无模型、仅靠减速实现路径跟踪的控制策略，用于在持续牵引不对称条件下行驶于可变形松散地形的滑移转向行星车，避免加速纠偏引发的滑陷被困。
AI.motivation: 传统基于运动学的控制器在路径纠正时加速车轮，常导致滑移-沉陷（slip-sinkage）被困；在可变形松散地形与持续牵引不对称条件下这一问题尤为突出，需要一种能避免沉陷的路径跟踪方法。
AI.method: 无模型控制策略，仅依赖减速：设定最大指令速度上限；航向纠正仅通过选择性地减速位于转弯外侧的外侧车轮，使其进入负滑移状态充当机械锚点。采用四轮独立驱动行星车EX1，在左右grouser高度不同的非对称轮配置下评估。
AI.result: 在多种速度工况（最高0.7 m/s）下成功抑制累积横向漂移且未引起沉陷；车载多轴传感器直接力测量证明，针对性减速实现底盘动态载荷均衡，并完全恢复对侧驱动轮的原有推力能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅减速的控制可有效抑制牵引不对称引起的横向漂移并避免沉陷，其土力学机理为动态载荷均衡与对侧驱动轮推力恢复。

title: FlapKAD: A Simulation Dataset of Coupled Wing Kinematics and Aerodynamic Dynamics for Flapping-Wing Aerial Vehicles
summary: Experimental investigation and modeling of flapping-wing aerial vehicles are limited by the scarcity of large-scale records that temporally align wing kinematics, aerodynamic responses, and flight states. Existing datasets are often limited in scale and affected by measurement noise and temporal misalignment between rapidly varying wing motion and the associated dynamic response, particularly during high-frequency flapping. We introduce FlapKAD, an episode-structured simulation dataset comprising 2,000 rigid-wing flight episodes and 720,152 valid time steps, with bilateral wing kinematics, aerodynamic responses, and flight states recorded synchronously within a common clock. FlapKAD supports a unified bidirectional sequence-prediction benchmark constructed from the same temporally aligned episodes. The forward task predicts future vertical force coefficients and body vertical velocity from histories of realized flap and twist angles, whereas the inverse task reconstructs future flap- and twist-angle trajectories from the corresponding response histories. A benchmark of eight representative time-series architectures across multiple prediction horizons reveals direction- and horizon-dependent model behavior, systematically higher reconstruction errors for twist angle than for flap angle, and no consistent advantage from increased architectural complexity. FlapKAD provides a reproducible dataset and benchmark for studying coupled wing-kinematic, aerodynamic, and flight-state dynamics in flapping-wing aerial vehicles.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FlapKAD——一个情节化扑翼飞行仿真数据集（2000个刚性翼飞行情节、720152个有效时间步），在统一时钟下同步记录双侧翼运动学、气动响应与飞行状态，并构建双向序列预测基准，评估八种时序模型在不同预测时域下的表现。
AI.motivation: 扑翼飞行器实验研究与建模受限于缺少大规模、时间对齐地记录翼运动学、气动响应与飞行状态的数据：现有数据集规模有限，且受测量噪声及快速变化的翼运动与动态响应之间时间错位的影响，尤其在高频扑动时更为严重。
AI.method: 提出FlapKAD仿真数据集，包含2000个刚性翼飞行情节与720152个有效时间步，在共同时钟下同步记录双侧翼运动学、气动响应和飞行状态；基于同一时间对齐情节构建统一的双向序列预测基准：正向任务由已实现的扑动角与扭转角历史预测未来垂直力系数和机体垂直速度，反向任务由相应响应历史重建未来扑动角与扭转角轨迹；并基准测试八种代表性时序架构在多个预测时域下的表现。
AI.result: 基准结果显示：模型行为具有方向依赖性和时域依赖性；扭转角的重建误差系统性地高于扑动角；架构复杂度增加并未带来一致优势。
AI.conclusion: FlapKAD为研究扑翼飞行器中翼运动学、气动与飞行状态的耦合动力学提供了可复现的数据集与基准。

title: Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Learning for Forward-Consistent Inverse Flapping-Wing Aerodynamics
summary: Flapping-wing vehicles regulate aerodynamic forces and moments through coordinated variations in stroke, deviation, and pitch motion. Because the resulting loads depend on both the instantaneous wing configuration and its preceding motion history, recovering suitable wing kinematics from a desired aerodynamic trajectory is a challenging inverse problem. Existing sequence models capture temporal dependencies, while spectral methods can exploit the periodic structure of flapping motion. However, unrestricted frequency-domain augmentation may interfere with temporal representations and produce inconsistent corrections across kinematic variables and prediction horizons. We propose the Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Residual Gated Recurrent Unit (BCS-GRU), which retains recurrent temporal prediction as its primary representation and restricts spectral information to a controlled output-specific correction. We further introduce a causally aligned forward-consistency objective that evaluates predicted kinematics through a separately trained and frozen aerodynamic surrogate. Experiments under a unified episode-level protocol show that BCS-GRU improves inverse prediction over recurrent and adaptive-spectral baselines, with greater benefits at longer prediction horizons. Forward-consistent fine-tuning further improves surrogate-based aerodynamic consistency while maintaining mean kinematic accuracy. These results demonstrate that controlled spectral correction and forward-consistent learning provide an effective framework for history-aware inverse modelling of flapping-wing aerodynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出BCS-GRU模型，用受限的通道自适应谱残差修正GRU时间表示，并结合前向一致性目标，提升扑翼气动反问题的逆运动学预测精度，尤其长预测时域受益更大。
AI.motivation: 扑翼飞行器通过stroke、deviation、pitch协调调节气动力与力矩，载荷既依赖瞬时翅膀构型又依赖历史运动，因此由期望气动轨迹反求合适运动学是困难的反问题。现有序列模型能建模时序依赖，谱方法可利用周期结构，但无约束的频域增强会干扰时间表示，并在不同运动学变量与预测时域间产生不一致修正。
AI.method: 提出Bounded Channel-Adaptive Spectral Residual Gated Recurrent Unit（BCS-GRU）：以循环时序预测为主表示，将谱信息限制为受控的、针对各输出通道的修正；并引入因果对齐的前向一致性目标，用单独训练且冻结的气动代理模型评估预测运动学。
AI.result: 在统一episode级协议下，BCS-GRU在逆预测上优于循环和自适应谱基线，长预测时域增益更大；前向一致性微调进一步改善基于代理模型的气动一致性，同时保持平均运动学精度。
AI.conclusion: 受控谱修正与前向一致性学习为扑翼气动的历史感知逆建模提供了有效框架。

title: AIfred: Augmented Learning through Functional Robotic Embodiment at the Desk
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to ICRA 2027. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Desk-based learning and creative activities benefit from handwritten engagement. However, current generative AI tools deliver guidance through a separate screen, creating a gap between where users think and where assistance appears. To address this, in this work we design AIfred, a desk-based robotic arm with a projector mounted at the end-effector that places AI-generated guidance alongside handwritten work. AIfred combines workspace perception, context-aware content generation, and robot-mediated projection to support math assignments, image generation, and drawing tasks. In a user study (n = 36), we compared AIfred against ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) running on a laptop. Both tools performed comparably while assistance was available during the math assignment (6.7 vs. 7.3/10, p = .41), but AIfred improved short-term learning transfer by 60% once assistance was withdrawn (7.0 vs. 4.4/10, p = .003). In addition, independent art and design professors ranked drawings produced with AIfred better in 33 of 36 cases. Our findings indicate that spatially co-located AI assistance benefits tasks whose guidance shares a spatial frame with the work.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AIfred——一种在末端执行器上搭载投影仪的桌面机械臂系统，将 AI 生成指导直接投射到手写工作旁，从而实现空间共置的 AI 辅助；用户研究（n=36）表明其与笔记本上的 ChatGPT 在辅助可用时表现相当，但在撤除辅助后使短期学习迁移提升 60%，且其辅助完成的绘画在 33/36 例中被专家评为更优。
AI.motivation: 桌面式学习与创作活动依赖手写参与，但现有生成式 AI 工具通过独立屏幕提供指导，造成"用户思考之处"与"辅助出现之处"之间的空间割裂。
AI.method: 设计并实现 AIfred：桌面机械臂 + 末端执行器投影仪，融合工作区感知、上下文感知内容生成与机器人介导投影，支持数学作业、图像生成和绘画任务；开展 n=36 用户研究，与笔记本上运行的 ChatGPT（GPT-5.6 Luna）对照。
AI.result: 数学任务中辅助可用期间两者表现相当（6.7 vs. 7.3/10，p=.41）；辅助撤除后 AIfred 使短期学习迁移提升 60%（7.0 vs. 4.4/10，p=.003）；独立艺术与设计教授在 33/36 例中评定 AIfred 辅助的绘画更优。
AI.conclusion: 空间共置的 AI 辅助对"指导与工作共享同一空间参照系"的任务具有显著收益。

title: HALO: Heterogeneous Allocation Via Localized Observations for the Vehicle Routing Problem
comment: 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary:
Scalable robotic fleets have become increasingly popular for various applications such as package delivery, warehouse management, and military operations. Prior fleet control algorithms solve centralized routing problems with up to $1{,}000$ tasks in controlled environments, yet they fail to consider realistic constraints such as limited observation and communication ranges typical of decentralized fleets. Thus, deploying existing fleet control algorithms into real-world settings is currently infeasible.
  To tackle this, we propose Heterogeneous Allocation via Localized Observations (HALO) to solve the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). HALO is a hybrid method that splits the VRP into allocation and routing portions to provide onboard, real-time solutions to robots in dynamic environments. During the allocation phase, HALO utilizes a heterogeneous graph neural network framework with unique message passing layers to explicitly separate the learning of spatial distributions and task-to-robot compatibility.
  Evaluation results on a partially observable, online variant of the VRP show HALO significantly outperforms the heuristic baseline while maintaining similar solution quality to an all-knowing offline variant of HALO. While HALO is explicitly designed for partially observable environments, it imposes no strict upper bound on the observation space allowing us to test HALO on the traditional static, single-depot VRP. Here, HALO outperforms state-of-the-art architectures strictly optimized for the static variant of the VRP by up to $14.06\%$. Throughout all testing, this framework maintains the quickest execution times which emphasizes its potential for large-scale, real-time deployment.

AI.tldr: HALO是一种面向部分可观测、动态环境下的机队车辆路径问题（VRP）的混合方法，将问题拆分为分配与路由两个阶段，通过异构图表神经网络实现实时在线求解，性能优于启发式基线及静态VRP的最先进架构。
AI.motivation: 现有集中式机队控制算法虽能在受控环境中求解多达1000个任务的路径问题，但未考虑分散式机队典型的有限观测与通信范围等现实约束，导致难以部署到真实场景。因此需要一种能在部分可观测、动态环境下提供车载实时解的方案。
AI.method: 提出HALO（Heterogeneous Allocation via Localized Observations），一种混合方法，将VRP拆分为分配与路由两部分。分配阶段采用异构图表神经网络框架，并设计独特的消息传递层，显式分离空间分布学习与任务-机器人兼容性学习，从而为机器人提供在线实时解。
AI.result: 在部分可观测的在线VRP变体上，HALO显著优于启发式基线，且解质量与全知离线版本HALO相近；在传统静态单仓库VRP上，HALO比严格针对静态变体优化的最先进架构最高提升14.06%；在所有测试中均保持最快的执行时间。
AI.conclusion: HALO在不设观测空间严格上界的前提下，兼顾部分可观测与静态VRP场景，兼具解质量与最快执行速度，展现出大规模实时部署的潜力。

title: PhaseSync-Exo: Human Clock Anchored Reference Adaptation for Dynamic Gait Tracking
summary: Human-aware exoskeleton walking requires reconstructing gait, tracking diverse motions under dynamic constraints, and preserving human timing. We present PhaseSync-Exo, which combines two-IMU CNN-Transformer reconstruction, factorized amplitude-cadence retargeting with curriculum-trained recurrent control, and a human-clock-anchored adapter (HCA). HCA combines human-clock attraction with robot-relative feedback to adjust reference rate while preserving forward progression and continuity. The reconstruction module achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 3.24 degrees on a held-out recording, and the frozen tracking policy completes 356 of 357 amplitude-frequency trials. Two complementary dynamic comparisons isolate HCA's timing benefit without retraining. Against robot-relative correction, HCA reduces human-clock phase MAE from 95.55 degrees to 10.99 degrees, limiting reference drift. When human and delivered phases initially differ, it reduces phase MAE from 72.02 degrees to 13.90 degrees versus fixed-clock continuation. Compared with immediate phase reset, HCA reduces transient reference-tracking hip RMSE by 22.7% without reference jumps. All 420 timing rollouts complete without falls. These simulation results support continuous phase acquisition and sustained alignment to an independent human clock.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhaseSync-Exo，通过双IMU CNN-Transformer步态重建、因子化幅度-步频重定向与课程训练循环控制，以及人体时钟锚定适配器（HCA），实现人-外骨骼连续相位对齐。
AI.motivation: 人-外骨骼行走需同时重建步态、在动态约束下跟踪多样运动并保持人体运动时序，现有方法在相位获取与持续对齐方面存在不足。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：(1) 双IMU CNN-Transformer步态重建；(2) 因子化幅度-步频重定向，配合课程训练的循环控制策略；(3) 人体时钟锚定适配器（HCA），结合人体时钟吸引与机器人相对反馈，调整参考速率以保持前向推进与连续性。
AI.result: 重建模块在留出录制上MAE为3.24°；冻结跟踪策略完成357个幅度-频率试验中的356个。与机器人相对校正相比，HCA将人体时钟相位MAE从95.55°降至10.99°，抑制参考漂移；初始相位不一致时相较固定时钟延续将MAE从72.02°降至13.90°；相较即时相位重置，HCA使瞬态参考跟踪髋关节RMSE降低22.7%，且无参考跳变。全部420次时序rollout无跌倒。
AI.conclusion: 仿真结果表明，该方法可实现连续的相位获取，并持续对齐独立的人体时钟。

title: Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS): Scaling Coral Recruit Monitoring Through Robotics and Computer Vision
summary: Climate change is the largest threat to coral reefs, with increasing global impacts accelerating the need for scalable reef restoration technologies. Large-scale reef restoration depends on the mass production of corals, such as through coral aquaculture. Coral seeding with recruits grown in aquaculture facilities is a feasible restoration approach, but effective production requires consistent, high-frequency monitoring of tens of thousands of macroscopic (0.5-2mm diameter) recruits, making conventional manual assessment prohibitively labor-intensive. To address this monitoring bottleneck, we introduce the Coral Grow-out Robotic Assessment System (CGRAS) which combines robotic imaging and computer vision to automate data acquisition, perform multi-species detection and counting of corals, and evaluate coral health. CGRAS automatically extracts coral growth, survival and spatial distribution metrics, with the aim of providing timely feedback to operators for optimizing production, grow-out and deployment workflow processes. We demonstrate CGRAS in a large aquaculture facility on standardized coral settlement tiles, reducing the time and labor costs by a factor of 9.6 as compared to manual monitoring, whilst achieving 96.4% agreement for Acropora kenti corals relative to expert counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出珊瑚培育机器人评估系统(CGRAS),结合机器人成像与计算机视觉自动化珊瑚幼苗的检测、计数、健康评估及生长/存活/空间分布指标提取,在大型水产养殖设施中验证,较人工监测降低时间与人力成本9.6倍,对Acropora kenti珊瑚的计数与专家计数一致性达96.4%。
AI.motivation: 气候变化是珊瑚礁面临的最大威胁,大规模珊瑚礁修复依赖于珊瑚的规模化培育(如珊瑚水产养殖)。基于养殖设施培育幼苗的珊瑚播种是可行的修复途径,但需要对数万个宏观尺寸(直径0.5-2mm)幼苗进行持续、高频监测,传统人工评估耗费人力巨大,成为监测瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出CGRAS系统,融合机器人成像与计算机视觉,自动完成数据采集、多物种珊瑚检测与计数以及健康评估,并自动提取珊瑚生长、存活与空间分布指标,以向操作人员提供及时反馈,优化生产、培育与部署流程。系统在大型水产养殖设施的标准珊瑚附着瓦上进行验证。
AI.result: 相比人工监测,CGRAS将时间与人力成本降低9.6倍;对Acropora kenti珊瑚的计数与专家计数达成96.4%的一致性。
AI.conclusion: CGRAS可有效缓解珊瑚培育中的高频监测瓶颈,在保证计数准确性的同时显著降低监测成本,为珊瑚规模化养殖与珊瑚礁修复提供可扩展的自动化监测方案。

title: Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
summary: Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出"反转栈"架构：先训练通用命令条件化运动策略作为基座，再叠加七个任务门控踢球技能，使运动控制器兼作技能组合枢纽与击球后稳定器；在29自由度Unitree G1上验证，覆盖259.5°瞄准方向。
AI.motivation: 现有类人足球系统将运动跟踪作为底层基座，通过将运动参考锚点转向球来派生运动，射门效果虽好，但运动能力仅在狭窄、确定性的接近球指令分布上训练，从未被作为独立能力评估。作者希望让可达步态空间由运动课程而非参考片段决定，并降低技能间切换复杂度。
AI.method: 反转系统栈：先训练一个通用、命令条件化的运动策略作为基座；在其上叠加N个运动引导的踢球技能，作为任务门控层。每个技能从同一可命令状态出发并回归该状态，使运动成为组合枢纽（O(N)而非O(N²)转移），击球后稳定交由已训练控制器完成而非逐片段脚本化。实例化于29自由度Unitree G1，含七个重定向踢球技能，覆盖259.5°标称瞄准方向，包括侧向、后向和弱脚击球。
AI.result: 报告了射门精度，以及附带完整技能库条件下的指令跟踪、地形适应与推力恢复结果——这是以往类人足球系统未报告的维度。技能库在硬件上通过前向、侧向、后向及受指令接近方式得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 以命令条件化运动为基座、技能为门控层的反转架构，可将运动从受限的接近球分布中解耦为独立可评估的能力，同时以线性复杂度支持多技能组合并复用控制器完成击球后恢复；在G1实物上覆盖广阔瞄准方向并验证成功。

title: Online Evolution Strategy for Flow-Matching VLA Policies via Self-Supervised Trajectory Distribution Optimization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models based on generative frameworks, such as Flow Matching, have recently achieved impressive performance in robotic manipulation. Unlike deterministic policies, Flow Matching enables VLA models to learn conditional action trajectory distributions, where latent noise vectors induce different actions under the same task scenario. However, we observe that these distributions are often ill-formed, with successful and failed behaviors coexisting while considerable probability mass remains in unfavorable regions. To this end, we propose Online-ES, an online adaptation framework for Flow Matching VLAs based on Evolution Strategy (ES), which refines the learned action trajectory distribution through interaction feedback. Instead of pruning the latent noise space, our method performs evolutionary exploration directly in the action trajectory space, where diverse trajectories generated by Flow Matching provide candidate solutions for adaptation. By perturbing sampled trajectories and evaluating their execution outcomes, we derive a self-supervised MSE objective that transfers the evolution direction from trajectory space into model parameter space. Mathematically, we prove that the proposed objective provides an unbiased estimator of the optimal evolution direction. Moreover, we also incorporate failure experiences as negative feedback to regularize the evolution direction, steering the policy away from previously explored failure regions. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that Online-ES achieves policy improvement comparable to reinforcement fine-tuning, without learning a value model or computing advantages.

AI.tldr: 提出 Online-ES：基于进化策略的 Flow Matching VLA 在线适配框架，直接在动作轨迹空间做进化探索，用自监督 MSE 目标把进化方向迁移到参数空间，无需价值模型或优势估计即实现与强化微调相当的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 基于生成式框架（如 Flow Matching）的 VLA 模型能学习条件动作轨迹分布，但该分布往往"不良"：成功与失败行为共存，且大量概率质量落在不利区域。传统做法是剪枝隐噪声空间，但作者希望在动作轨迹空间中直接进行自适应，以利用 Flow Matching 天然产生多样轨迹的特性。
AI.method: 1) 在动作轨迹空间进行进化探索，将由 Flow Matching 生成的多样轨迹作为候选解；2) 对采样轨迹施加扰动并评估其执行结果；3) 构造自监督 MSE 目标，把轨迹空间的进化方向迁移到模型参数空间；4) 理论证明该目标是"最优进化方向"的无偏估计；5) 引入失败经验作为负反馈，正则化进化方向，使策略远离已探索的失败区域。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实环境中，Online-ES 均取得与强化微调（reinforcement fine-tuning）相当的性能提升，同时无需学习价值模型，也无需计算优势函数。
AI.conclusion: Online-ES 验证了动作轨迹空间进化 + 参数空间迁移这条路径在 Flow Matching VLA 在线适配上的有效性，兼具性能与计算简洁性，为生成式策略的在线改进提供了无需 critic 的替代方案。

title: Plan-Conditioned Imitation for Robust Object Retrieval under Self-Occlusion in Dense Clutter
summary: Retrieving objects from dense clutter requires rearrangement during which the manipulator can occlude objects while moving them. Repeated arm withdrawals to restore visibility interrupt execution. We introduce TRACE, a plan-conditioned imitation framework for retrieval under self-occlusion. A single unoccluded observation initializes a digital twin, where a privileged teacher generates a fixed nominal rollout. A recurrent student combines local rollout context, partial object observations, and proprioception to select actions that can correct deviations from the prediction. Behavior cloning initializes the student; DAgger refines it with teacher labels on student-visited states. The rollout remains fixed throughout execution, so the deployed student needs neither online teacher queries nor additional simulator rollouts during pushing. On 511 simulation test scenes, TRACE achieves 90.7% success versus 43.4% for nominal replay and 96.7% for the privileged closed-loop teacher. At a matched 26,373-label budget, student-state supervision achieves 87.8% versus 66.7% for expert-only cloning, demonstrating gains beyond additional labels. On a UR5e, TRACE achieves 90.0% success versus 95.0% for the closed-loop teacher, while reducing total execution time from 192.7 s to 67.3 s. It avoids the teacher's 16.8 sensing-related arm retractions per trial during pushing, retaining a final withdrawal for graspability evaluation. Code and data will be released at: https://trace-retrieval.github.io.

AI.tldr: TRACE：一种基于固定规划的条件模仿学习框架，使机械臂在自遮挡下从密集杂物中取物，无需在线教师查询或额外仿真推演。
AI.motivation: 密集杂物取物需先重排，但移动物体时机械臂会自遮挡；反复撤臂以恢复可见性会打断执行，为此需在自遮挡条件下高效取物。
AI.method: 单次无遮挡观测初始化数字孪生，特权教师生成固定名义推演轨迹；循环学生网络融合局部轨迹上下文、部分物体观测与本征感知来选择动作以纠正偏差。行为克隆初始化，DAgger用学生访问状态上的教师标签精炼；执行全程轨迹固定，部署时无需在线教师查询或额外仿真推演。
AI.result: 511个仿真测试场景下成功率90.7%（名义重放43.4%，特权闭环教师96.7%）；同等26,373标签预算下学生状态监督达87.8%，仅专家克隆66.7%。UR5e上成功率90.0%（闭环教师95.0%），执行时间从192.7s降至67.3s，避免教师每次试验16.8次感知相关撤臂，仅保留最后撤臂用于可抓取性评估。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过固定规划+学生状态DAgger监督，在自遮挡取物中显著超越名义重放与仅专家克隆，接近特权教师性能，同时大幅减少机械臂撤臂与执行时间，验证了标签效率与部署实用性。

title: Efficient Multi-Modal Planning with Reward-Guided Preference Optimization for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safe and efficient trajectory planning is essential in autonomous driving. However, existing end-to-end approaches often fall short in both computational efficiency and safety guarantees. Methods based on imitation learning suffer from causal confusion, while rule-based scoring approaches often incur heavy computational overhead and suffer from objective misalignment. Additionally, preference-based methods rely on strict pairwise annotations, limiting data utilization. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPlan, an efficient multi-modal trajectory planning method powered by reward-guided fine-tuning. We design a hybrid architecture that combines sparse anchors with an offset refinement module for efficient multi-modal trajectory prediction. Sparse anchors provide coarse trajectory candidates with low latency, which are subsequently refined by the offset module for higher prediction accuracy. To enhance safety without incurring additional inference costs, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm consisting of pretraining and reward-guided fine-tuning. During fine-tuning, we leverage rule-based reward signals and unpaired preference supervision to refine the pretrained policy toward safer trajectory selection. We evaluate EMPlan on the non-reactive NAVSIM benchmark, where it strikes a favorable balance between planning accuracy and efficiency, demonstrating superior performance under real-time constraints.

AI.tldr: EMPlan是一种高效多模态轨迹规划方法，通过稀疏锚点+偏移精修架构与奖励引导微调实现自动驾驶安全与效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端轨迹规划方法在计算效率与安全性上难以兼顾：模仿学习存在因果混淆，基于规则打分的方法算力开销大且目标错位，偏好类方法依赖严格成对标注，限制了数据利用率。
AI.method: 提出EMPlan：采用稀疏锚点结合偏移精修模块的混合架构，稀疏锚点低延迟生成粗候选轨迹，再由偏移模块精修以提升精度；训练采用两阶段范式，即预训练加奖励引导微调，在微调阶段利用规则奖励信号与无配对偏好监督，将预训练策略向更安全的轨迹选择方向优化，且不增加额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在非反应式NAVSIM基准上评估，EMPlan在规划精度与效率之间取得良好平衡，在实时约束下表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: EMPlan通过混合架构与奖励引导微调，在不增加推理开销的前提下兼顾多模态轨迹预测效率与安全性，为自动驾驶轨迹规划提供了有效方案。

title: DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
comment: The first three authors contributed equally to this work. Project Page: https://psh0823.github.io/dodger-homepage
summary: Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.

AI.tldr: DODGER是一个安全引导的强化学习框架，训练时直接执行策略动作以保留探索能力，仅用CBF过滤后的参考和约束违反信号来塑造避障策略，在人形机器人动态避障任务中实现了无需运行时安全滤波器的安全导航。
AI.motivation: 在以人为中心的环境中，机器人需在多个动态障碍物间安全导航。CBF可用于安全滤波，但现有基于CBF的RL方法在训练时只执行被安全滤波后的动作，会限制策略探索；在安全性依赖机器人与障碍物相对运动的动态场景中，这一问题尤为严重。
AI.method: 提出DODGER框架：训练rollout直接执行策略生成的原始动作以保持探索，同时利用CBF滤波后的参考动作与约束违反信息来引导策略向避障行为学习。通过Dubins小车进行安全性分析，并在基于LiDAR感知的全阶人形仿真与真实人形实验中验证。
AI.result: 在Dubins小车安全性分析中验证了方法有效性；在多动态障碍物的全阶人形仿真和真实人形实验中实现了目标导向的导航，且无需运行时安全滤波器。
AI.conclusion: DODGER通过将安全信息用于策略塑造而非强制动作替换，兼顾了探索与安全，可在真实人形机器人上实现无运行时安全滤波器的动态避障导航。

title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled manipulation policies to perform increasingly diverse tasks and generalize across environments. However, reliable execution often depends on hidden task states that cannot be determined from current observations alone, making interaction history essential. We introduce $HIDE$, a benchmark for evaluating manipulation memory under partial observability. HIDE comprises 15 tasks covering repetition counting, historical-state recall, and execution-progress tracking, with randomized initial configurations and decision points where similar observations require different actions depending on prior events. We further propose $SEEK$, a framework combining three complementary memory mechanisms to retain historical evidence and track execution state. Evaluations reveal substantial limitations in existing policies on HIDE, while memory augmentation improves task success in both simulation and real-world experiments. Individual mechanisms benefit some tasks but can degrade others; their combination achieves the highest average success rate on HIDE among the evaluated configurations. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining internal representations of hidden task states and matching memory design to task-specific information requirements.

AI.tldr: 该文提出操作任务记忆基准HIDE与记忆增强框架SEEK，揭示现有策略在部分可观测下的不足，并证明组合记忆机制最优。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略虽日益多样且可跨环境泛化，但可靠执行常依赖无法由当前观测确定的隐藏任务状态，交互历史因此关键；然而缺乏专门评估部分可观测下操作记忆能力的基准与系统性方法。
AI.method: 提出基准HIDE，含15个任务，覆盖重复计数、历史状态回忆、执行进度追踪三类，采用随机初始配置与决策点（相似观测需依先前事件采取不同动作）；提出框架SEEK，融合三种互补记忆机制以保留历史证据并追踪执行状态。
AI.result: 现有策略在HIDE上表现显著受限；记忆增强在仿真与真实实验中均提升任务成功率；单一机制对部分任务有益但可能损害其他任务，组合机制在所评估配置中取得HIDE最高平均成功率。
AI.conclusion: 维持隐藏任务状态的内部表征至关重要，且记忆设计需与任务特定信息需求相匹配。

title: PRICE the Action Chunks: Physical Relational Credit Assignment for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) post-trains vision--language--action policies using terminal success signals, but assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to every action chunk. A failed episode can thus penalize useful early actions as if they caused the failure. Existing approaches seek finer-grained feedback through learned evaluators, adding task-specific supervision or additional model training. We explore, for the first time to our knowledge, whether physical relations across trajectories can provide action-chunk credit in embodied RL from terminal outcomes alone, without an auxiliary evaluator. The key insight is that rollouts reaching corresponding physical situations can serve as references for one another: their terminal outcomes provide evidence for assessing local progress. We introduce Physical Relations for Inferring Credit from Episodes(PRICE), with two components: (i) a physical relational graph that pools current and historical outcomes at corresponding chunk boundaries to estimate success potentials; and (ii) confidence-gated credit assignment that uses changes in these potentials to refine trajectory-level supervision. Our analysis connects oracle potential changes to the terminal-success objective and provides a finite-sample directional bound for outcome-independent evidence pools. Independent continuation tests show that PRICE's retained credits align with local progress, while experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots demonstrate improved task success over outcome-based baselines and faster learning.

AI.tldr: 提出PRICE方法，利用跨轨迹的物理关系在仅凭终端成功信号的具身强化学习中实现动作块级信用分配，无需辅助评估器，在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真机上提升成功率并加速学习。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的强化学习后训练VLA策略时仅使用终端成功信号，却将轨迹级优势均匀分配给每个动作块，导致失败回合中本有效的早期动作被错误惩罚。现有细粒度反馈方法依赖学习型评估器，需额外任务监督或模型训练。本文探索能否仅凭终端结果，利用跨轨迹的物理关系提供动作块信用。
AI.method: 核心洞见：到达对应物理情境的rollout可互为参考，其终端结果可作为评估局部进展的证据。提出PRICE，含两部分：(i) 物理关系图，在对应块边界处汇聚当前与历史结果以估计成功潜力；(ii) 置信度门控的信用分配，利用潜力变化精化轨迹级监督。理论分析建立oracle潜力变化与终端成功目标的联系，并给出结果无关证据池的有限样本方向性界。
AI.result: 独立延续性测试表明PRICE保留的信用与局部进展一致；在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实机器人上的实验显示，相较基于结果的基线，任务成功率提升且学习更快。
AI.conclusion: 跨轨迹物理关系可作为动作块级信用的有效来源，仅凭终端结果即可实现细粒度信用分配，无需辅助评估器，为具身RL后训练提供更精确且高效的监督信号。

title: EmbodiRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Data-Efficient Robot Adaptation
summary: Adapting robot manipulation policies to new tasks and environments remains highly data-intensive, while the data needed for further improvement depends on the policy's current capabilities and failure modes. We introduce EmbodiRSI, an agentic system for recursive self-improvement (RSI) in a real-to-sim-to-real setting, where task-specific simulations are constructed from target deployment scenarios and used as low-cost environments for iterative policy improvement before transfer back to the physical world. EmbodiRSI uses policy execution feedback to guide subsequent experience acquisition and policy updates. Two complementary mechanisms close this loop: Collaborative Error Correction generates agent-assisted corrective trajectories from policy-reached states, while Adaptive Data Collection directs expert demonstration generation toward the current policy's weaknesses. The task-specific simulation serves as a reusable workspace for policy warm-up, repeatable evaluation, failure diagnosis, and targeted data generation across successive RSI rounds. Across three tabletop environments and 14 subtasks, EmbodiRSI increases scene-balanced autonomous simulation success from 50.4% to 83.5% over two RSI updates. With 400 adaptive simulated trajectories and only ten real-world refinement trajectories per subtask, EmbodiRSI achieves 83.1% scene-balanced autonomous real-world success, compared with 75.0% for adaptation using 200 real-world demonstrations per subtask. These results demonstrate that feedback-driven recursive improvement in deployment-specific simulations can enable data-efficient adaptation of embodied policies to physical environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmbodiRSI 智能体系统，在“真实-仿真-真实”框架下利用策略执行反馈驱动的递归自我改进，仅用极少量真机数据即实现具身操作策略的高效自适应。
AI.motivation: 机器操作策略适应新任务与环境高度依赖数据，而后续改进所需数据取决于策略当前的能力与失败模式；直接在真实世界中进行迭代成本高、不可重复，因此需要低成本、可复现的改进环境与反馈驱动的数据采集机制。
AI.method: EmbodiRSI 基于目标部署场景构建任务专用仿真作为可复用工位，通过策略执行反馈引导经验获取与策略更新，形成递归自我改进（RSI）闭环。其两个互补机制为：协同错误纠正（Collaborative Error Correction），从策略到达的状态生成智能体辅助的纠正轨迹；自适应数据采集（Adaptive Data Collection），将专家演示生成导向当前策略的薄弱环节。该仿真工位支持策略预热、可重复评测、失败诊断与定向数据生成，并将改进策略迁移回物理世界。
AI.result: 在三个桌面环境、14 个子任务上，经过两轮 RSI 更新，仿真场景均衡自主成功率从 50.4% 提升至 83.5%；仅用每子任务 400 条自适应仿真轨迹与 10 条真机精调轨迹，达到 83.1% 的真机场景均衡自主成功率，优于每子任务使用 200 条真机演示的 75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在部署专用仿真中进行反馈驱动的递归改进，可实现具身策略对物理环境的数据高效自适应，显著降低真机数据需求并提升成功率。

title: Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary: Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal. This design enables LME to handle environments both with and without local minima within a unified framework, while remaining independent of the underlying local planner and requiring no additional training.
