Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that LME provides robust navigation performance and generalizes to challenging unseen scenarios. Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima. Successful deployments on both differential-drive and quadruped robots further demonstrate the practical applicability and generality of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出LME——一种基于局部观测、程序化生成并推理子目标的层次框架，显式引导机器人在无地图未知环境中逃出局部极小值区域，无需训练且与底层局部规划器解耦。
AI.motivation: 无地图、部分可观测环境下的移动机器人导航仍具挑战，局部极小值会使机器人无法向目标推进。现有局部导航方法缺乏显式的逃逸机制，而深度强化学习方法只能通过奖励设计和策略优化隐式学习恢复行为，可解释性与通用性不足。
AI.method: LME采用程序化层次框架，仅依赖局部观测；利用可解释的启发式准则选取候选子目标，准则同时考虑周边障碍几何结构与候选位置安全性；再由局部规划器朝选定子目标生成底层运动指令。框架与底层局部规划器无关，且无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实环境的广泛实验中，LME表现出稳健的导航性能，并能泛化到具有挑战性的未见场景；其生成的子目标可用于引导不同的局部规划器，显著提升它们逃离局部极小值的能力；并在差速驱动机器人与四足机器人上成功部署。
AI.conclusion: LME以统一的框架同时应对存在与不存在局部极小值的环境，兼具可解释性、免训练与规划器无关性，验证了其实用性与通用性。

title: DrivingBench: Can Vision-Language Models Drive a Toyota Corolla?
summary: Frontier models excel at many digital benchmarks, yet their ability to drive a real car, an everyday human skill, remains largely untested. We present DrivingBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car. Through three tools, the models see camera frames from a Toyota Corolla and directly command its steering and velocity around a parking lot cone course at low speeds. The car may continue moving while the model thinks and new commands replace the currently running one, so inference latency is part of the task, testing the models' abilities to observe, act, monitor, recover, and complete a long-horizon objective under such constraints. We benchmark GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Grok 4.6 in vendor-native harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) with up to three attempts each in one conversation; Astra is the only model to finish the course, on its second attempt, with no other attempt passing 50% of the course. Two of the four models improved materially across attempts with retained context. We also detail the design principles behind our action interface, and show how the tool output format and the framing of the task combined to determine whether models would drive at all or refuse. We release our harness, prompts, course map, and traces with video and telemetry for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DrivingBench——首个要求通用视觉语言模型驾驶真车（丰田卡罗拉）的基准，在停车场锥桶赛道低速行驶。模型通过三个工具接收摄像头画面并直接控制转向与速度，且推理延迟本身构成任务的一部分。在Codex、Claude Code、Cursor三种原生环境中测试四个模型，每个模型最多三次尝试，仅Astra在第二次尝试中完成赛道，其余无一次通过50%。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在诸多数字基准上表现出色，但驱动真实汽车这一日常人类技能基本未被检验。现有评测缺乏真实物理世界中长时程、含延迟约束的驾驶任务，因此需要构建面向通用视觉语言模型的真车驾驶基准。
AI.method: 构建DrivingBench：模型通过三个工具获取丰田卡罗拉的摄像头帧，并直接发出转向与速度指令，在停车场锥桶赛道低速行驶。车辆在模型推理期间持续运动，新指令会覆盖正在执行的指令，使推理延迟成为任务的内在组成部分，从而考察模型在约束下的观察、行动、监控、恢复与长时程目标完成能力。评测在厂商原生harness（Codex、Claude Code、Cursor）中进行，每个模型同一对话内最多三次尝试。
AI.result: 对GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-5.6 Sol和Grok 4.6进行测试：仅Astra完成赛道，且是在第二次尝试中达成，其他任何尝试均未通过赛道的50%。四个模型中有两个在保留上下文的情况下跨尝试取得实质改进。此外还发现工具输出格式与任务措辞共同决定模型是否愿意驾驶或直接拒绝。
AI.conclusion: DrivingBench首次将通用视觉语言模型置于真车驾驶场景中，揭示了当前模型在延迟约束下的长时程物理任务上仍普遍失败，仅个别模型具备完成能力。工具接口设计原则、输出格式与任务框架对模型是否行动有决定性影响。作者公开harness、提示词、赛道地图及含视频与遥测的轨迹以支持复现。

title: Video2SwimFish: An Automated Pipeline for Reconstructing Controllable Fish Models and Biological Locomotion from Real Fish Videos
summary: We present Video2SwimFish, an automated pipeline and benchmark for building controllable fish assets from real-fish videos for underwater embodied AI. Given synchronized multi-view videos of an individual fish, the pipeline reconstructs a metrically scaled deformable mesh from a VLM-selected canonical frame, generates internal articulation adapted to that individual's morphology through a VLM actor-critic loop, and extracts a Biological Locomotion Manifold (BLM) from the fish's observed midline curvature. The BLM provides a low-dimensional action space bounded by real-fish motion, enabling an individual swimming policy to be learned for each reconstructed fish. We release two paired datasets: synchronized top- and front-view recordings of 120 individual fish across 6 species, and the controllable assets and individual swimming policies derived from them. Because every asset is tied to the animal it came from, the dataset supports a benchmark that evaluates locomotion learning not only on task success but on fidelity to that individual in trajectory shape, body curvature, and tail-beat frequency, across trajectory following, reward-free swimming behavior transfer from video, and a downstream case study in which a simulated BlueROV underwater robot captures one of the assets. We find that task success and locomotion fidelity do not necessarily improve together: the method achieving the highest task completion is not the method achieving the highest locomotion fidelity, and we identify faithful reproduction of individual animal locomotion as an open challenge for the community. Project website: https://hangongchen.github.io/video2swimfish-web/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Video2SwimFish，一个从真实鱼类的同步多视角视频自动构建可控鱼体资产并学习个体游泳策略的流程与基准，包含120条鱼、6个物种的配对数据集。
AI.motivation: 水下具身智能需要可控、且忠实于真实个体的鱼体资产，但现有方法难以从真实视频重建个体化形态、内部关节与真实运动空间，且缺乏评估「运动保真度」的基准。
AI.method: 流程：①由VLM选取规范帧，重建具有真实尺度的可变形网格；②通过VLM actor-critic循环生成适配个体形态的内部关节结构；③从观测到的中线曲率提取「生物运动流形（BLM）」作为低维动作空间，进而为每条鱼学习个体游泳策略。数据集：6物种、120条个体的顶视+前视同步视频，及派生资产与策略。基准：轨迹跟随、无奖励的视频游泳行为迁移，以及BlueROV捕获资产的下游案例。
AI.result: 轨迹形状、身体曲率和尾部摆频等保真度指标上与任务成功率并不一致：任务完成度最高的方法并非运动保真度最高的方法。
AI.conclusion: 个体动物运动的忠实复现是社区尚未解决的开放挑战，任务成功与运动保真度需分别评估。

title: SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable abilities to autonomously reason about and achieve goals in the digital world. However, bringing this success to the physical world remains challenging. On the one hand, direct generation methods (e.g., Code as Policies) often suffer from the LLMs' insufficient understanding of robots and physical environments. On the other hand, iterative trial-and-error tuning in the physical world (e.g., physical autoresearch) induces significant experimental cost and safety concerns. We introduce SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch, an autoresearch framework that tightly integrates simulated experimentation, enabling coding agents to efficiently acquire physical capabilities for controlling real robots. SimEX operates in two stages. First, the agent conducts open-ended probe-and-optimize iterations in simulation, developing a robot toolbox with robust and generalizable capabilities. Second, the agent adapts the toolbox and the simulator together through only a few physical trials: each trial corrects the simulator, and the corrected simulator is used to diagnose failures and screen candidate repairs. We evaluate SimEX extensively in sim-to-sim settings and on physical robots. On challenging real-world manipulation tasks including towel folding, barcode scanning, and plate manipulation, SimEX enables coding agents to efficiently acquire robot skills without any demonstration and with only 10 minutes of real-robot interaction. These results suggest that simulation can be a critical component in achieving physical intelligence, not only as a source of training data that must closely replicate the real world, but also as a roughly correct laboratory where a coding agent develops the knowledge and procedures needed to act on the robot. More details and robot videos at https://robo-simex.github.io/

AI.tldr: SimEX是一个将仿真实验紧密集成到编码智能体自动研究流程中的框架，通过"仿真内开放式探针-优化"与"少量真机试验联合适配工具包和仿真器"两阶段，使LLM编码智能体在无演示、仅10分钟真机交互下习得毛巾折叠、条形码扫描、盘子操作等操作技能。
AI.motivation: 将LLM编码智能体的自主推理能力迁移到物理世界面临两难：直接生成方法（如Code as Policies）受限于LLM对机器人和物理环境理解不足；而在物理世界中进行迭代试错调优（如physical autoresearch）会带来高昂实验成本与安全隐患。因此需要一种既能高效获取物理能力、又避免真机高代价试错的方案。
AI.method: SimEX（Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch）将仿真实验深度嵌入自动研究循环，分两阶段：第一阶段，智能体在仿真中进行开放式probe-and-optimize迭代，构建具备鲁棒性与泛化能力的机器人工具箱；第二阶段，通过少量真机试验同时适配工具箱与仿真器——每次真机试验用于校正仿真器，校正后的仿真器再用于诊断失败并筛选候选修复方案。
AI.result: 在sim-to-sim设置与真实机器人上进行了广泛评测。在毛巾折叠、条形码扫描、盘子操作等具有挑战性的真实操作任务中，SimEX使编码智能体在无任何演示、仅10分钟真实机器人交互的条件下高效习得机器人技能。
AI.conclusion: 仿真可以成为实现物理智能的关键组成部分：它不仅是必须高度复刻真实世界的训练数据来源，更可作为一个"大致正确"的实验室，让编码智能体在其中发展出作用于真实机器人所需的知识与流程。

title: Sparse-WAM: Accelerating World Action Models via Action-Guided Sparse Imagination
comment: Xinling Xie and Haodong Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: World-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video models to improve generalization in robot control by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. This capability comes at a substantial inference cost, as dense future-frame tokens are repeatedly processed during denoising. Prior methods address this by token pruning that prioritizes visual fidelity to reduce denoising costs in video diffusion models. However, these methods do not use action relevance to determine which future-frame tokens to retain during joint denoising in WAMs. In this paper, we propose Sparse-WAM, a training-free framework for action-guided sparse imagination that selectively processes future-frame tokens to accelerate WAM inference. We observe substantial overlap in the spatial distribution of attention from action tokens to future-frame tokens (action-to-future attention) between consecutive denoising steps, despite continued updates to the future representations. Motivated by this, we develop Action-Guided Token Selection to retain frame-specific action-relevant regions together with cross-frame context. However, a naive implementation can incur attention-scoring and token-packing overhead that offsets the computational savings from pruning. We therefore introduce Pilot, an efficient engine that reduces sparse inference overhead through lightweight scoring and cross-step reuse of token selections. On LIBERO with FastWAM-Joint and RoboLab-120 with Cosmos 3 Edge, Sparse-WAM achieves inference speedups of approximately $2.0\times$ and $1.8\times$, respectively, over dense eager inference on an NVIDIA RTX 4090, while largely preserving task performance.

AI.tldr: Sparse-WAM 是一个免训练框架，通过动作引导的稀疏想象选择性处理未来帧 token，加速世界-动作模型（WAM）推理，实现约 1.8–2.0 倍加速且基本保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAM）联合预测未来视觉状态与动作以提升机器人控制的泛化性，但推理成本高昂：去噪过程中需反复处理密集的未来帧 token。现有 token 剪枝方法面向视频扩散模型，以视觉保真度为优先，未利用动作相关性来决定联合去噪中应保留哪些未来帧 token，因而无法有效加速 WAM。
AI.method: 作者观察到连续去噪步之间，动作 token 对未来帧 token 的注意力（action-to-future attention）在空间分布上存在显著重叠，尽管未来表示仍在更新。据此提出 Action-Guided Token Selection，保留帧特定的动作相关区域及跨帧上下文；为消除朴素实现的注意力打分与 token 打包开销，进一步提出高效引擎 Pilot，通过轻量打分与跨步复用 token 选择来降低稀疏推理开销。整体为免训练框架 Sparse-WAM。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO（FastWAM-Joint）与 RoboLab-120（Cosmos 3 Edge）上，相比密集 eager 推理，在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上分别取得约 2.0 倍与 1.8 倍推理加速，同时基本保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-WAM 表明动作引导的稀疏想象可在免训练条件下有效加速 WAM 推理，且借助跨步注意力分布重叠的特性与 Pilot 引擎的开销优化，实现了显著加速与性能保持的平衡。

title: Cue the Flow: Steering Flow-Matching Policies for Open-World Delivery Manipulation
summary: Open-world goods delivery requires mobile manipulators to follow free-form user instructions and manipulate potentially novel objects. Existing dual-system approaches use high-level grounding models to convert language into grounded visual prompts, but their low-level controllers can remain brittle under noisy perception, dynamic scenes, and contact-rich interactions. We instead use a pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action model as the low-level control interface, leveraging its reactivity and robustness to environmental changes while treating the grounding output as a spatial cue for policy steering. Our key insight is that the pretrained VLA already provides a strong manipulation prior, while the spatial cue supplies the missing target information needed to guide actions under novel language--object mappings. Concretely, we introduce a lightweight cue-conditioned adapter. The adapter is first trained with contrastive objectives to produce salient and spatially discriminative cue representations, and is then supervised to predict a diagonal affine transformation over the generated action chunk, aligning policy steering with the cued target. Across tabletop and mobile-base settings, our method improves instruction following and manipulation success on both in-domain and out-of-domain objects, achieving up to near $2\times$ improvement in average task success rate with negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 该工作将预训练流匹配VLA模型作为底层控制接口，把高层grounding输出降级为“空间线索”用于策略引导，并通过轻量级cue-conditioned adapter实现对动作chunk的仿射调制，在保持低推理开销下显著提升开放世界指令跟随与操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 开放世界货物递送要求移动操作机器人理解自由形式语言指令并操作潜在新物体。现有一部分dual-system方案虽有高层grounding模型把语言转为视觉提示，但底层控制器在感知噪声、动态场景和接触丰富交互下依然脆弱；而预训练VLA本身具备强操作先验，缺的是新语言—物体映射下的目标信息。
AI.method: 以预训练flow-matching VLA作为底层控制接口，将grounding输出作为空间线索进行策略引导。核心是轻量级cue-conditioned adapter：先用对比学习目标训练出显著且具空间判别性的线索表征，再以监督方式预测对生成动作chunk的对角仿射变换，使策略引导与线索目标对齐。
AI.result: 在桌面与移动底盘两类设置、域内与域外物体上，方法均提升指令跟随与操作成功率，平均任务成功率最高接近2倍提升，且推理开销几乎可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练VLA作为底层先验、把grounding结果作为空间线索进行轻量适配，是一种在开放世界下兼顾鲁棒性、泛化性与效率的有效范式。

title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
summary: Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method. Project website: https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出NEXUS感知式全身控制框架，通过跨地形配对动作生成与教师-学生学习，实现人形机器人在不同地形上的全身遥操作。
AI.motivation: 全身遥操作要求机器人在自身地形与操作者不一致时仍复现其行为，因此机器人需感知局部地形并调整姿态与接触，而非逐帧复制动作。但同一行为在平地与不同地形间的配对动作数据稀缺，限制了地形自适应控制的监督学习。
AI.method: 提出可扩展的地形自适应适配算法，无需针对具体动作或地形调参即可高效生成高质量跨地形动作配对；构建总计近1000小时的配对动作语料，并采用教师-学生学习训练感知式全身控制器，将人类运动指令与机载感知反馈相结合。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能高效、可扩展地生成高质量动作数据；NEXUS在行为覆盖范围、地形适应性与跟踪保真度上兼具优势，在评测基准上优于现有全身控制器；零样本真机部署实现了多样未知地形上的实时全身遥操作，验证了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: NEXUS通过感知反馈与跨地形配对数据训练，有效解决了地形不匹配下的全身遥操作问题，具备良好的可扩展性与真实世界泛化能力。

title: Function beyond Form: Functional Correspondence for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
summary: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation remains challenging because robotic hands differ substantially in geometry, topology, and kinematics. Existing approaches often lack explicit correspondences between structurally different hand regions that play similar functional roles in a grasp, a concept we refer to as functional correspondence. Consequently, their models tend to learn hand-specific interaction patterns rather than transferable grasp knowledge, limiting generalization to unseen hands. To address this limitation, we introduce FunCo-Grasp, which establishes functional correspondences across heterogeneous hand embodiments. Specifically, Functional Part Alignment aligns each hand to a canonical functional schema by mapping physical links to shared functional parts according to their grasping roles, while Canonical Frame Alignment expresses these parts in canonical local frames. These two alignments provide a consistent representation for inter-part and hand-object interactions, allowing the model to learn transferable grasp knowledge across hands. Conditioned on the aligned hand representation and object geometry, a diffusion model generates the target spatial arrangement of the functional parts, which are then converted into an executable joint configuration. Adapting FunCo-Grasp to an unseen hand requires only its geometric and kinematic models and a one-time lightweight functional annotation, without target-hand grasp data, fine-tuning, or learned retargeting. In simulation on held-out objects from the filtered CMapDataset, we achieves average success rates of 92.40% on three seen hands and 74.02% on four unseen hands. In real-world experiments, the same model achieves an overall success rate of 76.00% on two unseen hands without additional training or fine-tuning. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of FunCo-Grasp in transferring grasp knowledge to unseen hands.

AI.tldr: FunCo-Grasp 通过功能部件对齐与规范坐标系对齐，建立异构手部间的功能对应关系，实现跨本体灵巧抓取生成的迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有跨本体抓取方法缺乏结构不同但功能相似的手部区域之间的显式对应（功能对应），导致模型只学到特定手的交互模式，泛化到未见手时性能受限。
AI.method: 提出 FunCo-Grasp：1) 功能部件对齐（Functional Part Alignment），按抓取角色将物理连杆映射到共享功能部件；2) 规范坐标系对齐（Canonical Frame Alignment），在规范局部坐标系中表达这些部件，从而得到统一的部件间与手-物交互表示；3) 以对齐后的手部表示与物体几何为条件，用扩散模型生成功能部件的目标空间布局，再转换为可执行关节配置。
AI.result: 在 filtered CMapDataset 的留出物体上仿真：三只见过的手平均成功率 92.40%，四只未见手 74.02%；真实实验中对两只未见手达到 76.00% 总体成功率，无需额外训练或微调。
AI.conclusion: 功能对应表示能有效迁移抓取知识至未见手；适配新本体仅需几何与运动学模型及一次性轻量功能标注，无需目标手抓取数据、微调或学习式重定向。

title: OccluDex: Hierarchical 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Learning for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation under Self-Occlusion
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Reliable dexterous manipulation requires continuous estimation of object geometry and hand-object contact throughout interaction. With egocentric sensing, however, the manipulating hand frequently occludes task-relevant object surfaces and contact regions, reducing the visual evidence available for state estimation and thereby making robust closed-loop control and generalization to unseen object geometries particularly challenging. To address this, we present OccluDex, a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning framework that integrates global geometric structure with local contact information for robust manipulation under dynamic self-occlusion during hand-object interaction. OccluDex adopts multi-scale masked autoencoding to progressively encode partial 3D geometry and fuses tactile contact tokens with high-level geometric features through cross-modal attention. The encoder is pretrained from synchronized human visuo-tactile demonstrations and transferred as a frozen perceptual backbone for downstream reinforcement learning. We evaluate OccluDex on a faucet rotation task, requiring one full clockwise handle revolution, and a tabletop object reorientation task, requiring a 180-degree tabletop object reorientation without toppling. In simulation experiments, OccluDex demonstrated 12.6% higher accuracy for unseen objects and 8.3% higher accuracy for previously seen objects than the strongest state-of-the-art baseline models. Physical experiments were further performed with a Shadow Hand to demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real generalization on unseen physical objects. This results could enable humanoid egocentric object manipulation for seen and unseen objects even when the manipulating robotic hand occludes vision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出OccluDex，一种层次化3D视触觉表征学习框架，通过融合全局几何结构与局部触觉接触信息，解决手-物交互中自遮挡导致的状态估计难题。在仿真中，未见物体准确率提升12.6%，已见物体提升8.3%，并在Shadow Hand上实现了零样本sim-to-real泛化。
AI.motivation: 在自我中心（egocentric）视角下，操作手会频繁遮挡任务相关的物体表面与接触区域，导致视觉证据减少，从而难以进行状态估计，并使闭环控制和对未见物体几何的泛化变得尤为困难。因此需要一种能够在动态自遮挡条件下充分利用视觉与触觉信息进行鲁棒操作的方法。
AI.method: OccluDex采用层次化3D视触觉表征学习框架。使用多尺度掩码自编码（multi-scale masked autoencoding）逐步编码局部3D几何；通过跨模态注意力（cross-modal attention）将触觉接触token与高层几何特征融合。编码器在同步的人类视触觉演示数据上预训练，并作为冻结的感知骨干迁移到下游强化学习中。
AI.result: 在两个任务上评估：水龙头旋转（需完整顺时针转动把手一圈）和桌面物体重新定向（需在不倾倒的情况下旋转180度）。仿真实验中，OccluDex对未见物体准确率比最强SOTA基线高12.6%，对已见物体高8.3%。并进一步在Shadow Hand上进行物理实验，展示了在未见物理物体上的成功零样本sim-to-real泛化。
AI.conclusion: 该结果可使类人自我中心物体操作在机器人手遮挡视觉的情况下，对已见和未见物体均可实现，为鲁棒的视触觉融合操作提供了可行路径。

title: Make Code as Policy Great Again: Frontier Agents Write, Call, and Evolve Robot Tools
summary: Frontier models can control robots, but reasoning through every reach, grasp, and retreat makes manipulation slow and token-intensive. We revisit code as policy with a different division of labor: models build executable tools, code handles multi-phase motions, and models decide what to do next. We introduce URAI (Universal Robot-Agent Interface), which couples a programming agent that constructs robot tools with an execution agent that uses them in a feedback loop. The programming agent writes reusable and task-specific tools from task intent and refines them through execution feedback and human guidance. The execution agent selects and parameterizes these tools from current observations; each call runs a complete motion locally before returning control to the agent. Unlike delegating subsequent decisions to a generated program, this design retains model-level decision-making between tool executions. Validated tool revisions persist across episodes without updating foundation-model weights, and a shared GUI and API make the same tools available to humans and agents. Across five RoboDojo tasks and four frozen execution agents, URAI raises aggregate success from 18.0% to 53.0% relative to direct fingertip control, with the largest gain on Swap Blocks; with the same tools, a program written in advance reaches only 24% against 56% for two agents deciding after each call. Three of the four agents also finish episodes 1.3-1.5 times faster with 1.5-1.7 times fewer execution-agent output tokens; DeepSeek-V4-Flash's cost barely changes. We further evaluate URAI on seven real-world AgileX dual-arm tasks, spanning object manipulation, cloth folding, and human-interactive tic-tac-toe. URAI connects the coding and decision-making capabilities of frontier agents, organizing robot control around reusable tools that agents can both invoke and revise.

AI.tldr: URAI 将"代码即策略"重构为分工模式：编程智能体编写可复用机器人工具，执行智能体在每次工具调用后继续做决策，从而提升操作成功率、速度并降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型虽能控制机器人，但逐步推理每个伸展、抓取与回退动作会导致操作缓慢且 token 消耗巨大，因此需要重新设计模型与代码的分工方式。
AI.method: 提出 URAI（通用机器人-智能体接口），耦合一个构建机器人工具的编程智能体与一个在反馈循环中使用这些工具的执行智能体；编程智能体依据任务意图编写可复用及任务专用工具，并通过执行反馈与人类指导进行改进；执行智能体根据当前观测选择并参数化工具，每次调用先在本地完成整个运动再交还控制权，从而保留工具执行之间的模型级决策；有效修订跨回合持久化且不更新基础模型权重，并通过共享 GUI 与 API 向人类和智能体开放同一套工具。
AI.result: 在五个 RoboDojo 任务与四个冻结执行智能体上，URAI 将总体成功率从 18.0% 提升至 53.0%，在 Swap Blocks 上增益最大；使用相同工具时，预先写好的程序仅达 24%，而两个智能体在每次调用后决策可达 56%；四个智能体中三个完成回合快 1.3–1.5 倍，执行智能体输出 token 少 1.5–1.7 倍，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 成本基本不变；在七个真实 AgileX 双臂任务（物体操作、叠布、人机交互井字棋）上进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: URAI 将前沿智能体的编程能力与决策能力连接起来，围绕可被智能体调用与修订的可复用工具组织机器人控制，验证了"工具构建 + 逐步决策"分工范式的有效性。

title: Looking Back to Move Forward: Temporal Verification for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative policies have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, combining expressive generative action modeling with scalable imitation learning from large demonstration corpora. However, heterogeneous demonstrations can induce suboptimal action chunks whose errors compound over time, eventually driving the robot into out-of-distribution states from which recovery is difficult. Action verification offers a test-time scaling strategy for mitigating this failure mode by sampling multiple candidate actions and using a verifier to select one for execution. Existing approaches, however, remain temporally myopic and costly to train, evaluating candidates from the current observation alone without accounting for trajectory continuity and often relying on large verifiers and additional expert demonstrations. In this paper, we introduce Temporal Verification (TeV), an efficient temporally aware action verification framework for flow-matching VLAs. TeV first learns a temporal token that summarizes recent observation--action history, enabling candidate chunks to be evaluated as continuations of the execution trajectory rather than as isolated predictions. Conditioned on this token, TeV constructs positive--negative pairs without additional expert demonstrations or preference annotations and trains an energy-based verifier contrastively to assign lower energy to higher-quality, trajectory-consistent action chunks. Beyond post-hoc ranking, TeV further uses the learned energy landscape to guide intermediate flow samples toward lower-energy regions, improving candidates before final selection. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that TeV provides reliably ranks action candidates, improves task success rates, and produces smoother execution trajectories.

AI.tldr: TeV：面向流匹配VLA的高效时序感知动作验证框架，通过时序token与能量验证器实现候选动作轨迹一致性评估与引导。
AI.motivation: 生成式策略结合模仿学习虽具表现力，但异构示范会产生次优动作块，误差随时间累积使机器人进入分布外状态、难以恢复。现有动作验证虽提供测试时扩展方案，但存在时序短视（仅凭当前观测评估）、训练代价高（依赖大验证器与额外专家示范）的问题，忽视轨迹连续性。
AI.method: 提出TeV框架：1）学习时序token，汇聚近期观测—动作历史，使候选动作块作为执行轨迹的延续而非孤立预测被评估；2）在该token条件下，无需额外专家示范或偏好标注，自动构造正负样本对，对比式训练基于能量的验证器，使高质量、轨迹一致的动作块获得更低能量；3）除事后排序外，利用所学能量地形引导中间流采样向低能区移动，在最终选择前优化候选动作。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明：TeV能可靠地对动作候选进行排序，提升任务成功率，并产生更平滑的执行轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TeV以时序感知、低成本训练的方式改进了流匹配VLA的动作验证，兼顾验证排序与生成引导，在仿真和真实环境验证了有效性。

title: CLIPPER Beyond Shortlisting: Auditable Decision Support for Changing Municipal Micromobility Policies
comment: Author preprint. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2nd ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Spatial Intelligence for Smart and Connected Communities (SpatialConnect 2026)
summary: In municipal planning workshops, planners and other stakeholders compare shared-micromobility parking policies by varying no-parking zones, retained sites, spacing, or area allocations. Each edit changes feasible sites and how much demand they cover, so the alternative must be reoptimized on the same spatial data. Full-set greedy, the transparent reference for this task, takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay (CLIPPER), an optimizer with audit functions developed for requirements elicited with the City of Braunschweig. In each greedy round, it forms a deterministic candidate pool of bounded size, computes how much still-uncovered demand each candidate would add, and rejects candidates that violate an active constraint. An optional offline audit scans every remaining feasible candidate and records what the restricted pool omitted. We evaluate these functions on complete eleven-state edit chains ($E_0,\ldots,E_{10}$) in Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin. With $K=1024$ candidates per group, the fixed-width mode CLIPPER-F has mean coverage gaps to full-set greedy under the same policy of 0.245, 0.003, and 0.001 percentage points in Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, respectively, while mean rollout time falls by factors of 13.6--28.9; no audited run terminates while a candidate outside the pool could still increase coverage. Plans computed from two checksummed versions of Braunschweig's official no-parking-zone data differ in 30 of about 540 selected sites although coverage moves by only about 0.1 percentage points. These changes still require municipal assessment and implementation. The findings inform a proposed municipal process that versions policy inputs, reports site changes beside coverage, and scans the full candidate set before a final decision.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLIPPER，一种带审计功能的贪心优化器，用于城市共享微出行停车政策交互规划，在保持近乎无损覆盖率的同时将求解时间降低 13.6–28.9 倍。
AI.motivation: 市政规划工作坊中，规划者需通过调整禁停区、保留站点、间距或面积分配来比较停车政策方案，每次编辑都会改变可行站点集合及其需求覆盖，因而必须在同一空间数据上重新优化。作为透明基准的全集贪心在城市尺度下单方案需数十秒，交互效率不足。
AI.method: CLIPPER（Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay）面向与 Braunschweig 市共同提炼的需求设计。每轮贪心构建有界规模的确定性候选池，计算各候选可新增的未覆盖需求，并剔除违反活跃约束的候选；另设可选离线审计，扫描全部剩余可行候选并记录受限池的遗漏。
AI.result: 在 Braunschweig、Munich、Berlin 的完整十一状态编辑链（E0–E10）上评测。每组 K=1024 候选时，固定宽度模式 CLIPPER-F 相对同策略全集贪心的平均覆盖差距分别为 0.245、0.003、0.001 个百分点，平均 rollout 时间下降 13.6–28.9 倍；所有经审计的运行均未出现池外候选仍可提升覆盖即终止的情况。基于两份校验和版本的 Braunschweig 官方禁停区数据计算出的方案，在约 540 个入选站点中 30 个不同，但覆盖率仅变化约 0.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支撑一套拟议的市政流程：对政策输入进行版本化，在报告覆盖的同时报告站点变化，并在最终决策前扫描完整候选集。相关变化仍需市政评估与实施。

title: SteerQuant: Steering Quantization Error with Action-Guided Scaling in World-Action Models
comment: Yunhan Wang and Haodong Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future world states and actions through iterative denoising, using shared weights to process heterogeneous semantic streams of video, proprioceptive, and action tokens. Quantization reduces inference cost, but comparable numerical errors in different streams can have markedly different effects on final actions, making numerical accuracy alone insufficient for reliable control. We introduce SteerQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework for WAMs that steers errors toward computations with less influence on final actions. It maps how each stream's quantization errors affect final actions and uses this map to guide shared channel scaling. Activation scaling is further calibrated for each stream and denoising step to accommodate changes in activation ranges and action impact. This adapts quantization to different stream requirements without duplicating weights or increasing bit-widths for selected streams. To reduce the extra kernel launches and memory traffic introduced by scaling, we develop Rudder, a 4-bit inference engine for WAMs that fuses scaling and output compensation into low-bit kernels. Under W4A8 and W4A4, SteerQuant maintains mean LIBERO success within 0.8 percentage points of full precision, while delivering up to $2.23\times$ denoising speedup over BF16 across three WAMs with reduced peak GPU memory usage. On a real dual-arm robot, W4A8 deployment achieves a $1.35\times$ end-to-end inference speedup while maintaining average task success relative to BF16.

AI.tldr: SteerQuant 提出面向世界-动作模型（WAMs）的 4-bit 量化框架，通过将量化误差引导至对最终动作影响较小的计算路径，并结合分数据流与分去噪步的激活缩放校准，以及融合低比特内核引擎 Rudder，在几乎不损失成功率的前提下实现显著推理加速。
AI.motivation: WAMs 通过迭代去噪联合生成未来世界状态与动作，并用共享权重处理视频、本体感知、动作等异构语义流；量化虽可降低推理成本，但不同数据流中相近的数值误差对最终动作影响差异显著，仅以数值精度为指标不足以保障可靠控制。
AI.method: 1) 建立各数据流量化误差对最终动作影响的映射，并以此指导共享通道缩放，使误差偏向影响较小的计算；2) 针对每个数据流和每个去噪步校准激活缩放，以适应激活范围与动作影响的变化，在不复制权重、不提升特定流位宽的前提下适配异构流需求；3) 设计 4-bit 推理引擎 Rudder，将缩放与输出补偿融合进低比特内核，减少额外内核启动与内存访问。
AI.result: 在 W4A8 与 W4A4 设置下，SteerQuant 在三个 WAMs 上的 LIBERO 平均成功率与全精度相差不超过 0.8 个百分点，去噪阶段相对 BF16 最高加速 2.23 倍，并降低峰值 GPU 显存占用；在真实双臂机器人上，W4A8 部署实现 1.35 倍端到端推理加速，平均任务成功率与 BF16 相当。
AI.conclusion: 面向 WAMs 的量化应超越单纯数值精度，而以对最终动作的影响为误差分配准则；SteerQuant 与 Rudder 在保持控制性能的同时显著提升效率，验证了影响导向量化与内核级缩放融合的有效性。

title: Occlusion-Aware, Quasi-Static, Stability-Oriented Trajectory Planning on Uneven Terrain
summary: Autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments requires reasoning about both vehicle--terrain interaction and environmental unknowns. We propose a model-based framework for generating quasi-static, stability-oriented reference trajectories for rigid, non-articulated four-wheeled vehicles on highly uneven terrain. Our work makes three primary contributions. First, we model blind spots caused by terrain occlusion as coverage-induced epistemic uncertainty in a fixed-feature Fourier terrain representation, quantified through a regularized inverse-Hessian estimate. Second, we propagate this uncertainty through the Nonlinear Least-Squares (NLS) pose/contact model using implicit differentiation and incorporate the resulting pose, contact-point, and per-wheel surface-normal uncertainty terms into trajectory optimization based on the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). Third, we introduce a Flow Matching model that warm-starts terrain fitting, and we evaluate its fitting-accuracy--latency trade-off while retaining model-based refinement. Across six synthetic terrains with 30 matched start--goal pairs per terrain, the complete framework produced an observed failure rate of 18.9%, compared with 46.1% and 41.7% for two representative baselines and 34.4% for an ablation that removed the propagated-uncertainty scoring. Hardware evaluations span six distinct outdoor environments, with two representative executions presented in the paper and four additional executions included in the supplementary video. The evaluation also reports the accuracy--latency trade-off for the Flow Matching warm start.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向崎岖地形的基于模型参考轨迹生成框架，将地形遮挡盲区建模为认知不确定性并传播至轨迹优化，同时用Flow Matching热启动地形拟合，显著降低失败率。
AI.motivation: 非结构化越野自主导航需同时考虑车辆-地形交互与环境未知性，现有方法对地形遮挡导致的不确定性缺乏建模与传播，影响稳定性与安全性。
AI.method: 1) 在固定特征傅里叶地形表示中，将地形遮挡盲区建模为覆盖诱导的认知不确定性，并用正则化逆Hessian估计量化；2) 通过隐式微分将不确定性传播经非线性最小二乘位姿/接触模型，得到位姿、接触点与逐轮表面法向不确定性项，并纳入基于交叉熵方法（CEM）的轨迹优化；3) 引入Flow Matching模型热启动地形拟合，保留基于模型的精化并评估精度-时延权衡。
AI.result: 在6个合成地形、每个地形30组匹配起终点对中，完整框架失败率18.9%，优于两个基线（46.1%、41.7%）及去除不确定性传播评分的消融（34.4%）。硬件评估覆盖6个不同户外环境，主文给出2次代表性执行，补充视频含4次；并报告Flow Matching热启动的精度-时延权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将地形遮挡引起的认知不确定性显式量化并传播至接触/位姿与轨迹优化，可有效提升崎岖地形下四轮车准静态稳定性导向轨迹的可靠性；Flow Matching热启动可在精度与时延间取得可评估的折衷。

title: LBDU-VIO: Learned Bias Dynamics and Uncertainty for Visual-Inertial Odometry with Unreliable Vision
summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) for aerial robots relies on high rate inertial measurement unit (IMU) propagation between visual updates. However, conventional multi state constraint Kalman filters (MSCKFs) use random walk bias assumptions and fixed noise parameters, which can limit robustness when visual information is unreliable. To address this problem, we propose LBDU-VIO, a learning-augmented MSCKF with learned continuous time bias dynamics and an IMU uncertainty model. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) models continuous time bias dynamics to propagate the filter's bias states, replacing their random walk model. The IMU uncertainty model predicts motion adaptive measurement noise covariances for covariance propagation. Both models are trained with pose supervision without direct labels. Experiments on real world EuRoC and TUM-VI benchmarks show lower errors than representative visual-inertial baselines, including a 25.1% reduction in mean relative position error compared with S-MSCKF on EuRoC sequences with 10s visual outage.

AI.tldr: 提出LBDU-VIO，一种学习增强的MSCKF，用神经ODE建模连续时间零偏动态并预测IMU运动自适应噪声，仅用位姿监督训练，在EuRoC和TUM-VI上误差低于代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 传统多状态约束卡尔曼滤波（MSCKF）依赖随机游走零偏假设与固定噪声参数，当视觉信息不可靠（如视觉中断）时鲁棒性受限，需要提升VIO在视觉退化情况下的性能。
AI.method: 提出LBDU-VIO：以神经常微分方程建模连续时间零偏动态，替代随机游走模型用于滤波器零偏状态传播；引入IMU不确定性模型预测运动自适应量测噪声协方差用于协方差传播；两个模型均通过位姿监督训练，无需直接标签。
AI.result: 在真实世界EuRoC与TUM-VI基准上误差低于代表性视觉惯性基线；在含10s视觉中断的EuRoC序列上，平均相对位置误差较S-MSCKF降低25.1%。
AI.conclusion: 学习增强的连续时间零偏动态与运动自适应IMU噪声建模能有效提升MSCKF在视觉不可靠场景下的鲁棒性与精度，且无需直接标签。

title: Drape-Compatible Tool-Tip Localization for Hand-Held Laparoscopic Instruments via UWB Carrier-Phase Ranging and Trocar-Constrained Geometry
summary: A surgical robot policy needs to know where each instrument's working end sits relative to the camera and to the other instrument, yet a laparoscopic operation leaves only the endoscope video, and a draped instrument hides every optical path on itself. We estimate the tool tips from distances and an IMU alone. The distances are measured by ultra-wideband carrier phase between antenna nodes on the handle side of the instruments: one per hand-held instrument, one on the endoscope, all outside the sterile barrier. Take the endoscope antenna as the reference. The two instrument antennas carry six coordinates while the three pairs give three distances, so the problem is short by three, and averaging cannot close that gap because what is missing is information, not precision. Carrier phase adds one more unknown per pair, an integer that leaves distance fixed only modulo lambda/2 = 23.1 mm. The trocar settles both difficulties: each shaft passes through a port whose position is known and whose direction the on-board IMU measures, so its antenna keeps a single degree of freedom, the insertion depth. Two unknowns now face three distances -- two fix the depths and the third is left over, and that spare equation exposes a wrong integer or a wrong mounting offset instead of absorbing it. The same solve returns both tool tips in the endoscope frame, without the second carrier frequency that integer resolution usually needs, so the link never leaves a single PLL lock. In an 11-hole phantom among metal instruments the three distances hold sigma = 0.10-0.33 mm at 35-46 Hz, a sterile drape pressed onto the antennas leaves the link unchanged where an optical path would be blocked, and the logger was carried into a live rabbit appendectomy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出仅用超宽带载波相位测距与IMU，在无菌屏障外经由trocar几何约束估计腹腔镜器械末端位姿的方法。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人策略需要知道器械工作端相对摄像头及另一器械的位置，但腹腔镜手术仅有内窥镜视频，且铺巾会遮挡器械自身所有光路，因此需要一种不依赖光学的定位手段。
AI.method: 在手持器械与内窥镜的手柄侧（无菌屏障外）布置超宽带天线节点，以载波相位测量三对天线间距离；以内窥镜天线为参考，两器械天线共六个坐标对三个距离存在三自由度欠定，且载波相位每对引入一个整数模糊（λ/2=23.1 mm）。利用trocar提供约束：器械杆穿过位置已知的孔口，IMU测量其方向，使每根天线仅剩插入深度一个自由度，从而两个未知量对应三个距离，多余方程可检测错误整数或安装偏移。该求解同时输出内窥镜坐标系下两个器械末端，且无需第二载波频率完成整数解算，链路保持单一PLL锁定。
AI.result: 在含金属器械的11孔体模中，三个距离在35-46 Hz下标准差为0.10-0.33 mm；铺巾压在天线上时链路不受影响（而光路会被阻断）；记录器还被带入活体兔阑尾切除术中验证。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭UWB载波相位测距与IMU，结合trocar几何约束，即可在无需额外载波频率的条件下稳健估计器械末端位姿，并具备无菌环境与活体应用可行性。

title: Blackout vs. Freeze: Analyzing Physical Failure Modes of VLAs under Camera Faults
summary: Unreliable visual inputs can harm task performance and cause potential physical safety risks for vision-language-action (VLA) models. We analyze how $π0.5$ and GR00T models act under input faults such as image blackouts and freezing. We find that blackout and freezing produce distinct physical failure modes even when task-success rates are similarly low: freezing causes more extreme joint behavior, whereas blackout after gripper closure can cause more object drops, most markedly without proprioception. Selective intervention studies reveal that proprioception (current robot state) partly compensates for the removed robot depictions and reduces non-target contact. However, it cannot sufficiently restore task success when wrist-view object information is removed, even when aided by the remaining scene view. We then evaluate two mitigation approaches: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings. Both improve task success in selected conditions, but can increase unintended contact or disturbance to surrounding objects. Real-robot trials further show that successful execution under camera faults can still involve unintended physical interactions. These findings motivate designing VLA policies that use the robot and object information still available under camera faults to limit hazardous motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析VLA模型在视觉输入故障（图像黑屏、画面冻结）下的物理失效模式，发现黑屏与冻结即使成功率相近也导致不同失效行为，本体感知只能部分补偿，两类缓解方法各有代价。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型对不可靠视觉输入敏感，可能导致任务失败甚至物理安全隐患。现有工作多关注任务成功率，缺乏对故障条件下具体物理失效模式及其成因的系统分析，也缺少对缓解手段副作用的评估。作者因此希望通过故障注入与选择性干预，厘清不同视觉故障的失效机制与可用信息的作用。
AI.method: 以π0.5与GR00T模型为对象，注入图像黑屏与画面冻结等输入故障；对比不同故障下的物理失效模式；通过选择性干预（移除机器人本体图像、腕部视角物体信息、场景视角等）分析本体感知与各视角信息的作用；随后评估两类缓解方法：相机黑屏训练与免训练的故障视觉嵌入替换；并在真机上进行验证。
AI.result: 黑屏与冻结在任务成功率相近的情况下产生不同物理失效模式：冻结导致更极端的关节行为；夹爪闭合后发生黑屏更易导致物体掉落，在无本体感知时尤为明显。选择性干预表明，本体感知可部分补偿被移除的机器人图像并减少非目标接触，但当腕部视角的物体信息被移除时，即使有场景视角辅助也无法充分恢复任务成功率。两类缓解方法在特定条件下提升成功率，但会增加对周围物体的意外接触或扰动。真机实验同样显示，相机故障下成功的执行过程仍可能伴随意外物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 研究呼吁设计在相机故障下仍能利用可用机器人与物体信息来限制危险运动的VLA策略，而非仅以任务成功率为优化目标。

title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
summary: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. The linear model requires fewer recurrent parameters and less computation than GRU, but performs comparably. These results suggest that, for this memory dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory mechanism can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required. These conclusions are limited to the simulated task, teacher, state dimension, and blackout horizon considered here, and to policies whose observation encoder and action head remain nonlinear.

AI.tldr: 在模拟空气曲棍球防守（含追踪丢失）任务中，将DreamerV3教师蒸馏为64维循环策略：纯线性循环（k=0）与GRU、教师性能相当，增加非线性创新秩无收益，说明该记忆依赖控制任务不必然需要非线性循环动力学。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是"记忆依赖型控制是否需要非线性循环动力学"。作者通过在临时丢失冰球追踪的模拟空气曲棍球防守任务上检验该问题：教师（DreamerV3）在追踪丢失时优于无记忆策略，且重置教师的循环状态会显著降低性能，从而确认任务确实需要记忆，为后续对比线性与非线性循环机制提供了必要前提。
AI.method: 将DreamerV3教师蒸馏为紧凑的64维状态循环策略，循环部分为对角线性递推加上可选的秩-k非线性创新（rank-k nonlinear innovation），同时保留非线性的观测编码器与动作头。对比对象包括纯线性循环模型（k=0）、GRU基线和教师。在五个匹配随机种子下，于测试的追踪丢失范围内评估；结论基于一个全新的测试划分，且该划分要在所有模型与分析冻结后才打开。
AI.result: 在五个匹配种子下，纯线性循环模型（k=0）在整个测试的追踪丢失范围内与GRU基线和教师表现相当；提高非线性创新秩并未带来可测量的收益。线性模型所需循环参数更少、计算量低于GRU，但性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 在该记忆依赖控制任务中，围绕简单线性记忆机制进行非线性表示学习即可足够，非线性循环动力学并非必要。结论受限于所考虑的模拟任务、教师、状态维度、黑out时长，以及观测编码器和动作头保持非线性的策略设定。

title: Concurrent Semantic Search and Mission Execution for LTL Missions in Unknown Environments
summary:
Planning complex missions in unknown environments requires robots to reason simultaneously about what they should do and what they still need to discover. Existing approaches for solving LTLf missions typically assume a known environment, or separate the exploration of the environment from the execution of the mission, while semantic exploration methods look for one target at a time and ignore the mission being executed.
  To fill this gap, our main contribution is an adaptive high-level planning method that interleaves a task-driven semantic search with the execution of the mission, advancing both in a non-myopic manner.
  Our method leverages two representations built online, a metric-semantic scene graph, built with a Vision Language Model (VLM), that provides the evidence needed to locate the objects the mission refers to, and the deterministic finite automaton (DFA) encoding the mission, that indicates which of them matter at each mission state. At every planning stage, our planner selects the waypoints that are most valuable for both the semantic search and the advancement of the mission, valuing them over the remaining mission stages in order to avoid blocking states. The selected waypoints are then ordered in a single high-level plan, which is recomputed as new information arrives.
  In photorealistic indoor environments over five mission types, our method completes more missions than the compared approaches while having to cover less of the environment, and it does so with shorter paths and complying with the restrictions imposed by the mission.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应高层规划方法，将任务驱动的语义搜索与LTLf任务执行非短视地交错进行，在线构建度量-语义场景图与DFA，统一选择并排序航点，在室内环境中用更少探索和更短路径完成更多任务。
AI.motivation: 未知环境下规划复杂任务需同时推理"该做什么"和"还需发现什么"。现有LTLf方法假设环境已知，或将探索与执行分离；语义探索方法一次只找一个目标，忽略正在执行的任务。故需填补该空白。
AI.method: 自适应高层规划：在线构建两种表示——由视觉语言模型(VLM)构建的度量-语义场景图(提供定位任务所指物体的证据)，以及编码任务的确定性有限自动机(DFA，指示每个任务状态下哪些物体重要)。每个规划阶段选择对语义搜索和任务推进都最有价值的航点，并在剩余任务阶段上评估其价值以避免阻塞状态；将选中航点排序为单一高层规划，随新信息到达重新计算。
AI.result: 在逼真室内环境的五类任务中，相比对比方法完成更多任务，且需覆盖的环境更少，路径更短，并满足任务施加的约束。
AI.conclusion: 任务驱动的语义搜索与任务执行的非短视交错规划，结合在线场景图与DFA表示，能有效提升未知环境下LTLf任务的完成率与效率。

title: LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation
summary: High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations. Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation. Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines. Demos and code are available at: https://zhaozijie2022.github.io/LocoWM

AI.tldr: LocoWM：一种基于世界模型的预主动残差自适应框架，通过预测未来物理状态来提前补偿偏差，实现高精度运动控制。
AI.motivation: 高精度运动需要运动指令跟踪与任务相关物理状态的精确调节。端到端联合优化会导致精度目标优化不足；而反应式残差控制只能在偏差可观测后才调整动作，具有滞后性。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：基础策略提供指令跟随运动；动作条件世界模型根据本体感知历史和基础动作预测未来物理状态序列；残差适配器基于预测序列生成加性动作修正以补偿预期偏差。采用两阶段训练：先学习运动与动作条件动力学，再冻结两者训练适配器，将运动习得与精度自适应解耦。
AI.result: 在地形平整、加速度补偿和推力恢复等实验中，相比端到端与反应式残差基线，控制精度和扰动鲁棒性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过世界模型预测实现预主动（而非被动反应式）残差调整，并分离运动与精度优化目标，可有效提升高精度运动的控制精度与抗扰能力。

title: DSDyn-VLA: A Dual-Stream Dynamic Manipulation Framework with Motion Perception, Future Awareness, and Realtime Correction
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static tasks, they struggle in dynamic environments where objects are in motion (e.g., conveyor belt manipulation). We identify three fundamental limitations hindering current VLAs in these scenarios: the \textbf{perception gap}, where static visual inputs lack temporal motion cues; the \textbf{latency gap}, where inference delays render actions obsolete; and the \textbf{control gap}, caused by the open-loop action chunk execution without real-time adjustment. In this work, we propose \textbf{DSDyn-VLA}, a Slow-Fast \textbf{D}ual-\textbf{S}tream \textbf{Dyn}amic manipulation framework that integrates motion-aware foresighted planning with real-time residual correction. The slow \textbf{Flow-Planner} serves as a macro-planner. By enhancing the VLA with optical flow for temporal perception and a future state awareness mechanism to preemptively offset inference latency, it produces globally consistent, motion-aware action chunks. Complementing this, the fast \textbf{Res-Refiner} employs a lightweight RL policy to inject high-frequency, closed-loop corrections into the planned action chunks based on real-time observations. In addition, we introduce \textbf{DynBench}, a MuJoCo-based benchmark for dynamic object manipulation that comprises nine tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSDyn-VLA reduces the failure rate by over 76\% compared to current SOTA method in high-latency setting on the Kinetix dynamic benchmark, while achieving about 6$\times$ the success rate of PI0.5 in real-world dynamic settings and about 5$\times$ on DynBench. We will open-source all the code and weights.

AI.tldr: 提出DSDyn-VLA慢-快双流动态操作框架，结合运动感知前瞻规划与实时残差校正，解决VLA在动态环境中的感知、延迟与控制三大缺陷，并构建DynBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在静态任务表现优异，但在物体运动的动态环境（如传送带操作）中失效。作者识别出三大根本限制：感知差距（静态视觉输入缺乏时序运动线索）、延迟差距（推理延迟导致动作过时）、控制差距（开环动作块执行缺乏实时调整）。
AI.method: DSDyn-VLA采用慢-快双流架构。慢流Flow-Planner作为宏观规划器，通过引入光流增强时序感知，并利用未来状态感知机制预先补偿推理延迟，生成全局一致、运动感知的动作块。快流Res-Refiner采用轻量级RL策略，基于实时观测向规划动作块注入高频闭环校正。同时构建MuJoCo的DynBench基准，含九个任务。
AI.result: 在高延迟设置的Kinetix动态基准上，相比当前SOTA方法失败率降低超76%；在真实动态场景中成功率约为PI0.5的6倍，在DynBench上约为5倍。代码与权重将全部开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过慢-快双流设计将前瞻规划与闭环残差校正结合，可有效弥合VLA在动态操作中的感知、延迟与控制差距，显著提升动态环境下的操作鲁棒性与成功率。

title: Benchmarking EMlog Calibration for Autonomous Surface Vehicles
summary: Accurate velocity measurement is a fundamental requirement for autonomous surface and underwater vehicles. Commonly, velocity is provided by a Doppler velocity log (DVL) sensor, yet it becomes unavailable due to operational altitude constraints. In such situations, electromagnetic logs (EMLogs) provide a critically robust alternative for continuous velocity estimation. However, raw EMLog measurements are inherently corrupted by systematic errors, which need to be calibrated prior mission begins. Currently, a benchmarking comparative evaluation of how different calibration models perform under rapidly changing dynamic sea conditions is missing in the literature. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a comparative model-based calibration methodology that evaluates four distinct calibration models using two different estimation pipelines. The proposed framework is rigorously validated on a unique 221 minutes of continuous real-world telemetry collected from the MARVEL surface vehicle during dynamic sea trials. The dataset contains two different EMLogs and DVL recordings. Experimental results demonstrate that the bias and scale error model implemented with the Kalman filter improves the speed estimation by 71%. We also demonstrate that dynamical manoeuvres further improve the accuracy compared to standard straight-line paths, ultimately delivering a validated, real-time online calibration EMLog approach for autonomous surface vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电磁计程仪（EMLog）原始测量受系统性误差影响、且缺乏动态海况下不同标定模型对比评估的问题，提出基于模型的标定方法，在MARVEL水面艇221分钟真实试验数据上对比四种标定模型与两种估计流程。结果表明，采用卡尔曼滤波的偏置与尺度误差模型将速度估计精度提升71%，且动态机动路径优于直线路径，实现了面向自主水面艇的实时在线EMLog标定。
AI.motivation: 自主水面与水下航行器需要准确的速度测量，通常由多普勒测速仪（DVL）提供，但受作业高度限制时DVL会失效，此时电磁计程仪（EMLog）成为持续测速的关键替代方案。然而EMLog原始测量存在系统性误差，需在任务前标定；而文献中缺乏在快速变化的动态海况下对不同标定模型性能的基准对比评估。
AI.method: 提出一种基于模型的对比标定方法，评估四种不同的标定模型，并采用两种不同的估计流程（包含卡尔曼滤波）。在MARVEL水面艇动态海上试验中采集的221分钟连续真实遥测数据上进行严格验证，数据集同时包含两种EMLog与DVL记录。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，结合卡尔曼滤波实现的偏置与尺度误差模型将速度估计精度提升了71%；同时证明与标准直线路径相比，动态机动路径可进一步提升标定精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文为自主水面艇提供了一种经过验证的、可实时在线运行的EMLog标定方法，弥补了动态海况下EMLog标定模型对比评估的空白。

title: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
summary: We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASENA——一个将通用编程智能体与机器人感知、计算、受监督执行和持久经验相连接的具体智能体系统，并引入可选的4B单目导航策略ASENA-VLN。ASENA-VLN单独使用在R2R/RxR上达68.7%/70.2%成功率；与编程智能体集成后在两个智能体基准上提升11个百分点并缩短执行时间；通过持久工作区演化，重复100任务子集十轮后成功率从72%升至98%（R2R）、65%升至89%（RxR）；在具身问答上以更少交互步数取得最优精度；并在Unitree G1上完成无预建地图的真实世界演示。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人系统多局限于固定技能库或单一路线跟随，难以灵活组合感知、推理与长期经验积累；同时，将通用编程智能体与真实机器人执行闭环结合的研究仍较缺乏。作者希望构建一个可编程、可复用经验、可自主修复失败的具体智能体系统，并验证学习型导航策略作为其可选工具的增益。
AI.method: 系统层面：ASENA将通用编码智能体接入机器人的感知、计算、受监督执行与持久经验模块，智能体在冻结模型权重下编写并执行程序、检查记录结果、修复失败、复用笔记与可执行技能。策略层面：ASENA-VLN为4B单目导航策略，基于共享视觉-语言解码器，联合训练路线指令、视觉问答，以及新构建的几何推导原子导航任务数据集，输出体坐标系轨迹，兼顾长路线与短时行为。集成层面：将ASENA-VLN作为可调用工具嵌入可编程系统，并结合工作区持久演化与仿真器反馈进行多轮迭代。
AI.result: ASENA-VLN单独作为策略在R2R上成功率68.7%、RxR上70.2%，达到当时最优；与编程智能体集成后，在两个智能体基准上成功率均提升11个百分点，同时减少执行时间。通过持久工作区演化与仿真反馈，对重复出现的100任务子集进行十轮迭代，R2R成功率由72%提升至98%，RxR由65%提升至89%。在具身问答任务上以更少交互步数取得最优精度。真实世界在Unitree G1上完成搜索、视觉检查、空间推理与合成手势，且无需预建地图。
AI.conclusion: ASENA展示了"在线编程+学习型导航工具+持久经验"的组合范式：编码智能体可在权重冻结条件下通过程序编写与经验复用持续自我改进，学习型导航策略既可作为独立SOTA策略，也可作为系统内的可选工具带来显著增益。真实机器人演示表明该方法能将机器人行为从路线跟随和预定义技能扩展至开放式任务，为通用具体智能体提供了可扩展路径。

title: ReWAM: Reciprocal World Action Models for Interactive Autonomous Driving
summary: In interactive scenarios, an autonomous driving system is required to generate ego actions under the influence of other agents' behaviors. Existing World Action Models (WAMs) typically model other agents as components of the world model rather than as decision-makers that fundamentally shape the action of the ego agent, which impairs their performance in dense interaction scenarios. We introduce Reciprocal World Action Models (ReWAM), a game-theoretic world action modeling framework that captures the reciprocal influence between the ego agent and other agents by representing them as conditional responders whose actions are mutually influenced. We instantiate this framework with a Level-$k$ response hierarchy, where role-specific ego and other action DiTs exchange compact strategy tokens through cross-agent attention while remaining grounded in a shared representation of the future driving world. To learn the response policy of the ego agent from demonstrations, we formulate expert actions as samples from the best response distribution and jointly optimize the entire hierarchy using conditional flow matching. Our framework is evaluated on the NAVSIM dataset and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to baselines. The improvement is particularly significant in interactive scenarios, validating that modeling reciprocal responses provides a more effective foundation for interaction-aware world action generation.

AI.tldr: 提出互惠世界动作模型（ReWAM），将自车与其他智能体建模为相互影响的响应者，在NAVSIM数据集上取得最优性能，交互场景提升尤为显著。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）多将其他智能体视为世界模型的组成部分，而非根本上塑造自车动作的决策者，导致其在密集交互场景中性能受损。
AI.method: 提出ReWAM博弈论世界动作建模框架，将自车与其他智能体表示为相互影响的"条件响应者"；以Level-k响应层级实例化，角色专属的ego与other动作DiT通过跨智能体注意力交换紧凑策略token，并共享未来驾驶世界表征；将专家动作视为最佳响应分布样本，用条件流匹配联合优化整个层级。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM数据集上评估，性能优于基线，达到state-of-the-art；交互场景中的提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 对互惠响应的建模为交互感知的世界动作生成提供了更有效的基础。

title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
summary: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness is trustworthy, generalizes, and improves steadily. A single rollout is a noisy binary outcome, so with few rollouts per round a revision can be promoted on luck; enlarging the batch raises the signal-to-noise ratio of every promotion decision. Holding rounds fixed and growing the training set from 5 to 100 rollouts, held-out success rises from 47% to 67%, while small training sets overfit, reaching 70% on training tasks but only 54% held-out. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. With every revision it proposes accepted unconditionally, performance drifts downward within ten rounds as ill-judged edits accumulate; adding the most basic safeguard, Champion-Challenger selection that promotes a revision only if it strictly beats the incumbent on the same fixed evaluation set, turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"优化器智能体"自动进化为机器人策略服务的编码智能体"外壳"（提示词、工具与控制规则），并指出两个关键：每轮 rollout 规模决定进化可信度，以及必须引入 Champion-Challenger 筛选机制。
AI.motivation: 现成编码智能体作为机器人策略时，需通过截图观察浏览器 3D 界面、用少量工具设定虚拟目标夹爪，其外壳（harness、提示词、工具、控制规则）对成功率影响极大，但目前完全依赖人工编写，成本高且难以优化，因此需要探索自动化改进途径。
AI.method: 采用另一编码智能体作为优化器，自动改写上述外壳。实验考察两个变量：其一，每轮优化器观察的 rollout 数量（从 5 扩至 100，并对比小训练集情形）；其二，是否对优化器提出的每次修订无条件接受，还是加入 Champion-Challenger 选择，即仅当新版本在固定评估集上严格优于当前版本时才予以采纳。
AI.result: 固定轮数、将训练 rollout 从 5 增至 100，留出任务成功率由 47% 升至 67%；小训练集过拟合，训练任务达 70% 但留出仅 54%。若无条件接受所有修订，性能在十轮内持续下滑；加入 Champion-Challenger 后，30 轮内留出成功率由 51% 升至 67%。
AI.conclusion: 面向视觉界面机器人智能体的外壳自动进化是可行的，但其收益取决于每次决策背后的 rollout 规模（信噪比）以及优化器修订的筛选方式，二者是自动进化能否稳定增益的核心条件。

title: FORTE: Forecasting Occupancy for Spatiotemporal Risk-Aware Planning in Dynamic Environments
summary: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires anticipating future environmental states to account for spatiotemporal risks, specifically when and where collisions may occur. To this end, occupancy grid map (OGM) prediction has been widely adopted as an effective approach. However, existing OGM-based navigation methods often struggle to achieve accurate and efficient forecasting and fail to fully exploit the temporal information in predicted OGMs during planning. To address these challenges, we propose FORTE, a navigation framework that directly exploits the spatiotemporal evolution of predicted occupancy from the perspectives of spatiotemporal occupancy overlap and occupancy directivity. Based on these properties, FORTE evaluates multiple topology-distinct paths and selects the suitable one without explicit object detection or tracking. To support online planning, we formulate a latent diffusion model-based OGM predictor that generates the entire forecast horizon in a non-autoregressive manner while maintaining temporal consistency through temporal shift modules. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FORTE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. For prediction, FORTE achieves up to 215.3% higher IoU and 5.24x faster inference; for navigation, it yields up to a 3.5x higher success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出FORTE导航框架，直接利用预测占据栅格的时空演化（时空占据重叠与占据方向性），结合潜扩散模型非自回归预测器，实现无需显式目标检测/跟踪的高效安全导航。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下安全导航需预见未来环境状态以考虑时空风险（碰撞的时间与位置）。现有基于占据栅格地图（OGM）的导航方法预测精度与效率不足，且规划时未充分利用预测OGM中的时序信息。
AI.method: 1）FORTE框架从“时空占据重叠”和“占据方向性”两个视角直接利用预测占据的时空演化，评估多条拓扑不同的路径并选出合适路径，无需显式目标检测或跟踪；2）提出基于潜扩散模型（latent diffusion model）的OGM预测器，以非自回归方式生成整个预测时域，并通过时序偏移模块（temporal shift modules）保持时序一致性，支持在线规划。
AI.result: 预测方面，FORTE的IoU最高提升215.3%，推理速度最高快5.24倍；导航方面，成功率最高提升3.5倍，整体优于现有最优基线。
AI.conclusion: FORTE通过直接挖掘预测占据栅格的时空特性并配合高效非自回归预测，显著提升动态环境导航的预测精度、推理效率与导航成功率。

title: A Biophysically Detailed C. elegans Circuit as a Task-Agnostic Dynamical Core for Visually Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot policies are usually trained for one task, one body and one visual environment, and generalize poorly beyond these conditions. Whether a nervous system can instead supply the sensorimotor computation through its evolved wiring and biophysics remains unresolved. Here we embed a biophysically detailed Caenorhabditis elegans sensorimotor circuit - 136 multicompartment neurons with realistic morphologies and electrophysiological characteristics - as the dynamical core of a visuomotor policy. Only thin task-specific adapters are trained; the core's synaptic weights stay fixed while its membrane voltages evolve freely. Across different MetaWorld tasks the core matches or exceeds diffusion-policy, action-chunking-transformer and neural-circuit-policy baselines, and degrades less under visual perturbations. Replacing the core with generic network models such as MLP, LSTM, transformer or reservoir networks removes the advantage. Furthermore, on a real robotic arm the core withstands diverse visual perturbations that collapse the baselines. Our results suggest that visual robustness can be inherited from biophysically detailed circuit dynamics rather than learned by task-specific controllers.

AI.tldr: 将秀丽隐杆线虫的生物物理精细感觉运动回路（136个多室神经元，固定突触权重、膜电位自由演化）作为视觉运动策略的动力学核心，仅训练少量任务适配器。该核心在MetaWorld多任务上匹配或超越扩散策略、ACT及神经回路策略基线，视觉扰动下退化更小，并在真实机械臂上优于崩溃的基线，表明视觉鲁棒性可继承自生物物理回路动力学。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略通常针对单一任务、单一本体与单一视觉环境训练，跨条件泛化能力差。核心问题是：神经系统能否通过其演化形成的连接与生物物理特性直接提供感觉运动计算，而非依赖任务特定学习。作者借此探索以真实生物回路动力学作为策略核心来获得鲁棒性与泛化性的可能性。
AI.method: 构建生物物理精细的秀丽隐杆线虫感觉运动回路，包含136个具有真实形态和电生理特性的多室神经元，将其嵌入视觉运动策略作为动力学核心。核心突触权重保持固定（不训练），膜电位自由演化，仅训练轻量的任务专用适配器。在MetaWorld多任务上评估，并与扩散策略、动作分块Transformer（ACT）、神经回路策略等基线对比，考察视觉扰动下的表现；进一步用MLP、LSTM、Transformer、储备池网络替换核心，并在真实机械臂上验证。
AI.result: 在MetaWorld的不同任务上，该生物回路核心匹配或超过扩散策略、动作分块Transformer及神经回路策略基线，且在视觉扰动下性能下降更小。将核心替换为MLP、LSTM、Transformer或储备池网络后，优势消失，说明性能来源于特定生物物理回路而非通用网络容量。在真实机械臂上，该核心能承受导致基线方法崩溃的多种视觉扰动。
AI.conclusion: 视觉鲁棒性可以从生物物理精细的回路动力学中"继承"，而无需由任务特定控制器从零学习。这提示真实神经系统演化出的连接与电生理特性本身就是有效的、对视觉扰动鲁棒的策略动力学核心，为构建泛化性更强的机器人策略提供了新范式。

title: HiWE: Hierarchical World Knowledge Model with Visual Keypoint Enhancement for Zero-Shot 3D Path Planning
summary: Robot demonstration generation requires a system to identify where an interaction should occur, plan a feasible motion, and execute the required contact. HiWE connects these decisions through a point-based interface between visual grounding and language-based planning. PointVLM is instruction-tuned to associate task-relevant objects with image coordinates using a mixture of point annotations, segmentation-derived samples, robot observations, and visual question answering data. Depth measurements lift these predictions into a semantic 3D representation. A language planner, 3DLLM, uses this representation to specify end-effector waypoints and gripper commands, while a hybrid grasping module resolves local grasp poses. The evaluation covers 14 simulated manipulation tasks and four physical-robot tasks, together with ablations of the visual training data, spatial inputs, and grasp selection. Here, zero-shot execution refers to deployment without task-specific demonstration training; the visual model uses existing robot data during fine-tuning. This paper describes the original point-based formulation of the framework; its relationship to the subsequent GeneralVLA extension is detailed in the introduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiWE框架，通过PointVLM（点视觉定位）与3DLLM（语言规划器）间的点基接口，将视觉定位、运动规划与接触执行连接为闭环，并配合混合抓取模块解决局部抓取姿态问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人示范生成需同时解决"在哪里交互"（定位）、"如何规划可行运动"（规划）与"如何执行接触"（执行）三个环节。现有方法中视觉定位与语言规划彼此割裂，缺乏统一的中间表示来桥接二维视觉感知与三维动作生成。
AI.method: (1) PointVLM：指令微调，使用点标注、分割衍生样本、机器人观测与VQA数据的混合监督，将任务相关物体关联到图像坐标；(2) 深度测量将预测抬升为语义三维表示；(3) 3DLLM：在该表示上指定末端执行器路点与夹爪指令；(4) 混合抓取模块解析局部抓取姿态。核心是视觉定位与语言规划间的点基础接口。
AI.result: 评测涵盖14个仿真操作任务与4个真机任务，并做了视觉训练数据、空间输入及抓取选择的消融实验。零样本执行指部署时不进行任务特定的示范训练，但视觉模型微调阶段使用了现有机器人数据。
AI.conclusion: 点基接口可作为视觉定位与语言规划有效耦合的统一中间表示，支撑跨仿真与真机的示范生成；本文阐述该框架的原始点基形式，其与后续GeneralVLA扩展的关系在引言中说明。

title: RoboAssist: Interactive Human-Humanoid Planning for Long-Horizon Surgical Assistance
summary: Long-horizon surgical assistance requires humanoid robots to coordinate with evolving human activities while maintaining safety across planning and execution. We present RoboAssist, an agent-based framework for interactive human-humanoid planning that integrates workflow reasoning, task coordination, and cross-layer safety. At its core is an asymmetric dual-track representation that separates partially observed human process states from executable robot task sequences. By updating human-process estimates, scene context, and task dependencies online, RoboAssist revalidates the remaining task sequence and replans only the affected suffix when workflow requests change. A cross-layer safety architecture combines preventive navigation regulation, reactive regulation during close-range handover, and independent whole-body runtime supervision. This design couples online task coordination with safety constraints throughout execution. We demonstrate the framework on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot in long-horizon, multi-stage simulated surgical assistance scenarios encompassing multimodal interaction, instrument handling, medical material transport, navigation, and safe human-robot handover. Experiments show multi-stage task completion and adaptation to workflow-request changes. A targeted full-replanning ablation shows that residual replanning reduces plan-update latency and post-update token usage. Separate safety experiments demonstrate complementary protection across navigation, handover, and runtime supervision. Additional results and demonstrations are available online at https://roboassist.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboAssist，一个用于人-人形机器人交互式规划的智能体框架，通过非对称双轨表示与跨层安全架构，实现长时程手术辅助场景下的任务协调与安全执行。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人手术辅助要求人形机器人与动态变化的人类活动协同，同时在规划与执行全程保持安全。现有方法难以兼顾工作流推理、任务协调与多层安全约束。
AI.method: 核心为非对称双轨表示，将部分可观测的人类流程状态与可执行机器人任务序列分离；在线更新人类流程估计、场景上下文与任务依赖，仅对受影响的任务后缀重新规划（residual replanning）。跨层安全架构结合预防性导航调节、近距离交接反应式调节以及独立的全身运行时监督。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上开展长时程、多阶段模拟手术辅助实验（涵盖多模态交互、器械操作、医疗物资运输、导航与安全交接）。实验实现多阶段任务完成并适应工作流请求变化；消融实验表明残差重规划降低了计划更新延迟与更新后 token 消耗；安全实验证明导航、交接和运行时监督的互补保护。
AI.conclusion: RoboAssist 将在线任务协调与安全约束贯穿执行过程，可为长时程人形机器人手术辅助提供有效框架，更多结果见项目主页。

title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, yet using it to train humanoid robots presents two challenges: (1) an embodiment gap, as human hands differ structurally from robot end-effectors and low-cost egocentric recordings lack the torso kinematics required by conventional retargeting; and (2) heterogeneous data quality, including noisy hand-pose tracking and weakly aligned text annotations. We introduce IronMind, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that uses egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot data to pretrain policies for humanoid dexterous manipulation. To bridge the embodiment gap, IronMind bypasses explicit body-retargeting by using a camera-space action representation, the native reference space of egocentric video, and semantically aligning robot and human action dimensions. Across total pretraining budgets from 250 to 10,000 hours, validation loss decreases approximately log-linearly with data scale. Larger pretraining budgets also improve out-of-distribution real-robot manipulation after post-training: across six challenging tasks with unseen objects, affordances, and reasoning prompts, the 10,000-hour model achieves a 55.0% success rate, compared with at most 11.7% for every pretraining budget up to 5,000 hours and 5.0% without pretraining. At the same pretraining budget, the camera-space action representation also outperforms the torso-frame baseline. Together, these findings support pretraining with a camera-space action representation on large-scale human egocentric data as a scalable foundation for humanoid robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: IronMind 是一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用第一人称人类视频与异构机器人数据预训练人形机器人灵巧操作策略，通过相机空间动作表示绕开显式身体重定向，验证了数据规模的可扩展性与真实机器人泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人类视频是可扩展的灵巧操作数据来源，但用于训练人形机器人存在两大障碍：(1) 具身差异——人手与人形机器人末端执行器结构不同，且低成本第一人称录制缺乏传统重定向所需的上肢/躯干运动学信息；(2) 数据质量异质——手部姿态跟踪存在噪声、文本标注对齐较弱。作者希望找到一种可扩展的预训练范式来克服这些问题。
AI.method: 提出 IronMind，一种 VLA 模型，用第一人称人类视频加异构机器人数据预训练人形灵巧操作策略。为弥合具身差异，模型不做显式身体重定向，而是采用相机空间动作表示（即第一人称视频的天然参考空间），并对机器人与人类的动作维度进行语义对齐。与躯干坐标系（torso-frame）基线在相同预训练预算下对比。
AI.result: 预训练预算从 250 到 10,000 小时，验证损失随数据规模近似对数线性下降。更大预训练预算在后期训练后提升分布外真实机器人操作表现：在六项含未见物体、可供性与推理提示的挑战任务上，10,000 小时模型成功率达 55.0%，而 5,000 小时及以下各预算最多为 11.7%，无预训练仅为 5.0%。相同预训练预算下，相机空间动作表示优于躯干坐标系基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在相机空间动作表示下利用大规模人类第一人称数据预训练，可作为人形机器人操作的可扩展基础，为灵巧操作策略学习提供了可行路径。

title: Communication-Free Distributed Multi-Robot Task Allocation under Partial Observations Using Labeled Multi-Bernoulli Filtering
comment: This paper has been submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 for possible publication
summary: This paper proposes a communication-free multi-robot task allocation framework based solely on local observations. In this study, tasks are defined as reaching target locations. Each robot estimates the positions of neighboring robots using a Labeled Multi-Bernoulli (LMB) filter and independently assigns tasks through a greedy auction-based strategy. By continuously updating state estimates and reallocating tasks during execution, the proposed method enables decentralized coordination without explicit communication. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the proposed method enables effective cooperative task allocation without inter-robot communication while remaining robust to measurement clutter and observation uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需通信、仅依赖局部观测的多机器人任务分配框架：用LMB滤波器估计邻居位置，再以贪心拍卖策略独立分配任务（到达目标点），执行中持续更新状态并重分配，实现去中心化协调。蒙特卡洛仿真验证其在无通信条件下有效分配且对杂波与观测不确定性鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作通常依赖机器人间通信，但通信可能受限、不可靠或不可用。因此需要一种不依赖显式通信、仅靠局部观测即可完成协作任务分配的方法。
AI.method: 任务定义为到达目标位置。每个机器人使用Labeled Multi-Bernoulli (LMB)滤波器估计邻近机器人的位置；基于估计结果，各机器人通过贪心拍卖策略独立进行任务分配；在执行过程中不断更新状态估计并重新分配任务，从而在无显式通信条件下实现去中心化协调。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明，该方法在机器人间无通信的情况下仍能实现有效的协作任务分配，并对测量杂波和观测不确定性具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该通信无关的框架证明了仅凭局部观测与LMB状态估计结合贪心拍卖即可支撑去中心化的多机器人任务分配，为通信受限场景下的协作提供了可行方案。

title: LIBERO-Agent: Evaluating General-Purpose Agents for Direct Embodied Manipulation
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, use tools, and revise their behavior from feedback, but it remains unclear whether these capabilities transfer from digital environments to embodied manipulation. To investigate this question, we introduce LIBERO-Agent, an agent-native benchmark for evaluating these agents in robot manipulation tasks. Rather than asking agents to submit task-level Python control programs or operate through high-level robot skills, LIBERO-Agent provides an interactive robotic environment where agents can select which observations to inspect, process them with their own tools, and issue native action commands. LIBERO-Agent integrates 200 tasks into a common interaction framework and provides a 30-task primary suite that separates perception, short-horizon execution, and long-horizon composition. Results reveal a pronounced reliability gap: while agents perform well on perception and easy short-horizon tasks, their performance degrades substantially on hard short-horizon and long-horizon tasks. Richer observations improve short-horizon manipulation, while demonstration benefits depend on the agent and format. Among these agents, GPT-6 Astra achieves the strongest overall performance. Further analysis shows its major advantage lies in mechanism interaction, especially when sustained physical contact is needed, while its remaining failures stem from cross-stage interference and geometric errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LIBERO-Agent——一个面向通用智能体的交互式机器人操作基准，将200个任务纳入统一交互框架，考察数字环境中习得能力向具身操作的迁移。结果显示智能体存在明显可靠性缺口：感知与简单短程任务表现好，但在困难短程与长程任务上大幅退化。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体已具备规划、工具使用与基于反馈的行为修正能力，但这些能力能否从数字环境迁移到具身操作尚不明确。现有机器人评测多要求智能体提交任务级Python控制程序或调用高层技能，无法真实考察其原生交互与操作能力。
AI.method: 构建 LIBERO-Agent 交互式机器人环境：智能体自主选择查看哪些观测、用自带工具处理观测、并发出原生动作指令，而非提交任务级程序或调用高层技能。整合200个任务于统一交互框架，并划出30任务主套件，将评测拆分为感知、短程执行与长程组合三类。
AI.result: 存在显著可靠性缺口：感知与简单短程任务表现良好，困难短程与长程任务性能大幅下降。更丰富的观测能提升短程操作表现；示范带来的收益取决于智能体与示范格式。GPT-6 Astra 综合表现最强，其优势主要来自机制交互，尤其需要持续物理接触时；剩余失败源于跨阶段干扰与几何误差。
AI.conclusion: 通用智能体的数字环境能力仅部分迁移至具身操作，长程组合与精细物理交互仍是瓶颈。LIBERO-Agent 提供了统一、可交互的评测范式，揭示可靠性差距及其失败机理，为后续提升具身智能体能力指明方向。

title: Discrete Forcing: Infusing Discrete Guidance into Continuous Denoising for Few-Step Action Experts
summary: Efficient action generation in vision-language-action (VLA) models requires capturing both coarse action structure and fine-grained details. Discrete action tokens provide compact structural representations but sacrifice precision, while continuous action tokens offer high precision but often require multiple denoising steps. We introduce Discrete Forcing, a flow-matching framework that combines these representations through an explicit coarse-to-fine generation process. It first predicts discrete action tokens to establish a coarse action structure, then uses them to guide continuous action refinement. The discrete and continuous components share a common diffusion transformer backbone with specialized branches, maintaining a parameter count comparable to a conventional single-branch model while requiring only one forward pass per branch. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster inference over a parameter-matched continuous action expert, with consistent performance gains as model capacity increases. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improvements on high-precision and dynamic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Discrete Forcing：一种流匹配框架，用离散动作 token 先建立粗粒度动作结构，再引导连续动作精修，二者共享同一 DiT 主干并各用一条专用分支，实现粗到细的动作生成。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型的高效动作生成需同时兼顾粗粒度动作结构与细粒度细节。离散动作 token 结构紧凑但精度不足；连续动作 token 精度高，但通常需要多步去噪，推理开销大。因此需要一种统一表示，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: Discrete Forcing —— 基于流匹配（flow matching）的显式粗到细生成框架。第一步预测离散动作 token，建立粗粒度动作结构；第二步以该结构引导连续动作的精修。离散与连续组件共享同一 diffusion transformer 主干，并各自使用专用分支，参数量与常规单分支模型相当，且每条分支仅需一次前向传播。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，相比参数量匹配的连续动作专家，性能更优且推理更快；随模型容量增加，性能增益保持一致。真实世界实验中，在高精度与动态操作任务上亦取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式粗到细的离散-连续协同生成，Discrete Forcing 在参数量与单分支模型相当、每分支单次前向的条件下，同时获得更高精度与更高效率，并随模型规模扩大持续受益，验证于仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务。

title: General Performance Guarantee for Human Torque Estimation-Based Task-Agnostic Assistive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Accurate human torque estimation is crucial for enabling task-agnostic control in robotic exoskeleton systems. However, estimation errors may cause mismatches between the robot assistance and the human intention, degrading controllability and task performance. In this paper, we address this issue by formally defining matched assistance as scenarios in which the robot positively contributes to human movement. Based on this definition, we develop a theoretical framework to design the robot's desired interaction torque that guarantees a lower bound on the matched assistance probability. Importantly, the proposed guarantee holds over the entire torque distribution, including unseen data beyond the training tasks. This provides our method with strong reliability and generalization, both of which are critical for effective exoskeleton control. The proposed strategy is implemented on the ABLE upper-limb exoskeleton and evaluated in a multi-task setup. Experimental results validate the theoretical guarantees and demonstrate that the proposed strategy achieves effective general performance across several tasks, guaranteeing movement smoothness while reducing human physical effort.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对外骨骼扭矩估计误差导致辅助与意图不匹配的问题，形式化定义了"匹配辅助"，并构建理论框架设计期望交互扭矩，保证匹配辅助概率下界，且该保证在整个扭矩分布（含训练任务外数据）上成立，在上肢外骨骼上完成多任务验证。
AI.motivation: 外骨骼实现任务无关控制依赖于准确的人体扭矩估计，而估计误差会造成机器人辅助与人体意图不匹配，降低可控性与任务表现。因此需要一种能对辅助匹配性提供可靠性保证、并具备良好泛化能力的设计方法。
AI.method: 作者将"匹配辅助"形式化定义为机器人对人体运动产生正向贡献的情形；基于该定义构建理论框架，用于设计机器人的期望交互扭矩，从而保证匹配辅助概率具有下界；该保证面向整个扭矩分布，包括训练任务之外的未见数据。方法在ABLE上肢外骨骼上实现，并在多任务场景中评估。
AI.result: 实验结果验证了所提出的理论保证，并表明该策略在多个任务上实现有效的通用表现，在保证运动平滑性的同时降低了人体体力消耗。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化定义匹配辅助并在扭矩分布上提供概率下界保证，该方法兼具可靠性与泛化性，适用于外骨骼控制，并已在多任务实验中证明其有效性。

title: Sparse Planner: A Hybrid Planner for Efficient Sampling via a Conditional Variational Autoencoder
summary:
Trajectory planning is a core component of autonomous driving systems, where real-time performance and solution quality directly affect safety and reliability. Sample-Based Motion Planning (SBMP) is widely adopted for its ability to approximate near-optimal solutions through parameter space sampling. However, achieving high-quality trajectories typically requires dense sampling, leading to substantial computational overhead and significant runtime variability in complex traffic scenarios.
  To address this limitation, we propose a Sparse Planner (SP) that improves sampling efficiency by learning the conditional relationship between scene context and effective trajectory parameters using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). By modeling the structure of high-quality sampling distributions, SP directly generates cost-effective samples in the parameter space, significantly reducing the required sampling density while preserving solution quality.
  Experimental results show that SP achieves lower trajectory cost than the state-of-the-art FISS+ planner while using only one-eighth of the sampling density. In addition, SP demonstrates improved distance-keeping capability in obstacle-rich scenarios and maintains reduced and more stable runtime characteristics, indicating enhanced computational efficiency and predictable runtime behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出稀疏规划器（SP），用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数的映射，在八分之一采样密度下取得更优轨迹代价，并提升运行时的效率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶轨迹规划对实时性与解质量要求高。基于采样的运动规划（SBMP）虽能通过参数空间采样逼近近优解，但高质量轨迹需密集采样，导致计算开销大、复杂交通场景下运行时间波动显著。
AI.method: 提出稀疏规划器SP：利用CVAE学习场景上下文与有效轨迹参数之间的条件关系，建模高质量采样分布的结构，从而在参数空间中直接生成低成本有效样本，替代密集均匀采样。
AI.result: 相比最先进的FISS+规划器，SP在仅使用其八分之一采样密度的情况下获得更低的轨迹代价；在障碍密集场景中距离保持能力更好；运行时间更短且更稳定，计算效率和运行时可预测性提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习采样分布结构实现稀疏高效采样，SP在保持甚至提升解质量的同时显著降低采样密度与计算负担，兼具更优的实时性与运行稳定性。

title: ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://echo-g-project.github.io/
summary: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.

AI.tldr: 提出ECHO-G框架，联合语音音频与带时间戳文本条件，在机器人空间直接生成全身协同语音动作，并构建数据集与基准。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人生成全身协同语音动作需同时协调语音韵律、语言内容与机器人本体运动特性，现有方法（人类动作生成+重定向）难以满足需求。
AI.method: ECHO-G采用语音锚定扩散Transformer（SGDiT）：结合帧对齐声学特征与token级语言上下文，保持二者粒度差异；以rectified flow matching训练，在机器人空间直接建模一对多的语句-动作映射；并构建基于BEAT2的音频-文本-机器人数据集与评估基准。
AI.result: 在协同语音特征、机器人动作质量与运行效率基准上，直接机器人空间生成优于所评估的人类动作生成与重定向流程；模态消融显示联合音频-文本条件的增益；实现物理人形机器人部署，互补的视频评分研究也支持联合条件方案。
AI.conclusion: 直接机器人空间生成结合音频-文本联合条件可有效提升机器人协同语音动作生成质量，数据集、训练、推理与评估代码已通过项目主页公开。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control
summary: As robots are increasingly deployed in everyday environments, ensuring their safety has become a central challenge. Existing methods often encode safety requirements as opaque mathematical/logical formulations or dense cost functions.
