While effective in specific tasks, they remain difficult to interpret, tightly coupled to individual tasks, and offer limited insight into why a robot action is considered safe or unsafe. To address this limitation, we propose ``Neuro-Symbolic Predicate Learning for Semantic Safe Robot Control'' (NEUPRO), which leverages a differentiable reasoner that can learn reusable safety representations from human-specified safety knowledge. NEUPRO allows practitioners to express task-related safety requirements as transparent symbolic rules, while enabling gradients to propagate through these rules to a feature extractor that maps raw observations to safety-relevant concepts. As a result, the learned feature extractor is (softly) grounded in human-understandable semantics, supports transparent constraint evaluation, and is transferable across tasks. By coupling interpretability with differentiability, NEUPRO moves beyond opaque cost design toward reusable safety reasoning. To evaluate NEUPRO's capability, we collect and release REASON, the first real robot benchmark dataset for interpretable robot safety specification. Experiments on REASON show that NEUPRO learns safety-critical features that generalize across tasks, mitigate the interpretability limitations of conventional black-box cost formulations, and provide explicit explanations of safety violation.

AI.tldr: 提出NEUPRO，用可微推理器从人类安全知识中学习可复用、可解释的安全表示，并发布首个可解释机器人安全规约的真实机器人基准REASON。
AI.motivation: 机器人日益进入日常环境，安全性成为核心挑战。现有方法将安全要求编码为不透明的数学/逻辑公式或密集代价函数，虽在特定任务有效，但难以解释、与任务紧耦合，且难以说明机器人动作为何安全或不安全。
AI.method: NEUPRO利用可微推理器，允许从业者以透明的符号规则表达任务相关安全要求，并通过这些规则将梯度回传至特征提取器，把原始观测映射为安全相关概念，使提取器（软性）扎根于人类可理解的语义。
AI.result: 在REASON基准上，NEUPRO学到可跨任务泛化的安全关键特征，缓解了传统黑箱代价公式的可解释性局限，并能对安全违规给出显式解释。
AI.conclusion: NEUPRO结合可解释性与可微性，超越不透明的代价设计，走向可复用的安全推理；同时发布REASON——首个面向可解释机器人安全规约的真实机器人基准数据集。

title: MVP-SLAM: Multi-Camera Visual-Inertial Floorplan-Prior SLAM
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Indoor building construction sites are demanding environments for visual SLAM, where variable lighting and repetitive, low-textured structures make the system drift over long trajectories, though structural elements such as walls remain distinguishable despite these conditions. These buildings are constructed according to their as-planned floor plans, available from the design phase, and although the actual as-built site can differ from this design, floor plans still provide a metric reference, both to localize the system in the building and to correct drift. Existing methods often use the floor plan to correct an already-built trajectory offline, and those that instead correct it online typically rely on depth sensors. We instead present MVP-SLAM, an online visual-inertial SLAM on two opposite-facing fisheye cameras that corrects drift from cameras alone by matching walls detected in its map to the floor plan, through a drift-aware policy. A multi-stage integration then turns each matched pair incrementally into a persistent correction, so the trajectory stays corrected and localized within the floor plan as it is built. MVP-SLAM was validated on the multi-floor construction sites of the Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026, ranking 2nd of 22 teams in the Localization task (0.29 m mean RMSE) and 5th of 62 teams in the SLAM task (0.24 m), the top-ranked one in both tasks among those that operate online, integrate the floor plan, and localize within it.

AI.tldr: MVP-SLAM：面向室内施工现场的双鱼眼在线视觉惯性SLAM，仅用相机通过"漂移感知策略"将地图中检测到的墙面与设计楼层平面图匹配，多阶段增量集成匹配对形成持续修正，从而在轨迹构建过程中保持校正并实现楼内定位。
AI.motivation: 室内施工现场对视觉SLAM极不友好：光照变化大、结构重复且纹理稀疏，导致长轨迹漂移；但墙面等结构元素仍具可区分性。建筑按设计阶段可得的设计楼层平面图施工，尽管实际竣工状态与设计有差异，平面图仍提供度量参考，可用于楼内定位与漂移校正。现有方法多离线利用平面图修正已建轨迹，在线方法则普遍依赖深度传感器，缺少仅靠相机的在线方案。
AI.method: MVP-SLAM是一种在线视觉惯性SLAM系统，采用两个相对朝向的鱼眼相机。核心是漂移感知策略：将系统地图中检测到的墙面与楼层平面图进行匹配，仅依赖相机数据在线校正漂移；随后通过多阶段集成，将每一对匹配逐步转化为持久性修正，使轨迹在构建过程中始终保持校正状态并定位于平面图内。
AI.result: 在Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026的多层施工现场数据集上验证：Localization任务中22支队伍排名第2（平均RMSE 0.29 m），SLAM任务中62支队伍排名第5（0.24 m）；在两个任务中均为"在线运行、集成楼层平面图并在其中定位"类方法里排名第1。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭相机即可在线利用楼层平面图实现漂移校正与楼内定位，无需深度传感器；漂移感知匹配与多阶段增量集成能有效维持长轨迹精度，在具有挑战性的多层施工现场基准上达到同类在线方法中的领先水平。

title: Text-to-3D Policy: Fine-Grained Language-Behavior Alignment for Unseen Specification Generalization
summary: 3D visuomotor policies provide a strong foundation for spatially precise manipulation, yet current text-to-3D policies struggle to follow unseen fine-grained behavioral specifications beyond those covered by demonstrations. We study this challenge as unseen specification generalization, where language specifies behaviorally significant variations, such as target position, displacement, or articulated state, that are absent from policy training. We find that pretrained language representations and conventional global behavior-language alignment capture coarse task semantics but often blur nearby specifications that require distinct behaviors. We introduce T3DP, a Text-to-3D Policy framework for fine-grained language-behavior alignment. Rather than compressing each instruction and demonstration into a single global embedding, T3DP preserves their local structures and establishes bidirectional token-level correspondence between linguistic elements and behavioral segments. This directly grounds subtle linguistic variations in the behavior components they affect, preventing closely related specifications from collapsing in the representation space. The resulting specification-sensitive language representation conditions a point-cloud-based 3D diffusion policy, enabling more precise control over unseen behavioral specifications without modifying the underlying policy architecture. Across Meta-World, ManiSkill, and RoboTwin, T3DP improves average held-out-specification success over global language-behavior alignment by +11.0-14.2 points, with gains on all 15 task families; on real-robot tasks, it further raises average success from 47.5% to 65.0% (+17.5 points). Representation and action-probe analyses show that fine-grained alignment better preserves specification geometry and action-relevant variation, linking local behavior grounding to downstream control.

AI.tldr: 提出T3DP，一种文本到3D策略框架，通过 token 级双向对齐实现语言与行为片段的细粒度映射，显著提升未见行为规格的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到3D策略在空间精确操作上有基础，但面对演示未覆盖的细粒度行为规格（如目标位置、位移、关节状态）时泛化困难；预训练语言表征与全局行为-语言对齐只能捕获粗粒度任务语义，容易混淆需不同行为的相近规格。
AI.method: T3DP不将指令与演示压缩为单一全局嵌入，而是保留其局部结构，建立语言元素与行为片段之间的双向 token 级对应关系，将细微语言差异直接绑定到受影响的行为组件，避免相近规格在表征空间塌缩；由此得到的规格敏感语言表征用于条件化基于点云的3D扩散策略，无需改动底层策略架构。
AI.result: 在Meta-World、ManiSkill、RoboTwin上，T3DP在留出规格成功率上较全局对齐提升11.0-14.2个百分点，覆盖全部15个任务族；真实机器人任务平均成功率从47.5%提升至65.0%（+17.5）。表示与动作探针分析显示，细粒度对齐更好保留规格几何与动作相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度语言-行为对齐能够将局部行为 grounding 与下游控制有效关联，为3D visuomotor策略的未见规格泛化提供可行路径。

title: Towards Agile Vision-Based Multi-UAV Flight: Revisiting State Estimation
comment: This work has been accepted to the IEEE for possible publication (IROS 2026)
summary: Agile multi-UAV flight requires accurate and low-latency onboard estimation of the kinematic states of neighboring UAVs for collision avoidance, motion coordination, etc. Most vision-based approaches rely on position-only measurements, inferring velocity and acceleration indirectly from displacement. We show that this introduces a fixed structural delay in the estimation of higher-order states, which limits the achievable agility. To address this, we propose to integrate tilt measurements, provided by a state-of-the-art visual detector, which inform about the thrust direction of co-planar multirotor UAVs. We benchmark four position-only and five pose-aware estimators, including a novel formulation of a linear thrust-constraining Kalman filter, on two real-world and one high-fidelity photorealistic simulated dataset over different levels of agility (3-21 m/s^2). In our setup, pose-aware estimation consistently reduces the average velocity and acceleration estimation errors by 40% and 57% across the three datasets with the proposed KF formulation outperforming the other estimators. Position-only filters exhibit a constant ~300 ms delay in acceleration step response independent of agility, whereas the tilt-constrained estimators operate near the physical response limit given by the camera frame-rate by observing the change in thrust direction before the displacement accumulates. In a closed-loop leader-follower simulated experiment with NMPC control, position-only estimation of the leader's state fails to facilitate stable hovering of the follower, while the proposed estimator enables tracking of lateral maneuvers exceeding 2g of acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出融合倾角测量的位姿感知估计方法，消除仅用位置测量带来的固定结构延迟，显著降低邻机速度/加速度估计误差并提升闭环敏捷跟踪能力。
AI.motivation: 敏捷多无人机飞行需要准确、低延迟的机载邻机运动状态估计以支持避碰与协同。多数视觉方法仅使用位置测量，通过位移间接推断速度与加速度，会引入固定的结构性延迟，从而限制可达敏捷性。
AI.method: 引入最先进视觉检测器提供的倾角测量，反映共面多旋翼无人机的推力方向；在2个真实数据集与1个高保真照片级仿真数据集（敏捷度3–21 m/s²）上基准测试4种仅位置估计器与5种位姿感知估计器，其中包括新提出的线性推力约束卡尔曼滤波（KF）形式。
AI.result: 位姿感知估计在三数据集上平均将速度与加速度估计误差分别降低40%和57%，所提KF表现最优。仅位置滤波器在加速度阶跃响应中呈现约300 ms的恒定延迟且与敏捷度无关；倾角约束估计器通过先观测推力方向变化再等位移累积，工作接近相机帧率决定物理响应极限。在NMPC领航-跟随闭环仿真中，仅位置估计无法使跟随者稳定悬停，而所提估计器可跟踪超过2g的横向机动。
AI.conclusion: 融合倾角/推力方向信息可突破仅位置测量的结构性延迟瓶颈，显著提升邻机高阶状态估计精度与闭环敏捷飞行性能。

title: TO-mdiSPAs: Topology Optimization of multi-directional Soft Pneumatic Actuators
summary: Soft pneumatic actuators (SPAs) are highly promising and have been extensively explored within the field of soft robotics. Under pneumatic pressure loads, an SPA undergoes bending deformation to perform specific tasks. A multi- or omni-directional SPA can bend and move in any direction within a 3D space, leveraging its multiple degrees of freedom to realize various mechanical functions. This work presents a systematic methodology using topology optimization (TO) to achieve an optimized design for a multi-directional SPAs. To ensure manufacturing robustness, a three-field TO formulation considering blueprint, dilated, and eroded designs is implemented. Additionally, Darcy's law, incorporating a drainage term, is used to model the design-dependent nature of the pneumatic loading. A min-max optimization problem is formulated based on the target output deformations of the SPA unit and solved using the Method of Moving Asymptotes. The optimization yields a high-performing, unconventional geometric design. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate that the optimized SPA successfully achieves versatile multi-directional movements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拓扑优化的系统方法，用于设计多方向软体气动执行器，通过三场构型保证制造鲁棒性，并利用带排液项的达西定律建模气动载荷，最终获得高性能非常规几何设计。
AI.motivation: 软体气动执行器（SPA）在软体机器人领域应用广泛，多方向或全向SPA可借助多自由度在三维空间内实现弯曲与运动。然而，如何系统性地获得高性能多方向SPA的优化构型仍具挑战，需要兼顾气动载荷的设计依赖性以及制造可行性。
AI.method: 采用拓扑优化（TO）构建多方向SPA的优化设计框架。为提升制造鲁棒性，引入同时考虑blueprint、dilated与eroded设计的三场TO构型。使用带排液项的达西定律建模气动载荷的设计依赖性。基于SPA单元的目标输出变形，建立min-max优化问题，并采用移动渐近线法（MMA）求解。
AI.result: 优化得到一种高性能且非常规的几何设计。数值仿真表明，优化后的SPA能够成功实现多样化的多方向运动。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了拓扑优化在多方向SPA设计中的有效性，所提方法可系统性地生成满足制造约束并具备多方向运动能力的软体执行器构型。

title: Prediction is Better than Detection: Traffic Congestion Control using Drones
summary: A central question in deploying teams of mobile robots for persistent monitoring is how task performance scales with fleet size, and whether this scaling holds once sensing drives downstream action rather than mere observation. We study this question for a team of drones performing traffic-jam detection and prediction in a simulated road network, whose reports drive an adaptive traffic-signal controller in closed loop. We build a multi-agent simulation, with vehicles following Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular-automaton dynamics and drones patrolling junctions via a round-robin policy, and sweep fleet size, traffic level, and network size to evaluate detection rate, detection delay, and prediction rate. We show how performance plateaus for fleet size approximating the number of junctions being monitored, and offer a general fleet-provisioning rule for persistent-monitoring deployments. More significantly, adapting the signal on a predicted jam, rather than a detected one, roughly doubles the resulting reduction in jam duration, showing that the value of onboard prediction in a sensing-to-action pipeline can exceed the value of adding more robots. Prediction accuracy, not sensing coverage, is now the binding constraint on further improvement, pointing to onboard inference, not fleet size, as the more promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 无人机车队在闭环交通信号控制中执行拥堵检测与预测，性能随车队规模增长在"车队数≈路口数"处饱和；基于预测的自适应信号控制带来的拥堵时长削减约为基于检测的两倍，预测精度而非感知覆盖成为瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 部署移动机器人车队进行持续监测时，核心问题是任务性能如何随车队规模扩展，以及当感知用于驱动下游动作（而非仅用于观测）时该扩展规律是否仍成立。本文以无人机在仿真路网中执行交通拥堵检测与预测、并闭环驱动自适应信号控制为场景研究该问题。
AI.method: 构建多智能体仿真：车辆遵循Nagel-Schreckenberg元胞自动机动力学，无人机以轮询（round-robin）策略巡逻路口；对车队规模、交通流量与路网规模进行参数扫描，评估检测率、检测时延与预测率。
AI.result: 性能在车队规模接近被监测路口数量时出现平台期，并据此提出持续监测部署的通用车队配置规则；在预测到拥堵（而非检测到拥堵）时调整信号，可使拥堵时长的削减幅度约翻倍，表明感知-动作链路中机载预测的价值可超过增加机器人数量。
AI.conclusion: 持续监测中性能提升的约束已从感知覆盖率转移到预测精度，未来工作更有前景的方向是机载推理能力而非单纯扩大车队规模。

title: Making Waves: A Membrane-Coupled Delta Array for Manipulating Objects Below the Actuator Spacing
summary: Distributed manipulator systems manipulate objects through the coordinated motion of many actuators. However, an object must be supported by several actuators at once, so the centre-to-centre actuator spacing imposes a hard lower bound on manipulable object size. We remove this bound by coupling the end-effectors of an 8 x 8 array of three degrees-of-freedom delta robots with a stretchable fabric, turning 64 discrete contacts into a continuous surface capable of manipulating objects smaller than the actuator spacing. Viewing the array as a displacement field over that surface, we investigate local quasi-static and cyclic fields as manipulation primitives. These primitives can be applied globally across the array or locally confined around each tracked object to independently manipulate several objects in parallel. We then train a policy acting on low-order discrete cosine transform coefficients: at equal action dimension, commanding a nineteen-delta neighbourhood halves the placement error of commanding the whole array. The policy transfers to hardware without adaptation at 76% success. The platform manipulates objects from 15mm-90mm, a six-fold range spanning both sides of the actuator spacing, 43.3mm, on a single surface.

AI.tldr: 该研究用可拉伸织物耦合8x8三自由度delta机器人阵列的末端执行器，将64个离散接触点变为连续表面，突破执行器间距对可操纵物体尺寸的下限约束。
AI.motivation: 分布式机械手系统依赖多个执行器同时支撑物体，导致执行器中心间距成为可操纵物体尺寸的硬性下限，无法操作小于间距的物体。
AI.method: 将8x8三自由度delta机器人阵列的末端通过可拉伸织物耦合，把离散接触转为连续表面；将阵列视为该表面上的位移场，研究局部准静态场与循环场作为操作基元，可全局施加或围绕每个被跟踪物体局部约束以并行操作多物体；随后训练作用于低阶离散余弦变换系数的策略。
AI.result: 在相同动作维度下，命令19个delta邻域相比命令整个阵列将放置误差减半；策略无需适配即可迁移至硬件，成功率为76%；平台在单一表面上可操作15mm至90mm的物体，跨度六倍，涵盖执行器间距43.3mm的两侧。
AI.conclusion: 通过织物耦合构建连续操作表面并结合位移场基元与DCT策略，可突破执行器间距限制，实现跨尺度、可并行的多物体操作，并具备良好的硬件迁移性。

title: From Local Whole-Body VLA Behaviors to Scene-Scale Aerial Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable task-conditioned interaction, but extending them to scene-scale aerial manipulation remains challenging due to costly whole-body demonstrations, latency-induced action-state misalignment, and cross-site behavior composition. We present a unified framework for synthetic policy training and scene-scale execution on articulated uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs). A scene-reconfigurable pipeline synthesizes task-conditioned, kinodynamically feasible trajectories and synchronized multiview observations for VLA training without physical-platform demonstrations. Measured-progress-aligned realization (MPAR) aligns asynchronously returned action chunks with measured execution progress and realizes them as continuous, dynamically feasible trajectories. A relational Scene Graph grounds language goals to object instances and feasible interaction regions, while topology-guided transfer connects local behaviors across sites. Local VLA skills achieve 39/60 successes (65.0%) in simulation under oracle target and feasible-handoff conditions. Under 500-ms added latency, with and without a transient command-update stall, MPAR reduces median takeover phase error by 0.212 s over nominal-time alignment. The complete system completes 21/50 simulated multi-site missions (42.0%) and is further validated on a physical articulated UAM.

AI.tldr: 提出面向场景级空中操作的可重构合成训练与执行框架，MPAR缓解延迟错位，仿真任务成功率42.0%，并在实体铰接UAM上验证。
AI.motivation: VLA模型支持任务条件交互，但扩展到场景级空中操作面临三大挑战：全身示范采集成本高、延迟导致动作与状态错位、跨站点行为难以组合。
AI.method: 构建统一框架：1）场景可重构流水线，无需真机示范即可合成任务条件、运动动力学可行的轨迹及同步多视角观测用于VLA训练；2）测量进度对齐实现（MPAR），将异步返回的动作块与实测执行进度对齐，并实现为连续、动力学可行轨迹；3）关系式场景图将语言目标接地到物体实例与可行交互区域；4）拓扑引导迁移连接跨站点局部行为。
AI.result: 局部VLA技能在oracle目标与可行交接条件下仿真成功率39/60（65.0%）；在500ms附加延迟（含/不含瞬态指令更新停顿）下，MPAR较名义时间对齐降低中位接管相位误差0.212s；完整系统完成21/50仿真多站点任务（42.0%），并在实体铰接UAM上进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过合成训练数据与进度对齐执行机制，有效缓解延迟错位并支持跨站点行为组合，为场景级铰接无人机操作提供了可落地路径，且仿真与真机结果一致。

title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出世界模型引导的教练框架ROBOCOACH，通过"想象失败"来指导示范采集与专家更新，实现长时程机器人操作技能的模块化自提升。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作虽可复用技能，但用额外端到端示范来改进任务组合代价高昂。实用的自提升系统需同时决策"下一步教什么"与"在哪里施加监督"，即示范采集与专家更新的定位问题。
AI.method: 提出ROBOCOACH框架及RIDI循环（Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve）：在共享的动作条件世界模型COACHWORLD中执行可复用技能专家，由进度评判器记录首个未能完成的子任务；聚合这些记录以选择要采集哪个子任务的示范、更新哪些专家适配器。
AI.result: 在两个仿真套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象成功率与实际部署成功率在22个任务-策略对上的相关系数达rho=0.840。在匹配数据预算与更新计划下优于基线：仅增加150条子任务示范，Franka成功率由13.3%升至75.0%，AgileX由40.0%升至83.8%；教练后的专家迁移到4个未见过组合平均成功率为35.0%，而用均匀采集示范更新的共享策略基线为0%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可作为主动教练，把想象出的失败转化为有针对性的监督，从而推动模块化策略的改进。项目主页：https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

title: Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models
summary: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.

AI.tldr: PL-MPC在TD-MPC框架上改进critic监督、终值估计与actor蒸馏，在HumanoidBench及真机螺母对齐任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 规划与学习构成闭环反馈：规划器决定学习经验，而学到的critic与actor又为未来规划打分和提议。已有策略约束变体仅强化了闭环中的策略一侧，critic监督与规划器终值估计仍是薄弱环节。
AI.method: 在保持世界模型架构与MPPI优化器不变的前提下，PL-MPC做三处修改：(1) 混合多步TD目标，使critic更新在自举前接触更多已实现回报；(2) 分歧感知的终值估计，在MPPI规划中降低不确定critic值的影响；(3) 回报加权的actor蒸馏，强调高回报回合中规划器实际执行的动作。
AI.result: HumanoidBench上最大增益出现在balance-hard（TAR由98±18升至387±255）与hurdle（199±13升至466±200）；整体基准表现依赖任务，在DMControl上保持竞争力。消融实验显示两任务中组件交互不同。在7-DoF KUKA IIWA14扳手-螺母对齐任务上实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，训练物尺寸及两种未见尺寸的成功率均高于TD-M(PC)^2。
AI.conclusion: 同时改进critic监督与规划器终值估计可与策略约束互补，强化规划-学习闭环的另一半，并具备零样本真机迁移能力；性能提升仍具任务依赖性。

title: ChunkTrust: Adapting Execution Horizons for Robot Policies with Action-Expert Evidence
summary: Robot foundation policies predict action chunks, but how many actions to execute before replanning depends on the current task phase. We introduce ChunkTrust, which treats the execution horizon as a latent variable inferred from action-expert evidence rather than a fixed hyperparameter. Its training-free Action-aware Horizon Selector (AHS) combines intra-chunk spectral stability of generation traces with inter-chunk continuity between executed history and predicted actions. An online Beta posterior with kernel forgetting tracks horizon preferences across replans. A lightweight Query-based Horizon Adapter (QHA) optionally learns a context-conditioned dense prior from complementary evidence, fused with current evidence and episode-local Beta memory while the base policy remains frozen. Across RoboTwin2.0 and RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop, AHS improves overall task-averaged success for each evaluated base-policy configuration, including gains of +6.80 percentage points on $π_{0.5}$ over all 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks and +9.67 percentage points on Qwen3GR00T in RoboCasa. AHS+QHA raises the gain over Base to +9.44 percentage points on the eight-task $π_{0.5}$ evaluation. On four real-world household tasks, AHS improves the equal-task mean normalized process score from 50.4% to 57.5%. Ablations examine the contributions of both evidence terms, temporal memory, and the learned prior. Project page is https://hf618.github.io/ChunkTrust.github.io/

AI.tldr: ChunkTrust 将机器人基础策略的动作块执行时域视为从动作专家证据中推断的隐变量，通过免训练的 AHS 与可选的 QHA 自适应选择重规划前执行的动作数量，在仿真与真实任务上稳定提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础策略通常预测动作块（action chunk），但每次重规划前应执行多少动作取决于当前任务阶段，固定执行时域超参数难以适配不同阶段，因此需要一种自适应机制。
AI.method: 提出 ChunkTrust：将执行时域建模为隐变量。其免训练的 Action-aware Horizon Selector（AHS）结合生成轨迹的块内谱稳定性与已执行历史同预测动作之间的块间连续性；用带核遗忘的在线 Beta 后验跨重规划跟踪时域偏好；可选轻量 Query-based Horizon Adapter（QHA）从互补证据学习上下文条件化的稠密先验，并与当前证据及回合局部 Beta 记忆融合，而基础策略保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin2.0 与 RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop 上，AHS 对每个被评估的基础策略配置均提升任务平均成功率，包括在全部 50 个 RoboTwin2.0 任务上对 π_{0.5} 提升 +6.80 个百分点、在 RoboCasa 上对 Qwen3GR00T 提升 +9.67 个百分点；AHS+QHA 在八任务 π_{0.5} 评测中将相对 Base 的增益提升至 +9.44 个百分点。在四项真实家庭任务中，AHS 将等任务平均归一化过程得分从 50.4% 提升至 57.5%。消融实验考察了两种证据项、时序记忆与学习先验的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以证据驱动方式推断执行时域可有效替代固定超参数，免训练 AHS 与可选 QHA 在多种基础策略、仿真基准与真实任务中均带来一致增益，且各证据项、时序记忆与学习先验均有可验证的贡献。

title: Experience-Driven Continual Learning of Terrain Traversability for Quadruped Robots
summary: Safe and efficient quadruped navigation over unfamiliar terrain requires predicting terrain-robot interaction before contact: geometry and visual appearance alone cannot reveal how the robot will slip, load its feet, or expend energy. This paper presents a continual learning pipeline that uses locomotion experience to learn these interaction outcomes from pre-contact images and continually updates the predictions as new contacts are observed. Pre-contact descriptors, produced by a DINOv3 backbone model frozen during training, are mapped to five proprioceptive indicators weighted according to measurement reliability: planar foot slip, mean normal ground-reaction force, traction index, cost of transport, and touchdown loading rate. A compact evidential regressor allows us to predict these indicators together with aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty from the visual descriptors. Continual adaptation combines bounded experience replay with a validation gate: candidate models replace the deployed predictor only when they improve performance on recent held-out data while keeping degradation on historical held-out data within a prescribed tolerance. Predictions and epistemic uncertainty are projected into a local multilayer map and combined into a conservative traversability score map whose property weights can be adjusted without retraining. The resulting map is used for downstream navigation tests. The ROS2 implementation supports evaluation on a Unitree Go2 in simulation and on hardware, with models trained separately in each domain. On a sequential hardware stream over three previously unseen terrains, gated replay reduces final anchor negative log-likelihood (NLL) degradation by 23.1% relative to replay without the gate while attaining similar new-terrain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种持续学习流水线，利用运动经验从接触前图像预测地形-机器人交互结果，并在部署中持续更新；基于冻结DINOv3描述子与证据回归器预测五项本体感受指标及其不确定性，通过门控经验回放实现稳定持续适应，并构建可调权重的保守可通行性地图用于导航。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人在陌生地形上安全高效导航，需要接触前预测地形-机器人交互；仅靠几何与视觉外观无法预知打滑、足端受力或能耗等交互结果，且新地形持续出现要求预测器能在线更新而不遗忘旧知识。
AI.method: 使用训练中冻结的DINOv3骨干生成接触前描述子，映射到按测量可靠性加权的五项本体感受指标（平面足端打滑、平均法向地面反作用力、牵引指数、运输成本、触地加载率）；采用紧凑证据回归器同时预测指标值与偶然/认知不确定性；持续适应结合有界经验回放与验证门控（仅在近期留出数据改善且历史留出数据退化在容差内时替换模型）；预测与认知不确定性投影到局部多层地图，融合为保守可通行性分数图，属性权重可在不重训下调整，并用于下游导航。ROS2实现支持Unitree Go2仿真与实机评估，分域训练。
AI.result: 在三块未见地形的顺序硬件数据流上，门控回放相比无门控回放将最终锚点负对数似然（NLL）退化降低23.1%，同时取得相近的新地形适应效果。
AI.conclusion: 以接触前视觉描述子结合证据不确定性预测交互指标，并通过门控经验回放的持续学习，可在保持历史性能的同时适应新地形，所得保守可通行性地图可调权重并支持实际四足导航部署。

title: DiffWAM: A Fast and Efficient Navigation World Action Model
summary: Pretrained video foundation models encode rich semantic and spatiotemporal priors for embodied navigation, yet converting these priors into UAV motion typically requires expensive future-video synthesis and geometric reconstruction. We investigate whether the motion implicit in future visual prediction can instead be recovered directly from the predictive representations of a frozen video model. To this end, we present DiffWAM, a geometry-conditioned navigation world-action model that directly transforms multi-level predictive features into continuous camera trajectories. Its Grid-Motion module preserves spatial-temporal motion associations, while Latent2Pose grounds them with first-frame geometry to recover metrically meaningful 3D motion. Complete video rollouts and geometric reconstruction are required only for offline supervision, eliminating future-video decoding and multi-frame reconstruction during deployment. We further introduce FastDreamer, which overlaps predictive and geometric computation with ongoing flight and performs timestamp-aware asynchronous trajectory handoff for continuous UAV execution. DiffWAM achieves a trajectory RMSE of 0.3492 m and an endpoint success rate of 74.40% on the 1,000-sample DiffWAM-1000 benchmark, while representative real-world experiments demonstrate complex behaviors including constrained traversal, orbiting, S-shaped flight, and multi-stage navigation. An onboard DiffWAM-Flash implementation further reaches 1.08 s model-pipeline latency on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor. These results demonstrate that predictive video representations can be efficiently grounded into continuous 3D motion, providing a direct alternative to generate-then-reconstruct navigation pipelines. Project page: https://zzmmzzm.github.io/diffwam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DiffWAM将冻结视频基础模型的预测表征直接转化为连续无人机相机轨迹，无需部署时的未来视频合成与几何重建，配合异步执行的FastDreamer实现连续飞行。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频基础模型蕴含丰富的语义与时空先验，但将其用于具身导航时，通常需要昂贵的未来视频合成与几何重建（generate-then-reconstruct）才能得到无人机运动，部署开销大。作者探究能否直接从冻结视频模型的预测表征中恢复未来视觉预测所隐含的运动。
AI.method: 提出DiffWAM：几何条件化的导航world-action模型，将多层级预测特征直接映射为连续相机轨迹；Grid-Motion模块保持时-空运动关联，Latent2Pose用首帧几何进行接地以恢复度量有意义的3D运动。完整视频推演与几何重建仅用于离线监督。进一步提出FastDreamer，将预测与几何计算与正在进行的飞行重叠，并进行时间戳感知的异步轨迹交接，实现无人机连续执行。
AI.result: 在1000样本DiffWAM-1000基准上，轨迹RMSE为0.3492 m，终点成功率74.40%；真实世界实验展示受限穿越、环绕、S形飞行与多阶段导航等复杂行为；机载DiffWAM-Flash在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor上模型流水线延迟达1.08 s。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视频表征可被高效接地为连续3D运动，为generate-then-reconstruct式导航流水线提供了直接替代方案。

title: Tool-Policy Co-Design for Powder Weighing in Laboratory Automation
comment: Paper video can be found at https://youtu.be/BEUT70hX9LM
summary: Autonomous powder weighing is one of many bottlenecks in laboratory automation due to the complex, non-linear dynamics of heterogeneous materials. Robot chemists performing this task utilise standard tools shaped for the dexterity of human hands, whose fixed geometry sets the dynamics that the control policy needs to regulate. This work introduces a tool-policy co-design framework that concurrently optimises the morphology of a dispensing tool and its control policy for use by robots in chemistry laboratories, formulated as a bi-level optimisation that minimises dispensing error over a target distribution of powder flowabilities. The outer loop varies tool-design parameters such as tool depth, width and rim spike topology using Bayesian optimisation and hyperband, while an inner loop optimises a control policy for each candidate morphology. We also introduce a geometric similarity metric that warm-starts policy training from cached policies of structurally similar designs, exploring 28% more configurations under the same compute budget. The proposed framework is evaluated on a robotic powder weighing task across seven materials with distinct physical dynamics in a flowability-informed robot-material simulation framework. Experimental results demonstrate that our co-designed tool morphology reduces real-world weighing errors by 45% relative to a standard tool, including on previously unseen materials. These results demonstrate our method can adapt both the control policy and the physical tool to the dynamics of the target material, bringing a new paradigm for material manipulation to the field of laboratory automation.

AI.tldr: 提出工具-策略协同设计框架，同时优化粉末分配工具的形态与控制策略，通过双层优化降低机器人称量误差，实现比标准工具减少45%的真实称量误差。
AI.motivation: 自主粉末称量是实验室自动化的瓶颈之一，源于异质材料复杂的非线性动力学。机器人化学家使用为人类手部灵活性设计的固定几何标准工具，其固定形态限制了控制策略可调节的动力学范围，因此需要让工具形态与控制策略协同适配目标材料动力学。
AI.method: 将问题建模为双层优化，在目标粉末流动性分布上最小化分配误差。外层用贝叶斯优化与Hyperband优化工具设计参数（深度、宽度、边缘尖刺拓扑）；内层为每个候选形态优化控制策略。并引入几何相似度度量，用结构相似设计的缓存策略热启动训练，同等算力下多探索28%配置。在基于流动性的机器人-材料仿真框架中，于七种物理动力学不同的材料上评估。
AI.result: 协同设计的工具形态相对标准工具将真实世界称量误差降低45%，包括在未见过的材料上亦然；几何相似度热启动使同算力下配置探索量增加28%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能同时使控制策略与物理工具适配目标材料动力学，为实验室自动化领域带来材料操作的新范式。

title: Learning from Runtime Feedback through Failure-Bank Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Runtime-feedback-driven self-evolution for safer VLA policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize broadly across robotic manipulation tasks, but complex environments require balancing task success with unintended contact. Runtime shields can correct individual actions, but they leave the underlying policy unchanged, so repeated disagreements may create a persistent policy-shield mismatch that blocks task progress. To address this challenge, we introduce FailBank, a four-stage self-evolving framework that converts runtime feedback into persistent policy improvement. During collection, a fixed CBF-based safety module serves as an observe-only teacher, producing counterfactual corrections while the policy remains in control. Outcome-aware admission then converts useful proposals into corrective targets and retains successful uncorrected actions as quiet anchors for guarded LoRA updates. We evaluate FailBank on the VLA-Arena benchmark across two difficulty levels and two VLA backbones. Compared with the base policies, FailBank improves the joint success-cost operating point. Across the two backbones, FailBank improves task success rate by 8.5 and 6.9 percentage points, while reducing policy-induced cumulative cost by 35.6\% and 23.8\%, respectively. Compared with runtime shielding, FailBank raises task success rate by 25.4 and 9.5 percentage points, while maintaining comparable policy-induced cumulative cost. These results show that runtime feedback can serve as persistent policy supervision rather than only as a temporary action constraint.

AI.tldr: FailBank是一个四阶段自演化框架，将运行时安全反馈转化为持久性的策略改进，在VLA-Arena上同时提升任务成功率并降低累积代价。
AI.motivation: VLA模型泛化能力广，但在复杂环境中需要在任务成功与意外接触之间权衡。运行时shield只能修正单个动作而不改变底层策略，导致策略与shield之间持续失配，进而阻碍任务进展。因此需要一种能把运行时反馈固化为策略改进的方法。
AI.method: FailBank采用四阶段自演化框架：（1）采集阶段，用固定的基于CBF的安全模块作为"仅观察"教师，在策略保持控制权的情况下生成反事实修正；（2）结果感知准入，将有用的建议转化为修正目标；（3）保留未被修正的成功动作作为"安静锚点"，用于带保护的LoRA更新，从而实现持久策略改进。
AI.result: 在VLA-Arena的两种难度和两个VLA骨干上与基线策略相比，FailBank改善了成功-代价联合操作点：两个骨干任务成功率分别提升8.5和6.9个百分点，策略引发的累积代价分别降低35.6%和23.8%；与运行时shielding相比，成功率分别提高25.4和9.5个百分点，且策略诱导累积代价相当。
AI.conclusion: 运行时反馈可以作为持久性的策略监督，而不仅仅是临时的动作约束；将运行时纠正固化为策略更新能同时改善任务成功率与安全性。

title: Toward Real-Time VLAs: Stage-Aware Two-Step Flow Denoising and System-Level Evaluation
comment: 31 pages, 21 figures (including 10 supplementary figures), and 10 tables (including 3 supplementary tables). Project page: https://embodied.magiclab.top/works/inference/index.html. Code: https://github.com/MagiclabRobotics/Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models face a timing gap between low-rate inference and high-rate robot execution. We characterize this gap through end-to-end latency measurements of model inference and the robot execution chain. Repeated Flow Matching denoising contributes substantially to inference cost, while robot-side delays mainly arise from perception acquisition, communication scheduling, and physical response. Analysis of the velocity field shows relatively stable magnitude and direction in early integration, followed by stronger directional correction near the terminal steps. Based on this stage heterogeneity, we propose two-stage non-uniform denoising, reducing the number of steps from 10 to 2 and model-inference time from 61.557 ms to 21.956 ms. We also develop a distributed real-time VLA framework with independent inference, action-publication, and robot-control rates, modular observation acquisition, and action-provenance logging. Using π0.5 as the baseline, we evaluate six real-time execution methods on a long-horizon physical garment-folding task. Legato performs best overall among training-based methods, while Temporal Smoothing leads among training-free methods; both perform strongly in task success, completion time, action continuity, and acceleration smoothness. Combining two-step denoising with representative execution methods substantially reduces inference cost with a small reduction in task performance. These results motivate joint optimization of model-inference efficiency and robot-system timing.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对VLA模型低推理速率与高机器人执行速率之间的时序鸿沟，测量端到端延迟并分析Flow Matching去噪的阶段异质性，提出两阶段非均匀去噪（步数10→2，推理时间61.557ms→21.956ms）及分布式实时VLA框架，并在长时序服装折叠任务上评估六种实时执行方法。
AI.motivation: VLA模型存在低频率推理与高频率机器人执行之间的时序鸿沟。重复的Flow Matching去噪显著增加推理开销，机器人侧延迟主要来自感知采集、通信调度与物理响应。作者希望通过刻画端到端延迟构成及去噪速度场的阶段特征，寻找推理效率与系统时序的联合优化空间。
AI.method: 1) 对模型推理与机器人执行链路进行端到端延迟测量；2) 分析速度场的幅值与方向特征，发现在早期积分阶段相对稳定、终端步骤附近方向修正更强；3) 基于该阶段异质性提出两阶段非均匀去噪，将去噪步数从10降至2；4) 构建分布式实时VLA框架，支持推理、动作发布与机器人控制独立频率，具备模块化观测采集与动作溯源日志；5) 以π0.5为基线，在长时序服装折叠任务上评估六种实时执行方法。
AI.result: 两阶段非均匀去噪将去噪步数从10降到2，模型推理时间从61.557 ms降到21.956 ms。在长时序服装折叠任务中，训练类方法中Legato整体表现最佳，免训练方法中Temporal Smoothing表现最佳，二者在任务成功率、完成时间、动作连续性与加速度平滑性上均表现强劲。将两步去噪与代表性执行方法结合，可在大幅降低推理成本的同时仅带来较小的任务性能下降。
AI.conclusion: VLA部署中的推理效率与机器人系统时序应进行联合优化。基于Flow Matching去噪阶段异质性的非均匀去噪可在几乎不损失任务性能的前提下显著降低推理开销，配合合理的实时执行策略可有效缓解推理—执行时序鸿沟。

title: RL-Guided PAC-NMPC for Probabilistically-Safe Perception-Based Navigation in Unknown Environments
summary: In this paper, we present an approach for combining stochastic nonlinear model predictive control (SNMPC) and reinforcement learning (RL) to enable probabilistically-safe perception-based navigation in unknown environments. Our method first uses RL to train probabilistic actor-critic and sensor prediction models. We then leverage these probabilistic models in a sampling-based SNMPC framework known as Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-NMPC, which uses hard constraints to enforce finite-time statistical guarantees on the probability of collision and value function improvement. By ensuring that our finite-horizon SNMPC policies decrease the value function in expectation, we can approach the long-horizon performance of the RL approach while satisfying probabilistic safety constraints. Through simulation experiments, we show that our approach can improve the safety of perception-based RL navigation policies and scale to high dimensional systems with large sensor input spaces and complex nonlinear dynamics. We also demonstrate our approach through hardware experiments, showing improved performance for vision-based navigation with an agile fixed-wing aerial vehicle in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 本文将强化学习（RL）与随机非线性模型预测控制（SNMPC）结合，先用RL训练概率型actor-critic与传感器预测模型，再将其嵌入基于采样的PAC-NMPC框架，通过硬约束实现碰撞概率与值函数提升的有限时间统计保证，在仿真与固定翼飞行器视觉导航硬件实验中提升了感知型导航的安全性与性能。
AI.motivation: 感知型RL导航策略在未知环境中缺乏概率安全性保证，难以兼顾长时域性能与安全约束；同时高维传感器输入与复杂非线性动力学对控制方法提出挑战。
AI.method: 提出RL与SNMPC融合的方法：1）用RL训练概率型actor-critic策略与传感器预测模型；2）将概率模型嵌入基于采样的PAC-NMPC（Probably Approximately Correct-NMPC）框架；3）用硬约束对碰撞概率和值函数改进施加有限时间统计保证；4）通过要求有限时域SNMPC策略在期望上降低值函数，衔接RL的长时域性能。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明该方法提升了感知型RL导航策略的安全性，并可扩展到具有大传感器输入空间和复杂非线性动力学的高维系统；硬件实验在未知环境中使用敏捷固定翼飞行器进行视觉导航，验证了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将概率型RL与PAC-NMPC结合，可在满足概率安全约束的同时逼近RL的长时域性能，并在仿真与真实固定翼平台验证了可行性与扩展性。

title: Magic-W0: A Structured World-Action Foundation Model for Physical Intelligence
comment: 29 pages, 15 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://embodied.magiclab.top/works/wam/magic-w0/index.html; Code: GitHub - MagiclabRobotics/Magic-W0
summary: World-action models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned environment dynamics, yet existing approaches largely rely on future observation reconstruction or generic latent prediction and lack structured, control-oriented world representations tightly coupled with action generation. We introduce Magic-W0, a world-action foundation model that jointly models structured physical state evolution and continuous actions. Magic-W0 represents interaction as a Structured World Transition consisting of Current State, Transition, and Future State. Current State combines vision-language context with Current 3D Geometry; Transition is represented by 3D Motion capturing action-induced three-dimensional changes; and Future State is represented by Future Semantics describing task-relevant outcomes. To couple prediction and control, we propose a layer-aligned world-action interaction architecture in which evolving action hypotheses condition world-transition prediction, while predicted world representations continuously inform action generation. Magic-W0 is pre-trained on large-scale egocentric human manipulation, UMI, real-robot, and simulation data, with latent supervision for geometry, 3D motion, and future semantics from pre-trained visual models. Inference-time interventions show that structured world representations respond systematically to changes in candidate actions and that action-related information propagates through shared 3D representations into future semantic predictions. On RoboDojo-Sim, Magic-W0 achieves an average Score of 27.10, the highest among the compared WAMs. Across multiple real-robot tasks, it also demonstrates strong downstream performance after fine-tuning with limited downstream data, supporting generalization and rapid adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Magic-W0世界-动作基础模型，通过结构化世界转移（当前状态、转移、未来状态）联合建模物理状态演化与连续动作，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）多依赖未来观测重建或通用隐空间预测，缺乏与动作生成紧密耦合的结构化、控制导向的世界表征，难以有效支撑机器人策略学习。
AI.method: Magic-W0将交互表示为结构化世界转移：当前状态（视觉-语言上下文+当前3D几何）、转移（3D运动捕获动作引起的三维变化）、未来状态（未来语义描述任务相关结果）。提出层对齐的世界-动作交互架构，使动作假设条件化世界转移预测，预测的世界表征反向指导动作生成。在大规模第一人称人类操作、UMI、真实机器人及仿真数据上预训练，并用预训练视觉模型对几何、3D运动、未来语义进行隐监督。
AI.result: 推理时干预实验表明结构化世界表征对候选动作变化响应系统、动作相关信息通过共享3D表征传播至未来语义预测；在RoboDojo-Sim上平均得分27.10，为对比WAM中最优；在多真实机器人任务上经少量下游数据微调后表现良好，具备泛化与快速适应能力。
AI.conclusion: Magic-W0通过结构化、控制导向的世界表征与动作生成的紧耦合，为世界-动作基础模型提供了有效范式，兼具仿真性能优势与真实场景泛化能力。

title: SplineWAM: Adaptive Action Horizons for World Action Models via B-Spline Representations
summary: World action models (WAMs) are large embodied policies that jointly predict future video and the actions to execute, emitting a fixed-length action chunk per inference call. Such a policy allocates its computational budget uniformly in time, unable to execute for longer over free-space motion or to spend more inference on contact-rich manipulation, which limits the throughput a WAM can reach when served in the cloud. We present SplineWAM, which adaptively compresses the action trajectory into a fixed-size window of cubic B-spline parameters, fitting the knot times to the characteristics of the motion. One parameter budget then decodes into chunks of varying temporal resolution and duration, and both the executed span and the interval until the next policy call follow from the prediction itself. Aligning the video supervision to the fitted knot times of the demonstration rather than to a uniform grid concentrates the supervised frames where the action trajectory is complex. For asynchronous deployment we introduce Jacobian-Pullback Real-Time Chunking (JP-RTC), which imposes chunk continuity on the decoded raw actions the robot executes rather than on the spline parameters, and corrects the parameters through the decoder so that the executed prefix agrees with the actions already committed. On LIBERO-Plus and RoboCasa, SplineWAM improves success rate over an action chunking WAM by $8.2$ and $4.4$ points while cutting policy calls per episode by 22% and 26%. On three bimanual real-robot tasks under asynchronous execution, it leads or matches the baseline while decoding 1.2 to 1.6 times as much executed motion per call.

AI.tldr: SplineWAM 将动作轨迹自适应压缩为固定数量的三次B样条参数，实现可变时间分辨率与执行时长的动作块，并配合 JP-RTC 支持异步部署。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）每次推理输出固定长度的动作块，计算预算在时间上均匀分配，无法在自由空间运动时延长执行、也无法在接触密集操作上投入更多推理，限制了云端部署吞吐量。
AI.method: 将动作轨迹压缩为固定尺寸的三次B样条参数窗口，节点时间依据运动特征拟合；同一参数预算可解码为不同时间分辨率与持续时长的动作块，执行跨度与下次策略调用间隔由预测本身决定；视频监督对齐到演示的拟合节点时间而非均匀网格，以在动作复杂处集中监督帧；提出雅可比回拉实时分块（JP-RTC），对解码后的原始动作施加块连续性约束，并通过解码器反向修正参数，使已执行前缀与已提交动作一致。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboCasa 上，成功率分别较动作分块 WAM 提升 8.2 与 4.4 个百分点，同时每回合策略调用次数减少 22% 与 26%；在三个双臂真机任务异步执行下，性能领先或持平基线，每次调用解码执行的运动量为基线的 1.2–1.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过样条参数化实现时间自适应的动作分块，并配合 JP-RTC 支持异步执行，SplineWAM 在提升成功率的同时显著降低策略调用频率，提高云端服务吞吐量。

title: Active Mapping of Underwater Litter Using Camera-Sonar Fusion
summary: Marine litter is a growing threat to the underwater ecosystem, driving demand for autonomous survey methods that can locate debris efficiently over large areas. Existing survey methods typically follow predefined paths or operate with a single sensing modality, typically a camera (with image quality suffering in poor-visibility conditions) or sonar (usually noisy and low-resolution). We present an active mapping framework in which a forward-looking sonar and a camera both feed into a shared Bayesian occupancy map, and an optimization problem is solved at each step to decide on the next best view. Candidate viewpoints are scored by a two-term utility that balances exploration of uncertain regions via voxel entropy against exploitation of likely objects. Each sensor is characterized by range- and bearing-dependent detection and false-alarm probability tables determined from data. We evaluate the approach in a realistic underwater simulator, demonstrating that active mapping finds objects faster than a lawnmower coverage pattern, and that the dual-sensor approach works better than using either of the individual sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动建图框架，融合前视声呐与相机到共享贝叶斯占据栅格地图，通过每步求解优化问题选择下一最佳视角，在真实感水下仿真中证明其比割草机式覆盖路径更快发现目标，且双传感器优于任一单传感器。
AI.motivation: 海洋垃圾对水下生态系统威胁日益严重，亟需能在大范围高效定位碎屑的自主勘测方法；现有勘测方法多沿预设路径行进或仅使用单一传感模态（相机在低能见度下画质差，声呐噪声大且分辨率低），难以兼顾效率与可靠性。
AI.method: 构建主动建图框架：前视声呐与相机同时输入一个共享的贝叶斯占据栅格地图；每一步求解一个优化问题以确定下一最佳视角；候选视角由两项效用函数评分，一项通过体素熵驱动对不确定区域的探索，另一项驱动对潜在目标的利用；每种传感器由基于数据标定的、随距离与方位变化的检测概率与虚警概率查找表刻画。
AI.result: 在真实感水下仿真器中评估：主动建图比割草机式覆盖模式更快发现目标；双传感器方案的性能优于单独使用声呐或相机中的任一种。
AI.conclusion: 融合声呐与相机的主动建图方法能有效提升水下垃圾勘测的搜索效率，双模态互补优于单模态方案，为自主水下勘测提供了可行路径。

title: Magnetic based In-situ Self 3D Pose Estimation for a Modular Soft Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot via IMU-Fusion
summary: Continuum robots are well suited for gentle manipulation because of their inherent compliance and ability to adapt to complex environments. However, their continuously deformable structure makes accurate configuration estimation challenging, particularly when external vision systems are unavailable or obstructed. In this work, we present an embedded pose sensing framework that combines inertial measurement units (IMUs) and active magnetic fields to estimate the robot configuration without relying on external cameras. The angular measurements from the IMU and magnetic-field references are fused to improve local orientation estimation and reduce accumulated orientation error during operation. This pose sensing scheme achieves an update rate of 16.7~Hz, allowing real-time feedback. The proposed system is experimentally validated through closed-loop control, where the estimated robot configuration is used to maintain the end-effector at a desired position while interacting with an object. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed magnetic--inertial sensing for real-time pose estimation and closed-loop control of continuum robots.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合IMU与主动磁场的嵌入式位姿感知框架，实现连续体机器人无需外部视觉的实时构型估计与闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人因固有柔顺性和对复杂环境的适应性，非常适合进行柔顺操作；但其连续可变形结构导致构型估计困难，尤其在外部视觉系统不可用或被遮挡时，现有方法难以获得准确位姿。
AI.method: 构建嵌入式位姿感知框架，将IMU的角度测量与主动磁场参考进行融合，以改善局部姿态估计并减少运行过程中累积的姿态误差；该感知方案的更新率为16.7 Hz，可支持实时反馈。
AI.result: 通过闭环控制实验验证系统性能：利用估计的机器人构型，在与物体交互过程中将末端执行器维持在期望位置。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了分布式磁-惯性感知在连续体机器人实时位姿估计与闭环控制方面的潜力。

title: TACTIC: Temporal and Context-Aware LLM Tactical Planning for Roadside LiDAR Attacks
summary: Physical LiDAR attacks are often evaluated using fixed primitives and manually selected parameters, despite their strong dependence on surrounding traffic. We present TACTIC, a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to coordinate state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks. Under a gray-box threat model, TACTIC relies only on an attacker-operated roadside perception stack, without accessing the victim LiDAR's native point clouds or internal processing. Local perception provides metric vehicle states, while the MLLM combines these measurements with roadside imagery to infer relational traffic context and construct a semantic scene graph. Based on this representation, TACTIC selects and configures two complementary primitives: \emph{push-away}, which shifts the perceived range of a lead vehicle, and \emph{phantom-obstacle braking}, which triggers emergency braking through obstacle injection. Measured traffic states and empirically calibrated constraints ground the generated tactics in physically feasible operating regions. To accommodate MLLM latency, TACTIC overlaps reasoning and execution asynchronously while high-rate local perception detects scene changes and triggers replanning. Across 280 randomized CARLA trials, the full policy achieves a 100% collision rate, compared with 35% for a fixed rule, 60% for random selection, and 75% for a restricted LLM using mode selection with default parameters. Joint physical-and-image input achieves 100% success, versus 65% with physical measurements alone and 75% with imagery alone, while asynchronous $Δ$ refresh reduces scene-mutation response from 7.4 s to 2.0 s. These results show that scene-dependent tactical planning can expose context-sensitive LiDAR failure modes that fixed attack policies may miss.

AI.tldr: TACTIC：一种场景感知的MLLM驱动框架，用于协调自适应路侧LiDAR攻击，在280次CARLA随机试验中实现100%碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 现有物理LiDAR攻击多采用固定原语与手动参数，忽视其对周边交通场景的强依赖性，难以覆盖上下文相关的失效模式。
AI.method: 灰盒威胁模型下，仅依赖攻击方路侧感知栈；本地感知提供车辆度量状态，MLLM结合路侧图像推断关系型交通上下文并构建语义场景图；据此选择与配置两类互补原语（push-away、phantom-obstacle braking），以实测状态与经验标定约束限定物理可行域；采用异步重叠推理与执行，高频感知检测场景变化并触发重规划。
AI.result: 280次随机CARLA试验中，全策略碰撞率100%，对比固定规则35%、随机选择60%、受限LLM（模式选择+默认参数）75%；物理+图像联合输入成功率100%，仅物理65%，仅图像75%；异步Δ刷新将场景突变响应从7.4 s降至2.0 s。
AI.conclusion: 场景相关的战术规划能够揭示固定攻击策略可能遗漏的上下文敏感型LiDAR失效模式。

title: PhasePlan: Ordered Future-Phase Planning for Robot Brain Models
summary: Robot brain models integrate vision, language, and robot state to generate actions for complex manipulation tasks. Most predict fixed-length action chunks that may span multiple task phases. This can obscure phase transitions and favor frequent action patterns, compromising action timing in dynamic environments. We propose \method, an ordered future-phase planning method for robot brain models. From current multimodal observations, it predicts the task phase at each future action position. The resulting planning representations condition the corresponding actions, preserving temporal alignment between task progress and action generation. Training first learns the planner, then freezes it during action-model adaptation to maintain stable phase representations. We instantiate \method on pretrained $π_{0.5}$ and AcrossWAM1.0 robot brain models. Detailed quantitative evaluation uses the $π_{0.5}$ implementation. On conveyor-belt manipulation, \method reduces offline joint-action error by approximately 22.5\% relative to the original $π_{0.5}$ model. It also improves phase-transition modeling and cross-phase action prediction. These results demonstrate the value of ordered future-phase planning for continuous action generation.

AI.tldr: 提出有序未来阶段规划方法，为机器人脑模型的连续动作生成提供阶段对齐条件，在传送带操作任务中将离线关节动作误差降低约22.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人脑模型多预测固定长度的动作块，动作块可能跨越多个任务阶段，导致阶段转换被掩盖、偏好高频动作模式，从而损害动态环境中的动作时序。
AI.method: 从当前多模态观测出发，预测每个未来动作位置所处的任务阶段，生成规划表示以条件化对应动作，保持任务进展与动作生成的时间对齐。训练分两阶段：先学习规划器，再在动作模型适配时冻结规划器以维持稳定的阶段表示。方法实例化于预训练的π_{0.5}与AcrossWAM1.0机器人脑模型。
AI.result: 在π_{0.5}实现上进行详细定量评估：传送带操作任务中，离线关节动作误差相对原始π_{0.5}降低约22.5%，并改善了阶段转换建模与跨阶段动作预测。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式建模有序未来阶段规划对连续动作生成具有价值，可提升动作时序精度与阶段转换能力。

title: When Instructions Retrieve Trajectories: Diagnosing and Mitigating Generalization Failures in VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can exceed 90% success on in-distribution tasks and withstand nuisance changes that preserve the required action, yet fail under counterfactual changes that demand a different action. Aggregate robustness scores can therefore conceal a more specific failure, in which a policy responds to both language and vision yet does not combine them to select the action the task requires. We call this failure instruction-action binding. Instructions cue familiar trajectory families, and visual feedback adjusts their execution. Behavioral analyses of fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.7 policies reveal that failed rollouts often retain the source behavior or switch to another demonstrated task. These switches show that language is not simply ignored. Readouts and interventions connect these choices to task-conditioned internal states. Our analysis of the imitation objective shows how narrow conditional action support can leave grounded and instruction-keyed solutions indistinguishable on the demonstrations. This motivates Equivariant Counterfactual Training (ECT), which acts at two levels. ECT data supply valid demonstrations in which the same instruction requires different actions in distinguishable scenes, while the ECT loss trains each demonstration with its counterpart in the same update. In a controlled LIBERO-PRO comparison, full ECT raises $π_{0.5}$'s mean position-swap success from 36% to 59%. On CALVIN, where counterparts already occur in the original data, the ECT loss improves five-task completion without new demonstrations. On a real UR5e under a fixed demonstration budget, full ECT raises unseen-position success from 8% to 88%.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别并定义了VLA模型的"指令-动作绑定"失效模式，并提出等变反事实训练(ECT)加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在分布内任务成功率超90%，并能容忍不改变所需动作的干扰变化，但在需要不同动作的反事实变化下失败。聚合鲁棒性指标会掩盖这种更具体的失效：策略虽同时接收语言与视觉，却未将二者结合来选出任务所需的动作。
AI.method: 作者定义该失效为"指令-动作绑定"，对微调的π0.5与GR00T-N1.7策略进行行为分析，并通过读出与干预将动作选择联系到任务条件化的内部状态；同时从模仿目标角度分析窄条件动作支撑为何使"真值接地"与"指令键控"解在示范数据上不可区分。据此提出等变反事实训练(ECT)：数据层面提供同一指令在可区分场景中要求不同动作的有效示范，损失层面在同一更新中成对训练对应示范。
AI.result: 在受控的LIBERO-PRO对比中，完整ECT将π0.5的平均位置交换成功率从36%提升至59%；在CALVIN上（对应样本已存在于原始数据），ECT损失无需新示范即改善五任务完成度；在固定示范预算的真实UR5e上，完整ECT将未见位置成功率从8%提升至88%。
AI.conclusion: 失败轨迹常保留源行为或切换到另一已示范任务，说明语言并未被简单忽略，而是与视觉未正确绑定。ECT通过数据与损失的双层设计，在不增加示范预算的条件下显著提升反事实场景下的动作选择能力。

title: EWAM: Emergent Depth-Wise Specialization in a Unified Embodied Model -- From Semantic Understanding through Visual Foresight to Action
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies emphasize semantic understanding, whereas world-action models (WAMs) learn predictive representations of environment dynamics. Systems that expose a policy to both sources often still concentrate action computation on a single expert. We present EWAM, an action-centric unified embodied model whose asymmetric joint attention lets action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action information at every layer while the perceptual experts retain their distinct roles. Without layer-wise supervision, EWAM develops an emergent depth-wise specialization: action queries attend mainly to vision-language features in shallow layers, to predicted future frames in intermediate layers, and to action tokens themselves in deep layers. This handoff replicates across tasks and is stable across denoising steps. Checkpoint tracking and causal interventions show that it is learned and that action generation depends on it. EWAM is pretrained in two separate regimes, one on cross-embodiment robot trajectories and one on human egocentric video. In simulation and real-robot experiments, it surpasses existing VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines. Human egocentric data improve both cross-embodiment transfer and real-robot robustness, and subtask-phase supervision improves long-horizon completion. Together, these results suggest that unified embodied learning can induce an ordered internal progression from semantic understanding, through visual foresight, to action formation.

AI.tldr: EWAM 是一个以动作为中心的统一具身模型，通过非对称联合注意力让动作 token 在每一层读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来与动作信息，并自发形成“浅层看语义→中层看预测未来→深层看动作”的深度特化，在仿真与真机实验中超越 VLA、WAM 及混合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 强调语义理解，WAM 学习环境动态的预测表征，但即便同时暴露于两类信息，策略的动作计算仍集中在单一专家上，未能真正整合语义、视觉预见与动作生成。
AI.method: 提出 EWAM：以动作为中心的统一具身模型，采用非对称联合注意力，使动作 token 在每一层均可读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来帧与动作信息，同时保持各感知专家分工。模型在两个独立范式下预训练：跨具身机器人轨迹与人类第一视角视频。
AI.result: 在无逐层监督下，EWAM 涌现出深度特化：浅层动作查询主要关注视觉-语言特征，中层关注预测未来帧，深层关注动作 token 自身；该交接跨任务复现且在去噪步间稳定。检查点跟踪与因果干预表明该特化是习得的且动作生成依赖它。仿真与真机实验中超越 VLA、WAM 与混合基线；人类第一视角数据提升跨具身迁移与真机鲁棒性，子任务阶段监督提升长时程完成度。
AI.conclusion: 统一具身学习可诱导出从语义理解、经视觉预见、到动作形成的有序内部进程。

title: Identifiable Decomposition of Submovements in Human Hand Trajectories
summary: Voluntary movements have long been hypothesised to be comprised of discrete primitives called submovements, as a descriptive model of human motor behaviour. However, existing methods scale poorly, and no principled method exists to determine whether a decomposition is informative. We propose a spatiotemporal kernel correlation between primitive pairs as an identifiability criterion. Submovement-Identifiable Decomposition (Sub-ID) embeds this criterion in its adaptive-ridge regularisation, biasing the optimiser toward low-correlation solutions. Identifiability is lost when primitives become collinear and recovered when they diverge spatially. On synthetic data, Sub-ID recovers ground-truth parameter distributions where existing methods fail; furthermore, when primitives overlap too heavily to be distinguished, the method explicitly detects this ambiguity rather than outputting misleading results. Sub-ID extracts submovements from real three-dimensional, long-horizon movements, a regime no prior method addresses. This method has the potential to identify physiologically grounded primitives for motor control research and imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出子运动可辨识分解（Sub-ID）方法，以时空核相关作为可辨识性判据并嵌入自适应岭正则化，实现对运动基元的分解与歧义检测，在合成与真实三维长时序数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 自愿运动被假设由离散基元（submovements）组成，但现有分解方法可扩展性差，且缺乏判定分解是否具有信息量的原则性方法。
AI.method: 提出基元对之间的时空核相关作为可辨识性判据，并将其嵌入 Sub-ID 的自适应岭正则化中，使优化器偏向低相关解；当基元共线时可辨识性丧失，空间上分离时恢复。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，Sub-ID 能恢复真实参数分布而现有方法失败；当基元重叠严重无法区分时，方法显式检测歧义而非输出误导结果；并从真实三维长时序运动中提取子运动，为先前方法未涉及的场景。
AI.conclusion: Sub-ID 有望为运动控制研究与模仿学习识别具生理基础的基元。

title: BatSLAM 2.0: Sequence-Verified Sonar Place Recognition in a Robust Pose Graph
summary: Echolocating bats can navigate dark and cluttered spaces using echolocation. Over a decade ago, BatSLAM showed that a robot with a biomimetic binaural sonar can build a topological map of the environment, by recognizing places from the received acoustic signals. Sonar place recognition, however, is ambiguous by nature: corridors produce nearly identical echo trains, and wrong loop closure can collapse the topological map. In this paper, we introduce BatSLAM 2.0, a novel sonar-only SLAM system built from three elements: an updated acoustic front-end, a sequence verifier that tracks and verifies loop closure candidates and a pose graph implemented on a high performance factor graph framework. The system was thoroughly evaluated both in simulated as well as real world recordings. In both cases, the BatSLAM2.0 algorithm shows the capability of robust topological map creation, countering map collapse, and robust scaling of map size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BatSLAM 2.0，一个仅依赖仿生双耳声呐的SLAM系统，通过改进的声学前端、序列校验器和高性能位姿图，实现鲁棒的拓扑建图并抑制错误回环导致的地图坍缩。
AI.motivation: 蝙蝠能利用回声定位在黑暗杂乱环境中导航。此前BatSLAM证明了仿生双耳声呐机器人可通过接收的声学信号识别地点，构建拓扑地图。但声呐地点识别本质上是歧义的：走廊会产生几乎相同的回波序列，错误的回环闭合会导致拓扑地图坍缩。
AI.method: BatSLAM 2.0由三个部分组成：更新后的声学前端、跟踪并验证回环候选的序列校验器，以及在高效因子图框架上实现的位姿图。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界录音两种场景下进行了全面评估，BatSLAM 2.0均展现出鲁棒的拓扑地图创建能力，能够对抗地图坍缩，并具备鲁棒的地图规模可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: BatSLAM 2.0有效缓解了声呐回环歧义问题，为仅用声呐的鲁棒拓扑SLAM提供了可行方案，并在仿真与真实数据中得到验证。

title: Passive Stiffness Shaping in Cable-Suspended Aerial Manipulation via Movable Compliant Anchors
summary: Cable-suspended aerial manipulation offers a lightweight architecture for cooperative transportation and physical interaction, yet the passive mechanical response perceived at the load remains insufficiently understood and systematically exploited. This work interprets aerial vehicles as movable compliant anchors and develops a gravity-aware quasi-static theory for predicting and shaping the passive Cartesian stiffness of a suspended load. The formulation applies to an arbitrary number of aerial vehicles connected to a point load by taut, straight, inextensible cables. At a selected gravity-loaded equilibrium, aerial-anchor compliance and transverse cable geometric compliance combine in series within each leg, while the leg stiffnesses act in parallel on the load. For isotropic aerial-anchor behavior, each leg is exactly equivalent to a virtual unilateral elastic cable, revealing an axial--transverse stiffness decomposition governed by the equilibrium tension. These results define a nonlinear map from commanded-anchor configuration to passive load stiffness, whose differential enables local constraint-preserving shaping through anchor repositioning. A dynamic rigid-body validation framework with nonlinear vehicle control, elastic-damped tendons, and environmental contact is defined to assess when and to what extent the derived stiffness remains predictive beyond the assumptions of the analytical model.

AI.tldr: 该工作将无人机视为可移动柔性锚点，建立重力感知的准静态理论，用于预测与塑造缆索悬挂负载的被动笛卡尔刚度，并通过动力学刚体仿真验证理论的有效边界。
AI.motivation: 缆索悬挂式空中操作系统在协同运输与物理交互中具有轻量化优势，但负载端所感知的被动机械响应尚未被充分理解与系统利用，因而缺乏可预测、可设计的被动刚度理论。
AI.method: 针对任意数量无人机经张紧、笔直、不可伸长的缆索连接单点负载的情形，在选定重力加载平衡态下建模：每条支腿内锚点柔顺与缆索横向几何柔顺串联，各支腿刚度在负载处并联；对等向锚点行为，将支腿严格等效为虚拟单侧弹性缆索，导出由平衡张力支配的轴向—横向刚度分解，并构建从指令锚点构型到被动负载刚度的非线性映射，其微分用于局部保约束的刚度塑形。
AI.result: 获得了基于平衡张力的轴向—横向刚度分解与虚拟单侧弹性缆索精确等效，建立了锚点构型到负载被动刚度的非线性映射及其微分形式，从而支持通过锚点重定位实现局部保约束刚度塑造；并给出含非线性车辆控制、弹性阻尼腱与环境接触的动力学刚体验证框架，用于评估该刚度预测在超出解析假设时的适用程度。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将空中锚点柔顺与缆索几何柔顺统一为可解析的被动刚度模型，为缆索悬挂协同操作的刚度预测与主动塑造提供了准静态基础，其预测能力需通过动力学仿真与接触验证进一步界定。

title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Preprint, under review
summary: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx, a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.

AI.tldr: TacEx将触觉反馈引入基于认知不确定性的探索框架，通过按感官模态分解模型不确定性，把好奇心导向触觉通道，从而在无任务奖励与专家演示条件下发现接触动力学。该方法采集的密集交互数据可支持离线学习下游抓取放置策略，并可用于后训练VLA模型，在保持高样本效率的同时显著提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在机器人操作技能学习中样本效率低下。主流RL依赖随机动作采样，导致训练预算大量消耗于无接触的自由空间运动，而操作技能恰恰源于接触。已有的基于模型分歧或认知不确定性的内在动机方法虽优于各向同性噪声，但会对功能无关的转移（如自由空间中的杂乱运动）给予不确定性奖励，探索信号不够定向。
AI.method: 论文提出TacEx框架，将触觉反馈作为探索的自然信号，把认知不确定性驱动的探索与触觉结合。核心做法是按感官模态分解模型不确定性，将好奇心定向到触觉通道，使机器人主动探索复杂接触动力学。该触觉驱动的好奇心在探索阶段无需任务奖励与专家演示即可学习操作与抓取。所采集的交互密集数据集用于离线学习下游pick-and-place策略，无需额外环境交互；同时用于对预训练（无触觉）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。
AI.result: 触觉驱动的探索使机器人能够发现复杂接触动力学，在无任务奖励与专家演示下学会操作与抓取物体。由该探索采集的交互密集数据集支持离线学习下游pick-and-place策略，且无需额外环境交互。对初始无触觉预训练的VLA模型进行TacEx后训练后，下游性能显著提升，同时保持很高的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 触觉反馈是指导机器人探索的有效自然信号。通过将认知不确定性按模态分解并把好奇心锚定到触觉通道，TacEx避免了在功能无关的自由空间转移上浪费探索，实现了无奖励、无演示的接触动力学发现，并可作为高质量交互数据来源支持离线策略学习与VLA模型后训练，在样本效率上具有明显优势。

title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
summary: Video generation models (VGMs) offer strong spatiotemporal priors for embodied observation--action modeling. However, joint-space action vectors lack explicit image-space structure and vary in dimensionality and semantics across embodiments, making it challenging to directly leverage the rich spatiotemporal priors of VGMs. End-effector visualizations provide an alternative but do not specify the full articulated configuration needed for robot execution. We present Dream4ACT, a world model built for joint video-action modeling across embodiments. To unify action representations across embodiments, we introduce a shared visual action interface, called action views, which render target joint configurations from four prescribed virtual cameras using URDF-based forward kinematics. This shared visual representation preserves embodiment-specific articulated geometry while allowing observation and action sequences to share a video autoencoder and diffusion transformer. Through masked flow-matching, our model supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint observation--action generation within a single jointly trained model by varying which future sequences are corrupted. To recover executable action sequences from predicted action views, we propose a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery mechanism, without a learned embodiment-specific decoder. Dream4ACT achieves an average success rate of 88.98\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and an overall score of 65.66 on TriWorldBench, supporting effective closed-loop manipulation and competitive action-conditioned multiview prediction through the visual action interface.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dream4ACT 世界模型，通过"动作视图"这一共享视觉动作接口统一不同本体的联合空间动作表示，结合掩码流匹配单模型支持正/逆动力学与联合观测-动作生成，并用免训练 URDF 约束多视图恢复机制还原可执行动作。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型具备强时空先验，可用于具身观测-动作建模；但联合空间动作向量缺乏显式图像空间结构，且跨本体维度与语义不一致，难以直接利用这些先验。末端执行器可视化虽为替代方案，却无法刻画机器人执行所需的完整关节构型。
AI.method: 1) 定义"动作视图"共享视觉动作接口，基于 URDF 前向运动学从四个预设虚拟相机渲染目标关节构型，在保留本体特定关节几何的同时让观测与动作序列共享同一视频自编码器与扩散 Transformer；2) 采用掩码流匹配，通过改变被破坏的未来序列，在单一联合训练模型中支持正动力学、逆动力学及联合观测-动作生成；3) 提出免训练、URDF 约束的多视图恢复机制，从预测的动作视图恢复可执行动作序列，无需学习本体特定解码器。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率达 88.98%，在 TriWorldBench 上总体得分 65.66，支持有效闭环操作，并在动作条件多视图预测上具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以动作视图为核心的视觉动作接口可有效桥接 VGM 时空先验与跨本体动作建模，单一掩码流匹配世界模型即可统一多种动力学任务，且无需学习解码器即可恢复可执行动作，验证了该框架在闭环操作与多视图预测中的有效性。

title: Rethinking Legibility in Social Robot Hallway Navigation: Impact of Intent Representation and Human Distraction
summary: We focus on legible robot motion generation in social navigation settings. Legibility in human-robot interaction (HRI) is often described as the property of robot motion that enables an observer to confidently infer the robot's intent. While mature frameworks exist for generating legible motion in front of static observers, social robot navigation presents a new challenge: the robot must clearly convey its intent while ensuring human safety in dynamic pedestrian environments where human attention is often divided. With the goal of enabling robots to generate legible motion in dynamic and constrained spaces, we investigate how the choice of representation and the level of human attention shape navigation performance and human impressions. Focusing on the ubiquitous and demanding scenario of hallway navigation, we conduct two controlled user studies involving alternative legibility formulations implemented within a shared model predictive control framework. Study 1 (N = 45) investigates the role of intent representation, showing that passing-side legibility, particularly when adaptively updated, leads to smoother human motion and is perceived as more competent and less mentally and physically demanding than destination-based and non-legible baselines. Study 2 (N = 45) examines the effect of pedestrian attention, demonstrating that legible motion allows for smooth human motion even under distraction, even if this is not consistently reflected in subjective ratings. Together, these findings suggest that effective legible motion in social robot navigation benefits from interaction-level intent representations that support coordination, with some effects persisting even when human attention is divided. Code is available at https://github.com/fluentrobotics/Legible_MPPI.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨社交导航中机器人可读运动生成，通过两项用户实验比较不同意图表征与人类注意力水平对导航性能和主观印象的影响，发现基于"通过侧"的交互级意图表征效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有可读运动框架多针对静态观察者，而社交机器人导航面临动态行人环境与人类注意力分散的新挑战，机器人在传达意图的同时还须保障安全，因此需要研究表征选择与注意力水平如何影响导航表现。
AI.method: 聚焦走廊导航场景，在共享的模型预测控制（MPC）框架内实现多种可读性公式。开展两项受控用户研究（各N=45）：研究1考察意图表征方式（通过侧可读性、目的地可读性及非可读基线）的影响；研究2考察行人注意力水平的影响。
AI.result: 研究1表明，基于通过侧的可读性（尤其自适应更新时）使人类运动更平滑，并被感知为更有能力、身心负担更低。研究2表明，可读运动能在行人分心时仍保证人类运动平滑，尽管这一点未在主观评分中一致体现。
AI.conclusion: 社交机器人导航中的有效可读运动受益于支持协调的交互级意图表征，且部分效果在人类注意力分散时依然存在。代码已开源。

title: PrefPI: Preference-Guided Steering into Out-of-Distribution Behaviors
summary: We present PrefPI (Preference-Guided Policy Iteration), an iterative framework for steering pretrained generative robot policies using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories. Unlike prior preference-learning methods that primarily sharpen modes already represented by the policy, we study steering beyond the initial effective support, where desired behaviors are rarely or never observed under the initial policy. Our key idea is to formulate preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling: preferred trajectories define a conditional distribution, whose density ratio with the broader behavior prior provides an implicit preference signal amplified by classifier-free guidance (CFG). Repeating this preference-conditioned modeling and guidance step yields a form of preference-guided policy iteration, turning incremental improvements toward previously inaccessible behaviors. Across diffusion policies and the PI0.5 flow- matching VLA in simulation and the real world, PrefPI produces substantial behavioral shifts with limited feedback. In particular, PrefPI increases object transport height from 10.7 cm to 19.8 cm on real hardware with only 150 preference-labeled trajectories.

AI.tldr: PrefPI是一个偏好引导的策略迭代框架，仅用自生成轨迹的相对偏好即可引导预训练生成式机器人策略，实现超越初始有效支撑范围的行为转变。
AI.motivation: 既有偏好学习方法主要在策略已能表示的模态上做"锐化"，难以引导至策略初始有效支撑范围之外、几乎从未被观察到的目标行为。本文研究这种更具挑战的"支撑外引导"问题。
AI.method: 将偏好学习建模为偏好条件生成：偏好轨迹定义条件分布，其与更广泛行为先验的密度比提供隐式偏好信号，并通过无分类器引导(CFG)放大；重复"偏好条件建模+引导"步骤，形成偏好引导的策略迭代。
AI.result: 在扩散策略与PI0.5 flow-matching VLA上、仿真与真实环境中，PrefPI以有限反馈产生显著行为偏移；真实硬件上仅用150条偏好标注轨迹即将物体搬运高度从10.7 cm提升至19.8 cm。
AI.conclusion: 偏好可作为一种条件生成信号，通过CFG放大并迭代应用，实现对预训练生成式机器人策略的支撑外引导，且反馈需求低、跨策略与场景有效。

title: Social-WM: Safety-Aware Latent World Models for Robot Social Navigation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Safe social navigation requires a robot to anticipate not only the future consequences of its actions, but also whether a nominal action can actually be executed under surrounding physical and social constraints. We present Social-WM, an efficient latent world-model planning framework trained from egocentric RGB video sequences. Our key observation is that social-navigation experience contains a systematic discrepancy between the nominal action and the realizable action: a nominal forward action may be fully executed in free space, but needs to be constrained when heading towards a pedestrian or obstacle. Social-WM learns these safety-relevant consequences directly through action-conditioned future prediction, where the target is the actual observed future following each command. We further introduce a realizable inverse-dynamics objective that associates observed latent transitions with the action actually realized rather than the nominal one. At deployment, candidate actions are imagined through the latent world model, and the inverse dynamics model estimates their realizability; nominal--realizable discrepancy then provides a safety signal before execution. The learned dynamics and realizability model remain goal-independent and support both position- and image-goal navigation. On Social-HM3D, Social-WM achieves 63.77% success while reducing human collisions to 21.67%, and maintains strong performance under zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D, without explicit pedestrian tracking, privileged human state, or online reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: Social-WM：基于自视角RGB视频训练的高效隐世界模型规划框架，通过学习"名义动作-可实现动作"差异提供执行前安全信号，实现社交导航。
AI.motivation: 安全社交导航要求机器人不仅预测动作的未来后果，还需判断名义动作在周围物理与社会约束下能否真正被执行。既有方法通常依赖行人追踪、特权人类状态或在线强化学习，缺乏对"动作可实现性"的统一建模。
AI.method: 构建隐世界模型（latent world model），以动作条件化的未来预测为目标，预测目标为每条指令后实际观测到的未来；引入"可实现逆动力学（realizable inverse-dynamics）"目标，将观测到的隐状态转移与真正实现的动作（而非名义动作）关联。部署时，通过隐世界模型想象候选动作，用逆动力学模型估计其可实现性，并以名义-可实现差异作为执行前安全信号。动力学与可实现性模型与目标无关。
AI.result: 在Social-HM3D上成功率达63.77%，人类碰撞率降至21.67%；零样本迁移至Social-MP3D仍保持较强性能；无需显式行人追踪、特权人类状态或在线强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 社交导航经验中普遍存在名义动作与可实现动作的系统性差异，显式建模该差异可作为有效的执行前安全信号；隐世界模型与可实现逆动力学结合，能同时支持位置目标与图像目标导航，并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。

title: Non-Invasive Inspection of Water Canals Using Dronar
summary: Open concrete canals play a vital role in water transportation, serving as primary water infrastructure for millions of people across the Phoenix, Arizona, metro area. Over time, the concrete canals can experience a range of issues, including canal lining deformation, cracked concrete, and sediment buildup on the canal floor. Identifying such critical issues is a resource-intensive process, which currently happens only during four-year dry-up cycles. This prevents the maintenance crew from prioritizing operations on the most affected canal segments. To address this issue, the research team has developed and verified an easily deployable and non-invasive method to inspect canal beds without draining the water. This inspection system integrates affordable, off-the-shelf drone and sonar technology (termed dronar). This dronar system includes a consumer-grade sonar system integrated into an unmanned surface vehicle (USV) that carries the sonar transducer just under the surface of the canal water. This paper presents a proof-of-concept demonstration of the dronar system across three field tests on the Arizona Canal in Phoenix. DownScan depth profiles from the sedimented canal segment were consistently shallower than profiles from the same segment after cleaning, with offsets of up to 15 cm observed along the track. Repeated runs over the clean segment produced closely overlapping DownScan depth profiles, confirming that the dronar yields repeatable measurements across the natural variation of the canal bed. These results establish the dronar as a viable proof-of-concept tool for non-invasive canal bed inspection.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一种名为"dronar"的非侵入式运河河床检测系统，将低成本消费级声纳集成于无人水面艇（USV），无需排空运河即可检测淤积与衬砌问题，并在亚利桑那运河的三次现场试验中验证了其可行性与可重复性。
AI.motivation: 混凝土运河是凤凰城都会区数百万人的关键输水基础设施，长期运行会出现衬砌变形、混凝土开裂和河床淤积等问题。当前检测只能在四年一次的干涸（dry-up）周期内进行，资源消耗大，导致维护人员无法优先处理受损最严重的渠段。因此亟需一种易于部署、非侵入、无需排水的检测方法。
AI.method: 研究团队开发并验证了"dronar"系统：将消费级、现成的声纳系统集成到无人水面艇（USV）上，声纳换能器置于运河水面以下。该系统在凤凰城亚利桑那运河（Arizona Canal）进行了三次现场试验，通过DownScan深度剖面比较淤积段与清理后同一渠段的测量结果，并对清洁渠段进行重复测量以评估可重复性。
AI.result: 淤积渠段的DownScan深度剖面始终比同一渠段清理后的剖面更浅，沿轨迹观测到的偏差最大达15 cm。对清洁渠段的重复测量产生了高度重叠的DownScan深度剖面，表明dronar在运河河床自然变化条件下仍能提供可重复的测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了dronar作为一种可行的概念验证（proof-of-concept）工具，可用于非侵入式运河河床检测，为在不停水条件下识别淤积与受损渠段、优化维护优先级提供了技术路径。

title: Centralized Multi-UAV Exploration and 3D Reconstruction Using Single-UAV Planners
comment: Presented at the IEEE International Conference on Advanced Robotics and Mechatronics (ICARM 2026). To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary:
Extending single Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) exploration methods to multi-UAV teams can improve coverage speed and robustness, but introduces challenges such as consistent mapping, safe navigation, and deployment strategy. In this work, we present a centralized multi-UAV exploration framework that enables the use of existing single-UAV sampling-based planners in a multi-UAV setting.
  The proposed architecture allows multiple UAVs to collaboratively explore unknown environments using a shared global Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF) map and centralized planning. Building on the voxblox library, we adapt its mapping pipeline to support real-time fusion of depth measurements from multiple UAVs into a common TSDF representation. In addition, inter-UAV collision avoidance and robot self-filtering mechanisms are integrated into the system to ensure safe navigation and prevent reconstruction of other UAVs as static obstacles.
  The framework is evaluated in simulation using four sampling-based exploration planners - RH-NBVP, KRH-NBVP, AEP, and KAEP - whose core sampling logic is preserved, with only system-level adaptations for multi-UAV operation. Experiments are conducted across multiple environments and under two deployment configurations: Joint Start (JS), where UAVs are initialized in close proximity, and Separated Start (SS), where UAVs are initialized in distinct locations. Results show that SS deployments consistently achieve faster exploration and improved coverage across all planners, highlighting the importance of the deployment strategy in multi-UAV exploration performance.

AI.tldr: 提出集中式多无人机探索框架，复用单机采样规划器，基于共享全局TSDF地图与集中规划，并评估部署策略对探索性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 将单无人机探索方法扩展到多无人机团队可提升覆盖速度与鲁棒性，但带来一致建图、安全导航与部署策略等挑战；目标是在多机场景下复用已有的单机采样规划器。
AI.method: 构建集中式多无人机探索框架：多机共享全局TSDF地图并集中规划；基于voxblox改造建图流水线，实现多机深度测量的实时融合；集成机间避障与机器人自滤波机制，避免将其他无人机重建为静态障碍；保留RH-NBVP、KRH-NBVP、AEP、KAEP四种采样规划器的核心采样逻辑，仅做系统级适配。
AI.result: 在多种环境与两种部署配置（Joint Start 近距离初始化、Separated Start 分离初始化）下仿真评估：SS配置在所有规划器上均持续获得更快的探索速度与更高的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可有效将单机采样规划器迁移至多机探索，分离式部署策略对多无人机探索性能具有重要影响。

title: STARS: From Spatiotemporal Dynamics to Social Representations in Human-Robot Interaction
comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. First two authors contributed equally. Project site: https://larg.github.io/stars/
summary: Robot navigation in dynamic, human-centered environments requires socially-compliant decisions grounded in robust scene understanding. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising capabilities such as object recognition, common-sense reasoning, and contextual understanding, capabilities that align with the nuanced requirements of social robot navigation. However, it remains unclear whether VLMs can accurately understand complex social navigation scenes (e.g., inferring the spatial-temporal relations among agents and human intentions), which is essential for safe and socially compliant robot navigation. While some recent works have explored the use of VLMs in social robot navigation, no existing work systematically evaluates their ability to meet these necessary conditions. In this paper, we introduce the Social Navigation Scene Understanding Benchmark (SocialNav-SUB), a Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs for scene understanding in real-world social robot navigation scenarios. SocialNav-SUB provides a unified framework for evaluating VLMs against human and rule-based baselines across VQA tasks requiring spatial, spatiotemporal, and social reasoning in social robot navigation. Through experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that while the best-performing VLM achieves an encouraging probability of agreeing with human answers, it still underperforms simpler rule-based approach and human consensus baselines, indicating critical gaps in social scene understanding of current VLMs. Our benchmark sets the stage for further research on foundation models for social robot navigation, offering a framework to explore how VLMs can be tailored to meet real-world social robot navigation needs. An overview of this paper along with the code and data can be found at https://larg.github.io/socialnav-sub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SocialNav-SUB基准，用于系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在社会机器人导航场景理解中的能力，发现当前最强VLM仍不及简单规则方法和人类共识基线。
AI.motivation: 动态以人为中心环境中的机器人导航需要基于稳健场景理解的社会合规决策。VLM具备目标识别、常识推理与上下文理解等能力，契合社会机器人导航需求，但其能否准确理解复杂社会导航场景（如智能体间时空关系与人类意图）尚不明确，且现有工作缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出社会导航场景理解基准SocialNav-SUB，构建面向真实社会机器人导航场景的视觉问答（VQA）数据集与基准，提供统一评估框架，在需要空间、时空和社会推理的VQA任务上，将VLM与人类基线和规则基线进行对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，表现最佳的VLM与人类答案一致的概率虽较可观，但仍逊于更简单的规则方法和人类共识基线，说明当前VLM在社会场景理解上存在关键差距。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为社会机器人导航基础模型研究奠定基础，提供探索VLM如何适配真实社会机器人导航需求的框架；论文概览、代码与数据见 https://larg.github.io/socialnav-sub。

title: GPU-Accelerated Path-Dependent Marginal Information Gain for Autonomous Exploration
comment: Submitted for review to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Autonomous exploration demands that robots continuously evaluate candidate viewpoints based on their expected information gain and execution cost.
