Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.

AI.tldr: 论文通过构造人工同形异义词和人工上位词作为伪词，研究词汇歧义与语义欠明确对语言模型训练的影响，发现两者均以与类型-标记比相关的方式提升模型性能，但会降低含歧义词序列的生成准确性；模型内部表示对伪同形词进行了消歧，而对伪上位词保持欠明确。
AI.motivation: 探究词汇歧义（lexical ambiguity）与语义欠明确（underspecification）如何影响语言模型的训练过程，并理解模型在内部如何表征与处理歧义及消歧现象。
AI.method: 构造人工同形异义词（artificial homonyms）和人工上位词（artificial hypernyms）作为伪词（pseudowords）；以递增数量的歧义或欠明确伪词类型训练语言模型，评估其生成性能；进一步分析模型是否对歧义或欠明确语句进行消歧；并对歧义与消歧的内部表示给出初步的机制性解释。
AI.result: 1）歧义与欠明确均提升模型性能，且提升程度随其对语言类型-标记比（type-token ratio）的影响而扩展；2）但生成包含歧义词或其同义词的序列时，准确率相较其他文本下降；3）伪词的内部表示反映了伪同形词的消歧过程，而伪上位词的欠明确性在生成过程中得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 词汇歧义和欠明确并非单纯增加学习难度，而是在提升整体模型性能的同时带来局部生成代价；模型内部对同形异义词进行消歧，对欠明确的上位词则维持其语义模糊性。

title: Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?
summary: Agent harnesses often improve language models with human-designed workflows, but as models grow more capable, unreliable guidance can increasingly constrain their execution. We call the ability to benefit from useful guidance while overriding unreliable guidance thinking outside the box. We introduce Box$^2$-Bench, which holds the model and task fixed while varying workflow reliability to isolate how models regulate their reliance on guidance. On Box$^2$-Bench, frontier models often benefit from reliable guidance but remain vulnerable when it is misleading or becomes unreliable. To test whether this capability can be learned, we train two open-weight models using bad workflows, reserving good workflows for evaluation. We explore two complementary training strategies: counterfactual supervised fine-tuning improves robustness, while outcome-based reinforcement learning can shift the balance toward greater use of helpful workflows. We further find that this behavior extends beyond workflows to other forms of external information, improving peer correction and robustness to corrupted memory. Together, our results identify selective reliance on fallible external information as a dimension of agent reliability not captured by task performance alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"跳出框框思考"能力(利用可靠指引、拒绝不可靠指引)及Box²-Bench基准,发现前沿模型依赖指引时易受误导,并通过反事实SFT与结果型RL两种训练策略提升模型对指引的选择性依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有agent harness常以人工设计的工作流增强语言模型,但随着模型能力提升,不可靠的指引可能反而约束模型执行。作者认为"在采纳有用指引的同时压制不可靠指引"是一项独立能力,而任务表现本身无法衡量这种选择性依赖。
AI.method: 提出Box²-Bench,固定模型与任务、仅改变工作流可靠性,以隔离模型调节依赖指引的行为。为检验该能力可否被学习,使用"坏工作流"训练两个开放权重模型并保留"好工作流"用于评估,探索两种互补策略:反事实监督微调(SFT)与基于结果的强化学习(RL)。
AI.result: 在Box²-Bench上,前沿模型虽能从可靠指引中获益,但在指引具有误导性或变得不可靠时仍显脆弱。反事实SFT提升了鲁棒性,而结果型RL可将平衡转向更多使用有益工作流。该行为可泛化到其他外部信息形式,如同伴纠错与对受损记忆的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对可错性外部信息的选择性依赖是agent可靠性中一个独立维度,无法仅由任务表现来刻画。该能力可通过训练习得,并对多种外部信息形式具有迁移性。

title: Is This Evidence Decision-Critical? Learning to Verify Rule-Governed Decisions
summary: Rule-based reasoning, as in eligibility checks and contract reviews, requires language models to assess evidence against individual conditions and combine their judgments under explicit rules. Errors in evidence assessment can leave a decision unchanged, but misinterpreting or overlooking decision-critical evidence can reverse it. Identifying such evidence allows more capable models to focus on checking the corresponding condition judgments, supporting accurate and safe decisions. Recognizing the evidence's criticality requires understanding how evidence affects a condition judgment and how that judgment affects the decision. To achieve the goal, we propose a INTERvention-based imPACT learning framework (InterPact), which enables counterfactual verification of evidence criticality in rule-governed decisions. Specifically, its evidence intervention constructor generates training pairs for a propagation verifier by editing case facts with a frozen language model while holding rules and non-target conditions fixed. Human-reviewed labels record the resulting condition and decision changes, while complete state-to-decision mappings supervise consequences beyond the observed edit. During training, the verifier weights learned conditional decision predictions by evidence-based condition probabilities through a fixed composition operation, propagating decision-change supervision into the base model. At inference, the trained base model directly judges criticality from the original case and target evidence, without human or stronger-model supervision. On single-case evidence criticality verification over adapted rule-governed decision cases, InterPact achieves 68.28% accuracy, outperforming all six baselines. These results support learned decision sensitivity as a basis for prioritizing evidence checks.

AI.tldr: 提出InterPact框架，通过反事实干预验证规则决策中证据的关键性，在单案例证据关键性验证任务上达到68.28%准确率，优于全部六个基线。
AI.motivation: 规则推理（如资格审核、合同审查）要求模型针对各条件评估证据并在显式规则下组合判断。证据评估错误可能不改变决策，但误判或忽略决策关键证据会导致决策反转。识别此类关键证据可使更强的模型聚焦于相应条件判断的核查，从而支撑准确、安全的决策。识别证据关键性需要理解证据如何影响条件判断，以及该判断如何影响决策。
AI.method: 提出基于干预的影响学习框架InterPact，实现规则约束决策中证据关键性的反事实验证。其证据干预构造器利用冻结语言模型编辑案件事实，同时固定规则与非目标条件，生成传播验证器的训练对；人工审核标签记录由此产生的条件与决策变化，完整的状态到决策映射为观测编辑之外的后果提供监督。训练时，验证器通过固定的组合操作，用基于证据的条件概率对学到的条件性决策预测加权，将决策变化监督传播至基座模型。推理时，训练后的基座模型直接依据原始案例与目标证据判断关键性，无需人工或更强模型监督。
AI.result: 在改编的规则约束决策案例上进行单案例证据关键性验证，InterPact达到68.28%的准确率，超过全部六个基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将学习到的决策敏感性作为优先安排证据核查的依据。

title: Marginal Response Surface Elicitation for Zero-Label Tabular Learning
summary: Tabular learning uses structured data to predict target outcomes. Traditionally, this process has relied on labeled data. However, large language models (LLMs) can be used to elicit domain priors based on the task description and feature semantics, thereby enabling predictions without labeled data. We propose Marginal Response Surface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms feature-level LLM priors into a reusable, zero-shot tabular classifier. To construct this classifier, MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and prompts the LLM to provide corresponding class support scores and feature weights. It then aggregates multiple responses using the median to construct feature response functions, and makes predictions through their weighted sum without further LLM queries. Across eight tabular benchmark tasks, MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP, outperforming direct prompting by 1.97 and 6.21 percentage points respectively, while substantially reducing end-to-end costs. Evaluations with LLMs of different sizes further demonstrate its predictive advantage over direct prompting.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS方法，将特征级LLM先验转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在8个表格基准任务上取得最高平均AUC与AP，并显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 传统表格学习依赖标注数据。虽然LLM可基于任务描述与特征语义引出领域先验从而支持无标注预测，但现有做法（如直接提示）预测性能有限且端到端开销较高，需要一种更高效、可复用的零样本表格分类方案。
AI.method: MARS（Marginal Response Surface Elicitation）从未标注数据中为每个特征选取代表值，提示LLM给出对应的类别支持分数与特征权重；对多次响应取中位数以构建特征响应函数，再通过其加权和进行预测，无需进一步LLM查询。
AI.result: 在8个表格基准任务上，MARS取得最高平均AUC与AP，较直接提示分别提升1.97与6.21个百分点，同时大幅降低端到端成本；使用不同规模LLM的评估进一步验证了其相对直接提示的预测优势。
AI.conclusion: MARS能够将LLM特征级先验有效转化为可复用的零样本表格分类器，在预测性能与成本效率上均优于直接提示，且在不同规模LLM下保持稳健优势。

title: Zero-Compute Cross-Lingual Transferability Estimation Using Typological Feature Proxies
comment: 4 pages, NeurIPS workshop, Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models, lp4fm
summary: Cross-lingual transfer describes how knowledge in a source language benefits a target language. Measuring it quantitatively requires broad multilingual pre-training, as prior work has done with cross-lingual transfer matrices. We ask whether transfer is predictable from freely available typological features, and whether the prominence of high-resource source languages reflects typology or data quality and quantity. We show that typological databases contain cheap and dense signals about cross-lingual transfer. Our typology-only random forest on a 24-language prior-work transfer matrix scores leave-one-language-out $ρ{=}0.705$ and $R^2{=}0.49$, beating a non-typological control at $ρ{=}0.62$, which verifies the ability of typology-only predictions to reconstruct costly measured cross-lingual transfer. The signal survives leave-one-script-out and leave-one-family-out protocols, so script and family confounding do not explain the effect. By decomposing the transfer into a typology term and a resource-and-script bias term, we find the best-source ranking sensitive to this bias. In contrast, typology is not affected by this bias, which makes it a zero-compute screening tool that replaces hundreds of training runs with a model fit. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/dharmsen/typo-x-ling-transfer}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨语言迁移是否可由类型学特征预测，发现仅用类型学特征的随机森林即可较好重建迁移矩阵，且类型学信号不受资源与文字偏置影响，可作为零算力筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移的传统度量依赖大规模多语言预训练和昂贵的迁移矩阵测量。作者希望探究：迁移是否可由免费可得的类型学特征预测；高资源源语言的突出地位究竟反映类型学还是数据质量与数量。动机在于用低成本信号替代高成本测量。
AI.method: 在24语言的已有迁移矩阵上，使用仅含类型学特征的随机森林进行预测，并与非类型学对照组比较；采用留一语言、留一文字系统、留一语系等协议检验稳健性；将迁移分解为类型学项与资源-文字偏置项，分析最佳源语言排序。
AI.result: 类型学随机森林在留一语言协议下达到ρ=0.705、R²=0.49，优于非类型学对照组的ρ=0.62；信号在留一文字和留一语系协议下依然存在，说明效果不由文字或语系混杂解释；最佳源排序对资源-文字偏置敏感，而类型学不受该偏置影响。
AI.conclusion: 类型学数据库包含关于跨语言迁移的廉价且密集的信号，仅用类型学即可重建昂贵的实测迁移。类型学不受资源-文字偏置影响，可作为零算力筛选工具，用一次模型拟合替代数百次训练运行。

title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL.

AI.tldr: SEPAL通过三条私有Actor-Critic团队(直接推理、证据支撑、验证)实现角色专化训练与团队内闭环修订,仅在最终答案层面做多数投票,从而在保持推理多样性同时提升问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作虽能通过审议与反馈提升LLM问答能力,但共享讨论会把纠错与错误暴露耦合在一起,侵蚀投票所需的多样性;自一致性缺乏反馈,单一Actor-Critic对也只能精炼一个候选答案。因此需要在保留多样性的同时引入有效反馈修正。
AI.method: SEPAL设置三个私有的Actor-Critic团队,分别负责直接推理、证据支撑与验证。采用角色特定训练赋予各团队超越采样差异的不同推理目标;每个Critic仅在本团队内引导修订,防止错误跨候选传播;修订结束后只对最终答案进行多数投票,推理过程在决策前保持隔离。在五个开源权重骨干和五个问答基准上评估。
AI.result: 相比匹配的单一Actor-Critic对,SEPAL平均准确率提升1.81个百分点,且在全部五个骨干模型上均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过私有化团队修订与仅答案级投票,SEPAL在维持候选多样性的同时有效利用反馈纠错,验证了角色专化多团队协作在LLM问答中的优势。

title: The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends
summary:
Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces but increasingly control overlapping memory functions. Second, heterogeneous architectures increasingly coordinate across network depth: layer-wise composition distributes complementary memory processing across representational stages, while cross-layer reuse carries selected memory and routing artifacts forward. Depth thus becomes a dimension along which contextual memory is constructed and managed. Third, these developments motivate a stateful multidimensional memory-routing hypothesis: persistent memory is organized across temporal scope, network depth, substrate type, and representation granularity, while coordinated Sparse Write and Sparse Read determine what is maintained and what contributes to each query. Overall, efficient sequence architecture design increasingly concerns the organization, lifecycle, and selective use of contextual memory rather than an isolated Attention operator.

AI.tldr: 该综述将高效序列架构的各类进展统一重构为"模型内部上下文记忆"问题，提出五维分析视角，并基于59条发布级记录与11个开放权重端点，归纳出深度维度上的记忆组织与"有状态多维记忆路由"假说。
AI.motivation: 自注意力虽提供细粒度、查询依赖的上下文访问，但密集token交互带来二次预填充开销与随上下文增长的KV缓存，由此催生了显式记忆压缩、稀疏访问、循环状态构建、结构化状态动力学及异构机制组合等多条研究路线。然而这些研究线索术语与计算模型各异、彼此交叠，缺少统一框架进行比较与整合，因此本文以"模型内部上下文记忆"为统合视角加以重述。
AI.method: 提出五维分析视角：记忆表示（表征什么）、记忆更新（如何变化）、访问（什么是查询可及的）、读出（如何被读取）、集成（读出如何形成输出）。该视角用于横向比较相互重叠的研究路线，而不强加单一计算模型。在实证层面，重建机制级发展与架构采用情况，使用来自14个主要模型谱系的59条发布级记录以及11个高性能开放权重端点作为证据基础。
AI.result: 三点发现：其一，显式记忆方法与循环状态方法保持不同的接口，但在记忆功能控制上日益重叠；其二，异构架构越来越多地跨网络深度进行协同——层级组合将互补的记忆处理分配到不同表征阶段，跨层复用则将选定的记忆与路由产物向前传递，深度由此成为构建与管理上下文记忆的一个维度；其三，上述发展支持"有状态多维记忆路由"假说。
AI.conclusion: 高效序列架构设计日益聚焦于上下文记忆的组织、生命周期与选择性使用，而非孤立的Attention算子。所提出的假说认为，持久记忆按时间跨度、网络深度、基底类型与表示粒度进行组织，而协同的稀疏写入与稀疏读取共同决定哪些信息被维持、哪些信息对每个查询产生贡献。

title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their pool covers more such positions than the unperturbed privileged teacher. We introduce Neighborhood OPSD (N-OPSD) to turn these corrections into supervision at student-visited states. Offline, greedy selection builds a compact pool of frozen experts by rewarding filtered reference-token gains beyond the pool's current best at each position. The highest-peak expert need not provide the best training target. Online routing therefore separates the anchor direction from its level of support. MaxPeak selects the anchor token, and quantile selection chooses among experts whose top token matches it. The student learns from the chosen expert's full next-token distribution through the clipped forward-KL objective inherited from OPSD. We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Across three independent runs per method, Neighborhood OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively. Student-prefix continuations support using the pool beyond the reference trajectories used for selection. Matched ablations support filtered reference-token gains as a selection criterion. Accounting for overlap within the pool and routing by state further improve student accuracy. Inference uses only the distilled student.

AI.tldr: 提出 Neighborhood OPSD（N-OPSD）：利用局部参数扰动构造多个冻结专家池，在离线贪心选择与在线路由下为数学推理学生模型提供更丰富的参考对齐监督；在 AIME/HMMT 上较 OPSD 平均提升 2.75/1.67/1.94 分（Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B）。
AI.motivation: 标准 on-policy self-distillation（OPSD）在每个状态仅使用一个固定参数设定的特权教师，监督信号单一；作者发现邻近参数扰动可在同一参考解上下文中揭示互补的、参考对齐的修正，且不同专家在不同参考位置提供修正，其并集覆盖的可用位置多于未扰动的特权教师。
AI.method: N-OPSD 将该类修正转化为学生访问状态上的监督。离线阶段：以“过滤后的参考 token 增益”（超越池内当前最优）为奖励，贪心选择构建紧凑的冻结专家池。在线阶段：将锚方向与其支持度分离——MaxPeak 选择锚 token，分位数选择在 top token 与锚一致的专家中挑选；学生通过继承自 OPSD 的 clipped forward-KL 目标，学习所选专家的完整下一 token 分布。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT February 2025 上，每种方法三次独立运行：N-OPSD 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 上分别将三基准 Average@12 较 OPSD 提升 2.75、1.67、1.94 分。学生前缀续写结果支持将专家池用于参考轨迹之外的状态；匹配消融支持以过滤参考 token 增益作为选择准则；考虑池内重叠并按状态路由进一步提升学生准确率。
AI.conclusion: 局部参数邻域可提供互补的参考对齐监督，N-OPSD 通过离线专家池构建与在线锚/支持度分离路由有效利用这些信号，稳定提升数学推理性能；推理阶段仅需蒸馏后的学生模型，不增加额外开销。

title: Drift Inspector: Exploring and Measuring Scientific Drift with Atomic Contribution Claims
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations. 11 pages. Live demo, code and data: https://hamyrappy.github.io/drift-inspector
summary: Scientific abstracts mix contributions with background, motivation, and meta-language, so tools that read them as-is cannot separate what a field produces from what it discusses. We present Drift Inspector, an open-source system for measuring and exploring how a research field changes over time at the level of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs): decontextualized, contribution-bearing propositions an LLM extracts from each abstract before analysis. The system clusters these claims across years into an interactive map where every trend traces back to the claims and papers behind it. Applied to six years of EMNLP, it shows the field shifting away from classic NLP tasks toward LLM-era capabilities such as reasoning and multimodality -- a movement that keyword or whole-abstract counts blur. The released data extend beyond EMNLP: the same pipeline has processed the full ACL Anthology (346k claims, 80k abstracts, 423 venues). Extraction is human-validated and clustering checked against an external manually constructed taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Drift Inspector，一个开源系统，通过大语言模型从摘要中抽取"原子贡献主张"（ACC），并对这些主张按年份聚类，构建可交互的研究领域演化地图，从而将论文的贡献与背景、动机等元语言分离，度量领域随时间的变迁。
AI.motivation: 科学摘要混杂了背景、动机与元语言，直接按原文读取的工具无法区分"领域真正产出了什么"与"领域在讨论什么"，因此需要一种能在主张层面度量领域演化的方法。
AI.method: 定义原子贡献主张（ACC）为去语境化、承载贡献的命题；用 LLM 在分析前从每篇摘要中抽取 ACC；再将这些主张跨年份聚类，生成可交互地图，使每条趋势都可追溯到其背后的具体主张与论文。
AI.result: 在 EMNLP 六年数据上，系统显示该领域正从经典 NLP 任务转向推理、多模态等 LLM 时代能力，而这种迁移在关键词或整篇摘要计数下会被模糊化；同时同一流程已处理完整 ACL Anthology（346k 条主张、80k 篇摘要、423 个会议/期刊），且抽取结果经人工验证，聚类结果与外部人工构建的分类体系进行了对照检验。
AI.conclusion: Drift Inspector 提供了在贡献主张层面度量并探索研究领域演化的开源方案，能够揭示被传统关键词或全文计数掩盖的趋势，并具备可追溯到原始论文的可解释性；其数据集与方法可扩展至更大规模的文献集合。

title: LatentHarness: Learning Latent Actions for Memory and Reasoning via Counterfactual Policy Distillation
summary: Long-context reasoning faces two complementary bottlenecks: retaining evidence across long inputs and sustaining computation across many reasoning steps. Existing approaches largely address them separately, with external memory extending access to distant evidence and latent reasoning compressing multi-step computation. We introduce LatentHarness, which unifies memory access and latent reasoning as sequential latent action selection. At each internal step, the model chooses THINK for further computation, RECALL from a fast-weight memory of input evidence and intermediate reasoning states, or EXIT to emit the next token. We train this policy with counterfactual policy distillation, which branches every action for one step and scores its effect on the emitted token. These gains teach the policy when memory is more useful than further reasoning, while gradients through counterfactual recall teach which intermediate states should be retained in memory for future use. Across six general and long-context reasoning benchmarks, LatentHarness at 1.4B improves on the strongest baselines by 2.8% and 10.0% relative, respectively, and runs 5.9x faster than the strongest long-context baseline.

AI.tldr: LatentHarness 将外部记忆访问与潜在推理统一为序列化的潜在动作选择（THINK/RECALL/EXIT），并用反事实策略蒸馏训练该策略，在长上下文推理任务上以 1.4B 规模取得性能和速度双重提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理存在两个互补瓶颈：一是需要在长输入中保留证据，二是需要在多步推理中维持计算。现有方法大多分别处理这两个问题——外部记忆扩展对远距离证据的访问，潜在推理压缩多步计算——缺乏统一协调。
AI.method: 提出 LatentHarness，把记忆访问与潜在推理统一为序列化的潜在动作选择：每个内部步骤模型在 THINK（继续计算）、RECALL（从输入证据与中间推理状态的 fast-weight 记忆中读取）、EXIT（输出下一 token）之间选择。采用反事实策略蒸馏训练该策略：对每个动作分支出一步并评估其对输出 token 的影响，从而学习何时记忆比继续推理更有用，并通过反事实召回的反向梯度学习哪些中间状态应被保留在记忆中。
AI.result: 在六个通用与长上下文推理基准上，1.4B 规模的 LatentHarness 相比最强基线分别相对提升 2.8% 与 10.0%，且比最强长上下文基线快 5.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆访问与潜在推理统一为潜在动作选择是有效方向，反事实策略蒸馏可同时优化“何时记忆”与“保留什么记忆”，在性能与效率上均优于分别处理两类瓶颈的现有方法。

title: MemCodex: Self-Programming Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents
summary: Agent memory faces heterogeneous access needs: a single-hop question may require one piece of evidence, whereas a multi-hop question must combine evidence from multiple sources. Predefined memory workflows cannot adapt to these varying needs. Recent adaptive methods search or learn over memory components and their compositions, but the design space itself remains predefined. We introduce MemCodex, a self-evolving hierarchical memory system that organizes experience into executable memory programs for summaries, relational knowledge, reusable skills, and latent memory. Open-ended program evolution searches the open design space of layer programs by rewriting how each layer is constructed, indexed, retrieved, and routed, thereby adapting both within-layer implementations and cross-layer composition. At query time, reads traverse the hierarchy from coarse to fine and stop once sufficient evidence is found, descending to the original history when needed. We further develop MemArena, a unified runtime that places heterogeneous data and memory systems behind a common interface. MemCodex improves average task success by 10.1% relative to the strongest adaptive-memory baseline, while using 3.4x fewer context tokens and achieving 2.1x faster inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自演化分层记忆系统MemCodex，将经验组织为可执行记忆程序，通过开放式程序演化搜索层程序的开放设计空间，并配套统一运行时MemArena。相比最强自适应记忆基线，任务成功率平均提升10.1%，上下文token减少3.4倍，推理速度提升2.1倍。
AI.motivation: Agent记忆面临异构访问需求：单跳问题可能只需一条证据，多跳问题则须组合多源证据。预定义记忆工作流无法适应这些变化的需求。现有自适应方法虽能在记忆组件及其组合上搜索或学习，但设计空间本身仍是预先定义的，缺乏对记忆构建方式的开放式探索。
AI.method: 提出MemCodex自演化分层记忆系统：将经验组织为可执行记忆程序，涵盖摘要、关系知识、可复用技能与潜在记忆。通过开放式程序演化，重写各层的构建、索引、检索与路由方式，从而在层内实现与跨层组合上同时自适应。查询时读取沿层次由粗到细遍历，一旦找到足够证据即停止，必要时下沉至原始历史。并开发MemArena统一运行时，将异构数据与记忆系统置于统一接口之后。
AI.result: 相较最强自适应记忆基线，MemCodex平均任务成功率提升10.1%，同时使用少3.4倍的上下文token，推理速度提升2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 开放式的层次记忆程序演化，配合由粗到细的自适应读取策略，能有效应对Agent记忆的异构访问需求，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低上下文开销并加速推理。MemArena为该类异构记忆系统的统一评测与集成提供了基础。

title: Explore-on-Graph: Hybrid Embedding-LLM Reasoning for Knowledge Graph Question Answering under Incompleteness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly combined with knowledge graphs (KGs) to ground reasoning in structured evidence. However, most LLM-based KGQA methods rely on traversing existing graph edges and become unreliable when reasoning paths are broken by missing facts. Alternatives that ask LLMs to generate missing knowledge risk introducing hallucinated evidence. We introduce XoG (eXplore-on-Graph), a framework for multi-hop question answering over incomplete KGs that recovers missing reasoning paths from learned graph structure rather than LLM parametric knowledge. XoG combines type-level entity-relation statistics to identify candidate relations with KG embeddings to retrieve plausible missing entities, using the LLM as a semantic selector and reasoner. These mechanisms are integrated into an iterative planning-exploration-reasoning process. Experiments on WebQSP, CWQ, and the Wikidata-based BRINK benchmark show that XoG remains competitive on complete KGs and consistently outperforms comparable methods without task-specific KGQA training under KG incompleteness. These gains persist across multiple LLM backbones, indicating that stronger LLMs alone do not resolve missing graph evidence. XoG also reduces LLM token consumption by up to 33% compared with a closely related planning-based approach.

AI.tldr: XoG 是一个面向不完整知识图谱的多跳问答框架，通过结合类型级实体-关系统计与 KG 嵌入来恢复缺失推理路径，而非依赖 LLM 参数化知识，在完整 KG 上保持竞争力并在 KG 不完整时稳定优于同类方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 KGQA 方法多依赖遍历已有图边，当推理路径因缺失事实而断裂时表现不可靠；而让 LLM 直接生成缺失知识又会引入幻觉证据。因此需要一种能从学习到的图结构中恢复缺失推理路径、而非依赖 LLM 参数化知识的方案。
AI.method: 提出 XoG（eXplore-on-Graph）框架：结合类型级实体-关系统计以识别候选关系，并利用 KG 嵌入检索合理的缺失实体，将 LLM 作为语义选择器与推理器；这些机制被整合进迭代式的“规划-探索-推理”流程中。
AI.result: 在 WebQSP、CWQ 及基于 Wikidata 的 BRINK 基准上的实验表明：XoG 在完整 KG 上保持竞争力，在 KG 不完整情形下持续优于未进行任务特定 KGQA 训练的同类方法；该优势在多种 LLM 骨干上均成立，说明仅靠更强的 LLM 无法解决图证据缺失问题；相比相近的规划类方法，XoG 还将 LLM token 消耗最多降低 33%。
AI.conclusion: 恢复缺失推理路径应依托学习到的图结构而非 LLM 参数化知识，这一思路在 KG 不完整条件下更具鲁棒性；同时更强的 LLM 本身并不能弥补图证据缺失，而 XoG 在效果与 token 效率上均具优势。

title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations
summary: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona's beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究谎言检测探针在LLM扮演反事实人格（如阴谋论者）时能否可靠识别虚假陈述。作者构建了8,916条人工复核的on-policy响应数据集，测试8个既有探针，发现多数在人格提示下失效，其原因是探针实际追踪了训练数据中与真实性虚假相关的混淆概念（如指令遵从、响应似然）。作者据此提出一个简单线性探针，在人格与混淆压力测试中均取得最佳整体表现。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演使LLM的"真实"含义变得模糊：模型可采纳与事实相悖的人格信念。既有谎言检测探针假设真实性有统一内部表征，但在反事实人格下其可靠性存疑，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 构建包含8,916条人工复核、来自3个LLM的on-policy响应数据集（反事实人格设定）；评估8个既有探针，并设计三个人为构造的混淆数据集，使真实性与潜在混淆概念呈反相关，以诊断探针实际追踪的概念；据此提出一个简单线性探针。
AI.result: 许多既有探针在反事实人格下失效，尤其在同一人格提示下同时评估正确与错误答案时；实验表明这些探针强烈追踪与真实性在训练数据中虚假相关的概念，如指令遵从与响应似然；所提简单线性探针在人格与混淆两类压力测试上均取得最强整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前谎言检测探针远不可靠，其在反事实人格下追踪的是混淆概念而非真实性；亟需构建真实性与混淆概念去相关的训练数据。

title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior
summary: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math). We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens. Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale. However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical prior. Downstream performance does not consistently align with grammatical acceptability across model sizes. Instead, we find that downstream gains arise from PPT tasks that improve long-range retrieval. Finally, PPT performance gains are robust to how PT data mixtures are composed and diminish only when web text is absent. Overall, PPT is a low-cost addition to PT, and future PPT task design should target long-range retrieval rather than natural language grammar.

AI.tldr: 本文在大规模设置下系统研究预预训练（PPT），发现其在500M–7B参数、最高100B token预算下仍能提升下游性能与token效率，但增益并非源于语法先验，而是来自改善长程检索的PPT任务。
AI.motivation: 既有工作认为PPT（在合成非自然语言数据上的预预训练）的收益来自"语法先验"这一结构化归纳偏置。然而此前PPT仅在≤1B参数模型、≤2B token预算且以网页文本为主的设置下验证，无法确认其在大规模模型和包含代码、数学等多样来源的真实PT数据混合下是否仍有效。
AI.method: 开展一项综合性PPT研究，覆盖5种PPT任务、4种PT数据混合、4个参数规模（500M至7B）以及最高100B token的PT预算，对比PPT对下游性能与token效率的影响，并检验增益与语法可接受性、长程检索能力之间的关系。
AI.result: PPT的下游性能与token效率增益在规模上得以保持，例如在3B规模下至少节省21B PT token。但与先前工作相反，未发现一致证据表明增益源自语法先验：下游性能与语法可接受性在不同模型规模下并不一致对齐。增益实际上来自能改善长程检索的PPT任务。此外，PPT增益对PT数据混合的组成方式具有鲁棒性，仅当缺少网页文本时才减弱。
AI.conclusion: PPT是预训练的一种低成本补充手段；未来PPT任务设计应面向长程检索而非自然语言语法。

title: When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models
summary: We investigate the problem of role-capability leakage (RCL), in which a role-prompted reasoning model generates convincing in-role text while continuing to exhibit capabilities on benchmarks that exceed those implied by the assigned role. For example, when a model is prompted to assume the role of a kindergarten student, one might expect its performance on a mathematics benchmark to reflect kindergarten-level ability rather than expert-level proficiency in solving calculus problems. We introduce RoleCapBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating RCL across six educational roles and four assessment levels spanning elementary school through A-level, and use it to evaluate three open-weight reasoning models. We find that although the models can generate stylistically convincing in-role responses, they consistently fail to align their underlying capabilities with their assigned roles. Naive role prompting yields strong role-voice scores of 1.218--1.389 while retaining above-role accuracy of 0.811--0.898. RCL persists across a range of prompting conditions, including prompts that explicitly instruct the model to match the role's capability level. To mitigate this problem, we propose Injection, an inference-time intervention that combines explicit, role-specific capability guidelines with a guiding prefilled response prefix. Injection improves role-capability alignment across models, reducing above-role accuracy by up to 0.562 while preserving in-role accuracy with a marginal drop of less than 0.058 across most models. All artifacts, including scripts and evaluation data, will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并研究"角色-能力泄漏"(RCL)问题，构建RoleCapBench基准，发现推理模型在角色扮演时风格逼真但能力超出角色设定，并提出推理时干预方法Injection以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 角色提示的推理模型在生成符合角色语气的文本时，其实际能力仍可能远超角色所暗示的水平（如扮演幼儿园学生却能解微积分）。这种"角色-能力泄漏"现象会影响角色扮演的可信度与安全性，但此前缺乏系统评估与研究。
AI.method: 提出RoleCapBench基准，涵盖六种教育角色与四个评估等级（小学至A-level）；据此评估三个开放权重推理模型；并提出推理时干预方法Injection，将角色特定的能力指南与引导性预填充回复前缀相结合。
AI.result: 朴素角色提示下，模型取得较强的角色语气分数(1.218–1.389)，但仍保持超角色准确率(0.811–0.898)；即便明确指示模型匹配角色能力水平，RCL依然存在。Injection可将超角色准确率最多降低0.562，同时在多数模型上仅使角色内准确率下降不到0.058。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型难以将底层能力与所扮演角色对齐，RCL是普遍存在的问题；所提Injection方法能在保持角色内表现的同时有效缓解该问题，相关脚本与评估数据将在录用后公开。

title: Cognitive Enhancement: Rethinking the Necessity of Role-Playing for Large Language Models
summary: Role-playing prompting has become a popular yet simple technique for improving LLM reasoning and output quality. However, whether it consistently boosts performance across diverse domains remains unclear, as systematic validation is lacking. To fill this gap, we run multi-model, cross-domain, and multilingual experiments on MMLU and MMLU-Redux. We find that gains from role-play prompting depend heavily on model capacity, knowledge domain, and prompt language. Drawing on metacognition theory, we propose the persona-related cognitive alignment hypothesis: role-play works only when the LLM correctly grasps the designated persona and its associated knowledge domain. We test this hypothesis through persona information richness ablation, layer-wise entropy divergence analysis, and latent thought-space deflection observation. To reduce persona cognitive bias and stabilize role-play performance, we propose \textbf{M}ixed-\textbf{L}anguage \textbf{C}oncatenate \textbf{P}rediction \textbf{(MLCP}), a simple, training-free, and efficient multilingual prompt concatenation strategy. It aggregates semantically equivalent role prompts to enrich complementary representational cues. Extensive experiments show that MLCP consistently outperforms vanilla role-play prompting across all tested LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统验证角色扮演提示在不同领域、模型和多语言下的效果差异，提出"人格相关认知对齐假说"解释其生效机制，并提出无需训练的混合语言拼接预测（MLCP）策略以稳定并提升角色扮演性能。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演提示被广泛用于提升大语言模型推理与输出质量，但其跨领域、跨模型、跨语言的一致有效性缺乏系统验证。作者希望填补这一空白，并解释角色扮演何时有效、为何有效。
AI.method: 在MMLU与MMLU-Redux上进行多模型、跨领域、多语言实验；基于元认知理论提出人格相关认知对齐假说，并通过人格信息丰富度消融、逐层熵散度分析、潜在思维空间偏移观测进行验证；提出混合语言拼接预测（MLCP）——一种免训练、高效的多语言提示拼接策略，聚合语义等价的角色提示以丰富表征线索。
AI.result: 角色扮演提示的收益高度依赖模型能力、知识领域与提示语言；消融与表征分析支持认知对齐假说；MLCP在所有测试的大语言模型上均稳定优于原始角色扮演提示。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演并非普适增益技术，其效果取决于模型对人格及其知识领域的正确把握；通过多语言提示拼接可缓解人格认知偏差并稳定提升性能。

title: LLM Persona Unlearning
summary: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit that makes a designated persona difficult to elicit and enact on unseen contexts. We introduce PersonaUnlearnBench, a model-specific paired benchmark spanning six LLMs from three families and five personas, with aligned forget/retain sets, held-out instruction paraphrases, and four-axis evaluation. The benchmark shows that standard unlearning methods cannot reliably erase the target persona without sacrificing meaningful generation or general utility. We therefore propose PaCE, which compares target and desirable responses to the same questions to locate an internal behavior direction, then trains target-prompt states away from the target mode and toward the matched desirable response. Experiments show that PaCE consistently suppresses target personas with high response quality and useful counterpart behavior, at moderate utility cost. These results establish persona unlearning as a distinct behavior-level editing problem and a practical route toward persistent control of latent LLM response policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人格遗忘"(persona unlearning)任务，并构建PersonaUnlearnBench基准与PaCE方法，在权重层面抑制指定人格。
AI.motivation: 预训练赋予大模型多种角色、风格、价值观等人格行为模式，后训练虽使"有用助手"成为默认模式，但并未从权重中抹去其他模式，显式提示仍可诱发特定人格。在开放权重场景下运行时控制可被移除，因此需要权重级编辑，使指定人格难以被诱发与执行。
AI.method: 提出PersonaUnlearnBench：覆盖3个系列、6个LLM、5种人格的模型专属配对基准，含对齐的遗忘/保留集、留出指令改写及四维评估。并进一步提出PaCE方法：通过对比同一问题的目标回应与期望回应，定位内部行为方向，再将目标提示状态从目标模式推离、拉向匹配的期望回应。
AI.result: 基准显示标准遗忘方法无法在不损害生成质量与通用效用的前提下可靠抹除目标人格；PaCE则能一致地抑制目标人格，同时保持较高回应质量与有用的对应行为，通用效用仅受中等程度损失。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立人格遗忘为一种独特的行为级编辑问题，并为持久控制LLM潜在回应策略提供了一条实用路径。

title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation
summary: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD.

AI.tldr: 提出 OPSRD：以固定专家角色作为特权教学上下文，在同一基座模型上进行在策略自蒸馏，无需参考解，仅用角色条件分布监督学生轨迹，配合前向KL、裁剪与高熵位置筛选，在三个竞赛数学基准上提升 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 的表现。
AI.motivation: 角色提示虽能以专家身份引导大模型推理，但对完整角色提示答案做评估或蒸馏，会在采样解错误时丢失有用的下一 token 偏好；且迁移这些偏好需要一种能覆盖学生极少预测到的替代选项的目标函数。现有方法难以充分利用这类细粒度偏好信号。
AI.method: OPSRD 使用固定专家角色作为特权教学上下文，进行无需参考解的在策略自蒸馏。学生（无角色）生成轨迹，由同一基座模型的冻结实例在其精确前缀上给出角色条件分布，从而暴露采样续写之外的替代选项。采用教师加权的前向 KL 作为目标，聚焦学生低估的替代项，并加裁剪以限制单个词表项的贡献；监督仅限学生位置中熵最高的一半，把学习集中在预测不确定处。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 三个规模、三个竞赛数学基准上，方法相较推理时不加角色提示的基座模型均有提升；在评估的三种散度中，前向 KL 在每个规模上都取得最高的宏平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将角色提示转化为特权教学上下文做在策略自蒸馏，是一种轻量且有效的推理能力提升途径；前向 KL 结合裁剪与高熵位置监督是迁移角色偏好的有效目标设计。代码已开源。

title: The Concrete-Arbitrary Gap: Kinship Reasoning in LLMs Is Not Indifferent to Presentation
summary: We test whether large language models solve formally matched kinship problems equally well when relations are expressed in familiar vocabulary or by explicitly defined nonce predicates. Across 500 paired graphs, concrete accuracy exceeds arbitrary accuracy by 35.6 percentage points in local Qwen3.8-27B, 26.6 in Gemma 4 26B-A4B, 12.0 in Gemma 4 31B, and 5.4 in Qwen3.8-Max. All four paired gaps are statistically resolved. Reasoning budgets and prompt-language interventions can substantially reduce the difference, showing that it is modifiable rather than a fixed incapacity. The minimal conclusion is behavioral: on these tasks, the models' manifested relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. Explicit definitions provide the formal relations but do not make nonce predicates as usable as familiar vocabulary embedded in learned linguistic associations.

AI.tldr: 研究以500组配对亲属关系图比较"熟悉词汇"与"显式定义生造谓词"两种表述，发现四个模型的具体表述准确率均显著高于任意表述，差距5.4–35.6个百分点，但可通过推理预算与提示语言干预显著缩小，说明该差距是可调节的行为现象而非固有能力缺失。
AI.motivation: 检验大语言模型的关系统推理能力是否真正抽象、独立于表述形式：若模型掌握的是形式化的关系推理，则在逻辑上等价、仅词汇熟悉度不同的两种表述下应表现相当；反之，则说明其表现出的关系能力依赖语言表征。
AI.method: 构建500组"形式匹配"的亲属关系配对图，一组用熟悉词汇表述，另一组用显式定义的生造谓词表述，在四个模型（Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma 4 26B-A4B、Gemma 4 31B、Qwen3.8-Max）上比较准确率，并施加推理预算与提示语言两类干预，对配对差距做统计检验。
AI.result: 具体表述准确率分别高出35.6、26.6、12.0、5.4个百分点，四个配对差距均具统计显著性；推理预算与提示语言干预可大幅缩小差距，表明差距可改变。
AI.conclusion: 最小结论是行为层面的：在这些任务上，模型展现的关系能力并非对表述方式漠不关心；显式定义虽给出了形式关系，却不足以使生造谓词像嵌入语言学习关联中的熟悉词汇那样可用。

title: AdaGEPA: Adaptive Feedback Allocation for Reflective Prompt Optimization
summary: Prompt optimization improves the performance of language-model systems on downstream tasks by refining their prompts. Classical methods evaluate prompts on task examples and use the resulting feedback to guide prompt revisions through reflection. However, when feedback selection does not account for the prompt's weaknesses, these revisions may improve performance on selected examples without yielding broader task improvements. To address this issue, we propose AdaGEPA, an adaptive feedback-allocation method that uses the prompt's performance and task structure to select examples for the next prompt revision. Our method replaces at most one example in each feedback minibatch to target an identified weakness while preserving the remaining feedback context. Across our main experiments on six downstream benchmarks, AdaGEPA achieves higher mean validation scores than non-adaptive feedback selection under matched rollout budgets. AdaGEPA also finds high-performing prompts earlier across several tasks. In the initial Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) study, its half-budget prompts outperform the non-adaptive baseline's full-budget prompts in joint goal accuracy on new dialogues from services seen and unseen during search. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of adaptive feedback allocation to improve both the effectiveness and rollout-budget efficiency of reflective prompt optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaGEPA，一种基于提示性能与任务结构自适应分配反馈样例的方法，通过每批最多替换一个样本来针对弱点改进提示，在多任务上提升效果与预算效率。
AI.motivation: 经典反思式提示优化在评估提示时使用任务样例反馈指导修改，但若反馈选择不考虑提示的弱点，修改可能只提升被选样例的表现，而无法带来更广泛的任务改进。
AI.method: AdaGEPA利用提示当前性能与任务结构来选择下一轮提示修改所需的样例；在每次反馈小批次中最多替换一个样例，以针对已识别的弱点，同时保留其余反馈上下文。
AI.result: 在六个下游基准的主要实验中，相同rollout预算下AdaGEPA平均验证分数高于非自适应反馈选择；在多个任务上更早找到高性能提示；在Schema-Guided Dialogue(SGD)研究中，其半预算提示在新对话上的joint goal accuracy超过非自适应基线的全预算提示，涵盖搜索中见过和未见过的服务。
AI.conclusion: 自适应反馈分配有望同时提升反思式提示优化的有效性与rollout预算效率。

title: UBTree: Parallel Tree Drafting via Unigram and Bigram Models for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. Recent parallel drafters have achieved breakthrough performance in frontier production models, but their effectiveness deteriorates as the entropy of target distributions increases due to insufficient draft diversity. To overcome this bottleneck without sacrificing parallelism, we introduce UBTree, a parallel drafter that couples a Unigram proposer with a Bigram selector to construct drafting Trees. The unigram proposer is trained with the standard cross-entropy objective to generate candidate tokens independently for each position, while a lightweight bigram selector predicts transition scores between adjacent candidate pairs. Unlike the proposer, the selector is trained with a renormalized KL objective on high-temperature data. This tree-native training broadens the supervision beyond the greedy path, encouraging plausible alternative branches that improve the chance of accepting additional tokens during tree verification. Across seven standardized benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, UBTree achieves an average speedup of $5.84$--$6.94\times$ over autoregressive decoding and outperforms DARTree in all 28 comparisons. Production-scale evaluation further demonstrates UBTree's advantage over frontier baselines such as DSpark.

AI.tldr: UBTree：并行草稿器，结合Unigram提议器与Bigram选择器构建草稿树，通过树原生训练提升草稿多样性，在高熵场景下显著加速推理。
AI.motivation: 投机解码通过单次目标模型前向验证多个草稿token来加速推理。近期并行草稿器在前沿生产模型中性能突破，但当目标分布熵增大时，因草稿多样性不足而效果下降。本文旨在不牺牲并行性的前提下克服该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出UBTree并行草稿器：Unigram提议器用标准交叉熵目标训练，各位置独立生成候选token；轻量Bigram选择器预测相邻候选对的转移分数，并用高温数据上重归一化的KL目标训练。该树原生训练将监督扩展到贪心路径之外，鼓励合理的替代分支，从而提高树验证时接受额外token的概率。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B的七个标准基准上，UBTree相对自回归解码平均加速5.84–6.94倍，在全部28项对比中均优于DARTree；生产规模评估进一步显示其优于DSpark等前沿基线。
AI.conclusion: UBTree通过提议器与选择器的树原生训练增强草稿多样性，在不牺牲并行性的情况下有效缓解高熵目标分布下的性能退化，实验证明其加速效果与对前沿基线的优势。

title: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents
summary: Terminal agents act through stochastic model generations, yet the ability to generate a useful action does not ensure its reliable execution. A poor command (e.g., wrong package install) can change the environment in ways that hinder subsequent progress, even when the model could generate a better alternative. We investigate whether allocating test-time compute at the model-harness boundary can improve action reliability and trajectory success, and what makes this allocation effective. To study these questions, we introduce Mid-Harness, which samples and verifies candidate actions before forwarding one for execution, while keeping the generator and harness unchanged. With a TMAX-9B generator, more action sampling yields little benefit under weak verification, whereas a capable verifier can exploit useful alternatives from the same generator. On TerminalBench-Lite, a GPT-5.6 Sol verifier raises Pass@1 from 50.00% for the base agent to 68.03% with 8 sampled actions. When the same TMAX-9B model serves as the verifier, pairwise verification performs best among the evaluated verification mechanisms. Distilling responses from the stronger verifier into TMAX-9B further improves Pass@1, while leaving the action generator unchanged. With TMAX-9B on TerminalBench-Lite, combining action and trajectory scaling reaches higher success at lower estimated token cost than generating more trajectories alone. Mid-Harness also improves performance across additional models, benchmarks, and harnesses. These findings identify action scaling as a promising target for test-time compute scaling in terminal agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mid-Harness：在模型与执行框架（harness）边界处采样并验证候选动作后再执行，从而提升终端智能体的动作可靠性与轨迹成功率。实验表明，动作扩展（action scaling）是终端智能体测试时计算扩展的有效方向。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体通过随机模型生成来行动，但"能生成有用动作"并不等于"能可靠执行"：一个糟糕的命令（如错误的依赖安装）会改变环境状态，反而阻碍后续进展，即使模型本可生成更优替代方案。因此作者探究在模型-框架边界分配测试时计算能否提升动作可靠性与轨迹成功率，以及何种分配方式才有效。
AI.method: 提出 Mid-Harness：在不改动生成器与 harness 的前提下，对候选动作进行采样与验证，仅将其中一个转发执行；并在 TMAX-9B 生成器上系统比较弱/强验证器、多种验证机制（含成对验证 pairwise verification）、动作扩展与轨迹扩展的组合，以及将强验证器响应蒸馏回 TMAX-9B（保持动作生成器不变）。
AI.result: TMAX-9B 生成器下，弱验证时增加动作采样收益甚微，而强验证器可挖掘同一生成器中的有用替代动作。在 TerminalBench-Lite 上，GPT-5.6 Sol 验证器配合 8 个采样动作将 Pass@1 从基线 50.00% 提升至 68.03%；同模型 TMAX-9B 作验证器时，成对验证在所评估机制中表现最佳；将强验证器响应蒸馏进 TMAX-9B 可进一步提升 Pass@1。以 TMAX-9B 运行时，动作扩展与轨迹扩展结合相比单纯增加轨迹，能以更低的估计 token 成本取得更高成功率。Mid-Harness 在更多模型、基准与 harness 上也带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 动作扩展是终端智能体中测试时计算扩展的有前景方向；在模型-harness 边界引入可验证的动作采样，可在不改变生成器的情况下显著提升可靠性与成功率，并带来更优的成本-性能权衡。

title: OPTS-TTPO: Enhancing Finite-Sample Policy-Gradient Learning with Tree Search
summary: The policy-gradient theorem gives the exact gradient under the current policy, but finite on-policy samples may miss rare high-return trajectories. We study whether tree search improves their coverage within a fixed budget while controlling gradient bias. We introduce On-Policy Parallel Tree Search (OPTS) and Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization (TTPO) using on-policy tree trajectories, which sample new suffixes from the current policy at visited states. This needs no action-distribution correction, although branching changes state visitation. Our Branch Aggregation Lemma shows that branch-weighted tree statistics recover chain expectations when branch choices and weights are fixed before outgoing transitions are sampled. OPTS selects expansion states using estimated performance differences. Under deterministic dynamics, exact values, and max-backup advantages, the induced search policy's expected return improves monotonically with the budget. We bound the gradient bias from adaptive expansion and show that max backup assigns prefix credit to actions leading to better discovered suffixes. Against a finite chain reference, TTPG's measured bias stays near its no-branching level, while NaivePG's bias grows from 0.1251 to 0.4884. At matched budgets, reward- and value-guided OPTS improve correct-answer coverage and majority-vote accuracy over independent sampling. At matched branch counts, OPTS + TTPG gains coverage with a modest bias increase relative to Fixed-branch + TTPG. Under matched interaction or rollout budgets, OPTS-TTPO improves MuJoCo tail returns over PPO by up to 28.6%, achieves a 34-22-1 win-loss-tie record against PPO on Atari-57 under the last-100-log mean-return metric, and improves micro-averaged avg@32 and pass@32 over PPO across all four Qwen3 models.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在固定预算下，树搜索能否在控制梯度偏差的同时提升同策略样本对稀有高回报轨迹的覆盖。作者提出OPTS与TTPO（含TTPG），基于同策略树轨迹采样，无需动作分布校正，并给出分支聚合引理、单调改进与梯度偏差界。实验显示偏差可控、覆盖与正确率提升，并在MuJoCo、Atari-57和Qwen3上优于PPO。
AI.motivation: 策略梯度定理给出精确梯度，但有限的同策略样本可能遗漏稀有高回报轨迹，导致覆盖不足。论文希望探究在固定预算下引入树搜索能否改善覆盖，同时控制由此带来的梯度偏差。
AI.method: 提出On-Policy Parallel Tree Search（OPTS）与Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization（TTPO），使用同策略树轨迹，在已访问状态从当前策略采样新后缀；无需动作分布校正，尽管分支会改变状态访问。给出Branch Aggregation Lemma，证明当分支选择与权重在采样后续转移前固定时，分支加权树统计可恢复链式期望。OPTS利用估计的性能差异选择扩展状态。
AI.result: 在确定性动力学、精确值和max-backup优势下，诱导搜索策略的期望回报随预算单调提升。给出自适应扩展导致的梯度偏差界，并表明max backup将前缀信用分配给通向更优发现的后续动作。与有限链参考相比，TTPG偏差接近无分支水平，而NaivePG偏差从0.1251增至0.4884。匹配预算下，奖励和价值引导的OPTS在正确回答覆盖与多数投票准确率上优于独立采样；匹配分支数下OPTS+TTPG以适度偏差增加换取覆盖提升。匹配交互或rollout预算下，OPTS-TTPO在MuJoCo尾部回报较PPO最高提升28.6%，Atari-57上以34-22-1胜负平记录优于PPO，并在四个Qwen3模型上提升微平均avg@32和pass@32。
AI.conclusion: 树搜索可在固定预算下提升同策略轨迹覆盖，并可将梯度偏差控制在接近无分支的水平，理论保证与多种任务（连续控制、Atari、语言模型）实验均支持OPTS-TTPO相对PPO的一致改进。

title: MGhana-ST: A Low-Resource Speech Translation Dataset for Ghanaian Languages and an Analysis of Multilingual Training Trade-offs
summary:
We present MGhana-ST, a speech translation dataset for four low-resource Ghanaian language varieties: Ga, Twi (Akuapem and Asante), Ewe, and Fante. MGhana-ST is an ongoing annotation effort; the experiments here use a fixed subset of about 16.1 hours of paired speech and English translations. The audio is curated from two existing Ghanaian speech resources. Unlike in those resources, the English translations are produced directly from audio by 37 native-speaker annotators and include verbal and non-verbal event annotations.
  Using Whisper-small, we compare monolingual and multilingual training under severe data scarcity, reporting means over three seeds. Flat multilingual training benefits no variety in this regime. Ga and Twi are unchanged within seed variance (+0.51 and +0.06 BLEU against monolingual standard deviations of 1.63 and 2.20), while Ewe declines by 6.99 BLEU and Fante by 5.11. The degrading varieties are Ewe, which is linguistically distinct and drawn from a different source corpus, and Fante, the least-resourced. Comparing empirical cross-lingual transfer with typology-based similarity, we find that transfer BLEU identifies closely interacting language pairs better than URIEL similarity, though neither predicts which varieties benefit from joint training.
  We also report a methodological finding. An earlier single-run analysis found positive transfer for three of four varieties; this did not survive replication across seeds. For Ga and Twi, monolingual baselines trained on 1.6 to 6.2 hours of audio have seed standard deviations roughly five and thirty times those of the multilingual models (0.35 and 0.07 BLEU). When the monolingual condition is noisier, a single-run comparison can show apparent transfer of this size from seed variation alone. We release MGhana-ST to support research on African language speech technology and low-resource speech translation.

AI.tldr: MGhana-ST：四个加纳低资源语言变体的语音翻译数据集（约16.1小时），实验表明在极度数据稀缺下扁平多语言训练无获益，且单次运行的"正迁移"结论无法通过多种子复现。
AI.motivation: 加纳多种低资源语言变体缺乏直接由音频生成英文翻译的语音翻译资源；同时需要检验在严重数据稀缺条件下，多语言联合训练是否真能带来跨语言迁移收益，并纠正以往依赖单次运行得出的迁移结论。
AI.method: 构建MGhana-ST数据集：覆盖Ga、Twi（Akuapem与Asante）、Ewe、Fante四个变体，音频取自两个现有加纳语音资源，英文翻译由37名母语标注者直接从音频产出，并含言语与非言语事件标注；实验使用约16.1小时配对子集。以Whisper-small为基座，在三种随机种子下比较单语言与多语言（扁平联合）训练，报告均值与标准差。并将经验跨语言迁移（迁移BLEU）与基于类型学的URIEL相似度进行对比。
AI.result: 扁平多语言训练在严重数据稀缺下对所有变体均无收益：Ga、Twi变化在种子方差内（+0.51、+0.06 BLEU，对应单语言标准差1.63、2.20）；Ewe下降6.99 BLEU，Fante下降5.11 BLEU。退化者为语言上差异较大且来自不同源语料的Ewe，以及资源最少的Fante。迁移BLEU比URIEL相似度更能识别交互密切的语言对，但两者都无法预测哪些变体受益于联合训练。方法学发现：早期单次运行显示四变体中有三者为正迁移，多种子复现后不成立；Ga、Twi单语言基线（1.6–6.2小时）的种子标准差约为多语言模型的5倍与30倍（0.35、0.07 BLEU），当单语言条件噪声更大时，仅由种子波动即可在单次比较中产生该量级的表观迁移。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源加纳语言语音翻译中，扁平多语言训练并不优于单语言基线，语言/语料差异与资源量共同影响退化；单次运行对比易将种子方差误判为迁移效应，需多种子复现。数据集MGhana-ST已发布，以支持非洲语言语音技术与低资源语音翻译研究。

title: From Tweets to Trades: Analyzing the Influence of Public Mood over Stock Market Performance in Turkiye
summary:
Purpose: This study examines whether domain-specific public mood is associated with stock-market dynamics and whether these relationships vary across communication domains and market conditions. It distinguishes public mood from investor sentiment and investigates whether heterogeneous sources of public communication exhibit different relationships with market behaviour.
  Design: The study analyses 610,422 posts published by 176 curated X accounts between January 2022 and December 2023, covering Politics and Government, Economy and Finance, and Media and Society. Posts are classified using fine-tuned Turkish transformer models under three domain-specific and one pooled regime. Public mood measures are constructed at daily, weekly, and monthly frequencies and examined alongside BIST100 and BIST30 market measures using correlation, Granger causality, vector autoregression, and impulse response analyses across the full period and selected market conditions.
  Findings: Public mood is not associated with the direction of stock-market returns but is associated with the magnitude of price movements, particularly for Media and Society and pooled communication. These relationships become stronger at longer aggregation frequencies. Predictive relationships are concentrated in Economy and Finance communication, while their magnitude and direction vary across market conditions, particularly during the 2023 election period. The pooled measure largely reflects the most active communication domain.
  Originality: The study contributes to behavioral-finance research by incorporating communication - domain heterogeneity into the analysis of public mood and market dynamics. It also demonstrates how aggregating heterogeneous sources can obscure domain-specific relationships between public communication and financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于176个X账号在2022–2023年间发布的610,422条帖文，用微调土耳其语Transformer模型按政治与政府、经济与金融、媒体与社会三个领域分类，构建日/周/月频率的公共情绪指标，考察其与BIST100、BIST30市场动态的关系。结果显示公共情绪与收益率方向无关，但与价格波动幅度相关，且关系随聚合频率提高而增强；预测关系集中在经济与金融领域，并随市场状态（尤其2023年选举期）变化。
AI.motivation: 既有行为金融研究多将公共情绪与投资者情绪混同，且常把异质性公共传播来源聚合为单一指标，忽视了传播领域异质性可能造成的掩盖效应。本文旨在区分公共情绪与投资者情绪，检验不同传播领域、不同市场状态下的关系差异。
AI.method: 采集176个精选X账号2022年1月至2023年12月的610,422条帖文，覆盖政治与政府、经济与金融、媒体与社会三个领域；采用微调土耳其语Transformer模型，在三个领域特定制度与一个池化制度下进行分类。构建日、周、月频率的公共情绪指标，与BIST100、BIST30市场指标进行相关分析、Granger因果检验、向量自回归（VAR）及脉冲响应分析，并分全样本与特定市场状态进行检验。
AI.result: 公共情绪与股票市场收益率方向无显著关联，但与价格波动幅度相关，媒体与社会领域及池化传播尤为明显；这些关系在更长聚合频率上更强。预测性关系集中于经济与金融传播，其幅度与方向随市场状态变化，尤其在2023年选举期间表现突出。池化指标在很大程度上反映的是最活跃的传播领域。
AI.conclusion: 研究将传播领域异质性引入公共情绪与市场动态分析，拓展了行为金融研究视角，并表明聚合异质来源会掩盖公共传播与金融市场之间的领域特定关系。

title: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research
summary: Existing auto-research benchmarks often entangle multiple sources of improvement, including training frameworks, hyperparameters, compute budgets, and data, making it difficult to attribute why one frontier agent outperforms another to specific research capabilities. In this work, we isolate and systematically evaluate Data Intelligence: an agent's ability to understand, manipulate, and improve the data that shapes model capabilities. We introduce AutoDataBench, a controlled testbed built on a conceptual framework of data intelligence spanning data diagnosis, data organization, and data construction, instantiated through three highly curated optimization tasks while holding non-data factors fixed. Across tool use, retrieval, and knowledge injection, we evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to improve training data through iterative experimentation under task-specific resource budgets. Beyond optimization performance, we ask: do LLMs understand what their data interventions do? We compare predictions made before training with observed outcomes to seek evidence of data-effect reasoning beyond trial and error, and explore whether iterative feedback helps LLMs better understand how changes to training data affect model performance. Finally, we show that reusing AutoDataBench trajectories for mid-training improves downstream coding performance, highlighting its value in both evaluating data intelligence and generating high-quality training data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoDataBench，一个隔离并评估 LLM "数据智能"（理解、操作、改进训练数据）的受控基准，涵盖数据诊断、组织与构建三类任务，并进一步检验模型是否能推理数据干预的效果，同时证明该基准轨迹可用于中训练以提升下游编码性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动研究（auto-research）基准混合了训练框架、超参数、算力预算、数据等多重改进来源，难以归因某一前沿智能体究竟因何种研究能力胜出。作者希望剥离非数据因素，单独、系统地评估智能体的"数据智能"。
AI.method: 构建 AutoDataBench 受控测试平台：以数据诊断、数据组织、数据构建为概念框架，实例化为三个精心设计的优化任务，固定非数据因素。在工具使用、检索、知识注入三类设定下，评估前沿 LLM 在任务特定资源预算内通过迭代实验改进训练数据的能力。此外，对比训练前的预测与训练后的实际结果，以检验模型是否具备超越试错的数据效应推理能力，并考察迭代反馈是否有助于其理解数据改动对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 1) 得到前沿 LLM 在受控数据优化任务上的表现对比；2) 通过"预测-观测"对比获得模型是否具备数据效应推理的证据，并评估迭代反馈对理解的作用；3) 复用 AutoDataBench 轨迹进行中训练可提升下游编码性能。
AI.conclusion: AutoDataBench 既能评估 LLM 的数据智能，又能生成高质量训练数据，具有评测与数据生成双重价值。代码与资源已开源于 https://github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench。

title: JuryFlow: Disagreement-Guided Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Evaluation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. To appear in Proceedings of the 14th International Conference on Human-Agent Interaction (HAI '26), November 16-19, 2026, Osaka, Japan
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated judges for AI-generated content, yet a single judge is unreliable and even a panel of judges leaves a hard residue: when judges disagree, majority voting discards the conflict instead of resolving it. We present JuryFlow, a disagreement-guided, human-in-the-loop multi-agent evaluation framework that treats inter-judge disagreement not as noise to be averaged away, but as a precise, claim-level signal indicating where an evaluation is uncertain. JuryFlow decomposes each candidate response into atomic claims, has a panel of heterogeneous judges assign per-claim verdicts, and builds a disagreement graph whose nodes are scored by verdict entropy and whose edges encode structural similarity between claims. A human acts as a structural guide, selecting which disagreement to resolve through a single, minimal intervention rather than re-labeling the response, after which the focal claim is re-evaluated, the correction propagates along graph edges and to historically similar cases, and is crystallized into reusable rubric entries that all judges inherit, making the evaluator progressively self-refining. To enable large-scale, reproducible benchmarking without human studies, we evaluate JuryFlow in an automatic configuration in which focal selection is made by entropy ranking. On MT-Bench and LLMBar, JuryFlow improves agreement with gold labels over single-judge and majority-vote panel baselines, and ablations isolate the contributions of disagreement-targeted re-evaluation, propagation, and rubric induction. We contribute (1) a human-in-the-loop paradigm that recasts the human from labeler to structural guide, (2) the JuryFlow framework operationalizing it through a disagreement graph, focal re-evaluation, and closed-loop rubric induction, and (3) an evaluation protocol with ablations that isolate where the gains originate.

AI.tldr: JuryFlow将评审间的分歧视为精确到论断级别的信号，通过分歧图、焦点重评、传播与规则归纳，把人工从标注者转变为结构性引导者，在MT-Bench与LLMBar上优于单评审与多数投票基线。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作AI生成内容的自动评审，但单一评审不可靠，评审团也残留难题：评审分歧时多数投票直接丢弃冲突而非加以解决。作者主张不应把分歧当作需要平均掉的噪声，而应视为指示评估不确定性的论断级精确信号。
AI.method: 提出JuryFlow，一种分歧引导的人在回路多智能体评估框架。将候选回答分解为原子论断，由异构评审团逐论断给出判定；构建分歧图，节点由判定熵打分，边编码论断间结构相似性。人类作为结构性引导者，以一次最小干预选择要解决的分歧而非重新标注整条回答；随后焦点论断被重评，修正沿图边及历史相似案例传播，并结晶为可复用规则项供全体评审继承，使评估器逐步自我精炼。为支持无人工实验的大规模可复现评测，采用熵排序做焦点选择的自动配置进行评估。
AI.result: 在MT-Bench和LLMBar上，JuryFlow相对单评审与多数投票评审团基线提升了与金标签的一致度；消融实验分离出分歧靶向重评、传播与规则归纳各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 贡献有三：(1) 将人类从标注者重塑为结构性引导者的人在回路范式；(2) 通过分歧图、焦点重评与闭环规则归纳实现该范式的JuryFlow框架；(3) 含消融的评估协议，用以定位增益来源。

title: OverdoseMoE: A Multi-Expert Framework for Opioid Overdose Risk Prediction
summary: Opioid overdose remains a major clinical and public health burden, highlighting the need for scalable approaches to identify patients at high risk. Here, we investigate diagnosis-specific adaptation for 180-day opioid overdose risk prediction from patients' preceding one-year longitudinal ICD histories. We develop OODMAMBA and OODQWEN through continued pretraining on longitudinal diagnostic sequences followed by task-specific fine-tuning. Building on the stronger Qwen-based predictors, we further propose OVERDOSEMOE, a multi-expert framework that integrates models of different scales using complementary expert-weighting strategies. Diagnosis-specific adaptation consistently improved predictive performance over general-purpose language-model baselines, with OODQWEN achieving an AUPRC of 24.47 and an AUROC of 68.56. OVERDOSEMOE further improved discrimination and precision, achieving an AUPRC of 25.17 and an AUROC of 69.49 while outperforming the strongest single-model baselines. Among patients ranked in the top 5% of predicted risk, OVERDOSEMOE identified substantially enriched overdose risk, achieving a PPV of 25.38% while retaining meaningful recall. Evaluation on an independent MIMIC-IV cohort further demonstrated cross-cohort robustness, with complementary weighting strategies showing advantages across different performance measures. These findings demonstrate that diagnosis-specific language-model adaptation combined with multi-expert integration can improve opioid overdose risk stratification and support more robust prediction across heterogeneous electronic health record populations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于诊断序列的语言模型适应方法（OODMAMBA、OODQWEN）及多专家集成框架OVERDOSEMOE，用于180天阿片类药物过量风险预测，在提升AUPRC/AUROC的同时实现跨队列稳健性。
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物过量仍是重大的临床与公共卫生负担，亟需可规模化的高危患者识别方法。既有通用语言模型未针对诊断特异性进行适配，预测性能受限。
AI.method: 基于患者前一年纵向ICD诊断序列，通过继续预训练（continued pretraining）结合任务特定微调，构建OODMAMBA与OODQWEN；在表现更优的Qwen预测器基础上，提出OVERDOSEMOE多专家框架，以互补的专家加权策略整合不同规模模型。
AI.result: 诊断特异性适应持续优于通用语言模型基线：OODQWEN达AUPRC 24.47、AUROC 68.56；OVERDOSEMOE进一步提升至AUPRC 25.17、AUROC 69.49，优于最强单模型基线。在预测风险前5%患者中，PPV达25.38%，同时保留有意义的召回率。在独立MIMIC-IV队列上验证了跨队列稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 诊断特异性语言模型适配结合多专家集成可改善阿片类过量风险分层，并在异构电子健康记录人群中实现更稳健的预测。

title: Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV cache has expired. Past attention provides signals of historical importance and dependencies between messages, while relevance to the current task must be assessed using the new user request. We introduce ReCAP, a memory compaction method that stores attention-derived importance scores and dependency links in a lightweight, persistent context graph. For each new request, ReCAP combines stored importance with relevance cues from the request and follows dependency links to select messages and their supporting context, without additional model calls for selection. Compared with Codex's default summarization-based compaction, ReCAP reduces estimated latency for compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95% on both Qwen3-Coder and gpt-oss. It also roughly halves the historical context per call on SWE-Together at comparable task quality and improves accuracy on the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation over full history by 19.8 and 41.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReCAP，一种基于注意力派生重要性与依赖链接的轻量持久上下文图记忆压缩方法，可显著降低压缩与冷恢复延迟并减少历史上下文开销。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM Agent 处理更长时域、更复杂的任务，交互历史不断增长，内存压缩成为控制上下文窗口与降低预填充成本的关键。现有方法通过摘要或压缩 KV cache 保留信息，但需额外模型计算；而新用户请求会改变历史的重要性分布，KV cache 过期后重新评估历史需重新编码，代价高昂。
AI.method: ReCAP 将历史注意力导出的重要性分数与消息间依赖链接存储在轻量、持久的上下文图中。对每个新请求，方法将存储的重要性与来自当前请求的相关性线索相结合，并沿依赖链接选择消息及其支撑上下文，选择过程无需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 相比 Codex 默认的摘要式压缩，ReCAP 在 Qwen3-Coder 与 gpt-oss 上把压缩与冷恢复的估计延迟降低约 95%；在 SWE-Together 上任务质量相当的情况下将每次调用的历史上下文约减半；在 Lost-in-Conversation 的代码任务上相比全历史分别提升 19.8 与 41.2 个点的准确率。
AI.conclusion: ReCAP 通过注意力信号与请求相关性结合的结构化选择机制，在不增加模型调用的情况下实现高效记忆压缩，兼顾延迟、上下文成本与任务质量，是一种面向长时域 Agent 的实用内存压缩方案。

title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables, accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了近期关于AMR增强提升LLM下游性能的工作，发现在统一超参数选择协议下，纯文本基线可匹配或超过AMR增强模型；作者提出基于困惑度的探针，发现AMR并未为LLM补充其尚未掌握的关系性知识，因此AMR增强对下游任务无明显收益。
AI.motivation: AMR在传统NLP任务中曾带来性能提升，但其对现代LLM的增强效益尚不明确；近期有工作声称AMR增强可显著提升下游表现，作者希望验证该结论是否稳健。
AI.method: 复现相关实验，并采用一致、统一的超参数选择协议进行对比；同时提出一种基于困惑度（perplexity-based）的探针，用于衡量AMR是否为LLM提供了模型原本不具备的补充性关系知识。
AI.result: 在统一超参数选择协议下，纯文本基线持续匹配甚至超过AMR增强模型；基于困惑度的探针显示，AMR增强并未提升LLM对句子中关系性内容的理解。
AI.conclusion: 原工作报告的下游增益很可能源于实验设置中的特定选择；AMR增强对LLM在下游任务上没有明确收益。

title: Debias It Yourself: Teaching LLMs Cognitive Bias Mitigation Interventions
summary: Bias has long been studied in social psychology and cognitive science, where decades of research have produced a body of validated interventions that reduce stereotypical thinking and prejudiced responses in humans. We propose Debias It Yourself (DIY), a cognitively grounded framework that translates five such interventions into debiasing procedures for large language models and delivers them through three established paradigms: Show (in-context examples), Train (instruction tuning), and Revise (guided self-revision). Across three models, five bias benchmarks, eleven debiasing baselines, and three reasoning benchmarks, Train+Revise and Revise alone attain the top two average ranks, lead the bias-reasoning tradeoff (mean bias as low as 2% at 90% reasoning accuracy), and reduce bias on unseen dimensions by up to 14.8%. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Debias It Yourself（DIY）框架，将五种社会心理学与认知科学的去偏干预转化为大语言模型的去偏流程，并通过Show（上下文示例）、Train（指令微调）、Revise（引导式自我修正）三种范式实现，在多个模型与基准上验证其能有效降低偏见并保持推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在社会偏见问题，而社会心理学和认知科学已积累了大量经过验证的、可减少人类刻板印象与偏见的干预方法，作者希望将这些认知科学成果迁移到LLM去偏中，形成有认知依据的去偏方案。
AI.method: 提出DIY（Debias It Yourself）框架，把五种认知科学中的去偏干预转化为针对LLM的去偏流程，并通过三种范式交付：Show（上下文示例）、Train（指令微调）、Revise（引导式自我修正）。
AI.result: 在三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线和三个推理基准上进行评测。Train+Revise与单独Revise取得最高的两个平均排名，在偏见-推理权衡上表现领先（平均偏见低至2%时推理准确率仍达90%），并在未见维度上最多降低14.8%的偏见。代码与数据已公开。
AI.conclusion: 基于认知科学干预的DIY框架可有效降低LLM偏见，其中Train+Revise与Revise最为有效，能够在保持推理能力的同时显著减少偏见，并具备向未见偏见维度泛化的能力。

title: Index-Translate: A Multilingual Translation Model Family -- Text, Speech, Controlled Dubbing, and Long-Document Translation
comment: 27 pages. Project: https://index-translate.bilibili.com ; Code and models: https://github.com/bilibili/Index-Translate
summary: We introduce Index-Translate, a multilingual translation model family that combines a shared multilingual foundation with specialized training for general translation, instruction following, speech translation, controlled dubbing, and long-document translation. It includes three model sizes, 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B, and supports translation in 150 languages, with multilingual instruction following. Evaluations on general translation and complex translation instructions show that Index-Translate outperforms translation models of comparable size and achieves performance comparable to 100B-scale translation models and frontier models. Index-Echo provides end-to-end speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, outperforming existing end-to-end models and achieving performance comparable to frontier omni models. Index-Homura extends the family to syllable-controlled dubbing. Index-NativeLong introduces native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These capabilities support diverse translation tasks, including multilingual content production.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍Index-Translate多语言翻译模型家族，基于共享多语言底座并进行多任务专门化训练，涵盖通用翻译、指令跟随、语音翻译、可控配音与长文档翻译，提供2B、9B、35B-A3B三种规模，支持150种语言，并在多项翻译任务上达到或接近百B级与前沿模型水平。
AI.motivation: 面向多样化翻译场景（通用翻译、复杂指令、语音、配音、长文档），统一构建可扩展的多语言翻译模型家族，以较小规模实现与大规模及前沿模型相当的翻译能力。
AI.method: 以共享多语言基础模型为核心，进行任务专门化训练，形成多个子模型：通用翻译与指令跟随（Index-Translate，2B/9B/35B-A3B）、端到端语音到文本与语音到语音翻译（Index-Echo）、音节可控配音（Index-Homura）、长文档翻译（Index-NativeLong，含专门任务形式化与基准）。
AI.result: 通用翻译与复杂翻译指令评测中，Index-Translate优于同等规模翻译模型，性能可比100B级翻译模型与前沿模型；Index-Echo优于现有端到端模型并可比前沿omni模型；Index-Homura实现音节可控配音；Index-NativeLong提供原生长文档翻译及配套基准。
AI.conclusion: 该模型家族以较小参数规模覆盖多语言、多模态与多任务翻译需求，可支撑多样翻译任务，包括多语言内容生产。

title: Provably Tractable NFA-Constrained Language Generation via HMMs
summary: Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length-$n$ sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that #NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NFA-LM，一个针对 NFA（非确定有限自动机）约束语言生成的多项式时间引擎，基于 #NFA 的 FPRAS 结果，在温和假设下提供理论保证，实验表明其能高效生成高质量输出且近似误差有界。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 NFA 约束的受限生成技术要么扭曲分布，要么牺牲效率；而该任务本质上归约为计数 NFA 接受的长度为 n 的序列（#NFA），精确求解是 #P 完全问题，因此需要兼顾分布正确性与效率的新方法。
AI.method: 受 #NFA 存在全多项式随机近似方案（FPRAS）这一近期结果的启发，提出 NFA-LM：一个用于 NFA 约束生成的多项式时间引擎，并在温和假设下具备理论保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，NFA-LM 能够高效生成高质量输出，且近似误差具有理论界。
AI.conclusion: NFA-LM 在效率与分布保真度之间取得平衡，为 NFA 约束生成提供了带理论保证的可行方案。

title: SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models
comment: Conducted during a 2024 internship at SCBX R&D
summary: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpeechConversationBench（SCB），用 103 个分片 GSM8K 数学题评估语音对话系统的跨轮次推理能力，比较单轮完整呈现、单轮拼接呈现与多轮增量口述三种条件，发现四款商用语音系统在多轮分片条件下准确率下降 5.0–25.3 个百分点，而内部系统 LEGO 在三种条件下均保持 77.5%。
AI.motivation: 语音到语音系统的任务需求往往在多轮对话中逐步显现，而现有评测多聚焦单轮语音输入，无法区分“问题改写带来的敏感度”与“增量式口语交互额外引入的困难”。因此需要一个专门基准来刻画跨轮次信息获取对语音推理的影响。
AI.method: 构建 SpeechConversationBench（SCB）：选取 103 个分片后的 GSM8K 数学推理题，设计三种条件——(1) full：原始问题一次性给出；(2) concat：将各信息分片拼接后一次性给出；(3) sharded：跨轮次增量口述披露信息。以最终答案准确率为指标，评测四款商用语音系统以及内部语音流水线 LEGO（具备显式对话上下文管理）。
AI.result: 相对于 concat，四款商用语音系统在 sharded 条件下的准确率下降 5.0–25.3 个百分点。LEGO 在三种条件下均达到 77.5% 准确率；GPT-4o Realtime 在 sharded 条件下为 76.6%。
AI.conclusion: 增量式口语交互本身会显著增加语音数学推理难度，且该难度不能仅归因于问题改写。两个单轮基线（full 与 concat）可用于分离问题表述变化的影响与跨轮交互带来的附加挑战。具备显式上下文管理的系统（LEGO）可缓解分片带来的性能损失。

title: Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports
summary: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

AI.tldr: 将自由文本放射报告转换为结构化标签可支持队列构建、质量保证和临床影像模型监测，但最强的标签抽取器是专有模型，存在隐私、成本和可复现性问题。该研究通过2x2设计（判别式分类头CH vs 生成式指令微调IFT × 真实GPT-4o标注报告蒸馏 vs GPT-4o合成报告），在五种训练规模下考察开放权重模型Gemma-3-12B能否在颅内出血（ICH）急性度多标签抽取上匹敌GPT-4o。结果显示蒸馏后的指令微调模型DIFT与GPT-4o相当（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850，p=1.000），并比基座模型高0.178；决定因素是训练数据来源而非微调方法，合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未超过未微调基座模型。
AI.motivation: 专有托管模型（如GPT-4o）虽在放射报告结构化标签抽取上表现最强，但其使用带来隐私泄露、成本高昂和可复现性差等问题。研究旨在验证开放权重模型能否在特定临床标签抽取任务上达到专有模型水平，并识别实现这一目标的关键要素，从而提供私有化、低成本、版本稳定的本地替代方案。
AI.method: 采用2x2实验设计：交叉两种适配策略（判别式分类头CH、生成式指令微调IFT）与两种训练数据来源（对真实GPT-4o标注报告进行蒸馏、由GPT-4o基于真实样例生成的合成报告），并在五种训练规模下进行训练。以100份专家裁定的报告为基准，将微调后的Gemma-3-12B与GPT-4o及未微调的开放权重基座模型进行对比。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的指令微调模型（DIFT）与GPT-4o表现相当（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850；p=1.000），并比未微调基座模型高出0.178。决定性能的关键因素是训练数据来源，而非微调方法本身：两种合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未能超过未微调的开放权重基座模型，且在所有急性度类别上均劣于蒸馏模型。微调与推理均可在单张24 GB消费级GPU的内存范围内完成。
AI.conclusion: 对于狭窄且高价值的临床标签抽取任务，蒸馏真实报告而非生成合成报告是缩小与托管模型差距的关键，从而可实现私有、低成本、版本稳定的本地部署替代方案。

title: Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning
summary: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语言预算多语言遗忘"任务，并构建跨语言遗忘张量基准（174种语言-文字对、25类原子复述）与COVER方法，通过选择最优源语言子集最大化跨语言遗忘覆盖率，在三种模型家族上使留出残差访问平均降低7.8–27.3%。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型中在一种语言里遗忘某事实，并不能保证其在其他语言中被移除：更换查询语言甚至更换回答语言都可能重新打开"已遗忘"的知识，形成跨语言漏洞。最直接的补救（在所有语言上都做遗忘）既不可扩展，也会加剧对无关模型能力的损害，因此需要一种在语言预算约束下的可推广遗忘方案。
AI.method: 1）定义"语言预算多语言遗忘"任务：在有限语言预算下选择源语言子集，使跨语言擦除效果最大化。2）构建Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor基准，涵盖174个语言-文字对与25种原子复述类型，用于考察同一知识的遗忘能否跨语言表达泛化。3）提出COVER方法，通过预测未被遗忘监督语言的覆盖范围来选择源语言；部署时仅需良性校准数据与冻结模型的访问权限。
AI.result: 作者发现，朴素地挑选单个强源语言并不能可靠地组合成强源语言集合，这促使了COVER的提出。在三种模型家族、两个不相交遗忘集上，COVER相比均匀源语言选择使平均留出残差访问降低7.8–27.3%。该增益还能从合成基准推广到低资源语言场景下的真实新闻文档（使用LORELEI语料的人工翻译数据）。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言遗忘存在语言选择上的组合非平凡性，需要在语言预算下进行覆盖导向的源语言选择。COVER以低成本的校准方式实现了更优的跨语言遗忘泛化，并在合成与真实低资源数据上均验证有效，为可扩展的多语言知识擦除提供了可行路径。

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.

AI.tldr: 研究"野外"AI生成文本对预训练的影响，发现AI token的价值随比例与人类数据预算而变号，并提出能捕捉该行为的缩放律。
AI.motivation: 网络文本是预训练数据主体，且AI生成内容占比快速上升。与合成数据或模型崩溃不同，这些"野外"AI文本来自众多模型、面向人类读者、且未加标注混入语料。其对人文本预训练的实际影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 用Pangram标注2026年6月至8月FineWeb过滤后数据中AI生成token比例；预训练800个语言模型，改变AI token与人类token的掺入比例，对保留集上的人文本与AI文本损失分别拟合缩放律，并提出带独立收益项与损害项的缩放律。
AI.result: 2026年6月27.5%、8月31.1%的token被判为AI生成。数据紧缺模型中人文本损失随AI token增加先降后饱和并转为有害；人类数据预算充裕的模型中人文本损失几乎立即上升，而同量新人类token持续降低损失。Hoffman等(2022)缩放律无法预测。新律在更小模型上拟合后可预测3.6倍大模型的留出人文本损失，误差比现有最优律低41%。
AI.conclusion: 目标为人文本时应过滤AI文本，扩展数据集时应重复使用人类文本而非先用AI网络文本；建议分别报告人文本与AI文本验证损失，因为AI文本在目标为AI文本时仍有价值。发布WildAI（83B token，含AI、主题、格式标签）、800个模型及代码。

title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
