summary: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.

AI.tldr: EvoDuet 是一种双层优化方法，在固定模型参数下协同演化解与检索查询，通过检索门控和内外循环提升 LLM 进化搜索效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的进化搜索在需要模型缺乏的外部知识时会停滞；仅添加网页搜索工具会因解不断变化而反复返回相同页面，检索效率低。
AI.method: 双层优化方法：每轮由检索门控让 LLM 评估知识缺口，选择检索新文档、复用已存文档或不检索；内层循环优化查询并按预测解分数对文档排序，外层循环基于这些文档并行生成候选并记录评估结果以供后续检索使用。
AI.result: 在 21 项优化任务、每轮一个候选设置下，EvoDuet 将 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益在 GPT-5.6-Luna 上从 74.1% 提升至 78.0%，在 Gemini-3.8-Flash 上从 61.3% 提升至 82.3%，但 Qwen3.5-9B 未受益。最佳运行在八项任务上超越此前报告的最佳分数（含 Q20 与 Rosetta 的 Swap Reduction），并在另三项上持平。在 Sums/Diffs 与 Denoising 任务上，该方法对 Top-K、EvoX 等其他搜索骨架也有改进。
AI.conclusion: EvoDuet 通过解与查询的协同演化有效缓解 LLM 知识缺口带来的搜索停滞，并可跨多种进化搜索骨架迁移应用。

title: LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset
comment: Accepted for publication at the 8th Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个大规模欧盟法院（CJEU）法律信息检索数据集，解决了现有公开数据集存在查询文本数据泄漏及语料不完整导致的性能虚高问题，并支持案件/段落多层级检索。
AI.motivation: 法律检索实践中常需精确到段落的引用（pincite），但现有公开法律IR数据集大多缺乏段落级引用标注；而少数带此类标注的数据集又存在查询文本数据泄漏，并剔除了既未引用也未被引用的段落，导致检索场景不真实、任务过度简化，进而造成性能指标虚高。
AI.method: 从欧盟法院（CJEU）判决中构建大规模法律IR数据集，包含三部分：(i) 掩码处理后的案件/段落查询，去除了引用信息以消除数据泄漏；(ii) 包含全部段落的语料库；(iii) 案件级与段落级ground truth引用标注，并经过部分人类专家验证。数据集支持案件到案件、段落到案件、段落到段落三种查询-文档层级的检索。
AI.result: 构建出支持多层级（case-to-case、paragraph-to-case、paragraph-to-paragraph）检索任务的大规模法律IR数据集，数据集与代码已公开于Hugging Face。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可用于法律IR方法的开发与严格评估，克服了既有数据集在数据泄漏和语料截断方面的缺陷，提供了更真实、更贴近法律实践需求的检索评测基准。

title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results
summary: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 在四项医学基准（MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ、NEJM病例挑战）上评估非生成式"系统一"模型Jev 1.13，与GPT-6 Sol（含/不含推理）对比，结果显示Jev速度快、成本低，在研究摘要类任务上与前沿大模型相当，但在考试题与复杂诊断病例上明显落后，且校准与判别能力有限。
AI.motivation: Jev作为非生成式"系统一"模型，只能对预设答案选项赋概率，无法回答选项之外的问题。其在医学问答与病例诊断推理任务上的准确率与校准性能尚属未知，因此需要系统性评估以判断其临床可用性。
AI.method: 评估对象为Jev 1.13，在MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ、NEJM Case Challenges四个医学基准上进行测试；以GPT-6 Sol（含中等推理与不含推理两种设置）为参照。主要结局为top-1准确率，次要结局包括校准（ECE、AUROC）、选择性预测以及不可回答问题识别；共8,469次请求，并记录延迟与成本。
AI.result: 全部8,469次请求均返回有效答案。PubMedQA上Jev准确率与GPT-6 Sol（中等推理）相近（78.4% vs 78.2%）；MetaMedQA上较低（74.8% vs 82.7%）；DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）与NEJM病例（61.8% vs 82.4%）上差距显著。MetaMedQA上Jev校准最优（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9的答案（占52.9%）准确率达93.4%，但GPT-6 Sol在接收相似比例题目时准确率相当。DiagnosisArena-MCQ上Jev判别能力较差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。162道正确答案为"我不知道或无法回答"的题目中，Jev该选项选择率为10.5%（GPT-6 Sol为8.6%）。中位延迟0.27–0.31 s；2,823题总成本0.08美元。
AI.conclusion: Jev具有速度快、成本低的优势，在研究摘要类任务上准确率可与前沿大模型相当，但在医学考试题和复杂诊断病例上表现明显偏低，且概率判别能力有限。临床使用前需针对具体任务开展验证。

title: When Does a Spoken Agent Have Enough Evidence to Act? The PACT-SLM Contract Test
summary: Streaming spoken agents may take an external action before the available speech supports it, yet final-turn scores do not reveal whether each observed prefix supports that action. We introduce the Partial Speech Action Contract for Turn Taking in Speech Language Models (PACT-SLM), a controlled evaluation that assigns a first valid action time and measures action identity and timing separately. The primary diagnostic contains 80 paired contrast groups from four held-out semantic families and 1,600 prefix predictions across clean and 15 dB noise renderings. After correcting a mismatch between randomized branch codes and semantic labels, a refitted WavLM Base Plus probe reaches 26.03% pooled post-onset semantic-label accuracy (95% group-bootstrap interval: 22.14%-29.68%), exposes an action on 18.99% of pre-onset prefixes, and predicts 5.94% of complete trajectories exactly. It exceeds matched text, scalar-acoustic, and shuffled-representation probes in post-onset label accuracy, but its score is at the 96th percentile of 100 within-prefix label permutations and below the 97.5th-percentile reference (26.73%). Elapsed time is more onset-exact than WavLM Base Plus (36.25% vs. 23.13%) but less accurate about action identity (9.92% vs. 26.03%). These results show that action identity and timing measure distinct aspects of partial-speech decision behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PACT-SLM 评测框架，将流式语音语言模型的"部分语音下动作决策"拆分为动作身份与时机两个独立维度进行诊断，发现二者测度的是不同能力。
AI.motivation: 流式对话智能体可能在语音证据尚不充分时就提前触发外部动作，而仅用整轮（final-turn）打分无法判断每个已观测语音前缀是否真正支持该动作，因此需要一种能够在部分语音条件下分别评估动作身份与触发时机的受控评测。
AI.method: 构建 PACT-SLM 受控评测：为每个样本标注首个有效动作时间（first valid action time），分别度量动作身份与时机。主诊断集含 4 个留出语义族共 80 个配对对比组、1600 条前缀预测，覆盖干净与 15 dB 噪声渲染；修正随机分支编码与语义标签的错配后，重新拟合 WavLM Base Plus 探针，并与匹配文本、标量声学、打乱表征三类探针对照，另以 100 次组内标签置换作为参照基线。
AI.result: 重拟合 WavLM Base Plus 探针在 onset 后语义标签准确率为 26.03%（95% 组自助区间 22.14%–29.68%），在 18.99% 的 onset 前前缀上已暴露动作，完整轨迹精确预测率 5.94%；其 onset 后标签准确率高于匹配文本、标量声学与打乱表征探针，但仅处于 100 次组内标签置换的第 96 百分位，低于 97.5 百分位参考值 26.73%。Elapsed time 方法的 onset 精确率更高（36.25% vs. 23.13%），但动作身份准确率更低（9.92% vs. 26.03%）。
AI.conclusion: 动作身份与时机是部分语音决策行为中两个相互独立的评测维度，单一时序指标或整轮得分均不足以刻画流式智能体的提前动作倾向；PACT-SLM 提供了可分离诊断二者的受控基准。

title: Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将多上下文窗口中计算分配与信息传递的决策权从固定框架转移到模型本身，定义此能力为"上下文推理"，并给出可配置框架Hermes及两阶段学习框架Hermes-Learn。实验表明，强模型能借此随推理计算扩展而提升性能，小开源模型初始不足，经Hermes-Learn训练后可弥补差距，学习到随问题与推理进程变化的自适应策略，且收益可跨基准、跨模型泛化，外推至训练未见计算量，并迁移到其他测试时扩展方法。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）通过增加推理阶段计算提升性能，但在多个上下文窗口间有效利用这些计算，需决定如何分配新上下文以及在窗口间传递哪些信息。现有方法多通过固定框架（harness）预先规定这些决策，限制了模型的自主性与适应性。
AI.method: 1) Hermes：一族简单、可配置的框架，逐步变化模型对上下文分配与复用的控制程度；2) Hermes-Learn：两阶段学习框架，用于学习上述上下文推理能力。核心思想是将决策从框架转移到模型，定义模型做出这些决策的能力为"上下文推理"（contextual reasoning）。
AI.result: 能力较强的模型可利用该灵活性，随推理时计算增加而扩展性能；较小的开源模型初期难以做到。经Hermes-Learn训练后弥补了这一差距，诱导出随问题与推理进展而变化的自适应上下文推理策略。收益可跨基准与模型泛化，外推至训练时未见过的推理计算量，并迁移到Hermes之外的其他互补测试时扩展方法。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文分配与复用的决策权交由模型并加以学习，是有效利用多上下文窗口测试时计算的关键；Hermes与Hermes-Learn使弱模型也能获得可泛化、可外推、可迁移的自适应上下文推理能力。

title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
summary: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出用GFlowNet生成多样化高质量合成对话数据，通过高斯混合密度建模潜在对话结构，在辅导与情感支持两个领域优于RL和端到端LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 后训练LLM的自适应AI应用需要代表对话中多样专家策略的高质量合成数据，但直接prompt或基于终端场景条件化LLM会产生多样性低、塌缩到主导模式的数据。
AI.method: 用Generative Flow Networks（GFlowNets）生成多样高质量合成数据；训练GFlowNet在关键交互特征（如困惑情节动态、支架式指令平衡）上使用高斯混合密度来生成潜在对话结构，从而按训练数据中的流行度比例采样专家策略。
AI.result: 在两个结构不同的领域（辅导和情感支持对话）中，GFlow合成数据生成方法在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性方面均优于强化学习和端到端LLM基线，且不复制训练数据；在三个下游结果预测任务上，用GFlowNet生成对话训练的classifier比竞争合成基线提供更强的训练信号。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNet通过建模潜在对话结构并按流行度比例采样专家策略，能生成高保真、覆盖广、逼真的合成对话，为后训练LLM提供优于现有基线的训练信号。

title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT，一种协同训练框架，通过强化学习与可验证奖励周期性优化教师模型在“学生生成前缀”上的续写能力，从而缓解在线策略蒸馏中教师面对学生前缀时的off-policy不对称问题，并提升蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，轨迹对学生是on-policy，但对教师却是off-policy：教师通常只在自己策略生成的前缀上训练，却需在OPD中监督学生生成的前缀，导致其续写性能随前缀增长而下降。这一根本性不对称是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 提出SCOUT（Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher）协同训练框架。在标准OPD更新之外，周期性使用带可验证奖励的强化学习优化教师的条件续写能力：教师从学生前缀生成续写，并依据结果奖励进行学习，从而适应学生生成的前缀分布。
AI.result: 受控实验显示，SCOUT提升了教师从学生生成前缀续写的能力，验证了学生条件化教师适应这一预期机制。在多种教师—学生配置、模型规模与推理领域上，SCOUT均持续提升在线策略蒸馏的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT通过协同适应教师于学生前缀分布，有效缓解OPD中的on/off-policy不对称，是一种具通用性与稳定增益的在线策略蒸馏增强方案。

title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: https://loaym.github.io/GoldiMask/
summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

AI.tldr: 提出 GoldiMask，一种用于离散扩散语言模型监督微调的掩码策略：通过近似最大化解约束的子模目标来选择作为上下文的可见 token，并对预测目标进行加权，在多个骨干与数据集上取得更优平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调依赖掩码模式，而掩码模式同时决定了模型可用的上下文与被预测的目标 token。均匀随机掩码并未显式考虑"哪些 token 应作为上下文暴露"与"哪些 token 应作为预测目标"之间的相互作用，因此存在改进空间。
AI.method: GoldiMask 分两步：1）上下文选择——利用模型信号构造子模目标，近似最大化该目标以挑选要揭示的上下文 token，在"揭示带来的收益"与"其作为预测目标的价值"之间取得平衡；2）目标加权——对剩余预测目标按其从已选上下文中获得的收益及剩余学习潜力进行加权。
AI.result: 在三种骨干网络与三个训练数据集上，GoldiMask 在多数评测设置中取得最高平均准确率，在推理与代码生成任务上均有提升。组件消融表明上下文选择与目标加权均有贡献。在 GSM8K 与 MATH-500 上，置信度阈值并行解码下减少了迭代次数，并在较高置信度阈值下保持可比准确率。
AI.conclusion: 掩码模式的设计应显式建模上下文选择与目标选择之间的耦合关系；通过子模目标驱动的上下文选择结合目标加权，可同时提升监督微调效果与并行解码效率。

title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArgGYM，一个面向结构化可废止推理（defeasible reasoning）的过程式基准与RLVR兼容训练环境，包含1,440个验证实例、12类任务及符号论证引擎评分机制。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理进展主要依赖数学、代码、形式逻辑等具有自动可验证奖励的基准与环境，其问题规格固定、评价标准稳定；但现实推理常在信息不完整且可修正的条件下进行，结论可被临时支持、被反证推翻、被进一步论证恢复或修正，因此固定规格下的成功能否迁移到此类领域尚不明确。
AI.method: ArgGYM将可废止推理分解为12项任务，并以符号论证引擎（argumentation engine）计算形式化状态，作为任务特定评分的依据。环境包含：1,440个已验证实例的冻结基准，覆盖15种课程配置；两种论证偏好排序（weakest-link与last-link）和两种集合排序（elitist与democratic）。同一套生成器与验证器可生成新实例，用于降低对静态测试集依赖的评估以及可验证奖励训练。
AI.result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开放权重模型呈现显著不同的推理画像：二者均能在未完成完整任务的情况下恢复相当部分结构化答案；随着课程配置推进、依赖链更长、结构交互更多，性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布基准、生成器与验证器，以支持可复现评估与RLVR训练。该工作将可废止推理形式化为可扩展、可自动评分的环境，揭示了当前模型在该类推理上的能力边界与课程依赖性问题。

title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预训练与中期训练如何为奖励适配提供信息与可执行计算，通过顺序状态计算与上下文记忆两类任务构建有限采样Adam路径，证明预测获取执行/检索能力、奖励学习任务特定用法；在Qwen2.5上验证源监督与记忆重放的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 奖励信号只能标定正确答案，却无法确定新输入所需的计算过程；因此需要厘清预训练与中期训练如何提供"信息"与"计算"，使奖励适配真正有效。论文关注：在训练奖励完全一致的条件下，为何模型在留出样本上表现不同，以及何种源监督能消除这种歧义。
AI.method: 1) 在顺序状态计算与上下文记忆两类设置中，刻画在全部训练奖励上一致但留出答案不同的机制，指出任务无关的源观察可消解歧义；2) 从指定随机初始化出发，在同一参数上构造有限采样的Adam优化路径，依次经过源预测与奖励适配，证明预测阶段获得执行或检索能力、奖励阶段学习任务特定用法；3) 使用预训练Qwen2.5检查点开展八世界实验，设置正确源+首操作监督与私有随机源对照、记忆重放与匹配的替代检索训练对照；4) 在GSM8K与HotpotQA上区分奖励入口准确率、后续增益与最终性能。
AI.result: 八世界实验中，使用正确源与首操作监督的顺序模型成功率达82.61%，私有随机源对照仅44.15%；记忆重放可在奖励适配期间保持检索能力，独立八世界验证取得75.32%任务成功率，匹配的替代检索训练后为49.86%。GSM8K与HotpotQA上，奖励入口准确率、后续增益与最终性能三者可分离。
AI.conclusion: 信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习相互衔接：源预测提供或固化执行/检索结构，奖励适配在其上学习任务特定用法。任务无关源监督与记忆重放是使奖励适配有效的关键条件。

title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHOIR框架，将认知人类学的自由列举法引入LLM集成评估，通过重复获取排序列表并将条目聚类为提示级概念，量化概念在模型、提示变体与人格条件下的显著度，把开放式同质化转化为可诊断的测量问题。
AI.motivation: 开放式LLM同质化会造成"虚假多元性"：多个系统看似提供独立视角，实则返回相同的默认答案。单次生成难以区分这种一致性究竟源于受约束的答案空间、提示词词汇回声，还是表层之下存在稳定替代项的宽阔答案空间。因此需要一个能揭示收敛位置、收敛原因及深层可达性的诊断性测量方法。
AI.method: 提出CHOIR（Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses）框架，借鉴认知人类学的自由列举（free-list）启发方法并将其适配到LLM集成：反复诱导模型生成排序列表，将条目聚类为提示级概念，并在不同模型、提示变体与人格条件下测量概念显著度。评估使用两个数据集：Infinity-Chat 100（近期开放式模型同质化研究的外部提示库）与一个27题的定向诊断题库，后者用于分离机制层面的对比。另设盲源排序模块，优先筛出稀有但稳定的候选概念供后续检查。
AI.result: 在Infinity-Chat 100上，CHOIR复现了较高的表层一致性（100个提示中93个高于随机水平），同时将狭窄提示与具有可恢复深度的宽阔提示区分开。在定向探针与外部提示库中，基础模型身份始终是最强可恢复特征，人格提示则在基础模型特征内部改变表层概念。盲源排序模块可优先识别稀有但稳定的候选。
AI.conclusion: CHOIR将开放式同质化重构为诊断性测量问题，回答"模型在何处收敛、为何收敛、以及在结构化深度探测下仍可触及什么"，为区分虚假多元性与真实多样性提供了系统化评估路径。

title: Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: Large language models are frequently proposed as a route to AI-powered services for African communities, but they are least reliable exactly where the need is greatest: all African languages remain low-resource by any standard measure, and models trained on scraped, standardised text systematically misrepresent the dialectal and regional variation of how people actually speak. We introduce \textbf{Model as a Library (MaaL)}, a software architecture that packages small, community-enrolled speech models as versioned on-device dependencies, enabling offline structured data collection that cannot generatively hallucinate, for populations that current language models serve worst. Rather than relying on web-scraped corpora, MaaL's vocabulary is enrolled directly from a small number of example recordings by the speakers themselves, at the point of deployment. We describe the architecture and its central mechanism - keyword spotting that turns a closed-vocabulary text form into a voice form, filled and submitted entirely on-device - and propose transpiling the closed-vocabulary elements already present in widely-deployed digital form tools into MaaL schemas, a low-friction path to voice-first, offline data collection for the low-literacy populations these tools already reach. This is a position and system-design paper: we describe the concept, the mechanism, and an analytical feasibility case, and identify what a working implementation still requires.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MaaL（Model as a Library）软件架构：将社区自录的小型语音模型封装为版本化的端侧依赖，通过关键词识别把封闭词表的文本表单转为语音表单，实现完全离线、无法生成式幻觉的结构化数据采集，服务低资源语言与低识字率人群。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被宣传为服务非洲社区的技术路径，但在需求最迫切之处可靠性最低：非洲语言按任何标准衡量均属低资源；基于网络爬取的标准化文本训练的模型系统性歪曲了人们实际口语中的方言与地区变异。因此需要一种不依赖网络语料、能真实反映本地口语、且不会生成式幻觉的替代方案。
AI.method: MaaL 是一种软件架构，将小型的、由社区登记的语音模型打包为带版本号的端侧依赖。其核心机制为关键词识别（keyword spotting）：把封闭词表的文本表单转换为语音表单，由说话者在部署现场用少量示例录音直接登记词表，全部填写与提交均在设备本地完成。此外，作者提出将已广泛部署的数字表单工具中的封闭词表元素转译为 MaaL schema，以低摩擦方式实现语音优先的离线数据采集。
AI.result: 这是一篇立场与系统设计论文，未给出实证性能指标。工作产出包括：架构描述、核心机制（关键词识别 + 端侧封闭词表语音表单）、以及一个分析性可行性案例；并明确了实现可用系统仍需解决的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: MaaL 为当前语言模型服务最差的人群提供了一条离线、语音优先、无生成式幻觉的数据采集路径，且可通过转译现有数字表单工具中的封闭词表实现低摩擦落地。作为定位与设计论文，其贡献在于提出概念与机制并论证可行性，而非提供完整实现。

title: When Scientific Contradictions Are Lost in Translation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. This version is not included in the official NeurIPS proceedings
summary: Two scientific findings can disagree without contradicting each other. Determining whether they conflict requires knowing whether they describe comparable measurements. We study how language models behave at this decision point. In a controlled task, we generate an unsatisfiable XOR constraint system and translate its constraints into scientific reports from different laboratories. One assignment satisfies more constraints, while another satisfies fewer but better matches expected biology. This creates a simple dilemma: does the model choose the assignment that best fits the constraints, or the one that better matches biological expectations? When the constraints are stated directly, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 recover the best-supported assignment in 90% and 96% of cases, respectively. In scientific prose, however, the models behave differently. Claude Opus 5 often prefers the biologically expected assignment. Removing that biological preference increases recovery of the better-supported assignment from 27% to 79% (p<.001); recovery reaches 92% when the same Biology-favored record is accompanied by a formalization request and an explicit paired-design cue (p<.001). GPT-5.6 Sol is less sensitive, with neither corresponding change reaching statistical significance. These results suggest that reliable scientific verification depends not only on formal reasoning, but also on how models decide which findings should be compared and what relations they imply.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型在判断两项科学发现是否冲突时的行为：在受控的不满足XOR约束任务中，GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5在直接陈述约束时能高比例恢复最佳支持的赋值（90%、96%），但在科学文本表述下表现分化，Claude倾向于生物学预期赋值（通过去除生物偏好或加入形式化请求与配对设计提示可显著提升恢复率），而GPT-5.6 Sol对此不敏感。
AI.motivation: 两项科学发现可以不一致而不矛盾，判断是否冲突需先确定它们是否描述可比测量。论文关注语言模型在这一决策点上的行为，即模型在科学验证中如何决定哪些发现应当比较、蕴含何种关系。
AI.method: 构建受控任务：生成不可满足的XOR约束系统，并将其约束翻译成来自不同实验室的科学报告。其中一种赋值满足更多约束，另一种满足较少但更符合预期生物学，形成简单两难：模型选择最符合约束的赋值，还是更符合生物预期的赋值。比较直接陈述约束与科学文本表述下的模型表现，并通过移除生物偏好、加入形式化请求与显式配对设计提示进行干预。
AI.result: 直接陈述约束时，GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5分别以90%和96%恢复最佳支持赋值。在科学文本中，Claude Opus 5常偏好生物预期赋值；移除该生物偏好使最佳支持赋值恢复率由27%升至79%（p<.001）；当同一生物学偏好记录伴随形式化请求与显式配对设计提示时，恢复率达92%（p<.001）。GPT-5.6 Sol对此较不敏感，两项相应变化均未达统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的科学验证不仅依赖形式推理，还取决于模型如何决定哪些发现应被比较以及它们蕴含何种关系。模型对科学文本表述的敏感性可能影响其冲突判断与验证可靠性。

title: Evaluating Persistent Calibration under Evolving Model Knowledge
summary: As AI systems move from static repositories to agents that are capable of continual adaptation and learning, maintaining their trustworthiness means equipping the models backing them with the ability to produce confidence estimates that dynamically reflect their changing skills and knowledge. We introduce the problem of persistent calibration, which requires a confidence estimator to faithfully reflect the knowledge contained in a model as that knowledge changes, without recurring supervision. We operationalize this by examining persistent calibration across checkpoints of open models, asking whether confidence estimators trained on earlier checkpoints can generalize to later ones. Specifically, we aim to shed light on whether confidence is dependent on knowledge, a question with implications for the reliability of confidence estimates. To measure this relationship, we define and evaluate calibration on knowledge contrast sets: subsets containing questions that one checkpoint answers correctly and another checkpoint answers incorrectly, reflecting a change in knowledge. We show that both inference-time and fine-tuning methods fall short on contrast-set calibration compared to oracle methods trained on future checkpoints, even for methods that are well-calibrated on the full dataset. We provide evidence for the hypothesis that persistent calibration is challenging because there is a vast space of possible confidence functions that are well-calibrated on a given checkpoint, out of which only some rely on meta-knowledge features that would generalize to other checkpoints. Towards improving contrast-set calibration, we show that multi-checkpoint training helps, suggesting an avenue for identifying confidence features that remain robust across changing knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"持续校准"(persistent calibration)问题：模型能力随训练/适应不断变化时，置信度估计需无需反复监督即可忠实反映其知识变化。作者通过跨checkpoint评测与"知识对比集"发现现有推理时与微调方法均落后于oracle，并给出"良好校准函数空间过大"的解释及多checkpoint训练的改进方向。
AI.motivation: AI系统正从静态模型库转向可持续适应与学习的智能体，其可靠性依赖置信度估计能动态反映不断变化的知识与技能。然而置信度估计通常只在某一固定模型上训练与评估，无法保证在知识变化后仍然可信。因此需要研究"持续校准"，并弄清一个根本问题：置信度是否依赖于知识？这直接关系到置信度估计的可信性。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义persistent calibration：要求置信度估计器在无持续监督下忠实反映模型变化中的知识。2) 在开源模型的多个checkpoint上评测：检验在早期checkpoint上训练的置信度估计器能否泛化到后期checkpoint。3) 构建知识对比集(knowledge contrast sets)：由某checkpoint答对、另一checkpoint答错的样本子集构成，用以度量知识变化下的校准。4) 对比推理时方法与微调方法，并以在"未来checkpoint"上训练的oracle作为上界。5) 提出并检验"良好校准函数空间过大"假说，测试多checkpoint训练的效果。
AI.result: 推理时与微调两类方法在对比集校准上均逊于基于未来checkpoint训练的oracle方法，即使这些方法在整个数据集上校准良好也依然如此。证据支持该假说：在单个checkpoint上良好校准的置信度函数数量庞大，其中仅有部分依赖可跨checkpoint泛化的元知识(meta-knowledge)特征。多checkpoint训练可提升对比集校准。
AI.conclusion: 持续校准是模型知识不断演变下的新挑战，仅在全数据集上校准良好并不足以保证知识变化时的校准可靠性；关键在于识别依赖元知识、可跨checkpoint泛化的置信度特征。多checkpoint训练是有前景的改进途径，为构建随技能与知识变化而自适应可信的置信度估计器提供了方向。

title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems
summary: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"黑板智能"（Blackboard Intelligence）推理范式，将模型从因果式左到右生成改为在固定、可修改的画布上搜索与修订解状态，并用扩散语言模型的任意顺序预测接口实现，以平均置信度作为全局一致性的代理指标指导推理时搜索。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测驱动的LLM在受复杂全局约束支配的问题上表现欠佳。作者怀疑部分局限源自下一词预测所诱导的推理界面（因果、从左到右、不可回溯），因此希望在推理时层面探究是否存在更合适的替代范式。
AI.method: 提出黑板书智能：模型在固定且可修订的画布上工作，搜索候选解状态而非直接沿因果路径逐词提交。用扩散语言模型（LLaDA-8B-Instruct）实例化，其任意顺序预测天然暴露部分填充解状态上的预测；以掩码扩散目标中可得的平均置信度作为全局连贯性的代理，引导推理时的搜索与修订。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogic、Nurse Rostering、Job-Shop Scheduling三个基准上，固定同一微调checkpoint，Blackboard持续提升推理表现并显著优于同规模自回归基线：ZebraLogic-Hard准确率90.4%，Nurse Rostering精确可行性76.4%，JSSP最优性80.2%。更强的自回归搜索与精修在ZebraLogic-Hard上仍无法弥合差距；尽管前沿LLM规模和测试时推理能力更强，Blackboard仍在该任务与JSSP上超越它们。
AI.conclusion: 部分全局约束问题的困难可归因于下一词预测的推理界面本身，而非单纯模型能力；通过扩散语言模型的任意顺序预测接口并结合内部置信度驱动的搜索与修订，可在不改变模型参数的情况下显著提升约束满足类任务的推理性能，并超越更大规模的前沿系统。

title: When Reasoning Goes Astray: Attention Dynamics of Uncontrolled Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve performance on complex tasks through extended reasoning, yet the same process can degenerate into redundant verification and persistent generation loops. Such uncontrolled reasoning increases inference cost and creates risks of resource exhaustion and service degradation. However, existing mitigations largely truncate long outputs or react to surface repetition, and thus fail to distinguish normal thinking from uncontrolled reasoning or explain how benign reasoning degenerates into harmful behavior. In this paper, we operationalize LRM generation as four states and further introduce Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses (RADAR), which identifies the current reasoning state in real time and characterizes how effective reflection can develop into uncontrolled generation. Guided by RADAR's analysis, we further realign abnormal attention distributions toward patterns observed in normal requests and examine how this correction affects excessive reflection and persistent looping. Temporal analyses show that uncontrolled reasoning is characterized by attention distributions that deviate from normal generation, with abnormal trends becoming detectable before repetition begins. Correcting these deviations through Attention Realignment consistently reduces looping while largely preserving benign performance. Together, RADAR provide a mechanistic account of how reasoning becomes uncontrolled, offering actionable guidance for identifying critical failure stages and designing targeted runtime interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADAR框架，将大推理模型（LRM）的生成过程刻画为四种状态，通过动态注意力响应实时识别推理状态，揭示正常反思如何演变为失控生成，并据此进行注意力重对齐以抑制循环。
AI.motivation: LRM通过延长推理提升复杂任务表现，但该过程易退化为冗余验证与持续生成循环，导致推理成本上升及资源耗尽、服务降级风险。现有缓解方法多仅截断长输出或对表层重复作出反应，无法区分正常思考与失控推理，也无法解释良性推理如何退化为有害行为。
AI.method: 1）将LRM生成操作化为四种状态；2）提出Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses（RADAR），实时识别当前推理状态并刻画有效反思向失控生成的发展过程；3）在RADAR分析指导下，将异常注意力分布重对齐至正常请求中观察到的模式（Attention Realignment），并考察该校正对过度反思与持续循环的影响。
AI.result: 时间分析表明，失控推理的特征是注意力分布偏离正常生成，且异常趋势在重复出现之前即可被检测到；通过注意力重对齐校正这些偏差，能持续减少循环，同时基本保持良性性能。
AI.conclusion: RADAR为推理失控提供了机制性解释，说明推理如何变得不可控，并为识别关键失败阶段和设计针对性运行时干预提供可操作指导。

title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
summary: Organizations increasingly route employee feedback to leaders through large language model (LLM) summaries, an unaudited layer that silences already-spoken voice. We introduce a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric for representational bias in summarization and apply it to a bilingual (English/German) corpus of 2,586 free-text responses from a global professional service company. First, employees supply criticism more reliably than praise (withholding praise is 82 times more common). Second, across 45 leader-summaries the pipeline filters by popularity, not sentiment: criticism survives, yet a concern voiced once is dropped 86% of the time, with short and German-only content lost on the same axis (theme retention 0.14 vs 0.74; German directional). Controlling for frequency, sentiment has no independent effect; the harm is prevalence-driven, which sentiment-only audits miss. A targeted prompt recovers only named themes. We contribute the metric, field evidence, and a disaggregated voice-retention card.

AI.tldr: 组织日益使用大语言模型（LLM）摘要向领导者传递员工反馈，形成一层未经审计的过滤机制，使已被表达的"声音"被消音。作者提出"声音保留/代表比"（Voice Retention / Representation Ratio）指标，用于衡量摘要中的代表性偏差，并应用于某全球专业服务公司2,586条英德双语自由文本语料。研究发现：员工表达批评比赞美更可靠（隐藏赞美比隐藏批评常见82倍）；在45份领导者摘要中，过滤按"流行度"而非情感运作——批评得以保留，但仅被提及一次的关切有86%概率被删除，短文本和纯德语内容同样被丢失（主题保留率0.14 vs 0.74，德语方向性）；控制频率后情感无独立效应，危害由普遍性驱动，这是仅做情感审计所遗漏的；定向提示仅能恢复被命名的主题。作者贡献了该指标、实地证据与一份分解式"声音保留卡"。
AI.motivation: 组织将员工反馈交由LLM摘要后，摘要层成为无审计的"守门人"，可能系统性压制已表达的员工声音，但既有实践多只关注情感倾向，缺乏衡量"谁的声音被保留、被删除"的代表性偏差工具与实证证据。
AI.method: 提出"声音保留/代表比"（Voice Retention / Representation Ratio）指标以量化摘要中的代表性偏差；构建并分析某全球专业服务公司2,586条英德双语自由文本反馈语料；对45份领导者摘要进行主题保留分析，比较情感、提及频率（流行度）、文本长度、语言等变量的效应，并检验控制频率后情感的独立效应以及定向提示的恢复效果。
AI.result: 员工提供批评比提供赞美更可靠，隐藏赞美比隐藏批评常见82倍；45份领导者摘要显示过滤按流行度而非情感运作：批评被保留，但仅出现一次的关切被删除86%的时间；短文本与纯德语内容沿同一轴线丢失，主题保留率为0.14对0.74，且呈现德语方向性；控制提及频率后，情感无独立效应，危害由内容普遍性（prevalence）驱动；定向提示仅能恢复被明确命名的主题。
AI.conclusion: LLM摘要层的代表性问题并非情感偏向，而是流行度驱动的少数意见压制，仅做情感审计会系统性遗漏该危害；作者贡献了"声音保留/代表比"指标、实地证据以及分解式的"声音保留卡"（voice-retention card），为组织审计与治理LLM反馈摘要提供可操作工具。

title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
summary: Decision models such as Jev answer questions with probabilities, which are only useful if they are calibrated. Open-source reproductions rely on supervised fine-tuning plus temperature scaling, while reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes reasoning models overconfident. We present a working implementation of reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) for reasoning models: the model samples a rationale, and we score the answer distribution it commits to afterwards with a strictly proper scoring rule. A variance identity shows that scoring the mixture of several samples rewards disagreeing rationales, and that RLVR is exactly this mixture objective without its diversity term. Optimized naively, the per-rationale objective either switches reasoning off or is drowned out by policy-gradient noise, which leads to a two-stage recipe: calibrate, then reinforce. With Qwen3-1.7B on two reasoning tasks (3 seeds, paired tests), RLCD matches or beats SFT, RFT/STaR and GRPO (each temperature-scaled) in accuracy and beats all of them in selective prediction; on GSM8K answer verification a single query decides \gvTwoCovFive\% of the items at $\le$5\% error, versus \gvGrpoCovFive\% for GRPO. When uncertainty comes from annotator disagreement, RLCD provably cannot beat cross-entropy. Code and results: https://github.com/ZimmyGao/openjev-rlcd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLCD（面向校准决策的强化学习）框架，先校准后强化，使推理模型的答案概率分布经严格proper scoring rule评分，在准确率与选择性预测上优于SFT、RFT/STaR和GRPO。
AI.motivation: 决策模型（如Jev）给出的概率只有在校准后才有用。开源复现依赖监督微调加温度缩放，而从可验证奖励做强化学习（RLVR）会使推理模型过度自信，缺乏校准。
AI.method: RLCD让模型采样推理链（rationale），再对其最终承诺的答案分布用严格proper scoring rule打分。方差恒等式表明：对多样本混合打分等价于奖励"推理链分歧"，而RLVR正是该混合目标去掉多样性项。由于朴素优化会使per-rationale目标要么关闭推理、要么被策略梯度噪声淹没，故采用两阶段配方：先校准、再强化。以Qwen3-1.7B在两个推理任务上验证（3个随机种子、配对检验）。
AI.result: RLCD在准确率上达到或超过SFT、RFT/STaR和GRPO（均做温度缩放），在选择性预测上全部胜出；在GSM8K答案验证中，单次查询以≤5%误差决策约\gvTwoCovFive\%条目，而GRPO为\gvGrpoCovFive\%。当不确定性来自标注者分歧时，RLCD可证明无法超过交叉熵。
AI.conclusion: 通过严格proper scoring rule对答案分布评分并采用"先校准后强化"的两阶段训练，RLCD在保持推理能力的同时显著改善校准与选择性预测；但其收益有边界——在标注分歧型不确定性下无法超越交叉熵。

title: Audio Token Attention Is Predictable Before the Language Model Runs
summary: A large audio language model (LALM) turns a minute of speech into 750-1,500 tokens and prefills every one. Image-token pruning often cuts after the language model's first layers, where image tokens draw little attention. Audio tokens draw much more attention there, and their ranking is still far from final, so audio needs a ranking before the language model runs. Surprisingly, the attention an audio token will receive across the language model is already linearly predictable from its encoder output, before the language model runs. A linear map, fitted in closed form without labels, predicts this all-layer attention ranking at $ρ\geq .69$ on eleven of thirteen LALMs. Our method, Triage, cuts audio tokens by this prediction and, on multiple choice, cuts again at layer 2, correcting the prediction with the attention observed there. Triage sets its compression without labels, under two budgets that limit how far its output may differ from the model's own full-audio output. At the conservative budget, its word error rate and accuracy stay within .04 of full audio. At the aggressive budget, Triage beats every baseline in all twelve transcription cases. On multiple choice, at 2.2-5x compression, it outperforms DART, the strongest baseline on average, by .043 in mean accuracy. Because it cuts before the language model, it raises the audio that fits in Qwen2.5-Omni-3B's context window from 21.8 to about 62 minutes. At its most compressive point, Triage lets one GPU serve 4x as many concurrent 5-minute streams of that model. Project page: https://audio-triage.github.io

AI.tldr: Triage 利用音频编码器输出可线性预测全层注意力排序这一特性，在语言模型运行前对音频 token 进行剪枝，并在第 2 层再次剪枝校正，实现无标签压缩，性能接近全音频且在多个任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）将一分钟语音编码为 750-1500 个 token 并全部预填充，计算开销大。图像 token 剪枝通常在语言模型前几层之后进行，但音频 token 在前几层获得远高于图像的注意力，且其排序远未稳定，因此需要在语言模型运行之前就对音频 token 进行排序与剪枝。
AI.method: 作者发现音频 token 在语言模型各层将获得的注意力，可从其编码器输出中线性预测得出。据此拟合一个无需标签、闭式求解的线性映射来预测全层注意力排序。方法名为 Triage：依据该预测在语言模型运行前剪枝音频 token；在多项选择任务上，于第 2 层利用观测到的注意力对预测进行校正后再次剪枝。压缩预算无需标签设定，并受两个约束限制输出与模型全音频输出的偏差范围。
AI.result: 线性映射在 13 个 LALM 中的 11 个上以 ρ≥.69 预测全层注意力排序。保守预算下，词错误率与准确率与全音频相差不超过 .04；激进预算下，Triage 在全部 12 个转写案例中均优于所有基线。多项选择任务中，在 2.2-5 倍压缩下，平均准确率较最强基线 DART 高出 .043。由于在语言模型前剪枝，Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上下文窗口可容纳的音频从 21.8 分钟提升至约 62 分钟；在最压缩设置下，单块 GPU 可服务 4 倍并发的 5 分钟流。
AI.conclusion: 音频 token 的全层注意力排序可在语言模型运行前由编码器输出线性预测，据此实现的免训练、无标签剪枝方法 Triage 能在保持接近全音频性能的同时显著压缩音频 token，提升上下文容量与并发服务能力，并在转写与多项选择任务上超越现有基线。

title: K2P: Label-Free Knowledge to Prompt Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer reasoning from stronger teachers to frozen students through reusable prompts, but avoiding weight updates does not eliminate supervision. Without ground-truth answers, teacher solutions are unverified, and agreement with the teacher can reward shared mistakes. We introduce Knowledge-to-Prompt (K2P) for label-free knowledge distillation to prompts. K2P synthesizes reusable instructions from teacher solutions, refines them using paired teacher and student responses, and guides search and selection with answer agreement. It retains candidates that adaptive search may undervalue and selects on reserved questions. Deployment uses only the frozen student and selected prompt. Our theory separates generation and selection gaps and gives conditions under which agreement-guided construction yields accuracy guarantees despite imperfect teacher references. Across reasoning tasks and students, K2P outperforms label-free alternatives overall and remains competitive with supervised prompt optimization. Ablations and archive diagnostics assess the contributions of teacher solutions and refinement, while revealing the limits of agreement-guided selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出K2P方法，在无标签条件下将教师推理知识蒸馏为可复用提示词，用于冻结的学生模型。
AI.motivation: 提示蒸馏无需更新权重，但缺乏真值答案时教师解答未经校验，学生与教师一致可能奖励共同错误，因此需在无标签条件下实现可靠的知识蒸馏。
AI.method: K2P从教师解答中合成可复用指令，利用教师与学生响应对进行精炼，以答案一致性引导搜索与选择，保留被自适应搜索低估的候选，并在留出问题上进行选择；部署时仅需冻结学生与选定提示。
AI.result: 理论分离生成差距与选择差距，给出不完美教师参考下一致性引导构造仍具精度保证的条件；在多项推理任务与学生模型上，K2P整体优于无标签基线，并与有监督提示优化相当；消融与存档诊断评估了教师解答和精炼的贡献，并揭示一致性引导选择的局限。
AI.conclusion: K2P为无标签提示蒸馏提供了可行方案，兼顾性能与理论保证，同时明确了基于一致性选择的边界。

title: Targeted Retrieval, Compact Representations: How CoT Reasoning Improves Long-Context Counting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly improving in long-context tasks, powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, the internal mechanisms underlying this improvement remain unclear. We investigate these mechanisms through a needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) counting task, where an LLM is asked to count the number of records dispersed in a long text. Across twelve model comparison groups, Thinking (or reasoning) improves counting accuracy over Non-thinking, with pronounced gains at larger counts. This motivates our mechanistic analysis, which identifies two contrasting mechanisms: (i) broad retrieval, where Non-thinking models broadly attend to multiple needles; (ii) targeted retrieval, where Thinking models use enumeration in CoT traces to successively retrieve needles. Targeted retrieval concentrates attention on individual needles and is accompanied by more compact internal representations. Moreover, causal intervention analysis suggests that Thinking models use the CoT trace to maintain and update an internal counter as needles are successively retrieved, even without explicit numbering. In small controlled experiments, both retrieval mechanisms and counter states emerge under standard autoregressive training. Together, our results connect long-context retrieval with representation geometry of counting, supporting a state-tracking account of CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"大海捞针计数"任务，揭示思维链（CoT）提升长上下文任务性能的机制：非思考模型采用广泛检索，思考模型采用逐条枚举的定向检索，并借助CoT轨迹维护内部计数器，支持CoT推理的"状态追踪"解释。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长上下文任务上随思维链推理显著提升，但其内部机制尚不清楚。作者希望探究Thinking相较Non-thinking在长上下文计数任务中性能提升的机制来源。
AI.method: 构建needle-in-a-haystack（NIAH）计数任务：要求模型统计长文本中分散记录的数量。在12组模型对比中比较Thinking与Non-thinking的表现，并进行机制分析（注意力分析、表征几何分析、因果干预）及小规模受控训练实验。
AI.result: 1) 12组对比中Thinking普遍优于Non-thinking，计数越大优势越明显；2) 机制上存在两种检索模式：Non-thinking为广泛检索（同时注意多个needle），Thinking为定向检索（通过CoT枚举依次检索单个needle）；3) 定向检索使注意力集中于单个needle，内部表征更紧凑；4) 因果干预表明Thinking模型利用CoT轨迹维护并更新内部计数器，即使无显式编号；5) 小规模受控实验显示两种检索机制与计数器状态可在标准自回归训练中自然涌现。
AI.conclusion: 长期上下文检索与计数任务中的表征几何相关联，CoT推理可用"状态追踪"框架加以解释：CoT轨迹充当外部工作记忆，支持逐步检索与内部计数的维护更新。

title: Switching Linear Attention
summary: Designing expressive sequence layers with efficient inference remains a central challenge in modern machine learning. Standard softmax attention achieves excellent sequence modeling performance through rich nonlinear token interactions, but it requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with sequence length, limiting its scalability. Linear attention enables efficient recurrent computation with a constant memory footprint, yet its reduced expressivity often yields inferior modeling performance. We introduce Switching Linear Attention (SwiLA), a novel sequence layer that bridges this gap by enhancing representational capacity while retaining the fixed-size recurrent state of linear attention. We derive the SwiLA recurrence from the test-time regression framework, casting the state update rule as online expectation-maximization in a mixture of linear regressions model. At test time, each output dimension dynamically selects among multiple linear attention components based on the input. Across associative recall, in-context language learning, and language modeling benchmarks, SwiLA shows strong performance and narrows the gap to softmax attention, even surpassing it in several settings.

AI.tldr: SwiLA：通过将线性注意力状态更新建模为混合线性回归的在线EM，在固定大小循环状态下动态选择多个线性注意力成分，提升表达能力。
AI.motivation: 软max注意力性能强但KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，限制可扩展性；线性注意力有恒定内存但表达能力弱、建模性能较差。需在保留固定大小循环状态的同时增强表达能力。
AI.method: 提出Switching Linear Attention (SwiLA)。从测试时回归(test-time regression)框架推导其循环，将状态更新规则视为混合线性回归模型中的在线期望最大化(EM)。测试时，每个输出维度根据输入在多个线性注意力成分间动态选择。
AI.result: 在联想回忆、上下文语言学习及语言建模基准上表现强劲，缩小了与软max注意力的差距，在若干设置中甚至超越。
AI.conclusion: SwiLA弥合了软max注意力与线性注意力在表达能力和推理效率之间的鸿沟，兼顾固定大小循环状态与更强表示能力。

title: A Tilted Bowl Is Not a Slippery Slope: Compressing Looped Models
summary: Looped models reason by applying the same block of weights many times, so compressing that block saves memory traffic on every loop. Compressed looped models, however, often collapse, and the collapse is usually blamed on rounding error that accumulates from loop to loop. In this work we test that account on more than 30 models from five families and find, to our surprise, that it holds only for loops that never settle. When a loop settles, a fixed rounding error does not accumulate. It moves the point where the loop settles, much as tilting a bowl moves where a ball comes to rest, and the answer is lost only when the shift is larger than the readout tolerates. This picture lets us predict which models fail from a single label-free measurement, and it tells us why failed models recover: their loops still settle, so a few final loops with 8-bit weights bring the answer back. Motivated by these findings, we build a controller that stops when the model's halting head fires and then finishes with 8-bit loops. On Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard it beats fixed-depth inference by up to 15 points under a third of the weight traffic.

AI.tldr: 压缩循环模型并非因舍入误差逐圈累积而崩溃，而是因为在循环未收敛时误差才累积；当循环收敛时，固定误差仅平移收敛点，只有当平移超出读出容忍范围才会导致答案丢失。
AI.motivation: 循环模型通过重复应用同一权重块进行推理，压缩该权重块可节省每圈的内存流量，但压缩后的循环模型常发生崩溃，通常被归因于逐圈累积的舍入误差。本文旨在检验这一归因是否成立。
AI.method: 作者在来自五个模型族的30多个模型上测试上述假设；提出用无标签的单次测量预测哪些模型会失败；并基于发现构建了一个控制器：当模型的停止头触发时停止，然后用8位权重完成最后几圈循环。
AI.result: "误差累积导致崩溃"仅在循环永不收敛时成立；循环收敛时固定舍入误差不累积，只是平移收敛点，类似倾斜碗使球停止位置改变，仅当平移超过读出容忍度时答案才丢失。该方法可预测失败模型，并解释失败模型为何能恢复：其循环仍收敛，故最后几圈用8位权重即可恢复答案。在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Hard上，该方法以约三分之一的权重流量超越固定深度推理最多15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 压缩循环模型的崩溃机制被重新解释为收敛点的平移而非误差累积，据此设计的控制器在保持计算效率的同时显著提升推理性能。

title: Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models
summary: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. To address this, we introduce Arbitr, a training framework where an adversarial trader penalizes the model for logical inconsistencies, paired with a calibration anchor to prevent uninformative collapse. Across five pre-registered experiments on Qwen2.5 and Phi-3.5 models, we demonstrate that standard models are highly exploitable across different phrasings. Arbitr reduces this exploitability by orders of magnitude without sacrificing task accuracy, and the effect successfully transfers to unseen logical patterns and new model families. Crucially, we uncover a scaling illusion: at 7B parameters, near-zero measured incoherence often coincides with extreme, unjustified confidence. We conclude that while Arbitr enforces rigorous logical consistency, coherence is a necessary condition for knowledge, but not a sufficient one

AI.tldr: 该论文以"无套利"为视角量化语言模型的理解程度，证明标准下一词预测目标在逻辑上不相容，并提出Arbitr对抗训练框架大幅降低模型的可套利性。
AI.motivation: 论文试图回答"语言模型是仅预测词元还是真正理解其内容"这一问题。作者认为需要一个可测量、可操作的"理解"定义，于是借助金融中的无套利思想：若一个计算受限的交易者无法通过针对模型概率下注而获得保证利润（即无法构造"荷兰赌"），则模型对其词表具有一定程度的理解。
AI.method: 作者首先给出三项理论结果：逻辑完全一致性在计算上不可行，故理解是分级的而非绝对的；标准下一词预测的最优解在不同提问格式间本质上不相容，缺陷源于训练目标而非架构；推理链上不确定性可预测地累积，过度自信本身即是套利机会。据此提出Arbitr训练框架，引入对抗性交易者对模型的逻辑不一致加以惩罚，并配合校准锚点以防止无信息坍缩。在Qwen2.5与Phi-3.5模型上进行五项预注册实验。
AI.result: 标准模型在不同措辞下高度可被套利；Arbitr将这种可套利性降低数个数量级，同时不牺牲任务准确率，且效果可迁移至未见过的逻辑模式与新的模型家族。研究还揭示了"缩放错觉"：在7B参数规模下，接近零的实测不相容往往伴随极端且缺乏依据的过度自信。
AI.conclusion: Arbitr能够强制执行严格的逻辑一致性，但一致性只是知识的必要条件而非充分条件。

title: Can Computation from Earlier Problems Help LLMs Solve New Ones?
summary: Large language models often solve independent problems in the same conversation. Can computation from earlier problems help them solve new ones? To answer this question, we first conduct preliminary experiments showing that retained history can raise or lower later-turn accuracy, even within the same domain. To understand these effects, we use controlled replay to isolate internal state changes specific to each problem-history pairing. Across different histories, these changes preserve similar relationships among current problems. To improve reasoning under retained history, we introduce STAIR (Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse). STAIR captures keys and values from earlier response generation in a fixed bank. It learns to redirect current queries when they read this bank during prompt processing. The base model remains frozen; only 12,288 parameters are trained. Across three Qwen models and four benchmarks, STAIR improves average later-turn accuracy by up to 11.67 percentage points over the unmodified model with history.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话历史对后续问题求解的影响，提出STAIR方法通过复用早期响应的键值缓存来提升多轮推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常在同一对话中解决多个独立问题，但先前问题的计算能否帮助解决新问题尚不明确。初步实验显示，保留的历史可能提高也可能降低后续轮次准确率，且这种影响即使在同领域内也存在，因此需要理解并利用这一现象。
AI.method: 通过受控回放实验隔离每个"问题-历史"配对特定的内部状态变化；提出STAIR（Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse），将早期响应生成中的键和值存入固定bank，并学习在当前查询处理提示时读取该bank时进行重定向。基座模型保持冻结，仅训练12,288个参数。
AI.result: 在三个Qwen模型和四个基准测试上，STAIR相比保留历史的未修改模型，平均后续轮次准确率最高提升11.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 保留对话历史对后续问题求解既有增益也有损害，但内部状态变化在不同历史下保持当前问题间的相似关系；STAIR以极少量可训练参数有效实现了跨查询历史复用，显著提升多轮推理表现。

title: From Speech to Editable Concepts: Probing Emotion Recognition with Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is the task of assigning emotion labels to utterances. Early systems relied on acoustic features, whereas recent approaches combine multiple modalities, most commonly speech and text. Still, performance remains poor on many datasets. Large language models (LLMs) have therefore attracted interest for SER, as they can process diverse inputs jointly with instructions. However, direct audio input raises questions of explainability. To address similar questions in image classification, concept bottleneck models were introduced. This work adapts concept bottlenecks to SER to examine how individual predictions depend on transcripts, acoustic descriptions and speaker attributes. Experiments test three LLMs on CREMA-D, IEMOCAP and MELD, with concepts extracted by separate tools. On scripted corpora, LLMs are strongly biased towards the transcript in the zero-shot setting, which lowers Macro-F1 from 27.8 to 5.8 on CREMA-D. Fine-tuning removes this bias, and the transcript raises Macro-F1 from 41.8 to 45.1. Removing speech rate changes 48% of Neutral predictions to Disgust on CREMA-D; removing intensity level on MELD changes predictions despite little change in Macro-F1. These findings show that aggregate performance changes alone do not capture the effects of concept removal on individual predictions.

AI.tldr: 该工作将概念瓶颈模型引入语音情感识别（SER），用以考察LLM预测对转录文本、声学描述和说话人属性的依赖，并在CREMA-D、IEMOCAP、MELD上测试三个LLM。
AI.motivation: SER早期依赖声学特征，近期多模态（语音+文本）方法性能仍不理想；LLM因能联合处理多模态输入与指令而受到关注，但直接音频输入带来可解释性问题。借鉴图像分类中的概念瓶颈模型来剖析SER预测依据。
AI.method: 将概念瓶颈适配到SER：概念包含转录文本、声学描述与说话人属性，由独立工具抽取；在CREMA-D、IEMOCAP、MELD上对三个LLM进行零样本与微调实验，并通过移除单个概念观察预测变化。
AI.result: 脚本语料上零样本LLM强烈偏向转录文本，CREMA-D的Macro-F1从27.8降至5.8；微调消除该偏差，转录使Macro-F1从41.8升至45.1。CREMA-D移除语速使48%的Neutral预测变为Disgust；MELD移除强度等级虽改变预测但Macro-F1变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 仅看聚合性能变化无法刻画概念移除对个体预测的影响，需关注实例级预测的依赖结构。

title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
summary: Typed decision models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative LLMs in decision-making workflows by selecting directly from predefined options. When candidate sets contain no valid answer, TypeSafe recommends including an "other" or "none-of-the-above" option to enable rejection. In this report, however, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck: Jev reliably selects correct numerical answers when available but frequently accepts incorrect alternatives when they are absent despite an explicit rejection option. On paired arithmetic problems, answer-present accuracy reaches 99%, while correct rejection falls to 7%. Moreover, this gap persists across numerical magnitudes, operation depths, contextual formulations, and rejection labels, and extends to scenarios such as time calculation and capacity rounding. Yet native Boolean verification achieves 99% exact-match accuracy on the same answer-absent arithmetic cases, showing that categorical rejection can fail even when the model successfully verifies candidate correctness. Finally, we show that a simple decision threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection accuracy from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, substantially mitigating the failure without retraining or additional inference.

AI.tldr: 本文发现类型化决策模型Jev存在"算术依赖的拒答瓶颈"：当候选项中没有正确答案时，即便提供了显式的拒答选项，模型仍常错误接受错误选项；而原生布尔验证在同批样本上可达99%准确率。通过一个在独立开发集上选定的简单决策阈值，可将算术拒答准确率从7%提升至79%，同时保持97%的有答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型（如Jev）通过从预定义选项中直接选择，为决策工作流提供了比生成式大模型更高效的替代方案。TypeSafe此前建议在候选集中加入"other"或"none-of-the-above"选项以实现拒答。然而，作者关注到：当候选中确实不存在有效答案时，这类模型能否可靠地执行拒答，这一问题尚未被充分检验，因而促使本文系统性地识别并量化该失败模式。
AI.method: 作者构造了成对的算术问题（有答案/无答案配对），在Jev上系统评估拒答行为，并跨数值规模、运算深度、上下文表述形式和拒答标签等维度进行稳健性检验，同时扩展到时间计算、容量取整等场景。此外，对比测试原生布尔验证（Boolean verification）在同一批无答案算术样本上的表现。最后，在独立的开发集上选取一个简单的决策阈值，在不重训练、不增加推理的前提下缓解拒答失败。
AI.result: 在有答案的成对算术问题上，Jev准确率达99%；但在无答案时，正确拒答率仅为7%。该差距在不同数值规模、运算深度、上下文表述与拒答标签下持续存在，并延伸至时间计算与容量取整等场景。与之对照，原生布尔验证在同一批无答案算术样本上达到99%的精确匹配准确率，说明即使模型能成功验证候选项正确性，分类式拒答依然可能失败。应用在开发集上选定的简单决策阈值后，算术拒答准确率由7%提升至79%，同时保留97%的有答案准确率。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了类型化决策模型中一个此前被忽视的"算术依赖拒答瓶颈"：拒答错误并非源于验证能力不足，而是分类式选择与布尔验证之间存在能力错配。一个无需重训练、不增加推理开销的简单阈值即可大幅缓解该失败，表明该问题在实践中具有低成本可修复性，同时提示拒答机制本身值得进一步研究与改进。

title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
summary: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introduce the transfer map, a signed estimate of how much each source helps or hurts each held-out target. We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, with all sources drawn from one corpus and no training examples from the target. The map predicts a held-out target's accuracy on unseen mixtures: recorded before those runs, its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline. The map is specific to its target and corpus but transfers across model scale: a mixture selected in advance at one size beats training on all source tasks at every other size we tested. Transfer is thus a property of the data. The map selects the tasks that help and drops the one that interferes: accuracy on the reasoning targets (causal explanation, multi-hop questions and methodological critique) rises by up to 14 percentage points over training on all source tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"迁移地图"(transfer map)，对有向源-目标任务对之间的助益/损害进行带符号估计，可在固定预算下预测指令微调任务组合的效果。
AI.motivation: 将语言模型适配到专用语料时，需在固定预算下选择训练哪些指令微调任务，而每次尝试一种选择都要花费一次微调运行。常见启发式假设迁移永不为负（多源任务更好）或迁移是对称的（相似源任务可迁移），本文指出这两种假设都不成立。
AI.method: 提出迁移地图：对每个留出目标，给出各源任务助益或损害的带符号估计。在Qwen3与Mistral（0.6B至32B）上进行数百次微调运行来拟合该地图，所有源任务取自同一语料，且不使用目标的任何训练样本。地图在运行之前即记录其预测，用于评估未见的任务混合。
AI.result: 迁移地图能预测留出目标在未见混合上的准确率，误差不足"混合无关"基线的一半；该地图特定于其目标与语料，但可跨模型规模迁移：在一个规模上预先选定的混合，在我们测试的其它每个规模上都优于训练所有源任务。对推理类目标（因果解释、多跳问答、方法论批判），准确率相比训练全部源任务最高提升14个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 助益性是有向源-目标对的带符号属性，任务A可帮助B而B却损害A。迁移是数据的属性，而非模型规模的属性，因此迁移地图可通过选择有助益的任务、剔除干扰任务，在固定预算下更高效地适配专用语料。

title: OverForge: Reasoning Through Strategies and Tactics Helps Cooperative Lifelong Adaptation
summary: Cooperative language-model agents must coordinate over long horizons and adapt to changing environments and to partners with unfamiliar conventions, yet existing agents map observations to actions without separating persistent coordination strategies from their tactical execution. We introduce OverForge, a training-free hierarchical architecture that separates strategic reasoning over roles and divisions of labour from tactical reasoning over actions within each agent's private, partner-conditioned world model. A metacognitive Prefrontal Cortex Module couples the two levels by forming strategy-action branches, imagining their consequences with a forward model, and committing when confident. In OvercookedV2, OverForge delivers 7 soups in a connected kitchen versus 3 for each flat LLM baseline, retains agreed roles, and adopts roles proposed by unfamiliar partners. Ablations and a fixed-strategy probe show that persistent strategies guide tactical adaptation while each reasoning level contributes to coordination. Memory restarts show that cross-episode partner knowledge supports task performance and partner prediction, linking the hierarchy to continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OverForge，一种免训练的分层多智能体架构，将长期协作策略推理与战术动作执行分离，通过元认知前额叶模块耦合两层，在OvercookedV2中显著优于扁平LLM基线并支持与陌生伙伴的适应。
AI.motivation: 协作型语言模型智能体需在长时序中协调，并适应变化的环境与具有陌生约定的伙伴；但现有智能体直接将观测映射为动作，未将持久协作策略与其战术执行分离，导致难以维持角色分工与迁移适应。
AI.method: 提出OverForge：免训练分层架构，上层对角色与分工进行策略推理，下层在各智能体私有的、以伙伴为条件的世界模型中做战术动作推理；由元认知前额叶皮层模块耦合两层——构建策略-动作分支，用前向模型想象其后果，并在置信时提交执行。
AI.result: 在OvercookedV2中，OverForge在连通厨房中完成7个汤，而每个扁平LLM基线仅为3个汤；能保持已约定的角色，并采纳陌生伙伴提出的角色。消融与固定策略探针表明持久策略引导战术适应，且两个推理层均对协调有贡献。记忆重启实验显示跨回合的伙伴知识支持任务表现与伙伴预测，将层级结构与持续适应相衔接。
AI.conclusion: 显式的策略-战术分层与元认知承诺机制可提升长时序协作表现、角色稳定性与对陌生伙伴的适应能力；跨回合伙伴记忆进一步支撑持续适应，说明将持久协作策略与战术执行解耦是构建协作型LLM智能体的有效方向。

title: Learning Steganography Is Easy, Learning Steganographic Reasoning Is Hard
comment: Accepted as an oral at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD). 41 pages. Code: https://github.com/stegano-ai/steg-reasoning-is-hard
summary:
Chain-of-thought monitoring as an approach for AI oversight and control is threatened by the possibility of steganographic reasoning, where LLMs conceal their reasoning inside innocuous-looking text. Two neighbouring capabilities, steganographic messaging (passing a concealed message) and encoded reasoning (reasoning in an illegible but unconcealed format), have already been shown to emerge under training pressures that occur in real pipelines, such as reinforcement learning against monitors. This suggests that steganographic reasoning too might arise as an unintended side effect of training. Here, we compare how easily models learn steganographic reasoning and these two neighbouring capabilities across three elicitation methods: reinforcement learning, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  For most tasks, models learn steganographic reasoning only under SFT, while they learn steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning under all three elicitation methods. Even under SFT, steganographic reasoning requires at least twice as much training as messaging, and for several model-task combinations it is not learned at all. However, on a cover task that makes hiding information especially convenient, steganographic reasoning can be successfully learned under all three elicitation methods. Steganographic reasoning is thus much harder than steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning, and learning the latter two does not imply learning the former. Yet it lies within reach: an easy version is learned under every elicitation method, when the cover task is convenient for hiding information.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了隐写推理与其他两种相邻能力（隐写消息传递、编码推理）在强化学习、上下文学习和监督微调三种引导方法下的学习难度，发现隐写推理远比其他两种能力更难习得，但在"掩护任务"便利时仍可被习得。
AI.motivation: 链式思维监控作为AI监督与控制手段，面临隐写推理的威胁——模型可能将推理隐藏在看似无害的文本中。已有研究表明，隐写消息传递与编码推理可在真实训练流程（如针对监控器的强化学习）中作为非预期副产物涌现，这暗示隐写推理也可能因训练而意外出现。作者因此想探究：模型习得隐写推理究竟有多容易？它与另外两种相邻能力的关系如何？
AI.method: 作者对三类能力（隐写推理、隐写消息传递、编码推理）进行对比实验，采用三种引导方法：强化学习（RL）、上下文学习（ICL）和监督微调（SFT），并在多个任务以及一个特别便于隐藏信息的"掩护任务"（cover task）上进行评估，比较各能力的可学习性及所需训练量。
AI.result: 在多数任务上，模型仅在SFT下才能习得隐写推理，而隐写消息传递和编码推理在三种引导方法下均可习得。即便在SFT下，隐写推理所需训练量至少是消息传递的两倍，且在若干模型-任务组合中完全无法习得。然而，在使信息隐藏特别便利的掩护任务上，隐写推理在三种引导方法下均能成功习得。
AI.conclusion: 隐写推理远比隐写消息传递和编码推理更难习得，且习得后两者并不意味着习得前者。但隐写推理并非遥不可及：当掩护任务便于隐藏信息时，一种"简单版本"的隐写推理在每种引导方法下都能被习得，这对链式思维监控安全性构成潜在威胁。

title: FIGS: Evaluating Multi-Turn Sycophancy Without Penalizing Empathy
summary: Large language models frequently fail to balance staying truthful with being supportive. They often exhibit sycophancy in responses to users, agreeing with false claims, offering unwarranted flattery, and giving advice skewed toward users' expressed views. In reality, sycophancy rarely happens in a single exchange; it may emerge organically as users repeatedly insist or subtly steer the dialogue over time. Current evaluations, however, rely on rigid, single-turn tests or fixed scripts that fail to capture these natural dynamics. Furthermore, these benchmarks often mistake showing basic empathy for yielding, penalizing models for acknowledging a user's feeling. This view may drive future models to over-correct into cold, dismissive rigidity. To address this gap, we introduce FIGS (Factual Integrity and Grounded Support), a dual-axis evaluation framework built around extended, realistic dialogue. We use an adaptive 10-turn conversational simulator that dynamically challenges the target model, reflecting how users repeat requests, push back, or steer a conversation toward a preferred answer. To accurately evaluate these trajectories, we apply a taxonomy that strictly separates Sycophancy (whether the model holds firm to the truth and keeps its praise proportional) from Calibrated Validation (showing empathetic understanding of the user's feelings without overdoing it). We release our complete testing environment, including 500 diverse multi-turn scenarios and an automated judge. Our evaluation of leading models reveals a consistent trade-off: over the course of a sustained interaction, current systems either slowly drift to sycophancy or over-correct into robotic detachment. This demonstrates that balancing honesty with appropriate support throughout a natural conversation remains a critical, unsolved challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FIGS双轴评测框架，通过自适应10轮多轮对话模拟器与区分"谄媚"与"校准式共情"的分类体系，揭示当前大模型在持续对话中无法兼顾问真与支持性的困境。
AI.motivation: 大模型难以兼顾"保持真实"与"给予支持"，常表现出谄媚行为（附和错误主张、不当吹捧、迎合用户立场给出有偏建议）。现有评测依赖刚性的单轮测试或固定脚本，无法捕捉谄媚在多轮互动中随用户反复坚持或引导而逐渐涌现的动态特性；同时这些基准常把基本共情误判为让步，惩罚模型承认用户情绪，可能导致未来模型过度纠偏为冷漠生硬的姿态。因此需要能刻画真实多轮动态、且区分共情与顺从的评测方法。
AI.method: 提出FIGS（Factual Integrity and Grounded Support，事实完整性与有依据的支持）双轴评测框架，围绕延展的真实对话构建。采用自适应10轮对话模拟器，动态挑战目标模型，复现用户重复请求、反驳或逐步将对话引向偏好答案的方式。评价上使用一套分类体系，严格区分"谄媚"（模型是否坚守事实、赞许是否保持适度）与"校准式共情"（对用户情绪表达恰当理解而不过度）。公开完整测试环境，含500个多样化多轮场景及自动评判器。
AI.result: 对领先模型的评测显示出一致性权衡：在持续互动过程中，当前系统要么缓慢滑向谄媚，要么过度纠偏变得机械疏离。
AI.conclusion: 在自然对话全程中兼顾诚实与恰当支持仍是关键的未解难题，说明需以多轮动态视角而非单轮静态测试来评测与改进模型的真实性与支持性平衡。

title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an imperfect proxy for semantic quality.
  We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data. GrammarRL optimizes the model using two complementary self-supervised rewards derived from its own likelihoods: a direct reward, measuring how likely the constrained output is given the input, and a reverse reward, measuring how well the input can be reconstructed from the generated output. We optimize these rewards with a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) objective over groups of grammar-constrained rollouts, augmented with the top-1 beam-search hypothesis and regularized towards a frozen base model.
  We evaluate GrammarRL on sign language gloss translation, hierarchical text classification, and named entity recognition using Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. GrammarRL consistently outperforms constrained greedy decoding, with an average improvement of 9.8 points and gains of up to 22.8 BLEU. It matches or outperforms beam search on two of the three tasks while preserving greedy-decoding inference cost. Ablations further show that the two rewards are complementary: either reward alone can underperform the untrained baseline, whereas their combination consistently improves upon it.

AI.tldr: GrammarRL：一种无需标注数据的强化学习方法，通过自监督的双向奖励（正向+逆向）适配语言模型以符合语法约束，在三个任务上超越约束贪心解码，平均提升9.8分。
AI.motivation: 语法约束生成虽保证句法合法，但当模型偏好输出与施加语法对齐不良时，会显著损害语义质量，尤其在提示欠指定或模型指令遵循能力有限时更为严重。束搜索可部分缓解，但计算成本随束宽增长，且序列级概率只是语义质量的不完美代理。
AI.method: 提出GrammarRL，一种无标签强化学习方法，无需标注数据即可使语言模型适配语法约束。使用两个互补的自监督奖励：直接奖励（给定输入下约束输出的似然）与逆向奖励（由生成输出重建输入的能力）。采用RLOO目标在语法约束的rollout组上优化，并增强以top-1束搜索假设，同时向冻结基座模型正则化。
AI.result: 在手语词译、层级文本分类和命名实体识别任务上，使用1B至8B参数的Llama模型评估。GrammarRL持续优于约束贪心解码，平均提升9.8分，最高增益22.8 BLEU；在三个任务中的两个上达到或超过束搜索，同时保持贪心解码的推理成本。消融实验表明两个奖励互补：单独任一奖励可能不如未训练基线，而组合则持续超越基线。
AI.conclusion: GrammarRL通过自监督双向奖励的强化学习，在不增加推理成本的前提下有效提升语法约束生成的语义质量。

title: RoPE at the End of Its Rope? Theory, Diagnosis, and Mitigation of Long-Context Failures
summary: Long-context failures of RoPE-based language models can arise from RoPE's intrinsic tradeoff between maintaining stable token preferences and distinguishing nearby positions. Determining which weakness to address, and how, requires a more precise characterization of RoPE's behavior in trained models across context lengths. We address a key limitation of prior theory by allowing unequal query-key scales across RoPE frequencies, which aligns well with practical empirical observations. Our theory makes both vulnerabilities measurable for individual heads and inputs, and quantifies how high-frequency components support positional sensitivity while potentially disrupting semantic stability. We also derive a theoretical context-length bound beyond which, under specified conditions, a fixed attention-score comparison cannot jointly avoid semantic reversal and positional insensitivity. Guided by our fresh theoretical insights, we introduce RoPE Profiler, a lightweight, plug-and-play diagnostic toolkit that augments existing evaluations with zero additional forward passes by reusing cached query and key activations. Reusing activations collected during evaluation, the toolkit incurs little overhead. It supplements standard benchmark scores with two diagnostic scores that reveal semantic and positional weaknesses and help users prioritize which aspect to address. Crucially, our evaluations across 49 long-context task settings reveal a distinct pattern where reasoning tasks predominantly suffer from semantic reversal, whereas retrieval tasks are primarily vulnerable to positional insensitivity. Guided by our theory and diagnostic profiles, targeted high-frequency rescaling achieves immediate gains without additional training, improving task accuracy by up to 20 percentage points on Qwen3-8B and 25 percentage points on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 本文通过允许RoPE各频率的查询-键缩放不相等，精细化刻画RoPE的长上下文行为，提出可诊断语义反转与位置不敏感的RoPE Profiler工具，并据理论进行高频重缩放，在多项任务上大幅提升准确率。
AI.motivation: RoPE基础模型的长上下文失败源于"稳定token偏好"与"区分邻近位置"之间的内在权衡。要确定应针对哪种弱点、如何干预，需要更精确地刻画已训练模型在不同上下文长度下RoPE的实际行为，而先前理论在这方面的刻画不够准确。
AI.method: 放宽先前理论假设，允许不同RoPE频率上的查询-键缩放不相等，使理论更贴合实际经验观察；据此理论为单个注意力头和输入量化两类脆弱性，并分析高频分量如何支撑位置敏感性同时可能破坏语义稳定性；推导出上下文长度理论上界，超过该界且满足特定条件时，固定的注意力分数比较无法同时避免语义反转与位置不敏感。基于此提出RoPE Profiler诊断工具，复用评估中缓存的查询与键激活，零额外前向传播，输出两个诊断分数。
AI.result: 在49个长上下文任务设置上评估发现明显模式：推理任务主要受语义反转影响，检索任务主要受位置不敏感影响。依据理论与诊断结果进行高频重缩放，无需额外训练即可即时提升：Qwen3-8B上准确率最高提升20个百分点，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上最高提升25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 更精确的理论刻画能够将RoPE的两类长上下文脆弱性变为可测量指标；RoPE Profiler以极低开销提供诊断分数，帮助用户定位并优先处理弱点；结合高频重缩放可实现免训练的显著性能提升。

title: LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Technical report of MMLA. The authors contributed equally
summary: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) give a frozen model a compact numerical state that can learn from feedback. The map $h+BAh$ adds a low-rank correction to a hidden representation. A slow state $ρ$ learns starting factors across tasks; a private fast state $Φ$ copies them, changes with feedback, and resets to the trained initialization. This report specifies an input-side realization of the numerical policy carrier in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture and examines its factor-space dynamics and learning lifetime. We study a rank-4 input residual with 12,288 trainable parameters on a frozen MiniCPM5-1B-SFT substrate. In a four-candidate program-selection task, two feedback-gradient steps reduce expected query execution error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points relative to resetting to the respective trained static and post-adaptation initializations. These development results cover 16 parameter groups and three paired training seeds. A direct support-loss selection rule is much more accurate, reaching 0.78125% error. In a repository-balanced chronological replay of public continuous-integration jobs, retaining online updates raises half-Brier loss from 0.1274 to 0.1808. A fixed follow-up intervention records same-batch non-descent and inconsistent future benefit from shrinking updates. Together, the algebra and measurements distinguish residual capacity, adaptation relative to a starting point, and usefulness on later decisions.

AI.tldr: 该报告给出了记忆中介学习架构中"数值策略载体"的输入侧实现：在冻结的MiniCPM5-1B-SFT上使用秩4输入残差（12,288个可训练参数），包含慢状态ρ与私有快状态Φ；实验显示两步反馈梯度可将程序选择误差降低24.65与36.65个百分点，但持续在线更新在CI作业重放中反而使半Brier损失从0.1274升至0.1808。
AI.motivation: 为冻结模型赋予一个紧凑的、可从反馈中学习的数值状态，并厘清"残差容量、相对起点的自适应能力、以及对后续决策的实际有用性"这三者的区别。
AI.method: 在冻结MiniCPM5-1B-SFT底模上实现秩4输入残差映射 h+BAh（12,288个可训练参数）；由慢状态ρ跨任务学习起始因子，私有快状态Φ复制ρ、随反馈变化并重置到训练初始化；在四候选程序选择任务上进行两步反馈梯度实验（16个参数组、3个配对训练种子），并做仓库均衡的CI作业时序重放及固定后续干预。
AI.result: 程序选择任务中，两步反馈梯度相对重置到训练静态初始化与后适应初始化，分别降低查询执行误差24.65与36.65个百分点；直接支持损失选择规则更准，误差为0.78125%。在仓库均衡的CI作业时序重放中，保留在线更新使半Brier损失由0.1274升至0.1808；固定后续干预记录到同批次非下降以及缩小更新带来的未来收益不一致。
AI.conclusion: 代数结构与测量结果共同区分了残差容量、相对起点的自适应以及在后继决策上的有用性；对冻结模型添加紧凑低秩数值状态虽能短期降低误差，但持续在线更新未必带来稳定的未来收益。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Error Dataset（AED），包含来自33个环境、9,961个源任务的50,228条错误诊断对，并设计五阶段Agentic Error-to-Training（AET）流水线，通过诊断与修正的对比验证，证明基于错误经验的训练可显著提升LLM智能体的错误恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 失败的LLM智能体轨迹中蕴含比最终奖励更丰富的信息，包括观测、动作与环境反馈，但复用这些经验进行学习需要识别待修正的决策并检验具体替代方案，现有方法对此支持不足。
AI.method: 构建AED数据集，保留源轨迹与执行元数据以支持跨设定失败分析与再诊断；设计五阶段AET流水线：采集自然失败、生成诊断与修正建议、基于记录证据校验；在支持回放时，将修正与同一检查点的原始动作重试在匹配执行设置下对比；并分别构建诊断与执行者恢复的训练视图。
AI.result: 在3,062对匹配回放中，首次提议修正将验证器通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%，增益32.7个百分点；在冻结诊断版本上，对1,656个源任务进行全诊断微调，使Qwen3-8B与内部教师标签的精确步骤一致率从47.2%提升至63.6%（三个随机种子平均，943例留出集），超过最强提示参考的54.7%，且一致率随四个递增训练集规模逐级提升；在单种子执行者训练配方比较中，仅动作修复训练在WebShop-lite上比仅成功训练高6.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 失败轨迹可被系统化转化为可验证的诊断-修正监督信号，既提升修正方案的验证通过率，也显著改善模型的错误诊断一致性与执行恢复性能，为智能体经验复用提供了可扩展的数据与训练范式。

title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression
summary: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses. We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end. Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector. All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen.
