Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved. After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor. In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values. Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases. At -70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline. The factorized model decodes up to 1.6x faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5x at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5x for untied baseline factorizations.

AI.tldr: 提出可学习子空间投影（LSP），端到端学习每层丢弃的子空间，替代局部闭式准则，在高压缩下显著优于现有低秩分解方法。
AI.motivation: Transformer 内存与计算开销大，低秩权重分解可保持稠密矩阵、适配标准硬件。但现有方法用局部闭式准则（激活能量、逐层重构误差、损失的二次近似）选择待移除子空间，忽略误差在网络中的传播，高压缩时误差随深度累积导致性能崩溃。
AI.method: 为每个线性层（或读取相同激活的绑定层组）分配一个正交投影器，所有投影器针对全局目标联合优化——即对稠密模型输出分布的 KL 散度或原始训练损失，同时冻结预训练权重。投影器由白化 SVD 截断初始化，秩按每个投影器单位参数节省所诱导的输出 KL 分配。训练后将投影器合并为标准低秩因子，每个绑定组共享一个因子；在注意力中可缓存单个窄潜变量替代完整 K、V。
AI.result: 在 OPT-125M/1.3B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-2-7B 及 ViT-B/16 上，LSP 优于基线且优势随压缩率增大而扩大。70% 压缩下 Llama-2-7B 达 10.9 WikiText-2 困惑度与 42.2% 平均零样本准确率，最强基线为 13.3 与 36.0%。小批量下分解模型解码最高快 1.6 倍；缓存共享潜变量在 128k 上下文下将权重与 KV 缓存总内存缩减 13.5 倍，非绑定基线分解最多 6.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 端到端学习子空间投影能有效缓解深层误差累积，在高压缩率下保持性能，同时带来解码加速与显著的内存缩减。

title: Cheap to Draw, Expensive to Trust: Certifying Test-Time Scaling Curves
summary: Sampling several answers and keeping the one a verifier scores highest is one of the simplest ways to buy accuracy at test time. Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: accuracy against the number $k$ of sampled answers. The curve is cheap to draw and expensive to trust. A budget read off it is chosen after looking at every point, so only a band that covers all budgets at once protects the choice, and on a 100-question benchmark a fixed exact-binomial design needs 192,000 generated answers to certify 64 budgets to within $\pm1/32$ at 95%. Most of that cost pays for the wrong uncertainty. A benchmark is a fixed list of questions; at budget 64, about three quarters of the variance of a selected answer's correctness lies between questions, and an audit that revisits every question need not pay for it. We derive the minimax cost of certifying the whole curve, up to logarithmic factors. It has three parts: calibrating the tail of the score distribution, telling the questions apart, and within-question noise summed along the curve. At a single benchmark the last part sharpens to the variance of one answer's influence under the best allocation of answers to questions, which every valid audit pays and an audit that learns the allocation attains, up to a logarithm, as the precision grows. A paired audit built on an exponential inequality for two independent draws at the same question needs no pilot. On 185 held-out score pools it uses 0.74 times the answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at 64 budgets and 0.53 times at 1,024, and on a newly generated MMLU-Pro study it certified the curve with 79,133 answers, within 0.6% of what a cost law fitted beforehand predicted from the study's within-question variance. The same paths certify pass@$k$ and majority voting, and the bands extend to populations of questions and to answers that depend on earlier ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在测试时通过采样多答案并用验证器打分选出最优答案的"预算缩放曲线"（准确率对采样数k），提出对整条曲线同时进行认证的极小极大成本理论，并给出一种无需预实验的配对审计方法。
AI.motivation: 缩放曲线虽易绘制却难以被信任：预算是在观察了所有点之后才选取的，因此只有能同时覆盖所有预算的置信带才能保护该选择；现有固定精确二项设计成本极高，且在100题基准上认证64个预算到±1/32（95%置信）需生成192,000个答案，其中大部分代价花在了错误的方差来源上。
AI.method: 作者推导了认证整条曲线的极小极大成本（对数因子范围内），将其分解为三部分：分数分布尾部的校准、区分不同问题、以及沿曲线的题内噪声之和。在单个基准上，第三部分精化为"最优答案-问题分配下单个答案影响力的方差"，任何有效审计都必须支付该代价，而学习该分配的审计可达到该下界（至多相差对数项）。据此提出基于同一问题上两个独立抽样之间的指数不等式的配对审计，无需预实验。
AI.result: 在185个留出评分池上，该方法在64个预算下仅用最便宜的竞争认证审计的0.74倍答案量，在1,024个预算下为0.53倍；在新生成的MMLU-Pro研究中，以79,133个答案认证了曲线，与事先从该研究题内方差拟合的成本律预测值相差在0.6%以内。
AI.conclusion: 该审计路径同样可认证pass@k与多数投票，置信带可扩展到问题总体以及依赖先前答案的答案情形。

title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds
summary: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhantomEnvironments：一种完全由规则生成、无需LLM、零边际成本的虚构世界多轮强化学习环境，用于训练LLM搜索智能体。虽然环境不含任何真实世界事实，训练的智能体却能迁移到真实多跳搜索基准，且搜索预算随问题难度近似线性增长。
AI.motivation: 训练LLM智能体的RL方法受制于环境：环境需提供可验证奖励、支持长时程交互并可低成本扩展。现有方案依赖昂贵的人工标注数据，或依赖LLM生成环境，但后者易产生幻觉与基准污染。作者希望探索一种无需LLM、零成本且可扩展的环境生成范式。
AI.method: 构建 PhantomEnvironments：基于规则自动生成虚构世界中的模板化文章语料，构成多轮RL环境，智能体需在语料中检索以回答多跳问题。环境生成完全不使用LLM，边际成本为零。随后在此环境上训练LLM搜索智能体，并评测其向真实世界多跳搜索基准的迁移能力；同时分析未见虚构宇宙的泛化性与搜索预算随难度的缩放行为，并消融环境复杂度（跳数、约束、比较等）对迁移的影响。
AI.result: 在虚构环境中训练的智能体可迁移到真实世界多跳搜索基准，在新基准上常优于真实世界数据训练的效果；能泛化到未见过的虚构宇宙；Qwen模型学会了随问题难度近似线性扩展搜索预算，显示出仅由环境交互产生的涌现式搜索缩放。消融表明跳数对迁移的驱动作用大于约束或比较等其他复杂度因素。
AI.conclusion: 规则生成的合成环境即使极为简单，也是训练可泛化LLM智能体的高效且免费资源；多跳结构（跳数）是驱动迁移的关键因素，表明无需LLM生成或人工数据即可获得强搜索智能体。

title: Distribution Matching Distillation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate all tokens in parallel, yet high-quality generation can still require hundreds of network evaluations (NFEs). We study how distributional distillation can reduce this cost by exploiting the student's probabilistic token outputs. Our unified formulation connects the student's output parameterization to the resulting gradient estimators and yields two methods with the same student architecture and reverse-KL matching objective: Simplex-DMD uses continuous token relaxations and pathwise gradients, while Reinforce-DMD uses categorical sampling and REINFORCE with a learned density ratio. We develop both methods for multi-step generation and investigate the training and sampling choices associated with each parameterization. On OpenWebText, for sequences of 1,024 tokens, Simplex-DMD achieves a generative perplexity of 45.6 at a unigram entropy of 5.44 nats in just 4 NFEs, a 49% reduction relative to the strongest evaluated diffusion baseline at matched entropy and sampling budget. Reinforce-DMD improves the frontier at larger budgets, reaching a generative perplexity of 14.9 at an entropy of 5.00 nats with 256 NFEs, a 20% reduction under the same comparison protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究连续扩散语言模型的分布蒸馏,提出统一框架连接输出参数化与梯度估计器,得到 Simplex-DMD 和 Reinforce-DMD 两种方法,在匹配熵和采样预算下大幅降低生成困惑度。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型虽可并行生成全部 token,但高质量生成仍需数百次网络评估(NFEs),计算成本高;作者希望利用学生模型的概率化 token 输出来进行分布蒸馏,以降低这一成本。
AI.method: 提出统一公式,将学生模型的输出参数化与其对应的梯度估计器联系起来,在相同学生架构和 reverse-KL 匹配目标下导出两种方法:Simplex-DMD 采用连续 token 松弛与路径梯度(pathwise gradients);Reinforce-DMD 采用类别采样与带学习密度比的 REINFORCE。两者均针对多步生成开发,并研究各自参数化相关的训练与采样选择。
AI.result: 在 OpenWebText 上,长度为 1,024 token 的序列中,Simplex-DMD 仅用 4 次 NFE 即达到生成困惑度 45.6(unigram 熵 5.44 nats),在匹配熵和采样预算下相较最强扩散基线降低 49%;Reinforce-DMD 在更大预算下改进前沿,以 256 次 NFE 达到生成困惑度 14.9(熵 5.00 nats),同一比较协议下降低 20%。
AI.conclusion: 分布蒸馏可有效降低连续扩散语言模型的 NFE 成本,且不同输出参数化(连续松弛与类别采样)对应不同的性能—预算权衡:Simplex-DMD 适合极小预算,Reinforce-DMD 在较大预算下更优。

title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproducibility crisis. Benchmarks are based on complex infrastructure with varying machine and container configurations that confound the evaluation of the execution speed of CUAs. Towards addressing this gap, we propose cua-speedrun, which introduces standardized infrastructure and task sets, with a focus on evaluating the speed and efficiency of CUAs. cua-speedrun uses a uniform virtual machine setup and execution pipeline, along with a common agent interface that enables single-agent implementations to operate seamlessly across different benchmarks. Across four different CUA benchmarks, we evaluate how reasoning effort, agent harnesses, and environment latency affect performance, speed, and cost. We find no single model family is optimal for all three; none of the open-weight models are on the frontier, and also, unintuitively, for some models increasing the reasoning effort can speed up task completion, while faster environment input-output can slow down overall task completion time. We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison. We believe cua-speedrun will enable structured progress towards fast, efficient CUAs, unlocking new real-world use cases and applications. All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at https://cuaspeedrun.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 cua-speedrun，一个通过标准化基础设施与任务集来评估计算机使用代理（CUA）速度与效率的基准框架，解决了现有 CUA 基准在速度评估上的可复现性危机。
AI.motivation: CUA 在诸多标准基准（含长程任务）上已超越人类表现，但其速度与成本成为广泛部署的关键障碍。然而现有 CUA 基准因复杂的机器与容器配置差异，导致执行速度评估结果被混淆，面临可复现性危机，缺乏可靠的测速手段。
AI.method: cua-speedrun 引入统一的基础设施与任务集：采用统一的虚拟机配置与执行流水线，并提供通用代理接口，使单一代理实现可无缝跨不同基准运行。基于此，在四个不同的 CUA 基准上评估推理力度（reasoning effort）、代理框架（agent harnesses）与环境延迟对性能、速度和成本的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现：不存在在所有三项指标（性能、速度、成本）上均最优的单一模型系列；没有开源权重模型处于前沿水平；此外存在反直觉现象——对部分模型增大推理力度反而加快任务完成，而更快的环境输入输出反而可能拖慢整体任务完成时间。同时证明可有效缩减多数 CUA 基准的评估任务集而不损失整体统计功效。
AI.conclusion: cua-speedrun 实现了更高效的基准测试与比较，为快速、高效 CUA 的研发提供结构化进展路径，有望解锁新的真实应用场景。所有代码、基础设施与分析均已开源。

title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts
summary: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping that characterizes the effective-parameter gain from looping and how sparsity raises this gain. The laws predict the held-out loss of looped models more accurately than prior alternatives, and recover the standard dense and MoE scaling laws as special cases. Beyond prediction, the fitted laws provide a principled foundation for designing looped MoE models under compute and memory constraints. Downstream evaluations further demonstrate the complementary benefits of the two axes: sparsity delivers ~3x active-parameter efficiency, recurrence yields ~2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning, and joint scaling further advances the performance frontier. As a practical extension, we show these gains hold at trillion-token scale: at matched training compute, a looped MoE with law-derived recurrence matches a ~2x larger non-looped MoE on the reasoning benchmarks, while enabling test-time scaling through recurrence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个联合建模循环（recurrence）与稀疏性（MoE）的缩放定律 Loop Scaling Laws，能够准确预测循环 MoE 模型的损失，并为在算力与显存约束下设计模型提供依据。
AI.motivation: 循环（recurrence）与 MoE 稀疏性是两条互补的高效扩展路径：循环在固定参数下增加计算深度，MoE 在固定激活计算下扩大总容量。然而现有缩放定律只单独建模其中之一，无法刻画二者联合效应。
AI.method: 提出 Loop Scaling Laws，核心是一个有界的、以稀疏性为条件的循环映射（bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping），用于刻画循环带来的有效参数增益及稀疏性如何提升该增益；同时将模型规模与数据量纳入统一建模。
AI.result: 该定律对循环模型留出损失的预测比现有方法更准确，并能退化为标准稠密与 MoE 缩放定律的特例；下游评测显示稀疏性带来约 3 倍激活参数效率、循环在推理任务上带来约 2 倍总参数效率，联合缩放进一步推进性能前沿。在万亿 token 规模下，同等训练算力时，采用定律推导循环配置的循环 MoE 在推理基准上可匹配约 2 倍大的非循环 MoE，并支持通过循环实现测试时扩展。
AI.conclusion: 循环与稀疏性在缩放上互补，联合建模可提供统一且可预测的设计原则，并具备万亿 token 规模的实用价值。

title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCAPO，一种因果启发的GRPO变体，将半事实提示干预下的token级概率漂移（稳定性）纳入信用分配，降低不稳定token的优势，从而在不更新权重的前提下提升LLM推理准确率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: RLVR提升了大模型推理能力，但模型预测对与任务无关的提示特征仍然敏感。作者通过保持问题与答案不变的半事实（semifactual）提示干预发现，token级敏感度差异显著，并指出GRPO对所有response token施加相同的结果派生的优势值，可能同时强化了有益的推理与虚假依赖。
AI.method: 提出Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization（SCAPO）：在半事实干预下测量固定响应的token概率漂移，用归一化稳定性分数在训练早期降低相对不稳定token的优势，且不因稳定性本身给予额外信用，从而进行更细粒度的token级信用分配。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base与Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，SCAPO相比GRPO在AIME 2024-2026准确率上分别提升5.63与4.17个百分点；在两种模型规模下，SCAPO在多数数学基准以及全部分布外基准上均取得最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 半事实稳定性可为RLVR提供有效的训练信号，通过更细粒度的信用分配同时提升推理能力与泛化性能。

title: Multi-Rate Bandwidth Extension by Token Completion in Neural Audio Codecs
summary: Bandwidth extension, the task of reconstructing the high-frequency components of an audio signal from its low-passed counterpart, is a long-standing problem in audio processing. In this work, we extend recent advances in neural architectures by framing bandwidth extension as an audio token prediction problem. Specifically, we train a transformer-based language model on the discrete representations produced by a disentangled neural audio codec, where the disentanglement is guided by a Harmonic-Percussive decomposition of the input signals, highlighting spectral structures particularly relevant for bandwidth extension. Our approach introduces a novel codec design that explicitly accounts for the downstream token prediction task, enabling a more effective coupling between codec structure and transformer modeling. This joint design yields high-quality reconstructions of the original signal, as measured by both objective metrics and subjective evaluations. These results highlight the importance of aligning codec disentanglement and representation learning with the generative modeling stage, and demonstrate the potential of global, representation-aware design for advancing bandwidth extension.

AI.tldr: 本文将带宽扩展建模为音频token预测问题，利用谐波-打击分离引导的解耦神经音频编解码器，联合设计编解码器与transformer语言模型，实现高质量高频重建。
AI.motivation: 带宽扩展（从低通信号重建高频成分）是音频处理的长期难题。作者希望将近期神经架构的进展与音频token预测范式结合，并通过让编解码器设计显式服务于下游token预测任务，弥合编解码器解耦与生成建模阶段之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将带宽扩展重构为音频token预测：在解耦神经音频编解码器产生的离散表示上训练transformer语言模型，解耦过程由输入的谐波-打击（Harmonic-Percussive）分解引导，以突出对带宽扩展尤为重要的频谱结构。同时提出一种新的编解码器设计，显式考虑下游token预测任务，实现编解码器结构与transformer建模的有效耦合。
AI.result: 在客观指标与主观评测中均实现了对原始信号的高质量重建，验证了所提联合设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了将编解码器解耦与表示学习同生成建模阶段对齐的重要性，并展示了全局、表示感知的设计在推进带宽扩展方面的潜力。

title: RAST: Resolution-Aware Privileged Structure Transfer for Low-Resolution Audio Activity Recognition
summary: Audio is increasingly used for human activity recognition (HAR) because it captures object interactions, environmental events, and contextual cues in everyday environments. High-resolution (HR) audio provides rich acoustic information for model development but incurs substantial energy and storage costs and may expose sensitive speech content. Low-resolution (LR) audio offers a more privacy-preserving and resource-efficient alternative for deployment, but reduced sampling rates can remove acoustic cues essential for activity recognition, leading to significant performance degradation. We formulate this training-deployment mismatch as sensor-resolution privileged learning, in which HR audio is available during training, while inference relies exclusively on LR audio. We propose RAST, a resolution-aware transfer framework that compresses HR teacher representations by preserving token-level information and neighborhood structure before performing localized HR-LR alignment. Experiments on the SAMoSA and AudioIMU datasets show that RAST consistently outperforms LR-only training and direct teacher-transfer baselines, improving LR-only recognition by up to approximately 7.8% while requiring only LR audio at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"传感器分辨率特权学习"问题：训练时可用高分辨率(HR)音频，推理时仅用低分辨率(LR)音频，并给出分辨率感知迁移框架RAST以缓解二者失配。
AI.motivation: 音频用于人类活动识别(HAR)能捕捉物体交互、环境事件与语境线索。HR音频信息丰富但能耗、存储成本高，且可能泄露语音隐私；LR音频更隐私友好、资源高效，但采样率降低会丢失关键声学线索，导致识别性能显著下降。该训练-部署分辨率失配亟需解决。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为传感器分辨率特权学习(HR仅训练可用，推理仅用LR)。提出RAST分辨率感知迁移框架：先对HR教师表征进行压缩，保留token级信息与邻域结构，再进行局部化的HR-LR对齐。
AI.result: 在SAMoSA与AudioIMU数据集上，RAST持续优于仅LR训练和直接教师迁移基线，使LR-only识别性能最高提升约7.8%，且推理阶段仅需LR音频。
AI.conclusion: RAST有效缓解了HR训练与LR部署间的分辨率失配，在保持推理低资源、隐私友好的同时显著提升LR音频的HAR性能。

title: FFASR: Benchmarking Far-Field Automatic Speech Recognition using High-Fidelity Simulated RIRs
summary: Far-field automatic speech recognition(ASR) degrades under reverberation, noise, and talker motion, yet the benchmarks that drive model selection emphasize close-microphone speech. We present FFASR, a held-out corpus of 15,637 utterances and an open leaderboard spanning nine conditions, each varying a single acoustic factor: anechoic near-field speech, a measured-versus-simulated office-lab pair, static far-field mixtures at high/mid/low signal-to-noise ratio(SNR), and moving-talker variants at matched SNR. Dry speech from 15 talkers is convolved with hybrid wave/geometrical-acoustics room impulse responses from 14 furnished rooms; because the speech is newly recorded and the test waveforms are never released, the corpus resists training-data contamination. Across contemporary systems, mean word error rate (WER) rises from 4.4% near-field to 41.3% in the static low-SNR condition; a moving talker adds a small but consistent penalty at matched SNR; and on the office-lab pair, measured and simulated WER agree to within about 1.7 pp on average. These results support high-fidelity simulation as a scalable proxy for measured far-field evaluation under the conditions we test.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FFASR远场语音识别基准语料（15,637条话语、九种条件、开放排行榜），通过新录制语音与混合声学脉冲响应避免数据污染。当代系统平均WER从近场4.4%升至静态低SNR的41.3%，移动说话人带来小幅但一致的性能损失，实测与仿真的办公室场景WER平均仅差约1.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 远场ASR在混响、噪声和说话人移动条件下性能显著下降，但主导模型选择的现有基准仍以近讲麦克风语音为主，缺乏系统隔离单一声学因素、且免受训练数据污染的远场评测资源。
AI.method: 构建FFASR留出语料：15位说话人的干语音与来自14间布置房间的混合波动/几何声学房间脉冲响应卷积，形成覆盖九种条件的测试集——无回声近场、实测与仿真办公室实验室配对、高/中/低SNR静态远场混合、以及匹配SNR下的移动说话人变体；语音为新录制且测试波形不公开，以抵御训练数据污染。
AI.result: 当代系统平均WER由近场4.4%升至静态低SNR的41.3%；移动说话人在匹配SNR下带来小幅但一致的性能损失；办公室实验室配对中，实测与仿真WER平均相差约1.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在所测试条件下，高保真仿真可作为实测远场评测的可扩展替代方案；FFASR提供了隔离单一声学因素、抗数据污染的远场ASR评测基准与开放排行榜。

title: How Reliable Are Predicted MOS for Reproducing Human System-Level Preferences in Speech Enhancement?
summary: We investigate whether predicted Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) can reliably support system-level comparisons of speech enhancement (SE) methods by introducing system-level preference accuracy (SPA). Although MOS prediction models are widely used to evaluate SE systems, their performance is typically assessed by correlation with human-rated MOS, which does not guarantee agreement on which system is better. SPA addresses this gap by directly evaluating whether predicted and human-rated MOS yield the same system preferences. Using SPA, we systematically evaluate three settings: single prediction models, ensembling, and domain adaptation. Through experiments, SPA varies substantially across single prediction models, from 9.4% to 76.8%. Even the best model disagrees with human judgments in approximately 23% of system comparisons. Ensembling yields only limited improvement, while domain adaptation tends to substantially improve SPA in the closed condition but brings only modest gains in the more practical open condition, where neither the target systems nor the speakers are known. These results suggest that SPA can reveal errors correlation-based evaluation alone does not expose, and that predicted MOS alone can lead to unreliable conclusions in practical SE system comparison.

AI.tldr: 论文提出系统级偏好准确率（SPA）指标，直接衡量预测MOS与人工MOS是否给出一致的系统偏好，并用其系统评估单模型、集成与域适应三种设定，发现现有MOS预测模型在系统级比较中可靠性有限。
AI.motivation: MOS预测模型被广泛用于语音增强（SE）系统评估，但其性能通常仅以与人工MOS的相关性来衡量；相关性高并不保证预测MOS与人工MOS在"哪个系统更好"这一系统级判断上一致。因此需要一个新的、直接面向系统比较的评价指标来揭示相关性评估无法暴露的误差。
AI.method: 提出系统级偏好准确率（SPA），直接评估预测MOS与人工评分是否产生相同的系统偏好（即系统两两比较结论是否一致）。基于SPA系统考察三种设定：单一预测模型、模型集成、域适应；其中域适应又区分封闭条件与开放条件（后者目标系统与说话人均未知）。
AI.result: 在单一预测模型上，SPA差异显著，范围从9.4%到76.8%；即便最优模型在约23%的系统比较中仍与人工判断不一致。集成仅带来有限提升；域适应在封闭条件下显著提升SPA，但在更贴近实际的开放条件下增益有限。
AI.conclusion: SPA能够揭示仅依赖相关性评估所无法暴露的错误，表明在实际SE系统比较中，仅使用预测MOS可能导致不可靠的结论；系统级偏好一致性应成为MOS预测模型评估的重要补充维度。

title: Game Sound-Effect Completion with Event-Level Transformation Hints
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Creating sound effects for a new game-character skin requires a distinct acoustic identity while preserving gameplay-event roles. The challenge is to complete a coherent set of related sounds whose required degrees of redesign differ. We formulate this task as completion conditioned on base-skin audio, completed target assets, and a textual design description. We develop a pipeline to collect, process, and align corresponding events across League of Legends skins. Building on Stable Audio 3's pretrained audio prior, we fine-tune a latent inpainting model to jointly complete missing events. A signed soft retention mask encodes available audio and an adjustable transformation hint for each missing event, specifying the requested balance between retention and redesign. Experiments on held-out skins show improved reconstruction over the evaluated general-purpose audio editors. Target-derived hints further improve paired similarity, with three-level hints retaining most of the benefit of continuous guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Stable Audio 3预训练音频先验的潜在修补模型，通过在基础皮肤音频、已完成的目标准则资产和文本设计描述条件下联合补全缺失音效事件，利用带符号软保留掩码控制保留与重设计的平衡，在《英雄联盟》皮肤音效跨事件一致补全任务上优于通用音频编辑器。
AI.motivation: 为新游戏角色皮肤创建音效时，需要同时满足两个要求：一是形成独特的声学身份，二是保留原有游戏事件的功能角色。实际制作中，一组相关音效的完成度不同，各事件所需的重设计程度也不同，这使得任务成为一个在已有基础音频、部分已完成目标资产和文字设计说明条件下的"缺失音效补全"问题。现有通用音频编辑器难以兼顾跨事件一致性与可控的保留/重设计比例。
AI.method: 工作包含数据与建模两部分。数据侧：构建了一条流水线，用于收集、处理并对齐《英雄联盟》不同皮肤之间对应的事件音效（如技能、攻击等），形成配对训练数据。模型侧：以Stable Audio 3的预训练音频先验为基础，微调一个潜在修补（latent inpainting）模型，使其在给定基础皮肤音频、已完成的目标准则资产与文本设计描述的条件下，联合补全多个缺失事件。为控制每个缺失事件的保留程度，设计"带符号软保留掩码"（signed soft retention mask），将可用音频与可调变换提示编码进掩码中，从而规定保留与重设计之间的请求平衡；同时支持连续强度提示与三级离散提示两种引导方式。
AI.result: 在留出皮肤（held-out skins）上的实验表明：相较于所评估的通用音频编辑器，该模型在重建质量上有提升；使用目标皮肤导出的提示（target-derived hints）可进一步提高配对相似度；三级离散提示保留了连续引导的大部分收益，说明较粗粒度的控制即可接近精细控制的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将皮肤音效制作形式化为条件式联合补全任务，并给出可用的数据对齐流程与带符号软保留掩码机制，验证了在预训练音频先验上微调潜在修补模型的可行性，实现了可控保留/重设计权衡下的跨事件音效一致补全。

title: SCIC: Scope- and Codebook-Aware Instruction Conditioning for Speaker-Adapted Expressive TTS
summary: Long-form live-streaming TTS requires context-dependent prosody and paragraph-level coherence. However, many existing instruction-based TTS systems use global or uniform conditions, providing limited explicit control over clause-level relative prosodic changes. We introduce Speaker-Relative Inline Prosody Control, where each Pitch, Energy, or Speed instruction targets a clause relative to the preceding clause from the same speaker, while Pause uses an absolute duration interval. In codec-based TTS, Speed and Pause affect sequence length, whereas Pitch and Energy rely on residual codebooks. By analyzing Qwen3-TTS RVQ codebooks, we find that Energy concentrates in early residual codebooks, whereas Pitch accumulates across a deeper prefix. We therefore propose Scope- and Codebook-Aware Instruction Conditioning (SCIC), combining a Temporal Instruction Router for frame-level tag activation with Tag-Specific Codebook Weighting over residual codebooks. SCIC improves speaker-relative Pitch and Energy control over standard instruction fine-tuning using text-token tags. We further apply multi-reward GDPO post-training to jointly optimize control and quality, improving control accuracy while preserving CER and speaker similarity. In long-form synthesis, SCIC produces a more distinct paragraph-level expressive hierarchy than speaker-adapted SFT without instructions. Audio demos are available at: https://taoliveaigc.github.io/SCIC/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Speaker-Relative Inline Prosody Control（说话人相对内联韵律控制）与 SCIC（Scope- and Codebook-Aware Instruction Conditioning），在基于 codec 的 TTS 中实现子句级相对韵律控制，并通过多奖励 GDPO 后训练同时优化控制精度与语音质量。
AI.motivation: 长时段直播 TTS 需要上下文相关的韵律与段落级连贯性，但现有指令式 TTS 多采用全局或统一条件，对子句级的相对韵律变化缺乏显式控制能力。
AI.method: 提出 Speaker-Relative Inline Prosody Control：Pitch、Energy、Speed 指令以同一说话人前一个子句为参照做相对控制，Pause 使用绝对时长区间。分析 Qwen3-TTS RVQ 码本发现 Energy 集中于早期残差码本、Pitch 在更深前缀中累积，据此设计 SCIC，结合 Temporal Instruction Router（帧级标签激活）与 Tag-Specific Codebook Weighting（残差码本加权）。进一步采用多奖励 GDPO 后训练联合优化控制与质量。
AI.result: 相较于使用文本 token 标签的标准指令微调，SCIC 提升了说话人相对的 Pitch 与 Energy 控制效果；多奖励 GDPO 后训练在保持 CER 与说话人相似度的同时提高控制准确率；在长时段合成中，SCIC 相比无指令的说话人适配 SFT 产生更明显的段落级表现力层级。
AI.conclusion: SCIC 通过显式的子句级相对韵律控制与码本感知的条件建模，有效改善了长时段 TTS 的韵律可控性与段落级连贯性，兼顾控制精度与语音质量。

title: Training-Free Affinity Fusion of Neural and Embedding-Based Speaker Diarization
summary: Speaker diarization systems based on speaker embeddings and neural diarization exploit complementary forms of speaker information, but their intermediate representations are not directly compatible. We introduce Training-Free Affinity Fusion (TFAF), which integrates the speaker structure inferred by a neural diarizer into an embedding-based diarization system. The neural speaker partition is used to condition local speaker representations, from which we construct a continuous affinity matrix and combine it with the embedding-based acoustic affinity before a single global clustering step. The method requires no additional training, shared embedding space, speaker-label alignment, or hard transfer of the neural diarizer's speaker count. Experiments on AMI and CALLHOME show consistent DER improvements over both constituent systems; on AMI, fusion also improves speaker-attributed transcription. Ablations show that the neural speaker partition accounts for most of the gain, while retaining the continuous embedding-based affinities provides additional benefit over hard partition fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练亲和度融合(TFAF)，将神经说话人分区信息融入基于嵌入的说话人日志系统，通过构建连续亲和度矩阵并与声学亲和度结合，实现单次全局聚类，在AMI和CALLHOME上取得一致的DER改进。
AI.motivation: 基于说话人嵌入的日志系统和基于神经日志的系统分别利用互补的说话人信息，但二者的中间表示不直接兼容，难以直接整合互补优势。
AI.method: TFAF用神经日志器推断的说话人分区对局部说话人表示进行条件化，据此构造连续亲和度矩阵，并在单次全局聚类前与基于嵌入的声学亲和度结合；无需额外训练、共享嵌入空间、说话人标签对齐，也无需硬性传递神经日志器的说话人数量。
AI.result: 在AMI和CALLHOME上，相比两个组成系统均获得一致的DER改进；在AMI上融合还提升了说话人归属转录性能。消融实验表明神经说话人分区贡献了主要增益，而保留连续嵌入亲和度相比硬分区融合有额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的亲和度融合能有效结合互补的说话人信息，在无额外训练与对齐约束下提升日志与说话人归属转录性能，连续亲和度融合优于硬分区融合。

title: UniAE-MoE: A Unified Audio Encoder via Mixture of Experts
summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) rely on effective audio encoders for multi-task performance. We introduce UniAE-MoE, a unified audio encoder designed to model cross-domain audio representations and achieve outstanding downstream understanding performance via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. Specifically, we explore mainstream audio encoders and integrate those from Qwen2-Audio and Audio-Flamingo 3, which demonstrate superior downstream capabilities. To facilitate effective model fusion, we improve our encoder using SwiGLU with shared experts to decouple encoder networks, and we further introduce a two-stage instruction-tuning strategy to better adapt the model to diverse downstream tasks. Moreover, we propose the task-specific data scaling (TSDS) technique to enhance \tool's understanding capabilities. On the XARES-LLM benchmark, UniAE-MoE attains a score of 0.802, achieving state-of-the-art performance. It also delivers top-tier performance in the official Interspeech 2026 Audio Encoder Capability Challenge, further demonstrating robust generalization across diverse audio tasks. Together, these results validate the effectiveness of \tool for unified audio understanding across speech, music, and general audio domains.

AI.tldr: 提出统一音频编码器 UniAE-MoE，基于混合专家架构融合 Qwen2-Audio 与 Audio-Flamingo 3 编码器，通过 SwiGLU 共享专家、两阶段指令微调与任务特定数据扩展，在 XARES-LLM 达 0.802 的 SOTA，并在 Interspeech 2026 音频编码器能力挑战赛中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）的多任务性能高度依赖有效的音频编码器，而单一编码器难以覆盖语音、音乐与通用音频等跨域表示需求，因此需要构建统一编码器以提升下游理解能力。
AI.method: 采用混合专家（MoE）架构构建统一音频编码器 UniAE-MoE，融合 Qwen2-Audio 与 Audio-Flamingo 3 等主流编码器；引入带共享专家的 SwiGLU 解耦编码器网络以实现有效融合；设计两阶段指令微调策略适配多样下游任务；并提出任务特定数据扩展（TSDS）技术增强理解能力。
AI.result: 在 XARES-LLM 基准上取得 0.802 分，达到状态最优；在 Interspeech 2026 音频编码器能力挑战赛官方评测中取得顶尖表现，验证了跨多样音频任务的稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了 UniAE-MoE 在语音、音乐与通用音频域上统一音频理解的有效性，表明 MoE 融合与两阶段微调、TSDS 相结合是提升 LALM 音频编码能力的可行路径。

title: Who Said What, and Will It Be Remembered? Evaluating Persistent Speaker Attribution Across Meetings
comment: A short version is accepted at IEEE SLT 2026, Demo Track
summary: Speech transcripts used as long-term memory must preserve both words and stable speaker identities. Existing meeting-transcription metrics either ignore speakers or remap anonymous speakers independently in each recording, so they cannot measure whether the same person retains one identity across meetings. We evaluate persistent speaker attribution with Speaker Identified cpWER (SI-cpWER), which scores a corpus under one global speaker-ID assignment. The benchmark covers five commercial diarize-then-identify cascades, two open academic baselines, and ThyVoice on the full 129-meeting CHiME-8 NOTSOFAR evaluation set in clean and noiseaugmented form, plus CHiME-6. ThyVoice is our end-to-end reference system; it repairs overlap and gates the evidence used to create and update voiceprints. Requiring persistent identity changes the commercial ranking: ThyVoice records lower SI-cpWER than every evaluated commercial cascade in all three conditions and the lowest mean in the full panel, 47.13 versus 54.75 for the next system. Complementary lexical, diarization, per-recording attribution, and speaker-clustering diagnostics characterize upstream error surfaces in the final attributed record. These results show why persistent attribution must be evaluated directly in systems that reuse conversations across time.

AI.tldr: 提出 SI-cpWER 指标以衡量跨会议持久说话人归属，并构建 ThyVoice 端到端系统，在 CHiME-8 NOTSOFAR 全量集上取得最低 SI-cpWER。
AI.motivation: 语音转录作为长期记忆需同时保留文字与稳定的说话人身份。现有会议转录指标要么忽略说话人，要么在每条录音中独立重映射匿名说话人，无法衡量同一人是否在跨会议中保持同一身份，因此需要直接面向持久归属的评测。
AI.method: 提出 Speaker Identified cpWER（SI-cpWER），在单一全局说话人 ID 分配下对整个语料评分。基准覆盖五个商用"先分离后识别"级联、两个开放学术基线及本文参考系统 ThyVoice，评测集为 CHiME-8 NOTSOFAR 全量 129 场会议（干净与加噪两种形式）以及 CHiME-6。ThyVoice 为端到端系统，修复重叠语音并对用于创建和更新声纹的证据进行门控。另设词汇、分离、单录音归属与说话人聚类等诊断分析。
AI.result: 要求持久身份会改变商用系统排名：ThyVoice 在三种条件下 SI-cpWER 均低于所有参评商用级联，全组平均最低，为 47.13，次优系统为 54.75。诊断分析刻画了最终归属记录中的上游错误来源。
AI.conclusion: 跨时间复用对话的系统必须直接评测持久说话人归属，SI-cpWER 揭示了传统指标掩盖的说话人身份一致性问题。

title: Ghost in the Encoder: Decodable Artist Identity Representations in Lyrics-to-Song Generation
summary: Text-to-song generation models can be prompted to imitate specific artists or regurgitate entire songs from their training data. Although these phenomena have been documented behaviorally on small datasets, little is known about the internal representations that may give rise to them. Prior interpretability work on generative audio has focused on locating semantic concepts such as genre or time signature within model activations. In this work, we show that a trained model can be probed for linearly decodable representations of artist identity from song lyrics alone, without any additional identifiers. Through a controlled case study of ACE-Step 1.5 spanning 2,000 songs across 100 artists, we demonstrate that the artist associated with a given set of lyrics can be identified within the model's internal activations, and that this conditioning signal propagates from the lyric encoder to the diffusion backbone during inference. These findings indicate that lyrics constitute an artist-level conditioning channel not addressed by prompt-side replication safeguards. More broadly, our work highlights how latent-space analysis can be used to audit what generative music models have implicitly learned from their training data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控案例研究（ACE-Step 1.5，2,000首歌，100位艺术家），揭示仅凭歌词即可在模型激活中线性解码出艺术家身份，且该条件信号会从歌词编码器传播到扩散主干。
AI.motivation: 文本到歌曲生成模型可被提示模仿特定艺术家或复现训练数据中的完整歌曲。已有行为层面的研究基于小数据集证实了这些现象，但对其内部表征机制知之甚少。此前的生成音频可解释性工作主要聚焦于语义概念（如流派、拍号）的定位，而艺术家身份这一更敏感的层面对应的内部表征尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 作者采用线性探针（probing）方法，对训练完成的模型内部激活进行可解码性分析，判断能否仅从歌词文本解码出艺术家身份，无需任何额外标识符。研究以 ACE-Step 1.5 为案例，覆盖 100 位艺术家的 2,000 首歌曲，并追踪该条件信号在推理过程中从歌词编码器到扩散主干的传播路径。
AI.result: 实验表明，给定歌词所对应的艺术家身份可在模型内部激活中被识别出来，即存在线性可解码的艺术家身份表征；同时该条件信号在推理时从歌词编码器传播至扩散主干，说明歌词构成了一条通往生成过程的艺术家级条件通道。
AI.conclusion: 歌词构成了一种未被提示侧复制防护措施所覆盖的艺术家级条件通道。更广泛地，该工作展示了如何利用潜在空间分析来审计生成式音乐模型从训练数据中隐式学到了什么。

title: SE-ADD: Self-Evolving Audio Deepfake Detection with Mistake-Driven Supervision
summary: Audio deepfake detection (ADD) must remain effective when new spoofing attacks emerge after deployment. Emerging audio language model (ALM)-based ADD methods are built on predefined supervision from ground-truth labels or verified forensic rationales. However, this paradigm overlooks an ALM's own mistakes, which indicate where targeted supervision is most needed. To this end, we first introduce evolving spoofing environments for ALM-based ADD, where a new attack becomes dominant while previously observed attacks persist. Motivated by the above learning-from-mistakes perspective, we further propose SE-ADD, a self-evolving framework that iteratively adapts an ALM via low-rank adaptation (LoRA) using mistake-driven supervision built from its verdicts and self-generated forensic cues. All training samples receive direct authenticity supervision, while misclassified ones receive additional cue-augmented supervision. As verdicts and cues are regenerated by the updated ALM, the resulting supervision evolves accordingly. Experiments on two ALMs demonstrate the effectiveness of SE-ADD in generalizing to unseen attacks, reducing the equal error rate (EER) from $36.72\%$ to $7.52\%$ for Qwen2-Audio and from $19.93\%$ to $3.97\%$ for MOSS-Audio.

AI.tldr: 提出SE-ADD自进化框架，利用ALM自身错误驱动LoRA迭代微调，在持续演化的伪造攻击环境中显著提升音频深度伪造检测的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 部署后新出现的音频伪造攻击要求ADD方法保持有效性。基于ALM的ADD方法依赖预定义的监督信号（ground-truth标签或经核验的取证理由），但该范式忽略了ALM自身的错误，而错误恰恰指示了最需要针对性监督的位置。
AI.method: 首先引入"演化伪造环境"设定：新攻击成为主导，而此前观测到的攻击持续存在。据此提出SE-ADD自进化框架，通过LoRA迭代适配ALM。监督信号由模型自身的判定和自我生成的取证线索构建：所有训练样本接受直接真伪监督，被误分类样本额外接受线索增强监督；随着更新后的ALM重新生成判定与线索，监督信号随之演化。
AI.result: 在两个ALM上的实验验证了SE-ADD对未见攻击的泛化有效性：Qwen2-Audio的等错误率（EER）从36.72%降至7.52%，MOSS-Audio从19.93%降至3.97%。
AI.conclusion: 从"从错误中学习"的视角出发，利用ALM自身判定与自生成取证线索构建动态演化的监督，可有效应对持续出现的伪造攻击，显著提升跨未见攻击的检测性能。

title: Synthetic Speech Attribution via Prototypical Networks
summary: Synthetic speech attribution aims to identify the generative system responsible for a speech signal, but current approaches typically rely on black-box neural networks that provide limited insight into their decisions. This work investigates prototype-based networks as an interpretable alternative, where predictions are grounded in comparisons with representative training examples. We adapt ProtoPNet to spectrogram-based speech representations and evaluate the proposed framework on the MLAAD dataset under closed-set, cross-lingual, and open-set conditions. Experiments show that prototype-based reasoning achieves competitive or improved attribution performance compared with the baseline while enabling example-based explanations. These results highlight that interpretability and performance can be jointly achieved in synthetic speech attribution through prototype-based modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于原型网络的可解释合成语音归属方法，将ProtoPNet适配到频谱图表示，在MLAAD数据集上评估，结果表明原型推理在闭集、跨语言和开集条件下性能与基线相当或更优，同时提供基于样本的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有合成语音归属方法依赖黑盒神经网络，其决策缺乏可解释性，难以获得对判断依据的洞察，因此需要一种可解释的替代方案。
AI.method: 将ProtoPNet适配到基于频谱图的语音表示，构建原型网络，使预测基于与代表性训练样本的比较；在MLAAD数据集上进行闭集、跨语言和开集三种条件下的评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，原型推理相比基线取得竞争性或更优的归属性能，同时能够提供基于样本的解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于原型的建模，合成语音归属可以在可解释性与性能之间实现兼顾。

title: SEAR: Spoofing Evidence-Grounded Audio Reasoning Benchmark for Audio Language Models
summary: Audio language models (ALMs) are increasingly used for audio deepfake detection (ADD), yet existing benchmarks assess their verdicts or rationale plausibility without verifying the underlying acoustic evidence. To address this issue, we first introduce spoofing evidence-grounded audio reasoning (SEAR), a four-task AQA benchmark to evaluate ALM-based ADD through acoustic evidence identification and quantification, deepfake detection, and forensic rationale generation. We further propose a bona-fide-based acoustic evidence agent (BAEA), which equips a frozen ALM with controlled acoustic tools under \textsc{fixed} or \textsc{adaptive} evidence-acquisition policies. Experiments with six ALMs reveal a clear gap between plausible rationales and verifiable acoustic evidence reasoning, while BAEA-\textsc{Fixed} improves final verdicts and forensic rationales on both evaluation partitions. Controlled interventions further show that misleading evidence degrades both detection and grounding performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEAR基准与BAEA智能体，通过可验证的声学证据评估音频语言模型的音频深伪检测能力，实验揭示合理解释与可验证证据推理间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有音频深伪检测基准仅评估结论正确性或解释的合理性，未验证其背后的声学证据，导致模型可能给出看似合理但缺乏真实声学依据的判断。
AI.method: 提出SEAR——一个四任务音频问答基准，涵盖声学证据识别与量化、深伪检测及取证性理由生成；并提出BAEA（基于真实语音的声学证据智能体），为冻结的ALM配备受控声学工具，采用固定或自适应证据获取策略。
AI.result: 对六种ALM的实验显示，合理解释与可验证声学证据推理之间存在明显差距；BAEA-Fixed在两个评估分区上均改善了最终判定与取证性理由。受控干预实验进一步表明，误导性证据会同时降低检测与证据定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 以声学证据为基础的评估范式能更真实地衡量ALM的深伪检测推理能力，BAEA通过受控证据获取有效提升判定与理由质量，且模型对误导性证据敏感。

title: MeanVoiceFlow2: Joint Optimization of Mean Flow and Content Encoder for Fast One-Step Zero-Shot Voice Conversion
summary: Flow-matching approaches to voice conversion (VC) have gained attention owing to their high speech quality and strong speaker similarity. Among them, one-step models such as MeanVoiceFlow are particularly attractive because they enable efficient inference; however, their reliance on a computationally intensive content encoder remains a bottleneck. We therefore propose MeanVoiceFlow2, a framework that jointly optimizes a flow-based conversion module and a computationally efficient content encoder. The model is trained through conversion distillation using MeanVoiceFlow and the reconstruction of real data. We further incorporate diffusion-GAN training with sample mixing and teacher-guided conditioning augmentation to enhance realism and disentanglement. Experiments on zero-shot VC showed that MeanVoiceFlow2 achieved higher perceptual quality and approximately $9\times$ faster inference than MeanVoiceFlow while maintaining comparable speaker similarity. Audio samples are available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/meanvoiceflow2/.

AI.tldr: 提出MeanVoiceFlow2，通过联合优化流匹配转换模块与高效内容编码器，实现零样本语音转换中更高感知质量与约9倍加速。
AI.motivation: 流匹配语音转换（VC）虽语音质量高、说话人相似度强，但一步模型如MeanVoiceFlow依赖计算量大的内容编码器，成为推理效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 联合优化基于流的转换模块与轻量内容编码器；采用MeanVoiceFlow进行转换蒸馏并重建真实数据；引入扩散-GAN训练，结合样本混合与教师引导的条件增强以提升真实感与解耦性。
AI.result: 零样本VC实验表明，MeanVoiceFlow2在保持相当说话人相似度的同时，感知质量优于MeanVoiceFlow，推理速度约提升9倍。
AI.conclusion: MeanVoiceFlow2有效缓解内容编码器计算瓶颈，在质量与效率间取得更优平衡，适用于高效零样本语音转换。

title: Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models
summary: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. We evaluate this approach on a corpus of 48 dyadic recordings drawn from psychiatry settings, testing four open-weight models in an inference-only setting: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Nemotron-3-Nano, and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni. A disjunctive OR ensemble over fourteen model-view configurations had a combined F1 of 0.478 (precision 0.330, recall 0.870), an improvement over individual model estimates driven by recall gains that point to substantial complementarity across models and context views.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究精神科双人临床对话录音中"指定说话人语音是否已彻底删除"的验证问题，提出两条对称流水线（分别确认医生语音与患者语音已从录音中移除），先对目标角色音频做脱敏处理，再用音频-语言模型与大语言模型扫描剩余输出以发现漏删。在48段精神科双人录音语料上，以仅推理方式测试4个开源权重模型，十四种"模型-视图"配置的析取OR集成取得组合F1为0.478（精确率0.330、召回率0.870），表明模型与上下文视图之间存在显著互补性。
AI.motivation: 精神科临床研究日益依赖大规模口语数据采集以识别声学与语言学标记，但不断演变的知情同意与协议要求可能迫使研究者从多人录音中移除指定说话人，并在整个语料库范围内核验移除结果——这一规模使人工逐条审查不可行。因此需要一种可扩展的自动化验证方法。
AI.method: 针对精神科角色驱动的双人临床对话，设计两条并行、对称的流水线：其一确认医生语音已从精神科访谈录音中移除，其二确认患者语音已从同一批录音中移除。每条流水线先对目标角色的原始音频执行脱敏（redaction），再用音频-语言模型（audio-language models）与大型语言模型（LLMs）扫描残留输出，识别遗漏的删除。在48段精神科双人录音语料上开展评估，采用仅推理（inference-only）设置测试四个开源权重模型：Gemma-4-12B、Gemma-4-31B、Nemotron-3-Nano、Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni。最终采用覆盖十四种"模型-视图"配置的析取OR集成（disjunctive OR ensemble）。
AI.result: 析取OR集成的组合F1为0.478（精确率0.330，召回率0.870）；相较于单个模型估计值有所提升，且提升主要由召回率增益驱动，说明不同模型与不同上下文视图之间存在显著的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 基于音频-语言模型与LLM的对称脱敏验证流水线，配合OR集成策略，能够在人工审查不可行的规模上有效核查指定说话人语音的移除情况，其价值主要体现在高召回率与跨模型、跨视图的互补性上，尽管精确率仍偏低，需在后续工作中进一步改善误报问题。

title: Robust LassoNet: Enhancing Feature Selection in Neural Networks via Robust Loss Functions
summary: Feature selection in neural networks remains a challenging problem, particularly in the presence of noisy or contaminated data. LassoNet is a recent approach that addresses this issue by combining neural networks with hierarchical sparsity constraints, enabling simultaneous prediction and variable selection. However, its standard formulation relies on the mean squared error (MSE) loss, which is known to be highly sensitive to outliers. In this paper, we present Robust LassoNet, an extension of LassoNet that incorporates robust loss functions, such as Huber, Cauchy, Tukey's bisquare, and Nonnegative Garrote, to mitigate the effect of extreme observations. The proposed approach preserves the original optimization framework while improving stability under data contamination. Through experiments on synthetic and real datasets, we show that robust LassoNet significantly improves both predictive performance and feature selection accuracy in the presence of outliers or heavy tailed noise, while maintaining comparable performance in clean settings. These results highlight the importance of robustness in neural network based feature selection and suggest practical guidelines for choosing appropriate loss functions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Robust LassoNet，通过在 LassoNet 中引入 Huber、Cauchy、Tukey's bisquare 与 Nonnegative Garrote 等稳健损失替代 MSE，在保持原有优化框架的同时提升对离群点和重尾噪声的鲁棒性，从而改善预测与特征选择性能。
AI.motivation: 神经网络中的特征选择在含噪或受污染数据下仍是难题。LassoNet 通过将神经网络与层次稀疏约束结合，实现同时预测与变量选择，但其标准形式依赖 MSE 损失，而 MSE 对离群点高度敏感，因此在数据污染场景下性能不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Robust LassoNet，作为 LassoNet 的扩展，将原 MSE 损失替换为多种稳健损失函数（Huber、Cauchy、Tukey's bisquare、Nonnegative Garrote），在保留原始优化框架的前提下增强稳定性；并在合成与真实数据集上开展实验，比较不同损失函数的预测性能与特征选择准确性。
AI.result: 实验表明，在存在离群点或重尾噪声时，Robust LassoNet 显著提升预测性能与特征选择准确性；在干净数据设置下性能与标准方法相当，并给出了选择合适损失函数的实践性指导。
AI.conclusion: 稳健性对基于神经网络的特征选择至关重要；用稳健损失替代 MSE 是缓解离群点与重尾噪声影响的有效途径，且不牺牲干净数据下的表现。

title: Acceleration of Diffusion Language Model through Discrete Average Generator
summary: Discrete diffusion models and flow matching have emerged as powerful frameworks for generative modeling over discrete state spaces, yet efficient few-step generation remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we introduce the Discrete Average Generator, a principled extension of MeanFlow to Continuous-Time Markov Chains (CTMCs). Analogously to how MeanFlow defines an average velocity field over a time interval in continuous spaces, we define an average generator as the normalized increment of the transition kernel over a time interval. We show that this average generator satisfies a self-consistency identity, which provides the foundation for our training objective. We further develop training strategies that align with the standard training paradigm of diffusion language models while keeping the resulting objective tractable. When projected onto per-coordinate marginals, the self-consistency identity admits a closed-form expression, enabling efficient training and inference. In Potts model simulations, our objective reduces the total variation distance of the $K$-step sampler by up to 67%. On OpenWebText, our method achieves the lowest generative perplexity among the evaluated methods for 8 to 64 sampling steps while enabling a $16\times$ acceleration, and achieves comparable performance to existing methods on ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 提出离散平均生成器（Discrete Average Generator），将MeanFlow推广至连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），实现离散扩散与流匹配的少步高效生成。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型与流匹配在离散状态空间生成建模中表现强大，但高效的少步生成仍是根本性挑战，现有方法难以在少量采样步数下保持生成质量。
AI.method: 将连续空间MeanFlow中"时间区间上的平均速度场"概念推广到CTMC，定义平均生成器为时间区间内转移核增量的归一化形式；证明其满足自洽（self-consistency）恒等式，作为训练目标基础；设计符合扩散语言模型标准训练范式的可解训练策略；投影到逐坐标边缘分布时自洽恒等式具有闭式表达，从而实现高效训练与推理。
AI.result: 在Potts模型仿真中，目标函数使K步采样器的总变差距离最多降低67%；在OpenWebText上，8至64步采样下取得所评估方法中最低的生成困惑度并实现16倍加速；在ImageNet上性能与现有方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为离散生成建模提供了原理性的少步采样框架，兼顾训练可处理性与推理效率，在文本与图像任务上验证了其有效性和通用性。

title: Lower Bounds for Linear-Oracle Online Learning
summary: Can a constant number of linear minimizations per round improve on the $T^{3/4}$ regret rate of online Frank-Wolfe on general convex sets? Weibel et al. conjectured that fixed-coefficient methods cannot. We prove their conjecture and extend the lower bound to every deterministic learner in an oracle-only model. The learner receives an initial feasible point and a diameter bound, and must remain feasible on every domain consistent with its oracle replies. For $T$ rounds, at most $b$ calls between decisions, diameter bound $D$, and gradient norm bound $L$, we construct an instance in dimension $d=2b(T-1)+1$ with regret at least $2^{-1/4}LDb^{-1/4}T^{3/4}$. The adversary fixes the domain, initial point, deterministic tie rule and linear losses before play. The vertices form a path on which every point available before a decision has zero current loss, while the final vertex has negative loss on every round. For constant $b$, the result matches the known upper rate for dimension-independent guarantees. For one-call fixed schedules with a nonzero coefficient on the newest gradient, a second construction gives regret at least $3LDT^{3/4}/4$ with unique minimizers at every issued query. Exact-arithmetic certificates for the tuned schedule of Weibel et al. closely match their finite-horizon numerical worst cases, with unique oracle replies.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明并推广了Weibel等人的猜想：在仅依赖一阶oracle的确定性学习模型中，每轮常数次线性最小化无法突破在线Frank-Wolfe的T^{3/4}遗憾下界，构造出维度d=2b(T-1)+1的实例使遗憾至少为2^{-1/4}LDb^{-1/4}T^{3/4}。
AI.motivation: 在线Frank-Wolfe在一般凸集上的遗憾率为T^{3/4}。Weibel等人猜想固定系数方法无法改进这一速率。本文旨在证明该猜想，并将其下界从固定系数方法扩展到更广泛的确定性oracle学习器，以厘清常数次线性最小化是否本质上受限。
AI.method: 采用oracle-only模型：学习器仅获得初始可行点与直径界，且必须在所有与其oracle回复一致的域上保持可行。构造对抗实例：域、初始点、确定性平局规则及线性损失在博弈前固定；顶点构成一条路径，任何在决策前可获得的点当前损失为零，而最终顶点每轮损失为负。维度设为d=2b(T-1)+1，每轮至多b次oracle调用。另对一调用固定调度（最新梯度系数非零）给出第二构造。
AI.result: 对T轮、每轮至多b次调用、直径界D、梯度范数界L，构造实例的遗憾至少为2^{-1/4}LDb^{-1/4}T^{3/4}；常数b时与已知的维度无关上界匹配。对一调用固定调度，第二构造给出遗憾至少3LDT^{3/4}/4，且每个发出的查询都有唯一极小点。针对Weibel等人调优调度的精确算术证书与其有限视界数值最坏情况高度吻合，oracle回复唯一。
AI.conclusion: 常数次线性最小化无法改善一般凸集上在线Frank-Wolfe的T^{3/4}遗憾率，Weibel等人的猜想成立且下界可推广至任意确定性oracle学习器。该下界在常数b时是紧的，验证了维度无关保证的最优性。

title: Generative sequence modeling for infinite memory processes via predictive states
summary: We consider estimating the one-step-ahead conditional distribution of a multivariate stochastic process. Many existing approaches rely on assumptions such as finite-range memory, sparsity, or additivity, which can be poorly suited to processes with long-range nonlinear interactions. However, without such structural assumptions, nonparametric estimation is challenging due to the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we introduce a new estimation approach based on the predictive states of a process, possibly with infinite-range memory. We show that our estimator achieves fast convergence rates when the past history can be compressed into a low-dimensional statistic that is sufficient for predicting the future. Specifically, we show that the statistical complexity of the estimation problem is determined by the intrinsic dimension of the predictive state space. We establish guarantees for an instantiation of our method based on deep neural network estimators, and we support these theoretical results with experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于预测状态（predictive states）的多变量随机过程一步条件分布估计方法，可在记忆无限、无非线性结构假设下利用预测状态空间的低维本质维度实现快速收敛率，并给出深度神经网络实例的理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖有限记忆、稀疏性或可加性等结构假设，难以适用于具有长程非线性交互的随机过程；但若不做这些假设，非参数估计又会因维数灾难而困难。因此需要一种既不依赖这些限制性假设、又能规避维数灾难的估计框架。
AI.method: 引入基于过程预测状态（predictive states）的估计方法，允许过程具有无限记忆。核心思想是：当历史信息可压缩为对未来预测充分的低维统计量时，估计问题的统计复杂度由预测状态空间的内在维度决定，而非原始历史维度。并给出基于深度神经网络估计器的具体实现及其理论保证。
AI.result: 在历史可压缩为低维充分预测统计量的条件下，所提估计器达到快速收敛率；证明估计问题的统计复杂度由预测状态空间的内在维度决定；为基于深度神经网络的实例建立了理论保证，并通过实验支持理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测状态视角，可将无限记忆随机过程的非参数条件分布估计复杂度归结为预测状态空间的内在维度，从而在避免维数灾难的同时放宽结构假设，深度神经网络实现为该框架提供了可行性支撑。

title: Bandits with Multiple Optimal Arms: Minimax Regret and Non-Adaptivit
summary: We study multi-armed bandits (MAB) with multiple optimal arms, motivated by the fact that many practical decision making problems admit multiple correct answers. For $K$-armed bandits with $A$ optimal arms, we first provide a sharper analysis of previous sub-sampling algorithms (De Heide et al., 2021; Zhu and Nowak, 2020), establishing a $\tilde{O}\Big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T} \Big)$ minimax regret, where $T$ is the total number of interactions and $\tilde O(\cdot)$ drops all constant and logarithmic factors, improving the previous $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$ regret. We then provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, indicating that our established rate is nearly minimax-optimal. We further show that the knowledge of $A$ up to $\tilde{O}(1)$ factors is necessary to achieve near-optimal regret, as near-optimal algorithms for one number of optimal arms must incur substantially larger regret than optimal regret for a smaller number. Overall, our results provide a comprehensive minimax characterization of $K$-armed bandits with $A$ over the entire range of $1 \leq A \leq K-1$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究存在多个最优臂的多臂老虎机问题，给出子采样算法的更紧致遗憾上界 $\tilde O((K-A)/\sqrt{KA}\cdot\sqrt{T})$，并证明其近似极小极大最优性及 $A$ 的必要知识。
AI.motivation: 许多实际决策问题存在多个正确答案（即多个最优臂），因此研究具有 $A$ 个最优臂的 $K$ 臂老虎机问题有现实意义。此前子采样算法（De Heide et al., 2021; Zhu and Nowak, 2020）的遗憾界为 $\tilde O(\sqrt{KT/A})$，刻画不够精确，需要更紧致的分析。
AI.method: 对 $K$ 臂老虎机、$A$ 个最优臂的情形，重新分析先前的子采样算法，得到更紧致的遗憾上界；进而构造匹配的下界（至多对数因子）；并分析最优臂数目 $A$ 的知识对实现近最优遗憾的必要性。
AI.result: 建立了 $\tilde O\big((K-A)/\sqrt{KA}\cdot\sqrt{T}\big)$ 的极小极大遗憾上界，优于先前的 $\tilde O(\sqrt{KT/A})$；给出了对数因子范围内匹配的下界，表明该速率近似极小极大最优；并证明要实现近最优遗憾，必须知道 $A$（在 $\tilde O(1)$ 因子范围内）。
AI.conclusion: 在 $1\le A\le K-1$ 的整个范围内，完整刻画了带 $A$ 个最优臂的 $K$ 臂老虎机的极小极大遗憾特性。

title: Sharp Statistical Rates for Asynchronous TD Learning with Markovian Data

AI.tldr: 本文研究单轨迹表格型时序差分(TD)学习最后一次迭代的收敛性，证明其在高概率下达到ε精度所需的转移次数为Õ(H³/(μ_min ε²)+t_mix/μ_min)，并给出匹配的极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 现有TD学习理论多关注同步或平均迭代的收敛，缺乏对单轨迹下最后一次迭代(last iterate)的紧致分析，尤其需要厘清有效时域H、最小平稳概率μ_min与混合时间t_mix对样本复杂度的确切影响，并明确是否能去除混合时间因子。
AI.method: 采用反向时间的锚定局部泊松方程(anchored local Poisson equation)控制随机波动，避免引入混合时间因子；用首达时间补偿恒等式(hitting-time compensation identity)界定初始化误差；通过对期望累积传播质量(expected cumulative propagation mass)的界，将论证推广至递减步长。构造三状态已知确定性奖励实例给出极小极大下界。
AI.result: 得出最后一次迭代TD在0<ε≤1时以高概率达到上确界误差≤ε，所需转移次数为Õ(H³/(μ_min ε²)+t_mix/μ_min)。该速率对为目标精度选定的常数步长和与目标精度、终止时间无关的递减步长均成立；递减步长给出超过显式瞬态阈值后所有时刻的同时保证。统计项保留同步TD的三次有效时域依赖，加性混合瞬态无额外时域因子。结果允许非可逆链、任意初始分布、依赖下一状态的有界奖励。下界在慢混合参数区域的指定模型类上对统计项和混合项（达到对数因子）匹配。
AI.conclusion: 单轨迹最后一次迭代TD可在无额外混合时间因子的情况下达到与同步TD相同的有效时域依赖，递减步长还能提供统一的同时保证；三状态构造证实该样本复杂度在统计项与混合项上均为最优(至对数因子)。

title: Warm-starting PDE solvers with any-dimensional machine learning
summary: Any-dimensional machine learning models, such as graph neural networks (GNNs), can be naturally trained and evaluated on inputs of different sizes and dimensions. Inspired by the GNN transferability literature, we show mathematical conditions under which a partial differential equation (PDE) learning-based solver can be trained in small dimensions and directly applied to solve a higher dimensional PDE in a zero-shot fashion. These conditions are based on symmetries in both the partial differential equation and the initial data. When the equations satisfy the symmetries but the data does not, which is the case for many PDEs arising from physics, we show that our theory gives a principled way of warm-starting low-dimensional PDE solvers for higher dimensional PDEs. We apply this method on the heat equation, Burgers' equation, and the compressible Navier--Stokes equations, improving the performance in both zero-shot and typical training regimes on high dimensional data. For example, we train a surrogate model on 2D Navier--Stokes data and achieve better results on 3D test data than a baseline surrogate model trained on 3D data, while only using 12$\%$ of the flops and 20$\%$ of the total data size.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对称性给出了PDE学习型求解器可在低维训练、零样本直接用于高维PDE的条件；当方程满足对称性但数据不满足时，可用于热启动低维求解器，并在热方程、Burgers方程与可压缩Navier–Stokes方程上提升了高维性能。
AI.motivation: 受图神经网络可迁移性研究的启发，作者希望探究：类似GNN这类可处理不同尺寸输入的学习模型，PDE学习型求解器是否也能在小维度上训练并直接零样本求解更高维PDE，从而降低高维数据与计算成本。
AI.method: 作者推导了PDE学习型求解器实现跨维度零样本迁移的数学条件，这些条件依赖于PDE本身与初始数据双方的对称性。若方程满足对称性而数据不满足（物理中常见情形），该理论提供了一种为高维PDE低维求解器进行warm-start的原则性方法。作者将该方法应用于热方程、Burgers方程和可压缩Navier–Stokes方程。
AI.result: 在零样本与常规训练两种设置下，该方法均改善了高维数据的性能。例如，在2D Navier–Stokes数据上训练的代理模型，在3D测试数据上优于在3D数据上训练的基线代理模型，且仅使用12%的FLOPs和20%的总数据量。
AI.conclusion: PDE学习型求解器在满足特定对称性条件下可实现跨维度零样本迁移；所提出的理论为低维求解器warm-start高维PDE提供了原则性路径，并在多个方程上验证了高效性和性能优势。

title: Minimax rates for learning spectral Barron functions by deep ReLU neural networks
summary: We study how well deep neural networks approximate and learn spectral Barron functions. Recent studies have shown that these function classes can be efficiently approximated by shallow neural networks without suffering from the curse of dimensionality. We complement these results by providing new approximation bounds for deep networks with ReLU activation and establishing the minimax rates for learning these function classes. Specifically, we show that $d$-dimensional spectral Barron functions with smoothness index $s>0$ can be approximated by deep ReLU neural networks with approximation rate $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}} (S^{-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{s}{d}})$, where $S$ denotes the number of nonzero parameters in the network. Using this approximation result, we further show that deep ReLU neural networks can learn spectral Barron functions in a fast rate $n^{-\frac{d+2s}{2d+2s}}$ with $n$ training samples. Finally, we prove that this convergence rate is minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 研究了深度ReLU网络对谱Barron函数的逼近与学习能力，给出新的逼近界并确立了极小极大最优学习速率。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明浅层网络可高效逼近谱Barron函数且不受维数灾难影响，但深度网络的逼近能力以及该类函数类的学习速率（是否达到极小极大最优）尚待补充研究。
AI.method: 针对d维、光滑度指标s>0的谱Barron函数，利用ReLU激活的深度网络进行逼近分析，以非零参数数目S衡量网络复杂度，推导逼近速率；并基于该逼近结果分析用n个训练样本的学习收敛速率，进而证明该速率的极小极大最优性。
AI.result: 深度ReLU网络对谱Barron函数的逼近速率为Õ(S^{-1/2-s/d})；用n个样本学习时的收敛速率为n^{-(d+2s)/(2d+2s)}；并证明该速率在对数因子意义下是极小极大最优的。
AI.conclusion: 深度ReLU网络能够高效逼近并学习谱Barron函数，其学习速率达到（对数因子内）极小极大最优，补充并强化了此前关于浅层网络的既有结果。

title: Steepest Guidance: A Practical and Principled Approach to Inference-Time Alignment of Flow and Diffusion-based Models
summary: Inference-time alignment of flow and diffusion-based models is critical for achieving flexible generative modeling. Theoretically, Doob's $h$-transform provides an elegant solution to this problem, and most existing methods are based on this principle. However, in practice, estimating the optimal guidance derived from Doob's $h$-transform at inference time is challenging. To deal with this issue, we regard inference-time alignment as a sequential optimization problem in the space of probability measures and propose a novel framework called *Steepest Guidance*, based on the principle of maximizing local improvement in the objective. We provide a theoretical analysis of the proposed method and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文将推理时对齐视为概率测度空间上的序贯优化问题，提出了基于目标局部改进最大化原理的Steepest Guidance框架，用于流模型与扩散模型的推理时对齐，并提供理论分析与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 推理时对齐对实现灵活的生成建模至关重要。理论上Doob的h-变换为该问题提供了优雅解，且多数现有方法基于此原理。但实践中，在推理时估计由Doob h-变换导出的最优引导十分困难。
AI.method: 将推理时对齐重新表述为概率测度空间中的序贯优化问题，并基于最大化目标函数局部改进的原则，提出名为Steepest Guidance的新框架。
AI.result: 通过大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性，并对该方法的理论性质进行了分析。
AI.conclusion: Steepest Guidance为流模型与扩散模型的推理时对齐提供了一种新的可行方案，兼具理论支撑与实证效果。

title: Asymptotic Properties of Support Vector Machines in High-Dimension, Low-Sample-Size Settings under a Spiked Model
summary: In this paper, we consider asymptotic properties of the support vector machine (SVM) in high-dimension, low-sample-size (HDLSS) settings under a spiked model. The existing theory of the SVM in the HDLSS context relies on the geometric representation of HDLSS data, which requires that the eigenvalues of the covariance matrices are not dominant. We first show that the geometric representation does not hold under the spiked model. We show that the Gram matrix of HDLSS data converges in distribution to a random matrix, namely, the HDLSS data converge to a random configuration in a finite-dimensional space whose dimension is given by the number of the spikes. We show that the misclassification rates of the SVM do not tend to zero, that is, the SVM does not hold the consistency property. We also show that the bias-corrected SVM (BC-SVM) does not give preferable performance in this setting because the bias term itself should be modified. In order to overcome such difficulties, we propose a spike-corrected SVM (SC-SVM). We show that the SC-SVM holds the consistency property when the sample size goes to infinity, and that the growth of the sample size is essential in the sense that any projection-based procedure fails when the sample size is fixed. Finally, we check the performance of the classifiers by numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维低样本量（HDLSS）设定下、尖峰模型（spiked model）中支持向量机（SVM）的渐近性质，指出经典几何表示不再成立，SVM 与偏差修正 SVM（BC-SVM）均不具一致性，并提出尖峰修正 SVM（SC-SVM），证明其在样本量趋于无穷时具有一致性，且样本量增长是必要的。
AI.motivation: 现有 HDLSS 下 SVM 的理论依赖数据的几何表示，而该表示要求协方差矩阵特征值不存在主导项。然而在尖峰模型下，少数大特征值占主导，几何表示的前提被破坏，因此有必要重新审视 SVM 在尖峰模型下的渐近行为，并寻求能在此设定下保持一致性的分类方法。
AI.method: 1）在尖峰模型下分析 HDLSS 数据的 Gram 矩阵极限分布，证明其收敛到随机矩阵，数据收敛为维数等于尖峰个数的有限维随机构型，从而说明几何表示不成立；2）分析 SVM 与 BC-SVM 在此设定下的渐近误分类率与偏差项问题；3）提出尖峰修正 SVM（SC-SVM）以克服上述困难；4）通过数值模拟比较各分类器性能。
AI.result: 几何表示在尖峰模型下不成立；HDLSS 数据的 Gram 矩阵依分布收敛到随机矩阵，数据表现为有限维随机构型；SVM 的误分类率不趋于零，即不具一致性；BC-SVM 因偏差项本身需修正而无法给出理想性能；SC-SVM 在样本量趋于无穷时具有一致性，且任何基于投影的方法在样本量固定时均失败，说明样本量增长是必要条件；数值模拟验证了各分类器的性能。
AI.conclusion: 在 HDLSS 尖峰模型下，传统 SVM 理论所依赖的几何表示失效，SVM 与 BC-SVM 均不具一致性。为此提出的 SC-SVM 在样本量趋于无穷时能够恢复一致性，并且样本量的增长是不可或缺的。该结果揭示了尖峰结构对高维分类器渐近性质的根本影响，并为高维小样本下的分类提供了理论指导。

title: Minimax Additive Regression under Unknown Dependent Designs
summary: We study additive regression under a potentially non-product random design on $[0,1]^d$, allowing the dimension $d$ to grow with the sample size $n$. We introduce coupled smoothness classes that separately control the regularity of the marginal densities and the density-weighted additive components. To handle dependence, we adapt a Riesz-basis construction for functional ANOVA models and establish compatibility bounds with constants independent of the dimension under uniform bounds on the joint density. We construct thresholded least-squares estimators and establish matching minimax upper and lower bounds for prediction with known or unknown marginal densities, under suitable dimension-growth conditions. When the marginal densities are at least as smooth as the weighted components, the unknown-density problem attains the known-density minimax rate. When the densities are less smooth, their regularity determines the minimax rate over the coupled class. Finally, we show that the centered additive components can be recovered at the same aggregate upper rate, without an additional order of error.

AI.tldr: 研究 $[0,1]^d$ 上可能非乘积设计的可加回归，允许维数 $d$ 随样本量 $n$ 增长，在耦合光滑类下建立带阈值最小二乘估计的匹配极小极大上下界。
AI.motivation: 经典可加回归理论多假设乘积设计或固定维数。本文针对更一般的非乘积随机设计、增长维数情形，刻画边际密度正则性与密度加权可加分量正则性如何共同决定估计的极小极大速率，并处理分量间相依带来的困难。
AI.method: 引入耦合光滑类，分别控制边际密度与密度加权可加分量的正则性；为处理相依性，改造函数型 ANOVA 模型的 Riesz 基构造，在联合密度一致有界下建立常数与维数无关的相容性界；构造带阈值的最小二乘估计量。
AI.result: 在适当的维数增长条件下，对已知与未知边际密度两种情形分别得到预测误差匹配的极小极大上下界。当边际密度至少与加权分量同样光滑时，未知密度问题达到已知密度的极小极大率；当密度更不光滑时，其正则性决定耦合类上的极小极大率。中心化可加分量可以相同的聚合上界速率被恢复，且不产生额外阶的误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将可加回归的极小极大理论推广到非乘积设计、增长维数与相依结构，明确了密度光滑性与分量光滑性对估计速率的相对作用，并给出可同时恢复分量的阈值最小二乘方法。

title: Discrete Score Matching Enables Causal Discovery from Count Data
summary: Count data pose a challenge for score-matching-based causal discovery: derivatives are unavailable, and simply replacing them with finite differences does not generally suffice for causal discovery. We generalize SCORE's constant-curvature criterion (Rolland et al., 2022) by conditioning on the node's value, yielding the conditional curvature score (CCS) for ordering. We also extend curvature-based parent recovery through the off-diagonal curvature score (OCS), enabling directed acyclic graph (DAG) recovery with both scores constructed from score functions for continuous data and concrete scores for counts. In the bivariate setting, zero CCS exactly characterizes a semiparametric generalized linear model (GLM) conditional form in which the conditional family need not be specified in advance, unlike in classical GLMs. For bivariate semiparametric GLM DAGs under our regularity condition, canonical-parameter nonlinearity is necessary and sufficient for identifiability. In multivariate DAGs, this nonlinearity enables DAG recovery through CCS and OCS. Our framework identifies a new class of semiparametric GLM DAGs that strictly contains the nonlinear Gaussian ANM class identified by SCORE. We introduce DISCO (DIscrete SCOre), a count-DAG recovery algorithm that estimates CCS and OCS using discrete diffusion. Experiments demonstrate accurate DAG recovery across Poisson, negative binomial, binomial, and mixed-family settings, as well as scalability to 1,000-node DAGs on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出条件曲率分数（CCS）与离对角曲率分数（OCS），将SCORE的常曲率准则推广到计数数据，并基于离散扩散构建DISCO算法，实现泊松、负二项、二项及混合族场景下的DAG恢复，可扩展至1000节点。
AI.motivation: 计数数据的导数不可用，用有限差分替代通常不足以进行因果发现，因此需要将面向连续数据的SCORE准则推广到计数场景。
AI.method: 通过以节点取值作为条件推广SCORE的常曲率准则，得到用于排序的条件曲率分数（CCS）；并扩展基于曲率的父节点恢复，得到离对角曲率分数（OCS），二者分别由连续数据的score函数与计数数据的concrete score构造，从而实现DAG恢复。提出DISCO算法，利用离散扩散估计CCS与OCS。
AI.result: 双变量情形下，CCS为零恰好刻画一类半参数GLM条件形式，且条件族无需预先指定；在正则条件下，规范参数非线性是双变量半参数GLM DAG可识别性的充要条件。多变量下该非线性使CCS与OCS可恢复DAG。该框架严格包含SCORE识别的非线性高斯ANM类。实验在泊松、负二项、二项及混合族设置下实现准确DAG恢复，并在单GPU上扩展至1000节点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将曲率型因果发现扩展到计数数据，界定了新的半参数GLM DAG可识别性类别，并提供可扩展的DISCO算法。

title: A Dynamical Theory of LoRA in Continual Learning
summary: Despite the widespread use of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), little is known about its dynamics in continual learning and the mechanisms by which low-rank updates affect catastrophic forgetting. We provide an asymptotically exact dynamical characterization of LoRA in a solvable two-task teacher-student model. In the high-dimensional online-learning limit, we derive a closed system of ordinary differential equations for a finite set of macroscopic order parameters, yielding exact expressions for the generalization errors throughout both the initial Task 1 learning phase and the subsequent LoRA fine-tuning on Task 2. The theory quantitatively matches finite-dimensional simulations and exposes two characteristic effects of LoRA: low-rank adaptation reduces interference with features learned on the first task, but its initialization slows adaptation to the second task. Building on this mechanistic picture, we analyze a state-dependent masking strategy that freezes hidden units carrying the strongest first-task representations and restricts adaptation to the complementary subspace. This structural partitioning markedly reduces forgetting, while preserving plasticity on the new task. Our framework further clarifies the role of adapter rank: transfer improves only up to the intrinsic dimensionality of the target task and saturates beyond it, while forgetting continues to grow with rank. These results provide a dynamical and geometric account of how low-rank adaptation organizes information across sequential tasks and are qualitatively reproduced on a sequential MNIST benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文在可解的双任务师生模型中对LoRA进行渐近精确的动力学刻画，揭示了低秩适配减少干扰但初始化拖慢新任务适应的双重效应，并提出状态依赖掩码策略以显著降低遗忘。
AI.motivation: 尽管LoRA被广泛使用，但其在持续学习中的动力学机制、以及低秩更新如何影响灾难性遗忘仍缺乏理论理解。作者希望建立精确的动力学与几何解释。
AI.method: 在双任务师生模型的高维在线学习极限下，推导出有限个宏观序参量的常微分方程组闭系统，得到Task 1学习阶段与Task 2 LoRA微调阶段泛化误差的精确表达式；据此分析状态依赖掩码策略（冻结承载最强Task 1表示的隐藏单元，仅在互补子空间适配），并考察适配器秩的作用。
AI.result: 理论定量匹配有限维仿真；低秩适配减少对Task 1特征的干扰，但其初始化拖慢Task 2适应；状态依赖掩码显著减少遗忘同时保持新任务可塑性；迁移仅在达到目标任务内在维度前提升，超过后饱和，而遗忘随秩持续增长；结论在序列MNIST基准上定性复现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了低秩适配在顺序任务间组织信息的动力学与几何解释，阐明了LoRA秩、干扰、遗忘与可塑性之间的权衡。

title: Towards Optimal Inventory Control under Censored Demand: A Biased Sample-Average Approximation Approach
summary: We study data-driven multi-period lost-sales inventory control under censored demand, where a stockout reveals only that demand exceeded the stocking level. We develop a unified, model-based framework for policy learning from censored data, built on a new cost decomposition for base-stock policies and a biased sample-average approximation (SAA) approach. The cost decomposition allows us to propose a new coverage condition under which censored observations are informative enough for sample-efficient policy learning. Guided by this coverage condition, we design two biased SAA algorithms: an upper-biased one that achieves near-optimal sample complexity under the offline coverage condition, and a lower-biased one that actively generates the required coverage and achieves near-optimal regret online. More broadly, this biased SAA approach provides a general principle for implementing pessimism and optimism under censored feedback, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究截断需求下的数据驱动多周期缺货损失库存控制问题，提出基于成本分解与有偏样本平均近似（SAA）的统一策略学习框架，并设计上偏与下偏两种算法分别实现离线近优样本复杂度和在线近优遗憾。
AI.motivation: 缺货损失（lost-sales）情形下，缺货仅能观测到"需求超过库存水平"这一截断信息（censored demand），导致观测信息不完整。如何在此类截断反馈下高效学习库存策略，并刻画"截断观测何时足以支撑样本高效学习"，是亟待解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 针对base-stock策略提出一种新的成本分解；2) 基于该分解给出新的"覆盖条件"（coverage condition），刻画截断观测信息量是否充分；3) 以此为指导设计两种有偏样本平均近似（biased SAA）算法：上偏（upper-biased）算法用于离线场景，下偏（lower-biased）算法主动生成所需覆盖用于在线场景。
AI.result: 上偏算法在离线覆盖条件下达到近优的样本复杂度；下偏算法通过主动生成所需覆盖，在线场景下达到近优遗憾（near-optimal regret）。
AI.conclusion: 该有偏SAA方法为截断反馈下实现悲观（pessimism）与乐观（optimism）提供了一般性原理，具有独立的研究价值，为数据驱动库存控制提供了统一且样本高效的学习范式。

title: Principal Component Regression Dominates all Monotone Spectral Filters for Linear Regression
summary: We compare the instance-wise, finite-sample risks of monotone spectral filters for linear regression, a broad class of estimators including principal component regression (PCR), gradient descent (GD), and ridge regression. We show that PCR dominates all monotone spectral filters: compared to any such filter, the risk of optimally tuned PCR is no bigger by a constant factor for all problems. Furthermore, the dominance is strong if the filter is separated from step functions (e.g., GD and ridge): there exist problem instances for which the risk of PCR is smaller by a polynomial factor in sample size dependence. Our comparison results show that PCR is optimal and thus admissible among monotone filters, significantly extending Wu et al. (2026)'s result that GD strongly dominates ridge. From a technical perspective, we establish new upper and lower bounds for general spectral filters, which are instance-wise sharp when specialized to ridge or GD, recovering or improving the best-known bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文比较线性回归中单调谱滤波器（含PCR、GD、岭回归）的逐实例有限样本风险，证明最优调参的PCR在所有问题上以常数因子支配任何单调谱滤波器，对远离阶跃函数的滤波器（如GD、岭回归）可达样本量多项式因子的强支配，说明PCR在单调滤波器中是最优且可容许的，并给出一般谱滤波器的逐实例紧致上下界。
AI.motivation: Wu et al. (2026) 仅证明了GD强支配岭回归。本文希望将这一支配性结论推广到更一般的单调谱滤波器类，厘清PCR、GD、岭回归等估计器之间的风险排序，从而回答哪类滤波在单调谱滤波族中最优、是否可容许的问题。
AI.method: 在逐实例、有限样本风险框架下比较单调谱滤波器；通过建立一般谱滤波器的新型上界与下界，并将其特化到岭回归或GD以得到逐实例紧致的界；利用滤波器与阶跃函数之间的距离来刻画支配强度（常数因子支配 vs. 多项式因子强支配）。
AI.result: 最优调参的PCR支配所有单调谱滤波器：与其相比风险至多相差常数因子；若滤波器远离阶跃函数（如GD、岭回归），则存在问题实例使PCR风险在样本量依赖上小多项式因子。同时得到的一般谱滤波器界在特化到岭回归或GD时为逐实例紧致，恢复或改进了已知最优界。
AI.conclusion: PCR在单调谱滤波器类中最优且可容许，显著推广了Wu et al. (2026)关于GD强支配岭回归的结论；新建立的一般谱滤波器上下界具有独立的技術价值。

title: Distributionally robust linear regression through the lens of adversarial training
summary: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) studies parameter estimation under uncertainty in the underlying probability distribution and has emerged as a principled framework for analyzing robustness and generalization. In particular, Wasserstein DRO, with distributional uncertainty induced by the Wasserstein distance, generalizes several popular regularizers. This paper studies Wasserstein DRO linear regression, unifying square-root Lasso and adversarial linear regression as important special cases. We prove that many properties of these two special cases carry over to this general method. In particular, we show (i) deterministic and non-asymptotic in-sample error bounds $O(n^{-1/2})$ in general and $O(n^{-1})$ under design matrix and sparsity conditions; (ii) insensitivity to the noise level, also known as the pivotal property; and (iii) solution equivalences for small and large ambiguity sets. The key proof step is to recast the method into a quadratic form, mimicking adversarial linear regression. We also show that the method can be solved efficiently, and we validate our findings through numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Wasserstein分布式鲁棒优化（DRO）线性回归，将平方根Lasso与对抗线性回归统一为特例，证明该方法继承两者的诸多性质，并给出高效求解算法与数值验证。
AI.motivation: Wasserstein DRO作为分析鲁棒性与泛化的原则性框架，可推广多种正则化方法；平方根Lasso与对抗线性回归是其中两个重要特例，但二者共同所属的更一般方法的理论性质尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 将Wasserstein DRO线性回归重构为二次型形式（类比对抗线性回归），以此证明：样本内误差界的确定性与非渐近性、对噪声水平的不敏感性（pivotal性质），以及小/大模糊集下的解等价性；同时给出高效求解算法。
AI.result: 在一般情况下得到确定性非渐近样本内误差界O(n^{-1/2})，在设计矩阵与稀疏性条件下达到O(n^{-1})；证明方法具有pivotal性质；刻画了小模糊集与大模糊集下的解等价性；数值模拟验证了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: Wasserstein DRO线性回归统一并继承了平方根Lasso与对抗线性回归的性质，兼具良好理论保证与计算可行性，为鲁棒回归分析提供了更一般的理论框架。

title: CAMOS: Coupled Oscillatory State-Space Model for Multimodal Clinical Time-Series
summary: Longitudinal clinical cohorts are multimodal, irregularly sampled and pervasively incomplete: in ADNI, positron emission tomography and cerebrospinal fluid assays are absent from roughly half of all visits. Linear state-space models handle irregular sampling gracefully but treat a missing modality by masking the input, leaving the transition operator untouched. We prove that this is a representational limitation: the latent state of any linear state-space layer whose transition operator does not depend on the availability pattern is an additive function of the availability indicators, so no such layer can represent an interaction between two modalities being jointly present or jointly absent. We propose CAMOS, which gives each modality a bank of second-order oscillators coupled through a matrix that sits inside the differential equation and is gated by availability, so the transition operator itself becomes a function of which measurements were taken. Coupling invalidates the analysis of uncoupled oscillatory models, and we restore it: a per-channel Gershgorin budget makes the effective stiffness positive definite uniformly over all $2^M$ availability patterns and all gaps, an energy argument charges amplification to availability transitions rather than sequence length, and a channel factorization preserves exact associative parallel scans. On ADNI, CAMOS outperforms uncoupled oscillatory state-space models and clinical fusion models on same-visit staging, landmark prediction and longitudinal forecasting, and under zero-shot transfer to OASIS-3 it is the only model that avoids collapse to the majority class.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMOS，用二阶振荡器耦合矩阵并把可用性门控嵌入微分方程，使转移算子依赖缺失模式，在ADNI多模态不完整纵向建模中优于解耦振荡状态空间与临床融合模型，并零样本迁移OASIS-3避免多数类坍塌。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床队列（如ADNI）具有多模态、不规则采样和普遍缺失的特点：约半数访视缺少PET与脑脊液检测。线性状态空间模型虽能处理不规则采样，但对缺失模态仅做输入掩码，转移算子不随可用性变化。作者证明这是一种表示能力局限：转移算子不依赖可用性模式的线性状态空间层，其隐状态是可用性指示变量的加性函数，无法表示两模态"同时存在或同时缺失"的交互。
AI.method: CAMOS为每个模态配置一组二阶振荡器，通过位于微分方程内部、由可用性门控的耦合矩阵相连，使转移算子本身成为"哪些测量被采集"的函数。针对耦合破坏原有解耦振荡模型分析的问题，作者给出三点理论恢复：逐通道Gershgorin预算保证有效刚度在所有2^M种可用性模式与所有时间间隔上一致正定；能量论证将放大归因于可用性切换而非序列长度；通道因式分解保持精确的关联式并行扫描。
AI.result: 在ADNI上，CAMOS在同访视分期、标志性预测与纵向预测任务中均优于解耦振荡状态空间模型和临床融合模型；在零样本迁移至OASIS-3时，是唯一未坍塌到多数类的模型。
AI.conclusion: 将缺失模式通过门控耦合直接写入转移算子，可突破掩码式线性状态空间模型的表示瓶颈，并在多模态不完整纵向临床建模中获得更稳健、可迁移的性能。

title: Mitigating Representation Gaps in Amortized Bayesian Inference with Auxiliary Supervision
summary: Casting Bayesian inference as a neural network optimization problem targeting an amortized posterior is attractive, as it extends to otherwise intractable statistical models and offers near instantaneous inference for new datasets after prepaying the training cost. Although theory guarantees faithfulness under ideal convergence, practical amortized inference still requires iterating over architectures and optimization choices and ultimately ``satisficing'' under finite simulation, compute, and time budgets. Even the best-performing solution may thus retain avoidable representation gaps that typically require problem-specific fixes. Here, we propose a generic alternative which improves training dynamics with auxiliary guidance losses applied to internal representations. Specifically, we show how such guidance leads to faster convergence when training data is abundant and to better performance when it is scarce. We formalize representation gaps as getting stuck in a local optimum at the information bottleneck between the parts of the network tasked with feature learning and those tasked with conditional distribution learning, and offer a generic diagnostic to separate summary failures from inference failures. Finally, we demonstrate that auxiliary supervision improves convergence speed and accuracy on a range of challenging real-world inference problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通用方法，通过在神经网络内部表示上施加辅助引导损失来改进摊销贝叶斯推断的训练动态：数据充足时加速收敛，数据稀缺时提升性能，并给出表示差距的诊断手段。
AI.motivation: 摊销贝叶斯推断虽在理想收敛下具理论保证，但实际中受限于模拟、算力与时间预算，只能"满意化"地迭代架构与优化选择，最优方案仍可能残留可避免的表示差距，通常需要针对具体问题做修补。
AI.method: 提出对网络内部表示施加辅助引导损失（auxiliary guidance losses）的通用训练策略；并将表示差距形式化为卡在特征学习部分与条件分布学习部分之间信息瓶颈处的局部最优，同时提供一种通用诊断以区分摘要失败与推断失败。
AI.result: 辅助监督在多种具有挑战性的真实世界推断问题上提升了收敛速度与精度；数据充足时收敛更快，数据稀缺时性能更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过辅助引导损失改善训练动态是一种通用的、无需问题特定修补的替代方案，并能借助信息瓶颈视角诊断表示差距的来源。

title: Estimation of the Label-Noise Transition Matrix with Performance Guarantees via Selective Classification
summary: Modern machine learning depends heavily on massive datasets, but obtaining high-quality annotations at scale is often expensive. As a result, learning from noisily-labeled data has become common, making accurate estimation of the label-noise transition matrix crucial. However, existing transition matrix estimators rely on the fragile estimation of class-posteriors and do not provide finite-sample performance guarantees. In this work, we propose a novel methodology to estimate the transition matrix based on one-sided selective classification. This approach bypasses class-posterior estimation, provides finite-sample performance guarantees, and leverages flexible learning methods for binary classification. Moreover, we introduce effective algorithms to implement the proposed methodology and provide their refined finite-sample performance bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单侧选择性分类的标签噪声转移矩阵估计方法，绕过类后验估计，具备有限样本性能保证，并可利用灵活的二元分类学习方法，同时给出了有效的实现算法及其精细化的有限样本界。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习依赖大规模数据集，但高质量标注成本高昂，带噪标注学习已成常态，因此准确估计标签噪声转移矩阵至关重要。现有转移矩阵估计器依赖脆弱的类后验估计，且缺乏有限样本性能保证。
AI.method: 提出基于单侧选择性分类（one-sided selective classification）的转移矩阵估计方法：绕开类后验估计，利用灵活的二元分类学习器，并设计相应有效算法实现该估计流程。
AI.result: 方法绕过类后验估计，提供有限样本性能保证，并针对所提算法给出精细化的有限样本性能界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为带噪标签学习中的转移矩阵估计提供了无需类后验估计、且具理论保证的新途径，并附有可实现算法与更紧的有限样本界。

title: BayesNDE: Bayesian Generative Modeling for Neural Density Estimation
summary: Density estimation is a fundamental problem in statistics and machine learning. In this work, we introduce BayesNDE, a neural density estimator based on Bayesian generative modeling. BayesNDE learns a Bayesian generative model and evaluates its density without requiring invertible networks or Jacobian-determinant computation. For each observation, it infers a sample-specific latent posterior to construct an adaptive proposal that focuses computation on regions contributing most to its density. Bridge sampling then combines samples from this proposal with separate posterior samples to estimate the density. Experiments on nonlinear and multimodal synthetic datasets show improved estimation of density values and better recovery of the density structure compared to the state-of-the-art neural density estimators. Applications to real-world datasets further demonstrate improved anomaly detection.
