Together, these results highlight BayesNDE as a flexible and effective neural density estimator, demonstrating how posterior inference can turn generative models into tools for density estimation. The code and tutorials are available at https://github.com/liuq-lab/BayesNDE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BayesNDE，一种基于贝叶斯生成建模的神经密度估计器，无需可逆网络或雅可比行列式计算，通过推断样本特定的潜在后验构造自适应提议分布，并用桥式采样估计密度值。
AI.motivation: 密度估计是统计学与机器学习的基础问题，但现有神经密度估计方法（如归一化流）通常依赖可逆网络结构和雅可比行列式计算，带来计算与建模上的限制，需要更灵活有效的替代方案。
AI.method: BayesNDE学习一个贝叶斯生成模型，直接评估其密度，避免可逆网络和雅可比行列式。针对每个观测，推断样本特定的潜在后验，用以构建自适应提议分布，将计算集中在对其密度贡献最大的区域；随后通过桥式采样，将该提议分布的样本与独立的后验样本结合来估计密度。
AI.result: 在非线性与多模态合成数据集上，BayesNDE相比最先进的神经密度估计器，密度值估计更准确，密度结构恢复更好；在真实数据集上的应用进一步显示异常检测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: BayesNDE是一种灵活且有效的神经密度估计器，表明后验推断可将生成模型转化为密度估计工具，代码与教程已开源。

title: Amortized Bayesian Inference on Multilevel Models of Arbitrary Structure
summary: We develop a general method for amortized Bayesian inference on multilevel models of arbitrary structure. Given a generative model specified as a directed acyclic graph, our method automatically derives valid factorizations of the joint posterior and matching neural network architectures. The key steps, graph expansion and graph inversion, yield an inverse graph that determines how inference networks are stacked and conditioned, producing factorizations that amortize over the number of groups and the number of observations within each group. Unlike approaches that simplify the dependency structure to speed up learning or inference, our method preserves all conditional independence and exchangeability assumptions of the generative model. Across three case studies, it closely matches gold-standard samplers on models with more than 6,500 parameters while reducing inference to a near-instant forward pass once trained.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对任意结构多层模型的摊销贝叶斯推断通用方法，通过图扩展与图反转自动推导联合后验的有效分解及匹配的神经网络架构，在三个案例中与标准采样器高度一致，训练后可近似即时推断。
AI.motivation: 多层模型结构多样，现有摊销推断方法常通过简化依赖结构来加速学习或推断，这牺牲了生成模型原有的条件独立性与可交换性假设。需要一个能处理任意结构、同时不破坏这些假设的通用摊销推断方法。
AI.method: 将生成模型表示为由向无环图（DAG）。方法包含两个关键步骤：图扩展（graph expansion）与图反转（graph inversion）。图扩展得到逆图，用以决定推断网络如何堆叠与条件化，从而自动生成联合后验的有效分解及与之匹配的神经网络架构；分解对组数及每组内观测数均实现摊销。
AI.result: 在三个案例研究中，方法在参数量超过6,500的模型上与金标准采样器结果高度吻合；训练完成后，推断被简化为一次近乎即时的前向传播。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为任意结构多层模型提供了通用、忠实于生成假设的摊销贝叶斯推断方案，兼顾准确性与推断速度，避免了以简化依赖结构为代价的近似。

title: Proximal Balancing for Causal Effect Estimation under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating causal effects from observational data is central to science and policy, but the effects are not identified when confounders are unmeasured. Proximal causal inference addresses this problem with proxies of the unmeasured confounders. However, existing proxy-based approaches either designate proxy roles and solve an inverse problem, which is ill-posed and hard to estimate with high-dimensional proxies, or use a latent-variable model, which assumes that the learned latent variable matches the hidden confounder and leaves bias when it does not. To address these challenges, we introduce proximal balancing. It carries the classical idea of covariate balancing to confounders that are observed only through proxies: it learns a low-dimensional summary of the covariates and proxies that makes the treatment groups comparable, and then adjusts for this summary. It needs no designated proxy roles, inverse problem, or latent model. We give identification theory, finite-sample guarantees, and a practical algorithm, PROBE. We demonstrate the method on low-dimensional, high-dimensional, and image proxies and on real-world data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 proximal balancing，将经典协变量平衡思想拓展到仅能通过代理变量观测的混杂因子，学习协变量与代理的低维摘要使处理组可比，无需指定代理角色、求解反问题或潜在变量模型，并给出识别理论、有限样本保证及实用算法 PROBE。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计因果效应在科学与政策中至关重要，但当混杂因子未被测量时效应不可识别。近端因果推断通过未测混杂因子的代理变量解决此问题，然而现有基于代理的方法存在两类缺陷：一是指定代理角色并求解反问题，该问题病态且在高维代理下难以估计；二是使用潜在变量模型，假设学得的潜在变量恰好匹配隐藏混杂因子，一旦不匹配便留下偏差。论文旨在同时克服这两类挑战。
AI.method: 提出 proximal balancing 方法：把经典协变量平衡思想推广到仅通过代理观测的混杂因子上——学习协变量与代理变量的低维摘要，使处理组之间具有可比性，然后针对该摘要进行调整。该方法不需要指定代理角色、不需要求解反问题、也不依赖潜在变量模型。论文进一步给出识别理论、有限样本保证，并提出实用算法 PROBE。
AI.result: 在低维、高维以及图像代理变量上进行了验证，并在真实世界数据上展示了方法的效果。
AI.conclusion: proximal balancing 为存在未测混杂因子且仅有代理观测的因果效应估计提供了新的思路，规避了现有近端方法在代理角色指定、反问题病态性以及潜在变量模型误设方面的困难，兼具理论保证（识别与有限样本）与实用算法（PROBE），并在多种代理类型和真实数据上得到验证。

title: Signal Processing over Product DAGs: Causal Shifts and Filters
summary: We develop a signal processing framework for signals indexed by the product of two directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and described by a linear structural equation model (SEM). Such a setup arises whenever (linear) causal relations act along two domains, as in component versus manufacturing stage or gene versus experimental condition. Disregarding the factorization of the underlying graph and the native two-axis causal structure requires inverting a weighted transitive closure matrix whose size is the product of the two factor sizes for Fourier analysis. Recognizing that standard graph products fail to yield factorizable transitive closures, we introduce a new DAG product under which separability holds. We motivate the new operator in the vertex domain, and show that it also renders the SEM, the Fourier modes, the causal shifts, and the filters on the product DAG separable across its constituent graph factors.

AI.tldr: 本文针对由两个有向无环图（DAG）乘积索引、且服从线性结构方程模型（SEM）的信号，提出了一种新的DAG乘积运算，使传递闭包矩阵可分离，从而在顶点域与谱域均实现因果信号处理框架的可分解性。
AI.motivation: 许多线性因果关系会同时沿两个域展开（如组件×制造阶段、基因×实验条件），此时信号由两个DAG的乘积索引并服从SEM。若忽视底层图的因子分解及固有的双轴因果结构，则Fourier分析需对一个规模为两因子尺寸之积的加权传递闭包矩阵求逆，计算代价高。而标准图乘积无法产生可分解的传递闭包，因而需要一种新的DAG乘积来保证可分离性。
AI.method: 作者首先指出标准图乘积（如笛卡尔积、张量积等）不能使传递闭包因子化，随后提出一种新的DAG乘积运算，并在顶点域给出其构造动机。基于该新乘积证明可分离性成立，并进一步展示该算子使SEM、Fourier模式、因果移位（causal shifts）以及乘积DAG上的滤波器均可跨两个因子图分解。
AI.result: 在所提出的新DAG乘积下，传递闭包具有可分离结构，避免了直接对大尺寸加权传递闭包矩阵求逆；同时证明了SEM、Fourier模式、因果移位与滤波器均能在两个构成图因子上实现分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入一种新的DAG乘积算子，本文为双轴因果结构信号建立了可分离的信号处理框架，使Fourier分析与滤波等操作可沿两个因子图分解，显著降低了处理乘积DAG上因果信号的复杂度，并为多域因果信号分析提供了理论基础。

title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public (directory scale_field, tag p5-scale-field-v1)
summary: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以“行与列尺度场”（对权重矩阵通道取对数RMS并减去中位数）作为介观层级的分析对象，与全局尺度及均衡核心一起精确表示权重矩阵。在Pythia多个规模与三类初始化的受控训练中，均衡化揭示相似的实测核心幅值剖面，并用混合桥模型解释合并形态随场宽的偏离；尺度场还对齐共享功能通道的投影、随RoPE频率重分配而变化，可用于跟踪训练轨迹与检验权重结构。
AI.motivation: Transformer权重的合并统计量掩盖了幅值在功能通道上的分布，而逐权重比较又因数量庞大不可行。作者希望在两者之间建立一个可精确、可解释的介观层级表征，以刻画并检验训练后权重中的通道组织。
AI.method: 将权重矩阵分解为全局尺度、均衡核心（full balanced core）以及行、列尺度场（对各通道取中位数中心化的对数RMS剖面），该表示无损。在Pythia公开检查点（四种规模）与来自三类初始化族的受控运行上分析这些尺度场；采用形式预先设定、系数拟合的混合桥（mixture bridge）模型；将分析扩展到AdamW二阶矩的对数空间行、列因子；并通过编辑冻结检查点区分互反尺度均衡与相对通道增益。
AI.result: 均衡化在受控网格各运行与数据分支上显示相似的实测核心幅值剖面；混合桥能从场宽预测合并形态的偏离并在留出运行上验证。索引尺度场呈现额外结构：在共享功能通道的投影间对齐，query/key剖面对应重新分配的RoPE频率而非固定矩阵坐标。训练轨迹表现为早期尺度场形成，随后按组件不同而展宽或收缩。AdamW二阶矩的对数空间行列因子也表现出相关的功能组织。编辑实验中，展平相对通道增益会提高分布内损失，同时保持矩阵范数与均衡核心不变；而互反尺度均衡保持前向计算不变。
AI.conclusion: 行列尺度场将合并幅值统计与通道组织联系起来，为跟踪和检验训练得到的权重结构提供了可用的坐标系，并可作为编辑与诊断权重功能结构的介观工具。

title: Grokking through the Lens of Minimum-Norm Interpolation
summary: Grokking shows that fitting the training data and learning the underlying signal can occur at very different stages. However, existing theories offer limited quantitative insight into how this delayed generalization depends on inductive bias and signal structure. Our work addresses the gap by developing a statistical theory that characterizes how regularization geometry and signal sparsity govern generalization near interpolation. In particular, we focus on the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression and identify regimes in which sparsity-promoting regularization makes exact interpolation much more accurate than approximate fitting. In strongly overparameterized noiseless problems, we prove a zero--one generalization law and construct a family of convex norms whose interpolators transition from the trivial risk of the all-zero predictor to exact recovery, while keeping the training error equal to $0$. Furthermore, when feature dimension and sample size are proportional, we provide a precise characterization of training and generalization errors along $\ell_r$-regularization paths. This in turn allows us to quantify the generalization gain that remains near interpolation: we show that this gain increases as the norm becomes more sparsity-promoting and as the target becomes sparser, with a sharp drop in generalization reached for noiseless data and $\ell_1$ regularization. Experiments on diagonal linear networks and transformers trained on modular arithmetic demonstrate the generality of our theoretical predictions. Finally, beyond grokking, our work reveals a statistical instability in minimum-norm interpolation: small perturbations in the regularization strength can lead to drastically different generalization, while preserving small training error.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了高维回归下解析grokking的统计理论，刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何支配插值附近的泛化，并证明零一泛化律、量化稀疏正则带来的泛化增益及最小范数插值的统计不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有grokking理论难以定量解释延迟泛化如何依赖归纳偏置与信号结构，尤其缺乏对插值附近泛化行为的精确刻画。
AI.method: 以高维回归为原型设定，发展统计理论：分析强过参数化无噪声问题中促进稀疏的正则化几何，证明零一泛化律，构造凸范数族使插值器从全零预测器的平凡风险跃迁到精确恢复且训练误差为0；在特征维度与样本量成比例时，精确刻画沿ℓ_r正则化路径的训练与泛化误差。
AI.result: 证明零一泛化律并构造过渡性凸范数族；量化插值附近的泛化增益随范数更促进稀疏、目标更稀疏而增大，无噪声数据与ℓ1正则时泛化增益急剧下降；发现最小范数插值的统计不稳定性——正则强度微小扰动即可导致泛化剧变而训练误差仍很小。对角线性网络与模运算Transformer实验验证了理论预测的普遍性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为grokking提供了定量统计解释，揭示稀疏正则几何与信号稀疏性共同决定插值附近泛化，并指出最小范数插值存在统计不稳定性，超越grokking本身具有更广泛意义。

title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
summary: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

AI.tldr: ShamAN-Q是一种亚1比特训练后量化方法，通过将NanoQuant的对角重构几何替换为基于Kronecker乘积拟合经验Fisher信息的可处理稠密曲率度量，显著降低WikiText-2困惑度并保持零样本精度。
AI.motivation: NanoQuant等亚1比特量化方法使用对角重构几何，对权重曲率的刻画较为简化，限制了重构质量。作者希望引入更精确的稠密曲率度量（借鉴Shampoo优化器的思路）来提升量化后模型的性能。
AI.method: ShamAN-Q在NanoQuant基础上，用可处理的稠密曲率度量替换每个对角重构几何。对每个线性权重，通过KL最小化将Kronecker乘积拟合到小校准集的经验Fisher信息矩阵，形成Mahalanobis重构损失。连续ADMM更新转化为Sylvester方程求解，离散投影与部署格式保持不变。由于曲率是局部于给定权重的，在每层分解前重新测量输入曲率统计，并周期性刷新部分量化模型上的所有统计。此外，在相同总比特数下跨层重新分配NanoQuant的均匀秩。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base上，约1 bpw时，ShamAN-Q将WikiText-2困惑度从27.56降至22.96（0.6B）、19.21降至16.72（1.7B）、14.29降至13.80（4B），同时在Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness上匹配或提升零样本精度。在0.6B上，ShamAN-Q在约0.8 bpw时的困惑度即可匹配NanoQuant在约1.0 bpw时的已发表结果。
AI.conclusion: ShamAN-Q通过引入稠密曲率度量有效提升了亚1比特训练后量化的性能，在更低比特预算下达到更优困惑度，同时兼容原有部署格式，显示出实际应用潜力。

title: Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching
summary: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Universal Barycenter Approximation 问题，即近似整个 Wasserstein 单纯形上的重心族，并提出流匹配模型 BaryFM，可在单次训练后通过 ODE 采样任意权重的 Wasserstein 重心。
AI.motivation: Wasserstein 重心是概率机器学习中的核心工具，但现有方法多针对固定权重向量计算重心，对近似整个单纯形上重心族（Wasserstein simplex）的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 提出 BaryFM，一种流匹配（flow matching）模型，将边缘测度输运至 Wasserstein 单纯形中的任意重心；训练完成后可通过常微分方程（ODE）从单纯形内的测度中采样。
AI.result: 在 4 个下游任务上验证：域适应、泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合与算法公平性；在 10 个域适应基准上，BaryFM 在 15 种对比方法中取得最佳平均排名，并匹配或超越非通用求解器。
AI.conclusion: BaryFM 有效实现了通用 Wasserstein 重心近似，兼具通用性与竞争性能，可广泛应用于多种下游任务。

title: Learning-Enabled Estimation: Tight Characterizations under Sample Selection Biases
summary:
When can we learn from biased samples? We study regression when outcomes are observed only after passing through selection filters that depend on both covariates and outcomes themselves, a ubiquitous challenge spanning clinical trials with patient dropout, labor markets with self-selection, and auctions with strategic entry. Ignoring such selection yields systematically biased conclusions with real-world consequences. This challenge has a long history in econometrics and statistics, starting with Heckman's seminal two-stage model and followed by numerous generalizations. While these works provide various sufficient conditions for identification, a complete characterization of when such regression is possible has remained elusive.
  In this work, we provide a characterization for when regression is possible in the presence of sample selection bias. Our results establish the minimal assumptions required on the functional forms of selection processes under which regression remains possible, which are particularly relevant in modern settings where selection mechanisms are increasingly complex and opaque. As a corollary of our characterization, we show that there are settings where the regression function can be identified even when the selection filter itself cannot. This observation already goes beyond the ``estimate selection filter, then debias regression'' paradigm that is followed by virtually all existing approaches. Under natural strengthenings of our identification conditions, we also establish finite-sample estimation guarantees with explicit convergence rates and provide oracle-efficient algorithms. This yields the first general-purpose estimation method for this broad class of selection problems. Finally, we explore the implications of our results for several well-studied econometric settings with complex selection mechanisms such as auctions with entry costs and labor markets.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了存在样本选择偏差时回归可识别性的完整刻画，指明选择过程函数形式所需的最小假设，并进一步提供具有显式收敛率的有限样本估计保证与预言机高效算法。
AI.motivation: 样本选择偏差广泛存在于临床试验患者脱落、劳动力市场自选择、拍卖策略性进入等场景，忽略选择会导致系统性偏差。尽管自Heckman两阶段模型以来已有大量充分条件，但"回归何时可能"的完整刻画仍缺失，尤其在选择机制日益复杂的现代设定下。
AI.method: 刻画使回归可识别的选择过程函数形式所需的最小假设；作为推论证明存在选择过滤器本身不可识别、但回归函数仍可识别的设定，从而突破"先估计选择过滤器再纠偏"的范式；在加强识别条件下建立有限样本估计保证，给出显式收敛率与预言机高效算法。
AI.result: 获得样本选择偏差下回归可识别性的完整刻画；证明回归函数可在选择过滤器不可识别时仍被识别；在自然强化条件下得到带显式收敛率的有限样本估计保证与预言机高效算法，构成该类选择问题首个通用估计方法；并探讨其对拍卖进入成本、劳动力市场等复杂选择机制计量场景的含义。
AI.conclusion: 本文为样本选择偏差下的回归提供了完整可识别性刻画与首个通用估计方法，揭示了识别回归无需识别选择过滤器这一反直觉现象，对现代复杂选择机制下的计量与统计实践具有重要理论与方法意义。

title: Understanding Off- vs On-Policy Distillation: A Tale of Distinct Training Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) learns from teacher feedback on student-generated responses and has shown promise in reducing forgetting relative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, its benefits and fragility remain incompletely understood. We study sequential distillation from multiple teachers, where the student minimizes its average divergence from the teachers. Forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence yields a weighted arithmetic mixture, while reverse KL yields a normalized weighted geometric aggregate. We develop algorithms that learn these targets under off-policy and on-policy feedback, respectively, establishing logarithmic regret bounds in the tabular setting and extending the analysis to function approximation. By analyzing these aggregation targets, we identify mechanisms that help explain both the benefits and fragility of OPD. Relative to forward KL, reverse KL can better retain a confident expert's preferences under uninformative feedback, but is more sensitive to teachers that assign very low probabilities to correct responses. Its token-level conditionals also reveal a dependence on continuation distributions that can favor incorrect prefixes over long horizons.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上研究多教师序贯蒸馏中前向与反向KL聚合目标的异同，提出在离线与在线反馈下学习这两种目标、并具备对数遗憾界的算法，从而解释在线策略蒸馏（OPD）相对监督微调（SFT）的优势与脆弱性来源。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用教师对"学生自己生成的回答"的反馈，被认为比SFT更能缓解遗忘，但其收益与脆弱性尚未被充分理解。作者希望从理论上刻画多教师序贯蒸馏的聚合目标，从而揭示OPD为何有效、又在何处失效。
AI.method: 研究从多个教师出发的序贯蒸馏：学生最小化其与教师之间的平均散度。作者指出前向KL的聚合结果是加权算术混合，而反向KL对应归一化的加权几何聚合；随后分别针对离线反馈与在线反馈设计学习这两种目标的算法，在表格情形下建立对数遗憾界，并将分析推广到函数逼近设定。
AI.result: 算法在表格情形下获得对数遗憾界，并成功扩展到函数逼近；通过对聚合目标（算术混合 vs 几何聚合）的分析，作者识别出若干机制来解释OPD的收益与脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 相较前向KL，反向KL在反馈信息量低时能更好保留自信专家的偏好，但对给正确答案分配极低概率的教师更敏感；其token级条件分布还暴露出对后续（continuation）分布的依赖，在长时程下可能反而偏好错误前缀——这些机制共同解释了OPD的优势与不稳定性。

title: Amortized Data Borrowing with Exchangeability-Aware Neural Posterior Estimation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026)
summary: Augmenting small concurrent studies with external or historical cohorts is attractive in drug development, where enrollment is slow, follow-up is expensive, and closely related trial or real-world data are often already available. Bayesian dynamic borrowing (BDB) provides a principled framework for adaptively controlling the influence of external data, but classical implementations often depend on hand-specified priors and MCMC-based inference, which can be computationally expensive and not generalizable. In this work, we study amortized neural posterior estimation (NPE) as a flexible alternative. A single network is pretrained on simulated current/external dataset pairs spanning covariate shift, outcome drift, and joint non-exchangeability, and then returns an approximate posterior for a scalar current-study target in a single forward pass. Through simulation studies, we find that NPE is most useful under outcome drift and joint mismatch: in the harder outcome-drift regimes, it gives up to about five-fold lower absolute bias than the best classical baseline and keeps Type I error close to nominal. After pretraining, posterior summaries are obtained in about 8 ms per dataset, roughly $10^3\times$ faster than MCMC-based borrowing baselines in our timing experiment. We further analyze Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) data and show that, when mild cognitive impairment outcomes differ across cohorts, the NPE formulation recovers the later-cohort risk level in this example without claiming greater precision. Code is available at https://github.com/ChinHungScott/NPE-for-Bayesian-Dynamic-Borrowing-MLHC-.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究摊销神经后验估计（NPE）作为贝叶斯动态借用的替代方案，在多种不匹配情形下表现优于经典基线且计算高效。
AI.motivation: 药物开发中，小型同期研究常通过借入外部或历史队列来增强统计效能，但存在协变量漂移、结局漂移、非可交换性等问题。经典贝叶斯动态借用依赖手设先验和MCMC推断，计算昂贵且泛化性差，因此需要一种灵活、高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出用摊销神经后验估计（NPE）替代传统贝叶斯动态借用（BDB）。在模拟的当前/外部数据集对上预训练单个神经网络，覆盖协变量偏移、结局漂移及联合非可交换性，然后对当前研究的标量目标进行单次前向传播，返回近似后验。模拟研究中与经典BDB基线比较偏差、Type I错误率和计算时间；并在ADNI真实数据上分析轻度认知障碍结局的跨队列差异。
AI.result: NPE在结局漂移和联合不匹配下最为有效：在更难处理的结局漂移情形中，绝对偏差比最佳经典基线低约5倍，Type I错误率接近名义水平。预训练后，每数据集的后验摘要仅需约8毫秒，比基于MCMC的借用基线快约10^3倍。ADNI分析显示，当轻度认知障碍结局在不同队列间存在差异时，NPE公式能恢复较晚队列的风险水平，而不虚称更高精度。
AI.conclusion: NPE是一种灵活、高效且计算快速的贝叶斯动态借用替代方案，特别适用于结局漂移和联合不匹配情形，可避免手设先验和昂贵的MCMC推断，在真实数据中也能合理借入外部信息而不夸大精度。

title: Flow Matching under Noisy Latent Structure: Beyond Exact Low-Dimensional Support
summary: Flow Matching (FM) learns a velocity field whose ODE transports a simple source distribution to a target law. Existing finite-sample theory largely treats ambient-space regularity or data supported exactly on low-dimensional sets. We study linear FM under a noisy latent-generator model, where a low-dimensional Hölder map is perturbed by nondegenerate ambient Gaussian noise, so the target law is full-dimensional despite its latent structure. We construct a spatially regular ReLU velocity class and establish non-asymptotic high-probability approximation and estimation bounds whose leading sample-size exponent is governed by the latent dimension rather than the ambient dimension, with ambient and noise dependence kept explicit. Fixed positive target noise keeps the interpolation nondegenerate over the full time interval. The same spatial regularity propagates the learned velocity error through the transport ODE, yielding a corresponding Wasserstein convergence guarantee. These results show that exact low-dimensional support is not necessary for Flow Matching to retain latent-dimensional statistical behavior.

AI.tldr: 该文研究噪声隐生成模型下的线性流匹配（FM），证明当目标律由低维 Hölder 映射加上非退化环境高斯噪声生成时，学习速度场的样本复杂度主指数由隐维度而非环境维度决定，并给出 Wasserstein 收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配的有限样本理论多假设环境空间正则性，或要求数据精确支撑在低维集合上。作者希望回答：当低维结构被非退化环境噪声"模糊"、目标律实为满维时，流匹配是否仍能保持隐维度式的统计行为。
AI.method: 采用噪声隐生成模型：低维 Hölder 映射 + 非退化环境高斯噪声。构造空间正则的 ReLU 速度函数类，建立非渐近高概率逼近与估计界，并显式保留环境维度与噪声依赖性；再将空间正则性传播到传输 ODE，得到速度误差到 Wasserstein 距离的收敛保证。
AI.result: 逼近与估计界的主导样本量指数由隐维度控制，而非环境维度，且对环境与噪声的依赖显式。固定正的目标噪声使插值在全时间区间上非退化。速度误差经传输 ODE 传播，得到相应的 Wasserstein 收敛界。
AI.conclusion: 精确的低维支撑并非流匹配获得隐维度统计速率所必需；只要噪声非退化，近似低维结构即可保留隐维度式的样本效率。

title: A Rank Graduation metric for Algorithmic fairness
summary:
Fairness assessment in algorithmic decisions that affect individuals, such as credit scoring, often relies on parity measures calculated at the aggregate group level. Such measures may not reveal which individuals experience unfairness or which explanatory factors contribute to it. In this paper, we propose a rank-based framework that evaluates fairness through the distribution of model prediction errors, thereby linking fairness assessment with predictive accuracy and explainability. The framework combines Rank Graduation Fairness (RGF), its integrated measure AURGF, a centered Cramer--von Mises permutation test, and a feature removal procedure for fairness explainability.
  We evaluate the methodology using logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, and a multilayer perceptron. The simulation study shows that protected-group imbalance can reverse descriptive fairness comparisons, whereas the proposed inferential procedure correctly distinguishes fair from unfair mechanisms. Its application to HMDA mortgage data produces model rankings that differ from those obtained with classical fairness criteria. Tree-based models, rather than logistic regression, provide the strongest combination of predictive accuracy and rank-based fairness, while the fairness null hypothesis is rejected for all four models. The persistence of disparity across statistical, bagging, boosting, and neural network specifications, together with the feature removal results, indicates that the observed unfairness is not specific to a single algorithm or predictor, but is associated with group differences embedded in the characteristics of the lending data. These findings support a broader approach to trustworthy artificial intelligence that combines predictive accuracy, fairness measurement, statistical inference, and explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于秩的公平性评估框架，通过模型预测误差分布将公平性与预测精度、可解释性相联系，包含RGF、AURGF、CvM置换检验及特征移除流程，并在模拟与HMDA房贷数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统群体层面的均等性度量只能反映聚合层面的差异，无法揭示哪些个体遭受不公平以及哪些解释性因素导致不公平，因此需要一种能关联预测精度与可解释性的公平性评估方法。
AI.method: 提出秩基公平性框架：Rank Graduation Fairness（RGF）、其积分度量AURGF、中心化Cramer–von Mises置换检验，以及用于公平性可解释性的特征移除程序；使用逻辑回归、随机森林、梯度提升和多层感知机进行评估，并开展模拟研究与HMDA房贷数据实证。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明受保护群体失衡会反转描述性公平比较，而所提推断程序能正确区分公平与不公平机制；在HMDA数据上模型排序与经典公平准则不同，树模型在预测精度与秩基公平性组合上最优，四个模型的公平性原假设均被拒绝；特征移除结果与多种算法设定下差异的持续性表明不公平并非源于单一算法或预测变量，而是与贷款数据特征中的群体差异相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持将预测精度、公平性度量、统计推断和可解释性结合的可信人工智能更广泛路径。

title: Awakening of the Buddha: Subspace Learning During Population-Loss Plateaus
summary: Population loss can remain nearly constant while a neural network learns a substantially more predictive representation. We establish this separation for two-layer ReLU and leaky-ReLU networks trained on Gaussian inputs by simultaneous fixed-step population gradient descent on all parameters. For structured additive teachers whose links are positive mixtures of Gaussian-damped cubics in $H^1(γ)$, we give explicit conditions under which small IID Gaussian initialization yields a high-probability guarantee: at a checkpoint during a high-loss plateau, minimum alignment between the rank-$r$ teacher subspace and the leading $r$-dimensional eigenspace of the predictor's average gradient outer product (AGOP) increases by at least $1/2$, and the minimum refit MSE under unchanged coefficient budgets decreases by more than $0.399$, both relative to initialization. The same trajectory subsequently attains a trained loss below every value in the plateau window. A complementary result treats unequal-weight cubic teachers and small additive Sobolev perturbations using projected-feature refits. For SwiGLU networks with an exactly fitted intercept, we prove leading-AGOP alignment during a loss plateau at fixed width and dimension as Gaussian initialization vanishes, for square-integrable teachers with nonzero Hermite content of degree one, two, or three. A rank-one cubic specialization also gives simultaneous unrestricted-refit gains at a prescribed width. An approximation lower bound further shows that certain interaction targets retain nonzero error when ridge neurons are restricted to shared orthogonal axes within the teacher subspace. Population-moment experiments with ReLU students across 21 teachers and 50 initializations per teacher complement the analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经网络在总体损失几乎不变（高原期）时，其表征已显著增强的现象，并在两层ReLU/leaky-ReLU网络与SwiGLU网络上给出了理论分离与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 动机在于解释神经网络训练中"损失平台期"与"表征学习"之间的解耦现象：总体损失可长期保持近似不变，但网络内部已学得更具预测性的表征。作者希望在可控的总体梯度下降框架下，严格刻画这种损失与表征分离的条件与幅度。
AI.method: 方法上，作者对高斯输入下的两层ReLU与leaky-ReLU网络，采用所有参数同步定步长总体梯度下降；针对链接为高斯衰减三次函数正混合、属于H^1(γ)的结构化加性教师，给出小IID高斯初始化下的高概率保证。借助预测器平均梯度外积（AGOP）的前r维特征空间与教师秩r子空间的最小对齐度，以及固定系数预算下的重拟合MSE来度量表征。另对不等权三次教师与加性Sobolev扰动采用投影特征重拟合；对精确拟合截距的SwiGLU网络，在宽度与维度固定、初始化趋于零时证明损失高原期的主导AGOP对齐；并给出秩一三次特化的无限制重拟合增益与近似下界。
AI.result: 结果方面：在高原期某一检查点，教师秩r子空间与预测器AGOP前r维特征空间的最小对齐度较初始化至少增加1/2，固定系数预算下最小重拟合MSE下降超过0.399；同一轨迹随后达到低于高原窗口所有值的训练损失。SwiGLU情形下证明了初始化消失时损失高原期的主导AGOP对齐，适用于Hermite内容为一、二或三次非零的平方可积教师；并给出共享正交轴限制下交互目标误差非零的近似下界。21个教师、每个50次初始化的ReLU学生总体矩实验与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：总体损失停滞并不等价于表征停滞，网络可在损失平台期显著提升表征预测能力；该分离在ReLU、leaky-ReLU及SwiGLU等架构上具有可证明的高概率保证，并受教师结构与初始化尺度影响，同时由总体矩实验支持。

title: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters: A Causal Intervention for Routing Collapse in Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) commonly adapt to new data by attaching a single trainable head to a frozen backbone, a one-size-fits-all setup that underfits heterogeneous regimes. Replacing the head with a mixture of experts is the standard upgrade, but on instance-normalized backbones (the dominant TSFM design class) it fails: routing entropy collapses to zero and one expert absorbs every input, a failure we call normalization-induced routing collapse. Standard MoE rescue mechanisms do not repair it, because the cause is in the router's input, not its optimization. Pre-encoder normalization strips the statistics a router would need to tell regimes apart. A mutual-information decomposition makes this precise and yields a signal-ratio that, computed before training, predicts dataset vulnerability (Spearman $ρ= -0.88$). Eight causal controls, including a vision-modality replication, isolate instance normalization as the cause. The prescription is a minimal causal intervention: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters (RR-MoA), which routes on the raw, pre-normalization input. Under a strictly frozen backbone, RR-MoA wins 54/54 comparisons against the strongest fixed adapter and significantly outperforms LoRA, TRACE, AdaMix, and full fine-tuning. The effect generalizes across six backbones and an imputation task. Frozen RR-MoA also beats full fine-tuning by 12-79% (the Frozen Paradox); two architecturally distinct variants confirm the principle generalizes beyond this specific router.

AI.tldr: 本文发现时序基础模型（TSFM）中，实例归一化骨干上的MoE路由会因路由器输入被归一化而崩溃（路由熵归零），提出在原始未归一化输入上路由的RR-MoA，在冻结骨干下取得54/54全面胜利并超越多种微调方法。
AI.motivation: TSFM通常以"冻结骨干+单一可训练头"适配新数据，这种一刀切设置在异质数据分布下欠拟合；将其升级为专家混合（MoE）是常规方案，但在实例归一化骨干（主流TSFM设计）上会失败：路由熵坍缩为零，单个专家吸收所有输入。作者将此命名为"归一化诱导的路由崩溃"，并指出标准MoE补救机制无法修复，因为问题根源在路由器输入而非优化过程——预编码器归一化抹去了路由器区分不同数据状态所需的统计量。
AI.method: 作者通过互信息分解精确定位问题，并推导出一个"信号比"指标，可在训练前预测数据集的脆弱性（Spearman ρ=-0.88）。设计八项因果控制实验（含视觉模态复现）以分离实例归一化为根本原因。提出最小因果干预方案Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters（RR-MoA），即让路由器直接在归一化前的原始输入上进行路由；并给出两个架构上不同的变体以验证原理的普适性。
AI.result: 在严格冻结骨干条件下，RR-MoA在54/54次比较中均胜过最强的固定适配器，并显著优于LoRA、TRACE、AdaMix和全量微调。效果泛化到六个骨干模型及一个插补任务。冻结的RR-MoA还比全量微调高出12-79%（称为"冻结悖论"，Frozen Paradox）。
AI.conclusion: 实例归一化是导致TSFM中MoE路由崩溃的因果根源，修复方式在于改变路由器的输入（使用原始未归一化输入）而非优化策略。RR-MoA以极小的架构改动恢复了专家路由能力，在冻结骨干下全面超越现有适配与微调方法，且该原理在不同骨干、任务与路由器架构上均可泛化。

title: The Geometry of Randomized Smoothing on Feasible Sets
summary: Randomized smoothing certifies the probability of a fixed output event as the center of Gaussian noise moves. Feasibility or confidence filtering reports label probabilities only among retained proposals, producing a ratio. Its numerator is a fixed Gaussian event mass, while its denominator is the probability of retention and can change with the center. Substituting this ratio into the ordinary smoothing formula can therefore certify a ball that contains a decision boundary. We separate the problem into a geometric question and a certification question. Geometry determines when conditioning preserves Gaussian comparisons. Convex retained sets preserve the full comparison, while general sets require geometric control of the retained law as the center moves. Without such control, conditional probabilities imply no positive universal radius. Joint retention-and-label probabilities always yield a valid certificate for the same filtered predictor. A uniform covariance bound transfers divergence certificates to the retained law and can yield larger radii even when the Gaussian event comparison fails. Both methods admit finite-sample bounds. For a learned image classifier with a training-selected nonconvex filter, conditional Rényi bounds certify more images than joint-mass bounds without additional model evaluations. A released confidence filter exhibits verified label changes inside radii obtained by conditional substitution. An application of adaptive Gaussian composition covers causal finite-horizon executions with history-dependent center shifts under a pathwise energy bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机平滑在"筛选/置信过滤"下的认证问题：条件概率（保留集内的标签概率比）代入普通平滑公式可认证出包含决策边界的球，因而是无效的；需将其区分为几何问题与认证问题，并给出正确做法。
AI.motivation: 可行性/置信过滤只报告被保留提案之间的标签概率比，其分子是固定的高斯事件质量，分母是随中心变化的保留概率。将这一比值代入普通随机平滑公式，可能"认证"出一个包含决策边界的球，从而产生错误的鲁棒性保证。因此需要厘清条件概率在高斯比较下的有效性条件，并给出可靠的认证替代方案。
AI.method: 将问题拆分为几何与认证两部分：几何部分判定条件化何时保持高斯比较——凸保留集保持完整比较，一般集合则需对中心移动下保留分布进行几何控制，缺乏该控制时条件概率无法给出正的一致半径；认证部分提出(i)联合保留-标签概率，对同一过滤预测器始终给出有效证书；(ii)在一致协方差界下，将散度（Rényi）证书迁移到保留分布，即使高斯事件比较失效也可能得到更大半径。两种方法均给出有限样本界；并将自适应高斯组合推广至具有路径能量界的、历史依赖中心偏移的因果有限时程执行。
AI.result: 在训练时选定的非凸过滤器下，学习图像分类器的条件Rényi界比联合质量界能认证更多图像，且不增加模型评估次数；对一个公开的置信过滤器，条件代入所得半径内存在经验证的标签变化，说明其证书失效。自适应高斯组合可覆盖带路径能量界的因果有限时程执行。
AI.conclusion: 条件概率直接代入平滑公式是不安全的，其有效性取决于保留集的几何性质；联合保留-标签概率始终有效，而基于一致协方差界的Rényi散度迁移可在比较失效时仍给出（有时更大）的有效半径。

title: Probabilistic Adversarial Training
summary: Building on a probabilistic perspective in which adversarial examples arise from the overlap between a distance-based distribution $p_{\mathrm{dis}}$ and a victim-classifier-induced distribution $p_{\mathrm{vic}}$, we start from a simple intuition: adversarial examples become harder to generate when these two distributions are pushed apart, as their overlap becomes smaller, thereby increasing robustness. This intuition naturally motivates a KL-based robustness objective. We then prove that $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{dis}}\|p_{\mathrm{vic}})-\log Z_{\mathrm{vic}}$ is a lower bound on probabilistic robustness (PR), where $Z_{\mathrm{vic}}$ denotes the normalizing constant of $p_{\mathrm{vic}}$. Since PR is generally intractable to compute directly, maximizing this KL-based lower bound provides a tractable surrogate objective for improving PR. We further show that this objective recovers a scaled form of adversarial training, offering a probabilistic interpretation of adversarial training and a principled route to robustness improvement. We call the resulting method probabilistic adversarial training. Experiments show that it consistently improves PR, and ablation studies demonstrate that the induced scaling factor can even enhance the PR of non-probabilistic adversarial training methods.

AI.tldr: 本文从对抗样本源于距离分布与受害者分类器分布重叠的概率视角出发，证明 KL(p_dis‖p_vic)-log Z_vic 是概率鲁棒性(PR)的下界，并据此提出可处理的代理目标——概率对抗训练(PAT)，实验证明其能持续提升 PR。
AI.motivation: 对抗样本可理解为基于距离的分布 p_dis 与受害者分类器诱导的分布 p_vic 之间的重叠。直观上，两个分布被推得越开、重叠越小，对抗样本越难生成，鲁棒性越高。但概率鲁棒性(PR)通常难以直接计算，缺乏可处理的优化目标，因此需要一个可计算的下界或代理目标来指导鲁棒性提升。
AI.method: 作者首先形式化上述直觉，提出基于 KL 的鲁棒性目标；随后证明 KL(p_dis‖p_vic)-log Z_vic 是概率鲁棒性(PR)的下界（Z_vic 为 p_vic 的归一化常数）。由于 PR 直接计算不可行，最大化该 KL 下界即作为提升 PR 的可处理代理目标。进一步证明该目标可还原为一种带缩放形式的对抗训练，从而给出对抗训练的概率解释，并将该方法命名为概率对抗训练(PAT)。
AI.result: 实验表明 PAT 能够持续提升概率鲁棒性(PR)；消融研究进一步显示，该目标所诱导的缩放因子甚至能够增强非概率类对抗训练方法的 PR。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对抗训练提供了概率解释，给出了通过最大化 KL 下界来改进概率鲁棒性的原则性途径，并提出的 PAT 方法在实践中有效，其缩放因子还可推广增益于其他对抗训练方法。

title: Efficient Active Auditing of Multi-Group Fairness with Bias Probes
summary: Over the past decade, Machine Learning (ML) has been trained under dual objectives: minimizing prediction error via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) while controlling unfairness bias. In practice, however, fairness-aware training often yields limited improvements over standard ERM, making reliable post hoc auditing essential. Existing auditing approaches for black-box models either rely on model reconstruction --exposing systems to extraction attacks-- or directly estimate fairness metrics, offering limited insight into which regions of the data distribution drive bias. More fundamentally, property-specific auditing --aimed at extracting only targeted fairness information without reconstructing the model-- remains poorly understood. In this work, we introduce the bias probe framework, which enables targeted and adaptive querying to reveal bias structure while preserving model confidentiality. Building on this framework, we propose ALeBi, an active auditor that learns such probes to efficiently estimate multi-group fairness metrics. We establish novel sample complexity guarantees governed by a property-specific complexity measure, resolving a previously posed open question, and extend our analysis to adversarial settings where the model owner may strategically obscure bias. Our results uncover a fundamental trade-off between model confidentiality and reliable auditing, and show that property-specific probing enables both accurate estimation and interpretable identification of high and low-bias regions. Extensive experiments support our theoretical findings and demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"偏见探针"（bias probe）框架及主动审计器ALeBi，通过有针对性的自适应查询估计多群体公平性指标，在不重建模型的前提下兼顾模型保密性与可靠审计，并给出基于属性特定复杂度度量的样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性感知训练相较标准ERM提升有限，因此事后审计至关重要；但黑盒模型的现有审计方法要么依赖模型重建（暴露于提取攻击），要么仅直接估计公平性指标，难以揭示哪些数据分布区域驱动偏见。此外，"属性特定审计"——仅提取目标公平性信息而不重建模型——仍缺乏理论理解。
AI.method: 提出bias probe框架，支持有针对性的自适应查询以揭示偏见结构并保护模型机密；在此框架上提出ALeBi主动审计器，学习此类探针以高效估计多群体公平性指标；建立由属性特定复杂度度量控制的样本复杂度保证，并将分析扩展到模型拥有者可能策略性隐藏偏见的对抗场景。
AI.result: 建立了新颖的样本复杂度保证，解决了此前提出的开放问题；揭示了模型保密性与可靠审计之间的根本性权衡；表明属性特定探测可实现准确估计及高/低偏见区域的可解释识别；大量实验支持理论发现并验证方法的实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 属性特定探测在保护模型机密的同时可实现可靠的公平性审计，为黑盒公平性审计提供了理论与方法基础。

title: Gromov-Wasserstein Distillation for Inductive Multi-View Embedding
comment: This paper was accepted at the GDDL (Geometric Distributional Deep Learning) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Gromov-Wasserstein multidimensional scaling (GW-MDS) learns low-dimensional representations from relational data but remains transductive, providing no explicit mapping for unseen samples. We introduce an inductive framework based on barycentric distillation. A GW-MDS teacher learns a latent support and an optimal transport plan from the training data, and barycentric projection converts the resulting coupling into sample-aligned targets. A neural student then learns an explicit out-of-sample mapping, avoiding additional relational-matrix construction and GW optimization at inference. We formulate the approach for single-view data and extend it to Mean-GWMDS and Multi-GWMDS teachers through consensus and selected-projection targets learned by a multi-view student with view-specific encoders. We also investigate a direct neural baseline trained solely with a GW objective. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data using Euclidean, geodesic, and cosine relations show that the distilled models preserve the teacher geometry on unseen samples and consistently outperform direct neural GW training in sample-indexed relational preservation. These results establish barycentric projection as an effective bridge between transductive GW embeddings and inductive neural mappings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于重心蒸馏（barycentric distillation）的归纳式 Gromov-Wasserstein 多维标度框架，将转导式 GW-MDS 教师模型的知识蒸馏到神经网络学生模型，实现在未见样本上的显式映射，并扩展到多视图场景。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein 多维标度（GW-MDS）能从关系数据中学习低维表示，但本质是转导式的（transductive），无法为未见样本提供显式映射。同时，直接训练神经网络以 GW 目标进行优化存在困难。因此需要一种既能保留教师几何结构、又具备归纳推理能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于重心投影的蒸馏框架：GW-MDS 教师从训练数据学习潜在支撑集与最优传输计划，重心投影将耦合矩阵转换为样本对齐的目标；神经学生模型据此学习显式的样本外映射，避免推理时构建关系矩阵和 GW 优化。方法先针对单视图数据建模，再通过共识目标与选择投影目标扩展至 Mean-GWMDS 和 Multi-GWMDS 教师，多视图学生使用视图特定编码器。同时研究了仅以 GW 目标训练的直接神经基线。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上，使用欧氏、测地线与余弦关系进行实验。结果表明蒸馏模型能在未见样本上保持教师几何结构，并在样本索引的关系保持方面持续优于直接神经 GW 训练。
AI.conclusion: 重心投影可作为连接转导式 GW 嵌入与归纳式神经映射的有效桥梁，所提框架成功将 GW-MDS 的几何保持能力赋予具备归纳推理能力的神经学生模型。

title: Travel Time Prediction in Supply Chain Management Using Machine Learning
summary: The purpose of this research is to find data and methods using machine learning and deep learning to correctly predict the estimated travel time for transportation and logistics in a supply chain system. The supply chain ecosystem is very complex and heavily relies on the transportation and logistics of raw materials and finished goods. Accurate travel time estimation is critical because it helps supply chain members to improve logistics consistency and performance. This helps in planning, demand forecasting, lead time management and assembly planning. The logistics on the delivery side of the customer also plays a crucial role in customer satisfaction and voice of customer. With the collection of huge historical data and using novel techniques, the research builds an accurate model to predict travel time of inventory.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在利用机器学习和深度学习方法，基于海量历史数据构建模型，准确预测供应链运输与物流中的估计行程时间。
AI.motivation: 供应链生态系统复杂，高度依赖原材料与成品的运输和物流。准确的行程时间估计对提升物流一致性与绩效至关重要，可支持计划、需求预测、提前期管理和装配计划；同时，交付侧的物流影响客户满意度与客户之声。
AI.method: 该研究通过收集大量历史数据，并采用机器学习与深度学习的新颖技术，构建预测库存行程时间的模型。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或量化指标，仅说明研究构建了准确的库存行程时间预测模型。
AI.conclusion: 准确的行程时间预测有助于改善供应链物流一致性、计划与客户满意度；本研究探索了机器学习与深度学习在该任务上的应用路径。

title: EHR2Trace: Auditable EHR Data Infrastructure for Patient World Models and Clinical Agents
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and experiment records: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/ehr2trace
summary: Patient world models and clinical agents aim to predict changes in patients' health and support clinical work. Developing these systems requires reliable histories of patient conditions, treatments, and the information available at each decision. Electronic health records (EHRs) contain these histories, but differences in how events are recorded make them difficult to use consistently. We present EHR2Trace, a system that converts EHRs from different sources into traceable patient events for model training and evaluation. It links events to source records, separates event time from information availability, and distinguishes medication orders, dispensing, and administration. A shared event representation supports both OMOP and MEDS exports, with automated validation and reproducible builds. Across three clinical datasets, EHR2Trace converted 846.4 million events, with every applicable check passing except one unit-consistency check on MIMIC-IV, and detected all 28 injected faults. A controlled prediction experiment showed that assigning later diagnoses to admission time substantially inflated measured performance, and that a model trained on such data lost accuracy when deployed on histories filtered by availability. EHR2Trace provides a reusable data foundation for patient world models and clinical agents, helping researchers inspect patient histories, check conversion decisions, and evaluate models with explicit data rules.

AI.tldr: EHR2Trace 将多源电子健康记录转换为可追溯的患者事件序列，统一 OMOP 与 MEDS 表示，支持模型训练与评估。在三套临床数据集上完成 8.464 亿事件转换，检出全部 28 个注入故障；实验表明将后期诊断回填至入院时间会显著高估模型性能并导致可用性过滤后性能下降。
AI.motivation: 患者世界模型与临床智能体需要可靠的患者状态、治疗与决策时可用信息的历史。EHR 虽包含这些历史，但事件记录方式不一致，导致难以一致使用，因此需要可追溯、可复用的事件化数据基础。
AI.method: 提出 EHR2Trace 系统：将不同来源 EHR 转换为可追溯患者事件；关联事件与源记录；区分事件发生时间与信息可得时间；区分用药医嘱、发药与给药；采用共享事件表示以支持 OMOP 与 MEDS 导出，并具备自动验证与可复现构建。
AI.result: 在三个临床数据集上转换 846.4M 事件；除 MIMIC-IV 上一项单位一致性检查外，其余适用检查全部通过；检出全部 28 个注入故障。对照预测实验显示，将后期诊断赋给入院时间会显著抬高测量性能，且基于此类数据训练的模型在按信息可得性过滤的历史上部署时精度下降。
AI.conclusion: EHR2Trace 为患者世界模型与临床智能体提供可复用的数据基础，使研究者能够检查患者历史、核验转换决策，并在明确数据规则下评估模型。

title: A Moving-Horizon Approximate Branch-and-Reduce Method for Deep Classification Trees
summary: Despite the importance for interpretability, decision trees face severe scalability challenges. Existing global optimal methods are often limited by binary feature selection and shallow tree depths, whereas traditional heuristic approaches frequently sacrifice predictive accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a moving-horizon approximate branch-and-reduce method to train near-optimal deep classification trees on large-scale datasets with continuous features. Built on a hierarchical root-subtree optimization framework, the method solves the root-level problem via branch-and-reduce while approximating the induced subtree problem using greedy heuristics. Although the underlying framework is capable of guaranteeing global optimality, the approximation, which functions as a lookahead rollout in a reinforcement learning context, significantly boosts efficiency for deeper structures. A low-cost moving-horizon strategy is then employed to iteratively refine model accuracy. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that our method exceeds the testing accuracy of existing heuristic baselines while offering significantly greater scalability, in terms of both dataset size and tree depth, than global optimal solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出移动视界近似分支-归约方法，兼顾深度分类树的近最优性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 决策树对可解释性很重要，但面临严重可扩展性挑战：全局最优方法受二元特征选择与浅树深度限制，传统启发式方法牺牲预测精度。
AI.method: 构建分层根-子树优化框架：根层问题用分支-归约求解，诱导子树问题用贪婪启发式近似；该近似相当于强化学习中的前瞻rollout，加速深层结构训练；再用低成本移动视界策略迭代精炼模型精度。
AI.result: 大量数值结果表明，本方法在测试精度上超过现有启发式基线，且在大规模连续特征数据集上，数据集规模和树深度的可扩展性显著优于全局最优求解器。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持全局最优框架的前提下，通过近似与移动视界策略实现近最优深度分类树的高效训练，在精度与可扩展性间取得更优平衡。

title: A Data-Free Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Level-Set Interface Advection
summary: Operators for interfacial problems are trained on reference solutions produced by the solver they are intended to replace. This work develops a data-free physics-informed neural operator for level-set interface advection, in which the interface is the equation's unknown and the operator maps an initial interface to the full spatiotemporal trajectory under a prescribed flow. Training uses only the transport residual and a geometric constraint; no reference solution enters the objective at any point. A spacetime Fourier backbone emits the entire trajectory in one pass, and the initial condition is imposed by construction rather than by penalty, which removes the competition between the anchoring term and the residual that otherwise arises when no solution data are available. Supervised and hybrid operators are trained under an identical architecture, family, budget and test set, and are reported throughout as baselines that quantify what refusing labels costs. On a reversed single vortex the data-free operator reaches 1.614 +/- 0.067% relative L2 error on 100 held-out initial interfaces against 0.369 +/- 0.035% for the supervised baseline, a factor of 4.4; on solid-body rotation the corresponding figures are 3.804 +/- 1.075% and 2.576 +/- 0.159%, a factor of 1.5. The two benchmarks rank the arms differently, and the difference is attributable to the eikonal constraint: the exact solution violates |grad phi| = 1 over 0.3% of the domain under rotation and 86.9% under the vortex. Where the constraint is valid the physics-trained operator conserves enclosed area 2.7 times better than the supervised baseline despite a larger field error, and a hybrid arm using eight reference solutions outperforms a supervised arm using sixteen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无数据的物理信息神经算子，用于水平集界面平流：界面是方程未知量，算子将初始界面映射到完整时空轨迹，训练只用输运残差与几何约束，且初始条件由构造方式强加，从而消除了无标签时锚定项与残差的竞争。
AI.motivation: 界面问题的算子通常依赖其所要替代的求解器生成的参考解进行训练，即依赖监督标签。作者希望检验在完全没有参考解进入目标函数的情况下，能否训练出可用于水平集界面平流的神经算子，并量化"拒绝标签"所付出的代价。
AI.method: 采用时空傅里叶主干网络，一次前向即输出整条时空轨迹；训练目标仅含输运残差与几何约束（eikonal 约束 |grad phi| = 1 等），不含任何参考解；初始条件通过构造而非惩罚项施加。监督算子与混合算子在同一网络架构、算子族、训练预算与测试集下训练，作为基线对比。
AI.result: 反向单涡算例上，无数据算子对 100 个留出初始界面的相对 L2 误差为 1.614 ± 0.067%，监督基线为 0.369 ± 0.035%，相差 4.4 倍；刚体旋转算例上分别为 3.804 ± 1.075% 与 2.576 ± 0.159%，相差 1.5 倍。两个基准对两种方案的排序不同，差异可归因于 eikonal 约束：精确解在旋转下于 0.3% 区域违反 |grad phi| = 1，而在单涡下达 86.9%。在约束成立的区域，物理训练算子尽管场误差更大，其包围面积守恒比监督基线好 2.7 倍；使用 8 个参考解的混合方案优于使用 16 个参考解的监督方案。
AI.conclusion: 无参考解的物理信息神经算子可在水平集界面平流任务上训练成功，代价为精度下降（1.5–4.4 倍）；eikonal 约束的有效性决定了无数据方法与监督方法的相对表现，且能带来更好的面积守恒性；少量参考解的混合策略效率高于纯监督策略。

title: Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble
comment: Published in ICONIP 2024 (Neural Information Processing), LNCS 15287, Springer Nature, 2025
summary: Accurate time series forecasting is critical across various domains, yet traditional ensemble methods often suffer from the disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts. We introduce the Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble (CAGE), a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction to enhance forecast reliability and accuracy. CAGE employs multiple generative models to produce initial forecasts, which are then evaluated by a discriminative component using conformal prediction techniques. P-values derived from nonconformity scores help dynamically adjust model weights, minimizing the impact of unreliable forecasts. This approach ensures that only the most credible predictions contribute to the final ensemble output. Our empirical and statistical analyses of time series data from New Zealand's milk collection and the global health data from the public owid-monkeypox dataset show that the CAGE outperforms traditional ensemble methods, especially in handling outliers and noisy data. By incorporating conformal prediction, CAGE delivers accurate and statistically rigorous forecasts, enhancing decision-making. We have demonstrated performance on two different datasets deliberately to showcase that the proposed method offers a versatile solution potentially applicable across finance, weather, and supply chain management.

AI.tldr: CAGE：将生成建模、对抗判别与保形预测结合的集成框架，通过P值动态调整模型权重，抑制极端/不可靠预测，提升时间序列预测的可靠性与精度。
AI.motivation: 传统集成方法易受极端预测的过度影响（disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts），导致预测可靠性不足，需要一种能动态剔除不可靠预测的集成机制。
AI.method: CAGE（Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble）：1）用多个生成模型产生初始预测；2）判别组件结合保形预测（conformal prediction）进行评价；3）由非一致性分数（nonconformity scores）导出P值，据此动态调整各模型权重，使仅最可信的预测进入最终集成输出。
AI.result: 在新西兰牛奶采集量时间序列与公开 owid-monkeypox 全球健康数据上，CAGE 优于传统集成方法，尤其在异常值（outliers）与噪声数据场景下表现突出，并给出统计上严谨的预测。
AI.conclusion: 保形预测的引入使 CAGE 兼具准确性与统计严谨性，可增强决策支持；两个异构数据集的结果表明该方法具有通用性，潜在可应用于金融、天气与供应链管理。

title: DualCast: A Dual-Path Language Model for Bimodal Financial Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Financial time-series forecasting must capture price dynamics across heterogeneous assets while incorporating news available at prediction time. We introduce DualCast, a dual-path framework that extends a frozen language model with a discrete financial vocabulary. Each log-return patch is represented by a learned summary token and three residual shape tokens, preserving local drift and volatility while allowing shape patterns to be shared across assets. To improve codebook utilization, we develop adaptive frequency-equalizing residual vector quantization, which rebalances overloaded codewords without compromising reconstruction accuracy. The fast path trains only the new financial-token embeddings and output heads on a frozen Qwen3-8B backbone. A toggleable LoRA adapter enables a slow path that conditions on the fast forecast and news available at the forecast origin to produce a revised prediction. The reviser is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and further optimized with a return-space group relative policy optimization objective that rewards improvements over the fast forecast. In zero-shot evaluations covering equities and energy prices at five-minute, daily, and weekly resolutions, the slow path achieves the lowest mean absolute percentage error among the compared methods in 8 of 12 dataset-horizon settings, including every longest-horizon setting. News ablations indicate additional gains in most tested settings, although their magnitude varies across markets. DualCast thus combines a fast numerical forecaster with an optional text-conditioned revision mechanism.

AI.tldr: DualCast 是一个双路径框架：以冻结语言模型为骨干，用离散金融词表表示收益序列实现快速数值预测，并通过可开关的 LoRA 慢路径结合新闻文本进行修正。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列预测需同时刻画异质资产的价格动态，并纳入预测时点可得的新闻信息，而单一模型难以兼顾快速数值预测与文本条件化的修正。
AI.method: 将每个对数收益片段表示为一个学习到的摘要 token 加三个残差形状 token，保留局部漂移与波动并跨资产共享形状模式；提出自适应频率均衡残差向量量化以提升码本利用率且不损失重构精度。快路径仅在冻结的 Qwen3-8B 上训练新金融 token 嵌入与输出头；可开关的 LoRA 适配器构成慢路径，以快路径预测为条件并结合预测原点可得新闻生成修正预测，先经监督微调初始化，再用收益空间的组相对策略优化目标优化。
AI.result: 在股票与能源价格、5 分钟/日/周三种分辨率的零样本评测中，慢路径在 12 个数据集-预测跨度设置中的 8 个取得最低 MAPE，且覆盖所有最长跨度设置；新闻消融在多数设置中带来额外增益，但幅度因市场而异。
AI.conclusion: DualCast 将快速数值预测器与可选的文本条件化修正机制相结合，在多个市场与跨度上验证了有效性。

title: FlashDiffusion: Fused Tiled Kernel Spectral Decomposition
summary: Diffusion maps, and kernel methods more generally, provide an interpretable nonlinear spectral representation basis for geometric learning. In the geometric limit, small bandwidth, these matrices tend to be high rank and thus require materializing dense Gaussian kernels requires $O(N^2)$ memory. We introduce FlashDiffusion, a matrix-free method that evaluates dense Gaussian kernel blocks in fused GPU tiles and couples the eigensolver to an empirical $β$-flow that selects the finite-sample resolution scale. A continuation over sample size and bandwidth warm-starts increasingly expensive spectral solves from coarser resolutions.

AI.tldr: 提出FlashDiffusion：一种无矩阵（matrix-free）方法，在融合GPU tile中计算稠密高斯核块，并将特征求解器与经验β-flow耦合以选择有限样本分辨率尺度，同时通过样本量与带宽的延拓实现由粗到细的热启动。
AI.motivation: 扩散映射及核方法为几何学习提供可解释的非线性谱表示基。在几何极限（小带宽）下，这类矩阵趋于高秩，显式构造稠密高斯核需O(N²)内存，成为规模扩展的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 无矩阵（matrix-free）策略：不显式存储稠密核矩阵，而是在GPU上以融合tile方式按块评估稠密高斯核；2) 将特征求解器与经验β-flow耦合，用于选取有限样本下的分辨率尺度；3) 在样本规模与带宽两个维度做continuation，从较粗分辨率出发对代价递增的谱求解进行warm-start。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要贡献为方法层面：以块级融合计算替代O(N²)稠密存储，并以β-flow自适应确定有限样本分辨率尺度，配合样本量-带宽延拓降低谱求解的总体计算代价。
AI.conclusion: FlashDiffusion通过无矩阵分块核计算、β-flow尺度选择与多分辨率延拓热启动，缓解了大带宽极限下扩散映射谱分解的内存与计算瓶颈，为几何学习中的可扩展谱表示提供了可行路径。

title: Kinematic signatures of impairment: Detecting alcohol intoxication in e-scooter riders using sensor data and machine learning
summary: Alcohol intoxication is a leading contributor to fatal and severe-injured e-scooterist crashes. Current countermeasures, such as temporal restrictions or pre-ride cognitive screening, cannot continuously assess an e-scooterist's physical motor control or impairment in real time. We conducted a controlled experiment in which 25 participants rode an instrumented e-scooter through a test track while sober and at two targeted blood alcohol concentration levels (0.05% and 0.08%). The e-scooter was instrumented with a six-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), and throttle and brake lever position sensors, all sampled at 100 Hz. Two complementary signal features were computed: normalised permutation entropy, which quantifies temporal complexity, and standard deviation, which quantifies signal amplitude. Repeated measures correlation identified seven kinematic features (all IMU and throttle signals) whose entropy decreased (p < 0.001) while standard deviation increased (p < 0.01) with increasing intoxication, indicating that intoxicated riders shift from continuous, low-amplitude micro-corrections to fewer, high-amplitude reactive corrections. An entropy based multi-class logistic regression classifier, evaluated through leave-one-participant-out cross-validation, achieved 85% overall accuracy and a weighted one-vs-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AuROC) of 0.94, with a sober-vs-high AuROC of 1.00. Steering rate and lateral acceleration were the most important predictive features, indicating that alcohol induces a distinct collapse in lateral equilibrium during riding. Ultimately, these results demonstrate that onboard kinematic sensing combined with entropy-based signal analysis can reliably distinguish sober from intoxicated e-scooter riding, providing a foundation for automatic intoxication detection systems that preserve mobility for sober riders.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过受控实验发现，醉酒骑行者的电动滑板车运动学信号呈现熵降低、标准差升高的特征，据此构建的熵基多分类逻辑回归模型可高精度区分清醒与醉酒状态。
AI.motivation: 酒精中毒是电动滑板车致死及重伤事故的主要诱因。现有对策（如时段限制或骑行前认知筛查）无法实时、连续地评估骑行者的身体运动控制或损伤状态。因此，需要一种基于车载运动学传感的实时醉酒检测方法，同时保障清醒骑行者的出行便利。
AI.method: 开展受控实验，25名参与者在清醒状态及两种目标血液酒精浓度水平（0.05%和0.08%）下骑行装有传感器的电动滑板车通过测试赛道。传感器包括六轴惯性测量单元（IMU）及油门、刹车杆位置传感器，采样率均为100 Hz。提取两类互补信号特征：归一化排列熵（量化时间复杂性）和标准差（量化信号幅度）。采用重复测量相关分析识别特征，并构建基于熵的多分类逻辑回归分类器，通过留一参与者交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 重复测量相关分析识别出七个运动学特征（均为IMU和油门信号），其熵随醉酒程度增加而降低（p < 0.001），标准差随醉酒程度增加而升高（p < 0.01），表明醉酒骑行者从连续、低幅度的微修正转向更少、高幅度的反应性修正。熵基多分类逻辑回归分类器经留一参与者交叉验证达到85%总体准确率，加权一对多受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AuROC）为0.94，清醒对高醉酒的AuROC为1.00。转向速率和侧向加速度是最重要的预测特征，表明酒精引发骑行中侧向平衡的显著崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 车载运动学传感结合熵基信号分析能够可靠区分清醒与醉酒电动滑板车骑行，为自动醉酒检测系统奠定基础，该系统可保留清醒骑行者的出行能力。

title: Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation uses a model as its own teacher to provide dense supervision for reasoning, often through reference-solution conditioning. Providing privileged information does not by itself ensure effective token-level supervision throughout long responses. We introduce Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation (ACSD), which extracts a steering vector by contrasting activations of self-generated trajectories that reach verified correct answers within a generation budget with those of all remaining trajectories. A frozen copy of the base model applies this vector at each prediction position, and the student learns from its next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Outcome verification is used for direction construction and calibration; distillation requires neither problem-specific reference text nor teacher parameter updates. The distilled student is used alone at inference. On each of five models, ACSD achieves the highest mean accuracy over four mathematical benchmarks among the evaluated methods. On DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, mean mathematical accuracy reaches 71.9\% and LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12 reaches 70.9\%, compared with 69.0\% and 66.3\% for the reference-conditioned OPSD baseline. Contrasts among correct trajectories also support distillation, and extracted directions can be reused across mathematical training datasets. On fixed student trajectories, ACSD maintains more stable late-position logit-update magnitudes than OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出激活条件自蒸馏（ACSD），通过对比成功与失败轨迹的激活提取引导向量，由冻结基座模型在每个预测位置施加该向量，让学生在自身前缀上学习下一词分布，无需参考解文本或教师参数更新。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏通常依赖参考解条件化提供稠密监督，但引入特权信息本身并不能保证长回答中每个token都获得有效监督，需要一种更稳定的token级监督方式。
AI.method: ACSD对比在生成预算内到达正确验证答案的自生成轨迹与其余轨迹的激活，提取引导向量；冻结的基座模型在每个预测位置施加该向量，学生在自身生成前缀上学习其下一词分布；结果验证仅用于方向构建与校准。
AI.result: 在五个模型上，ACSD在四个数学基准上取得所评估方法中最高的平均准确率。在DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B上，数学平均准确率达71.9%，LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12达70.9%，优于参考条件OPSD基线的69.0%与66.3%。正确轨迹之间的对比同样支持蒸馏，提取方向可跨数学训练数据集复用；在固定学生轨迹上，ACSD比OPSD保持更稳定的后段位置logit更新幅度。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活对比的引导向量可在不依赖参考文本与教师更新的条件下实现有效自蒸馏，蒸馏后的学生独立推理即可获得更优且更稳定的长序列token级监督效果。

title: Function-Space Transformer with Adaptive Anchors
summary: Many forms of data, including physical fields, geometric shapes, and visual signals, are naturally described by functions over continuous domains but are observed through discrete samples. Representing these functions on fixed uniform grids imposes a trade-off between resolving localized variation and increasing computation across the domain. Neural operators address this mismatch by learning mappings between functions, while latent-attention architectures provide flexible processing of sampled observations. We introduce the Function-Space Transformer (FST), a framework for learning from functions through a spatially adaptive continuous latent representation. FST stores features at anchors whose locations are predicted from the input observations and recursively refines these anchor features through function-space interactions. This allows the representation to adapt its spatial organization to each input rather than inherit that of the observation grid, while supporting both spatially resolved and finite-dimensional outputs. On PDE solution prediction using PDEBench Burgers and Darcy flow, FST substantially outperforms the Perceiver IO baseline, whose latent representation lacks explicit spatial organization, and is highly competitive with the Fourier Neural Operator. On ImageNet-1K, FST achieves higher classification accuracy than the Vision Transformer baseline, with fewer parameters across these comparisons. Ablations further support the benefits of function-space updates and recursive refinement. Together, these results highlight the potential of adaptive continuous representations for both scientific prediction and visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 Function-Space Transformer（FST），通过从输入预测锚点位置并在连续函数空间递归细化锚点特征，实现空间自适应的连续隐表示，在 PDE 求解与图像分类上均优于相应基线且参数更少。
AI.motivation: 连续域上的函数（物理场、几何形状、视觉信号）通常只能通过离散采样观测，而固定均匀网格表示在"解析局部变化"与"控制全域计算量"之间存在权衡：网格越密越能刻画局部细节，但全域计算成本随之上升。神经算子通过函数间映射缓解该不匹配，隐注意力架构则支持对采样观测的灵活处理，但现有隐表示（如 Perceiver IO）缺乏显式的空间组织，无法随输入自适应调整空间结构。
AI.method: 提出 Function-Space Transformer（FST）：1）以锚点（anchors）为特征载体，锚点位置并非固定网格，而是由输入观测直接预测得到；2）通过函数空间交互（function-space interactions）对锚点特征进行递归细化（recursive refinement）；3）表示的空间组织随每个输入自适应变化，而非继承观测网格的结构；4）同时支持空间分辨输出（如场量预测）与有限维输出（如分类）。
AI.result: 在 PDEBench 的 Burgers 与 Darcy flow 方程求解任务上，FST 显著优于 Perceiver IO 基线，并与 Fourier Neural Operator（FNO）高度可比；在 ImageNet-1K 分类上，FST 精度高于 Vision Transformer 基线，且在这些对比中参数更少。消融实验进一步验证了函数空间更新与递归细化两方面设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，自适应连续表示在科学预测（PDE 求解）与视觉识别（图像分类）两类任务上均具潜力，说明突破固定网格、采用输入自适应的函数空间表示是一种通用且有效的建模思路。

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and curriculum revision. Across Terminal-Bench 2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE, MILO-discovered harnesses outperform eight state-of-the-art harnesses and six search methods using frontier (Opus 4.8) and open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) models. With Opus 4.8, MILO improves resolution over its initial harness by $+12.0\%$, $+28.3\%$, and $+10.3\%$, respectively, compared with best prior-search gains of $+4.5\%$, $+18.3\%$, and $0\%$. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, it achieves $86.1 \pm 2.0\%$, exceeding the official leaderboard's top entry ($83.8 \pm 2.3\%$) while using 26\% fewer tokens than its initial harness. On EinsteinArena open problems, MILO improves best-known upper bounds for Erdős minimum-overlap ($0.3808586 \to 0.3808568$) and the first and third autocorrelation inequalities ($1.50274365 \to 1.50274360$; $1.45081 \to 1.44889$).

AI.tldr: MILO 是一个让智能体"外壳"（harness）与其搜索策略共同进化的元进化框架，在多个基准上超越现有最优方法与排行榜成绩，并在开放数学问题上改进已知上界。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体系统的长程表现高度依赖外层 harness（控制执行与环境交互的框架），但 harness 的设计空间是组合爆炸式的，且需随模型更换反复人工重调。已有的自动化搜索方法探索范围狭窄：要么只优化 prompt、技能等个别组件，要么受限于固定、纯利用型的搜索策略，难以跳出局部最优。
AI.method: MILO（Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration）通过共进化 harness 与发现它的搜索策略来解决问题，包含三个机制：(i) 在基于岛屿的树上建立层级谱系记忆，将失败的变异作为负向证据；(ii) 每个岛屿配备 mutator agent，依据全局搜索历史与父代专属反馈重写完整 harness；(iii) 由 orchestrator 通过谱系嫁接（lineage grafting）与物种形成（speciation）、mutator 重新指派与课程修订来自适应地调整搜索。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、PaperBench、DeepSWE 上，MILO 发现的 harness 优于八个 SOTA harness 和六种搜索方法，并覆盖前沿模型（Opus 4.8）与开放权重模型（gpt-oss-120b）。以 Opus 4.8 为例，相对初始 harness 的提升分别为 +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，而此前最优搜索方法的增益仅为 +4.5%、+18.3%、0%。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 86.1±2.0%，超过官方排行榜榜首（83.8±2.3%），且比初始 harness 少用 26% token。在 EinsteinArena 开放问题上改进了多项已知最优上界：Erdős 最小重叠（0.3808586 → 0.3808568）、第一与第三自相关不等式（1.50274365 → 1.50274360；1.45081 → 1.44889）。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索策略与 harness 一同纳入元进化，可显著扩展自动化 harness 设计的探索广度与效果：MILO 不仅刷新了智能体基准与官方排行榜表现、兼顾 token 效率，还具备解决真实开放数学问题的迁移能力。

title: Continual Learning of Dynamical Systems in Recurrent Neural Networks through Recyclable Unit Gating
summary: Dynamical Systems Reconstruction (DSR) aims to infer models from observed time series that reproduce a system's qualitative long-term behavior. Continual DSR (cDSR) requires learning new systems while preserving previously learned dynamics, yet even small parameter updates in recurrent models can qualitatively alter their behavior over long autonomous rollouts. We benchmark established continual learning (CL) methods spanning parameter regularization, replay, and parameter isolation on the fully trainable and interpretable Almost-Linear RNN (AL-RNN). Parameter isolation preserves earlier dynamics most effectively, but excessive task-specific allocations can rapidly exhaust a fixed-size network. We therefore introduce Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG), which conserves capacity through compact allocation and forward transfer. Differentiable gates trained with an $L_0$-based penalty select task-specific units, while unused units are recycled for subsequent tasks. Directed connections allow later tasks to reuse earlier representations without affecting the dynamics of previously committed units. CRUG achieves the strongest reconstruction--capacity trade-off among the tested methods with zero forgetting and reliably learns a heterogeneous sequence of nonlinear and chaotic systems. Furthermore, we show that forward transfer is more pronounced and useful when tasks share similar underlying dynamics. Lastly, we demonstrate that CRUG's advantages extend beyond autonomous cDSR to sequential cognitive tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究持续动力系统重构（cDSR），在可训练且可解释的 Almost-Linear RNN（AL-RNN）上系统评测参数正则化、回放与参数隔离三类持续学习方法，并提出 Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating（CRUG）机制，在固定容量网络中实现零遗忘的重构-容量权衡。
AI.motivation: cDSR 要求在学习新系统的同时保留旧系统动力学，但循环模型中即使很小的参数更新也可能在长时自主 rollout 中定性改变行为，导致灾难性遗忘。已有 CL 方法在动力学重构场景下是否适用、如何兼顾容量与保真度，尚缺乏系统基准与更优方案。
AI.method: 1）在完全可训练、可解释的 AL-RNN 上基准测试参数正则化、回放与参数隔离三类持续学习方法；2）提出 CRUG：以紧凑分配和正向迁移节省容量，用基于 L0 惩罚的可微门控选择任务专属单元，并回收未使用单元供后续任务复用；3）通过有向连接使后续任务复用早期表征而不改变已固化单元的动力学。
AI.result: 参数隔离在保留早期动力学方面最有效，但过多任务专属分配会快速耗尽固定容量网络。CRUG 在所测方法中取得最佳重构-容量权衡，零遗忘，并能可靠学习由非线性和混沌系统组成的异构序列。正向迁移在任务底层动力学相似时更显著且更有用。CRUG 的优势还从自主 cDSR 扩展到序列认知任务。
AI.conclusion: CRUG 通过可微门控选择任务专属单元并回收闲置单元，在有向连接下实现表征复用，从而在固定容量下兼顾零遗忘与高质量动力学重构，且正向迁移在动力学相似任务间收益更大，其有效性可推广至序列认知任务。

title: Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design
summary: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. Unlike standard zeroth-order optimization, which requires a great number of random perturbations, our approach uses the surrogate's gradient to propose the perturbation direction while the simulator then searches based on this direction to identify an effective design update. Experimental results across different settings show that this method consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, producing layouts whose simulated S-parameters match the target specifications up to 21.2% closer for in-distribution targets and up to 19.8% for out-of-distribution targets.

AI.tldr: 提出Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD)，将低保真可微代理模型与高保真不可微仿真器结合于扩散采样过程，顶替传统梯度引导，在PCB逆设计中显著提升S参数匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 将扩散模型用于PCB布局逆设计时，难以满足定量电磁指标。基于梯度的引导虽可偏置采样过程，但全波电磁仿真器精确却昂贵且不可微，可微代理模型信息量大却不可靠，二者单独使用均受限。
AI.method: SRD在扩散采样中融合低保真可微代理模型和高保真不可微仿真器。不同于需要大量随机扰动的标准零阶优化，该方法用代理模型的梯度提出扰动方向，再由仿真器沿该方向搜索，从而确定有效的设计更新。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置下，SRD持续优于当前最先进方法；生成的布局其仿真S参数与目标规格的匹配度，在分布内目标上最高提升21.2%，在分布外目标上最高提升19.8%。
AI.conclusion: 用代理梯度引导方向并结合仿真器搜索的混合采样策略，可有效缓解可微代理不可靠与不可微仿真器昂贵的问题，为PCB布局逆设计提供更精确的定量电磁性能保障。

title: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
summary: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivial deletions. Continuing menu evaluation beyond the first success removes the ordering shortcut: a trained ranker selects the best candidate on 70.1% of evaluated held-out states, versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. For compression, iterating the symbolic pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, exceeding the neural hybrids we test there. Verified neural editing helps on other proof sources, but matched frozen-model controls show that its gains need not come from training. The supervision does improve whole-proof rewriting: fine-tuning raises verified token reduction from 2.8% to 5.5% on 19 PutnamBench proofs. Together, the released edits, complete candidate pools, and controlled evaluations separate learning to imitate a search policy from improving on that search. They provide a reproducible basis for studying proof improvement while keeping correctness, compression, and edit policy distinct.

AI.tldr: LeanPolish 是一个符号化 Lean 4 流水线，发布 33,402 条被接受的局部编辑与 65,596 条同状态失败尝试，用于研究模型从验证过的证明编辑监督中究竟学到了什么，并将正确性、压缩与编辑策略区分开来。
AI.motivation: 验证过的证明编辑是改进语言模型生成 Lean 证明的天然监督来源，但"验证通过"只能说明编辑正确，不能保证训练信号不含搜索伪影。因此需要区分"模仿搜索策略"与"超越该搜索"，并厘清正确性、压缩与编辑策略三者的关系。
AI.method: 提出符号化 Lean 4 流水线 LeanPolish，释放被接受的局部编辑与同状态失败尝试；通过续行式菜单评估（continuing menu evaluation）消除首个成功带来的排序捷径；训练排序器与最强冻结基线对比；在压缩任务上迭代符号化过程；并设置匹配的冻结模型对照与整证明改写微调实验。
AI.result: 首次成功搜索存在一个与目标无关、排序准确率完美的规则；教师选定的评估位置会奖励平凡删除。续行菜单评估消除排序捷径后，训练排序器在 70.1% 的留出状态上选出最佳候选，而最强冻结基线仅 36.9%。压缩方面，迭代符号化过程将 miniF2F 节省率从 19.7% 提升至 27.5%，超过所测试的神经混合方法。验证过的神经编辑在其他证明来源上有帮助，但匹配的冻结模型对照表明其增益未必来自训练。监督确实改善了整证明改写：微调使 19 个 PutnamBench 证明的验证 token 缩减率从 2.8% 提升到 5.5%。
AI.conclusion: 释放的编辑数据、完整候选池与受控评估，将"学习模仿搜索策略"与"超越该搜索"分离开来，为在保持正确性、压缩与编辑策略相互独立的前提下研究证明改进提供了可复现基础。

title: Which Tasks Survive Self-Supervised Learning?
summary: Same-instance self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations by enforcing consistency across two views of the same underlying instance. This principle alone, however, does not determine which downstream tasks remain recoverable from the learned representation. We study this question through \emph{semantic recoverability}, defined as the amount of a task's posterior score captured by the represented function space. We show that, for centered and whitened representations, recoverability exactly determines directional class-distance-normalized variance (CDNV), controls few-shot nearest-centroid classification, and governs the strength of task-relevant semantic directions. The population linear probe and centroid axis coincide, and multiple well-recovered tasks approach a factorial centroid geometry. We then analyze a canonical two-view SSL objective and show that its population optimum spans the leading cross-view-stable modes of the associated two-view operator. This yields a closed-form spectral characterization of semantic recoverability: a downstream task is preserved to the extent that its posterior lies in the selected spectral subspace. We validate these predictions on synthetic and real datasets across several SSL methods, testing the predicted relationships among recoverability, directional geometry, spectral structure, and few-shot transfer. Together, these results give a task-level account of what information survives same-instance SSL and how the retained information appears in downstream geometry and transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义可恢复性"框架，用任务后验被表征函数空间捕获的比例来刻画同实例自监督学习保留了哪些下游任务信息，并给出谱形式的闭式刻画。
AI.motivation: 同实例自监督学习仅通过强制同一实例两个视图的一致性来学习表征，但这一原则本身无法说明哪些下游任务能从学到的表征中恢复。论文旨在从任务层面厘清"什么信息在同实例SSL中幸存"。
AI.method: 定义语义可恢复性为任务后验得分被表征函数空间捕获的比例；在中心化、白化的表征下，证明可恢复性恰好决定方向性类别距离归一化方差（CDNV）、控制少样本最近质心分类、并支配任务相关语义方向的强度；理论表明总体线性探针与质心轴重合，多个恢复良好的任务趋于因子化质心几何；进一步分析规范双视图SSL目标，证明其总体最优解张成相关双视图算子的领先跨视图稳定模态，从而给出语义可恢复性的闭式谱刻画。
AI.result: 理论上建立了可恢复性与CDNV、少样本最近质心分类、语义方向强度的等价/控制关系，并得到总体线性探针与质心轴重合、多任务趋于因子化质心几何、最优解张成领先跨视图稳定模态等结论；在合成与真实数据集、多种SSL方法上验证了可恢复性、方向几何、谱结构与少样本迁移之间的预测关系。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了同实例SSL信息保留的任务级解释：下游任务被保留的程度取决于其后验是否落在所选谱子空间内，并说明了保留信息如何体现在下游几何与迁移性能中。

title: Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies
summary: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. Results: Score-selected DRIL produced its largest gains in the few-demonstration setting, improving over the strongest behavior-cloning mean by 61% with clipped-action demonstrations and by 112% with bounded-action demonstrations. With 20 trajectories, the advantage of DRIL narrowed; in the bounded-action regime, Beta behavior cloning remained about 7% above the best DRIL checkpoint. The experiments also show that the informativeness of the disagreement reward changes with the learner representation and training stage. Conclusion: DRIL can substantially improve few-demonstration visual continuous control, while bounded Beta policies provide strong behavior-cloning performance when more demonstrations are available. The results highlight the joint importance of learner support,ensemble response, and checkpoint selection.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了DRIL(基于策略分歧正则化的模仿学习)在图像连续控制任务中的效果,发现其在少样本演示场景下显著优于行为克隆,但优势随演示数量增加而收窄,且受学习器表示与检查点选择影响。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在控制器进入演示分布之外的陌生状态时会累积误差。作者希望检验DRIL——将克隆策略之间的分歧转化为强化学习奖励——能否改善基于图像的连续控制性能,并探究学习器表示、演示数量与检查点选择对效果的影响。
AI.method: 开展受控的CarRacing研究,组合Gaussian与Beta学习器策略;演示数据来自截断高斯专家或有界Beta专家;使用1条或20条轨迹;采用确定性与随机性评估;保留三个阶段:行为克隆、最优10回合训练得分检查点、DRIL最终检查点。每个变体的分歧集成均含5个高斯策略,每个保留策略在100个程序生成回合上评估。
AI.result: 在少样本设置下,按得分选择的DRIL取得最大增益:相对最强行为克隆均值,截断动作演示提升61%,有界动作演示提升112%。当使用20条轨迹时,DRIL优势收窄;在有界动作机制中,Beta行为克隆仍比最佳DRIL检查点高约7%。实验还表明分歧奖励的信息量随学习器表示与训练阶段而变化。
AI.conclusion: DRIL能显著改善少样本视觉连续控制;而当演示数据较多时,有界Beta策略可提供强行为克隆性能。结果强调学习器支持、集成响应与检查点选择三者的联合重要性。

title: Synthesis Without Training: An Inference-Only Pipeline for Tabular, Temporal, and Relational Synthetic Data
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 workshop: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
summary: Synthetic data generation is dominated by the fit-then-sample paradigm: a generative model is trained on a private dataset and then sampled from. Despite its widespread adoption, this paradigm faces three challenges: (1) a new training run is required for every dataset; (2) different data modalities, such as single tables, time series, and relational databases, require task-specific models and feature engineering; and (3) the resulting model is opaque, making its behavior under data constraints difficult to inspect. We propose GENSCRIPT, an inference-only pipeline that eliminates model training. GENSCRIPT computes a deterministic statistical profile of the source data (column types, ranges, missingness, categories, correlations, etc.) and passes it--rather than raw rows--to a language model to infer field semantics and cross-column integrity constraints. A coding agent then compiles the profile and constraints into an executable, auditable sampler. This unified approach supports single-table, temporal, and relational data without task-specific modeling. Across four single-table benchmarks, GENSCRIPT builds generators in 2 minutes and samples 50k rows within 6 seconds, while remaining within a few points of leading methods in marginal fidelity. Notably, it is the only method that perfectly preserves a 1-to-1 mapping between columns in the Adult dataset. On a smart-building dataset, it produces conditional time series that more closely match the real distribution than two baselines and perfectly preserves primary- and foreign-key relationships in the corresponding relational database.

AI.tldr: GENSCRIPT 提出一种无需训练的合成数据生成流程：对源数据计算确定性统计画像，交由语言模型推断字段语义与完整性约束，再由编码智能体编译成可执行、可审计的采样器，统一支持单表、时间序列与关系数据。
AI.motivation: 主流“先拟合再采样”范式存在三大痛点：每换一个数据集就要重新训练；不同模态（单表、时间序列、关系数据库）需专用模型与特征工程；生成模型不透明，难以在数据约束下检查其行为。
AI.method: GENSCRIPT 采用纯推理（inference-only）管线，摒弃模型训练。先计算源数据的确定性统计画像（列类型、取值范围、缺失模式、类别、相关性等），将画像而非原始行输入语言模型，推断字段语义与跨列完整性约束；随后由编码智能体将画像与约束编译为可执行、可审计的采样器。
AI.result: 在四个单表基准上，2 分钟即可构建生成器，6 秒内采样 5 万行，边际保真度与领先方法仅差数个百分点；是唯一在 Adult 数据集上完美保持列间一对一映射的方法。在智能建筑数据集上，其条件时间序列比两个基线更贴近真实分布，并在相应关系数据库中完美保持主键与外键关系。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的统一推理式生成管线可在保持较高保真度的同时显著降低构建与采样成本，并凭借显式约束与可审计采样器更好地满足单表、时序及关系数据的一致性要求。

title: Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes
summary: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-spectral relaxation. Sweeping relaxation horizon and endpoint tolerance yields a bank of scores that share one fitted prior: equilibrium Mahalanobis scoring is one limit, while finite-horizon control-energy and scale-normalized ratio scores reveal anomalies that static equilibrium scoring can mask. A label-free selector chooses the score family from feature homophily, edge density, and feature dimension, then ranks candidates by fitted-null deviation and rank stability. On 11 benchmarks and without labels at any step, EB-GAD has the best or tied-best AUROC on 9: the four financial fraud networks (up to 3.7M nodes), the YelpChi and Amazon review graphs, Weibo, Reddit and Facebook, with margins of up to 21.7 points. It is second on BlogCatalog and ACM.
