AI.tldr: EB-GAD是一个无需训练的节点级图异常检测框架，将正常性建模为向图滤波模板的广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck松弛，通过经验贝叶斯拟合图精度，并将异常评分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量，实现高效、可解释且稳定的检测。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测模型通过架构设计、消息传递、重构或对比目标间接编码正常性与评分，将图信任度、图谱加权与异常评分选择纠缠在一起，导致评分代价高、不透明，且在不同图情境下不稳定。
AI.method: 将正常性建模为图感知的广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck（GOU）松弛，朝向图滤波模板；用经验贝叶斯从残差场似然拟合图精度；GOU将评分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量（即沿图谱松弛将特征中性节点引导至观测终点的最小代价）；扫描松弛时域与终点容忍度得到共享同一拟合先验的评分库；采用无标签选择器依据特征同质性、边密度和特征维度选取评分族，并按拟合零偏差与排名稳定性对候选排序。
AI.result: 在11个基准数据集上全程不使用标签，EB-GAD在9个上取得最佳或并列最佳AUROC：四个金融欺诈网络（最多3.7M节点）、YelpChi与Amazon评论图、Weibo、Reddit和Facebook，领先幅度最高达21.7个百分点；在BlogCatalog和ACM上排名第二。
AI.conclusion: EB-GAD通过解耦图信任、图谱加权与评分选择，提供了一种无需训练、闭式、可解释的图异常检测范式，在多个大规模基准上验证了其优越性与跨图情境的稳定性。

title: An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean
summary: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. All deep learning variants outperform ridge, and all sequential encoders surpass the non-sequential MLP. The Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg ha^-1; rRMSE 5.3%; R^2 = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to the farmer baseline. In-season forecasts improve monotonically from early- to late-season issuance, reaching approximately 50% lower error than the baseline at the latest forecast point. Ablations indicate that the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity. SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains most of the long-run trajectory, whereas within-season weather and agro-environmental context primarily drive interannual deviations, with moisture/cloud and thermal-demand variables dominating. Overall, the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and geographic regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts for routine monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个仅依赖常规天气数据与两个轻量静态上下文的架构无关深度学习框架，用于作物产量预测。以巴西大豆2001/02–2020/21共20季为案例，基准测试MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer与Mamba。Transformer精度最佳（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较五年移动平均基线误差降低47.6%。
AI.motivation: 可靠的作物产量预测对市场稳定与风险管理至关重要，但现有方法多依赖成本高或难以规模化的输入数据。作者希望构建一个低成本（frugal）、可迁移、与模型架构无关的框架，仅用常规天气数据即可实现高精度预测，并适用于其他作物和地区。
AI.method: 框架仅使用常规天气作为唯一时变输入，另加两个轻量静态上下文输入（作物年份、农业环境标签）以刻画长期趋势与区域异质性，并支持多种序列编码器在相同数据要求下运行。采用2001/02–2020/21巴西大豆20季案例，使用留一年交叉验证（leave-one-year-out）。对比MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer编码器、Mamba状态空间模型，以及线性岭回归和五年移动平均"农民"基线。辅以消融实验和SHAP诊断分析。
AI.result: 所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，所有序列编码器均优于非序列MLP。Transformer取得最佳全国精度：RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784，较农民基线误差降低47.6%。季内预测从早期到晚期发布单调改善，最新预测点误差较基线降低约50%。消融显示农业环境标签与空间实例扩展（每个市-年多条网格节点天气序列）均有正向贡献且不增加输入复杂度。SHAP表明作物年份主导长期轨迹，季内天气与农业环境主要驱动年际偏差，其中水分/云量与热需求变量贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 该框架易于部署到其他作物和地理区域，且天然兼容业务化天气预报，可支持常规监测。其低成本、可迁移、架构无关的特性使其具备较强的实际应用潜力。

title: RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
summary: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RetroGEF，一种基于流的单步逆合成生成模型，通过在分子图上逐步加原子、改键来构建反应物，在同一生成过程中联合建模结构与图大小变化，无需预设编辑顺序，在基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 逆合成在现代药物发现与材料设计中至关重要。逆合成本质是分子图变换：既改变连接关系，也可能改变图的大小（原子数目）。现有方法常依赖固定大小的图表示或预设的编辑顺序，难以自然建模反应中反应物组分的新增与产物结构的改写。
AI.method: 提出RetroGEF，一个flow-based生成模型，用于单步逆合成。模型从目标分子出发，通过在分子图上添加原子和改变键来构造可能的反应物；在同一生成过程中同时建模分子变换与图大小变化，而不依赖固定尺寸的图画布；直接从产物-反应物对学习该过程，无需规定的编辑顺序。
AI.result: 在代表性的逆合成基准数据集上，RetroGEF取得了state-of-the-art的性能。
AI.conclusion: RetroGEF通过流式生成框架统一建模分子图的结构变换与规模变化，摆脱固定图尺寸和预设编辑顺序的限制，为单步逆合成提供了有效且表现领先的解决方案。

title: Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning
summary: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion，一种模拟生物生长的树状结构生成框架：每步用 SO(2)-等变 GNN 的流匹配模型预测前沿分支的分叉或终止，在神经元与植物树上验证其生成分布与参考及条件目标高度一致。
AI.motivation: 树状分支结构在自然界普遍存在（植物、神经元、血管、呼吸道树），其形态反映功能，因此结构建模是理解这些系统的关键。真实三维数据获取昂贵甚至不可行，因而需要逼真的生成模型用于仿真与数据增强。现有方法存在局限：形态学专用模型要么限制拓扑生成方式，要么依赖手工调参的机制性流程；通用三维图生成器则不利用或强制性体现树的结构特性。
AI.method: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion 生成框架，通过迭代扩展过程构建树，模拟真实树木的生物学生长。每一步由一个由 SO(2)-等变图神经网络（GNN）参数化的流匹配模型来扩展前沿（frontier），预测每个活跃分支是发生分叉还是终止。支持无条件生成、类别条件生成与形态引导生成三种设定。
AI.result: 在皮层神经元和植物树两个领域进行评估。生成形态与参考分布在两个领域均高度吻合；在条件实验中，生成结果与指定目标也高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以自回归前沿扩展的方式统一建模树状结构的生长过程，兼顾拓扑与几何生成，避免了对拓扑的硬性约束和手工机制性流程，也弥补了通用三维图生成器不体现树结构的不足，在神经元与植物树的无条件、类别条件及形态引导生成任务中均表现良好。

title: Does Text Steer Neural PDE Surrogates? A Controlled Diagnostic with OperatorCLIP
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Representation for the Physical Sciences
summary: Lower error from a text-conditioned neural surrogate does not, by itself, show that the model uses the meaning of the text. We examine this attribution problem with OperatorCLIP, comparing an unconditioned FNO, a constant-sentence FiLM control, and a fixed task description trained with contrastive alignment. Three-seed experiments cover Darcy2D, ShallowWater2D, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes (CNS3D). Constant conditioning has lower mean test error on both 2D tasks. Relative to this control, task text plus alignment has a similar mean on ShallowWater2D and CNS3D and a higher mean on Darcy2D; these descriptive comparisons have substantial seed uncertainty. The latter comparison changes both prompt content and loss, so it isolates neither effect. The text encoder is trained from scratch, and each conditioned model sees only one description during training. In this regime, pairwise InfoNCE cannot identify matched pairs and has minimum $\log B$. Prompt interventions show no reliable semantic ordering. This methodological caution demonstrates why pathway controls are needed; it neither establishes semantic competence of the encoder nor tests the effectiveness of text under varying physical context.

AI.tldr: 该论文以 OperatorCLIP 为例，考察"文本条件神经代理模型误差更低是否等于模型真正使用了文本语义"这一归因问题。在三个基准任务上通过无条件 FNO、常量句 FiLM 对照与固定任务描述+对比对齐三组设置的对比，发现常量条件反而在 2D 任务上平均误差更低，提示性文本干预也无法产生可靠的语义排序，故强调必须设置路径对照，而不能以误差高低推断语义能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常以"文本条件模型误差更低"作为其利用了文本语义的证据，但这一推断存在归因漏洞：误差下降可能来自额外参数、额外监督信号或训练噪声，而非文本含义本身。作者希望明确区分"文本条件有效果"与"模型理解了文本语义"这两件事。
AI.method: 以 OperatorCLIP 为对象设计路径对照实验：比较（1）无条件的 FNO，（2）常量句 FiLM 条件作为控制组，（3）以对比对齐训练的固定任务描述。三个随机种子下在 Darcy2D、ShallowWater2D 与三维可压缩 Navier–Stokes（CNS3D）上评估；文本编码器从零训练，每个条件模型训练时只见过一条描述；并实施提示词干预以检验是否存在语义排序。
AI.result: 常量条件在两个 2D 任务上平均测试误差最低。相较该对照，任务文本+对齐在 ShallowWater2D 与 CNS3D 上均值相近，在 Darcy2D 上均值更高，且这些描述性比较存在较大的种子不确定性。该比较同时改变了提示内容与损失函数，故无法分离任一效应。成对 InfoNCE 在此设定下无法识别匹配对，损失下界为 log B。提示干预未显示可靠的语义排序。
AI.conclusion: 误差更低的文本条件模型并不构成其使用文本语义的证据。论文的贡献是方法论警示：需要路径控制来正确归因；它既不证明编码器具备语义能力，也未检验文本在变化物理情境下的有效性。

title: MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting
summary: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MM-FinEval，一个覆盖2019-2022年、包含2,045场标普500财报电话会议的多模态多任务金融基准，评估图像-文本、音频-文本和任意到任意三类共19个基线模型，发现能处理三种模态的小型Any-to-Any模型性能优于仅用两模态的大型专有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准多局限于单模态输入或单任务设置，难以评估多模态大语言模型是否具备支撑真实金融分析的能力。财报电话会议涉及复杂企业披露、市场预期和微妙沟通信号，需要模型进行跨模态推理，因此亟需一个多模态、多任务的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建MM-FinEval基准：时间跨度为2019至2022年，涵盖2,045场标普500财报电话会议作为输入，对应12个金融任务标签作为输出；每个输入包含三种模态——逐词文本转录、会议使用的演示幻灯片以及完整音频录音。评估框架覆盖三类模型配置（图像-文本、音频-文本、任意到任意），共分析19个基线模型。
AI.result: 小型Any-to-Any模型在处理全部三种模态时取得较强性能，即便与仅支持两模态输入的大型专有模型相比也具优势，说明三模态设计引入了有用且非冗余的信息。
AI.conclusion: 文本、音频和视觉数据构成重要且互补的信号，模拟了专家级人类分析师的多源信息决策过程；MM-FinEval为多模态LLM在真实金融分析场景中的能力评估提供了严格框架。

title: Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization
summary: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $Θ(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个关于AI对齐中针对奖励模型优化的联合缩放定律，性能大致按Θ(√(min{log(M),K}))缩放，其中M为训练数据的比较对数，K为策略的散度预算；该定律在理论上得到证明，并通过大量实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律研究未能清晰识别性能如何同时随训练数据量和散度预算的变化而变化，尤其是当优化超出一定预算后会出现过度优化（reward hacking），导致性能停滞或下降。因此需要建立一个同时考虑数据量与优化努力的理论与经验框架。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个信息论模型来推导性能上界，并证明该上界可通过构造性过程紧致达到。同时使用真实标注设置进行广泛实证评估：由70B黄金奖励模型生成反馈数据，用较弱模型（0.6B到4B）训练代理奖励模型，并考虑最佳N选（best-of-N）和策略倾斜（policy tilting）等优化方式。
AI.result: 提出的缩放定律拟合效果优异（R²为97%至99%），优于其他替代规格，且在不同模型规模、噪声和优化程序下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 奖励优化可类比为一个简单的选择任务：在带噪声的偏好反馈下，从一系列独立同分布高斯随机变量中选择。该发现为理解代理奖励优化中的数据与计算权衡提供了理论基础和经验依据。

title: Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）在具身智能体任务中陷入"重试循环"的机制：掩码解码的自适应性会在失败状态下将已失败动作作为高置信填充直接提交，导致失败反馈从未被真正处理；作者将该偏差建模为与任务无关的上下文显著性腐蚀，证明该因子在反向条件（给定状态与候选动作下任务的可能性）中恰好抵消，据此提出无需训练的补救方法 Reflect Reverse。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大语言模型通过并行解码有望打破自回归智能体的串行延迟瓶颈，但近期评测显示这种效率优势无法转化为具身智能体能力：dLLM 驱动的智能体反复陷入重试循环，在动作早已失败后仍不断重新发出该动作。作者希望给出这一失败的机制性解释，并提供无需训练的解决方案。
AI.method: 将重试循环归因于掩码解码的自适应性：采样器优先提交最确定的token位置、推迟不确定位置，而在失败状态下上下文已为被推迟的决策提供了高置信填充（即失败动作本身），使重试在未处理失败反馈的情况下被提交。作者把由此产生的动作分布扭曲建模为任务无关腐蚀——上下文显著的动作（如刚执行的动作）概率被膨胀，膨胀因子依赖状态与动作但不依赖任务。在此模型下分析不变性命题：该任务无关因子在反向条件中恰好抵消，即给定状态与候选动作下任务的可能性等于理想无腐蚀模型的任务后验。掩码 dLLM 通过遮蔽任务 token 并去噪可原生地评估该反向条件（自回归模型不具备此能力），每个候选需若干并行前向传播。作者将该规则实例化为 Reflect Reverse。
AI.result: 在四个多轮具身基准上评测，Reflect Reverse 相较前向打分基线提升了任务成功率与推进率。
AI.conclusion: dLLM 智能体的重试循环源于掩码解码自适应性带来的任务无关动作分布腐蚀；利用反向条件对该腐蚀因子的抵消性质，可构建无需训练、仅需少量并行传播的方法 Reflect Reverse，有效改善具身任务表现，为 dLLM 智能体能力提供机制性理解与实用补救。

title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
summary: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

AI.tldr: ReLaG是一个模态无关框架，通过层次隐变量过程建模样本相关性，利用近邻图与社区检测推断相关样本组，从而生成独立的训练-测试划分，在分子和蛋白质数据集上性能可比且扩展性更好。
AI.motivation: 随机划分在存在相关样本的数据集（如生物化学研究）中会产生非独立的训练-测试子集，导致泛化估计过于乐观，因此需要一种能识别样本相关性并生成独立划分的方法。
AI.method: ReLaG通过层次隐变量过程建模样本相关性，使用近邻图与社区检测推断相关样本组以生成独立训练-测试子集；并提出无标签程序，根据生产数据自适应调整划分分辨率，使其与目标部署场景一致。
AI.result: 在分子和蛋白质数据集上，ReLaG与现有关系感知方法性能相当，但扩展性显著更优，可在以往不切实际的数据集规模下完成划分；推断出的分组还能提供有效数据集规模的廉价估计，支持多样性感知的数据集扩展。
AI.conclusion: ReLaG提供了一种模态无关、可扩展且开源的样本相关性感知划分方案，安装方式为pip install relag，有助于更真实地评估泛化性能并指导数据集扩展。

title: When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions
summary: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

AI.tldr: 该文区分了"曲率上界有效"与"可作为鲁棒性证书或内在训练干预"两件事：现有最后一层相对平坦度代理在前者成立时，后者仍可被证伪。
AI.motivation: 文献中常把最后一层相对平坦度代理的曲率上界有效性，直接当作鲁棒性证书充分的依据，或当作可微的内在训练干预目标，但这一跳跃缺乏论证。
AI.method: 从两方面反例入手：（1）分析有限全局经验风险最小点处保留的证书表达式，并构造规范不变的特征空间修复；（2）构造保持预测与精确收缩的公共行softmax平移，考察代理的无界性、参考类选择偏差，以及单样本固定特征（≥3类）下标量重调参无法对齐概率更新，进而用行中心化获得轨道最小上界并恢复值与全模型梯度不变性。
AI.result: 有限全局经验风险最小点处保留的证书表达式将损失增幅低估超过210倍；放大的平移可使原始正则化预测器分离，而商正则化预测器保持对齐（45组配对单步测试，含算法与图像模型）；行中心化给出轨道最小上界，且恢复值与全模型梯度不变性。CIFAR-10长时程实验显示对泛化的显著且可逆抑制，而"记忆后选择性延迟"证据不一致。
AI.conclusion: 曲率上界有效本身不足以支撑将其反演为鲁棒性证书，也不足以支撑将其微分用作内在训练干预；需附加规范不变性与对称性处理（如行中心化）才具合法性。

title: The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression
summary: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在（欠约束）迭代岭回归的列采样中，每步使用全新（fresh）草图相比复用草图具有可证明的优势，并基于"仅沿当前残差方向分析误差"的定向视角，提出残差感知采样规则、oracle分布及其实用近似，实验显示收敛显著加快。
AI.motivation: 过去25年，sketching与sampling已成为加速大规模回归的常用工具。在迭代随机求解器中，核心设计选择是每步复用同一草图还是重新采样（fresh）。对于列采样的欠约束迭代岭回归，fresh草图是否能带来可证明优势一直是开放问题。作者旨在回答并刻画这一优势。
AI.method: 作者利用fresh sketching的关键特性——误差只需沿当前残差解分析，而非在整个Gram矩阵上一致分析。这一"定向（directional）"视角：1）给出杠杆分数与岭杠杆分数采样的更紧收敛保证；2）导出残差感知（residual-aware）采样规则；3）通过最小化相关sketched矩阵-向量乘积的方差，推导出oracle采样分布及其实用近似，包括带（稍弱）收敛保证的混合采样分布。
AI.result: 理论上获得比已有方法更锐利的收敛保证；实践中在合成数据与真实数据（包括Qwen2.5表示的岭回归探测）上验证了理论，收敛速度显著更快。
AI.conclusion: fresh sketching在迭代岭回归列采样中确实具备可证明且实用的优势；基于残差方向的定向分析是获得更紧界与更优采样策略的关键，为大规模回归加速提供了新思路。

title: FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlexRouter，一种显式建模模型互补性的 LLM 路由框架，通过以“答案覆盖”为目标并借助行列式点过程（DPP）实现面向覆盖的子集选择，从而在无需固定预算下选择互补模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法独立地为各模型打分并选取 top-k，忽略了模型之间的相关性，且强制固定计算预算；这导致路由器常选出共享相同失败模式的冗余模型，从而降低整体成功概率。
AI.method: FlexRouter 将路由形式化为面向覆盖的子集选择问题，使用 Determinantal Point Processes（DPP）建模路由策略，以自然刻画模型能力与冗余性；为在无真实目标子集的情况下直接优化覆盖，提出基于对失败集边缘化的训练目标；推理阶段采用基于边缘对数行列式增益的贪心策略，自适应确定子集大小而无需预定义预算。
AI.result: 在 RouterEval 大规模基准上的大量实验表明，FlexRouter 在域内与域外任务上均以更低冗余取得更高覆盖，优于强基线，同时保持灵活的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: FlexRouter 通过建模模型互补性并优化答案覆盖，克服了传统 top-k 路由的冗余与刚性预算问题，在保持灵活推理成本的同时提升了多模型推理管线的整体成功率。

title: NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory. NeurDuo-EEG introduces multi-timescale memory management with learned consolidation and selective retrieval, enabling persistent modelling of continuous EEG with fixed-size state. It is pre-trained on 3,955 hours of EEG from 17 public datasets using multichannel autoregressive prediction of discrete spectral codes. Across three short-window and two long-sequence downstream tasks, NeurDuo-EEG achieves the best performance on four of five benchmarks, including all three short-window tasks and seizure detection, where AUC-PR improves from $0.285$ to $0.471$ over the strongest non-NeurDuo baseline. NeurDuo-EEG also remains competitive on sleep staging and supports efficient streaming inference, with nearly constant per-chunk latency as the available history grows to one hour. Notably, the Small variant achieves this with only 4.7M backbone parameters. These results demonstrate the value of persistent, multi-timescale modelling for both long-sequence and short-window EEG analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YifaNNW/NeurDuo-EEG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeurDuo-EEG，一个具备通道级持久记忆的因果EEG基础模型，通过多时间尺度记忆管理和离散频谱码自回归预训练，在长/短序列任务上取得领先性能且支持高效流式推理。
AI.motivation: EEG连续记录数小时，其有效动态跨越毫秒到小时的时间尺度。但多数EEG基础模型独立处理固定窗口，难以捕捉长时程动态信息；状态空间架构虽可递归处理，长程信息仍被隐式压缩在递归状态中，缺乏持久的、可检索的长期记忆。
AI.method: 提出NeurDuo-EEG，一种因果EEG基础模型。其核心是通道级持久记忆与多时间尺度记忆管理，包含可学习的记忆巩固（consolidation）和选择性检索（selective retrieval）机制，在固定大小状态下实现连续EEG的持久建模。预训练使用17个公开数据集共3955小时EEG，采用离散频谱码（discrete spectral codes）的多通道自回归预测目标。
AI.result: 在3个短窗口和2个长序列下游任务中，于5个基准上的4个取得最优，包括全部3个短窗口任务及癫痫检测（AUC-PR从0.285提升至0.471）；在睡眠分期上保持竞争力。支持高效流式推理，当历史增长至1小时时每块延迟近乎恒定。Small变体主干仅4.7M参数。
AI.conclusion: 持久化、多时间尺度的建模对长序列与短窗口EEG分析均具价值，兼顾性能与高效流式推理。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Complex (valued) Memories
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning 2026
summary: Partially observable environments pose a fundamental challenge in deep reinforcement learning, requiring agents to compress temporal information from observations and maintain a memory to make effective decisions. While there exist many approaches ranging from gated recurrence to attention mechanisms and model-based RL, the search for effective representational techniques that can capture long-term dependencies remains an active area of research. In this work we revisit Unitary recurrent networks (uRNNs) [Arjovsky et al., 2016, Jing et al., 2017], that demonstrated superior gradient flow and associative recall, expressing the recurrence and the hidden state in a complex vector space. Their norm preserving unitary dynamics enable information propagation through long sequences. To this end, we propose three different versions of uRNNs as drop-in replacements for recurrent PPO architectures, and demonstrate that the simple recurrence and the added degree of freedom from the phase of the complex representations enable significant gains over baselines on several memory-improvable tasks, including continuous control. We further explore how to preserve the phase information of the complex hidden state for a phase-aware policy by drawing a parallel to how quantum states are measured. With our methods reaching up to 2-3 $\times$ the reward in environments like rocksample and Craftax compared to the baselines, this work points towards an exciting new direction of representations for RL and the problem of partial observability. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sathya98/qurl

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视幺正循环网络（uRNNs），提出三种作为循环PPO架构直接替换的uRNN变体，利用复数空间中范数保持的幺正动力学实现长程时序信息传播，并在多个记忆依赖任务上取得2-3倍于基线的奖励提升。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境是深度强化学习的核心难题，智能体需压缩历史观测并维持记忆才能有效决策。现有方法（门控循环、注意力机制、基于模型的RL）在捕捉长期依赖方面仍不理想，缺乏有效的表征技术。uRNNs此前展现出更优的梯度流与联想召回能力，但其在RL部分可观测问题上的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 提出三种uRNN变体，作为循环PPO架构的直接替换（drop-in replacement）；在复数空间中表达循环连接与隐状态，利用范数保持的幺正动力学促进长序列信息传播；并借鉴量子态测量的思路，探索如何为策略保留复数隐状态的相位信息，构建相位感知（phase-aware）策略。
AI.result: 在多个可通过记忆改善的任务（含连续控制）上显著优于基线；在rocksample、Craftax等环境中奖励最高达到基线的2-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 复数域幺正循环表征为强化学习与部分可观测性问题提供了富有前景的新方向，简单的循环结构结合相位自由度即可带来显著增益。

title: JARQ: Joint Alternating Refinement for Quantization
summary: Group-wise post-training quantizers for large language models round weights onto a grid that is not refit to the resulting integer codes. We show that this leaves accuracy on the table: the best grid depends on the codes, input correlations couple the errors of different groups, and useful code changes often involve many codes at once. We propose JARQ , a plug-in refinement that starts from any group-wise quantizer and alternates a joint least-squares fit of all group scales with bounded Babai proposals that move many codes of a group together on the current grid. The problem is a bilinear box-constrained mixed-integer least-squares problem; the solver is backpropagation-free, does not increase the layer-wise objective under exact scale solves, and keeps the host's bit width, groups, zero points, and inference cost. Across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Qwen models with RTN, GPTQ, OmniQuant, and AWQ hosts, JARQ lowers perplexity in 90 of 96 comparisons, cuts three-bit RTN perplexity by up to 36%, raises mean multiple-choice accuracy in 23 of 24 configurations, and improves QEP, QuaRot, and OJBKQ outputs, at under a minute per 7B block.

AI.tldr: 提出JARQ：一种分组权重量化的插件式精炼方法，通过联合最小二乘拟合组尺度与有界Babai提案，在保持宿主位宽、分组、零点与推理成本的前提下降低困惑度并提升下游准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有分组训练后量化器将权值舍入到固定网格，网格并未根据生成的整数码重新拟合。作者指出这损失了精度，原因有三：最优网格依赖整数码；输入相关性使不同组的误差相互耦合；有用的码变更往往需要一次性改变大量整数码。
AI.method: JARQ以任意分组量化器为起点，交替执行两步：(1) 对所有组尺度进行联合最小二乘拟合；(2) 在当前网格上使用有界Babai提案，一次性移动同一组内的多个整数码。该问题被形式化为双线性、盒约束的混合整数最小二乘问题；求解器无需反向传播，在精确求解尺度时不增加层目标函数，并保持宿主的位宽、分组、零点与推理成本。
AI.result: 在Llama-2、Llama-3、Qwen模型上，以RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant、AWQ为宿主，JARQ在96次比较中的90次降低困惑度，将三位RTN困惑度最多降低36%；在24种配置中的23种提升平均多项选择准确率，并改善QEP、QuaRot、OJBKQ的输出，7B模型每个块耗时不到一分钟。
AI.conclusion: 分组训练后量化中“先定网格再舍入”并非最优；将整数码选择与尺度拟合联合优化可显著提升量化质量，且JARQ作为通用插件兼容多种宿主量化器，几乎不引入额外推理开销。

title: Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders
summary: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables. For a fixed number of observed variables and a fixed upper bound on latent variables, we establish consistency of global score minimizers up to marginal quasi-equivalence under algebraic faithfulness, structural minimality, and model-overlap assumptions. We parameterize the inclusion of directed edges and candidate latent variables using Bernoulli gates, whose continuous probabilities are optimized jointly with the structural coefficients. Averaging the penalized negative log-likelihood over these gates yields an objective with a closed-form differentiable complexity penalty. We prove that this expected objective has the same global infimum as the corresponding discrete structure-learning objective. Experimental results show that our approach achieves lower recovery error than previous methods in several experimental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含环有向图与未知数量外生潜混淆因子的线性高斯结构因果模型，提出边缘准等价概念，并用伯努利门参数化结构学习目标，给出全局最优解一致性证明及优于现有方法的实验结果。
AI.motivation: 现有因果结构学习多假设无环且无潜混淆因子；当存在有向环和未知数量的外生潜混淆因子时，观测分布与结构之间的等价关系不清，传统方法难以保证恢复的正确性。因此需要刻画此类模型下的可识别性并给出可优化的学习准则。
AI.method: （1）推导观测变量协方差，提出“边缘准等价”，刻画不同因果模型共享满维观测分布子集的条件；（2）以对数缩放复杂度惩罚（计有向边与潜变量数）的高斯负对数似然为评分，证明在代数忠实性、结构最小性和模型重叠假设下全局评分最小解在边缘准等价意义下一致；（3）用伯努利门对边与候选潜变量的包含进行参数化，将结构系数与门概率联合优化，对惩罚负对数似然在门上取平均，得到闭式可微复杂度惩罚，并证明该期望目标与对应离散结构学习目标具有相同全局下确界。
AI.result: 理论上建立了含环、含潜混淆因子线性高斯模型下全局评分最小解的一致性（至边缘准等价）；方法上获得闭式可微的期望目标且全局下确界等价于离散目标；实验表明，在若干实验设置下本方法的恢复误差低于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将因果结构学习推广到含环且潜混淆因子数未知的线性高斯场景，通过边缘准等价与伯努利门松弛，把离散结构搜索转化为可微优化，兼具一致性保证与更低的经验恢复误差。

title: Geometry-physics confounding impairs PDE learning across varying domains
summary: Learning partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics across varying domains is central to predictive modelling and data-driven discovery of governing equations. However, geometric variation alters both field representation and the governing differential operators, confounding geometric effects with intrinsic physical properties in the observed dynamics. This work identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains. In forward operator learning, this confounding increases the burden of inferring geometry-dependent operator changes from finite data, reducing data efficiency and generalisation. In equation discovery, omitting geometry-induced operators misspecifies the candidate library, leading to biased parameters, missed governing terms and spurious terms. We propose a de-confounding framework that makes the known geometry-to-operator transformation explicit. Geometry-induced coefficient fields improve prediction and data efficiency across five operator-learning benchmarks, while geometry-complete candidate libraries recover the generating equations and reduce held-out PDE residuals by more than two orders of magnitude in both evolving-domain systems. By separating known geometric action from intrinsic physics, the proposed framework supports more reliable and data-efficient PDE learning across scientific and engineering problems with varying geometries.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出"几何-物理混杂"是变域PDE学习的统一失效机制，并提出显式化几何到算子变换的去混杂框架，在正演算子学习与方程发现两方面均取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 跨不同域学习PDE动力学对预测建模与数据驱动方程发现至关重要，但几何变化会同时改变场表示与控制性微分算子，使几何效应与内在物理属性相互混杂，降低了正演算子学习的数据效率与泛化性，并在方程发现中造成候选库误设、参数偏差、遗漏真实项和引入伪项。作者因此提出以"几何-物理混杂"作为统一失效机制来解释上述困难。
AI.method: 提出一个去混杂框架，将已知的几何到算子（geometry-to-operator）变换显式化，从而把已知的几何作用与内在物理分离开来。具体包括：构建几何诱导的系数场以改进正演算子学习；构建几何完备的候选库以改进方程发现。
AI.result: 在五个算子学习基准上，几何诱导系数场提升了预测精度与数据效率；在两类演化域系统中，几何完备候选库成功恢复生成方程，并将留出PDE残差降低超过两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离已知几何作用与内在物理，该框架支持在几何多变科学与工程问题中更可靠、更数据高效地进行PDE学习。

title: Interpretable but Fragile? Robustness of Concept Bottlenecks under Geometric-Semantic Perturbations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to provide interpretable intermediate representations, yet how such bottlenecks affect robustness remains unclear, with existing studies reporting mixed and sometimes contradictory findings. We argue that these discrepancies arise from conflating different robustness notions and perturbation regimes, rather than from fundamental disagreements about CBMs themselves. To disentangle these factors, we introduce a generator-based evaluation framework that enables controlled comparisons between standard classifiers and CBMs under two distinct perturbation types: continuous geometric perturbations in latent space and discrete semantic interventions in concept space. Within this framework, we evaluate robustness both empirically, via prediction and concept-level sensitivity metrics, and certifiably, using randomized smoothing in latent and concept spaces. Across experiments, we reconcile previously conflicting findings by clarifying when, and in what sense, concept bottlenecks do or do not improve robustness. By further analyzing robustness under varying task conditions, including class semantic similarity and concept vocabulary size, we show that interpretability does not inherently confer robustness. Instead, concept bottlenecks shift where and how sensitivity manifests, revealing a nuanced interpretability robustness trade off that depends critically on the perturbation regime and task structure. Together, our results show that interpretability and robustness are distinct objectives: interpretable intermediate representations do not uniformly improve robustness, but instead redistribute sensitivity across perturbation spaces and model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成器的评估框架，区分潜空间连续几何扰动与概念空间离散语义干预两种扰动方式，并在经验与可验证（随机平滑）两个层面评估，揭示概念瓶颈并非均匀提升鲁棒性，而是转移敏感性的位置与方式。
AI.motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）旨在提供可解释的中间表征，但其对鲁棒性的影响尚无定论，已有研究结论混杂甚至相互矛盾。作者认为分歧源于将不同的鲁棒性概念与扰动机制混为一谈，而非对 CBM 本身的根本分歧。
AI.method: 提出基于生成器的评估框架，在两种扰动类型下对标准分类器与 CBM 进行受控比较：潜空间的连续几何扰动与概念空间的离散语义干预。评估同时采用经验方式（预测与概念层面的敏感性指标）与可验证方式（潜空间与概念空间的随机平滑）。
AI.result: 在不同扰动机制与任务条件下（类别语义相似度、概念词表规模），调和了以往相互冲突的发现；表明可解释性并不天然带来鲁棒性，概念瓶颈会改变敏感性出现的位置与方式，形成依赖于扰动机制和任务结构的可解释性—鲁棒性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性与鲁棒性是相互区别的目标：可解释的中间表征不会一致地提升鲁棒性，而是在不同扰动空间与模型族之间重新分配敏感性。

title: Proper Scoring Rule-based Diffusion for Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
summary: Recent probabilistic weather forecasters train stochastic predictors with the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) to generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass. These models learn the predictive distribution from the forecast context alone, which becomes difficult at longer forecast horizons where uncertainty is high. To learn the predictive distribution more effectively, we introduce auxiliary conditional denoising tasks that predict the same future state from the context and its corrupted version, which provides partial future information that can reduce prediction ambiguity. Building on distributional diffusion models, we learn the conditional distributions of these tasks with a single stochastic predictor by minimizing a proper scoring rule across noise levels. At inference, the predictor can still generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass at the fully corrupted endpoint. Standard CRPS training is recovered as the endpoint-only special case of our formulation, so our framework extends existing CRPS-based forecasters with only additional conditioning inputs. Controlled experiments show that the auxiliary tasks improve one-step forecasting across architectures, with larger gains at longer forecast horizons. The gains extend to high-dimensional global weather forecasting under both training from scratch and fine-tuning, along with improved calibration and potential benefits for generalization under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在基于CRPS的随机天气预报模型中引入辅助条件去噪任务，通过对上下文及其受损版本预测同一未来状态来降低预测歧义，并用单一随机预测器在各噪声水平上以恰当评分规则学习条件分布；标准CRPS训练是其端点特例。
AI.motivation: 现有概率天气预报器用CRPS训练随机预测器，单次前向生成集合成员，但仅依赖预报上下文学习预测分布，在预报时效较长、不确定性较高时较为困难。
AI.method: 引入辅助条件去噪任务，从上下文及上下文受损版本预测同一未来状态以提供部分未来信息；基于分布扩散模型，用单一随机预测器最小化跨噪声水平的恰当评分规则来学习这些条件分布；推理时仍在完全受损端点单次前向生成每个集合成员。标准CRPS训练是端点特例，框架可通过增加条件输入扩展已有CRPS预报器。
AI.result: 受控实验显示辅助任务在不同架构上改善单步预报，长时效增益更大；增益扩展到高维全球天气预报，适用于从头训练与微调，并改善校准，且在分布偏移下可能有利于泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过辅助条件去噪任务扩展CRPS训练框架，可有效提升概率天气预报在长时效和高维场景下的性能与校准，同时保持单次前向生成集合成员的推理效率。

title: Alignment via Training Against Probes Without Losing Monitorability
summary: Models are usually aligned based on their observed outputs, using demonstrations, preference data, or reward signals. These objectives reward responses that look aligned. More capable models may learn to satisfy them without internalizing the intended behavior, for example by faking compliance during training. Such superficial compliance could be harder when the objective is defined on model internals rather than outputs. Therefore, we study probe-guided fine-tuning, using probes that detect undesired properties in model activations as a direct training signal. We evaluate linear and non-linear probes with different numbers of probes per layer across two alignment objectives: harmlessness and honesty. We find that training against probes that do not update during training is an easily exploitable objective, while continuously updated probes substantially reduce harmfulness and improve honesty while preserving utility. Probe-guided fine-tuning achieves better safety-utility trade-offs than DPO and inference-time steering, while being substantially more robust against jailbreak and abliteration attacks. Moreover, the concepts stay linearly encoded after fine-tuning, meaning oversight is not lost by our method. Training against probes thus offers a way to shape what models represent rather than only what they output, which may become increasingly important as models get better at making their outputs look aligned.

AI.tldr: 提出探针引导微调（probe-guided fine-tuning），用检测模型激活中不良属性的探针作为训练信号，持续更新探针可在保持效用的同时降低有害性、提升诚实性，安全性-效用权衡优于 DPO 与推理时引导，且对越狱与消融攻击更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法多基于模型的可观测输出（演示、偏好数据或奖励信号），本质是奖励"看起来对齐"的回复。能力更强的模型可能在未内化目标行为的情况下学会满足这些目标，例如在训练中假装顺从。若把目标定义在模型内部而非输出上，这类表面顺从会更难实现，因此作者研究以探针作为直接训练信号的探针引导微调。
AI.method: 在模型激活上训练探针以检测不良属性，并将其作为微调的直接训练信号。实验对比线性与非线性探针、每层不同探针数量，覆盖无害性与诚实性两个对齐目标；同时对比训练中固定不变的探针与持续更新的探针，并与 DPO、推理时引导（inference-time steering）进行对照，另评估对越狱（jailbreak）和消融（abliteration）攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 使用训练中不更新的探针是一种易被利用的目标；持续更新的探针能显著降低有害性、提升诚实性，同时保持效用。探针引导微调在安全性-效用权衡上优于 DPO 和推理时引导，并且对越狱和消融攻击的鲁棒性明显更强。此外，相关概念在微调后仍保持线性编码，说明该方法并未导致监督能力丧失。
AI.conclusion: 针对探针训练提供了一种塑造模型"表征内容"而非仅塑造其输出的途径，在模型越来越擅长让输出看起来对齐的趋势下，这种内部层面的对齐方式可能愈发重要。

title: Uncertainty-Normalized Margins for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct preference optimization (DPO) models binary preferences through a Bradley-Terry model with a common noise scale, without explicitly accounting for preference strength or prompt-dependent uncertainty from human feedback. We introduce uncertainty-normalized margin DPO (UNM-DPO), which combines strength-dependent margins with a learned prompt scale. Motivated by a heteroskedastic Bradley-Terry model, we develop two training objectives. Both compare the implicit rewards of preferred and rejected responses, derived from response log-probability ratios to a reference policy. Advantage-only (AO) divides this reward difference by the prompt scale before subtracting the margin; whole-residual (WR) subtracts the margin before dividing by the scale. For the WR comparison model, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which known margins make the prompt scale identifiable. We introduce a practical procedure for learning the scale. Building on WR, we introduce ULNM-DPO-WR, which normalizes each response's implicit reward by its length. We evaluate our methods against DPO and related baselines on HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3, using the Skywork reward model as a judge. With Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ULNM-DPO-WR achieves tie-adjusted win rates against matched DPO of 68.00% and 65.31% on evaluation panels, with higher mean rewards and shorter responses on average. On AlpacaEval with a GPT-4.1 judge and GPT-4-Turbo reference answers, the same 8B policy achieves a length-controlled win rate of 21.62%, compared with 16.39% for DPO and 15.30% for SimPO. These results demonstrate the potential of combining preference-strength margins, learned prompt scales, and length normalization for policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 UNM-DPO/ULNM-DPO-WR，用偏好强度 margin 与可学习 prompt scale 建模异方差偏好，并以长度归一提升 DPO 类策略优化效果。
AI.motivation: DPO 用 Bradley-Terry 模型以统一噪声尺度建模二元偏好，未显式考虑偏好强度与由人类反馈带来的 prompt 相关不确定性。
AI.method: 基于异方差 Bradley-Terry 模型，提出两种目标：AO 先用 prompt scale 除偏好奖励差再减 margin；WR 先减 margin 再除 scale。对 WR 给出已知 margin 下 prompt scale 可辨识的充要条件及学习流程，并进一步提出按响应长度归一隐式奖励的 ULNM-DPO-WR。
AI.result: 在 HelpSteer2/HelpSteer3 上以 Skywork 奖励模型为评审，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 ULNM-DPO-WR 对匹配 DPO 的 tie-adjusted 胜率为 68.00% 与 65.31%，平均奖励更高、响应更短；AlpacaEval（GPT-4.1 评审、GPT-4-Turbo 参考）长度控制胜率 21.62%，高于 DPO 的 16.39% 与 SimPO 的 15.30%。
AI.conclusion: 结合偏好强度 margin、可学习 prompt scale 与长度归一化在策略优化中具有潜力。

title: Provable Test-Time Scaling for Beam Search in LLM Reasoning
summary: Beam-search-based test-time methods provide an effective way to improve large language model (LLM) performance on long-horizon generation by pruning invalid reasoning paths early, leading to significantly improved reasoning efficiency and more favorable test-time cost scaling. Despite strong empirical success, the theoretical understanding of beam search remains limited. In this paper, we study the test-time compute guarantee of the commonly used beam search framework that uses the model's internal log-likelihood for intermediate scoring, while relying on an external reward model only after a complete response is generated. We first establish a lower bound for vanilla beam search, showing that at least $Ω(C^\star(x)^2)$ samples are required for the optimal response to survive, where $C^\star(x)$ is the token-level coverage coefficient for prompt $x$. This motivates our modified confidence-filtered beam search (CF-Beam), which reduces the sufficient coverage dependence from quadratic to nearly linear under prefix competitiveness, for fixed horizon, gap, and target accuracy. We then show that the regret of CF-Beam is upper-bounded by the probability of rare failure events and the reward estimation error scaled by a path-level coverage coefficient, where the rare-failure term vanishes as per-step sampling increases. Our results highlight a fundamental advantage of beam search over sequence-level inference methods such as Best-of-N and Best-of-Majority. While the guarantees of these approaches typically involve coverage coefficients that grow exponentially with the horizon $L$, CF-Beam controls the dominant search-induced term through a token-level coverage coefficient that scales polynomially with $L$. Our numerical experiments further confirm that beam search is more robust on hard instances and under increasing reasoning horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于beam search的测试时方法进行理论分析，揭示其相对Best-of-N等方法在长程生成中的计算优势。
AI.motivation: Beam search在长程生成中经验上有效，能及早剪枝无效推理路径、改善推理效率与测试时成本伸缩，但缺乏理论理解。本文旨在建立其测试时计算保证。
AI.method: 研究使用模型内部对数似然做中间打分、仅在生成完整响应后使用外部奖励模型的常用beam search框架。先为vanilla beam search建立下界，再提出改进的置信过滤beam search（CF-Beam），将充分覆盖依赖从二次降至近线性。
AI.result: 证明vanilla beam search至少需要Ω(C⋆(x)^2)个样本才能使最优响应存活，其中C⋆(x)为提示x的token级覆盖系数。CF-Beam在prefix competitiveness下将充分覆盖依赖从二次降至近线性。CF-Beam的regret由稀有失败事件概率和奖励估计误差（按路径级覆盖系数缩放）上界，稀有失败项随每步采样增加而消失。
AI.conclusion: Beam search相对Best-of-N和Best-of-Majority具根本优势：后者的覆盖系数随horizon L指数增长，而CF-Beam通过token级覆盖系数控制搜索主导项，多项式中随L增长。数值实验证实beam search在难例和推理horizon增加时更鲁棒。

title: In-Distribution Imagination for Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based offline reinforcement learning (MBORL) improves sample efficiency through model-generated trajectories. However, accumulative model error can drive imagined trajectories outside the offline data distribution, leading to unrealistic synthetic data and unstable policy optimization. Many existing methods primarily control rollouts using transition-level uncertainty. We propose \emph{in-distribution imagination} (IDI), a rollout control framework that estimates trajectory support in a learned representation space and adaptively truncates rollouts that leave the offline trajectory manifold. Combined with trajectory-regularized RL, an extension of entropy-regularized RL, IDI consistently improves performance in limited-data settings. Experiments show that trajectory support predicts rollout failure substantially better than transition-level uncertainty, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level rollout control in MBORL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布内想象（IDI），在学习到的表征空间中估计轨迹支撑度，并自适应截断离开离线轨迹流形的 rollout，配合轨迹正则化 RL，在有限数据下稳定提升 MBORL 性能。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的离线强化学习虽通过模型生成轨迹提升样本效率，但累积模型误差会使想象轨迹偏离离线数据分布，产生不真实合成数据并导致策略优化不稳定。现有方法多依赖转移级不确定性控制 rollout，缺乏对轨迹整体支撑的判断。
AI.method: 提出 IDI rollout 控制框架：在所学表征空间中估计轨迹支撑度，对离开离线轨迹流形的 rollout 进行自适应截断；并结合轨迹正则化 RL（熵正则化 RL 的扩展）进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在有限数据设置下，IDI 持续提升性能；实验表明轨迹支撑度对 rollout 失败的预测能力显著优于转移级不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级 rollout 控制对 MBORL 至关重要，IDI 通过轨迹支撑度估计与自适应截断有效缓解模型误差累积问题。

title: Molecular Property Prediction under Structural Shift with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Predicting molecular properties for compounds that differ structurally from labeled training molecules is important for drug discovery and materials design. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a promising approach through in-context learning, but their performance under structural shifts and the value of molecular comparisons in this setting remain underexplored. We study structural generalization in molecular property prediction and introduce MolPAIR (Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement), a framework that combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts without task-specific parameter updates. A global tabular foundation model (TFM) first predicts a query's property from labeled molecular examples. A second frozen TFM predicts differences in prediction errors between the query and labeled reference molecules, using these comparisons to refine the initial prediction. Across 58 MoleculeACE and Polaris tasks, CheMeleon representations combined with TabPFN-3 already outperform each evaluated baseline on a majority of tasks. MOLPAIR further improves this predictor on 46 of 58 tasks, with gains across four molecular representations and three TFM backbones. These results show that explicit molecular comparisons can strengthen tabular in-context learning for structural generalization while keeping the molecular encoder and pretrained model weights fixed. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/MolPAIR.

AI.tldr: 提出MolPAIR框架，用分子级与分子对上下文增强表格基础模型的上下文学习，在结构泛化场景下提升分子性质预测。
AI.motivation: 针对结构上与训练分子差异较大的化合物进行性质预测对药物与材料设计很重要。表格基础模型(TFM)通过上下文学习提供了新思路，但其在结构偏移下的表现、以及分子比较在此设定中的价值仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: MolPAIR为免任务特定参数更新的框架，融合分子级与分子对上下文。先用全局TFM基于标注分子样例预测查询分子性质；再用第二个冻结TFM预测查询分子与参考分子间预测误差的差异，据此对初始预测进行细化。方法在四种分子表示与三种TFM骨干上验证。
AI.result: 在58个MoleculeACE与Polaris任务上，CheMeleon表示结合TabPFN-3已在多数任务上超越各基线；MolPAIR在58个任务中的46个进一步提升该预测器，增益跨四种分子表示与三种TFM骨干。
AI.conclusion: 显式分子比较可增强表格上下文学习以实现结构泛化，且无需更新分子编码器与预训练模型权重。

title: Lasting Effects of Abstract Pretraining Beyond Perplexity
summary: Language models are typically pretrained from random initialization. Recent work challenges this convention, showing that a brief warm-up on abstract, algorithmically generated data can provide a better starting point for subsequent learning of natural language. In this paper, we show that in small language models, such a warm-up improves specific capabilities that are not reflected in language-modeling perplexity. Our warm-up uses an abstract stack-manipulation task that requires compositional and state-tracking capabilities. Allocating as little as 1% of pretraining tokens to this data improves multi-hop question answering by up to 3.9 F1 points on MUSIQUE, with additional gains on HOTPOTQA and 2WIKIMULTIHOPQA despite comparable language-modeling perplexity. Controlled experiments show that the warm-up substantially accelerates the acquisition of deeper reasoning chains. We also explore what drives this transfer. First, the structure of the data matters: replacing the stack task with a queue fails to produce the same gains. Second, the gains are specific: performance improves on sequential reasoning chains, with no consistent benefit on tasks that combine or compare independent facts. Third, timing matters: mixing abstract data with natural language is far less effective than an initial dedicated phase, and exposure after pretraining completely removes the benefits. The early advantage persists through billions of subsequent language tokens. These results show that early abstract training can reliably shape the capabilities language models later acquire.

AI.tldr: 在小型语言模型中，用1%预训练词元进行抽象栈操作任务的预热，可显著提升多跳问答能力（MUSIQUE上最高+3.9 F1），该增益取决于数据结构、任务类型和训练时机，并在后续数十亿词元训练中持续存在。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常从随机初始化开始预训练。近期工作表明，在抽象、算法生成的数据上进行短暂预热可为后续自然语言学习提供更好的起点。本文旨在探究这种预热是否能在小型语言模型中改善那些不体现在语言建模困惑度上的特定能力，并厘清该迁移现象的驱动因素。
AI.method: 使用一个抽象的栈操作任务（要求组合能力与状态跟踪能力）进行预热。仅将1%的预训练词元分配给该数据，随后继续常规自然语言预训练。通过控制实验比较：栈任务与队列任务、顺序推理链与独立事实的组合/比较任务、抽象数据与自然语言混合训练 vs 独立预热阶段、预训练后暴露 vs 早期暴露，并追踪后续数十亿词元的性能变化。
AI.result: 在MUSIQUE上多跳问答提升最多3.9 F1点，在HOTPOTQA和2WIKIMULTIHOPQA上也有增益，而语言建模困惑度相当。控制实验显示预热显著加速了更深推理链的习得。栈任务有效而队列任务无效；增益仅体现在顺序推理链上，对独立事实的组合/比较任务无稳定收益；将抽象数据与自然语言混合效果远不如独立预热阶段，预训练后再暴露则完全消除增益。早期优势在后续数十亿词元中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 早期抽象训练能够可靠地塑造语言模型后续习得的能力，且此类能力无法通过语言建模困惑度反映。数据结构的性质、任务类型的匹配以及训练时机共同决定了迁移效果，表明预热数据的抽象结构与引入阶段对能力形成具有关键作用。

title: dattri-LLM: A Unified and Efficient Library for Training Data Attribution at LLM Scale
summary: Training data attribution (TDA) estimates the contribution of individual training examples to model outputs. Most scalable TDA methods rely on per-example gradients, whose computation and use at LLM scale pose challenges in efficiency, compatibility, and extensibility. We introduce dattri-LLM, a TDA library that makes gradient-based attribution more practical at scale. For efficiency, dattri-LLM uses compact gradient representations and dynamically routes gradient operations based on a cost model. For compatibility, its capture mechanism collects per-example gradients from existing training loops that call backward(), without requiring changes to the loop or its configuration. This includes distributed training with DDP and FSDP and pipelines built with HuggingFace Transformers, TRL, and OLMo. For extensibility, dattri-LLM exposes reusable gradient operations and training-time callbacks for implementing attribution methods and applications. These interfaces support a variety of attribution methods, including gradient similarity, curvature-based influence, and trajectory-based methods, as well as applications that act on gradients during training, such as online data selection. On the same hardware and workload, dattri-LLM achieves 3.2x the throughput of the fastest competing library on average, scales multiple attribution methods to 110B-parameter models across four H200 GPUs, and offers superior attribution fidelity-cost trade-offs across a range of models with different model families and scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 dattri-LLM，一个面向大语言模型规模的可扩展训练数据归因（TDA）库，通过紧凑梯度表示、基于代价模型的动态梯度算子路由、无需修改训练循环的梯度捕获机制以及可复用的梯度算子与训练回调接口，在效率、兼容性和可扩展性上显著提升基于梯度的归因方法。
AI.motivation: 多数可扩展的训练数据归因方法依赖逐样本梯度，但在 LLM 规模下，逐样本梯度的计算与使用在效率、兼容性和可扩展性方面均存在挑战：计算与存储开销大、难以适配现有训练流程与分布式训练框架，且不易扩展以支持新方法与新应用。
AI.method: dattri-LLM 从三方面设计：（1）效率——采用紧凑梯度表示，并基于代价模型动态路由梯度操作；（2）兼容性——其捕获机制可从调用 backward() 的既有训练循环中收集逐样本梯度，无需修改训练循环或其配置，兼容 DDP 与 FSDP 分布式训练，以及基于 HuggingFace Transformers、TRL 和 OLMo 构建的流水线；（3）可扩展性——提供可复用的梯度操作与训练期回调接口，用于实现归因方法及应用。
AI.result: 在相同硬件与工作负载下，dattri-LLM 平均达到最快竞品库 3.2 倍的吞吐量；可在四块 H200 GPU 上将多种归因方法扩展至 110B 参数模型；并在不同模型家族与规模上取得更优的归因保真度—成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: dattri-LLM 使基于梯度的训练数据归因在 LLM 规模下更实用，支持梯度相似度、基于曲率的影响函数与基于轨迹的方法等多种归因方法，以及在线数据选择等训练期作用于梯度的应用，在大规模模型上兼顾了效率、兼容性与可扩展性。

title: Learning Under Forgetting: Statistical Support-Selective Retention in Stochastic Training Dynamics
summary: Prior work has shown that neural networks exhibit implicit biases toward low-complexity structure (e.g., spectral bias), memorization dynamics, and compression-like effects during training, but a unified dynamical account of selective retention remains incomplete. We propose Repeated Reinforcement with Persistent Forgetting (RPF) dynamics, a minimal framework in which repeated exposure reinforces patterns and structures that recur in the data, while persistent forgetting attenuates learned information. This view treats forgetting not merely as a failure mode, but as a selection mechanism. We build the theory in three successive layers. First, in an independent-feature model, we derive an exposure-selective survival law and a support-dependent retention boundary characterizing which patterns persist under forgetting. Second, in a shared-parameter model, we show that forgetting induces spectral filtering over covariance modes, preserving strongly supported shared components while suppressing weak ones. Third, under small-step and norm/coding approximations, we show how RPF dynamics induce an implicit trade-off between data fitting and the cost of stored information, yielding Minimum Description Length (MDL)-like compression. Controlled experiments provide evidence for this reinforcement--forgetting selection mechanism in scalar memories and a nonlinear shared network. Joint reinforcement and attenuation interventions shift conditional retention, while matched exposure counts reveal forgetting-dependent effects of reinforcement timing and changes in the composition of the retained set. Together, these results show that repeated reinforcement and persistent forgetting jointly provide a controllable source of inductive bias beyond neural architecture and scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"重复强化与持续遗忘"(RPF)动力学框架，将遗忘视为一种选择性机制而非单纯的失效模式，并用三层理论（独立特征模型、共享参数模型、小步长/编码近似）刻画其归纳偏置，实验验证于标量记忆与非线性共享网络。
AI.motivation: 已有工作观察到神经网络的谱偏置、记忆动力学与类压缩效应等隐式偏置，但缺乏一个统一的选择性保留动力学解释。作者希望给出一个最小化框架，统一说明哪些模式会被保留、哪些被抑制。
AI.method: 提出RPF（Repeated Reinforcement with Persistent Forgetting）动力学：重复曝光强化数据中反复出现的模式与结构，持续遗忘衰减已学信息。理论分三层构建：(1) 独立特征模型，推导曝光选择性存续律与依赖支撑集的保留边界；(2) 共享参数模型，证明遗忘对协方差模态产生谱滤波；(3) 在小步长与范数/编码近似下，导出数据拟合与信息存储代价之间的隐式权衡，得到类MDL压缩。实验在标量记忆和非线性共享网络上进行，采用联合强化与衰减干预、匹配曝光次数等控制。
AI.result: 实验为强化–遗忘选择机制提供证据：联合强化与衰减干预会改变条件保留；在匹配曝光次数下，强化时机效应依赖遗忘，且保留集合的构成发生变化。共享参数模型中遗忘表现为对协方差模态的谱滤波，抑制弱支撑成分而保留强支撑共享成分。
AI.conclusion: 重复强化与持续遗忘共同构成一种可调控的归纳偏置来源，其作用独立于网络架构与规模，为理解选择性保留提供了统一动力学视角。

title: Distilling Diffusion Score Discrepancy for Efficient Training Data Attribution
summary: Training data attribution for diffusion models aims to identify the training samples that influence a generated instance, but existing methods either require costly per-sample gradient computation or query-specific model optimization. Moreover, most methods attribute changes in a proxy loss rather than changes in the actual model's generative behavior. We address these limitations by formulating attribution directly with a local score discrepancy measure, which applies to any diffusion variant (including DDPM, EDM, and flow matching), and by showing that such measure can be estimated without retraining, as a preconditioned gradient similarity. We instantiate this estimator as Training-data Influence via score Discrepancy (TID), which uses Kronecker-factored curvature to avoid random projections and per-sample gradient storage. We then distill TID into TIDE, a forward-only student trained online to reproduce the teacher's rankings from the diffusion model's internal activations. Under counterfactual evaluation on CIFAR-10, ArtBench-10, and MS-COCO, TID matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, while TIDE retains most of TID's accuracy at four to five orders of magnitude lower per-query cost, attributing generated samples in milliseconds and faster than the generation itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TID 与 TIDE 两种扩散模型训练数据归因方法，直接以局部分数差异度量归因，TID 用 Kronecker 分解曲率估计，TIDE 将其蒸馏为前向学生网络，在多个数据集上达到 SOTA 精度且查询成本降低四到五个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型训练数据归因方法存在两大约束：需要昂贵的逐样本梯度计算或针对查询的模型优化；且多数方法归因的是代理损失的变化，而非实际模型生成行为的变化。作者希望直接刻画生成行为层面的归因，并大幅降低查询成本。
AI.method: 将归因直接形式化为局部分数差异（local score discrepancy）度量，适用于 DDPM、EDM、flow matching 等任意扩散变体；证明该度量可在不重训练的情况下估计为预条件梯度相似度。实例化估计器 TID：使用 Kronecker 分解曲率，避免随机投影与逐样本梯度存储。进一步将 TID 蒸馏为 TIDE：一个在线训练的仅前向学生模型，从扩散模型内部激活中复现教师排序。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、ArtBench-10 和 MS-COCO 上进行反事实评估，TID 匹配或超越现有最先进方法；TIDE 在保留 TID 大部分精度的同时，将每次查询成本降低四到五个数量级，可在毫秒级对生成样本完成归因，速度快于生成过程本身。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部分数差异归因并配合 Kronecker 曲率估计与在线蒸馏，可在保持归因精度的同时实现极高效的扩散模型训练数据归因，为生成行为层面的数据影响分析提供了实用方案。

title: ChartDensity-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Numerical Data Reconstruction under Visual Density
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising approach for recovering numerical data from scientific charts, but their ability to reconstruct chart data from visually dense figures remains poorly understood. Existing chart understanding benchmarks primarily evaluate question answering or chart-level reasoning and provide limited support for evaluating structured numerical reconstruction from scientific figures. We introduce \textbf{ChartDensity-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on structured numerical data reconstruction from compound chart figures under controlled visual density. Built from charts paired with source-level ground-truth data, ChartDensity-Bench systematically varies the number of simultaneously presented charts ($k\in{1,3,6,9}$), enabling controlled evaluation of density-induced degradation. We further propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework covering structural reliability, reconstruction completeness, parseability, and numerical fidelity. Experiments on five recent MLLMs show that numerical reconstruction generally degrades as visual density increases, while the magnitude of degradation varies substantially across models. Chart-level paired comparisons further show that the same source chart can incur higher reconstruction error when embedded in denser visual contexts. These findings highlight visual density as an important and previously underexplored factor in MLLM chart data reconstruction and provide a systematic benchmark for evaluating model robustness in this setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartDensity-Bench，一个在受控视觉密度下评估 MLLM 从复合图表图像中重建结构化数值数据的基准，并揭示视觉密度是导致重建性能退化的重要且被忽视的因素。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在从科学图表恢复数值数据方面具有潜力，但其在视觉密集图像中重建图表数据的能力尚不清楚；现有图表理解基准主要评估问答或图表级推理，缺乏对结构化数值重建的评估支持。
AI.method: 构建 ChartDensity-Bench：基于图表与其源级真值数据配对，系统变化同时呈现的图表数量 k∈{1,3,6,9}，以控制视觉密度；并提出覆盖结构可靠性、重建完整性、可解析性和数值保真度的多维评估框架。
AI.result: 在五个近期 MLLM 上的实验表明，随着视觉密度增加，数值重建总体退化，且退化幅度在不同模型间差异显著；图表级配对比较显示，同一源图表嵌入更密集视觉语境时重建误差更高。
AI.conclusion: 视觉密度是 MLLM 图表数据重建中一个重要的、此前未被充分探索的因素，ChartDensity-Bench 为该场景下的模型鲁棒性评估提供了系统基准。

title: Does a Shared Temperature Imply a Shared Angular Scale in Probabilistic Contrastive Learning?
summary: In probabilistic contrastive learning, a shared temperature is commonly interpreted as a shared similarity scale, but this interpretation does not hold for high-dimensional distributional class representations. We study the exact von Mises-Fisher (vMF) probabilistic score used by ProCo when representation dimension and class concentration grow jointly. We prove that the score retains a class-dependent leading angular gain $g_c=A_c/τ$, where $A_c$ is the mean resultant length. This gain enters Softmax competition, pairwise decision boundaries, and feature gradients. On real CIFAR-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist representations, the theory accurately predicts boundary movements and local gradient changes under the full vMF score. Classwise temperature adjustment also changes the cosine-zero intercept and finite-dimensional response. We construct intercept-preserving and Pure Angular controls to separate the leading gain from these accompanying changes. Complete gain equalization yields a shared-scale cosine prototype rule at leading order; a finite-dimensional margin condition guarantees agreement of the two classifiers. Across 16 frozen representation settings, prediction agreement is 98.43-99.99%, with disagreements concentrated at small cosine margins. In controlled contrastive-only training with the training-frequency prior, Pure Angular editing improves both learned representations at all tested CIFAR-10/100 imbalance factors and retains positive changes on ImageNet-LT. Thus vMF concentration not only describes class distributions, but also forms a decision and learning scale in high-dimensional probabilistic contrastive learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维分布式类表示下vMF概率分数，证明其保留类依赖的主导角度增益，并在真实长尾数据集与对照训练中验证该增益塑造决策边界与特征学习尺度。
AI.motivation: 概率对比学习中常把共享温度解释为共享相似度尺度，但在高维分布式类表示下该解释不成立，需要澄清vMF分数中温度与类浓度的真实作用机制。
AI.method: 推导表示维度与类浓度联合增长时ProCo所用精确vMF概率分数的渐近形式，得到类依赖主导角度增益g_c=A_c/τ；构造保持截距与Pure Angular对照以分离该增益；给出有限维margin条件保证两种分类器一致。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-LT、ImageNet-LT、iNaturalist表示上理论准确预测边界移动与局部梯度变化；16个冻结表示设置下预测一致率98.43–99.99%，分歧集中于小余弦margin；Pure Angular编辑在CIFAR-10/100各不平衡因子下提升表示，并在ImageNet-LT保持正向变化。
AI.conclusion: vMF浓度不仅描述类分布，在高维概率对比学习中还构成决策与学习尺度，主导角度增益是连接温度、类浓度与决策规则的关键量。

title: How Accurate Is Accurate Enough?
summary: How accurate must a numerical approximation be within a learning system? Primitive error alone cannot answer this question: errors of the same magnitude can have very different consequences for losses, predictions, and gradients at different learning states. We study this question through the learning objective itself. The objective weights classwise numerical errors nonuniformly according to the current state, so the importance of an error depends not only on its magnitude but also on the class it affects and the weight that class receives. For softmax cross-entropy, we characterize this coupling between class weights and errors and derive the exact extrema of the signed loss change over pairings of fixed non-target probability and score-error multisets, with the target probability and target score error held fixed. Building on this structure, we establish finite-error guarantees that propagate primitive error to losses, probabilities, predictions, and feature gradients, then invert these guarantees to obtain a certified primitive tolerance for the current state under prescribed learning-level error requirements. We give a complete instantiation of the framework in high-dimensional von Mises-Fisher learning. Controlled interventions and a large collection of saved learning states show that identical primitive error can produce substantially different learning consequences, while certified numerical tolerances vary by orders of magnitude across states under the same learning-level requirements. These results show that the adequacy of a numerical approximation must be assessed in relation to the current learning state and the quantity to be preserved; numerical accuracy should itself be treated as part of the learning objective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习系统中数值近似的精度需求，从学习目标本身出发分析类别加权误差的耦合结构，给出有限误差保证与认证容差，并在高维von Mises-Fisher学习上验证。
AI.motivation: 原始误差（primitive error）本身无法回答"数值近似需要多精确"这一问题，因为相同量级的误差在不同学习状态下对损失、预测和梯度的影响差异很大。因此需要结合当前学习状态与被保留的量来评估数值近似的充分性。
AI.method: 通过学习目标研究该问题：目标函数按当前状态对各类别数值误差进行非均匀加权，故误差重要性取决于其量级、所影响类别及该类权重。针对softmax交叉熵，刻画类别权重与误差的耦合关系，在固定非目标概率与分数误差多重集配对下推导带符号损失变化的精确极值（固定目标概率与目标分数误差）。据此建立有限误差保证，将原始误差传播至损失、概率、预测与特征梯度，并反演出在给定学习级误差要求下当前状态的认证原始容差。在高维von Mises-Fisher学习中完整实例化该框架。
AI.result: 受控干预与大量保存的学习状态表明：相同原始误差可产生显著不同的学习后果；在相同学习级误差要求下，认证数值容差在不同状态间可相差数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 数值近似的充分性必须联系当前学习状态与需保留的量来评估；数值精度本身应被视为学习目标的一部分。

title: Same Loss, Different Gradients
summary: Differentiable learning typically assumes that the scalar objective evaluated in the forward pass and the gradient supplied to the optimizer in the backward pass describe the same mathematical object. We show that this correspondence can fail when probabilistic objectives rely on finite special-function recurrences, custom backward rules, and numerical clipping. In high-dimensional von Mises-Fisher learning, real numerical implementations can produce identical forward scores and losses at the same learning state while supplying different gradients and following different optimization trajectories. We characterize the structure of this mismatch in finite-start Bessel recurrence and show that classwise radial mismatch can compose through probabilities into a locally nonconservative update field. Evaluating the accuracy of special-function values and derivatives separately is therefore insufficient to characterize the realized learning objective. Motivated by this observation, we introduce AR/FR, a fixed-depth analytic realization that constructs a potential and its derivative jointly, ensuring forward-backward coherence by construction. We establish a uniform cubic-order error bound relative to the exact Bessel ratio over the entire nonnegative concentration axis and propagate this guarantee to learning scores and objectives. As representation dimension increases, the original finite recurrence becomes sequentially deeper, whereas the worst-case AR/FR error guarantee tightens cubically, jointly providing coherence, certified fidelity, and fixed-depth computation. These results suggest that a differentiable numerical primitive is defined by both the values it realizes and the derivatives it actually supplies to the optimizer; together, they constitute the numerical realization of the learning algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出可微学习中的一个潜在问题：前向传播计算的目标值与反向传播提供给优化器的梯度可能并不描述同一个数学对象。在高维von Mises-Fisher学习中，依赖于有限特殊函数递推、自定义反向规则和数值截断的概率目标会导致前向损失相同但梯度不同、优化轨迹分叉。作者提出AR/FR（固定深度解析实现），通过联合构造势函数及其导数，从构造上保证前向-反向一致性，并给出在整个非负集中度轴上相对于精确Bessel比值的均匀三次阶误差界，将其传播到学习得分和目标。结果表明，可微数值原语应由其实现的值与其实际提供的导数共同定义。
AI.motivation: 可微学习通常假设前向传播中评估的标量目标与反向传播中供给优化器的梯度描述同一数学对象。然而，当概率目标依赖有限特殊函数递推、自定义反向规则和数值截断时，这一对应关系可能失效。作者希望揭示并刻画这种前向-反向不一致性，并说明单独评估特殊函数值与导数的精度不足以刻画实际实现的学习目标，从而提出一种从构造上保证一致性的数值原语。
AI.method: 1. 在高维von Mises-Fisher学习设定下，构造并分析真实数值实现：同一学习状态下可产生相同前向得分与损失，却提供不同梯度并走向不同优化轨迹。2. 刻画有限起点Bessel递推中失配的结构，说明逐类径向失配可通过概率复合为局部非保守的更新场。3. 提出AR/FR（固定深度解析实现），联合构造势函数及其导数，使前向-反向一致性由构造保证。4. 建立相对于精确Bessel比值、在整个非负集中度轴上的均匀三次阶误差界，并将其传播到学习得分与目标。
AI.result: 作者证明：在有限起点Bessel递推中，类径向失配可经概率复合形成局部非保守更新场，导致相同前向损失对应不同梯度与优化轨迹；单独评估特殊函数值与导数的精度无法刻画实际学习目标。AR/FR构造保证前向-反向一致性，并获得相对于精确Bessel比值的均匀三次阶误差界，该保证可传播到学习得分和目标。随表示维度增加，原始有限递推顺序加深，而AR/FR的最坏情况误差保证按三次阶收紧，同时提供一致性、可认证保真度和固定深度计算。
AI.conclusion: 可微数值原语应由其实现的值以及其实际提供给优化器的导数共同定义，二者共同构成学习算法的数值实现。AR/FR通过联合构造势函数与其导数，实现前向-反向一致、误差可认证且计算深度固定，表明在高维概率学习中，梯度一致性应与数值精度同等对待。

title: LEARN-TS: LLM-Enhanced Alignment and Reconstruction with Normality Guidance for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Reconstruction errors in multivariate time-series anomaly detection may not reliably distinguish abnormal behavior from benign deviations. Language-derived semantics offer complementary context, but existing multimodal approaches may rely on time-associated paired textual information that is difficult to obtain consistently and is not provided by standard multivariate time-series anomaly detection benchmarks. This setting poses two challenges: (1) conditioning masked reconstruction on window-specific semantics without exposing exact numerical targets or anomaly-specific cues, and (2) using a window-independent concept of normality as a complementary semantic reference rather than an independent anomaly detector. We propose LLM-Enhanced Alignment and Reconstruction with Normality Guidance for Time Series (LEARN-TS), which uses a frozen language model to construct two role-separated semantic representations without requiring temporally paired external text. Window-specific observation semantics encode temporal and cross-variable context without exact numerical values to guide channel-shared patch-masked reconstruction. A fixed, dataset-agnostic normality prompt provides a window-independent semantic reference for aligning normal representations and estimating normality discrepancy. At inference, masking each temporal patch once yields timestamp-level reconstruction evidence, conditionally modulated by discrepancy from a separate unmasked view. Across four benchmarks, LEARN-TS achieves the highest mean performance in 13 of 16 dataset-metric comparisons. Controlled ablations examine observation conditioning, joint normality alignment and scoring, and reference content, showing dataset-dependent ranking benefits and modest average gains from semantic over random references.

AI.tldr: 提出LEARN-TS：用冻结语言模型构建角色分离的语义表示，无需时间配对文本，通过窗口观测语义引导掩码重建并借助数据集无关的正常性提示进行对齐与评分，在多变量时间序列异常检测中16项数据集-指标对比中的13项取得最高平均性能。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测中的重建误差难以可靠区分异常行为与良性偏差；语言语义可提供互补上下文，但现有多模态方法依赖难以稳定获取、且标准基准不提供的时间配对文本。该设定带来两个挑战：在不暴露精确数值目标或异常线索的前提下以窗口特定语义条件化掩码重建；以及将窗口无关的正常性概念用作互补语义参考而非独立异常检测器。
AI.method: LEARN-TS使用冻结语言模型构建两种角色分离的语义表示，无需时间配对外部文本。窗口特定观测语义编码时间与跨变量上下文但不含精确数值，用以引导通道共享的patch掩码重建；固定、数据集无关的正常性提示提供窗口无关的语义参考，用于对齐正常表示并估计正常性偏差。推理时对每个时间patch掩码一次得到时间戳级重建证据，并由来自独立未掩码视图的偏差进行条件调制。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，LEARN-TS在16项数据集-指标对比中的13项取得最高平均性能。受控消融考察了观测条件化、联合正常性对齐与评分以及参考内容，结果显示排序收益依赖数据集，语义参考相对随机参考带来适度平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 在缺少时间配对文本的标准多变量时间序列异常检测设定下，通过冻结语言模型构建角色分离语义（窗口观测语义与窗口无关正常性提示）并结合掩码重建与正常性偏差调制，可有效提升检测性能；语义参考较随机参考有增益但幅度有限，效果受数据集影响。

title: Explicit Trajectory Diversity for RL-Based Post-Training of LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often admit multiple high-quality solutions to the same task, differing in reasoning structure, tool-use pattern, or interaction trajectory. Yet existing notions of diversity in LLM post-training are mostly implicit, arising from general stochasticity and regularization mechanisms rather than explicitly targeting task-relevant behavioral variation. While such implicit diversity can be useful, it does not directly specify which forms of behavioral variation should be encouraged for a given task. In this work, we study explicit trajectory diversity in RL-based post-training for LLMs. Our key idea is to define diversity through user-specified, task-specific trajectory descriptors, which map each sampled trajectory to an interpretable behavioral representation, and then measure diversity as a set-level functional over the resulting descriptor matrix. Building on this formulation, we introduce Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization(TJPO), a single-policy framework that optimizes explicit diversity over sampled trajectory groups, avoiding the need for population-based policy training, and instantiate it within group-based policy optimization through trajectory-level learning signals. This design makes the diversity objective both interpretable and controllable. Experiments on Sokoban and ALFWorld show that TJPO improves task-specific trajectory diversity while maintaining competitive task performance. Descriptor and trajectory analyses show that the learned variation follows the specified behavioral dimensions and includes distinct successful strategies. Extra experiment results suggest that explicitly shaping trajectory diversity can help LLM agents satisfy user requirements and remain effective when task conditions change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出显式轨迹多样性（explicit trajectory diversity）的RL后训练方法，通过用户指定的任务相关轨迹描述符定义多样性，并设计TJPO实现单策略框架下的可控多样性优化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练中的多样性多为隐式产生（源于随机性与正则化），无法针对特定任务指定应鼓励何种行为变化，缺乏可解释性与可控性。
AI.method: 用用户指定的任务特定轨迹描述符将每条采样轨迹映射为可解释的行为表示，以描述符矩阵上的集合级泛函度量多样性；提出Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization (TJPO)，在采样轨迹组上优化显式多样性，无需基于种群的策略训练，并通过轨迹级学习信号融入基于组的策略优化。
AI.result: 在Sokoban与ALFWorld上，TJPO提升任务特定轨迹多样性且保持有竞争力的任务性能；描述符与轨迹分析表明所学变异符合指定的行为维度并包含不同的成功策略；额外实验显示显式塑造多样性有助于满足用户需求并在任务条件变化时保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式轨迹多样性可作为可解释、可控的优化目标，在单策略RL后训练框架（TJPO）中有效提升任务相关行为多样性，同时维持性能与鲁棒性。

title: Learning Chaos Without Seeing Chaos: Extrapolation of Global Dynamics in Autoregressive Transformers
summary: Autoregressive models are trained to predict a system's behavior one step at a time, and recursive generation allows the learned dynamics to unfold over long horizons. To what extent can such dynamics learned from local observations recover broader organization of an underlying system that was only partially observed during training? Here we study small autoregressive transformers trained from scratch on trajectories sampled from restricted parameter regimes of several non-linear dynamical systems, including logistic and sine maps, the Lorenz system, and the generalized Hopf system, with control parameters and state trajectories represented as sequences of continuous tokens. Under closed-loop evaluation at parameters far outside the training distribution, the models can recover self-similar period-doubling cascades, chaotic dynamics, and attractor structures with remarkable visual and numerical fidelity. For the logistic map, a transformer reproduces successive period doublings up to period 128, yielding a finite-order scaling ratio of 4.6687, matching the Feigenbaum constant to within $5\times10^{-4}$. We further investigate how these structures emerge over the course of training, and reveal with causal interventions how control-parameter information is processed through attention into state prediction and shapes the resulting closed-loop dynamics. These results suggest that a surprisingly narrow window into a system's local behavior may suffice for autoregressive transformers to generalize to its unseen global dynamical organization.

AI.tldr: 自回归Transformer仅用受限参数区间内的局部轨迹训练，即可在闭环外推中恢复非线性动力系统的全局组织，包括周期倍增级联、混沌与吸引子结构；逻辑斯蒂映射的标度比与Feigenbaum常数误差小于5×10⁻⁴。
AI.motivation: 探究一个核心问题：仅从部分观测到的局部动力学中学习到的自回归模型，能在多大程度上恢复底层系统的全局组织。这关系到自回归序列模型作为动力学学习器的外推与泛化极限。
AI.method: 从零训练小型自回归Transformer，在若干非线性动力系统（logistic映射、sine映射、Lorenz系统、广义Hopf系统）受限参数区间的轨迹上训练；控制参数与状态轨迹均以连续token序列表示。采用闭环评估，在远离训练分布的参数下递推生成，并通过训练过程追踪与因果干预分析控制参数信息如何经注意力流入状态预测并塑造闭环动力学。
AI.result: 在闭环外推设置下，模型能高保真（视觉与数值）恢复自相似周期倍增级联、混沌动力学与吸引子结构。logistic映射可复现连续周期倍增直至周期128，有限阶标度比4.6687，与Feigenbaum常数误差在5×10⁻⁴以内。因果干预揭示了控制参数信息经注意力进入状态预测的机制。
AI.conclusion: 对系统局部行为的一个极窄观测窗口，就足以让自回归Transformer泛化到其未见的全局动力学组织。这表明局部动力学学习可支撑全局结构的涌现式外推。

title: SparLeak: Privacy Leakage from Sparse Attention in LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
summary:
Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate long-context inference in modern large language models (LLMs), but its input-dependent execution behavior introduces previously unexplored privacy risks. We identify a new GPU micro-architectural side channel, termed Sparsity-Induced Memory Access (SIMA), which arises from secret-dependent key-value cache access patterns induced by sparse attention.
  Based on this observation, we present SparLeak, a phase-aware side-channel attack that extracts SIMA traces during LLM inference and enables two practical privacy extractions: query attribute inference from prefill-phase traces and autoregressive response reconstruction from decoding-phase traces. By reconstructing approximate token-level sparsity profiles from page-level observations and applying profiling-based learning, SparLeak accurately recovers sensitive information, including user-query attributes and private LLM response content. Extensive evaluation across three LLM architectures, three sparse attention mechanisms, and three privacy-sensitive datasets shows that SparLeak achieves average attack success rates of 90.9% for attribute inference and 87.3% for response reconstruction under real-world LLM serving settings, highlighting the significance to account for SIMA leakage when deploying sparse-attention-based LLM systems. We provide anonymized SIMA traces, trained attack models, evaluation scripts, and documentation as artifacts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Janus_artifacts/.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现稀疏注意力在长上下文推理中引入的隐私侧信道SIMA，并提出SparLeak攻击，可从预填充与解码阶段泄露查询属性与私密回复内容。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力被广泛用于加速现代大语言模型的长上下文推理，但其输入相关的执行行为可能带来此前未被探索的隐私风险，因此作者希望揭示并量化这一新型安全问题。
AI.method: 作者识别出一种由稀疏注意力导致的秘密相关键值缓存访问模式所产生的GPU微架构侧信道SIMA，并设计分阶段攻击SparLeak：在LLM推理时提取SIMA轨迹，将页级观测重建为近似token级稀疏度画像，并结合基于profiling的学习，实现预填充阶段的查询属性推断与解码阶段的自回归响应重构。
AI.result: 在三种LLM架构、三种稀疏注意力机制和三个隐私敏感数据集上的广泛评估表明，在真实LLM服务设置下，SparLeak对属性推断的平均攻击成功率达90.9%，对响应重构的平均成功率达87.3%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力会通过SIMA造成显著隐私泄露，部署基于稀疏注意力的LLM系统时必须考虑该风险；作者还发布了匿名化SIMA轨迹、训练好的攻击模型、评估脚本与文档等工件。

title: ReSCENE: Server-Side Replay for Structural Mitigation of Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Continual Learning
summary: Federated continual learning must integrate new tasks over time without losing earlier-task knowledge. Most existing methods attach an anti-forgetting mechanism to the client-trained, server-aggregated loop of federated learning, which holds back new learning to preserve earlier knowledge and burdens resource-constrained clients.
