AI.result: 统计模型拟合时间随序列数近似线性增长；机器学习中特征构建主导内存消耗；在固定训练预算下神经训练时间几乎与面板规模无关。在全部 42,840 条序列上完成多引擎稀疏调和，而稠密实现在此规模下内存耗尽。Nixtlaverse 已获得大量公开分发、学术复用，并被其他预测框架采用，以宽松开源许可发布，附带公开数据集、可复现示例与可验证基准产物。
AI.conclusion: 共享数据与输出契约的设计在保留各模型族专用实现灵活性的同时，显著降低了跨模型族的数据准备与评估成本，验证了其成本、边界与实用性；该生态具备良好的可复现性、开放性与实际采用度。

title: Validity-Preserving Hierarchical RL for Joint Routing and Switch Placement in EDA
summary: Routing and switch placement are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems in chip design, requiring the joint optimization of routing topology and physical placement under strict structural, geometric and logical constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on carefully engineered heuristics that incorporate strong problem-specific biases to navigate the enormous space of possible designs. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for joint routing and switch placement at the level of logical communication routes. Starting from a minimal routing graph, our method progressively constructs increasingly expressive solutions through three coupled operations: switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement. These operations preserve routing validity by construction, restricting exploration to feasible configurations where every communicating initiator-target pair has one assigned loop-free route. We explore the induced solution space using Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search, showing that neural-guided search substantially improves solution quality over non-learning optimization methods. Furthermore, pretraining across floorplans provides a strong initialization for fine-tuning on unseen instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层强化学习框架，用于芯片设计中布线拓扑与交换机放置的联合优化。方法从最小路由图出发，通过交换机扩展、交换机放置与路由精化三种耦合操作逐步构造解，并以Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索探索解空间，实现神经引导的高质量搜索。
AI.motivation: 布线（routing）与交换机放置（switch placement）是芯片设计中的核心组合优化问题，需要在结构、几何与逻辑约束下同时优化路由拓扑和物理布局。现有方法多依赖带有强问题偏置的人工启发式策略来应对庞大设计空间，泛化性与解质量受限，因此需要一种学习驱动的方法。
AI.method: 提出分层强化学习框架，在逻辑通信路由层面进行布线拓扑与交换机放置的联合优化。从最小路由图出发，通过三种耦合操作——交换机扩展、交换机放置、路由精化——渐进式构造表达能力更强的解；这些操作在构造上保持路由有效性，将探索限制在每个通信initiator-target对均有唯一无环路由的可行配置内。采用Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索（Gumbel MCTS）结合神经网络引导进行解空间探索。
AI.result: 神经引导的搜索在解质量上显著优于非学习的优化方法；此外，跨floorplan的预训练可为在未见实例上的微调提供强初始化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将分层强化学习与Gumbel MCTS相结合可有效求解芯片设计中联合布线与交换机放置问题，且预训练可提升跨floorplan的泛化与迁移能力。

title: How Does Local Landscape Geometry Evolve in Language Model Pre-Training?
summary: The scale and expense of pre-training language models make efficient hyperparameter tuning essential, yet a principled guidance is still missing. In this work, we analyze language model pre-training dynamics from a local landscape geometry perspective. Our study reveals two distinct phases. In Phase I, sharpness of the local landscape is initially high, leading to instability and loss plateaus under large learning rates (LRs). The landscape shifts from sharp to flatter regions early in training. This dynamic explains the necessity of LR warmup and further suggests that larger peak LRs require proportionally longer warmup periods. In Phase II, the local landscape is governed by the gradient noise scale. Our theory identifies a depth flatness trade-off: high noise from smaller batches widens the loss basin, whereas reduced noise from larger batches deepens it. This theory motivates a dynamic batch-size (BS) scheduler that begins with a small BS and increases it late in training. Together, we provide a unified view of loss landscape evolution, which translates into actionable tuning strategies for large-scale pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部损失景观几何视角分析语言模型预训练动力学，将其划分为两个阶段：第一阶段景观从尖锐转向平坦，解释了LR warmup的必要性及峰值LR与warmup长度的比例关系；第二阶段景观由梯度噪声尺度主导，揭示深度-平坦性权衡，据此提出由小到大的动态批次大小调度策略，为大规模预训练提供统一的调参指导。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型规模大、成本高，高效超参数调优至关重要，但缺乏有原则性的指导。作者希望从损失景观几何角度为超参数（学习率、warmup、批次大小）选择提供理论基础。
AI.method: 从局部景观几何角度分析预训练动力学：考察局部尖锐度的演化以及梯度噪声尺度对景观的支配作用，并结合理论分析阶段划分与深度-平坦性权衡。
AI.result: 发现两阶段现象：阶段I中局部尖锐度初始较高，大学习率下导致不稳定与损失平台，景观早期由尖锐转为平坦；阶段II中景观由梯度噪声尺度支配，理论识别出深度-平坦性权衡——小批次的高噪声拓宽损失盆地，大批次的低噪声加深盆地。
AI.conclusion: 提供了损失景观演化的统一视角，并转化为可操作的调参策略：较大峰值LR需按比例延长warmup；采用从小批次开始、训练后期增大的动态BS调度。

title: Riemannian Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning for Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
summary: Crystal structure governs material properties, making crystal structure prediction (CSP) a fundamental problem in materials science. Generative models are a promising approach for solving this problem, but the prevalence of polymorphism, coupled with large unit cells and complex packing geometry, makes the molecular CSP task challenging for existing models. To address this, we introduce Coarse-Grained Open Materials Generation (CG-OMatG), an equivariant Riemannian flow-based generative model. CG-OMatG predicts molecular crystal structures \textit{via} a coarse-grained, hierarchical representation. CG-OMatG treats molecules as rigid bodies---performing both inter- and intra-molecular message passing to construct a geometric representation for molecular packings---and learns to reconstruct molecule centroid positions, orientations, and lattice parameters, conditioned on chemical species and conformer geometry. We train the model on subsets of the Open Molecular Crystals (OMC25) and Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) datasets. Further, we fine-tune the model \textit{via} policy gradient reinforcement learning to steer the model towards generating low-energy candidate structures. We validate the generated structures on the CSP blind test benchmark, assessing agreement with experimentally determined crystals using COMPACK packing-similarity analysis. CG-OMatG exhibits strong performance for generative molecular crystal structure prediction, paving the way for accelerated polymorph screening and organic solid-state materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出CG-OMatG，一种等变黎曼流生成模型，通过粗粒化层次表示预测分子晶体结构。
AI.motivation: 晶体结构决定材料性质，分子晶体结构预测（CSP）是材料科学的基础难题。生成模型虽有前景，但多晶型普遍存在、晶胞大、堆积几何复杂，使分子CSP任务对现有模型仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 构建等变黎曼流（Riemannian flow）生成模型CG-OMatG：将分子视为刚体，进行分子间与分子内消息传递以构造分子堆积的几何表示；学习在化学物种与构象几何条件下，重建分子质心位置、取向和晶格参数。模型在OMC25与CSD数据子集上训练，并通过策略梯度强化学习微调，引导生成低能候选结构。
AI.result: 在CSP盲测基准上验证生成结构，使用COMPACK堆积相似性分析评估与实验测定晶体的一致性，CG-OMatG在生成式分子晶体结构预测中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: CG-OMatG为加速多晶型筛选和有机固态材料发现提供了有效途径。

title: GraphMAS: A Systematic Benchmark of Multi-Agent Coordination for Graph Learning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate specialized reasoning through aggregation, interaction, and adaptive control, yet their potential for graph learning remains unexplored. Graph learning is a natural setting for such systems because useful evidence may arise from heterogeneous local, long-range, global structural, and semantic perspectives whose relevance varies across instances. Existing LLM-based graph learning approaches primarily rely on single-agent reasoning, while multi-agent coordination has been studied mainly in general reasoning settings. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multiple specialized agents can improve graph learning and how coordination strategies should be designed and evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMAS, a systematic benchmark of multi-agent coordination for graph learning. GraphMAS builds a shared pool of graph reasoning specialists and organizes coordination along two dimensions, inter-agent interaction and runtime adaptivity, yielding four paradigms and seven representative coordination methods. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate these methods across seven text-attributed graphs, three domains, and two graph learning tasks. We find that heterogeneous graph perspectives are complementary, and that coordinating specialists improves over individual specialists and single-agent graph reasoning, with gains from decomposing reasoning across specialists rather than from broader evidence access alone. However, richer inter-agent interaction does not reliably help, whereas instance-adaptive specialist selection yields the strongest accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We further show that coordination can be learned over a fixed specialist pool and transfers to held-out graphs. GraphMAS therefore provides a controlled evaluation framework and empirical principles for understanding when and how multi-agent coordination benefits graph learning.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphMAS基准，系统评估多智能体协调在图学习中的效果，发现异质专家协调优于单智能体，实例自适应专家选择取得最佳精度-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统通过聚合、交互与自适应控制协调专用推理，但其在图学习中的潜力尚未被探索。图学习天然适合该设定：有用证据可能来自异质的局部、长程、全局结构与语义视角，其相关性因实例而异。现有基于LLM的图学习方法主要依赖单智能体推理，多智能体协调主要在通用推理场景研究，因此多专用智能体能否提升图学习、协调策略如何设计与评估仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构建GraphMAS，一个面向图学习的多智能体协调系统性基准。建立共享的图推理专家池，沿两个维度组织协调：智能体间交互与运行时自适应，形成四种范式、七种代表性协调方法。在统一协议下，跨七个文本属性图、三个领域、两类图学习任务进行评估。
AI.result: 异质图视角具有互补性；协调专用专家优于单个专家和单智能体图推理，增益来自将推理分解到多个专家而非仅扩大证据访问。更丰富的智能体间交互并不稳定带来帮助，而实例自适应的专家选择取得最强的精度-效率权衡。协调可在固定专家池上学习，并能迁移到留出图。
AI.conclusion: GraphMAS提供了受控评估框架与实证原则，用于理解多智能体协调何时以及如何有益于图学习。

title: CORD: Learning Reusable Degradation Representations Across Heterogeneous Physical Systems
summary: Can heterogeneous physical degradation systems benefit from joint pretraining and move beyond system-specific prognostics toward reusable cross-system representation learning? CORD combines type-specific observation interfaces with a shared degradation backbone. Its two self-supervised objectives learn at complementary scales: Intra-Observation Structure Modeling (ISM) captures structure within observations, while Inter-Observation Dynamics Modeling (IDM) captures latent degradation evolution across observation histories. We evaluate CORD under two transfer boundaries: Pretraining-Included System Types, where downstream datasets and held-out units are unseen but their system types are represented during source pretraining, and Pretraining-Excluded System Types, where the entire turbofan-engine type is absent from pretraining. Across bearings, batteries, and cutting tools, CORD (Multi-domain) consistently improves over CORD (Single-domain) under Frozen adaptation, provides further gains under Full FT in most settings, and remains competitive with representative external baselines. Source-pretrained initialization also improves low-label adaptation to the pretraining-excluded engine type. Frozen-representation analysis further shows improved cross-unit lifecycle consistency after multi-domain pretraining. Joint pretraining across heterogeneous physical systems thus produces degradation representations reusable across devices, datasets, and system types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORD框架，通过在多类物理退化系统上联合预训练，学习可跨设备、数据集与系统类型复用的退化表征。
AI.motivation: 异构物理退化系统之间存在显著差异，既有方法多局限于单一系统或系统特定预测，难以验证联合预训练能否带来收益并实现跨系统可复用表征。
AI.method: CORD将类型专属的观测接口与共享退化骨干网络结合，并设计两个互补尺度的自监督目标：观测内结构建模（ISM）捕捉单次观测内部结构，观测间动态建模（IDM）捕捉观测历史中的潜在退化演化。评估设定两类迁移边界：预训练包含系统类型（下游数据集与留出单元未见但类型已出现）与预训练排除系统类型（整类涡轮风扇发动机类型完全缺席预训练）。
AI.result: 在轴承、电池与切削刀具上，CORD（多域）在Frozen适配下稳定优于CORD（单域），多数设置下Full FT进一步提升，并与代表性外部基线保持竞争力；源域预训练初始化也改善了向被排除的发动机类型的低标签适配；冻结表征分析显示多域预训练后跨单元生命周期一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 跨异构物理系统的联合预训练能够产生可跨设备、数据集和系统类型复用的退化表征，向通用退化表征学习迈出一步。

title: Pseudo-Label-Triggered Retraining from Forecast Errors for Online Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series forecasting systems operate under non-stationary data streams, where forecasting performance may degrade over time. Although retraining can recover the performance, it incurs non-trivial computational and operational costs. Under limited deployment resources, the key challenge is therefore not only how to retrain but also when to retrain. While existing retraining policies often rely on indirect indicators such as drift alarms or model staleness, we instead use realized forecast errors as direct deployment feedback. In this paper, we propose PILOT (Pseudo-label-Informed Learned Online Trigger), an online retraining framework that learns when to retrain from forecast-error dynamics. Since ground-truth retraining labels are unavailable, PILOT constructs a pseudo-label from future increases in forecast error and trains a lightweight scorer to predict it from observed error states. At deployment, PILOT uses only completed forecast errors and serves as a plug-in module for arbitrary forecasting backbones without architectural modification. We evaluate PILOT under standard multivariate forecasting settings across eight benchmarks with three representative backbones---DLinear, iTransformer, and TimesNet. Across all three backbones, PILOT achieves state-of-the-art average-rank performance among retraining policies while maintaining a favorable performance--efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PILOT，一种基于预测误差动态的在线重训练触发框架，用伪标签训练轻量评分器决定何时重训练。
AI.motivation: 现实时间序列预测面临非平稳数据流，性能会随时间退化；重训练虽能恢复性能但计算与运营成本高。资源受限下核心挑战是"何时重训练"，而现有策略多依赖漂移报警或模型陈旧度等间接指标。
AI.method: PILOT（Pseudo-label-Informed Learned Online Trigger）以已实现的预测误差作为直接部署反馈。由于缺乏真实重训练标签，从未来预测误差的上升构造伪标签，训练一个轻量评分器从观测到的误差状态预测该伪标签。部署时仅使用已完成的预测误差，可作为插件模块接入任意预测骨干，无需修改架构。
AI.result: 在标准多变量预测设定下，于八个基准数据集和三种代表性骨干（DLinear、iTransformer、TimesNet）上评估。在三种骨干上，PILOT在重训练策略中均取得最优平均排名，并保持较好的性能—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 以预测误差动态驱动的学习式在线触发机制可有效决定重训练时机，跨骨干与基准具备通用性和效率优势。

title: TopTimeNet: Topologically-assisted time-series classification model
summary: Distinguishing periodic from chaotic dynamics in a time series is a fundamental challenge in both physics and engineering. Yet, end-to-end learned architectures must discover both a representation and a decision boundary from data, at substantial cost. We introduce TopTimeNet, which decouples these tasks: a fixed, non-learned stage extracts a $42$-dimensional geometric and topological descriptor from Takens delay embeddings and persistent homology, and a lightweight learnable stage performs classification. On a benchmark of $49$ nonlinear dynamical systems, a $1{,}638$-parameter configuration matches the mean accuracy of one with $33\times$ more trainable parameters. Additionally, this approach delivers mean accuracy comparable to convolutional neural networks and surpasses the average performance of converged Transformer models, while requiring three to four orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters. Robustness also depends sharply on where noise is introduced: TopTimeNet degrades gracefully under perturbations to its precomputed features, but degrades sharply when noise is introduced into the raw signal and the full feature-extraction pipeline is recomputed, showing that robustness to perturbations of the precomputed features does not imply robustness of the complete raw-signal-to-prediction pipeline. These results show that decoupling fixed geometric and topological feature construction from a lightweight discriminative stage can achieve comparable classification accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出 TopTimeNet：用固定的几何/拓扑特征提取（Takens 延迟嵌入 + 持续同调，42 维描述子）解耦表征学习，仅用轻量可学习分类器区分周期与混沌动力学，以极少参数达到与 CNN 相当、超越收敛 Transformer 平均水平的精度。
AI.motivation: 从时间序列中区分周期与混沌动力学是物理与工程中的基础问题。端到端学习架构必须同时从数据中发现表征与决策边界，代价高昂（参数多、训练成本大）。作者希望将“特征构造”与“分类决策”解耦，以降低可学习参数量并保持精度。
AI.method: TopTimeNet 分两阶段：固定、非学习的阶段基于 Takens 延迟嵌入与持续同调提取 42 维几何与拓扑描述子；随后由轻量可学习阶段完成分类。在 49 个非线性动力系统基准上评测，并进行参数规模对比（1638 参数 vs. 33 倍参数配置）、与 CNN、收敛 Transformer 比较，以及不同噪声注入位置的鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: 1638 参数配置的平均精度与参数量多 33 倍的配置相当；平均精度与 CNN 相当，并超过收敛 Transformer 模型的平均表现，而可训练参数少三到四个数量级。鲁棒性依赖噪声注入位置：对预计算特征加扰时性能平滑下降，但将噪声注入原始信号并重跑完整特征提取流程时性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 将固定的几何与拓扑特征构造与轻量判别阶段解耦，可在显著更少可训练参数下取得可比的分类精度；同时表明“对预计算特征扰动的鲁棒性”并不蕴含“完整原始信号到预测流程的鲁棒性”。

title: Finite-Horizon Fisher Memory in Two-Sided Power-Bounded Recurrent Systems
summary: We analyse allocation, admission and post-write retention in finite-horizon linear-Gaussian noisy recurrent memories. At every horizon, the directional Fisher memory $M_n$ satisfies $\operatorname{tr}M_n=N$: non-normality redistributes information but cannot raise its spherical average, while normal carriers satisfy $M_n=I$. For bi-power-bounded carriers, we derive uniform $1/n$ lag bounds, identify the limit of $M_n$ with the inverse of the classical Cesàro asymptotic limit of $W^\top$, and give finite-horizon error bounds. A time-varying coupling defines an end-to-end store operator. The writer-optimal direction need not be store-optimal. After writing ends, an invertible hold preserves the full stored Fisher matrix. Additive contamination bounded by $α$ times the closure covariance retains at least $1/(1+α)$ of that matrix; a covariance-aware decoder attains the corresponding accuracy. With recurrent carriers held fixed, training input masks and linear readouts approached the task-specific optimum in 160 runs, with median normalized Rayleigh efficiency above $0.998$. Binary accuracy matched the Gaussian prediction to mean absolute error below $0.002$ over more than four orders of magnitude in $J$. In a separate pre-specified study of 320 runs, trained masks followed the designated input-time objective in both carrier types, in 16 of 16 draws. These studies used development-seen carriers and are pre-specified validations, not blind holdouts. The same fixed design reproduced the objective-specific result in 16 of 16 draws on carriers unused before run commitment. Exact isolation preserved information, while a decoder fixed at its training horizon fell to chance; inverse-adjoint transport restored its sampled decisions to numerical precision.

AI.tldr: 该文分析有限时域线性高斯噪声循环记忆中的分配、写入与写后保持问题，给出Fisher记忆的方向性界、污染鲁棒性界及掩码/读出训练的预注册验证结果。
AI.motivation: 理解循环记忆在有限时域下如何分配、写入并保持信息，以及非正态性、污染与训练掩码对信息保持和读出精度的影响。
AI.method: 利用方向Fisher记忆M_n及其迹恒等式，分析双幂有界载体的1/n滞后界与M_n极限（与W^⊤的Cesàro渐近极限之逆相关）并给出有限时域误差界；定义端到端store算子，分析可逆保持、加性污染界及协方差感知解码器；并以固定循环载体做预注册的掩码与线性读出训练实验。
AI.result: tr M_n=N，非正态性仅重分配信息而无法提升球面均值，正规载体满足M_n=I；污染不超过α倍闭包协方差时至少保留1/(1+α)的Fisher矩阵；160次运行中掩码与读出接近任务最优，中位归一化Rayleigh效率>0.998，二分类精度与高斯预测的平均绝对误差<0.002（跨四个数量级J）；320次运行的独立预注册研究中16/16次遵循指定输入时间目标；精确隔离保持信息，而固定于训练时域的译码器降至随机水平，逆伴随传输将采样决策恢复到数值精度。
AI.conclusion: 有限时域循环记忆的信息容量球形均值受tr M_n=N约束，非正态性只能重分配而非提升；写后保持与污染鲁棒性存在可证界；训练掩码与读出可稳定达到任务特定最优，且逆伴随传输能恢复时序错配译码器精度。

title: RATIO: Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization for Quantized Reasoning Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a widely adopted technique for reducing the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal that when applied to reasoning models, PTQ not only degrades reasoning performance but also exacerbates overthinking, leading to longer reasoning trajectories. These issues may offset the efficiency gains expected from lower-precision inference. Existing approaches mainly rely on complex optimization procedures. More recent lightweight inference strategies instead use predefined overthinking markers, limiting their adaptability across quantized models. To address these issues, we propose Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization (RATIO), a framework that identifies model-specific overthinking tokens and assigns each a tailored penalty. RATIO first introduces Quantization-aware Reasoning Behavior Analysis (QRBA) to identify overthinking tokens by analyzing discrepancies between full-precision and quantized models. It then adopts Token-Specific Penalty Determination (TSPD), which leverages full-precision guidance to derive token-specific penalties without additional training. Extensive experiments show that RATIO achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than existing token-level interventions. Specifically, RATIO achieves up to 9.8 points accuracy improvement and reduces chain-of-thought (CoT) length by up to 51.3% compared with quantized baselines. The code will be available at https://github.com/steven-bao1/RATIO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RATIO框架，通过识别量化模型特有的过度思考token并施加定制化惩罚，在推理模型的后训练量化中实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）虽可降低大语言模型的显存占用与推理成本，但应用于推理模型时会损害推理性能并加剧"过度思考"，导致推理轨迹变长，抵消了低精度推理的效率收益。现有方法依赖复杂优化流程，而近期轻量推理策略使用预定义的过度思考标记，难以适配不同的量化模型。
AI.method: 提出RATIO（推理分析与Token级推理优化）框架，核心包括两部分：一是量化感知推理行为分析（QRBA），通过分析全精度与量化模型之间的差异来识别过度思考token；二是Token特定惩罚确定（TSPD），利用全精度模型指导推导token特定的惩罚，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RATIO在精度-效率权衡上优于现有token级干预方法：相比量化基线，精度最高提升9.8个点，同时将思维链（CoT）长度最多缩短51.3%。
AI.conclusion: RATIO通过模型特定的过度思考token识别与定制化惩罚，有效缓解量化推理模型的过度思考问题，在不增加训练成本的前提下实现精度提升与推理长度压缩的双重收益。

title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation on Time Series Representations
summary: Source-Free Universal Domain Adaptation (SF-UniDA) extends Universal Domain Adaptation by removing access to source data at adaptation time while still handling label-set mismatches between domains. Despite growing interest in this setting for image data, no benchmark exists for time series, which are more challenging. We present the first SF-UniDA benchmark on time series. In addition, we provide the first study of pretrained foundation models as feature extractors for time series domain adaptation. In this context, we identify a critical and previously underexplored limitation of all existing SF-UniDA methods: the inference threshold for unknown-sample rejection is highly sensitive. We address this by proposing a plug-in auto-thresholding module that can be integrated into any SF-UniDA method. Experiments on three well-known time series datasets confirm the suitability of this module. They also highlight that foundation models do not systematically outperform classical backbones and that SF-UniDA tailored for time series is yet to be developed.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个面向时间序列的SF-UniDA基准，并首次将预训练基础模型作为时序域适应特征提取器进行研究；作者指出所有现有SF-UniDA方法对未知样本拒识的推理阈值高度敏感，提出可插拔的自动阈值模块予以解决。实验在三类时序数据集上验证了模块有效性，并发现基础模型并未系统性优于经典骨干网络，时序SF-UniDA仍有待发展。
AI.motivation: 源自由通用域适应（SF-UniDA）在适应阶段无法访问源数据且需处理域间标签集不匹配，虽在图像领域受到关注，但时间序列领域尚无基准；时序数据本身更具挑战性，同时基础模型作为时序域适应特征提取器的效果尚不明确。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个时间序列SF-UniDA基准；2) 首次系统研究预训练基础模型作为时序域适应特征提取器；3) 识别现有SF-UniDA方法共有的关键缺陷——未知样本拒识的推理阈值敏感；4) 提出可插入任意SF-UniDA方法的自动阈值（auto-thresholding）模块。
AI.result: 在三个知名时间序列数据集上的实验证实了自动阈值模块的适用性；结果显示预训练基础模型并未系统性地优于经典骨干网络，说明针对时间序列定制的SF-UniDA方法尚未成熟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了时间序列SF-UniDA评测空白，揭示了推理阈值敏感性这一普遍问题并提出通用解决方案；同时表明基础模型在时序域适应中优势不具普遍性，时序专属SF-UniDA方法是未来重要方向。

title: Backward-State Policy Is Part of the Learning Algorithm
summary: Low-precision training rounds tensors that the backward pass reads again, often for several gradients; each use can read the forward's rounded value, the original, or a new random rounding. This backward-state policy looks like a memory and precision detail, settled by copy accuracy and final loss. We argue that it is part of the learning algorithm, and that neither check shows whether it is right. Copy accuracy does not decide the outcome: in three pairs of 390M runs with an emulated FP8 backward, training fails when attention's backward reuses the forward's rounded output and succeeds with a new rounding from the same distribution. Even the most accurate copy, the original itself, can be wrong by our reference: the gradient of the forward pass as it actually ran, with gradients passed through rounding unchanged. For example, a normalization output stored in low precision feeds two gradients: the gain's gradient needs the original, but the next layer's weight gradient needs the rounded value that layer multiplied. Final loss, the other check, does not rule out the error of reading the original for both: it persists in models trained with such a store, while planned loss comparisons stay within a margin fixed in advance. We therefore derive from this reference which value each use must read, or which substitute gives the same gradient on average with the forward held fixed, and check these per-use requirements on single operators, without training. In three tests using PyTorch and Transformer Engine, the requirements predicted beforehand whether reuse changes what the backward computes on average relative to an independent copy, and every prediction held. Backward-state policy is thus part of the learning algorithm: it should be specified and checked use by use, not settled by copy accuracy and final loss.

AI.tldr: 论文指出低精度训练中"反向状态策略"（backward 中复用前向舍入值的规则）属于学习算法的一部分，不能仅凭 copy 精度和最终 loss 判断其对错，并提出基于参考梯度（真实前向+舍入直通）的逐次使用(per-use)规范与单算子检验方法。
AI.motivation: 现有做法把反向流程复用低精度张量的策略视为内存与精度细节，用"拷贝精度"和"最终 loss"两项检验来判定其好坏，缺乏理论依据。作者认为这两项检验都无法真正揭示该策略是否会导致反向计算结果错误，因此需要重新界定该问题的性质。
AI.method: 作者构造参考基准：以"前向实际运行结果、梯度经舍入后原样传递"作为正确梯度。据此推导每次反向使用张量时应读取哪个值（前向舍入值、原始值或新随机舍入），或确定哪种替代值在固定前向时能在期望上给出相同梯度。随后在单个算子层面对这些 per-use 要求进行验证，无需重新训练，并在 PyTorch 与 Transformer Engine 上做三组测试。
AI.result: copy 精度不决定结果：三对 390M 参数模型、模拟 FP8 反向的实验中，注意力反向复用前向舍入输出会训练失败，而使用同分布的新随机舍入则成功。即便最精确的拷贝（原值本身）也可能错误，例如低精度存储的归一化输出需同时喂给两个梯度——gain 的梯度需原值，而下一层权重梯度需该层实际相乘的舍入值。最终 loss 也无法排除"两处都读原值"的错误，该错误在模型中持续存在，且计划好的 loss 对比仍落在预设误差范围。三组测试中，事先给出的预测均正确判断复用是否会相对独立拷贝改变反向的平均计算结果，预测全部成立。
AI.conclusion: 反向状态策略是学习算法的一部分，应逐次使用地明确规定并检查，而不能由拷贝精度和最终 loss 来裁定。作者提出的参考梯度与 per-use 检验为这一规范提供了可操作的方法。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Prefix-Invariant Realizations of Low-Precision Fast Matrix Multiplication
summary: Fast matrix multiplication saves multiplications through exact cancellation, but rounding sums that mix token rows can leave contributions from later tokens in earlier language model outputs. This threatens prefix invariance, which multiple-choice likelihood scoring relies on: a scored likelihood must depend only on its allowed prefix. On Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, two fast FP8 realizations repaired to ordinary-looking accuracy still change the answers chosen by likelihood on 5.83% and 10.00% of 240 OpenBookQA items when only the text after the allowed prefix is replaced with the bf16 model's own greedy continuation. Both row-local controls, the bf16 model and a deployed FP8 matrix multiplication kernel, change none. Accuracy thus does not certify prefix invariance, and the stability criteria we analyze cannot tell realizations apart: across all 512 sign variants of two-level Strassen they stay constant while teacher-forced perplexities span a 772.4$\times$ range on the same model. We therefore construct certified realizations of two-level Strassen on bounded integer codes that quantize token rows independently, then mix and cancel exactly before rescaling, using 49 block multiplications instead of 64. Our certificate guarantees bitwise equality to a prescribed row-local classical int8 operator at the same quantization specification, so every certified realization inherits its prefix invariance. Certification thus turns realization choice into a pure cost decision: which certified realization runs can no longer change a single scored likelihood.

AI.tldr: 快速矩阵乘法通过精确抵消节省乘法，但混合 token 行的舍入可破坏前缀不变性；作者构建了可认证的两级 Strassen 实现（49 次块乘法、int8 量化、位级等价），从而消除实现选择对评分似然的影响。
AI.motivation: 多项选择评分依赖前缀不变性——似然只应取决于允许的前缀。快速矩阵乘法依赖精确抵消，若对混合 token 行的求和进行舍入，后续 token 的贡献可能泄漏到更早的输出中，破坏该性质。而准确率指标无法认证前缀不变性：两个修复到"正常"准确率的快速 FP8 实现在替换前缀后文本时仍改变 5.83% 和 10.00% 的 OpenBookQA 答案，行局部对照（bf16 模型、已部署 FP8 内核）则不变；且现有稳定性判据无法区分实现，512 个两级 Strassen 符号变体中判据恒定，而教师强制困惑度跨越 772.4 倍。
AI.method: 在有界整数编码上构造两级 Strassen 的可认证实现：对 token 行独立量化，混合与抵消在精确整数域完成后再重新缩放，使用 49 次块乘法替代 64 次。证书保证其与相同量化规格下规定的行局部经典 int8 算子位级相等，因此每个可认证实现都继承其前缀不变性。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上，两个快速 FP8 实现（修复后准确率正常）在 240 个 OpenBookQA 条目上分别改变 5.83% 与 10.00% 的似然选择答案，而行局部对照（bf16、已部署 FP8 内核）改变为 0；512 个 Strassen 符号变体的稳定性判据恒定而教师强制困惑度跨 772.4 倍；所提出的认证实现以 49 次块乘法达到与行局部 int8 算子位级相等。
AI.conclusion: 准确率不能认证前缀不变性，已有稳定性判据也无法区分实现。可认证实现把实现选择变为纯成本决策：运行哪个可认证实现不再能改变任何单个评分似然。

title: Should I stay or should I show? Learning to selectively disclose information
summary: In many high-stakes settings, human decision-makers can acquire support information before making a decision. However, acquiring information is costly, and disclosure may fail to improve human decisions or may even impair them. We tackle this problem by studying selective disclosure, i.e., the problem of learning when to reveal support information to a human decision-maker under a budget constraint. We first show that the optimal policy is a threshold rule on the Value of Information (VoI), i.e., the expected reduction in human decision risk induced by disclosure. Since VoI is unknown in practice, we estimate the regime-specific human risks and bound the possible degradation of the resulting plug-in policy relative to lack of disclosure, as well as its regret relative to the optimal policy. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that selective disclosure outperforms both no disclosure and full disclosure, regardless of whether the support information is beneficial or harmful. Two user studies show that human-AI team performance can improve when disclosure is led by our learned policy and not human-selected, although this advantage varies across tasks. A counterfactual benchmark, which replaces participants' predictions with a machine-learning prediction when disclosure occurs, suggests that these differences might depend on lower adherence to advice when the information is automatically provided rather than self-requested.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"选择性披露"问题：在预算约束下学习何时向人类决策者披露辅助信息，证明最优策略是关于信息价值(VoI)的阈值规则，并提出可估计的plug-in策略及理论界，实验与用户研究表明其优于不披露和完全披露。
AI.motivation: 在医疗、金融等高 stakes 场景中，人类决策前可获取辅助信息，但信息获取有成本，且披露未必改善甚至可能损害人类决策，因此需要决定"何时披露"。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为预算约束下的选择性披露：先证明最优策略是对信息价值(VoI，即披露带来的期望风险降低)的阈值规则；由于VoI实际未知，转而估计各情境(regime)下的人类风险，并给出plug-in策略相对于不披露的退化上界及相对于最优策略的regret界。采用基准数据集实验、两项用户研究和反事实基准验证。
AI.result: 基准数据集实验显示选择性披露优于不披露和完全披露，无论辅助信息是有益还是有害；两项用户研究表明由学习策略而非人类自选决定披露时，人机团队表现可提升，但优势因任务而异；反事实基准(披露时用机器学习预测替代参与者预测)提示差异可能源于自动提供信息时对建议的依从性较低。
AI.conclusion: 选择性披露可通过VoI阈值规则在预算约束下有效提升人机协作决策，但收益依赖于任务特性及决策者对所提供信息的依从程度，自动披露可能因降低依从性而削弱其优势。

title: RainAtlas: A Multi-Continental Dataset for Precipitation Downscaling
summary: Extreme rainfall events are increasing in intensity and frequency as climate change accelerates. While kilometer-scale precipitation forecasts are critical for supporting local decision-making, the limited availability of high-resolution precipitation observations hinders their accuracy, especially in under-resourced regions. Machine learning models are widely used to downscale precipitation data to km-scale, but their application to unseen geographies presents challenges. First, processing raw high-resolution precipitation datasets across regions requires significant engineering and domain expertise. Second, generalization across regions remains difficult. To help overcome these barriers, we release RainAtlas, a large-scale, ML-ready and multi-continental dataset for precipitation downscaling. Covering three continents, RainAtlas harmonizes heterogeneous hourly km-scale observations to a common 2-km grid. Each regional partition contains around 210,000 aligned low- and high-resolution precipitation pairs, respectively from ERA5 reanalysis and direct observations. We benchmark state-of-the-art ML-based downscaling models across RainAtlas using a wide range of metrics. Our evaluation reveals substantial variance in out-of-domain generalization depending on the training regions. This underscores the need for cross-regional, multi-source km-scale evaluation, establishing RainAtlas as a well-positioned benchmark for precipitation downscaling research.

AI.tldr: RainAtlas：面向降水降尺度的大规模、多大陆、ML就绪数据集，统一2公里网格并评测跨区域泛化。
AI.motivation: 气候变化下极端降水增强，km级降水预报对地方决策至关重要，但高分辨率降水观测稀缺（尤其资源匮乏地区）制约预报精度；现有ML降尺度模型在未见过地理区域应用存在两大障碍：跨区域处理原始高分辨率数据的工程与领域门槛高，以及跨区域泛化能力差。
AI.method: 发布RainAtlas数据集：覆盖三大洲，将异构的小时级km尺度观测统一到2公里公共网格；每个区域分区包含约21万对对齐的低分辨率与高分辨率降水样本，分别来自ERA5再分析与直接观测；并用多种指标对最先进ML降尺度模型进行基准评测。
AI.result: 基准评测显示，域外泛化性能因训练区域不同而存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 凸显跨区域、多源km级评测的必要性，RainAtlas可作为降水降尺度研究的合适基准。

title: Fast Regularized Policy Mirror Descent with One-Step TD Updates
summary: Policy mirror descent (PMD) enjoys fast convergence in regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs), but existing guarantees often rely on exact or increasingly accurate policy evaluation. We analyze PMD coupled with a persistent critic advanced by one temporal-difference (TD) update. For finite discounted MDPs, we establish global linear convergence in value for exact coordinate-wise Bellman updates, with any positive constant actor stepsize and arbitrary finite critic initialization. The proof combines a resolvent-based auxiliary distribution with a decaying Bellman-violation correction and a potential weighted by inverse coordinate weights. We then study stochastic TD-PMD with general strongly convex mirror maps under a single off-policy Markov trajectory. With suitably chosen constant stepsizes and a finite-batch TD update, the method achieves an expected value gap of $ε$ after $\widetilde{O}(1/((1-γ)^5 \widetildeσ_b ε))$ transitions. The stochastic analysis relies on the trajectory-wise Lipschitz continuity of the regularizer, derived from uniform bounds on vertex Bregman divergences, together with a visitation-weighted resolvent estimate for signed critic-error propagation that yields an inverse-linear dependence on behavior coverage $\widetildeσ_b$. In contrast to many prior guarantees for regularized policy optimization, our sample-complexity guarantee holds without trajectory resets, generative-model access, or nested policy-evaluation loops. Numerical results are consistent with the theoretical convergence analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文分析策略镜像下降（PMD）与单步TD更新的持久评论家相结合，证明有限折扣MDP下精确坐标Bellman更新具有全局线性收敛，并在单条离策略轨迹下给出随机TD-PMD的样本复杂度保证，无需轨迹重置、生成模型或嵌套策略评估。
AI.motivation: 现有PMD收敛保证通常依赖精确或越来越准确的政策评估，实际中难以满足。本文旨在分析评论家仅推进一次TD更新的PMD，并在更弱假设下建立收敛与样本复杂度保证。
AI.method: 对精确坐标Bellman更新，结合基于预解式的辅助分布、衰减的Bellman违反校正及按逆坐标权重加权的势函数进行证明。对随机TD-PMD，在单条离策略Markov轨迹下使用一般强凸镜像映射，采用合适常数步长与有限批量TD更新；利用正则器沿轨迹的Lipschitz连续性（由顶点Bregman散度一致界推出）和访问加权的预解式估计来分析带符号评论家误差传播。
AI.result: 有限折扣MDP中，对任意正常数演员步长和任意有限评论家初始化，精确坐标Bellman更新下价值全局线性收敛。随机TD-PMD在约$\widetilde{O}(1/((1-\gamma)^5 \widetilde{\sigma}_b \epsilon))$次转移后达到期望价值间隙$\epsilon$，并呈现对行为覆盖$\widetilde{\sigma}_b$的逆线性依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该分析在不依赖轨迹重置、生成模型访问或嵌套策略评估循环的情况下给出随机TD-PMD的样本复杂度保证，数值结果与理论收敛分析一致。

title: Dynamic LoRA-Experts and Prototype-Ensemble Matching for Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to continuously learn new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with pre-trained models reduces parameter overhead but can suffer from cumulative interference and suboptimal alignment between inference samples and specialized modules. We propose Dynamic LoRA-Experts and Prototype-Ensemble Matching (DLEPEM), a two-stage rehearsal-free framework. DLEPEM allocates a task-specific LoRA-Expert for each incremental task to reduce cross-task interference, then combines frozen pre-trained-model prototypes with task-adaptive LoRA-Expert prototypes for reliable task-level discrimination. Experiments on standard CIL and Few-Shot CIL benchmarks demonstrate strong performance under the evaluated protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出免回放的两阶段类增量学习框架DLEPEM：为每个增量任务分配独立LoRA-Expert以抑制跨任务干扰，并结合冻结预训练模型原型与任务自适应LoRA-Expert原型实现可靠的任务级判别，在标准与少样本CIL基准上取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 类增量学习需要持续学习新类而不遗忘旧知识。基于预训练模型的高效参数微调虽降低参数开销，但存在累积干扰以及推理样本与专用模块之间对齐不佳的问题。
AI.method: DLEPEM采用免回放的两阶段框架。第一阶段为每个增量任务分配一个任务专属LoRA-Expert，以减少跨任务干扰；第二阶段融合冻结预训练模型原型与任务自适应的LoRA-Expert原型，进行任务级判别。
AI.result: 在标准类增量学习与少样本类增量学习基准上，于所评估协议下表现出较强性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务专属LoRA-Expert与双原型集成匹配，DLEPEM在不依赖回放的情况下有效缓解干扰并提升任务判别能力，验证了参数高效微调与原型匹配结合在类增量学习中的有效性。

title: Predicting Multi-View Rashomon Representation: Can We Learn Where Models Disagree?
summary: Foundation models are increasingly adopted across a wide range of applications, often serving as core blocks within AI systems. Yet different foundation models may encode the same input from multiple different views, leading to substantial representation disagreement, which we term Rashomon Representation. Such disagreement often signals inputs that a given model encodes in a way inconsistent with other models, offering a valuable yet underexplored signal for input reliability estimation. While prior work has largely focused on measuring disagreement across multiple models with a representation set, we instead focus on predicting disagreement from a single representation. We hypothesize that this disagreement follows some consistent, input-dependent patterns rather than occurring at random. To test this, we quantify disagreement by comparing each sample's nearest neighbors across different models' representation spaces, then train a lightweight predictor that estimates disagreement from a single model's representation. At inference time, given a new input, the predictor uses that input's representation to tell whether it aligns with or diverges from those of other models. Extensive experiments across diverse foundation models and datasets show that representational disagreement is indeed input-dependent, predictable, and generalizable, enabling efficient reliability estimation of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Rashomon表示"概念，指不同基础模型对同一输入产生显著表示分歧的现象；作者证明该分歧并非随机而是依赖输入且可预测，并训练一个轻量级预测器，仅用单个模型的表示即可估计其与其他模型的分歧程度，从而实现高效可靠的可靠性估计。
AI.motivation: 基础模型被广泛用作AI系统核心组件，但不同模型可能从多种视角编码同一输入，导致显著的表示分歧。这种分歧通常暗示某模型对该输入的编码方式与其他模型不一致，可作为输入可靠性的信号。然而现有工作多依赖多模型表示集来度量分歧，计算成本高，且未探索能否从单一表示预测分歧，因此该信号的价值尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 作者首先定义并量化"Rashomon表示"分歧：通过比较同一样本在不同模型表示空间中的最近邻来衡量分歧程度。基于"该分歧遵循一致的、依赖输入的模式而非随机发生"这一假设，训练一个轻量级预测器，从单一模型的表示中估计该分歧。推理阶段，给定新输入，仅用其在该模型中的表示即可判断该表示与其他模型是趋同还是发散。
AI.result: 在多种基础模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，表示分歧确实是依赖输入的、可预测的且具有泛化性，能够支持对基础模型进行高效的可靠性估计。
AI.conclusion: 表示分歧不是随机噪声，而是具有可学习、可迁移的输入依赖结构；仅凭单模型表示即可预测其与其他模型的分歧，从而无需访问多模型表示集即可实现高效、可泛化的基础模型可靠性估计。

title: Dimension-Free Rank Lifting from Random Hyperplane Arrangements
summary:
We study the width required for a randomly initialized hidden layer of a neural network to achieve rank lifting. Namely, given a dataset $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times d}$ of $m$, $d$-dimensional input vectors separated by an angle of at least $θ$, we consider the random feature matrix $σ(XR)$, where $R$ is standard Gaussian. For positively homogeneous nonpolynomial activations, which include sign, Heaviside, ReLU, and ReLU powers among others, we prove that $$n \gtrsim \frac{1}θ\max\left\{m,\log\left(\frac{1}δ\right)\right\}$$ neurons suffice for $σ(XR)$ to have full row rank $m$ with probability at least $1-δ$. This dimension-free bound exponentially improves the previous general-dimensional guarantee for sign features (Drago et al., 2026) and is essentially tight. The proof shows that one random feature column escapes every proper subspace of $\mathbb{R}^m$ with probability $Ω(θ)$, using a coupling of nearby Gaussian directions and a local crossing of the induced hyperplane arrangement. We also study stable rank lifting, where the goal is to establish a quantitative analogue of exact rank lifting, i.e., a lower bound on the smallest eigenvalue of the empirical feature Gram matrix in high-probability.
  Our analysis unifies and generalizes stable rank guarantees for all $q$-homogeneous non-polynomial activations following prior work in Panigrahi et al. (2020) and Song (2026). In particular, we combine a diagonally dominant Taylor tail of the population kernel with truncation and matrix concentration, to show that for positively homogeneous nonpolynomial activations, stable rank lifting is achieved at width $$n \gtrsim C^q \frac{m}{θ^{2q+1}} \log^{2q+\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{m}θ\right) \log\left(\frac{m}δ\right),$$ where $q$ is the degree of the activation and $C > 0$ is some universal constant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机隐藏层实现秩提升（rank lifting）所需的最小宽度，对正齐次非多项式激活函数给出了近乎最优的维度无关宽度界，并统一推广了稳定秩提升的保证。
AI.motivation: 随机特征矩阵 σ(XR) 能否满行秩是理解神经网络表达能力与训练的关键问题。已有针对 sign 特征的一般维度保证不够紧，且缺乏对更广泛激活函数、以及定量（稳定秩）版本的统一分析。
AI.method: 针对正齐次非多项式激活，利用邻近高斯方向耦合与诱导超平面排列的局部穿越，证明单个随机特征列以 Ω(θ) 概率逃离任意真子空间；对稳定秩提升，将总体核的泰勒尾部对角占优性与截断、矩阵集中相结合。
AI.result: 证明 n ≳ (1/θ)·max{m, log(1/δ)} 时 σ(XR) 以概率 ≥1−δ 满行秩 m，该维度无关界指数级改进 sign 特征的先前保证且本质最优；稳定秩提升在宽度 n ≳ C^q·(m/θ^{2q+1})·log^{2q+1/2}(m/θ)·log(m/δ) 下实现。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出随机隐藏层秩提升的紧致维度无关宽度界，统一并推广了所有 q-齐次非多项式激活的稳定秩保证。

title: Fork-dLLM: Avoiding the Flexibility Trap in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) have shown strong potential for faster inference through parallel token generation when combined with confidence-based samplers. However, recent work has shown that such methods can defer unmasking high-entropy fork positions at which multiple plausible continuations exist. This results in reduced generation diversity, as shown by worse pass@k scaling, and limits gains obtainable from RL post-training. To avoid this flexibility trap, prior work advocated for autoregressive (AR) sampling. Here, we show that discarding confidence-based sampling is unnecessary and, once inference cost is taken into account, wasteful. We first propose Fork-dLLM, a simple hybrid sampler that uses AR-style ordering only at uncertain fallback steps while retaining parallel generation otherwise. We then extend the same principle to post-training with ForkGRPO, which uses Fork-dLLM rollouts and applies the GRPO objective only at fallback steps, preserving exact policy-likelihood ratios while substantially reducing rollout and optimization cost. In our experiments, Fork-dLLM matches the strong pass@k scaling of AR sampling while being 2-3x more efficient, and ForkGRPO achieves downstream performance comparable to or better than AR-based GRPO baselines at a substantially lower training cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fork-dLLM 混合采样器（仅在不确定回退步用 AR 顺序，其余并行生成）及 ForkGRPO 后训练方法，兼顾 pass@k 多样性与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型结合置信度采样器可实现并行解码加速，但会推迟对高熵"分叉位置"的解掩码，导致生成多样性下降（pass@k 扩展变差），并限制 RL 后训练收益。已有工作因此放弃置信度采样、改用自回归采样，但这忽略了推理成本，造成浪费。
AI.method: 1）Fork-dLLM：混合采样器，仅在不确定的回退步采用 AR 式顺序解码，其余步骤保留并行生成；2）ForkGRPO：将同一原则扩展到后训练，使用 Fork-dLLM 进行 rollout，并仅在回退步上应用 GRPO 目标，从而保持精确的策略似然比，同时大幅降低 rollout 与优化开销。
AI.result: Fork-dLLM 在达到 AR 采样同等强 pass@k 扩展性的同时效率提升 2–3 倍；ForkGRPO 在显著更低的训练成本下，下游性能与基于 AR 的 GRPO 基线相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 放弃置信度采样并非必要，考虑推理成本后甚至是有浪费的。在关键的分叉/回退步引入 AR 顺序即可兼顾生成多样性与效率，该原则可有效迁移至 RL 后训练。

title: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
summary: Open-weight LLMs are released not only as fixed products but also as substrates for downstream fine-tuning. This openness, however, creates legal and ethical risks because users may misuse fine-tuning to instill illicit knowledge or enable hostile operations. Model providers therefore need apre-release defense against such acquisition, motivating the problem of preemptive unlearning. Unlike retrospective unlearning, which removes capabilities already present in a fixed model, preemptive unlearning seeks to prevent their acquisition under unseen attack data and future fine-tuning procedures. Despite its practical importance, this setting remains largely unexplored, presents distinct challenges, and is therefore the central focus of our work. We first verify that existing retrospective methods provide insufficient pre-release protection. Even when forbidden capabilities are suppressed in current outputs, forbidden-domain data can still induce gradients through internal pathways, enabling later acquisition. Motivated by this finding, we propose a gradient-sealing principle that blocks these pathways by pushing relevant pre-activations into the negative region, where ReLU-family activations exhibit zero or near-zero derivatives. Experiments across multiple LLM families demonstrate our stronger resistance to downstream acquisition than retrospective baselines, validating gradient sealing as an effective mechanism for pre-release protection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预emptive unlearning（先发式遗忘）"问题：在开放权重LLM发布前，防止用户通过后续微调获取被禁止能力。作者发现既有回溯式遗忘方法防护不足，并提出"梯度封印"原则来阻断内部梯度通路，实验证明其抗下游获取能力强于基线。
AI.motivation: 开放权重LLM不仅是固定产品，也是下游微调的基座，用户可能滥用微调注入非法知识或实现恶意操作。因此模型提供方需要在发布前进行防御，而现有研究多聚焦于对固定模型的事后遗忘（retrospective unlearning），对"发布前、面对未知攻击数据与未来微调流程"的先发式遗忘（preemptive unlearning）几乎未被探索。作者首先验证了现有回溯方法在先发布防护上不足：即使在当前输出中压制了禁止能力，禁止域数据仍能通过内部通路产生梯度，使后续获取成为可能。
AI.method: 提出梯度封印（gradient-sealing）原则：将相关预激活值推入负区间，使ReLU族激活的导数变为零或接近零，从而阻断禁止域数据经由内部通路产生有效梯度。基于该原则设计发布前防御方法。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族上的实验表明，该方法对下游获取禁止能力的抵抗能力强于回溯式遗忘基线，验证了梯度封印作为发布前防护机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 先发式遗忘是开放权重发布场景中重要且未被充分探索的问题；仅靠输出层面的压制无法阻止后续微调获取能力。梯度封印通过切断内部梯度通路提供了更强的发布前防护，为开放权重模型的安全发布提供了可行方向。

title: Algorithmic Recourse Under Competition
summary: Algorithmic recourse provides individuals who have received undesirable outcomes from machine learning models with suggestions for minimum-cost improvements to achieve the desired outcome. A central assumption when computing recourse is that the decision rule remains fixed throughout the recourse implementation phase. We challenge this assumption in settings where individuals compete for limited resources. In such settings, widespread recourse implementation can change the acceptance threshold even when the scoring model that is used to evaluate individuals remains the same. This change in acceptance threshold can, in turn, invalidate the original recourse recommendations (i.e., following the recourse may not lead to the desired outcome). To address this problem, we introduce a framework called recourse under competition that jointly optimizes for recommendation recipients and the recommended score target they need to satisfy to balance the recourse cost and post-shift validity among initially rejected individuals. We develop an algorithm based on the Implicit Function Theorem and empirically analyze its performance. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that personalized score targets can achieve higher validity, albeit at a higher cost. In contrast, common score targets generally offer favorable cost-validity trade-offs for lower to medium validity values.

AI.tldr: 针对竞争性有限资源场景中因阈值漂移导致追索建议失效的问题，提出"竞争下的追索"框架，联合优化推荐对象与个性化分数目标以权衡成本与有效性，并基于隐函数定理设计算法，实验表明个性化目标有效性高但成本高，统一目标在中低有效性下取得较好成本-有效性权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有算法追索（algorithmic recourse）通常假设在建议实施阶段决策规则保持固定。然而在个体竞争有限资源的场景中，即使评估个体的评分模型不变，广泛的追索实施也会抬高录取阈值，从而使原始追索建议失效——即按建议改进后仍无法获得期望结果。该假设与真实竞争环境不符，需要重新建模。
AI.method: 提出"竞争下的追索"（recourse under competition）框架，不假设阈值固定，而是联合优化两类决策：（1）向哪些初始被拒个体发放建议（推荐对象），（2）发放何种建议分数目标（score target）。目标函数在追索成本与漂移后有效性（post-shift validity）之间取得平衡。为求解该优化问题，基于隐函数定理（Implicit Function Theorem）刻画阈值随追索实施变化的响应关系，并据此设计了相应算法。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上的实验表明：个性化分数目标（personalized score targets）能获得更高的有效性（validity），但代价是更高的追索成本；而统一分数目标（common score targets）在中低有效性水平下通常能提供更为有利的成本—有效性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 在个体竞争有限资源的场景下，追索必须考虑阈值漂移的内生变化，固定决策规则的假设失效。通过联合优化推荐对象与分数目标，可在成本与漂移后有效性之间进行权衡；个性化目标适合追求高有效性，统一目标在较低有效性需求下更具成本效率。

title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
comment: 36 pages. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/wjjpku/howloop
summary:
Looped Transformers repeatedly apply the same set of Transformer layers, giving them a recurrent architecture for latent computation. Their strong performance on iterative reasoning and length-generalization tasks suggests an appealing explanation: recurrence may provide an inductive bias that lets the model reuse a learned algorithm across loops. However, weight sharing alone does not imply that every loop performs the same operation. This raises a basic question: is each loop actually repeating the same computation, and if not, what routes the shared parameters to different operations?
  We study this question using graph walks as a test case. In the model's native trajectories, decoded predictions can advance by different numbers of graph steps or remain at a reached target, showing that recurrent progress need not follow a fixed one-loop-one-step pattern. We then show that a frozen loop can be steered toward different transitions by modifying its entering hidden state: a learned linear layer $J$ selects the desired transition without changing the shared Transformer layers.
  To test how this steering works, we use activation patching and find that attention patterns can recover its effects and switch the selected transition. Across five matched pairs of graph models, changing intermediate supervision during backbone training changes which transitions $J$ can induce. This suggests that $J$ selects computations learned by the backbone rather than creating new algorithms. Together, these results show that the hidden state can control shared computation, with attention routing as a causal pathway.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究循环Transformer的每个循环是否执行相同计算，发现隐藏状态可通过线性层J与注意力路由控制共享参数执行不同图游走转移操作。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer重复应用同一组层，在迭代推理与长度泛化上表现优异，通常被解释为"复用同一算法"的归纳偏置；但权重共享并不等于每次循环执行相同操作，因此需要弄清各循环是否真的重复同一计算，若不是，又是什么机制将共享参数导向不同操作。
AI.method: 以图游走（graph walks）为测试场景；观察模型原生轨迹中解码预测的步进模式；通过修改进入循环的隐藏状态并借助学习到的线性层J来选择不同转移；采用激活修补（activation patching）检验注意力模式对转向效果的作用；并在五对匹配的图模型上改变骨干训练中的中间监督，考察J可诱导的转移集合变化。
AI.result: 模型原生轨迹显示预测可一次推进多个图步或停留在已到达目标，说明循环进度并非固定"一循环一步"；一个冻结的循环可通过修改其输入隐藏状态被引导到不同转移，由线性层J选定目标转移而不改动共享Transformer层；激活修补表明注意力模式能恢复转向效果并切换选定的转移；在五对匹配模型中，改变骨干训练的中间监督会改变J所能诱导的转移。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态能够控制共享计算，注意力路由构成其因果通路；J是在选取骨干已学到的计算，而非创造新算法，权重共享下各循环可执行不同操作。

title: Do Better Goal Representations Improve Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) relies heavily on how target goals are represented to the policy. While recent methods encode goals via temporal distance, occupancy, or controllability, it remains unclear how much downstream performance actually depends on representation quality. We study this in offline GCRL by constructing an exact temporal-distance goal representation in deterministic mazes. We then systematically corrupt its geometric quality while keeping the downstream learner fixed. Across OGBench navigation tasks and two algorithms, large changes in goal-representation quality produce almost no change in performance. However, applying the same interventions to the agent's current state more than doubles success, revealing the state pathway as the true bottleneck. Building on this insight, we show that simple random Fourier positional encodings substantially improve performance on the hardest navigation tasks without map information or objective modifications. Overall, our findings suggest that in state-based offline navigation, improving how the agent's current state is represented matters far more than refining the goal representation. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离线GCRL中目标表示质量对性能的影响，发现在确定性迷宫中即使大幅降低目标表示几何质量，性能几乎不变；改为扰动当前状态表示则成功率翻倍，表明状态通路才是瓶颈，随机傅里叶位置编码可显著提升最难导航任务表现。
AI.motivation: 目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中目标如何表示一直是设计核心，已有方法用时距、占据度、可控性等编码目标，但尚不清楚下游性能究竟多大程度依赖目标表示质量，作者希望厘清目标表示与状态表示对性能的相对贡献。
AI.method: 在确定性迷宫任务中构造精确的时距目标表示，固定下游学习器，系统性地破坏其几何质量；在OGBench导航任务和两种算法上对比同种干预作用于目标表示与作用于智能体当前状态表示的效果；并提出使用简单的随机傅里叶位置编码改善状态表示。
AI.result: 目标表示质量的大幅变化几乎不引起性能变化；相同干预施加到当前状态表示上使成功率提升超过两倍；随机傅里叶位置编码在无地图信息、无目标函数修改的情况下显著提升最难导航任务的表现。
AI.conclusion: 在基于状态的离线导航中，改进智能体当前状态的表示远比精修目标表示重要，状态通路是真正的性能瓶颈，这为后续GCRL表示研究提供了新的重点方向。

title: Patient-Centered Treatment Planning for Chronic Multimorbidity: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Preference Modeling
summary: Patient preference, defined as a patient's demonstrated willingness and capacity to adhere to clinical recommendations, is a primary determinant of therapeutic effect yet remains structurally absent from existing computational treatment planning models. We address this gap by presenting patient-centered factored-action hierarchical option-critic (FAHOC), a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that jointly learns high-level options corresponding to therapeutic strategies and factored intra-option policies that decompose the joint action space into disease- and intervention-specific subcomponents, while imposing a cooperation-aware action masking mechanism. This enables structured exploration, improved credit assignment across hierarchy levels, and more interpretable decision pathways, while enforcing patients' preferences. Formal guarantees establish that cooperative patients achieve higher optimal expected health outcomes than non-cooperative patients, and that the factored Q-function approximation error is provably bounded. The framework is evaluated using longitudinal data collected from approximately 50,000 comorbid hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus patients from five hospitals in the Southeast U.S. FAHOC achieves a quality-adjusted life year expectancy equivalent improvement of 0.669 (vs -0.133 observed clinician practice), correctly identifies cooperative patients in 95.9% of cases and never violates a patient's preference in held-out test, demonstrating that HRL with explicit preference constraints can support preference-consistent, clinically safe decision-making in multimorbidity management.

AI.tldr: 提出FAHOC分层强化学习框架，将患者偏好显式纳入多病种治疗决策，在全美五家医院约5万共病患者的纵向数据上验证其有效性与安全性。
AI.motivation: 患者偏好（患者遵循临床建议的意愿与能力）是治疗效果的主要决定因素，但在现有计算化治疗规划模型中被结构性缺失。
AI.method: 提出以患者为中心的因子化动作分层option-critic（FAHOC）框架：联合学习对应治疗策略的高层option与因子化option内策略，将联合动作空间分解为疾病相关与干预相关子成分，并引入协作感知的动作掩码机制，从而实现结构化探索、跨层级信用分配与可解释决策路径，同时强制满足患者偏好。理论上证明了协作患者可获得更高的最优期望健康结果，且因子化Q函数近似误差有界。
AI.result: 使用美国东南部五家医院约5万名高血压合并2型糖尿病共病患者的纵向数据评估。FAHOC实现质量调整生命年预期提升0.669（临床医生实际实践为-0.133），协作患者识别准确率达95.9%，在留出测试中从未违反患者偏好。
AI.conclusion: 带显式偏好约束的分层强化学习可支持偏好一致、临床安全的多病种管理决策。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Selection for Parallel Scaling of Search Agents
summary: Parallel search may generate a correct answer that final-answer voting fails to select. We formulate this consolidation stage as trajectory selection and introduce TRACE (Trajectory Ranking with Aggregated Cross-Rollout Evidence), a lightweight learned selector that ranks completed trajectories using the search evidence behind their answers. TRACE preserves individual query and evidence occurrences, connects rollouts through shared content or document identity, and propagates information across these relations. Each candidate answer then reads the updated states of its own trajectory, preserving retrieval provenance while incorporating evidence from related rollouts. Trained with answer-level supervision over frozen text embeddings, TRACE returns an existing answer without additional search or autoregressive aggregation. One selector per search setting transfers across rollout policies and agent backbones without agent-specific fine-tuning, improving over voting across six WebQA policies and six long-horizon dataset-backbone combinations at $K=16$. On Qwen2.5-14B Base/SFT WebQA pools, TRACE achieves 45.2/49.2% EM, compared with 43.9/48.0% for the strongest Qwen3-32B generative aggregators. On long-horizon FRAMES, GAIA, and BrowseComp, it reaches 78.6% average accuracy, exceeding majority voting by 3.1 percentage points. On Base WebQA pools, TRACE with only 8 rollouts comes within 0.4 points of majority voting over 64. TRACE also achieves at least $10\times$ higher processing throughput than SolAgg, SummAgg, and AggAgent across all seven WebQA benchmarks. These results show that reusing cross-rollout search evidence provides an effective and efficient alternative to heavyweight generative aggregation for parallel search. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaasssoooonnnnn/TRACE.

AI.tldr: 本文将并行搜索的答案整合阶段形式化为轨迹选择问题，提出轻量级学习式选择器TRACE，利用跨rollout的搜索证据对完整轨迹排序，在不增加搜索或自回归聚合的情况下超越投票与重量级生成式聚合方法。
AI.motivation: 并行搜索可能已生成正确答案，但最终答案投票（final-answer voting）却无法将其选出。现有整合方式（如投票或生成式聚合）未能充分利用每条轨迹背后的检索证据与跨轨迹关联信息，导致整合阶段成为性能瓶颈且效率低下。
AI.method: 将整合阶段建模为轨迹选择（trajectory selection），提出TRACE（Trajectory Ranking with Aggregated Cross-Rollout Evidence）。该选择器保留各查询与证据出现记录，通过共享内容或文档身份连接不同rollout并跨关系传播信息；每个候选答案读取其自身轨迹更新后的状态，在保留检索来源的同时融合相关rollout证据。基于冻结文本嵌入，以答案级监督训练，直接返回已有答案，无需额外搜索或自回归聚合；每个搜索设置仅需一个选择器。
AI.result: 在K=16时，跨6种WebQA策略和6个长时程数据集-骨干组合均优于投票。Qwen2.5-14B Base/SFT WebQA池上EM达45.2/49.2%，优于最强Qwen3-32B生成式聚合器的43.9/48.0%。FRAMES、GAIA、BrowseComp平均准确率78.6%，超多数投票3.1个百分点。Base WebQA池上仅用8次rollout即接近64次投票（差0.4点）。在全部七个WebQA基准上处理吞吐率至少为SolAgg、SummAgg、AggAgent的10倍。
AI.conclusion: 复用跨rollout搜索证据为并行搜索提供了一种有效且高效的替代方案，可取代重量级生成式聚合。TRACE具有跨策略、跨骨干的迁移性，并在准确率与吞吐率上均有显著优势。

title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling
summary: Recursive reasoning models apply a small shared Transformer block many times to refine a latent state. This gives them large effective depth with few parameters and makes them strong on algorithmic tasks. Such compact solvers are natural candidates for tools that an LLM can call on narrow algorithmic subproblems. However, existing models such as HRM, TRM and URM differ in architecture, gradient propagation and training procedure simultaneously. This makes it hard to tell what drives their performance, and their optimization is still poorly understood and often unstable. In this work we address both of these gaps. First, we study these questions under a unified experimental pipeline spanning six algorithmic domains. Individual controlled ablations are performed on representative domains, while the resulting recipe is evaluated across the full suite. The study reveals a surprisingly simple recipe for stable and generalizable recursive reasoning: an intermediate gradient horizon, large physical batches and controlled updates of the recurrent state. An explicit hierarchical architecture is not needed. Second, we combine these findings into a stable 13.6M-parameter model that achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated recursive baselines, with particularly large gains on out-of-distribution generalization. It raises Arithmetic OOD accuracy to 71.2%, from 36.2% for the strongest baseline, while reaching 98.41% on Sudoku and 59.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1. Our results show that, within the recursive architectures studied here, performance depends strongly on how recurrence is optimized and stabilized. More broadly, it shows how AI systems can be improved by optimizing their components one at a time.

AI.tldr: 在统一实验管线中系统研究递归推理模型的架构、梯度传播与训练，提炼出无需显式层级结构的简洁稳定配方，并构建13.6M参数模型取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 递归推理模型以少量参数实现大有效深度，在算法任务上表现强，是LLM调用窄算法子问题的理想工具；但HRM、TRM、URM等在架构、梯度传播、训练流程上同时存在差异，难以辨别性能来源，且优化不稳定、理解不足。
AI.method: 在六个算法领域构建统一实验管线；在代表性领域进行受控消融，并将所得配方在完整套件上评估；识别关键因素（中间梯度视界、大物理批量、对循环状态的受控更新），并据此训练一个稳定模型。
AI.result: 得到稳定且可泛化的递归推理配方：中间梯度视界、大物理批量、受控循环状态更新，且无需显式层级架构；13.6M参数模型整体性能最强，Arithmetic OOD准确率从最强基线36.2%提升至71.2%，Sudoku达98.41%，ARC-AGI-1 pass@2为59.5%。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的递归架构范围内，性能强烈依赖循环的优化与稳定化方式，而非显式层级结构；这体现了通过逐组件优化来改进AI系统的思路。

title: Learning to Explain While Planning: Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Diffusion planners exhibit strong capabilities in generating multimodal trajectories. However, existing methods primarily rely on expert demonstrations to fit trajectory distributions, learning statistical correlations among scenes, behaviors, and trajectories without explicitly modeling driving rules. In long-tail scenarios where expert data are scarce, the lack of behaviors to imitate may lead to trajectories that violate safety or compliance requirements. Moreover, their generation process lacks rule-level explanations, making it difficult to determine which rules drive trajectory adjustments, when they take effect, and how strongly they act, thereby limiting failure diagnosis, safety validation, and targeted improvement. To address these limitations, we propose the Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planner (RADP), which incorporates differentiable driving rules into the diffusion objective during training, turning rule knowledge into intrinsic behavioral principles beyond finite demonstrations. We further introduce Rule-Pressure Attribution (RPA), which constructs supervision signals from gradients of rule losses with respect to predicted trajectories and employs a lightweight attribution head to estimate the optimization pressure exerted by each rule online. To assess the closed-loop behavioral relevance of these attributions, we propose a temporal risk-alignment protocol that evaluates whether current rule pressures reflect corresponding risks during subsequent closed-loop execution. Experiments on nuPlan show that RADP improves closed-loop planning in challenging safety-critical scenarios, while RPA exhibits consistent temporal alignment with subsequent rule-specific risks, validating both intrinsic rule learning and rule-level interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planner (RADP)，将可微驾驶规则融入扩散训练目标，并设计 Rule-Pressure Attribution (RPA) 实现规则级在线归因与可解释性；在 nuPlan 上提升安全关键场景的闭环规划，且归因具有时序风险一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散规划器主要依赖专家演示拟合轨迹分布，只学习场景、行为与轨迹间的统计相关性，未显式建模驾驶规则。在专家数据稀缺的长尾场景中，缺乏可模仿行为易导致轨迹违反安全或合规要求；同时生成过程缺少规则级解释，难以判断哪些规则驱动轨迹调整、何时生效、作用强度如何，从而限制失败诊断、安全验证与针对性改进。
AI.method: 1) RADP：在训练阶段将可微驾驶规则（differentiable driving rules）引入扩散目标函数，把规则知识转化为超越有限演示的内在行为准则；2) RPA：以规则损失对预测轨迹的梯度构造监督信号，并训练轻量归因头（attribution head）在线估计每条规则施加的优化压力；3) 时序风险对齐协议（temporal risk-alignment protocol）：评估当前规则压力是否能反映后续闭环执行中对应的风险。
AI.result: nuPlan 实验表明：RADP 在具有挑战性的安全关键场景中改善闭环规划性能；RPA 的规则压力与后续规则特定风险呈现一致的时序对齐关系，验证了内在规则学习与规则级可解释性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可微驾驶规则嵌入扩散训练目标并引入基于梯度的规则归因机制，可在有限专家演示下学习规则导向的驾驶行为，同时提供可在线获取、可时序验证的规则级解释，为安全关键场景下的规划改进、失败诊断与安全验证提供支持。

title: DashVMC: Real-Time Discrete World Model Control in Geometry Dash
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents". Project page: https://tariolle.github.io/dash-vmc/
summary: World-model agents are usually evaluated in simulators that can wait for the policy; live games impose the opposite constraint, requiring capture, prediction, and action before the next frame. We present DashVMC, which learns a compact, action-conditioned world model from approximately two hours of recorded Geometry Dash gameplay. To test whether the learned dynamics are actionable, a controller is initialized by behavioural cloning (BC) and refined with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) entirely in frozen-model rollouts, without further interaction with the live game. Across three controller seeds, the refined policies survive longer than their BC initializations on all three official levels and a held-out community layout. At deployment, the baseline skips visual generation and sustains a 60-Hz capture-to-action loop on a consumer GPU. Action-conditioned continuations and rollout diagnostics show that the model remains useful for control despite imperfect long-horizon fidelity.

AI.tldr: DashVMC：从约两小时《几何冲刺》录像学习紧凑的动作条件世界模型，控制器经BC初始化后在冻结模型内用PPO微调，无需与实时游戏交互；三个种子在三个官方关卡与一个社区关卡上均比BC基线存活更久，部署端在消费级GPU上实现60Hz闭环，证明模型虽有长时程保真缺陷但仍可用于控制。
AI.motivation: 世界模型智能体通常在"可等待策略"的模拟器中评估，而实时游戏施加相反约束：必须在下一帧到来前完成采集、预测与动作，因此需要检验所学动力学在严苛实时条件下是否具备可操作性（actionable）。
AI.method: 用约两小时《几何冲刺》游戏录像训练一个紧凑的、动作条件的世界模型；控制器先以行为克隆（BC）初始化，再完全在冻结模型的rollout中用近端策略优化（PPO）精调，不再与实时游戏交互。
AI.result: 三个控制器种子在三个官方关卡和一个留出的社区布局上，精调后策略的存活时间均超过其BC初始化。部署阶段基线跳过视觉生成，在消费级GPU上维持60 Hz的采集到动作闭环；动作条件延续与rollout诊断表明长时程保真度虽不完美，模型对控制仍具实用性。
AI.conclusion: 实时游戏可作为世界模型可控性的压力测试场景；紧凑、动作条件的世界模型即便长时程保真有限，仍足以支持在冻结rollout中训练出优于BC的实时控制策略。

title: Fenchel Tilting: Weighted Correction for Efficient Finetuning of Generative Models
summary: Adapting a pretrained generative model to an arbitrary preference expressed as a utility function underlies reward alignment, guided design, and constraint satisfaction, enabling diverse applications. Existing fine-tuning methods trade off generality against computational cost: they either restrict the family class of supported preferences to keep optimization simple or preserve generality at the expense of efficiency. We introduce Fenchel Tilt Flow Control (FTFC), which decouples utility optimization from generative-model fitting. FTFC first optimizes for a target distribution by jointly fitting an effective reward and density-ratio weights on pretrained samples. Method combines the utility's variational structure with Fenchel duality, supporting general $f$-divergence penalties that determine how rewards are transformed into an distribution-correction weights. These weights are then frozen and used to modify a diffusion or flow model in a single stage of importance-weighted denoising or flow matching, without differentiating through sampling trajectories. We establish exact duality for concave utilities under suitable conditions and show that weighted fitting reproduces the optimal target distribution for a given utility. Across image and molecule generation benchmarks, FTFC improves over baselines on diverse preference functions, while also being up to $20\times$ more efficient. roposed method enables adaptation beyond expected-reward maximization without complex optimization, while preserving robustness for more general class of the utility functions compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: FTFC通过解耦效用优化与生成模型拟合，先在预训练样本上联合拟合有效奖励与密度比权重，再以冻结权重单阶段微调扩散/流模型，实现对通用效用函数的奖励对齐，兼顾通用性与效率。
AI.motivation: 将预训练生成模型适配到任意以效用函数表达的偏好（奖励对齐、引导设计、约束满足）具有广泛价值。但现有微调方法在通用性与计算成本间存在权衡：要么限制可支持的偏好类别以简化优化，要么为保持通用性而牺牲效率。
AI.method: 提出Fenchel Tilt Flow Control（FTFC），将效用优化与生成模型拟合解耦。首先在预训练样本上联合拟合有效奖励与密度比权重来优化目标分布；方法结合效用的变分结构与Fenchel对偶，支持决定奖励如何转换为分布校正权重的通用f散度惩罚。随后冻结这些权重，用单阶段的重要性加权去噪或流匹配修改扩散或流模型，无需对采样轨迹求导。
AI.result: 在适当条件下为凹效用建立精确对偶性，并证明加权拟合可复现给定效用下的最优目标分布。在图像与分子生成基准上，FTFC在多种偏好函数上优于基线，同时效率提升最高达20倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在无需复杂优化的情况下实现超越期望奖励最大化的适配，相比基线对更一般的效用函数类保持鲁棒性。

title: Inference Auctions
summary: When inference demand exceeds available compute capacity, model providers must decide which requests should be served first. Users have different tolerances for delay from an LLM API, but current priority pricing schemes compress these differences into coarse fixed-price service tiers. We design an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster service. Our auction allocates priority in an economically efficient way without sacrificing latency, and we develop fast algorithms for implementing prices that incentivize truthful bidding. We also design an autobidding agent for our inference auction, where users specify an inference budget and the autobidder dynamically adjusts its bids over time to maximize user utility subject to the budget constraint. Experiments validate the practicality of our auction: it increases system welfare while maintaining the cache utilization and latency advantages of SGLang, a state-of-the-art inference serving framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种推理拍卖机制，让用户通过竞价获得更快的大模型推理服务，实现经济高效的优先级分配，并设计自动竞价代理在预算约束下最大化用户效用，实验验证其在不损失SGLang延迟与缓存优势的同时提升了系统福利。
AI.motivation: 当推理需求超过可用算力时，模型提供商必须决定优先服务哪些请求。用户对LLM API延迟的容忍度各不相同，但现有的优先级定价方案将这些差异压缩为粗粒度的固定价格服务层级，无法有效反映用户真实需求，导致资源分配效率低下。
AI.method: 设计了推理拍卖机制，让用户竞价以获得更快服务；以经济高效的方式分配优先级且不牺牲延迟；开发了用于实现激励真实出价价格的快速算法；并设计了自动竞价代理，用户只需指定推理预算，代理随时间动态调整出价，在预算约束下最大化用户效用。
AI.result: 实验验证了拍卖的实用性：在保持SGLang（当前最先进的推理服务框架）的缓存利用率和延迟优势的同时，提升了系统整体福利。
AI.conclusion: 该推理拍卖机制能够在维持现有推理服务框架性能优势的前提下，通过竞价实现更细粒度、更高效的优先级分配，并通过自动竞价降低用户参与成本。

title: Accelerated Algorithm for Sparse Regularized Partial Optimal Transport
comment: 36 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Optimization Theory and Applications
summary: Partial Optimal Transport (POT) extends the classical optimal transport problem by relaxing the strict mass conservation constraint, enabling its use in a wide range of real-world applications. In many of these settings, sparse transport plans are preferred for their interpretability and computational benefits. While smooth and strongly convex regularizers - such as quadratic or elastic net - have been vastly used in various machine learning applications to induce sparsity and accelerate computation, they have received less algorithmic attention compared to entropic approaches for computational POT. In this paper, we propose a new optimization framework that leverages these regularizers through a penalty-based reformulation, enabling efficient gradient-based updates while preserving the structure of the original problem. Our method accommodates a broad class of regularizers that promote structured and sparse transport plans. Building on this formulation, we design an accelerated first-order algorithm that alternates between smooth updates and simple projection steps. Through empirical benchmarks on color transfer, domain adaptation, and point cloud registration, our approach consistently outperforms established baselines - achieving lower transport cost, higher sparsity, and faster convergence - making it a practical and scalable solution for modern transport problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于惩罚式重构的优化框架，利用光滑强凸正则项（如二次、弹性网正则）求解部分最优传输（POT），并设计加速一阶算法交替执行光滑更新与简单投影，在保结构的同时获得稀疏传输方案，在颜色迁移、域适应和点云配准任务上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 部分最优传输（POT）放宽了严格质量守恒约束，适用于诸多实际场景；其中稀疏传输方案因可解释性与计算优势而更受青睐。光滑强凸正则项（二次、弹性网等）在机器学习中广泛用于诱导稀疏和加速计算，但在计算型 POT 中相较熵正则方法受到的算法关注较少，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出新的优化框架，通过惩罚式重构（penalty-based reformulation）引入一类光滑强凸正则项，从而支持高效梯度更新并保持原问题结构；该框架可容纳一大类促进结构化、稀疏传输方案的正则项。在此基础上设计加速一阶算法，交替进行光滑更新与简单投影步骤。
AI.result: 在颜色迁移、域适应、点云配准三个基准任务上的实验表明，该方法相较现有基线持续表现更优，实现更低的传输代价、更高的稀疏性以及更快的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为计算型 POT 提供了一种实用且可扩展的求解方案，说明光滑强凸正则在稀疏传输问题中同样具备算法竞争力，适用于现代传输问题。

title: Replay on Demand: An Emergent Curriculum for Balancing Adaptation and Forgetting in Continued Pretraining
summary: Continued pretraining enables language models to adapt to new domains and knowledge, but often at the cost of forgetting previously acquired capabilities. Replay can mitigate this trade-off, but fixed replay mixtures allocate training independently of the model's actual retention needs. We introduce Replay on Demand (RoD), which instead derives the replay allocation from the model's learning dynamics. RoD jointly prioritizes adaptation samples by their remaining learning potential and replay samples by their observed forgetting. Their competition for a shared training budget yields an online curriculum that determines what to train on at each step. Across models, scales, and adaptation domains, RoD reaches or improves upon the adaptation-forgetting frontier of tuned fixed-replay baselines and model merging without prescribing a replay allocation in advance. Replay concentrates on sources that are more vulnerable to forgetting and dynamically increases and redistributes as forgetting emerges during training. Together, our results show that replay can be allocated online from the model's evolving state, targeting what is needed, when it is needed.

AI.tldr: 提出 Replay on Demand (RoD)，一种根据模型学习动态在线分配回放比例的持续预训练方法，无需预先设定固定回放混合比例即可达到或超越调优的固定回放基线。
AI.motivation: 持续预训练使模型适应新领域与新知识，但常导致对既有能力的遗忘。回放 (replay) 可缓解这一权衡，然而固定的回放混合比例与模型实际的保持需求无关，无法按需分配训练预算。
AI.method: RoD 从模型的学习动态中推导回放分配：将适应样本按剩余学习潜力 (remaining learning potential) 排序，将回放样本按观测到的遗忘程度 (observed forgetting) 排序，二者在共享训练预算下竞争，形成在线课程 (online curriculum)，逐步决定每步训练的数据构成。
AI.result: 在多种模型、规模与适应领域上，RoD 达到或优于经过调优的固定回放基线及模型合并 (model merging) 所构成的适应—遗忘前沿，且无需事先指定回放分配。回放会集中于更易遗忘的来源，并随训练过程中遗忘的出现而动态增加与重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 回放分配可基于模型不断变化的状态在线进行，针对"所需之处"与"所需之时"进行回放，从而实现适应与保持之间更优的权衡。

title: Beyond Model Ranking: Regime Diagnosis for Distributional-Statistical Misspecification in Industrial Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting models achieve strong benchmark performance but exhibit severe systematic bias in industrial deployments. This train--deploy gap is conventionally attributed to temporal-structural errors or distribution shifts. We characterize a complementary source that these explanations overlook: canonical losses embed fixed statistical priors, while industrial demand mixes benign and pathological regimes---zero-inflation, skewness, high variability---in which these priors are systematically violated. The induced bias persists even under perfect temporal modeling, remains in a distributional-shape component that normalization cannot remove, and creates an aggregation trade-off invisible to aggregate metrics. We turn these observations into an evaluation toolkit centered on the Regime-wise Relative Bias Vector (RBV): a metric-agnostic, regime-decomposed diagnostic that audits how pooled training allocates systematic mismatch across pathological subpopulations. A controlled attribution analysis decomposes RBV into a model-independent intrinsic floor, set by each loss's estimand, and an excess component attributable to training, tracing observed bias to the loss rather than the model. A large-scale study---13 loss objectives, 3 seeds, 60,000+ series spanning RetailShiftBench and M5, with random-split controls---shows that regime-aware diagnosis separates optimization-type from bias-type failure, and that regime-aware training resolves the pooling-induced bias that capacity scaling cannot, for mean-type losses. A formal structural observation, that risk under evaluation-distribution contamination is affine in the pathology mixture weight, grounds these findings. Our work complements model ranking with mechanism-grounded, regime-oriented evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示时间序列预测的"训练—部署差距"存在被忽视的损失函数先验失配来源，提出以"区制相对偏差向量(RBV)"为核心的评估工具包，并通过大规模实验证明区制感知诊断与训练可分离优化型与偏差型失败、消除池化诱导偏差。
AI.motivation: 工业部署中时间序列模型虽在基准上表现优异，却存在严重的系统性偏差。传统解释将其归因于时间结构误差或分布偏移，但这些解释忽略了另一类来源：标准损失函数内嵌固定的统计先验，而工业需求混合了良性与病态区制（零膨胀、偏态、高波动），使这些先验被系统性违背。该偏差在完美时间建模下依然存在、无法被归一化消除，并产生聚合指标不可见的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出以"区制相对偏差向量(RBV)"为中心的评估工具包：一种与指标无关、按区制分解的诊断方法，审计池化训练如何在病态子群间分配系统性失配。通过受控归因分析，将RBV分解为模型无关的"内在下限"（由各损失的估计目标决定）与"超额分量"（归因于训练）。开展大规模研究：13种损失目标、3个随机种子、60,000+条序列，覆盖RetailShiftBench与M5数据集，并设随机划分对照。同时给出形式化结构观察：评估分布污染下的风险是病态混合权重的仿射函数。
AI.result: 大规模实验表明：区制感知诊断能够将"优化型失败"与"偏差型失败"区分开；对于均值型损失，区制感知训练可解决容量扩展无法消除的池化诱导偏差。风险在评估分布污染下关于病态混合权重呈仿射关系，为上述发现提供了理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 研究将偏差溯源至损失函数而非模型，补足了仅靠模型排序的评估范式，提出以机制为基础、面向区制的评估方法，揭示了区制感知训练在消除池化偏差方面的独特价值。

title: Scalable Cox Regression via Grouped Risk Sets and Sharper LogSumExp Rates
summary: Motivated by the computational challenges of large-scale Cox regression, we study stochastic minimization of LogSumExp objectives over large sets. Mini-batch normalizer estimates generally yield biased gradients. We instead use a softplus surrogate that introduces one auxiliary scalar per normalizer and admits unbiased single-sample gradients. For smooth convex LogSumExp objectives, we prove an $O(T^{-1/2})$ averaged objective bound, improving the previous $T^{-1/4}$ analysis. With a strongly convex regularizer on the original variable, we also obtain a last-iterate squared-error rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})$ without strong convexity in the auxiliary variables. For Cox regression, the normalizers are defined over nested risk sets. We exploit this structure by grouping neighboring failures and sharing one auxiliary variable per group. The resulting compressed objective admits uniform score and curvature bounds that control the errors from grouping and softplus approximation. Together with the general optimization result, these bounds give a mean-square rate of $T^{-4/5}$, up to logarithmic factors, relative to the full Cox solution. The compressed estimator also matches the full estimator's asymptotic distribution. Experiments on synthetic and real survival datasets with slowly decreasing risk sets show a favorable performance relative to stochastic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大规模Cox回归中LogSumExp目标的随机最小化。提出每归一化器引入一个辅助标量的softplus替代，获得无偏单样本梯度；对光滑凸目标证明O(T^{-1/2})平均目标界（优于此前T^{-1/4}）；对原变量加强凸正则时给出\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})最后迭代平方误差率。针对Cox嵌套风险集，将相邻失败分组共享辅助变量，得到T^{-4/5}均方率并匹配全量估计的渐近分布。
AI.motivation: 大规模Cox回归的计算代价高昂，其目标涉及在庞大集合上的LogSumExp（归一化项）。常见的mini-batch归一化估计会产生有偏梯度，影响优化正确性与收敛速率；同时已有分析仅给出较慢的T^{-1/4}速率，且Cox中风险集嵌套结构未被充分利用。
AI.method: 1) 对LogSumExp目标采用softplus替代，每个归一化器引入一个辅助标量，从而支持无偏单样本梯度；2) 对光滑凸LogSumExp给出O(T^{-1/2})平均目标收敛分析，并在原变量上添加强凸正则时给出最后迭代\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})平方误差率（辅助变量无需强凸）；3) 针对Cox，利用风险集嵌套结构，将相邻失败事件分组并每组共享一个辅助变量，构造压缩目标；4) 建立一致的得分与曲率界以控制分组误差与softplus近似误差，并结合一般优化结论推导均方速率。
AI.result: 理论上，光滑凸情形取得O(T^{-1/2})平均目标界，较此前T^{-1/4}改进；强凸正则下最后迭代达到\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})平方误差率。Cox应用中，压缩估计相对全量Cox解的均方率（忽略对数因子）为T^{-4/5}，且其渐近分布与全量估计一致。在风险集缓慢缩减的合成与真实生存数据上，方法相对随机基线表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过softplus替代与辅助标量实现无偏随机梯度，并在Cox中利用嵌套风险集的分组压缩，兼顾了统计精度与计算效率；理论保证更强收敛速率且保持渐近等价性，实验验证了相对随机基线的性能优势。

title: Policy Iteration Is Not Strongly Polynomial for Deterministic Markov Decision Processes: The Price of Algorithmic Anarchy
summary: We establish an exponential iteration lower bound in the number of states for Howard's policy iteration on deterministic discounted Markov decision processes, with at most two actions per state. This rules out strong polynomiality of Howard's policy iteration when the discount factor is part of the input and yields an exponential separation from the simplex method with Dantzig's pivoting rule, which is proved to be strongly polynomial on this class. Even when each reward is restricted to logarithmic bit length, we obtain a stretched-exponential iteration lower bound. The gap between Howard's decentralized and simultaneous selfish improvements and Dantzig's coordinated selection of a single action with the largest gain across all states reveals a ``price'' of algorithmic anarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文将Howard策略迭代（HPI）在确定性折扣MDP上的迭代复杂度下界提升至指数级（状态数指数），证明其非强多项式，并与Dantzig规则的单纯形法形成指数分离，揭示了去中心化改进与协调式选择的"算法无政府代价"。
AI.motivation: Howard策略迭代在折扣MDP上被广泛使用，但其关于状态数的迭代复杂度上界长期未明（此前仅有强多项式或指数级下界的争议空间）。作者希望厘清HPI是否具有强多项式性，并与经典单纯形法在同类问题上的表现进行对比，从而刻画不同改进机制（去中心化自私改进 vs. 全局协调选择）的算法代价。
AI.method: 构造性下界分析：在每状态至多两个动作的确定性折扣MDP上，设计一族实例，将折扣因子作为输入的一部分，证明Howard策略迭代所需迭代次数随状态数指数增长；进一步在奖励限制为对数比特长度时给出stretched-exponential下界。同时对比Dantzig枢轴规则的单纯形法在该类问题上的强多项式性，进行指数分离论证。
AI.result: 得到Howard策略迭代关于状态数的指数迭代下界；据此排除其强多项式性（折扣因子计入输入时）；证明其与Dantzig规则单纯形法在该类问题上的指数分离，而单纯形法在此类上是强多项式的；在奖励为对数比特长度时仍得到stretched-exponential下界。
AI.conclusion: Howard策略迭代虽在实践中高效，但最坏情况下不具有强多项式性；其基于各状态同时自私改进（去中心化）的机制，与Dantzig规则跨状态协调选择最大增益单一动作的机制之间存在本质差距，作者将此差距刻画为"算法无政府"的代价（price of algorithmic anarchy）。

title: From Spectra to Joint Schedules in LLM Pre-training: 3+3(+2) Scaling-Law Regimes
summary: Power-law learning curves are often treated as fixed properties of a model and its data, although learning-rate and batch-size schedules can change the observed loss. We study this dependence in noisy online SGD with linear random features. Conditional on the representation, an exact Volterra equation separates two response components: a forcing term that propagates unresolved target error and a memory kernel that propagates stochastic-error injections. We prove that either component follows a power law if and only if its cumulative weighted spectral mass has the corresponding low-spectrum scaling; individual eigenvalues and target coefficients need not obey coordinatewise power laws. Under a joint schedule, intrinsic time $T_t=\sum_{s<t}η_s$ controls optimization progress, while $r_t=B_t/η_t$ controls noise injection. Their interaction yields sharp conditions under which a schedule preserves, changes, or destroys the clean power law, together with a memory ceiling on noise reduction. The power-law random-feature model realizes this mechanism in $3+3(+2)$ propagation regimes with phase-dependent compute rates. Controlled nanoGPT experiments show that (1) learning-rate and batch-size schedules with matched $B/η$ paths are nearly equivalent in intrinsic time, (2) a forcing-memory surrogate accurately predicts loss across schedules, and (3) its fitted exponents across real-world datasets identify the regime of LLMs in $3+3(+2)$ map.

AI.tldr: 本文在带线性随机特征的噪声在线SGD中，用精确Volterra方程将损失响应分解为传播目标误差的forcing项与传播随机噪声注入的memory核，证明各分量呈幂律当且仅当其累积加权谱质量具有相应低谱标度。联合调度下，intrinsic time T_t=∑η_s 控制优化进度，r_t=B_t/η_t 控制噪声注入，二者交互给出调度保持、改变或破坏干净幂律的锐利条件及噪声削减的memory上限。幂律随机特征模型实现3+3(+2)传播区域，nanoGPT实验验证匹配B/η路径的近等价性、forcing-memory代理的预测精度，并据此定位真实数据上LLM所处区域。
AI.motivation: 幂律学习曲线常被视为模型与数据的固有属性，但学习率与批大小调度会改变观测损失，其依赖机制尚缺乏统一刻画。
AI.method: 在噪声在线SGD中采用线性随机特征设定，条件于表示导出精确Volterra方程，将响应分离为forcing项与memory核；以intrinsic time T_t=∑_{s<t}η_s 和噪声注入比 r_t=B_t/η_t 描述联合调度，并在幂律随机特征模型与nanoGPT上进行理论与实验验证。
AI.result: 证明分量呈幂律等价于累积加权谱质量的低谱标度，无需逐坐标幂律；给出调度保持、改变或破坏幂律的锐利条件与memory噪声削减上限；幂律随机特征模型呈现3+3(+2)传播区域；nanoGPT实验显示匹配B/η路径的调度在intrinsic time下近乎等价，forcing-memory代理能准确预测跨调度损失，拟合指数可定位LLM所处区域。
AI.conclusion: 学习曲线幂律并非固定属性，而由谱结构与调度共同决定；intrinsic time与噪声注入比是核心控制量，统一的forcing-memory机制可解释并预测调度对幂律的影响。

title: Role-Adaptive Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Policy regularization in offline reinforcement learning balances policy improvement against reliance on uncertain value estimates. This balance can differ between selecting actions for execution and supplying actions for critic bootstrapping, yet methods such as TD3+BC couple these roles through a shared policy. We propose Role-Adaptive Policy Optimization (RAPO), which adapts policy-update coefficients according to their roles in value learning and execution. RAPO learns these coefficients by differentiating through candidate policy updates formed using the base algorithm's actor objective.
