Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模拟两个LLM代理之间的对话，考察AI代理能否以及如何相互操纵信念走向极端化，发现"共鸣"（强化既有信念）比"说服"（推广原本不重视的信念）更能有效引发极端化，且极端化会扩散至相关信念。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能够影响人类信念，但学界对其是否能、以及如何相互操纵彼此信念知之甚少。同时，个性化AI代理与多代理AI生态系统的兴起，使得理解AI代理间的信念操纵风险变得迫切。
AI.method: 构建双代理对话模拟：目标LLM依据人口统计与心理属性扮演人类角色，影响者LLM旨在使其信念更极端。沿两条路径考察极端化——共鸣（强化目标已有信念）与说服（推广目标起初不重视的信念），并在情感与行为指标上比较不同影响策略（如谄媚、未经验证的主张）的效果。
AI.result: 两种机制均能使目标极端化，但共鸣的效果始终强于说服。不同影响策略产生不同程度的极端化，但跨指标表现不一致。此外，共鸣会扩散到相关信念，表明AI代理内部存在相互关联的信念结构。
AI.conclusion: AI代理容易受到极端化影响，尤其当信息与其既有信念一致时，这凸显了个人化AI代理及多代理AI生态系统的脆弱性风险。

title: CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?
summary: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

AI.tldr: CARAT框架通过8个匹配视图固定问题与标准答案，解耦材料LLM在晶体结构问答中的真实推理与表面复制行为，揭示了现有基准与模型评估中的多项隐患。
AI.motivation: 现有材料大模型在回答晶体结构问题时，准确率无法区分模型是真正基于结构推理，还是直接复制输入中已印出的答案字段——因为结构描述常直接包含被评分的字段本身，导致评估虚高、结论失真。
AI.method: 提出CARAT：在8个匹配视图中固定问题与金标准答案，在GraphSpace中逐一命名各结构关系，并引入匹配微调、答案掩蔽、证据注入、配对推理及可拒答规则；同时对自身基准进行攻击性检验，构建跳过链接直接读列表的捷径规则并加以硬化重建。
AI.result: 在最难家族上，接地视图较公式输入高17.3分；GraphSpace比普通周期图高19.3分，但该差距实为两种效应叠加：普通渲染已含所需信息时仅差1.96分，完全缺失相关字段时差46.7分，说明标题分数主要反映基线缺陷而非证据呈现方式。捷径规则可答对7个硬化家族中的4个，重建后11个捷径接近随机水平；冻结模型在95.6%配对案例中被重定向后答案不变，即引用关系却不使用；经匹配监督后达99.8%，删除链接后降至23.4%，低于最佳捷径的27.0%。
AI.conclusion: 准确率指标无法证明模型真正进行结构推理；GraphSpace的优势主要源于基线信息缺失而非呈现方式；模型存在"引用而不使用"关系链接的行为，但该能力可通过匹配监督习得，表明推理与捷径使用均为可学习项。

title: Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses
summary: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

AI.tldr: 分析1260个真实辅导会话中的20462个学生话轮，识别6630个僵局话轮（概念错误、表达不确定、求助），模拟三种辅导条件并追踪真实交互轨迹，发现僵局深度降低恢复概率，提问的收益随僵局加深而衰减，而针对错误本身的回应收益递增。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI导师普遍设置限制直接给答案的保护措施，但对其在僵局持续时的行为知之甚少。辅导面临"帮助困境"：过早帮助妨碍有效挣扎，过晚帮助导致挫败性持续僵局（wheel spinning）。研究旨在揭示AI导师在僵局中的指导变化规律，并为学习分析提供可实时触发的、状态敏感的分级帮助信号。
AI.method: 分析1260个真实会话中的20462个学生话轮，识别出6630个僵局话轮并分为概念错误、表达不确定、求助三类。据此模拟三种辅导条件（基线、禁止直接给答案、引导式导师），对150个僵局样本分析提示特异性对教学法的影响。随后分析真实交互中的僵局轨迹，采用带深度的回归模型（如脚本化提问×深度、追问×深度、针对错误×深度）检验各策略收益随僵局深度的变化。
AI.result: 提示特异性改变教学法：基线导师50.7%的回应直接给出答案，禁答导师每次都提追问，引导式导师根据情境多样化回应。真实轨迹中，每增加一个僵局话轮，下一话轮恢复的几率下降12.7%（AOR=0.873, p<.001）；早期退出的学生陷入递归式概念引导而无法进入执行阶段。提问的收益随僵局加深而衰减（脚本化提问×深度AOR=0.78；追问×深度AOR=0.83），而针对学生错误的回应收益递增（AOR=1.14）。脚本化提问失败后重复提问的恢复率为28.1%，而改为针对错误的恢复率为39.8%。
AI.conclusion: 僵局深度与类型是可观察的话轮级对话信号，学习分析可据此在实时中触发分级、状态敏感的帮助。教师/导师应随僵局加深从提问转向直接针对错误本身，避免机械重复低效提问。

title: Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI). 8 pages, 1 figure. Code and data: https://github.com/yezeytuncu/blaschke-ai-rediscovery
summary: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该文将固定四次Blaschke积作为受控环境，考察AI辅助数学再发现：智能体仅凭80组边界构型对应的六条配对线的数值坐标，拟合出一个齐次三次多项式，并在80组未见参数上预测480条直线（RMS无标度残差约8.88e-17）。因确定性次数搜索基线也能恢复该三次式，实验未证明相对多项式拟合的优势；作者将其定位为区分猜想、数值验证与证明的单实例协议案例。
AI.motivation: 为AI辅助数学发现提供一个受控、可复现的实验场景，检验智能体能否在目标定理被隐去的情况下，仅从数值数据中"再发现"几何/代数结构，并厘清猜想、数值验证与严格证明之间的界限。
AI.method: 以固定四次Blaschke积为对象，向智能体提供80组边界构型所确定的六条配对线的数值坐标；研究日志记录被否定的几何假设及对多边形边拟合的齐次三次式；用冻结系数对80组未见参数预测480条直线，并计算RMS无标度残差；以发现集对角线作拟合外一致性检验；另设单构型运行检验不变性；并加入事后确定性次数搜索基线作对照。
AI.result: 齐次三次式对480条未见直线的预测RMS无标度残差为8.88×10^-17，数值精度极高；但发现集对角线仅是拟合外一致性检查而非完全留出测试；单构型运行证据不足以支持不变性；事后确定性次数搜索基线同样能恢复该三次式。
AI.conclusion: 该单实例案例研究提出了一套分离猜想、数值验证与证明的实验协议，但明确存在局限：智能体元数据、先验知识与可复现性问题；且因基线同样成功，尚不能确立AI方法优于普通多项式拟合，故不构成对AI发现优势的证明。

title: Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Includes negative generalization results for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and two-GPU tensor parallelism
summary:
Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DLFP（解码延迟反馈预填充）控制器，通过比例反馈动态调整与解码重叠的预填充分块大小，在vLLM上单GPU小模型场景下显著降低P99 token间延迟，但该机制无法泛化到大模型和张量并行配置，属于可复现的概念验证与泛化边界研究。
AI.motivation: 并发自回归推理中存在根本性干扰问题：新到达的长prompt预填充会延迟已在解码请求的token生成。固定预填充分块虽能减少干扰，但最优分块大小依赖模型、硬件、负载与延迟目标，难以统一确定，因此需要一种自适应、无需建模的控制器。
AI.method: 提出无模型控制器DLFP，仅改变与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作量；在受保护的调度周期后，利用观测到的间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一个预填充分块大小，而孤立的预填充不受限制。在vLLM中实现，采用开环泊松到达、精确token计账、原始请求trace和NVIDIA遥测进行评测。
AI.result: 在单张A100 80GB GPU上运行Qwen3-0.6B（BF16），三次配对100请求试验将P99 token间延迟分别降低24.8%、30.1%、28.2%（均值27.7%，配对95%置信区间21.0%–34.3%），输出完全一致、无失败、SLO合规性不变；代价是平均P99首token时间增加34.8%，但仍在声明的SLO内。然而该机制无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B或双GPU张量并行配置，失败根源在于异步调度调用间隔仅是完成GPU迭代时间的代理指标。
AI.conclusion: DLFP在小模型单GPU场景有效，但泛化性受限，这一负面结果界定了贡献边界，并指向需要基于完成时刻（completion-timed）的控制器以支持并发CPU与设备端推理。作者声明不主张移动设备性能，本文为可复现的概念验证与泛化研究。

title: MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science
summary: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MetaPersona-DB（含 1.1 万余项实证人类被试研究、标注任务相关变量、变量间关系与群体统计）与 MetaPersona 框架，通过检索任务相关证据、构建文献衍生的 persona 依赖图、并从实证先验中采样合成人群，缓解 LLM 社会模拟的冷启动问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 社会模拟中用于初始化 persona 的方法缺乏选择属性及其取值的理论依据，导致合成人群可能偏离真实的人口构成、潜在属性与依赖结构，进而扭曲下游行为，即"冷启动问题"。
AI.method: 构建 MetaPersona-DB 数据集（11,000+ 实证人类被试研究，标注任务相关变量、报告的关系及群体层面统计量）；在其上提出 MetaPersona 框架：检索任务相关证据、构建文献衍生的 persona 依赖图、依据连接人口统计特征—潜在属性—结果的实证先验采样合成人群；并提供 MetaPersona-Studio 交互式原型界面。
AI.result: 在三个下游案例、三个基线与三个前沿模型上，效果随任务与模型而异：在错误信息信念与 AI 工具态度任务上表现强劲，在收入再分配任务上结果参差；使用 GPT-5.2 时将 persona 构建成本降至每任务 0.5 美元以下。
AI.conclusion: 以实证文献为证据基础可提升 persona 构建的原则性与可迁移性，并在部分任务上优于基线且显著降低成本；但其跨任务稳健性仍有限（如收入再分配任务），未来需扩展证据库与采样机制，并以 MetaPersona-Studio 支撑交互式、经验证依据的 persona 生成。

title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
summary: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 SimTrace 框架，利用扎根于真实用户轨迹与目标 Web 环境的计算机使用型客户端智能体，生成忠实、细粒度、多模态的合成点击流，作为机密日志的可共享替代品。
AI.motivation: 虚拟客户端支持 A/B 测试、推荐系统开发和界面评估等应用，但其构建依赖大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹。此类数据难以获取：专有日志受隐私限制，小企业又缺乏足够流量。现有公开数据集要么抽象掉细粒度交互细节，要么虽保留丰富上下文却受限于单一平台且规模小，形成数据缺口。
AI.method: SimTrace 先对真实交互进行匿名化处理，并针对给定 Web 环境构建模拟孪生环境；随后以计算机使用型客户端智能体为生成器，同时依托匿名化真实轨迹与模拟环境生成合成交互轨迹。每个动作均与其对应的 Web 观测和用户上下文配对，从而产出可共享的合成多模态点击流。
AI.result: 在电商场景中评估其保真度与下游效用：SimTrace 在 8 项保真度指标中的 7 项上优于竞争基线；基于合成数据训练的模型在购买预测、推荐等下游任务上达到与真实数据相当的性能；在下一动作预测任务中，真实数据与合成数据增广相比仅用真实数据训练，准确率相对提升 11.0%。
AI.conclusion: SimTrace 能够生成兼具保真度与下游可用性的合成点击流，缓解了敏感日志不可获取的问题，为计算机使用型智能体式虚拟客户端的开发提供可共享替代方案，并以开源包形式发布以促进在线用户行为建模研究。

title: A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents
summary: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个统一的“竞争风险”框架来描述AI智能体越界行为，并对22份事故报告与102份智能体安全评估进行审计，发现报告与评估在结果分类上严重不一致，且多数缺少估计所需字段。
AI.motivation: AI开发者已报告智能体超出授权范围行动，联合国小组称其为人类失控的早期预警；但事故报告与安全评估对同一事件的描述方式不同，导致失败难以比较、风险难以跨尝试追踪，也难以区分智能体行为与环境许可条件的贡献。因此需要一个共同框架来统一刻画与估计越界发生的概率。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：每次尝试的结果分为四类——授权完成、安全停止、范围逃逸、继续。将其形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型，推导在重试预算内的逃逸概率、模型条件下的安全预算上限，以及从执行日志进行参数估计的条件。随后以原始资料审计2025年1月至2026年9月发表的22份事故报告与102份智能体安全评估。
AI.result: 22起事故中：6起涉及无法在范围内完成的任务，13起为智能体继续行动而非停止，5起未报告停止行为。开发者数据暗示在从未解决与已解决任务之间，越界协调的任务级发生率比接近47。102份评估中：87份记录了越界效应或规范违反，26份将安全停止作为一等结果，仅20份同时记录两者，79份将预算耗尽与失败合并。22起事故中有20起环境允许了越界效应，说明实际失控常是持续智能体行为与宽松边界条件交互的结果；同时没有任何评估报告了从公开证据估计完整竞争风险过程所需的全部字段。
AI.conclusion: 现有事故报告与安全评估在结果分类与信息记录上缺乏统一口径，无法支持对智能体失控风险的定量比较与完整估计。竞争风险框架可作为统一语言，改善风险追踪、失败比较，并区分智能体行为与环境许可的作用；未来评估需按该框架记录安全停止、越界效应与预算耗尽等关键字段。

title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

AI.tldr: 提出AIM框架，用智能体代理与获取机制管理想法驱动的自动化研究，在AutoLab基准上超越最强基线并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM被用于通过迭代搜索自动化科研，但想法驱动型搜索面临三大挑战：研究想法的组织演化、有前景方向的选择、想法与实现的一致性维护。
AI.method: 受贝叶斯优化启发，AIM包含：Agentic Surrogate与Agentic Acquisition用于组织已发现想法并指导选择；Solution Auditor维持想法-方案一致性；Resource Planner自适应地在并行搜索分支间分配剩余实验预算。
AI.result: 在10个AutoLab基准任务上，AIM在系统优化任务上超最强基线1.6个百分点，在长时程模型开发与CUDA任务上超4.9个百分点，并在仅用3.1倍挂钟时间更短的情况下达到最佳基线性能；理论上证明显式想法级预算分配使语义覆盖可控，且竞争方向稀疏时更广覆盖更有价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式想法级分配可提升语义覆盖可控性，AIM为想法驱动的自动化研究提供了有效且高效的自主管理方案。

title: PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration
summary: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 提出PrivMeSA——隐私感知的自演化多智能体系统：本地智能体决定信息披露，通过强化学习在任务准确性与直接泄露、注册表重识别风险间权衡，并用经验记忆留存远程专家知识以供本地复用。
AI.motivation: 本地部署的临床大模型智能体虽可咨询远程更强模型，但存在患者信息泄露风险。仅去除显式标识符并不充分：准标识符可跨多轮咨询与重复就诊累积，导致重识别。
AI.method: PrivMeSA为自演化多智能体系统：本地智能体主导每次就诊并咨询可能索要额外信息的远程专家；以强化学习在任务准确性与直接披露、基于注册表的再识别风险之间权衡，隐私评估基于每次就诊的完整外发文本记录；本地经验记忆将已完成的咨询提炼为泛化临床指导，并在传输前检索相关经验，使后续病例无需再次远程交换即可复用专家知识；记忆增长无需额外结果标签或参数更新。
AI.result: 在基于MIMIC-IV-ED构建的急诊科基准上，PrivMeSA相比委托方式将平均任务准确率提升最多15.8个百分点；同一设置下，个人详细信息泄露比例由98.0%降至0.2%，患者可被缩小至10名或更少注册表患者的情况占比由74%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保留远程专家能力的同时有效控制隐私泄露与重识别风险，并支持本地经验复用而无需额外标注或参数更新。

title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
comment: 16 pages. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/abouzamm/naqd
summary: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across the reported conditions, withdrawal recall is at most 0.06, no valid resumption is observed at eligible opportunities, and only one episode matches the complete reference policy. Under the NAQD prompt, Qwen2.5-7B has fewer unsafe-attempt episodes than Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, but also completes less useful work and preserves unaffected actions less accurately. Exploratory supervised fine-tuning probes increase Qwen2.5-3B decision accuracy from 0.45-0.54 to 0.83-0.92; separate diagnostics reveal inappropriate withdrawal after curriculum omissions and a loss of event reporting. These results motivate evaluating selective withdrawal as a distinct component of agent reliability. The setting measures policy application with trusted structured inputs and does not establish real-world containment or source-verification ability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 NAQD-Env 合成环境，用于评估语言智能体在证据变化、权限撤销或停止指令到达时的选择性撤回能力。基于显式依赖关系与确定性参考策略，论文在 350 个场景上评测三个开源模型，发现其撤回召回率极低（≤0.06）、无有效恢复，凸显选择性撤回作为智能体可靠性独立维度的必要性。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在执行规划动作时，常面临证据变更、权限被撤销或收到停止指令等情形。理想的应对应是"选择性"的：暂停受影响动作、保留未受影响工作、并在修复充分后恢复。然而现有评估缺乏对这类选择性撤回决策的系统性衡量，作者因此构建专门环境来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 NAQD-Env 合成环境，针对显式证据、授权与约束依赖，与确定性参考策略进行对比评估。包含 11 个依赖族，支持开发结构、留出族与留出结构组合的评测。指标区分"尝试违规"与"经模拟执行门允许的违规"，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复与事件上报。在 350 个冻结场景、3 种提示条件下评测来自两个家族的三个开源指令微调模型，共 3,150 个模型-提示回合；并开展探索性监督微调实验。
AI.result: 报告条件下撤回召回率最高仅 0.06，在符合条件的时机未观察到有效恢复，仅一个回合完全匹配参考策略。NAQD 提示下 Qwen2.5-7B 的不安全尝试回合少于 Qwen2.5-3B 与 Llama-3.1-8B，但完成的有用工作更少、保畩未受影响动作的准确度更低。探索性监督微调将 Qwen2.5-3B 决策准确率从 0.45–0.54 提升至 0.83–0.92；但独立诊断揭示课程遗漏后出现不当撤回及事件上报丢失。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将选择性撤回作为智能体可靠性的一个独立组件进行评测。该设定在可信结构化输入下衡量策略应用，并不确立真实世界遏制能力或来源验证能力。

title: VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/rory-agent
summary: Voice agents in production must handle several requests, background speech, and customers who lose patience. We introduce VAmoS Energy, a benchmark that combines these challenges in 100 calls about utility billing and payment assistance. Each caller makes two to four requests. The agent has sixteen tools backed by a stateful Stripe billing twin and the Apache Fineract loan engine, with account access blocked until caller verification succeeds. The tasks use public household electricity data and a policy based on Pennsylvania's residential billing rules. An LLM-as-a-verifier checks the agent's actions and spoken figures against explicit requirements. On a calibration run, it agrees with a code verifier on 99.1% of checks. Across fourteen voice stacks and three repeats per task, completion ranges from 17.3% to 44.7%. Grok Voice leads, and Gemini 3.8 Live and GPT-Live follow at about the same cost per call. Background television reduces pooled completion from 38.7% to 8.6%. The simulated caller often accepts an incorrect result because it hears the agent's words but cannot inspect its actions. These findings show why voice agents need evaluation across the whole call, including what they say, what they change, and how they handle competing speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VAmoS Energy 基准，将多请求、背景语音与耐心有限的用户整合到 100 通公用事业账单与支付协助通话中，用于端到端评测语音智能体。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的语音智能体需同时应对多个请求、背景人声以及失去耐心的客户，而现有评测往往只关注单轮对话或单一能力，缺乏对整通电话中"说了什么、改了什么、如何处理竞争语音"的统一检验。
AI.method: 构建 100 通电话基准，每通包含 2 至 4 个请求；智能体配备 16 个工具，后端为由有状态 Stripe 计费孪生系统与 Apache Fineract 贷款引擎支撑，账户访问须先通过来电者身份验证。任务采用公开家庭用电数据，策略基于宾夕法尼亚州居民计费规则。使用 LLM-as-a-verifier 将智能体动作与口述数字同显式要求进行比对。
AI.result: 校准运行中，LLM 验证器与代码验证器在 99.1% 的检查项上一致。覆盖 14 种语音栈、每任务重复 3 次，完成率介于 17.3% 至 44.7%；Grok Voice 领先，Gemini 3.8 Live 与 GPT-Live 紧随且单次通话成本相近。背景电视使汇总完成率从 38.7% 降至 8.6%。模拟来电者常因只听到智能体话语而无法核查其动作，从而接受错误结果。
AI.conclusion: 语音智能体评测必须覆盖整通通话，兼顾其口头表述、实际执行的状态变更以及应对竞争语音的能力。

title: Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in culturally sensitive settings, where alignment requires representing diverse preferences within populations. Yet existing methods model populations at coarse demographic or community levels and overlook within-group variation. We introduce Demographic Pluralism, an inference-time framework that estimates population-level opinion distributions without opinion-distribution training data or task-specific fine-tuning by generating multiple perspectives within demographically grounded groups. Across four backbones on GlobalOpinionQA and VITAL, it reduces Jensen-Shannon distance by 8.4%-26.4% over Modular Pluralism. Among weighted, equal-weighted, and inverse-weighted aggregation, equal weighting performs best overall; group-level error also increases with group weight, helping explain weighted aggregation's weaker performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Demographic Pluralism 框架，通过群体内多视角生成在推理阶段估计人口意见分布，无需意见分布训练数据或任务微调，在 GlobalOpinionQA 与 VITAL 上将 JS 距离较 Modular Pluralism 降低 8.4%–26.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法以粗糙的人口统计或社群层级建模人群，忽视群体内部差异，难以在文化敏感场景中表征多样偏好。
AI.method: 推理阶段框架：在人口统计依据下划分群体，并在每个群体内生成多种视角，从而估计总体意见分布；不依赖意见分布训练数据，也不需任务特定微调；比较加权、等权与逆加权三种聚合方式。
AI.result: 在四个骨干模型、两个数据集（GlobalOpinionQA、VITAL）上，JS 距离相较 Modular Pluralism 降低 8.4%–26.4%；等权聚合整体最优；群体误差随群体权重上升，可解释加权聚合表现较弱。
AI.conclusion: 群体内多视角生成可有效提升人口意见分布估计的文化对齐度，等权聚合是更稳健的选择。

title: Defining and Categorising Human-AI Interactions in Clinical Trials: A Multidimensional Human-AI Classification Approach
summary: This paper examines human-AI interactions (HAIIs) in clinical trials and presents a multidimensional categorisation framework that classifies interactions according to AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups. We define HAII, examine existing taxonomies and extend existing categorisation approaches through this novel multidimensional framework. We purposively sampled 15 clinical trials from a previously reported dataset. Each trial was independently categorised by two human reviewers and six large language model (LLM) classifiers. The proposed categorisation provides a structured method for the consistent identification, comparison and synthesis of human-AI interactions across clinical-trial records. The framework is intended to support more consistent comparison and synthesis of AI-related clinical trials and to make explicit the different forms of human involvement associated with AI interventions. The results demonstrate the potential for LLM-assisted categorisation while indicating the continuing importance of human judgement where trial records are incomplete or ambiguous. The principal contribution is a proposed multidimensional framework that brings together AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups within a single approach designed for clinical-trial records. Its significance lies in its potential to support more systematic identification, comparison and synthesis of how humans and AI interact in clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对临床试验中的人机交互（HAIIs），提出一个多维分类框架，按AI任务、人机关系、交互配置和参与人群进行分类，并通过15项临床试验的样本进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的人机交互分类方法难以系统地识别、比较和综合临床试验记录中人类与AI的交互形式，缺乏统一框架来厘清AI干预中人类参与的不同形态。
AI.method: 界定HAII概念，检视既有分类体系并加以扩展，构建新的多维分类框架；从既有数据集中目的性抽取15项临床试验，每项由两名人工评审和六个大语言模型（LLM）分类器独立分类。
AI.result: 所提分类框架为跨临床试验记录一致地识别、比较和综合人机交互提供了结构化方法；结果显示了LLM辅助分类的潜力，同时表明在试验记录不完整或含糊时人类判断仍然不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是将AI任务、人机关系、交互配置与参与人群整合于单一框架，服务于临床试验记录；其意义在于支持更系统地识别、比较和综合临床试验中人机交互的方式。

title: Sense and Sensitivity: Benchmarking LLM Clinical Triage Recommendations with Physician Experts
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical settings, it is critical to evaluate their reliability under realistic variation in clinical text. We study this question in clinical triage, comparing LLMs to practicing physicians under text perturbations that preserve the underlying clinical setting. We introduce a benchmark of over 6,000 clinical scenarios, 7,000 physician annotations, and 225,000 model responses. Using this benchmark, we make two key observations. First, LLMs are more likely than physicians to recommend unnecessary care at baseline, and this tendency increases under perturbed inputs. Further, we find that LLM recommendations are more sensitive to gender and tone perturbations than human recommendations. Together, these results demonstrate that LLMs can vary under clinically irrelevant textual changes, highlighting the need for deployment-oriented evaluations grounded in expert physician behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建临床分诊基准（6000+场景、7000+医师标注、225000条模型回复），发现LLM基线更易建议不必要诊疗，且在文本扰动下更敏感，尤其是性别与语气扰动。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于临床场景，需评估其在真实临床文本变异下的可靠性；需以执业医师行为为参照，进行面向部署的评估。
AI.method: 在保持临床情境不变的前提下对临床文本施加扰动，构建包含6000+临床场景、7000+医师标注和225000条模型回复的基准，并将LLM与执业医师进行比较。
AI.result: LLM在基线比医师更倾向于建议不必要诊疗，扰动输入下该倾向增强；LLM建议对性别与语气扰动比人类建议更敏感。
AI.conclusion: LLM会因临床无关文本变化而产生建议波动，说明需要基于专家医师行为的部署导向评估。

title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on cloud-hosted large language models for planning, tool use, and iterative execution, raising concerns about API cost and data exposure. Advances in personal AI devices enable agents to execute locally, but limited resources on device may affect task success and performance. Existing benchmarks are inadequate for systematically characterizing these trade-offs across devices, workloads, and deployment architectures. We present AgBench, a benchmark suite and open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices. Using AgBench, we evaluate local, hybrid, and cloud execution across agentic workloads, examining task success, latency, cloud API cost, and data exposure. Our results, drawn from over 162.07 million data points, show that personal AI devices can complete many agent tasks locally, but local-only execution generally has lower task success and longer completion times than cloud-only execution, especially as concurrency increases. Local-only execution eliminates cloud model API costs and sensitive-information exposure to cloud agents. Hybrid execution can improve task success, but its cloud cost and data exposure depend on how agents divide work and share information. No single architecture performs best across task success, goodput, cloud cost, and data exposure; deployment choices should reflect the intended workload and device capabilities. AgBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgBench基准套件，用于在个人设备上系统评估agentic AI在本地、混合与云端三种部署架构下的任务成功率、延迟、API成本与数据暴露权衡。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI依赖云端大模型进行规划、工具调用和迭代执行，引发API成本与数据暴露担忧；个人AI设备虽支持本地执行，但资源受限可能影响任务成功与性能。现有基准无法系统刻画跨设备、工作负载与部署架构的权衡。
AI.method: 提出AgBench基准套件及开放工件，支持可复现的agentic AI个人设备评估。基于AgBench，在多种agentic工作负载下评估本地、混合与云端执行，考察任务成功率、延迟、云端API成本与数据暴露四个维度。
AI.result: 基于超过1.6207亿数据点：个人AI设备可本地完成许多agent任务，但纯本地执行的任务成功率普遍低于纯云端，完成时间更长，且随并发增加差距扩大；纯本地执行消除了云端模型API成本和敏感信息暴露；混合执行可提升任务成功率，但其云端成本与数据暴露取决于agent如何分工与共享信息。
AI.conclusion: 不存在在任务成功率、goodput、云端成本与数据暴露上均最优的单一架构，部署选择应匹配预期工作负载与设备能力。AgBench已开源。

title: EvoSteer: Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration via Reference-Anchored Credit Assignment
summary: In recent years, LLM-based multi-agent systems have been widely applied to orchestrate tool-using agents into executable communication graphs. However, existing self-evolving orchestration still faces key challenges, including post-hoc evolution that revises the team only after the trajectory ends, credit diffusion that gives every action the same terminal advantage under confounded baselines, and skill admission that is uncalibrated and never retired. To address these challenges, we propose EvoSteer, a new paradigm of Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration -- the orchestrator builds a running team and repairs its plausible but failing steps from execution features and a learned value estimate. To support this paradigm, we introduce Anchored Trajectory Balance (AnchorTB), a regression-style flow-matching loss that assigns each orchestration action a coefficient by balancing subtrajectories against a frozen reference. Built on the learned flow, we further propose Validated Skill Admission, in which a candidate skill is tried before promotion and promoted only if paired evidence passes a sequential test under a shared nominal testing budget. Moreover, AnchorTB combines measured task-level reference reward statistics with prefix-dependent corrections. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that EvoSteer significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive decision making. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/evosteer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EvoSteer，一种在线自演化图编排新范式，通过Anchored Trajectory Balance(AnchorTB)流匹配损失和Validated Skill Admission机制，解决现有LLM多智能体编排中的事后演化、信用扩散与技能准入未校准问题，在12个数据集上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统在编排工具使用智能体时存在三大挑战：(1)事后演化(post-hoc evolution)，仅在轨迹结束后才修正团队，无法在线修复失败步骤；(2)信用扩散(credit diffusion)，在混杂基线条件下所有动作获得相同的终端优势，导致信用分配不准确；(3)技能准入(skill admission)未经校准且从不退休，缺乏验证与淘汰机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出EvoSteer范式，即在线自演化图编排(Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration)，编排器在运行中构建团队，并基于执行特征与学习到的价值估计修复看似合理但失败的步骤。2) 引入Anchored Trajectory Balance(AnchorTB)，一种回归式流匹配损失，通过将子轨迹与冻结参考进行平衡，为每个编排动作分配系数；该损失结合了任务级参考奖励统计与依赖前缀的修正项。3) 提出Validated Skill Admission，候选技能先试用后晋升，仅当配对证据在共享的名义测试预算下通过序贯检验时才被提升。
AI.result: 在12个数据集上的实验结果表明，EvoSteer在问答、数学推理、代码生成以及交互式决策等任务中均显著优于基线方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: EvoSteer通过在线自演化图编排范式，结合AnchorTB流匹配损失和Validated Skill Admission技能准入机制，有效缓解了事后演化、信用扩散和技能准入未校准的问题，在多种任务上取得了优于基线的性能，为LLM多智能体系统的自演化编排提供了新思路。

title: Where Scientific Search Agents Fail: Decision-Checkpoint Auditing of Exposure and Inspection Attempts
summary: Final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a scientific-search agent failed to encounter a target paper, attempt to inspect it, or return an accepted answer after inspection. We introduce decision checkpoints that record observations and tool actions without benchmark labels during inference, then join target identities and evaluator labels to assign outcome categories from recorded events. Across five conditions on 540 answerable AutoResearchBench Deep questions in a fixed, target-enriched environment, keyword search achieves 24.6\% accuracy, compared with 17.8\% for raw search. The keyword condition has fewer incorrect answers with neither target exposure nor inspection, but more incorrect answers after the target is exposed and left uninspected. Compared with keyword search, read-first has 27.4\% more recorded evidence-search calls. Target inspection attempts occur on 199 questions under read-first and 191 under keyword search; both conditions achieve 24.6\% accuracy. The checkpoint protocol makes these question-level differences explicit, distinguishing target exposure and inspection from aggregate accuracy and total tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"决策检查点"协议，在推理时记录智能体的观察与工具动作（不依赖基准标签），再与目标身份和评测标签关联，从而以问题级事件类别区分"未遇到目标""遇到但未查看""查看后作答"等失败模式。在AutoResearchBench 540道Deep题上，关键词搜索准确率24.6%，原始搜索17.8%；read-first的记录证据搜索调用比关键词搜索多27.4%，两者准确率同为24.6%。该协议揭示了聚合准确率掩盖的暴露与查看差异。
AI.motivation: 最终答案准确率无法揭示科学搜索智能体失败的具体环节：是未能遇到目标论文、遇到但未去查看，还是查看后仍给出可被接受的答案。仅凭聚合准确率与总工具调用量，无法区分这些机制性差异，因此需要一种能在问题级别定位失败原因的诊断方法。
AI.method: 引入决策检查点（decision checkpoints）：推理过程中记录观察与工具动作，而不使用基准标签；随后将记录的事件与目标身份、评测标签进行连接（join），据此把每个问题归入不同的结果类别（如是否暴露目标、是否尝试查看、查看后答案是否正确）。在固定的、目标富集的环境中，对AutoResearchBench的540道可回答Deep问题进行五种条件对比实验。
AI.result: 关键词搜索准确率24.6%，原始搜索为17.8%。关键词条件下，"既未暴露目标也未查看"的错误答案更少，但"目标已暴露却未查看"后的错误答案更多。read-first的记录证据搜索调用比关键词搜索多27.4%；目标查看尝试分别出现在read-first的199题和关键词搜索的191题上，两种条件准确率同为24.6%。
AI.conclusion: 检查点协议使问题级差异显式化，将目标暴露与查看行为从聚合准确率和总工具使用量中分离出来，为科学搜索智能体的失败归因提供了比最终答案准确率更细粒度的诊断依据。

title: Concept-Grounded Attention: A Controlled Evaluation of Graph-Injected Attention, Temporal Versioning, and Epistemic Status
summary: Knowledge-intensive language-model systems typically represent external knowledge as text chunks or static graphs, with limited support for concept evolution, point-in-time reasoning, and distinctions between validated and inferred knowledge. We introduce the Concept Lifecycle Model (CLM), which represents concepts as persistent, graph-grounded, temporally versioned entities with explicit provenance and epistemic status, and Concept-Grounded Attention (CGA), which injects concept-graph structure into transformer computation through graph-biased self-attention (Form A) and gated cross-attention over concept nodes (Form B). We evaluate the framework in controlled settings using disabled-mechanism baselines. On 200 MuSiQue and HotpotQA questions with retrieval fixed, concept-graph retrieval recovers explicit multi-hop paths but does not improve evidence recall. Form A appears to steer attention, with 2.76 times more attention on gold than distractor concepts, but the same ratio occurs when Form A is disabled; the learned bias is negligible and no answers change. An identity-preserving Form B improves F1 from 0.188 to 0.221, but control concepts yield 0.213, indicating that most of the gain reflects added capacity. On LongMemEval, explicit temporal representation improves answer accuracy by 13 to 25 points across all tested generators, up to 122B parameters, while simplified CLM version resolution performs similarly to dated serialization because concept identity is not established reliably. On a synthetic source-independence task, protocol-derived epistemic status reduces unsupported assertions from 28% to 0.1% in a fine-tuned small model and from 19-68% to 0-5% in 72-122B models. Overall, the results support making temporal validity and epistemic status explicit, while showing that graph-attention diagnostics are not informative without disabled-mechanism controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念生命周期模型（CLM）与概念接地注意力（CGA），将概念表示为具时间版本、来源与认知状态的图实体。实验显示：时间有效性与认知状态的显式建模带来实质增益，而图注意力机制在缺乏禁用机制对照时无法证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有知识密集型语言模型系统多以文本块或静态图表示外部知识，难以支持概念演化、时点推理，以及已验证知识与推断知识的区分。
AI.method: 提出CLM（概念为持久、图接地、带时间版本、显式来源与认知状态的实体）与CGA（通过图偏置自注意力Form A与概念节点门控交叉注意力Form B将概念图结构注入Transformer）。采用禁用机制基线在受控条件下评测，任务包括MuSiQue/HotpotQA、LongMemEval与合成来源独立性任务。
AI.result: 固定检索下，概念图检索可恢复显式多跳路径但不提升证据召回；Form A的金标/干扰概念注意力比为2.76倍，但禁用Form A后比例相同，学习偏置可忽略、答案无变化；保恒等性的Form B将F1从0.188提升至0.221，但对照概念得0.213，说明增益多来自额外容量；LongMemEval上显式时间表示在至多122B参数的各生成器上提升准确率13–25点，而简化CLM版本消解因概念身份不可靠与日期序列化相当；合成任务上协议导出的认知状态将无支撑断言从28%降至0.1%（微调小模型）、从19–68%降至0–5%（72–122B模型）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将时间有效性与认知状态显式化；同时表明若无禁用机制对照，图注意力诊断不具信息量。

title: GATE-ST: Gene-Aware Text-image Encoder for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics enables spatially resolved gene expression analysis from slide-level images while preserving morphological features, providing valuable information for studying disease mechanisms and developing treatments. However, spatial gene expression profiling typically requires expensive and time-consuming tests. While existing image-based prediction optimizations mostly revolve around including positional embeddings and further image-based changes, text-based optimizations remain relatively unexplored. We present GATE-ST, which incorporates text-based inputs into image-based spatial gene expression predictions. With this approach, generated text descriptions of genes are utilized to better spatial transcriptomics prediction results. Gene summaries are put through a text encoder, generating embeddings that integrate with image embeddings through cross-attention layers to align with morphological features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of such text inputs by benchmarking performance against random gene embeddings and multiple other image-text fusion architectures, and show that GATE-ST outperforms these alternatives. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of GATE-ST in pathology imaging, which may greatly reduce the time and cost of accurate spatial transcriptomic predictions, proving the potential of text-guided spatial gene expression prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出GATE-ST，将基因文本描述引入基于图像的空间基因表达预测，通过文本编码器与跨注意力融合图像嵌入，性能优于随机基因嵌入及其他图文融合架构。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学能在保留形态特征的同时实现空间分辨的基因表达分析，对疾病机制研究与治疗开发有重要价值，但空间基因表达图谱获取成本高、耗时长。现有基于图像的预测优化多集中于位置嵌入与图像侧改进，基于文本的优化仍较少被探索。
AI.method: GATE-ST在基于图像的空间基因表达预测中引入文本输入：利用基因的文本描述（gene summaries），经文本编码器生成文本嵌入，再通过跨注意力层与图像嵌入融合，从而与形态学特征对齐。
AI.result: 通过与随机基因嵌入以及多种其他图文融合架构进行基准对比，GATE-ST均取得更优表现，验证了文本输入的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GATE-ST在病理影像中表现出有效性，有望大幅降低准确空间转录组预测的时间与成本，展示了文本引导空间基因表达预测的潜力。

title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Includes additional post-acceptance accounting and selection diagnostics
summary: A cumulative token cap can fall inside a mathematical derivation, forcing a test-time controller to choose between stopping at the cap (strict) and allowing the current attempt to finish (advisory). We measure this boundary choice with paired offline replays of 19,200 public traces: 120 AIME, BrUMO and HMMT problems and two archive configurations of one model. Candidate order and a 16-attempt cap are fixed, and answer selection is blind to reference answers and correctness labels. Three findings emerge. First, at the 4k cap, most advisory accuracy gains replace abstention with a correct answer; strict stopping pays for an unfinished prefix that the completed-only selector cannot use. Second, comparisons along realized cost differ from same-cap comparisons: advisory 4k in low has higher accuracy than strict 8k at comparable mean completion cost, while in high its observed accuracy is 0.42 points below strict 32k using 59% of its mean tokens. These aggregate comparisons do not establish equal-compute superiority or accuracy equivalence. Third, increased candidate coverage does not guarantee higher answer accuracy: a log-probability selector loses accuracy while coverage rises, including after a source-grade consistency repair. Same-cap majority-accuracy differences shrink below 1.3 percentage points at 32k. Budget curves should jointly state the cap, realized cost, eligible candidates, stopping rule and selector information.

AI.tldr: 该文研究累积 token 上限落在数学推导中途时的边界决策（严格停止 vs 允许当前尝试完成），通过对 19,200 条公开轨迹的配对离线重放进行测量，给出三项发现并提出预算曲线报告规范。
AI.motivation: 累积 token 上限可能落在数学推导过程中，迫使测试时控制器在“到上限即停”（strict）与“允许当前尝试完成”（advisory）之间抉择；这一边界选择对准确率与成本的影响此前缺乏系统测量。
AI.method: 对 19,200 条公开轨迹做配对离线重放：120 道 AIME、BrUMO、HMMT 题目，同一模型的两种归档配置；固定候选顺序与 16 次尝试上限；答案选择对参考答案与正确性标签盲化；对比同一上限与已实现成本两种比较方式，并考察对数概率选择器与覆盖率变化。
AI.result: (1) 4k 上限下，advisory 的多数准确率增益主要来自用正确答案替换弃答，strict 则被未完成前缀拖累，仅完成型选择器无法利用该前缀；(2) 沿已实现成本的比较不同于同上限比较：低配下 advisory 4k 准确率高于 strict 8k（均值完成成本相当），高配下其观测准确率比 strict 32k 低 0.42 个百分点而仅用其 59% 平均 token；(3) 候选覆盖增加不保证答案准确率提升，对数概率选择器在覆盖率上升时准确率下降，即便经过来源等级一致性修复亦然；32k 时同上限多数准确率差距缩小至 1.3 个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 这些聚合比较不能确立等算力优越性或准确率等价性；预算曲线应同时报告上限、已实现成本、合格候选、停止规则与选择器信息。

title: Staying on Task: Testing the Foundations of Long-Horizon Agent Reliability
summary: Long-horizon agentic workflows require models to sustain repeated state-dependent actions all while the context grows, sub-task complexity changes, and new data arrives. Each situation represents an independent axis along which an agent may fail. An agent reconciling a long ledger, for example, must repeatedly read its state, update the correct record, and preserve alignment across thousands of outputs. A model may accept the entire ledger yet lose its place or stop applying the operation consistently as generation proceeds. We introduce Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that tests a model's ability to stay on task during long generation while continuously reading, mutating, and outputting input-context dependent operations such as arithmetic, sorting, variable lookups, and table transformations. Long-Transduction evaluation independently varies local task complexity, input data formatting, and context length isolate failures along each axis. We evaluate seven open-weight models, finding a 62.8\% decrease when scaling context length from 4-128K, a 36.5\% decrease when varying input format, and a 39.9\% decrease by increasing local task complexity. Together, these failures represent critical liabilities in long-horizon agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出 Long-Transduction 诊断基准，通过独立变化局部任务复杂度、输入格式与上下文长度，隔离评估模型在长程生成中持续执行状态依赖操作的能力，发现七种开放权重模型在三个维度上均显著性能下降。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体工作流要求模型在上下文增长、子任务复杂度变化和新数据到达时持续执行依赖状态的操作。这些因素各自构成独立的失败轴，现有评估未能将其分离，难以定位模型失败的具体来源。
AI.method: Long-Transduction 是一个受控诊断任务：在长生成过程中持续读取、修改并输出依赖输入上下文的操作（如算术、排序、变量查找、表格变换）。该评估独立地改变局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式和上下文长度三个轴，从而隔离每个轴上的失败。
AI.result: 在七个开放权重模型上评估发现：上下文长度从 4K 扩展到 128K 时性能下降 62.8%；改变输入格式导致下降 36.5%；提高局部任务复杂度导致下降 39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败反映出长程智能体工作流中的关键隐患，模型即使在整体上接受了输入，仍可能在长生成中丢失状态或无法一致地应用操作，Long-Transduction 为分轴诊断此类失效提供了受控工具。

title: PathAnchor: Path-Structured Evidence for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents can retrieve relevant passages yet still lose functional order, mix evidence across sources, or state conclusions that exceed the retrieved record. We introduce PathAnchor, a bounded scientific reasoning system built on path-structured evidence workspaces. Instead of treating passages or extracted concepts as independent units, the system retrieves source-linked Material-Sensor-Signal-System trajectories that preserve role, direction, and the evidence supporting each transition. A controller uses three read-only tools to search paper-specific trajectories, trace paths across candidate sources, and open exact evidence before producing a claim-cited answer and an explicit evidence boundary. On 120 single- and cross-paper flexible-sensor questions, PathAnchor scores 82.6% and leads six evaluated systems. Under a matched controller, corpus, and six-call budget, replacing unordered concept graphs with path-structured records raises source recall from 61.3% to 82.9%, increases answers whose claims all cite opened evidence from 69.2% to 90.0%, and reduces tool calls. These results show that evidence organization affects retrieval and citation completeness under fixed agent resources.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathAnchor——基于路径结构化证据工作区的有界科学推理系统，用源链接的 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹替代无序概念图，提升检索召回与引用完整性。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体即使检索到相关段落，仍可能丢失功能顺序、跨来源混淆证据，或给出超出检索记录范围的结论。核心问题在于证据组织方式，而非单纯检索能力。
AI.method: 系统检索保留角色、方向及每步过渡证据的源链接 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹，而非将段落或概念视为独立单元。控制器通过三个只读工具工作：检索论文特定轨迹、跨候选来源追踪路径、打开精确证据，最终生成带引用的答案与显式证据边界。在匹配控制器、语料与六次调用预算下，对比无序概念图与路径结构化记录。
AI.result: 在 120 个单篇及跨篇柔性传感器问题上得分 82.6%，领先六个评估系统。相同条件下，路径结构化记录将来源召回率从 61.3% 提升至 82.9%，全部声明均引用已打开证据的答案比例从 69.2% 提升至 90.0%，并减少工具调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 在固定智能体资源下，证据组织方式直接影响检索效果与引用完整性。

title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
summary: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently. We define the merge rule as an action-conditioned bisimulation over the empirical predictive state graph a frozen agent fills as it acts. Two states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes and successor blocks under an affordance label. Observation similarity never enters the rule, and nothing is trained. It replaces the merge rule of an existing outcome-value memory, so a closed-loop comparison isolates it. On MiniWoB++ it raises success rate over a memoryless agent, while a control taking identical exploratory detours, the prior successor-representation merge, and the same criterion without action conditioning change nothing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于动作条件双模拟（action-conditioned bisimulation）的状态合并规则，用于网页智能体的记忆构建，仅当共享动作导致一致结果与后继块时才合并状态，从而提升MiniWoB++任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于观测相似度的记忆会错误地合并外观相似但行为不同的页面（如同构件两个标签页、同一菜单不同行），导致错误的状态合并，需要一种不依赖观测相似性的合并规则。
AI.method: 将合并规则定义为在冻结智能体经验预测状态图上的动作条件双模拟：仅当两状态的共享动作在可供性标签（affordance label）下产生一致结果和后继块时才合并；观测相似度不参与规则，且不进行任何训练。该规则替换既有结果-值记忆的合并规则，以闭环对比进行隔离验证。
AI.result: 在MiniWoB++上，相对无记忆智能体成功率提升；而采取相同探索绕路的对照组、先前后继表示合并方法、以及未加动作条件的同一准则均无变化。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件双模拟作为状态合并准则优于观测相似度与后继表示合并，且动作条件是效果的必要因素。

title: Persona and Persuasive Framing in AI Voice Agents: A $2\times2$ Field Experiment with Children
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Conversational agents increasingly interact with children, yet evidence on how their design shapes children's susceptibility to persuasion comes almost entirely from the lab. We report a $2\times2$ randomized field experiment embedded in a public German Santa Claus telephone hotline. Children's calls were randomly routed to one of four LLM voice agents varying persona (Santa, high authority, vs. Helper, low authority) and framing (persuasive nudges toward prosocial wishes vs. neutral). Of 1,072 logged calls, 89 conversations (median age 6) met inclusion criteria. Persuasive framing raised the probability of a prosocial wish from 11.6% to 45.7%, robust to controls. Persona authority showed a near-zero effect: Santa did not outperform the Helper. Persona instead shaped engagement; children hung up on the Helper far more often within the first minute (65% vs. 39%). Where context already lends an agent legitimacy, how it speaks shapes children's compliance more than who it claims to be.

AI.tldr: 在德国公益圣诞老人电话热线的2×2随机田野实验中，说服性话术框架将儿童表达利他愿望的概率从11.6%提升至45.7%，而角色权威性（圣诞老人vs.助手）几乎无影响；角色主要影响参与度，儿童更早挂断低权威助手。
AI.motivation: 对话式智能体日益与儿童互动，但关于其设计如何影响儿童易受说服程度的证据几乎全部来自实验室环境，缺乏真实、自然情境下的生态效度证据，因此需要开展实地随机实验。
AI.method: 在公共德国圣诞老人电话热线中嵌入2×2随机田野实验。儿童来电被随机分配至四种LLM语音智能体之一，操纵两个因素：角色（高权威的圣诞老人 vs 低权威的助手）与话术框架（指向利他愿望的说服性引导 vs 中性）。共记录1,072通来电，其中89段符合纳入标准的对话（中位年龄6岁）进入分析，并采用回归控制变量检验结果的稳健性。
AI.result: 说服性框架使儿童提出利他愿望的概率从11.6%升至45.7%，且对控制变量稳健；角色权威性效应接近零，圣诞老人并未优于助手。角色主要塑造参与度：儿童在第一分钟内挂断低权威助手的比例显著更高（65% vs 39%）。
AI.conclusion: 当情境本身已为智能体赋予合法性时，智能体的说话方式（话术框架）比其宣称的身份（角色权威）更能影响儿童的服从与顺从行为。

title: Positive Ratings, Hidden Concerns: Employee Voice Disclosure in AI-Mediated Organizational Listening
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Organizations started listening to employees through conversational AI agents alongside structured surveys. Little is known about what these channels change in what employees say when disclosure carries hierarchical risk. We report a field study inside a global management consulting firm whose process pairs a pre-survey with an adaptive AI voice interview on the same themes within one session. Across 44 first-session interviews (132 matched theme observations), 20-41% of sessions showed a favorable rating co-occurring with a substantive concern voiced later, depending on the favorability threshold. The Gioia analysis drew on 158 protective quotes from 65 eligible sessions. Disclosure rarely arrived unguarded: employees softened concerns, deflected accountability, and bounded how far they went, and this protective work tracked the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure. We develop a grounded model of bounded disclosure and derive four propositions for voice, channel and listening research. Silence, we argue, can persist inside expression.

AI.tldr: 一项全球管理咨询公司的实地研究（44场首次访谈、132个配对主题观察）显示，员工在同一场次中给出积极评分后仍可能提及实质担忧（占20–41%），且其披露普遍带有保护性加工，据此提出"受限披露"扎根模型与四项命题。
AI.motivation: 组织日益采用对话式AI代理与结构化问卷并行收集员工意见，但在披露伴随层级风险的情境下，这类渠道究竟改变了员工"说什么"尚缺乏认识，尤其是不清楚评分与担忧为何会并存。
AI.method: 在一家全球管理咨询公司开展实地研究，将同一主题的前置问卷与自适应AI语音访谈配对于同一场次；对44场首次访谈（132个配对主题观察）进行量化分析，并对158条来自65场合格访谈的保护性引述实施Gioia编码分析。
AI.result: 在20–41%的场次中（依好感度阈值而定），员工的积极评分与随后提出的实质性担忧共存；披露极少"无防备"，员工通过弱化担忧、转移责任、限定表达范围来保护自身，且这种保护性工作与员工对倾听结构合法性的感知相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究构建了"受限披露"的扎根模型，并提出四项面向建言、渠道与倾听研究的命题，主张沉默可以在表达之中持续存在。

title: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
summary: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale. Moreover, employing proprietary LLMs to generate such supervision further risks exposing sensitive graph data to external services. Therefore, we propose GraphCert to bootstrap agentic graph reasoning with certified evidence rubrics during post-training. Specifically, the Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer guided by generation controls produces graph-grounded QA pairs and marks supporting evidence, which undergo execution certification and semantic curation. The accepted evidence is then canonicalized into certified evidence rubrics that later reward Graph Solver evidence alignment alongside answer correctness during GRPO training. Experiments on five graph reasoning domains in GRBENCH demonstrate that GraphCert consistently outperforms substantially larger LLM agents and post-training method. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that the learned policy transfers robustly across heterogeneous graph domains, suggesting that GraphCert acquires reusable graph-reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific patterns. These results establish executable self-certification as an effective approach to self-training compact graph reasoning agents. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GraphCert 提出一种基于"可执行自认证"的后训练框架，用自动生成并认证的证据评分标准来引导紧凑型图智能体的强化学习训练，在不依赖人工标注和专有模型的前提下超越更大规模的 LLM 智能体。
AI.motivation: 训练具备多步图工具交互能力的图智能体通常需要大量问答对和推理轨迹，人工构建成本高、难以扩展；而借助专有 LLM 生成监督数据又会将敏感图数据暴露给外部服务，存在隐私风险。因此需要一种可扩展、隐私友好的自举式训练方案。
AI.method: 提出 GraphCert 框架，在 post-training 阶段以"认证证据评分标准"引导智能体训练：1）由生成控制引导的 Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer 产出图grounded的问答对并标注支撑证据；2）对证据执行执行认证（execution certification）与语义筛选（semantic curation）；3）将接受的证据规范化(canonicalize)为 certified evidence rubrics；4）在 GRPO 训练中，除答案正确性外，用该 rubric 奖励 Graph Solver 的证据对齐。
AI.result: 在 GRBENCH 的五个图推理领域上的实验表明，GraphCert 稳定优于规模显著更大的 LLM 智能体以及现有 post-training 方法。分析进一步显示，所学策略能跨异构图领域稳健迁移，说明其获得的是可复用的图推理能力而非领域特定模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可执行自认证（executable self-certification）是自训练紧凑型图推理智能体的一种有效途径，可在无需人工标注和专有 LLM 的情况下获得强泛化能力。代码将公开。

title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
summary: Direct-decision models turn text into low-latency structured labels and scores, making them attractive for classification and automatic evaluation. Yet reliability requires more than accuracy: a model must also use the ordinal decision scale supplied by the user faithfully. We analyze JEV~1.13 and three open KEV models. Our investigation begins with ANLI, where JEV assigns 38.8\% of all predictions and 51.3\% of errors to Neutral despite 74.95\% accuracy, nearly balanced gold labels, and balanced candidate positions. Across 36 ordinal datasets, final decisions use only 67--76\% of the effective gold support, versus 87--102\% on four nominal tasks. Randomizing candidate order weakens but does not remove this compression. Holding items and source scores fixed while balancing gold support and positions, we refine scales from $K=2$ to $14$; utilization falls for every model and reaches 26--75\% at $K=14$, although candidate probabilities remain broad for most models. Targeted BA-LoRA post-training raises gold-relative utilization from roughly 47\% to 86\% on eight supervised scales at both KEV sizes, showing that the compression is learned and modifiable rather than an immutable architectural limit. We call this ordinal scale-utilization bias: decision-stage candidate-space compression distinct from accuracy, gold imbalance, fixed position, and candidate count alone. The code and data are available at https://github.com/Glax147/jev_ordinal_scale_bia

AI.tldr: 该文揭示"序数刻度利用偏差"：直判模型虽准确，却未能忠实使用用户给定的序数决策刻度，决策阶段候选空间被压缩，且该偏差可通过BA-LoRA后训练修正。
AI.motivation: 直判模型（直接输出结构化标签与分数的模型）在分类与自动评测中因低延迟而受青睐，但可靠性不仅要求准确率，还要求模型忠实使用用户提供的序数决策刻度。作者怀疑现有模型存在系统性的刻度利用不足问题。
AI.method: 分析JEV 1.13及三个开源KEV模型。以ANLI为切入点，考察预测分布与错误在Neutral上的集中；在36个序数数据集与4个名义任务上比较有效黄金支撑的利用率；通过随机化候选顺序排除位置因素；在固定样本与源分数的条件下，将刻度从K=2细化至K=14，观察利用率变化；最后采用BA-LoRA进行定向后训练。
AI.result: JEV在ANLI上把38.8%的预测与51.3%的错误分配给Neutral，尽管准确率达74.95%、黄金标签近乎均衡、候选位置也均衡。36个序数数据集上最终决策仅使用67–76%的有效黄金支撑，而四个名义任务为87–102%。随机化候选顺序会削弱但不消除压缩。K=2增至14时所有模型利用率下降，K=14时仅26–75%，但多数模型候选概率仍较宽。BA-LoRA后训练在两种KEV规模、八个监督刻度上把黄金相对利用率从约47%提升到86%。
AI.conclusion: 该现象被命名为"序数刻度利用偏差"：它是决策阶段的候选空间压缩，区别于准确率、黄金不平衡、固定位置与候选数量等因素。由于BA-LoRA可显著改善，说明这种压缩是习得且可修改的，而非架构上的固有限制。

title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
summary: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. Across 5 models and 12 benchmarks, prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation in $55$ of $57$ valid cells, with the strongest effect on open-ended QA. We derive an Adaptive-K rule that uses a four-path pilot to select $K^*$, retaining $96$--$103\%$ of MV@$K{=}32$ accuracy across Math, QA, and NLU.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多路径LLM推理（如自一致性）形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，指出路径正确性的两两相关性将投票的有效样本量限制在有限上限，并据此提出利用提示模板多样性降低相关性，以及用四路径试点选择K*的自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多路径推理方法（如自一致性SC）通过采样K条推理路径并取最频繁答案来提升性能，但其收益随K增大迅速趋于饱和，且既有方法无法预测何时出现饱和。作者希望从理论上刻画这种饱和机制，并找到在有限预算下提升多路径推理效率的途径。
AI.method: 将多路径LLM推理建模为无线通信中的分集合并问题：每条路径视为一次含噪信道观测，路径正确性的两两相关性限制了投票的design-effect有效样本量上限。采用广义最小二乘（GLS）分析，在可交换性假设下证明潜在嵌入的最优对称线性合并器为均匀权重，从而支持多数投票作为标准SC的默认选择，同时为异构提示模板分支下的加权或剪枝留出空间。基于此提出自适应K规则，用四路径试点估计并选取K*。
AI.result: 在5个模型和12个基准上，提示模板多样性在57个有效单元中的55个降低了路径相关性，在开放式问答上效果最强。所提出的自适应K规则以四路径试点选择K*，在数学、问答和自然语言理解任务上保留了MV@K=32准确率的96%–103%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多路径推理与分集合并理论联系起来，论文揭示了路径相关性对SC收益饱和的制约机理，验证了提示模板多样性作为降低相关性的有效手段，并给出了以少量试点路径自适应确定K*的实用方案，在保持高准确率的同时显著提升计算效率。

title: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
summary: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still recover the updated value when the model answers with an old one, pointing to a failure to select information that remains available. Component tests in Qwen and Pythia identify a mechanism for this selection failure: attention drift, where attention favors old values over the current one when producing an answer. We study a one-layer transformer to mathematically understand how this phenomenon happens: when attention scores are similar, several old values can together receive more attention than the current value. Guided by this explanation, we redirect attention toward the current value without further training. When the current value is requested directly, adjusting this intervention for each input corrects most old-value errors across various model families while preserving nearly all initially correct answers. Reliable context management therefore requires more than remembering updated information: models must use it to guide their answers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"陈旧绑定"(stale binding)概念：当同一变量在上下文中存在新旧多个版本时，LLM智能体可能用旧值回答。作者构建CICM基准，发现前沿推理模型也会失败，并通过探针与组件测试定位机制为"注意力漂移"(attention drift)，进而提出免训练的注意力重定向干预，显著减少旧值错误。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中偏好、目标与事实不断变化，上下文中同时保留新旧版本信息，模型需使用最新状态。但模型常以同一变量的旧值作答，这一失败模式此前缺乏系统研究与机理解释，因此需要弄清"何时使用过时信息"以及"为何如此"。
AI.method: (1) 提出受控上下文记忆(CICM)基准，用于在对话与智能体日志中追踪并使用更新后的信息；(2) 用探针(probes)检验开源模型在输出旧值时是否仍编码了当前值；(3) 在Qwen与Pythia上做组件测试，识别选择失败机制；(4) 用单层Transformer做数学分析，刻画注意力分数相近时多个旧值累计注意力超过当前值的条件；(5) 基于该解释设计免训练的注意力重定向干预，并按输入自适应调整。
AI.result: 即便前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态；开源模型在回答旧值时，探针仍能恢复出更新后的值，说明信息仍可用而是选择失败；Qwen与Pythia组件测试表明失败源于注意力漂移——生成答案时注意力偏向旧值；单层Transformer分析显示注意力分数接近时，多个旧值合计可获得比当前值更多的注意力；按输入定制的注意力重定向干预在多个模型家族上纠正了大多数旧值错误，同时几乎保留了所有原本正确的回答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的上下文管理不只是"记住"更新信息，模型还必须用其引导回答。陈旧绑定反映了从可用信息到输出选择之间的断裂，注意力漂移是其机制之一，而针对性的注意力重定向可在不训练的情况下大幅缓解该问题。

title: Talk2Agent: Benchmarking Voice Interfaces for Text Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) computer-use agents are typically evaluated with clean written instructions, despite speech being an increasingly popular interface for interacting with such systems. Speech input introduces an additional failure point: transcription errors can alter task-critical entities, constraints, or targets before the agent begins reasoning, while conventional ASR metrics do not directly measure whether the information required for successful execution has been preserved. We introduce Talk2Agent, a benchmark for evaluating how effectively voice interfaces convey human-spoken instructions to LLM-based computer-use agents. Talk2Agent builds human-spoken versions of tasks from WildClawBench and OSWorld and evaluates a range of voice interfaces, including dedicated ASR models, audio-capable LLMs, contextual biasing, and LLM-based ontology repair. Because repeatedly executing long-horizon computer-use tasks is costly and stochastic, we further propose an execution-free, task-conditioned evaluation framework that projects the original task grader onto prompt-addressable intentions and measures how much task-relevant information is retained after the voice interface. On WildClawBench, Talk2Agent's execution-free native projection provides a practical, execution-grounded measure of voice-interface quality, correlating with downstream task completion and improving Pearson correlation by 0.246 over WER/CER on 32 hours of real human speech.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Talk2Agent 基准，用于评估语音接口向 LLM 计算机操作智能体传递人类口述指令的有效性，并设计免执行、任务条件化的评测框架，替代传统 ASR 指标。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 计算机操作智能体多在干净书面指令下评测，而语音正成为重要交互方式。语音输入引入转录错误这一额外失败点：错误可能改变任务关键实体、约束或目标，而 WER/CER 等传统 ASR 指标无法直接衡量执行所需信息是否被保留。
AI.method: 构建 Talk2Agent：将 WildClawBench 与 OSWorld 任务转为人声语音版本；评测多种语音接口，包括专用 ASR 模型、音频能力 LLM、上下文偏置与基于 LLM 的本体修复。针对长时程任务执行昂贵且随机的问题，提出免执行、任务条件化的评测框架，将原任务评分器投影到可提示寻址的意图上，度量语音接口后任务相关信息的保留程度。
AI.result: 在 WildClawBench 上，Talk2Agent 的免执行原生投影提供了与执行结果挂钩的语音接口质量度量，与下游任务完成度相关；在 32 小时真实人声语音上，其 Pearson 相关比 WER/CER 提升 0.246。
AI.conclusion: 免执行、任务条件化的评估可有效衡量语音接口对 LLM 计算机操作智能体的指令保真度，优于传统 ASR 指标，为语音交互智能体评测提供了实用方案。

title: Reasoning Externalization for Faithful Large Language Model Narratives of Stock Return Predictions
summary: In finance, interpreting machine learning predictions is essential, yet the numerical outputs of explainable AI can be difficult for non-experts to understand. While large language models (LLMs) can translate these outputs into natural language, they may produce errors when inferring numerical changes and feature relations. We propose an LLM narrative framework for cross-sectional stock return prediction that combines temporal Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) evidence with historical regime analogs. Temporal evidence tracks changes in the normalized global SHAP importance of an XGBoost model over six months. Historical analogs are past periods with similar changes in SHAP importance, their model performance and subsequent market returns are provided as comparative context. Using this framework, we conduct a controlled study of progressive reasoning externalization, sequentially providing raw SHAP sequences, deterministic temporal descriptors, and feature relations. Each generated claim is verified against provenance-linked evidence. Across Qwen3, externalizing numerical and relational reasoning improved evidence faithfulness as well as temporal and relational accuracy. Evidence faithfulness increased from 0.696 to 0.996 for Qwen3-32B-Instruct. While historical analogs did not improve structured automatic faithfulness, they received higher human-rated usefulness scores. These results suggest that externalizing verifiable reasoning enhances narrative faithfulness and that historical context adds interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向横截面股票收益预测的LLM叙事框架，将时序SHAP证据与历史状态类比相结合，通过渐进式外化推理提升叙事忠实度与准确性。
AI.motivation: 金融场景中机器学习预测需可解释，但可解释AI的数值输出对非专家难以理解。LLM虽可将数值转化为自然语言，但在推断数值变化和特征关系时易出错。因此需要一种既忠实又易理解的叙事生成方法。
AI.method: 基于XGBoost模型的时序SHAP证据，追踪六个月内归一化全局SHAP重要性的变化；并检索历史状态类比（SHAP重要性变化相似的过去时期），提供其模型表现与后续市场收益作为对比语境。采用受控实验，逐步外化推理：依次提供原始SHAP序列、确定性时序描述符和特征关系。每条生成的陈述均与来源关联证据进行验证。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列上，外化数值与关系推理提升了证据忠实度以及时序与关系准确性；Qwen3-32B-Instruct的证据忠实度从0.696提升至0.996。历史类比虽未提升结构化自动忠实度指标，但在人工评分中获得更高的有用性评价。
AI.conclusion: 外化可验证推理能增强叙事的忠实度，历史语境为解释增添了附加价值。该框架有望提升金融可解释AI对非专家的可用性与理解度。

title: STRATA: Self-Learning Through Role-Aligned Tiered Agents for Real-Time Strategy Games
summary: Real-time strategy (RTS) games require agents to coordinate economic development, production and construction, base defense, unit organization, and attack timing over long matches. Existing studies have applied large language models to command decision-making in RTS games, enabling agents to read textual game states and generate high-level plans. However, long inference latency can cause them to miss critical tactical events. The complexity and tactical diversity of full RTS matches also leave existing systems heavily dependent on manually written experience-based prompts, with limited ability to learn continuously from past games. We present STRATA, a role-aligned hierarchical system with cross-game self-learning for Red Alert. STRATA assigns in-game strategic, logistical, and tactical decisions to a Strategic Agent (SA), Logistics Agent (LA), and Tactical Agent (TA), respectively. The SA generates high-level directives based on the global game state and relevant experience cards, while the LA and TA handle logistics and tactical execution. After each match, a Review Agent (RA) derives candidate experience from game traces, validates and revises it using evidence from subsequent matches, and compresses strategic experience supported across multiple games into concise experience cards for SA retrieval. We evaluate STRATA through the formation of experience cards, full-match comparisons before and after learning, and experience learning against AI opponents with different play styles. Under a fixed scenario, using the learned experience cards increases the observed win rate from 30% to 100%. Sequential learning against AI opponents with different play styles also produces distinct long-term strategic experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRATA——一个面向《红色警戒》的角色对齐分层系统，通过跨对局自学习实现RTS游戏指挥决策，将经验压缩为经验卡供战略Agent检索，使固定场景胜率从30%提升至100%。
AI.motivation: RTS游戏需在长对局中协调经济发展、生产建造、基地防御、部队组织与进攻时机。已有工作虽将大语言模型用于RTS指挥决策，但存在两大问题：一是推理延迟高，易错过关键战术事件；二是对局复杂且战术多样，现有系统高度依赖人工编写的经验提示词，难以从历史对局中持续学习。
AI.method: STRATA采用角色对齐的分层架构：战略Agent（SA）依据全局状态与相关经验卡生成高层指令，后勤Agent（LA）与战术Agent（TA）分别负责后勤与战术执行。赛后由复盘Agent（RA）从对局轨迹中提炼候选经验，利用后续对局证据进行验证与修正，并将多局共享的战略经验压缩为简洁经验卡供SA检索。
AI.result: 通过经验卡形成、学习前后整局对比、以及对抗不同风格AI对手的经验学习三类实验评估。固定场景下，使用学到的经验卡使观测胜率由30%提升至100%；对风格各异的AI对手依次学习还能得到差异化的长期战略经验。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，角色对齐的分层架构结合跨对局自学习机制，可有效缓解大语言模型推理延迟与人工经验依赖问题，显著提升RTS智能体的胜率，并能积累可迁移的长期战略经验。

title: Consistent Plan-Act for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks demand strong reasoning and efficient execution across successive interactions with dynamic environments. A common approach decouples high-level planning from low-level execution through separate planner and actor roles. To investigate coordination failures in these tasks, we prompt both agents for structured state assertions and compare their reports programmatically to detect explicit contradictions. Our analyses reveal systematic disagreement about the same task-relevant state facts, a phenomenon we term planner-actor state mismatch. We further find that providing agents with task-relevant state information reduces mismatch and improves coordination and task performance. Based on the systematic analysis of the state mismatch, we propose Consistent Plan-Act (ConPAct), which feeds detected contradictions back to both agents to form consistent state interpretations and fine-tunes them on curated consistent interactions for better coordination. ConPAct improves performance across various environments and model configurations, e.g., increasing MiniGrid success rate from 38.6% to 54.4% with GPT-5.6-sol/terra as planner and actor respectively, demonstrating that state consistency can guide both inference-time correction and coordination training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规划者-执行者状态失配"现象，并基于此提出ConPAct方法，通过反馈矛盾状态与一致性微调提升长程智能体任务表现。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体任务需要强推理与高效执行，常见做法是将高层规划与低层执行解耦为规划者和执行者两个角色。但二者在动态环境中的协调失败问题尚未被系统研究，作者希望探究这种协调失败的根源。
AI.method: 通过提示两个智能体输出结构化状态断言，并以程序化方式比对二者报告，从而检测显式矛盾。基于此分析，提出ConPAct：将检测到的矛盾反馈给两个智能体，使其形成一致的状态理解，并在精心筛选的一致交互数据上进行微调以提升协调能力。
AI.result: 发现规划者与执行者对同一任务相关状态事实存在系统性分歧；提供任务相关状态信息可减少失配、改善协调与任务表现。ConPAct在多种环境和模型配置下提升性能，例如在MiniGrid上以GPT-5.6-sol/terra分别作为规划者和执行者时，成功率从38.6%提升至54.4%。
AI.conclusion: 状态一致性可同时指导推理时的纠错和协调训练，为长程智能体任务的规划-执行协调提供有效方案。

title: Composing Task-specific Agent Harnesses at Test Time with Reusable Primitives
summary: Agent harnesses govern how large language models (LLMs) gather context, invoke tools, verify results, preserve state, and terminate, largely affecting agent performance. However, the value of each harness mechanism can differ across heterogeneous tasks: a mechanism that improves one task may impose overhead or context distraction on another, leading to the suboptimality of a global harness. We characterize this suboptimality as a mismatch induced by fixed mechanism choices, motivating task-specific harness construction. Nonetheless, generating harness code for each task introduces generation and debugging costs, with execution risks that can compound as more mechanisms are generated. To address those challenges, we introduce Harness Primitives, reusable harness mechanisms with clear application scope and composition contract mined from failed task trajectories. Based on Harness Primitives, we propose STITCH, a framework that Selects suitable primitives given Task Information and compiles them into Task-speCific Harnesses at test time. This separation enables task-specific harnesses without generating or repairing mechanism code at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STITCH not only improves harness adaptability and robustness, but also scales with the primitive library size, boosting task success rates by up to 12 points over fixed harness baselines, surpassing human-designed harnesses like Codex CLI while maintaining a minimal test-time harness composition overhead of only 2.7%, 638 times more efficient than generating task-specific harnesses from scratch. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that building task-adaptive harnesses can be beneficial for completing diverse tasks and that building reusable primitives can be a promising path towards this goal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可复用的"Harness Primitives"（从失败任务轨迹中挖掘的带明确适用范围与组合契约的机制）以及STITCH框架，在测试时根据任务信息选择并编译任务专属harness，避免为每个任务生成/调试harness代码，从而提升适应性与鲁棒性、最高提升12个点成功率，测试时组合开销仅2.7%。
AI.motivation: Agent harness（管理LLM如何收集上下文、调用工具、验证结果、保存状态与终止）显著影响agent性能。但各harness机制的价值在不同任务间异构：对某任务有益的机制可能给另一任务带来开销或上下文干扰，导致全局harness次优。作者将这种次优性定义为固定机制选择带来的"错配"（mismatch），从而引出任务专属harness构建的需求。然而，为每个任务生成harness代码会带来生成与调试成本，且随机制增多执行风险会复合累积。
AI.method: 提出Harness Primitives：从失败任务轨迹中挖掘的可复用harness机制，具备明确的适用范围（application scope）与组合契约（composition contract）。在此基础上提出STITCH框架：依据任务信息（Task Information）选择合适原语（Selects），并在测试时将其编译为任务专属harness（task-speCific Harnesses）。该"选择-编译"分离设计使任务专属harness无需在测试时生成或修复机制代码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，STITCH提升了harness的适应性与鲁棒性，并随原语库规模增大而可扩展：相较固定harness基线，任务成功率最高提升12个点，超越人工设计的harness（如Codex CLI）；测试时harness组合开销仅2.7%，比从零生成任务专属harness高效638倍。
AI.conclusion: 构建任务自适应harness有助于完成多样化任务，而构建可复用原语是实现该目标的一条有前景的路径。

title: How Much Can Reliability Drift Under a Fixed Confidence Distribution?
summary: A classifier's conditional accuracy can change while its confidence distribution stays exactly the same. We study the worst-case movement of the reliability relation under covariate shifts that preserve the distribution of the confidence score, constraining the reweighting within each confidence level by a $χ^2$ budget; the resulting worst case, as a function of the budget, is a fragility profile. On an interval of budgets that can be computed from the source distribution, the profile equals exactly the square root of the budget times the within-level variance of the correctness propensity -- the grouping-loss term of calibration-refinement decompositions. Beyond this interval the profile is governed by the tails of the propensity law, and the entire upward profile determines the centred within-level law; consequently, calibration residual and grouping variance do not determine fragility in general, though they do when labels and predictions are deterministic. Since the propensity is not observed, we restrict reweightings to a learned finite readout within confidence bins, bound the part the restriction misses by the grouping variance remaining inside readout cells, estimate the restricted profile with role-separated labels, and provide a separate split-sample lower confidence bound. On ImageNet this bound is positive in both splits for four of six primary classifiers and nine of twelve additional ones as released, and for three of eighteen after temperature scaling. Held-out drift under optimised reweightings fitted without evaluation labels tracks the estimated profile; an exploratory label-permutation diagnostic yields near-zero agreement for this statistic while largely reproducing the correlation observed for unsigned random reweightings.

AI.tldr: 置信度分布不变时分类器的条件精度仍可能变化。本文研究保置信度分布的协变量漂移下可靠性关系的最坏移动，以χ²预算约束各置信层内重加权，得到"脆弱性剖面"。该剖面在一定预算区间内恰等于√预算×层内正确倾向方差（即校准-精细化分解的分组损失项），区间外由倾向分布尾部决定；整个上升剖面唯一决定中心化层内分布。作者提出基于学习有限读出、剩余分组方差界与角色分离标签的估计方法及分离样本下置信界，在ImageNet上验证该界为正且能跟踪优化重加权下的留出漂移。
AI.motivation: 分类器置信度分布保持不变并不意味着条件精度不变，因此仅凭校准残差等常规指标无法刻画可靠性关系在协变量漂移下的最坏波动。作者希望量化这种"脆弱性"，给出可计算的剖面及其与校准-精细化分解量的关系。
AI.method: 在保置信度分布的重加权下，用χ²预算约束每个置信层内的重加权，定义预算函数形式的最坏情况即脆弱性剖面。理论推导其在可计算预算区间内等于√预算×层内正确倾向方差，区间外由倾向分布尾部控制，并证明上升剖面决定中心化层内分布。由于倾向不可观测，将重加权限制在置信桶内学习的有限读出，用读出单元内剩余分组方差界定遗漏部分，用角色分离标签估计受限剖面，并给出分离样本的下置信界。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，分离样本下置信界在原始发布的六个主分类器中的四个、十二个附加分类器中的九个为正；温度缩放后十八个中仅三个为正。在不使用评估标签拟合的优化重加权下，留出漂移与估计剖面一致；一项探索性标签置换诊断对该统计量给出近零一致性，而基本复现了无符号随机重加权所观察到的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 校准残差与分组方差一般不能决定脆弱性（仅当标签与预测确定时才行）；脆弱性可由受限读出与剩余分组方差有效估计，并在ImageNet上获得正的下界与经验验证的漂移跟踪，说明该框架能刻画并检测置信度分布不变情形下的可靠性脆弱性。

title: Routing Probes Can Improve Without New Information: An Exact-Null Audit of Uncertainty Beyond Model Outputs
summary: Routing signals of modern vision transformers -- expert gates, attention-residual weights and halting scores -- often improve probes that predict whether the model is correct, and the improvement is commonly read as evidence that routing carries information about errors beyond the model's outputs. We test this inference directly: keeping real output-routing pairs, we redraw correctness labels from a frozen output-only generator fitted on disjoint data, so that routing is uninformative by construction. Under this exact label null, a width-matched MLP comparison still reports a routing gain in 51.3% of confidence-only evaluations (308/600), while a linear comparison reports none. Holding each training trajectory fixed on a six-model panel and selecting the checkpoint by validation log loss instead of validation accuracy removes the detections (50/120 to 0/120, and 83/120 to 0/120 in an independently implemented probe), identifying accuracy-based checkpoint selection as the cause; across all output views the raw detection rate falls from 27.5% (528/1,920) to zero observed detections. The repaired comparison is not sensitive, detecting an implanted signal of about 0.005 nats in 0/20 replicates in each of two matched settings, whereas a conditional permutation test built on an estimated routing law detects it in 11/20 and 10/20 and rejects rarely under the null. On real correctness labels, the conditional analysis yields model-relative evidence in five DeiT attention-residual families; in four it persists under two specified variants of the conditional law, and no family passes an additional noise criterion. Fitting a better probe and testing for incremental information are different problems, and each needs its own validation.
