AI.tldr: 该论文指出，视觉Transformer中"路由信号（专家门控、注意力残差权重、halt分数）能提升正确性探针"这一常见结论，在严格的"标签零假设"下会因基于准确率选择检查点而系统性地产生虚假检测；改用验证集对数损失选点后，检测率降为零，说明该推断不成立。
AI.motivation: 现有文献常把"路由信号改进了预测模型是否正确的探针"解读为路由携带了输出之外关于错误的信息。作者质疑这一推断：探针提升可能并非来自路由本身的增量信息，而是训练流程中的选择偏差（如按验证准确率选检查点）造成的假象。
AI.method: 1) 构造"精确标签零假设"：保留真实的输出-路由配对，但正确性标签由在不相交数据上拟合的、仅依赖输出的冻结生成器重新抽取，使路由按构造即无信息。2) 在此零假设下比较宽度匹配的MLP与线性探针。3) 在六模型面板上固定训练轨迹，比较按验证对数损失与按验证准确率选择检查点两种方式。4) 敏感性检验：植入约0.005 nats的信号，评估修复后比较的检测能力；并与基于估计路由律的条件置换检验对比。5) 在真实正确性标签上对五个DeiT注意力残差族做条件分析，并施加两种条件律变体及噪声准则。
AI.result: 在零假设下，宽度匹配MLP在51.3%(308/600)的仅置信度评估中仍报告路由增益，而线性比较无此现象。固定训练轨迹后，改按验证对数损失选点，检测从50/120降至0/120，另一独立实现从83/120降至0/120；跨所有输出视图，原始检测率从27.5%(528/1,920)降为零。修复后的比较敏感性低：在两套匹配设置中各0/20检测到约0.005 nats的植入信号，而条件置换检验分别检测到11/20和10/20且零假设下拒绝率极低。在真实正确性标签上，条件分析对五个DeiT注意力残差族给出模型相对证据，其中四个在两种条件律变体下仍成立，但没有任何族通过额外的噪声准则。
AI.conclusion: "拟合更好的探针"与"检验增量信息"是两个不同问题，各自需要独立的验证。路由信号的探针增益不能直接作为路由携带额外错误信息的证据；许多表面上的检测源于基于准确率的检查点选择。研究者应采用按对数损失选点及合适的条件检验来评估路由的增量信息。

title: Alleviating Hallucination in Reasoning Tasks with Training-Free Uncertainty-Guided Steering
summary: Recent work on hallucination detection in large language models has shown that, for a fixed pre-trained model and reasoning task, it is possible to estimate the model's confidence in the correctness of its outputs. Such uncertainty estimates have primarily been used to improve truthfulness by detecting or filtering confabulations. In this work, we ask whether these signals can instead be used more proactively to directly improve the accuracy of model-generated answers. We propose USteer, a simple, training-free steering mechanism that adjusts a model's layer-wise activations during inference using the gradient of a confidence measure with respect to the activations. This procedure nudges generation toward outputs with lower uncertainty at inference time, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision. We show that this approach consistently reduces hallucination across a range of tasks, demonstrating that confidence signals can be leveraged not only for detection, but also for effective inference-time control of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出USteer，一种无需训练、无需额外监督的推理时激活引导机制，通过沿置信度对激活的梯度方向调整各层激活，主动降低大模型幻觉并提升答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 以往大模型幻觉检测中的不确定性估计主要用于检测或过滤虚构内容，属于被动的事后处理；作者希望探究这些置信信号能否被更主动地利用，直接在推理阶段提升模型生成答案的准确性。
AI.method: 提出USteer，一种简单、免训练的引导机制：在推理时利用置信度度量相对于各层激活的梯度，对模型逐层激活进行调整，从而在不修改模型参数、不引入额外监督的情况下，将生成过程推向低不确定性输出。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，该方法一致地减少了幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: 置信信号不仅能用于幻觉检测，还可用于推理阶段对模型行为的有效控制，说明不确定性估计具有更主动的应用价值。

title: When Order Matters: First-Speaker Bias and Mitigation through Personality in Sequential Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is often used to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, but sequential debate is rarely a neutral aggregator of agents' opinions. We show that sequential MAD suffers from a pronounced first-speaker bias: agents disproportionately shape the final answer when they speak first. As a result, placing a stronger model after weaker ones can substantially offset its reasoning advantage. We then focus on the disadvantaged strong-agent-last setting and ask whether personality prompting can mitigate this imbalance. Drawing on the Big Five model, we study agreeableness and extraversion as behavioral interventions applied to either the strong or weak side. We find that their effects are trait-specific. Influence consistently shifts in the direction of lower agreeableness, and assigning low agreeableness to the stronger agent helps restore its lost influence and improves final accuracy. Extraversion, by contrast, produces less systematic changes in influence and accuracy, with its clearest effect appearing in agents' verbosity. These findings show that effective MAD design depends not only on model capability, but also on how speaking order and induced interaction behavior shape the debate process.

AI.tldr: 顺序多智能体辩论（MAD）存在明显的"首位发言者偏差"，先发言者不成比例地影响最终答案；以大五人格中的宜人性与外向性作为行为干预可部分缓解该失衡，其中低宜人性效果最一致。
AI.motivation: MAD 常被用于提升大语言模型推理能力，但顺序辩论并非中立意见聚合器；作者希望揭示其发言顺序偏差，并探索在"强智能体后发言"的不利情形下，能否通过人格提示来恢复强模型的应有影响力与最终准确率。
AI.method: 首先证明顺序 MAD 存在首位发言者偏差，并构造"强模型在后、弱模型在前"的劣势设置；随后基于大五人格模型，将宜人性与外向性作为行为干预分别施加于强侧或弱侧智能体，考察其对影响力分布与最终准确率的影响。
AI.result: 影响力始终朝低宜人性方向偏移；将低宜人性赋予更强智能体可恢复其丧失的影响力并提升最终准确率。外向性对影响力与准确率的影响不系统，最明显的作用体现在智能体的冗长程度上。
AI.conclusion: 有效的 MAD 设计不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于发言顺序与诱导出的交互行为如何塑造辩论过程；人格提示是一种可行的行为层面调节手段。

title: RealWorldShop: Benchmarking and Improving Conversational Shopping Agents in Real-World E-commerce
summary: Large language models are reshaping ecommerce from static recommenders into interactive shopping assistants, yet real-world shopping requires session-level decision support: users reveal and revise constraints, coordinate multiple goals, and expect product-grounded recommendations over a full conversation. Existing benchmarks are mostly outcome-oriented or execution-oriented, leaving this evolving decision process under-evaluated. We introduce REALWORLDSHOP, a benchmark built on 3.28M grounded products, structured shopping episodes, a profile-grounded and actioncontrolled user simulator, and role-play evaluation. Our analysis shows that current systems produce locally plausible responses but struggle with state tracking, constraint updating, and grounded convergence, especially under ambiguous intent, bundle, and multi-intent scenarios. We further propose REALSHOP_AGENT, an executable session-control framework with explicit state management, shopping-flow control, catalog-grounded retrieval, and runtime guards. Experiments show that REALSHOP_AGENT consistently outperforms strong baselines on REALWORLDSHOP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REALWORLDSHOP 基准与 REALSHOP_AGENT 框架，用于评估和提升大语言模型在会话级购物决策中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有电商基准多为结果导向或执行导向，未充分评估用户在完整对话中逐步揭示、修改约束并协调多目标的会话级决策过程。
AI.method: 构建基于 328 万真实商品的 REALWORLDSHOP，包含结构化购物回合、画像驱动与动作可控的用户模拟器及角色扮演评估；并提出具备显式状态管理、购物流程控制、商品目录检索与运行时防护的可执行会话控制框架 REALSHOP_AGENT。
AI.result: 分析表明现有系统仅能生成局部合理的回复，在状态跟踪、约束更新与基于商品的收敛上表现不佳，尤其在模糊意图、捆绑与多意图场景下；REALSHOP_AGENT 在 REALWORLDSHOP 上稳定优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 会话级决策支持是电商助手的关键评测维度，REALWORLDSHOP 与 REALSHOP_AGENT 为该方向提供了基准与有效框架。

title: C-STRIDE: An Observation-Driven AI Digital Twin for Predicting Basin-Wide Flood Fields from Sparse Stream-Gauge Histories
summary: Emergency managers need to know where floodwater is, how deep it is, and how it will change over the coming hours across an entire river basin. During a flood, however, real-time measurements come from only a handful of stream gauges, and high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly to rerun each time new data arrive or to run as large ensembles. We present C-STRIDE, an observation-driven AI digital twin that turns short records from a few stream gauges, together with terrain and rainfall, into basin-wide maps of water depth and extends these predictions up to a day ahead. It is trained on simulations from a calibrated two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and needs no separate data-assimilation step. In the Des Plaines River basin near Chicago, six gauges inform predictions over 4.2 million 30-m grid cells. Terrain improves the predictions most, rainfall keeps errors from growing over longer horizons, and together they reduce errors by about 40% compared with gauge records alone. When future rainfall is known, errors remain near 15% one day ahead, compared with nearly 40% without rainfall. Given real instead of simulated gauge records, the model shifts its predictions toward the observed hydrographs at three of six gauges without retraining, and it runs about 150 times faster than the hydrodynamic model. These results show how sparse gauges, terrain, and rainfall can be combined into fast, continuously updated flood predictions, a step toward operational flood digital twins that still requires testing with real-time data and rainfall forecasts.

AI.tldr: 提出C-STRIDE，一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生模型，将少量水文站短时记录与地形、降雨数据结合，生成全流域洪水水深图并可提前一天预测，无需独立数据同化步骤，运行速度比二维水动力模型快约150倍。
AI.motivation: 洪水应急管理需要掌握整个流域洪水的空间分布、水深及其未来数小时演变，但实时测量仅依赖少量水文站，高分辨率水动力模型重跑成本过高、难以实时同化新数据或大集合运行，因此需要一种快速、可连续更新的流域尺度洪水预测方法。
AI.method: 构建C-STRIDE观测驱动AI数字孪生：输入为少数水文站短时记录、地形与降雨数据，输出为全流域水深图并外推至未来一天；模型基于校准的二维水动力模型模拟结果训练，无需单独的数据同化步骤。
AI.result: 在芝加哥附近Des Plaines河流域，6个水文站驱动420万个30米网格的预测；地形对精度贡献最大，降雨可抑制长预见期误差增长，二者结合较仅用站测记录降低约40%误差；已知未来降雨时一天预见期误差约15%，无降雨时近40%；使用真实而非模拟站测记录时，模型在6个站中的3个向观测流量过程线偏移且无需重训练；运行速度约为水动力模型的150倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏水文站、地形与降雨可组合成快速、连续更新的洪水预测，是迈向业务化洪水数字孪生的一步，但仍需用实时数据与降雨预报进一步测试。

title: Search Shapes Conclusions: Auditing Evidence Selection Bias in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents synthesize evidence into cited reports, yet a well-cited report can still reach a misleading conclusion. Citation correctness checks whether cited sources support individual claims. It does not show whether adaptive search exposed a representative view of all documents made available for evaluation, which we call the candidate pool. Early findings redirect later queries, document choices, and stopping, so the documents an agent reads form a selective sample. Existing evaluations rarely account for this selection. We formulate the problem as adaptive evidence sampling and introduce Causal Evidence Selection Correction (CESS). CESS predicts each candidate document's evidence direction and corrects the candidate-pool average using the logged probabilities of selecting each document and reaching each search round. Shrinkage stabilizes short searches, while intervals replace point estimates when some documents cannot be sampled. We also prove that estimating the average evidence direction of a common pool differs from measuring how a change in search policy alters the evidence read. The latter requires intervention. On questions from the MS2 systematic-review benchmark, CESS reduces mean absolute error against the candidate-pool average by $9.2\%$ and reduces the estimate's change under opposing document rankings by $39.4\%$ relative to averaging the evidence scores of documents read. Across trajectories from a public Open Deep Research agent, the corresponding reductions reach $60.1\%$ and $87.2\%$. A further 4,800 trajectories under paired interventions confirm that correcting a pool estimate and measuring a policy effect are different tasks. CESS therefore audits whether the evidence direction underlying a report reflects the documents available for evaluation, while a separate intervention analysis measures the effect of search decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自适应证据采样"问题与CESS方法，用选择概率与到达轮次的记录概率校正候选池平均证据方向，从而审计深度研究智能体报告的证据代表性。
AI.motivation: 现有引用正确性检查只能验证单条论断是否被引用来源支持，无法判断自适应搜索是否暴露了候选池（全部可评估文档）的代表性观点。由于早期发现会改变后续查询、文档选择与停止决策，智能体实际阅读的文档构成选择性样本，而现有评估很少考虑这一选择偏差。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为自适应证据采样，提出因果证据选择校正（CESS）：预测每个候选文档的证据方向，并利用"选择各文档"与"到达各搜索轮次"的对数概率对候选池平均进行校正；引入收缩（shrinkage）稳定短搜索，用区间替代部分文档无法采样时的点估计。同时从理论上证明：估计公共池的平均证据方向与测量搜索策略变化如何改变所读证据是两个不同任务，后者需要干预。
AI.result: 在MS2系统综述基准问题上，CESS将相对候选池平均的MAE降低9.2%，并将相反文档排序下估计值的变化降低39.4%（相对于直接平均所读文档证据得分）。在公共Open Deep Research智能体的轨迹上，相应降幅达60.1%和87.2%。另有4,800条配对干预轨迹证实，校正池估计与测量策略效应是不同任务。
AI.conclusion: CESS可审计报告背后的证据方向是否反映可评估的全部文档，而搜索决策的影响则需通过单独的干预分析来测量。

title: MASCRDM: Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation in Training Process of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied in various fields. However, ensuring compliance and safety of LLMs, such as avoiding discrimination and bias, still remains a challenge. Current efforts mainly focus on detecting and filtering inputs and outputs of the trained models, rather than studying the intrinsic architecture of the models in real-time. To tackle this challenge, we analyze the LLMs training process and discover two critical issues: 1) Most of the existing methods are predominantly static in their approach to detection and filtering, achieving only localized optimizations without systematically enhancing the compliance of LLMs. 2) Another issue with existing approaches is the lack of real-time risk detection and mitigation across the full training process, which leads to limited flexibility. Motivated by these, we propose MASCRDM (Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation) during the LLM training process. Firstly, we develop a set of compliance rules based on existing Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and a compliance-specific LLM with the instruction of compliance law experts. Then, we deconstruct LLMs into several components and identify key nodes based on the compliance knowledge graph. During LLMs training, we implement our multiple agents in the whole process, giving compliance risk alerts and suggestions for LLM developers. Experiments on discrimination and bias benchmark demonstrate that our multi-agent system can effectively improve the compliance while maintaining reasonable semantic performance. The results indicate that our method provides an executable path for mitigating compliance risk from within the LLMs systematically.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MASCRDM多智能体系统，在LLM训练全过程中进行合规风险检测与缓解，通过合规规则、合规专用LLM及合规知识图谱定位关键节点，提升合规性同时保持语义性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM合规安全研究主要聚焦于对训练后模型的输入输出进行检测与过滤，属于静态、局部优化，缺乏对模型内在架构的实时研究，也缺乏覆盖完整训练过程的实时风险检测与缓解机制，导致灵活性有限，难以系统性提升LLM合规性。
AI.method: 提出MASCRDM（合规风险检测与缓解多智能体系统）。首先基于现有AI法律并由合规法律专家指导，构建合规规则集与合规专用LLM；然后对LLM进行组件解构，基于合规知识图谱识别关键节点；在LLM训练过程中部署多个智能体，向开发者提供合规风险预警与建议。
AI.result: 在歧视与偏见基准上的实验表明，该多智能体系统能够有效提升合规性，同时保持合理的语义性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从LLM内部系统性地缓解合规风险提供了一条可执行路径。

title: BELIEFRAG: Making Adaptive RAG State-Aware under Evolving Evidence
summary: Adaptive RAG uses signals such as confidence, relevance, support, and retrieval quality to decide when to search or correct evidence. In multi-step retrieval, however, these local signals must be combined into a persistent view of what the current evidence supports, what remains missing, and which action should follow. Existing methods often use such signals as separate triggers, making it difficult to preserve a coherent evidence state across a trajectory; we call this problem evidence-state fragmentation. We introduce BELIEFRAG, a closed-loop controller that updates an explicit state over sufficiency, reliability, conflict, uncertainty, evidence gaps, and acquisition cost, then chooses among retrieval, query rewriting, verification, answering, stopping, and abstention. Across six QA benchmarks with gpt-oss-120b, BELIEFRAG reaches mean token F1 0.572 with 3.89k tokens per question, outperforming fixed iterative retrieval (0.555 F1) while using 39% fewer tokens. The same quality-cost pattern transfers to Qwen3-32B, where BELIEFRAG reaches 0.552 F1 versus 0.523 for iterative retrieval while using 35% fewer tokens. Analysis shows that the main gains come from corrective re-retrieval rather than pruning alone, while several belief dimensions are redundant and calibrated answerability plays the strongest operational role. Calibration improves threshold stability across related evidence sources, although source shift can still invalidate the same decision signal.

AI.tldr: BELIEFRAG 提出用显式信念状态（充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口、获取成本）闭环控制多步检索与推理动作，缓解证据状态碎片化，在六个问答基准上以更少 token 取得更高 F1。
AI.motivation: 自适应 RAG 通常将置信度、相关性、支持度、检索质量等局部信号作为独立触发条件，难以在多步轨迹中维持连贯的证据状态，导致"证据状态碎片化"，无法持续判断现有证据支持什么、还缺什么、下一步该做什么。
AI.method: BELIEFRAG 是一个闭环控制器：维护关于充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口与获取成本的显式状态，并据此在检索、查询重写、验证、作答、停止与弃答之间选择动作；同时利用校准的可答性判断提升阈值稳定性。
AI.result: 在 gpt-oss-120b 上，六个问答基准平均 token F1 达 0.572，每题 3.89k token，优于固定迭代检索（0.555 F1）且 token 减少 39%；在 Qwen3-32B 上达 0.552 F1 对比 0.523，token 减少 35%。分析表明收益主要来自纠错式重检索而非单纯剪枝，部分信念维度冗余，校准可答性作用最强；校准提升阈值稳定性，但来源偏移仍可能使同一决策信号失效。
AI.conclusion: 显式信念状态与校准可答性能够在多步检索中同时改善质量与成本效率，纠错式重检索比剪枝更关键；未来需精简冗余信念维度并应对来源偏移导致的决策信号失效问题。

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
summary: Learning to complete tasks in unfamiliar environments with unknown rules remains a key challenge for LLM agents. Current LLM agents often record their discoveries in prose, which may not provide a compact, explicit account of how the environment works. Inspired by how scientists organize observations into testable, predictive theories, we introduce Schema, an agent harness that organizes learning and action through interactive program induction. The LLM agent decides what to investigate and how to act, expressing its evolving understanding of the environment as executable programs. The harness consists of a persistent program workspace and a small set of interfaces for checking these programs against the interaction history, planning within them, and executing plans under step-by-step verification. Schema raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE from 58.7% to 99.2% with the same base model, solves 100% of the public DiG-bench games, and reaches the median performance of the top-50 human players on MazeBench. Extensive analysis shows the effectiveness of Schema in unknown mechanism discovery, and ablations confirm the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Schema，一种通过交互式程序归纳组织学习与行动的 LLM 智能体框架，将环境理解表达为可执行程序，并配备持久程序工作区与验证、规划、执行接口。在 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 上从 58.7% 提升至 99.2%，DiG-bench 公开游戏全部通关，并在 MazeBench 上达到人类前 50 名玩家的中位水平。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在规则未知的陌生环境中完成任务仍是核心挑战。现有智能体多以散文形式记录发现，难以对环境机理给出紧凑、显式的描述，缺乏可测试、可预测的理论化表达。
AI.method: 受科学家将观察组织为可测试、可预测理论的启发，提出 Schema 智能体骨架（agent harness）：由 LLM 智能体自主决定调查内容与行动方式，将其不断演进的环境理解表达为可执行程序；骨架包含持久化的程序工作区，以及少量接口，用于对照交互历史检验程序、在程序内进行规划、并在逐步验证下执行计划。
AI.result: 在相同基座模型下，Schema 将 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 从 58.7% 提升至 99.2%；在 DiG-bench 公开游戏上达到 100% 通关率；在 MazeBench 上达到前 50 名人类玩家的中位表现。大量分析表明其在未知机制发现上的有效性，消融实验验证了各组成部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行程序为载体组织学习与行动，是一种紧凑、显式地刻画未知环境的有效范式，显著提升 LLM 智能体在陌生规则环境中的表现，且各组件均有独立贡献。

title: MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by allowing multiple agents to exchange and critique their answers to the same task. However, the interactions that enable agents to correct mistakes can also spread adversarial errors and steer the agents toward an incorrect answer. Although some efforts have been made to examine particular attack types on MAD, systematic evaluation of MAD under diverse attacks remains limited. A central question is whether debate mitigates adversarial influence or amplifies it.
  In this paper, we present MADBench, a benchmark for evaluating the security of MAD. We organize attacks into a layered taxonomy following the MAD workflow, incorporating both established attacks and new strategies tailored to debate. We evaluate six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 test cases, examining their effects on the final answer and the propagation of adversarial influence. Our results show that, under attacks, MAD does not necessarily improve LLM reasoning. Compared with a single-agent baseline, MAD can mitigate attacks on answer accuracy in question-answering tasks while amplifying unauthorized reads or writes in both question-answering and workspace tasks. Moreover, even when three out of five agents collude, the attack changes the final answer from correct to wrong on only 28.30\% of tasks answered correctly without attack, while only 3.26\% of initially correct honest agents switch to wrong answers during debate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MADBench，一个评估多智能体辩论（MAD）安全性的基准，将攻击按MAD工作流分层分类，覆盖六类攻击族、356个源任务和3,958个测试用例，系统考察辩论对对抗影响的缓解或放大作用。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论虽能通过多智能体交换与批判答案提升LLM推理，但促进纠错的交互同样可能传播对抗性错误并将智能体引向错误答案。已有研究多关注特定攻击类型，缺乏对MAD在多样攻击下的系统性评估，"辩论究竟缓解还是放大对抗影响"这一核心问题尚未明确。
AI.method: 构建MADBench基准：依据MAD工作流建立分层攻击分类体系，既包含已有攻击也纳入针对辩论设计的新策略；在356个源任务、3,958个测试用例上评估六个攻击族，考察其对最终答案的影响及对抗影响的传播过程。
AI.result: 在攻击下MAD未必提升LLM推理。相较单智能体基线，MAD在问答任务中可缓解攻击对答案准确率的影响，但在问答与工作区任务中均放大未授权的读/写操作。即便五分之三智能体合谋，攻击也仅使28.30%原本答对的任务最终变为错误，而初始正确的诚实智能体在辩论中仅3.26%转为错误答案。
AI.conclusion: MAD的安全性影响具有双重性：对答案准确率有一定缓解作用，却会放大未授权读写等安全风险，且整体鲁棒性优于合谋攻击的直觉预期。研究凸显了在多样化攻击下系统评估MAD安全性的必要性，并为后续防御设计提供基准与依据。

title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
summary: AI agents can externalize what they learn from past tasks into reusable \emph{skills}, such as procedures, checklists, code, or other executable artifacts, that can be retrieved and reused when solving new tasks. Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks, and the skill is then used on new tasks of the same kind. We ask a question: does the improvement a skill shows on its training tasks carry over to new test tasks? We test five self-evolving methods and a one-shot skill on six benchmarks, with the same model, the same agent, and the same train/test split for every method. Of the 21 skills that improve on their training tasks, 5 keep all of that improvement on the test tasks, 13 keep part of it, and 3 keep none of it. No existing method is best everywhere. When we read the skills, the ones that carry over badly often fix details that should depend on the task, such as column names and output files, or turn a fix for one failure into a rule for every task. An LLM judge that reads the skill content can often see this: it ranks finished skills the same way the test results do in 86\% of pairs. But it predicts the effect of a single edit poorly, so edits still have to be tested by running them. Based on these findings, we describe Generalizable Skill Optimization (GSO), which keeps only a guide for writing skills and writes a new skill for each task; it scores highest on all six benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"自演化技能"方法在训练任务上的提升能否迁移到同类的测试任务：在五种方法、六个基准、统一模型/智能体/数据划分下，21个训练提升的技能中仅5个完全保持测试提升、13个部分保持、3个完全丧失，且无单一方法处处最优。作者据此提出 Generalizable Skill Optimization（GSO），仅保留技能撰写指南并按任务新建技能，在六个基准上均取得最高分。
AI.motivation: 自演化技能方法在每轮训练任务后重写技能，并假定该技能可复用于同类新任务，但"训练任务上的提升是否真正迁移到测试任务"这一核心泛化问题缺乏系统检验；同时需要弄清迁移失败的具体成因，以指导更可靠的方法设计。
AI.method: 采用受控对比实验：固定同一模型、同一智能体和同一训练/测试划分，比较五种自演化技能方法与一次性（one-shot）技能在六个基准上的表现；进一步人工阅读技能内容，归纳泛化失败的模式；并评估 LLM 评判器对技能排序与单次编辑效果预测的能力；最后提出 GSO 方法，仅保留技能撰写指南，为每个任务重新编写技能。
AI.result: 在21个训练任务上有所提升的技能中，5个在测试任务上完全保持提升，13个部分保持，3个完全未保持；没有任何现有方法在所有情况下最优。迁移差的技能常固化本应依任务而变的细节（如列名、输出文件名），或把针对单一失败的修补升级为通用规则。LLM 评判器读取技能内容后在86%的配对中与测试结果排序一致，但对单次编辑效果的预测较差，说明编辑仍需实际运行验证。GSO 在全部六个基准上得分最高。
AI.conclusion: 自演化技能的训练提升普遍不能完全迁移到新任务，过度具体化与过度泛化是主要失效模式；技能内容对 LLM 评判器具有可判别的泛化信号，但单次编辑效果难以静态预测。以"指南而非固化技能"为原则的 GSO 通过逐任务重建技能，在六个基准上取得最优泛化表现。

title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Textual skills enable large language model (LLM) based agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. Yet existing skill evolution remains largely confined to the text space: an optimizer must diagnose success and failure patterns, and revise skills solely from long execution trajectories and sparse task outcomes. This text-only paradigm leaves the agent's internal representations, which contain rich records of its evolving execution state, outside the skill optimization loop. We ask whether an agent can improve its external textual skills by reflecting on its own internal representations. We introduce Rep2Skill, a representation-guided framework for self-evolution on agent skills. Specifically, upon the collected agent rollouts, Rep2Skill models their internal model representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution dynamics, and it further interprets these signals alongside the execution contexts as actionable textual feedback for targeted skill revision. Experiments on two agent environments with two open-source LLMs show that Rep2Skill consistently outperforms text-only approaches in the self-evolution setting, where the same LLM serves as both executor and optimizer without a stronger external model. This establishes a promising direction moving agent self-improvement beyond text-only reflection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rep2Skill，一个表示引导的智能体技能自进化框架，通过建模执行轨迹中的内部表示来定位偏离成功动态的轮次，并将其转化为可执行的文本反馈以修订技能，在自进化设置下优于纯文本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 智能体的技能进化局限于文本空间：优化器只能从冗长的执行轨迹和稀疏的任务结果中诊断成败并修订技能，导致包含丰富执行状态信息的内部表示被排除在技能优化回路之外。作者因此探究智能体能否通过反思自身内部表示来改进外部文本技能。
AI.method: Rep2Skill 在收集的智能体 rollout 上，对内部模型表示轨迹进行建模，定位偏离成功执行动态的轮次；随后结合执行上下文解释这些信号，转化为可操作的文本反馈，用于针对性地修订技能。
AI.result: 在两个智能体环境和两个开源 LLM 上的实验表明，在自进化设置中（同一 LLM 同时充当执行器与优化器，不使用更强的外部模型），Rep2Skill 持续优于纯文本方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了将智能体自我改进从纯文本反思拓展到内部表示引导方向的前景。

title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
summary: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化世界导航(Evolving-World Navigation)任务及EvolvingNav方法，通过时间索引信念与事件驱动滤波应对目标在未观察期间移动的问题，并构建EvoWorld-Bench基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体依赖持久空间记忆在熟悉环境中导航，但目标可能在未被观察时（包括导航途中）移动，导致智能体到达时记忆位置已不可靠。现有记忆检索与状态预测方法难以应对隐藏世界的持续演变，且在有限可见度下修正信念仍是难题。
AI.method: 提出EvolvingNav：基于带时间戳的3D物体历史构建时间索引信念，采用结构化"持续-迁移"模型，区分目标停留在最后观察位置与迁移到其他位置，并保留已知候选集之外的概率质量。通过事件驱动滤波随时间传播信念、预测候选检查时刻的目标占据情况，并融合新的RGB-D证据；负观测依据校准的、可见度条件下的检测概率对位置假设降权，配合证据跟踪避免重复使用同一观测。由冻结的零样本视觉-语言控制器基于更新信念选择动作并重规划。同时构建EvoWorld-Bench基准，含54个场景、803,680个任务，覆盖导航前与导航中的受控变化。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，EvolvingNav在导航成功率和搜索效率上优于所评估的基线。配对实验显示，在可学习的时间模式下增益最明显；消融实验证明保留不确定性以及引入可见度感知证据的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模隐藏世界的持续演变并在信念中保留不确定性，EvolvingNav有效应对目标未观察移动带来的定位失效问题，为进化世界中的具身导航提供了可行方案与评测基准。

title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Token-Level Perception-Grounded Advantage Estimation
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing frameworks rely on coarse, sequence-level reward signals that lack the fine-grained supervision over the visually-grounded steps within a multimodal reasoning chain. We investigate this gap through the lens of two token-level metrics: visual dependency (i.e. how much a token's prediction relies on the input image features) and predictive entropy. Our empirical analysis reveals two key findings: (1) correct reasoning chains exhibit a markedly sharper entropy reduction as visual grounding intensifies, compared to incorrect ones; (2) pivotal tokens, those whose misprediction triggers reasoning collapse, are statistical outliers in the joint distribution of visual dependency and predictive entropy derived from correct chains. Motivated by these findings, we propose token-level perception-grounded advantage estimation (TPAE), which estimates token-level advantages by measuring each token's statistical consistency with the vision-entropy patterns of correct rollouts. TPAE leverages this granular score to modulate the sequence-level advantage, producing a fine-grained supervision signal that can be integrated into various RLVR frameworks. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that TPAE consistently outperforms leading strong baselines, yielding more stable and efficient optimization for multimodal reasoning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zhihan72/TPAE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出token级感知接地优势估计（TPAE），利用视觉依赖度与预测熵的联合分布刻画多模态推理链中的细粒度监督信号，用于调制序列级优势，提升RLVR下MLLMs的推理稳定性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态RLVR框架依赖粗粒度的序列级奖励，缺乏对多模态推理链中"视觉接地步骤"的细粒度监督，导致对关键推理token的信用分配不精确。
AI.method: 通过两个token级指标——视觉依赖度（token预测对图像特征的依赖程度）与预测熵——进行实证分析；在此基础上提出TPAE，通过度量每个token与正确rollout的"视觉-熵"模式的统计一致性来估计token级优势，并用该细粒度分数调制序列级优势，可嵌入多种RLVR框架。
AI.result: 实证发现两点：(1) 正确推理链在视觉接地增强时熵下降更陡峭；(2) 关键token（误预测会引发推理崩溃）是正确链视觉依赖度-预测熵联合分布中的统计离群点。在七个基准上，TPAE持续优于强基线，优化更稳定高效。
AI.conclusion: token级、感知接地的优势估计能为多模态推理提供比序列级奖励更精细的监督，显著改善RLVR训练的稳定性、效率与最终性能。

title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
summary: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.

AI.tldr: FYAN是一个面向文档级数学形式化的人机协同框架，通过端到端工作流与证据驱动的语义审计，在同一模型下显著提升Lean定理证明成功率与自然语言证明质量。
AI.motivation: 传统数学形式化往往将定理孤立处理，且形式化陈述可能与非形式化原始规范存在语义偏差，缺乏系统性审计与可复现判断机制。
AI.method: FYAN协调规范、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean证明构造、知识整理与验证的端到端流程，支持独立监督与人类指导；核心为证据驱动的语义审计，由语言模型构建关于局部对应、遗漏、范围与逻辑关系的结构化证据，确定性验证器校验并给出可复现判断；当接受实质性但可容许的偏差时，要求显式的证明迁移义务。
AI.result: 同一模型DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash下，FYAN在严格Lean检查中证明143个FormalTCS定理中的86个，通用agent harness为69个；自然语言证明得分从0.501提升至0.851。在ConsistencyCheck上，语义审计比直接LLM判断发现更多不一致陈述（源自验证标签召回0.777 vs 0.636；原始标签0.873 vs 0.820），并能将不匹配定位到具体假设、结论或范围。此外构建了9,355行Lean库ODENumLib。
AI.conclusion: 人机协同与证据驱动的语义审计可有效提升文档级数学形式化的可靠性、可验证性与产出规模。

title: ANI: Adaptive Numerical Injection for Unifying Semantic and Arithmetic Representations in Numerical Reasoning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Jinsung-Jeon/ANI_EMNLP
summary: Precise numerical reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for expanding their applicability to complex real-world tasks. However, text-based tokenization often fragments numbers, significantly hindering precise arithmetic reasoning. Meanwhile, numerical embeddings, despite arithmetic precision, rely on context-agnostic substitution that disregards the semantic role of numbers as identifiers. To combine the complementary strengths, we propose \textbf{ANI (Adaptive Numerical Injection)}, a hybrid framework that governs the selective injection of numerical features based on the semantic context. By employing a context-aware gating mechanism, we selectively inject numerical embeddings (specifically FoNE) into the latent space, explicitly preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands. Through extensive evaluations across various LLMs, we demonstrate that ANI enhances MATH performance by 9.5 points over the official reference model, while maintaining robust performance on general linguistic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出ANI混合框架，基于语义上下文选择性注入数值嵌入，兼顾数值标识与运算精度，提升LLM数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在复杂现实任务中需要精确数值推理，但文本分词会切碎数字，影响算术精度；数值嵌入虽精确却采用上下文无关的替换方式，忽略数字作为标识符的语义角色。
AI.method: 提出ANI（Adaptive Numerical Injection）混合框架，利用上下文感知门控机制，选择性地将数值嵌入（具体为FoNE）注入潜在空间，在保留名义标识符的同时增强定量操作数。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上的广泛评估表明，ANI相比官方参考模型在MATH任务上提升9.5分，同时在通用语言基准上保持稳健表现。
AI.conclusion: 结合文本分词与数值嵌入的互补优势，通过上下文自适应注入可有效提升数值推理精度，且不损害通用语言能力。

title: MiniRep: Robust Reputation-Based Aggregation for Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into an open agentic ecosystem. To support trustworthy collaboration, industry initiatives increasingly assess agent reputation from past behavior and provide performance leaderboards. However, reputation derived from past performance may not reliably predict an agent's behavior on new tasks, particularly when malicious agents can adapt their behavior and influence other agents during collaboration.
  We study reputation in multi-agent debate (MAD), where multiple agents answer the same query, debate to improve their answers, and aggregate them into a final output. We present MiniRep, a reputation-based aggregation system for MAD under malicious agents. To ground our threat model in established research, we construct an attack taxonomy drawing on reputation-system attacks and software-testing mutation operators, covering strategic exploitation of reputation and subtle corruption of agent proposals. Guided by this taxonomy, MiniRep evaluates agents based on both their behavior on the current task and their reputation over time, while preventing groups of agents with highly similar responses from dominating the final decision. We assess MiniRep across diverse tasks, LLM-agent compositions, corruption placements, and attack types drawn from our taxonomy. Our experimental results show that, MiniRep outperforms both conventional MAD aggregation and conventional reputation-based approaches on MATH no matter being attacked or not. Also, under a heterogeneous 10-agent setting on MATH, MiniRep outperforms all baselines in all 28 attack conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiniRep——一种面向多智能体辩论（MAD）的基于声誉的聚合系统，用于在存在恶意智能体的场景下提升协作可信度。该方法结合当前任务行为与历史声誉评估智能体，并抑制高相似响应群体对最终决策的支配。实验显示MiniRep在MATH任务上优于传统MAD聚合与常规声誉方法，并在10智能体异构设置的28种攻击条件下全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的自主智能体正形成开放生态，业界通过历史行为评估声誉并发布排行榜以支持可信协作。但仅凭历史表现的声誉难以可靠预测智能体在新任务上的行为，尤其当恶意智能体可自适应调整行为并在协作中影响其他智能体时，这一问题更为突出。因此需要研究MAD场景下恶意智能体存在时的声誉机制有效性。
AI.method: 作者将研究定位于多智能体辩论（MAD）：多个智能体回答同一查询、进行辩论改进答案并聚合为最终输出。提出MiniRep，一种面向恶意智能体场景的基于声誉的MAD聚合系统。为确立威胁模型，构建攻击分类体系，融合声誉系统攻击与软件测试变异算子，涵盖对声誉的战略性利用与对智能体提案的细微污染。在该分类指导下，MiniRep同时依据智能体在当前任务上的行为与长期声誉进行评估，并防止响应高度相似的智能体群体主导最终决策。
AI.result: 在多样化任务、不同LLM智能体组合、不同污染位置及分类体系中的多种攻击类型下进行评估。结果表明，无论是否遭受攻击，MiniRep在MATH任务上均优于传统MAD聚合与常规基于声誉的方法；在MATH的10智能体异构设置下，MiniRep在全部28种攻击条件下均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: MiniRep表明，将当前任务行为与长期声誉结合并抑制相似响应群体的支配，能有效提升恶意智能体环境下MAD聚合的鲁棒性与可信度，为开放智能体生态中的声誉机制设计提供了可行方向。

title: WorkGenesis: Building the Worlds That Teach Agents to Work
summary: The ability of Large Language Model (LLM) agents to complete daily and professional work is receiving increasing attention. Training such agents requires realistic work scenarios. Expert-authored occupational work is costly and slow to produce, while unconstrained synthesis often yields tasks with weak factual grounding or internally inconsistent requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkGenesis, a framework that constructs executable occupational work from real-world artifacts through two core technical innovations: (1) Evidence-Based Work Construction, which grounds each unit of work in real-world evidence by retrieving public files guided by O*NET occupational knowledge and synthesizing the surrounding context, companion materials, work request, and itemwise rubric around them; and (2) Execution-Guided Consistency Verification, which renders a reference deliverable inside the constructed work, attributes every unsatisfied rubric item to the agent, the task, or the rubric, and uses task and rubric defects as feedback to iteratively repair the work until it passes the audit. Experimental results demonstrate that Fx-Work-35B, trained with simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on only 20K units of work synthesized by WorkGenesis, achieves the highest scores among all comparable-scale baselines on the five reported metrics across GDPvalAA-v2, APEX-Agents-AA, and JobBench (31.00 versus 24.79 average score), and even surpasses frontier models such as the 1.6T DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview. These results show that WorkGenesis provides scalable training data for working agents.

AI.tldr: WorkGenesis 通过"基于证据的工作构建"与"执行引导的一致性验证"两个创新，从真实世界材料自动合成可执行的职业工作任务，用其生成的数据微调模型可显著提升 LLM 智能体的工作能力。
AI.motivation: 训练能胜任日常与专业工作的 LLM 智能体需要真实工作场景数据。专家撰写职业工作数据成本高、速度慢；而无约束的合成任务常存在事实依据薄弱或需求内部不一致的问题。因此需要一个既能规模化又具备真实性与一致性的任务构建方案。
AI.method: 提出 WorkGenesis 框架，包含两项核心技术：(1) 基于证据的工作构建（Evidence-Based Work Construction）：以 O*NET 职业知识为引导检索公开文件，围绕这些真实文件合成上下文、配套材料、工作请求与逐项评分标准（itemwise rubric），使每个工作单元根植于真实证据；(2) 执行引导的一致性验证（Execution-Guided Consistency Verification）：在构建的工作中渲染参考交付物，将每条未满足的评分项归因于智能体、任务或评分标准，并以任务与评分标准缺陷作为反馈迭代修复，直至通过审计。
AI.result: 仅用 20K 条 WorkGenesis 合成工作单元进行简单监督微调（SFT）的 Fx-Work-35B，在 GDPvalAA-v2、APEX-Agents-AA 和 JobBench 三个基准的 5 项指标上，均取得所有同规模基线中最高分（平均 31.00 对 24.79），甚至超越 1.6T 的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: WorkGenesis 能为工作型智能体提供可扩展的训练数据，验证了"以真实证据构建 + 执行引导验证"的合成范式在提升智能体职业工作能力上的有效性。

title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming
summary: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.

AI.tldr: AutoMIP 是一种可复用的智能体技能，通过想法池化与算法树搜索来组织混合整数规划中的长时程自动研究。
AI.motivation: 尽管自动研究已有进展，但将其应用于实际运筹学问题（通常为 NP 难的混合整数线性或非线性规划，MILP/MINLP）仍具挑战，因为有效研究需要系统管理竞争性想法和长时程实验轨迹。
AI.method: AutoMIP 维护一个持久的互补候选想法池，并将可执行实验组织为算法树；借此智能体能够保留未探索假设、改进有前景的算法，并基于历史状态切换到替代方法方向。
AI.result: 在 MILP 与 MINLP 基准群上，AutoMIP 在所评估的自动研究框架中取得最高最终成功率。在 MIPLib 上，为 60 个实例中的 31 个发现新的最优解；在 MINLPLib 上，为 60 个实例中的 52 个取得新的最优解。消融研究进一步证明想法池化与算法树搜索的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 联合维护多样化研究想法与结构化实验轨迹，对长时程自动研究至关重要；AutoMIP 作为可复用技能有效提升了混合整数规划自动研究的性能。

title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Textual skills provide reusable guidance for large language model agents, but existing approaches often rely on manually curated skill banks or reinforcement learning with indirect and delayed feedback. We introduce SkillFM (Skill Flow Matching), a generative framework that synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills directly without test-time skill retrieval. Our framework combines a codec for encoding and reconstructing textual skills in a continuous latent space with a conditional flow model trained using improved MeanFlow. At inference time, the learned velocity field enables single-step latent sampling, and an LLM-based decoder converts the sampled representation into textual guidance for a frozen downstream agent. We evaluate the framework on embodied tasks, question answering, and web shopping. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, our method achieves the best overall performance among the compared vector-based skill approaches. Our analyses further demonstrate that latent skill generation is an effective alternative to retrieval-based skill augmentation. Our code and training skill libraries are available at https://github.com/lulushang999/SkillFM.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillFM生成式框架，用连续潜空间编解码器与改进MeanFlow的条件流模型直接合成任务条件文本技能，避免测试时检索，在具身任务、问答和网上购物等基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有文本技能方法依赖人工构建的技能库或强化学习，后者反馈间接且延迟，且测试时需检索技能，限制了可扩展性与效率。
AI.method: 框架包含一个codec，在连续潜空间编码与重建文本技能；一个基于改进MeanFlow的条件流模型学习速度场；推理时单步采样潜表示，再由LLM解码器转为文本指导，供冻结的下游智能体使用。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与Search-QA上，方法在基于向量的技能方法中取得最佳总体性能；分析表明潜技能生成是检索式技能增强的有效替代。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间生成式技能合成优于检索式增强，为LLM智能体提供可复用、任务条件的文本指导，代码与训练技能库已开源。

title: Experimental Experience Modeling for Autonomous Research
summary: Autonomous research agents can generate hypotheses and conduct experiments, but experimentation remains a major source of computational cost. A fundamental challenge is deciding which experiments are worth running, particularly when prior evidence is insufficient to resolve uncertainty. Yet current research agents lack a systematic way to leverage experimental experience when making such decisions. We introduce Experimental Experience Modeling (EEM), a framework for making informed experimental decisions by acquiring, reusing, and accumulating experimental experience. EEM extracts decision-relevant records from earlier experimental trajectories, distills them into reusable experience, and organizes them in an experience library. For a new experimental decision, EEM retrieves relevant historical experience and assesses whether it provides sufficient support for deciding whether a candidate direction warrants further investment. When historical experience is insufficient, EEM conducts a targeted, low-cost pilot experiment to acquire the missing decision-relevant experience on demand. It then combines this newly acquired experience with retrieved historical experience to determine whether the direction warrants full-scale evaluation, which requires substantial resources. The resulting experimental outcomes are further distilled into reusable experience, allowing the library to continually grow through iterative accumulation. Experiments on autonomous research benchmarks show that EEM improves research performance while reducing model interaction overhead, demonstrating the value of reusing accumulated experience and acquiring additional experience only when needed.

AI.tldr: 提出实验经验建模（EEM）框架，通过获取、复用与积累实验经验来优化自主研究智能体的实验决策。
AI.motivation: 自主研究智能体虽能生成假设并开展实验，但实验是主要的计算成本来源；核心难题在于判断哪些实验值得执行，尤其当先验证据不足以消解不确定性时。现有智能体缺乏系统化利用实验经验进行此类决策的机制。
AI.method: EEM从既有实验轨迹中抽取与决策相关的记录，蒸馏为可复用经验并组织成经验库；面对新决策时检索相关历史经验，评估其是否足以支撑判断候选方向是否值得进一步投入；若经验不足，则按需执行低成本定向预实验以补足缺失经验，再结合新旧经验决定是否进入需大量资源的全规模评估；实验结果继续蒸馏入库，实现迭代式经验积累。
AI.result: 在自主研究基准上，EEM提升了研究表现，同时降低了模型交互开销，验证了复用已积累经验、仅在必要时获取新经验的价值。
AI.conclusion: EEM为自主研究智能体提供了一种系统化的实验决策范式，以经验库为中枢，通过复用与按需获取相平衡，在提升研究性能的同时控制计算与交互成本。

title: Inferring Causal Relations between Two Sequences of Events with Language Models
summary: Causal AI is a branch of Artificial Intelligence which helps understand and reason about cause and effect relationships, not just patterns or correlations. Causal discovery aims to infer elements of the underlying causal structure--often represented as a directed graph--from observational and, when available, interventional data. While causal discovery is the fundamental step for moving beyond mere associations toward genuine understanding, and thus the basic building block of causal AI, it becomes intrinsically difficult when causal relations must be inferred from single observations. In such situations, standard causal discovery methods cannot be used and one has to identify causal relations from limited amount of information. This is typically the case for, e.g., sequences of events produced by different alarms which need to be analyzed on the fly to detect abnormal phenomena, which are usually rare. We show in this study that it is possible to leverage the predictive power of Large Language Models (LLMs) to infer causal relations between only two sequences of events. This approach, which is validated on both synthetic and real data, provides better results than standard causal discovery algorithms on several time series data, even though these data were converted into smaller, single observed sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）的预测能力，在仅有单次观测序列的极端信息受限场景下推断两个事件序列间的因果关系，在合成与真实数据上均优于标准因果发现算法。
AI.motivation: 因果发现是因果AI的基础步骤，旨在从观测（及干预）数据中推断以有向图表示的因果结构。然而当因果关系只能从单次观测中推断时（如稀有异常告警序列需在线分析），标准因果发现方法失效，可用信息极其有限，因此亟需新的方法。
AI.method: 借助大语言模型（LLMs）的预测能力，仅基于两条事件序列来推断其间的因果关系。方法在合成数据与真实数据上进行了验证，并将多个时间序列数据转换为更短的单次观测序列以进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在多个时间序列数据上，该LLM方法的结果优于标准因果发现算法，即便这些数据被转化为更小的单次观测序列。方法在合成与真实数据上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在信息极其受限、仅有两条事件序列可用的情形下，LLM的预测能力可用于有效推断因果关系，为单观测因果发现问题提供了一条可行且有效的替代路径。

title: Who Owns That? Evaluating Ownership Intuitions in Large Language Models
summary: Ownership establishes rights over the use, control, and transfer of objects. Understanding these relations is essential for AI systems to interact appropriately with people and their resources. Yet how large language models (LLMs) attribute ownership under competing claims remains unclear. We introduce the Competing Ownership Attribution Task (COAT), comprising 42 scenarios, and compare ownership allocations from 24 LLM configurations with those of 108 human participants. Overall, human-model similarity is close to human-human similarity, but models show greater homogeneity in their ownership judgments. Within individual answers, models also divide ownership more evenly among claimants than humans do. Pooling responses across model configurations reveals more scenarios with a shared judgment and fewer with distinct viewpoint groups than in humans. When humans form distinct groups, models may converge on one viewpoint or between competing viewpoints. Further comparisons reveal different contextual sensitivities. As material value increases across scenarios, allocations to creators decline less sharply in models than in humans. Across scenarios differing in public recognition of later holders as owners, allocations to these holders increase in models but decrease slightly in humans. Together, these findings suggest that the evaluated LLM responses do not fully capture the diversity of participants' ownership judgments or how those judgments vary across situations. Developing socially capable AI therefore requires moving beyond overall similarity to capture the diversity and context dependence of human judgments.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"竞争性所有权归因任务"(COAT)，包含42个情境，对比24种LLM配置与108名人类参与者的所有权分配判断。结果显示人机相似度接近人际相似度，但模型判断更加同质化，且对情境的敏感性与人类存在差异。
AI.motivation: 所有权确立了对象的使用、控制与转移权利，理解这些关系是AI系统恰当与人及其资源交互的基础。然而，大语言模型在存在竞争性主张时如何归因所有权仍不清楚，需要系统评估其与人类判断的一致性与差异。
AI.method: 构建竞争性所有权归因任务(COAT)，包含42个情境；将24种LLM配置的所有权分配结果与108名人类参与者进行对比，分析整体相似性、组内同质性、个体内所有权分配方式、跨情境聚类结构以及情境敏感性（如物质价值、后期持有者的公众认可度）。
AI.result: 人机相似度接近人际相似度，但模型判断的同质性明显更强；在单个回答中，模型比人类更平均地在主张者间分配所有权。汇总各模型配置后，出现共同判断的情境更多、存在明显观点分组的情境更少。当人类形成不同群体时，模型可能收敛于某一观点或折衷于竞争观点之间。情境敏感性方面：随物质价值上升，模型对创造者的分配下降幅度小于人类；在后期持有者获得公众认可的情境中，模型对其分配增加，而人类略有减少。
AI.conclusion: 所评估的LLM回答未能充分体现参与者所有权判断的多样性，也未能反映这些判断如何随情境变化。发展具备社会能力的AI需要超越整体相似度指标，转而捕捉人类判断的多样性与情境依赖性。

title: Referential Uncertainty in Human--AI Collaboration
summary: Effective human-AI collaboration requires partners to establish references through interaction, which becomes fragile when descriptions are ambiguous, similar referents compete, or partners see different things. We study referential uncertainty - uncertainty over which candidate object a description refers to - in a collaborative puzzle task where a human Helper instructs an AI Worker to place pieces. The Worker must identify and communicate its uncertainty, and the Helper must recognize and act on it. We show that a separately elicited belief distribution over candidate pieces is better calibrated (ECE 0.15) and better discriminates correct from incorrect placements (AUROC 0.65) than raw action-token probabilities, which are severely overconfident (0.97 mean confidence, ECE 0.44). Across three frontier vision-language models (GPT-4.1, GPT-5, GPT-5.5), this elicited uncertainty rises predictably with instruction vagueness, but not with competing referents in context, even when those increase errors. The models seldom externalize it, asking for clarification on only 3.5-16.7% of turns. In a controlled human study (N=210), participants given only the Worker's default message accept 78% of wrong placements and cannot tell right from wrong (AUC 0.50). Precise descriptions and, especially, well-targeted hedges cut wrong-move acceptance to 36% while largely preserving correct-move acceptance, compensating for missing shared awareness such as not seeing the Worker's action. But this benefit depends on targeting: a deployable hedge derived from the model's own belief entropy inherits that signal's weakness and can do more harm than good. Externalized uncertainty helps a human partner only when it is accurately targeted.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究人-AI协作中的"指称不确定性"，发现直接诱导的信念分布比动作token概率校准更好，但这种不确定性难以被模型外化，且只有被精准定位时才能帮助人类伙伴。
AI.motivation: 人-AI协作需要双方通过交互建立共同指称，但当描述模糊、候选对象相似或双方所见不同时，指称会变得脆弱。作者希望理解这种"指称不确定性"（即描述到底指向哪个候选对象的不确定性）如何被识别、表达和利用。
AI.method: 设计了一个协作拼图任务：人类Helper指示AI Worker放置拼块。Worker需识别并传达自身的不确定性，Helper需识别并据此行动。作者对比了"单独诱导的候选拼块信念分布"与"原始动作token概率"两种不确定性度量，并在三个前沿视觉语言模型（GPT-4.1、GPT-5、GPT-5.5）上测试不确定性随指令模糊度和竞争指称的变化，同时开展了N=210的受控人类实验，考察精确描述和针对性模糊限制语（hedges）对错误放置接受率的影响。
AI.result: 单独诱导的信念分布校准更好（ECE 0.15）且区分正确/错误放置的能力更强（AUROC 0.65），而原始动作token概率严重过度自信（平均置信度0.97，ECE 0.44）。在三个模型中，诱导的不确定性随指令模糊度可预测上升，但不随上下文中竞争指称上升，即使竞争指称会增加错误。模型很少外化不确定性，仅在3.5%-16.7%的回合中请求澄清。人类实验中，仅收到Worker默认消息的参与者接受了78%的错误放置，且无法区分对错（AUC 0.50）；精确描述和针对性模糊限制语将错误放置接受率降至36%，同时基本保持正确放置接受率。但收益取决于定位精准度：基于模型信念熵的可部署模糊限制语继承了该信号的弱点，可能弊大于利。
AI.conclusion: 外化的不确定性只有被精准定位时才能帮助人类伙伴；模型自身的不确定性信号虽有价值，但不足以自动转化为有效的协作沟通。

title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
summary: Recent achievements in AI-assisted mathematics require intensive interaction of agents with proof assistants to generate machine-checked proof certificates. Agents interact with proof assistants such as Rocq or Lean through an interface that controls what the agent receives from the prover and the cost of these interactions. Today, these interfaces are adapted from tools designed for humans and not optimized for agents. We propose an evolutionary method where a frontier model incrementally proposes new features and only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, \rme, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover. On the held-out \texttt{test} split of miniF2F-Rocq, an agent equipped with \rme outperforms both the baseline that only exposes the Rocq compiler and an established MCP server, across four models from two families, in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve. Although evolved for Rocq, the resulting server transfers to Lean, improving cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench. We release \rme and its port to Lean.

AI.tldr: 提出一种演化方法，让前沿模型迭代提出新接口特性并仅保留能提升小模型整体表现的特性，据此构建了 Rocq 证明助手的 MCP 服务器 rme；在 miniF2F-Rocq 测试集上成功率、单题成本与耗时均优于基线，并可迁移至 Lean。
AI.motivation: AI 辅助数学需要智能体与证明助手（如 Rocq、Lean）密集交互以生成机器可检验的证明证书，而当前交互接口沿袭自面向人类设计的工具，未针对智能体优化，限制了性能与效率。因此需要为智能体重新设计或演化证明助手接口。
AI.method: 提出一种演化式方法：由前沿模型（frontier model）增量提出新的接口/服务器特性，仅保留那些能提升较小模型整体性能的特性。用该方法在一组精选数学问题上"生长"出面向 Rocq 证明助手的新 MCP 服务器 rme。
AI.result: 在 miniF2F-Rocq 的留出 test 划分上，配备 rme 的智能体在成功率、单题求解成本和单题求解时间三方面均优于仅暴露 Rocq 编译器的基线以及一个已有 MCP 服务器，且该结论在来自两个模型族的四个模型上均成立。尽管为 Rocq 演化而来，该服务器可迁移到 Lean，在 PutnamBench 子集上改善单题成本与耗时。作者发布了 rme 及其 Lean 移植版。
AI.conclusion: 面向智能体优化的证明助手接口可以自动演化获得，并能在多个模型族上稳定提升定理证明的成功率与效率，且具有良好的跨证明助手迁移性。

title: RankEvolve: A Reliable Multi-Agent Auto-Research Harness for Evolving Ranking Models
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: Auto-research agents, LLM systems that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes across iterations, promise to automate applied ML's experimental loop. Over long horizons, execution accuracy is a binding constraint: a change can silently leak held-out data, omit normalization, disconnect a gradient, or leave a train/eval flag unwired, invalidating expensive runs and compounding error across iterations. We present RankEvolve, an auto-research framework for evolving generative ranking models. An Executable Operating Protocol (EOP) declares phases, gates, branches, and loops, and the runtime enforces the compiled state machine. A meta-meta-harness composes complete black-box coding-agent products, including Claude Code and Codex, as execution-graph nodes that review and repair one another's work. In a budget-matched evaluation, heterogeneous composition raises all-oracle execution accuracy from the best single-product baseline of 45.8 percent to 62.5 percent (paired +16.7 points, 95 percent CI [6.6, 26.7]) while achieving a 10.4 percent silent critical-defect rate. An implemented knowledge layer carries findings, including negative results, across iterations. In a twelve-iteration deployment on the open-source HSTU recommender, RankEvolve reported NDCG@10 of 0.2192 on MovieLens-20M LARGE (+4.48 percent over the published anchor) and 0.1948 on BASE (+2.80 percent). ExecML-HSTU, seeded by incidents from that deployment, provides the oracle benchmark for the execution-accuracy evaluation. A pre-specified LitGPT transfer split replicates the heterogeneous-composition effect beyond recommendation (+12.5 points, 95 percent CI [3.0, 22.0]), and a paired ablation isolates per-step from full-protocol instruction injection. These results characterize when runtime-controlled composition of coding-agent products improves execution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankEvolve自动研究框架，通过可执行操作协议(EOP)强制编译状态的运行时执行，并用元-元脚手架将多个编码智能体产品组合为执行图节点相互审查修复，在预算匹配下将执行准确率从45.8%提升至62.5%，并成功部署于HSTU推荐模型。
AI.motivation: 自动研究智能体虽能自动化应用机器学习的实验循环，但在长周期运行中执行准确率成为硬约束：数据泄漏、缺失归一化、梯度断连或训练/评估标志未接通等错误会静默发生，使昂贵运行失效并在迭代中累积误差。因此需要一种能控制并提升执行准确率的框架。
AI.method: 提出RankEvolve框架，包含：1) 可执行操作协议(EOP)，声明阶段、门控、分支与循环，运行时强制执行编译后的状态机；2) 元-元脚手架，将完整黑盒编码智能体产品(含Claude Code与Codex)组合为执行图节点，使其相互审查与修复；3) 知识层，跨迭代传递发现包括负面结果。构建ExecML-HSTU作为执行准确率评估的oracle基准。
AI.result: 预算匹配评估中，异构组合将全oracle执行准确率从最佳单产品基线的45.8%提升至62.5%(配对+16.7点，95%CI [6.6, 26.7])，静默关键缺陷率为10.4%。在开源HSTU推荐模型上十二轮部署，RankEvolve在MovieLens-20M LARGE上报告NDCG@10为0.2192(+4.48%)，BASE为0.1948(+2.80%)。预指定的LitGPT迁移划分复现了异构组合效应(+12.5点，95%CI [3.0, 22.0])，配对消融隔离了逐步与全协议指令注入的影响。
AI.conclusion: 运行时控制的编码智能体产品组合能有效提升长周期自动研究的执行准确率，异构组合与协议强制是最有效的机制，且该效应可迁移至推荐以外的任务。

title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
summary: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench 基准，用 100 份长文档游戏设计文档（GDD）评估 coding agents 的端到端游戏开发忠实度。
AI.motivation: 将完整应用开发交由 coding agents 需保留设计意图，而非通过朴素提示生成貌似合理的输出。游戏开发是严苛测试场景：长文档 GDD 的要求需在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染与玩家交互间协同。现有基准多用精简规格，缺乏对长文档 GDD 中跨方面相互依赖要求的评估支持。
AI.method: 构建含 100 份长文档 GDD 的基准；将每份 GDD 转为依赖感知契约（含规则、约束与前置关系），度量游戏是否满足 GDD 要求并保持其相互关系。结合源码检查与 agent 生成的测试策略，进行场景化回放与自适应 playtesting。契约在 agents 与修订轮次间保持固定，评判与证据绑定同一要求以支持一致比较与失败检测。
AI.result: 现有 agents 难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的要求；相比自我修订，要求特定反馈在两轮后将 GDD Fidelity 提升 10.9%。
AI.conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 超越实现层面评判，评估端到端规格遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实的游戏开发。代码与数据集已开源。

title: AVERT-VLN: Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Deploying vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents in unseen environments remains challenging because unfamiliar layouts and visual conditions can cause execution to go off track. Rather than relying on continuous human supervision, a practical strategy is to selectively request corrective guidance, recover the ongoing task, and reuse corrective interactions to improve subsequent navigation. We propose Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation (AVERT-VLN), a closed-loop framework that uses a plug-in vision-language Monitor for online human-assisted recovery and offline preference learning. The Monitor operates separately from navigation decision generation and assesses instruction-execution consistency from the instruction, visual history, and current observation. To train the Monitor for deviation recognition, we construct LOSTNAV DATASET with 20K counterfactual risk trajectories and rule-based deviation labels. The Monitor is first fine-tuned on 40K normal trajectories to assess instruction progress and then jointly fine-tuned on normal and risk trajectories to recognize semantic deviations. At runtime, Asynchronous Sidecar Monitoring evaluates execution alongside the navigation model. When the controller accepts a LOST verdict, it suspends autonomous execution and requests human guidance for recovery. For offline policy improvement, Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning converts deviation-associated failures into decision-level preference pairs under shared decision contexts, restricting supervision to the decisions targeted for correction. Under human-assisted evaluation, the full AVERT-VLN system achieves success rates of 76.2% and 66.3% on the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. The same monitoring and human-assisted recovery interface also improves success rates across the three evaluated navigation architectures.

AI.tldr: AVERT-VLN：即弃感知的视觉纠错与训练框架，通过插件式监控器实现在线人助恢复与离线偏好学习。
AI.motivation: 在未见环境中部署视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体时，陌生布局与视觉条件会导致执行偏离轨迹。相比持续人工监督，更有实用价值的策略是选择性请求纠正指导、恢复任务并复用纠正交互以改进后续导航。
AI.method: 提出AVERT-VLN闭环框架，包含插件式视觉语言Monitor与离线偏好学习。Monitor独立于导航决策生成，从指令、视觉历史与当前观测评估指令-执行一致性。为训练Monitor识别偏离，构建LOSTNAV DATASET，含2万条反事实风险轨迹与规则化偏离标签；Monitor先在4万条正常轨迹上微调以评估指令进度，再在正常与风险轨迹上联合微调以识别语义偏离。运行时采用异步Sidecar Monitoring与导航模型并行评估；当控制器接受LOST判定，则暂停自主执行并请求人工指导恢复。离线策略改进采用轨迹锚定偏好学习（Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning），在共享决策上下文下将偏离相关失败转化为决策级偏好对，将监督限制在被纠正的目标决策上。
AI.result: 在人助评估下，完整AVERT-VLN系统在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen划分上成功率分别达到76.2%和66.3%。相同监控与人助恢复接口在三种被评估导航架构上也均提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: AVERT-VLN通过选择性地请求人工纠正并复用纠正交互，形成在线恢复与离线偏好学习的闭环，在不依赖持续人工监督的前提下提升未见环境下的导航成功率，且监控与恢复接口具备跨导航架构的通用性。

title: Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata?
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/momentum-induction
summary: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8% to 99.9% on unseen rules; (3) for temporal stability, causal freezing lifts the same diffusion weights from 42.2% to 99.9%. None of the three changes touches the architectural backbone; each only modifies the information flow within it. We also compare joint and ordered sampling on billiards and, in an exploratory study, on a simulated Burgers equation.

AI.tldr: 本文以元胞自动机为试验台，发现传统世界模型（自回归/扩散、Transformer/CNN）虽能正确预测绝大多数像素，却几乎无法完成完整rollout；作者将差距归因于空间局部性、时间局部性与时间稳定性三类失效，并通过仅修改信息流（二维旋转位置编码、前一帧邻域输入、因果冻结）在不改骨干的前提下逐一修复。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：基于Transformer或卷积网络的自回归/扩散世界模型，能否从观测历史中学习到"精确的"世界动力学，而非仅拟合表面统计量。作者需要一个可精确判定正误、规则可换的简洁测试平台来检验这一点。
AI.method: 以元胞自动机（如Game of Life）作为测试床，对比CNN、Transformer与联合扩散模型的rollout表现，并用像素准确率与完整rollout成功率两项指标刻画差距；随后针对三类失效分别做最小干预：用二维旋转位置编码改善空间局部性，将每个token所在cell的前一帧邻域作为输入改善时间局部性，用因果冻结改善时间稳定性；并在台球与模拟Burgers方程上比较联合采样与有序采样。
AI.result: CNN预测96.3%的cell但仅完成18.9%的rollout，联合扩散模型完成率为0；三维修复效果显著：二维旋转位置编码将Transformer在Game of Life上从39.1%提升至100%，前一帧邻域输入将同一Transformer在未见规则上从25.8%提升至99.9%，因果冻结将同一扩散权重从42.2%提升至99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 高像素准确率不等于掌握精确动力学；传统世界模型的瓶颈不在架构骨干，而在信息流的组织方式。仅调整信息流（位置编码、输入邻域、因果冻结）即可近似完全修复rollout能力，说明局部性与稳定性应作为世界模型设计的一等约束。

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChronoGraph（功能化4D场景图）及配套数据引擎 ChronoGraphBench，并训练 ChronoGraphVLM，将动作—可供性部件—语义/几何状态变化统一为图结构，实现4D交互理解与空间规划共享表征，在多个模型规模上超越预训练基线并零样本迁移到 VLM4D。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要同时解决"在哪里行动"、"预测场景如何变化"、"解释观测结果以指导后续动作"三类问题，这要求将解释过去动作如何改变场景的4D交互理解与决定如何及何处行动、并预判场景变化的空间规划相连接。但现有方法缺乏统一表征，使理解与规划彼此割裂。
AI.method: 1) 提出 ChronoGraph：功能化4D场景图，将作用于可供性部件（affordance parts）的动作与语义及几何状态变化相链接，用同一形式表达已观测与预期（anticipated）的状态转移，为理解与规划提供共享基础。2) 构建 ChronoGraphBench：自动数据引擎将人类交互视频与仿真机器人轨迹转化为图标注问答，用于训练与评测 VLM。3) 训练 ChronoGraphVLM：两阶段适配预训练 VLM——先进行"图即思维链"（Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought）监督微调，使模型在作答前以图轨迹重建已观测转移并预测未来转移；再进行联合4D图强化学习，直接对图属性与答案正确性给予奖励。
AI.result: 跨模型规模的实验显示，ChronoGraphVLM 相较对应预训练基线取得提升，并实现向 VLM4D 的零样本迁移；真实世界演示表明，基于图的规划与可供性接地（affordance grounding）可借助现有机器人技能支持移动操作，且无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: 以功能化4D场景图统一"理解—预测—规划"，配合自动数据构建与两阶段监督+强化学习训练，可有效增强 VLM 的4D交互理解与空间规划能力，并具备零样本迁移与真实机器人任务部署潜力。

title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/renrua52/ArchitectureIQ
summary: Top researchers have good intuition, but do language models have as good intuition about model training as top AI researchers? To measure model intuition of LLMs and humans, we introduce the ArchitectureIQ benchmark. Each question presents a synthetic dataset and several training recipes, and the test-taker is asked to predict the recipe yielding the best test metric. Overall, we find that LLMs' model intuition is good but has four limitations: (1) The intuition is imperfect, or even sub-human in some cases. Frontier models achieve around 76% accuracy (random choice 33%) vs best human researcher (66.0%), yet remain far from perfect. For architecture-only questions, best human achieves 65% while GPT-6 Astra only has 38%. (2) The intuition is empirical, not structured, supported by the fact that more CoT compute does not lead to substantial improvement. Unlike math, we still lack a "Science of AI" language that enables structured reasoning on AI. (3) The intuition is not maximally condensed, and can be further compressed into a knoledge base. Our constructed knowledge base with only 20 items yields large gains for weak models: GPT-4o equipped with the accumulated knowledge almost matches the performance of Claude Opus 5. (4) The intuition is insensitive to dataset properties, but the best model should in general depend on data properties. This suggests that data is the real "dark matter" in AI -- LLMs (so do human researchers) understand too little about data, even less than model architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ArchitectureIQ 基准，用"预测最优训练配方"任务衡量 LLM 与人类研究者的模型直觉，发现 LLM 直觉虽强但存在四方面局限。
AI.motivation: 顶尖研究者拥有良好的模型训练直觉，但 LLM 是否具备同等直觉尚不清楚，且缺乏可量化的评测手段，因此需要构建专门的基准来对比 LLM 与人类的模型直觉。
AI.method: 构建 ArchitectureIQ 基准：每道题给出一个合成数据集和若干训练配方，要求受测者预测能取得最佳测试指标的配方；同时对比前沿 LLM 与人类研究者，并分析 CoT 计算量、知识库压缩、数据属性敏感性等因素。
AI.result: 前沿模型准确率约 76%（随机 33%），高于最佳人类研究者 66.0%，但仍远未完美；仅架构类问题上最佳人类 65% 而 GPT-6 Astra 仅 38%；增加 CoT 计算量无显著提升；仅 20 条的知识库即可让 GPT-4o 接近 Claude Opus 5 的水平；模型直觉对数据属性不敏感。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的模型直觉良好但存在四大局限：不完美甚至低于人类、经验性而非结构化、未最大程度压缩、对数据属性不敏感；这表明数据是 AI 中的"暗物质"，LLM 与人类研究者对数据的理解都严重不足，甚至弱于对模型架构的理解。

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
summary: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Runtime Assurance Contract（RAC），一种将自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、转移策略、人工复核能力与非补偿性门控绑定的策略级形式化模式，用以填补"assurance-transition gap"，并通过失败注入研究与合成留出集实验验证其机制。
AI.motivation: 现有基准、审计与智能体协议能描述性能、权限与修复，但无法规定在关键任务中观测到的证据应如何改变智能体的权限，即所谓"assurance-transition gap"。作者希望用形式化契约替代单纯依赖聚合性能指标来授权行动的做法。
AI.method: 定义 RAC 契约、证据记录、权限规则与五条不变量，并在临床、工业、司法失败探针中说明；随后报告确定性失败注入研究：在智能体编码场景构造 280 个案例，用门控合取、仅分数规则与受限协议基线评估。另用 18 条手工撰写轨迹检验版本固定证据与复核转移，并在 24 个情景的前瞻性合成留出集上由两名盲审 LLM 评判者对全部 72 次动作尝试标注。
AI.result: 在已发表示例权重与阈值下，仅分数规则放行了 100 个应阻断注入中的 80 个以及全部 40 个应复核注入；事后调优后在该语料上与合取规则一致。在正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号、零信号对照及各信号单独触发的注入案例下，精确一致当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重。18 条轨迹用于对照更简单的策略变体；在 24 情景合成留出集中，两名盲审 LLM 评判者对 72 次动作尝试给出完全相同标签，RAC 与另一独立实现的全状态基线均与之匹配。
AI.conclusion: 这些研究仅在合成案例上检验机制，既未证明实际部署的安全性，也未证明跨域有效性；RAC 的价值在于提供可形式化的证据—权限转移契约，但真实世界适用性仍待验证。

title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
comment: 62 pages. Website: https://discoailab.github.io/osworld-science-page/ Public contributions welcome: https://forms.gle/htxY5snyANJ4moVEA
summary: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application states and generated artifacts, including molecular structures, segmentation masks, plots, and numerical results, and award partial credit for incomplete outcomes. Our special harness integrates model adapters, interaction-loop control, and trajectory logging to support comparisons of models and interaction strategies. Our results show that current state-of-the-art VLMs with a strong harness still face challenges in addressing key questions in the scientific domains. We also analyze the benchmarking results across multi-linguistics, reasoning efforts, context length and other factors and derive several important conclusions and directions to assist future development. Overall, we provide an integrated framework connecting expert-defined scientific goals to verifiable software outcomes, enabling systematic evaluation of both agent capabilities and harness design in scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSWorld-Science基准与评测环境，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体在科学软件中的计算机使用能力，包含12个VLM、146个任务及基于执行产物的评估器与专用harness。
AI.motivation: 科学软件对基于VLM的计算机使用智能体构成高难度考验：完成科研工作流需要解读专用界面、操作科学对象并产出可验证结果。现有基准缺乏科学意义明确的任务、基于产物的评估以及高效的智能体harness，难以系统衡量该类能力。
AI.method: 构建OSWorld-Science：涵盖分子绘图与逆合成、病理图像分析、统计计算、物理仿真等领域的146个高质量任务；任务经专家提议与人机协同迭代设计，并按科学价值与难度筛选。设计任务特定的执行式评估器，检查应用状态与生成产物（分子结构、分割掩码、图表、数值结果），并给予部分得分。配套harness集成模型适配器、交互循环控制与轨迹日志，支持模型与交互策略对比。
AI.result: 在12个VLM上的评测显示，即便配合强harness，当前最先进VLM在科学领域关键问题上仍面临显著挑战；并跨多语言、推理投入、上下文长度等因素进行了结果分析。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一套连接专家定义的科研目标与可验证软件产物的集成框架，可系统评估科学工作流中的智能体能力与harness设计，并给出若干结论与未来发展方向。

title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
summary: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾性研究了一个用于企业与投资银行演示文稿生成的智能体框架（27B语言模型+财务计算+叙事模板+校验），并由LLM评审打分；该系统在17项交付物上均优于直接提示生成，但相对Opus直接生成优势有限，且评审存在分数漂移与排名不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 企业与投资银行团队需要演示文稿支撑信贷决策与融资交易建议，制作过程涉及财务数据勾稽、来源追溯与分析到建议的转化，人工成本高。研究动机在于验证将27B语言模型与财务计算、叙事模板、校验机制组合为智能体框架能否提升此类文档的生产质量，并探讨以LLM评审驱动工程改进时评分是否可靠。
AI.method: 采用回顾性研究，构建一个agentic harness，集成27B语言模型、财务计算模块、叙事模板与验证检查。以LLM评审（judges）指导工程迭代并评估产出文稿。评估设置为共享会话、纯文本评分、去除模板标记，使用五名评审，将完整系统与同一模型仅凭简短提示直接生成的结果对比，并与Opus直接生成对比；同时考察跨开发轮次的一致性与重复评分稳定性。
AI.result: 在去除模板标记的共享会话纯文本评分中，五名评审给完整系统的评分为95分制下的20.4至33.6分，高于同一模型由简短提示直接生成的结果；每名评审在全部17项开发交付物上均给系统更高分。相对Opus由简短提示直接生成的差距为-4.7至+0.8分。评审在开发轮次的整体进展上较一致，但对最终文稿排名的共识低于对合并分数的共识。重复评分会在文稿未变时改变分数，使小幅改进难以与评审波动区分。
AI.conclusion: 组合式智能体框架在银行演示文稿生成上相对同模型直接生成具有稳定增益，但相对Opus直接生成的优势不明确。LLM评审可用于粗略指示进展，但其排名一致性与重复评分稳定性不足，导致细微改进难以可靠识别；引入LLM评审进行工程决策时需谨慎对待评分漂移问题。

title: AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC
summary: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMS——一种面向仿真到现实（sim-to-real）多模态集成感知与通信（ISAC）的智能体AI框架。它根据自然语言部署需求自动推导部署特定的仿真到现实配置并协调执行，通过场景构建智能体与场景理解智能体协同工作，在DeepSense 6G数据集上提升了车辆检测与波束预测性能，并在编排基准上验证了规划正确性的改进。
AI.motivation: 多模态ISAC对标注真实数据依赖严重，限制了可扩展部署；合成数据生成虽能减轻负担，但将现有仿真流程适配到目标部署需保持场景、感知、无线与学习配置一致，各耦合组件间的失配会损害仿真到现实的可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出AIMS智能体AI框架：输入为指定目标任务、部署条件与真实数据预算的自然语言部署请求，输出为部署特定的仿真到现实配置及任务模型。采用双智能体架构——场景构建智能体从共享物理状态生成地理接地的、同步的感知与无线记录；场景理解智能体配置任务相关模态与专家混合（MoE）学习，支持零样本推理或少样本适配。结构化领域知识指导依赖感知规划，验证证据支撑反馈驱动的决策修订。
AI.result: 在真实世界DeepSense 6G数据集上，车辆检测与波束预测性能优于所对比的仿真与融合基线。另设编排基准评估跨多样部署请求的任务解读、依赖推理与反馈驱动重规划，结果显示在结构化领域知识与验证反馈下规划正确性提升。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过智能体化、依赖感知且反馈驱动的自动化流程，有效缓解了多模态ISAC中仿真到现实迁移的配置失配问题，减少对标注真实数据的依赖，并在真实数据集与编排基准上验证了其有效性与规划可靠性。

title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. The authors contributed equally
summary: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use.
